ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.name: places/ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKR1FUUlFhM1pFUm05WmEzazVNRnBUWDJvdFJVRRAB
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.author: Duc Huynh
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.text:
We ordered Cơm Tấm for a company get-together, and wow, everyone was absolutely raving about it! My foreign colleague, who's tried Cơm Tấm before, was especially impressed. She couldn't stop talking about how incredibly tasty and generous the portions were – definitely the best she's had!
Everything from the professional, tidy, and super hygienic packaging to the food itself was top-notch. The Cơm Tấm quality hit the spot. The pork chop and pork rib were perfectly seasoned, tender, and still incredibly juicy even after delivery. And that fish sauce? It was the ideal complement, bringing all the flavors together beautifully.
Even the smaller details shone through: the sunny-side up egg was cooked to perfection, and both the seaweed soup and Vietnamese sour soup were delicious additions. We were all incredibly happy with the service and the entire experience.
If you don't mind spending extra for quality, this place really knows how to deliver a winning meal!

ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.name: places/ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pObWVVMTZkVTVYYkdRM1gyRm9NV1JSYW5BMVlXYxAB
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.author: Ky-Anh Lê-Hoàng
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.text:
I came here impressed by the rating and I was not disappointed. The food was very good, though not exceptional. Well-executed Cơm Tấm. And definitely go for the ribs! That's the difference-maker!

Other then that, the place is clean and the staff was nice.

ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.name: places/ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOTk1HcERRWEZzZG5OU1RrWkVSemxPVGxwTlluYxAB
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.author: Franciz “SG FlavorScape”
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.text:
Personally I felt the meal would not be better without its tasty condiments, soup and egg meat loaf ! They are really awesome.

Close your eyes and order the combo which is so worth it !

ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.name: places/ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KTlZYSjJOR05EUTNsWVgySmFlSE5tTkRsYVlWRRAB
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.author: guy levy
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.text: The food is delicious, the restaurant is air-conditioned and there is plenty of room to sit, the staff is kind, highly recommend!

ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.name: places/ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURma1ktY2xRRRAB
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.author: Neary R.
ChIJ2eSxOIQvdTERaL5Ume1Fz1w.text: Sooooo good! We’ve tried both the Hanoi location and this one and hands down— taste and quality is amazing. We actually like it better than a certain Michelin Guide one also in town. The meat is tender and soft here, rice seasoned just right. Also their side of soup has minced pork and seaweed. Super tasty!

ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.name: places/ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfdTZmcVBREAE
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.author: Cole Trần
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.text:
Not really well dish but very so so as usual of all other places. Rice cooked well and fish sauce save the mood of dish. Meat get much salty while seaweed soup get much sweat. Not a well balance at all. Anw, Price is very comfortable so it’s
reccomended!

ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.name: places/ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxS2QwMUhVRTgwWDJvNFNHNWhRMWxqYm5sc01HYxAB
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.author: Tri minh Nguyen
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.text:
On the street like its supposed to be our Beloved saigon cơm tấm ❤️

I had cơm tấm bi suon cha.. the standard

Broken Rice with Grilled pork chops, shredded pork skin & steamed egg meatloaf.

Pickled Veggies [Do Chua] were 6/10
Dipping sauce [Nuoc mam] 6/10
Had to mix it with chilly myself .. sauce wasn‘t in the syrup texture i know it which makes the rice soggy.. needs to be more like fluid honey.
Fried shallots [pork belly] mỡ hành 8/10 .. like it supposed to be. Missed a sprinkle salt but solid. Gives the dish the fattyness it needs.
Suon.. Pork Chops..- wow…perfectly marinated smokey grilled.. 10/10
Bi .. shredded pork skin 8/10 next time more for texture.
Cha …steamed egg meatloaf! 07/10 yum but i know better in flavour.

All combined… NEXT LEVEL YUM. It‘s definately one of the better Cơm tấmin hcmc

ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.name: places/ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNGN2FLcUF3EAE
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.author: Soda Chanh
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.text:
Not good at all!!!
I should not eat there when I arrived as it was a roadside hawker with no proper shelter.
However, it seemed will rain soon so I decided to have a quick bite.
Ordered the special spare ribs instead of the normal pork chop. The feeling was the same as one of the reviews.
The spare rib was a bit salty and without a good smell of honey, it was cool as usual as they normally grilled and then put them aside and wait for the order.
It costed me VND110.000 /115.000 and a total of VND130.000 including one fried egg and one cup of iced tea. And they didn’t even offer you a complimentary soup as of the other shops.
I can’t image such a dish of food and environment costs me more than double or even triple the price if you eat in the local wet market.
No service , ordinary good , expensive price …..

ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.name: places/ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21NMFFXazRRek5CVWw5bVZqVlJSV2t3Wmtkc01sRRAB
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.author: Ken D.
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.text: The food was cold and mushy. I saw the high reviews and decided to give this place a try. There are several piles of pork meat sitting at the window to attract customers, thus when you come to the shop they pick one of the piece that's been sitting on the window to feed you. It's a cold and very tough piece of meat. The cha was mushy, like it was over cooked, no texture at all. I would never eat here again and would advise anyone I know to not try it.

ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.name: places/ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmemVtRFBREAE
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.author: Trisyi's Midnight Diner
ChIJ7f-3qVsvdTERIu4FtN_tNlk.text: Wouldn’t hesitate to call it the best Com Tam in Saigon.

ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.name: places/ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUdnJucXZBRRAB
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.text: Since the eatery is nestled in a small alley, parking might be limited. The eatery offers more than just their grilled pork chops, the delicious array of dishes displayed at the counter is sure to tempt you. Every order comes with a side of sliced cucumbers and a bowl of pork rinds, with free refills on the rinds. Complimentary iced tea is served at every table with attentive water refills. However, accompanying soup is not included, you have to purchase it separately.

ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.name: places/ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQyb3VHLUp3EAE
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.author: Taro
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.text: Great cơm tấm place. Open from 18:00-23:00. The food might be a bit sweet but this is common in southern Vietnam. Even though it's  sweet, it taste very good. It's very cheap in my opinion. But this ks the best Cơm tấm I've had so far in Ho Chi Minh City

ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.name: places/ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPaDZYWGJBEAE
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.author: Tri Vuong
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.text: Daily open from 5pm to 11pm (have a day-off on Saturday). Location in the small alley with only suitable for motorists. More popular night Broken rices in Hang Xanh Junction, Binh Thanh district. Foods are delicious and tasty with reasonable price.

ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.name: places/ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNXbFl2ZmhRRRAB
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.author: Ak
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.text: This com tam store is located in a small alley. The meat is tender and the flavor is very good. You can park against the wall in front of the store, but there is not many peking spots.

ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.name: places/ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURWeTRPNWpRRRAB
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.author: Kyle Danubio
ChIJn-mHTuUpdTER70EYG4nfN_k.text:
One of my favorite Cơm Tấm spots in HCMC. It’s tucked in a quiet little alley off the main street in Binh Thanh and they have consistent good quality.

Personally, I’m a big fan of the chili side on the table and the trà đá is good as well! They also understand my Vietnamese very well so as a basic-level speaker and foreigner I’m very comfortable to go here and order. Check it out for good food and a nice low key experience!

ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.name: places/ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNockk2cW5RRRAB

ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.text: This is my favorite place for cơm tấm ever. I have eaten here since I was 8, and now I’m 25. It has moved location to and from across the street, price has increased over the years with inflation, but quality remains. Still the best meat I can find with thick cuts, savory seasoning, awesome nước mắm sauce, and decent service.

ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.name: places/ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNQNnUzNkt3EAE
ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.author: Thao Nguyen
ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.text: Good portion & quality but a little pricey compared to majority of other com tam places.

ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.name: places/ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURidDZQTjdRRRAB
ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.author: Aaron Nguyen
ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.text: Great food, clean place, friendly staffs. Always my favorite place!!!

ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.author: Thach Trung
ChIJrzWr3EwpdTERY20o88yp2kE.text: Very good Vietnamese broken rice, signature dish of southern area

ChIJ84vNoiYvdTERL-VzFM_kxSw.text: one of the best Com Tam that you can find in Saigon. I have eaten here for 8 years and the taste is still excellent. ChIJ84vNoiYvdTERL-VzFM_kxSw.name: places/ChIJ84vNoiYvdTERL-VzFM_kxSw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIdUllVGZ3EAE

Happened to walk past and smelled and looked so good so decided to buy 2 boxes to takeaway for the staffs at nam hy hotel.

The young guy speaks English. Friendly grandma is doing the cooking.

ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.name: places/ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKeE5raDJTMFE0VkhRNFpsa3lObk52TnpkWFYwRRAB
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.author: kyeongran lee
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.text: On the fifth day of my Vietnam trip, I was getting a little tired of pho, banh mi, and banh xeo, so I stopped by this place as soon as I arrived in Ho Chi Minh City. The prices are a bit high compared to the prices in Vietnam, but it seems like a lot of locals eat there. The smoke inside the restaurant is suffocating. Still, I was looking forward to the delicious food. The seasoning of the meat is similar to Korean pork ribs, but the quality is just so-so. The seasoning they give you is delicious when you mix it with rice. The portions are generous. It's worth going there at least once. If you're nearby, I recommend giving it a try. They charge for wet wipes, but you can't not use them if you're eating meat.

ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.name: places/ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOb2VEWTBia3AyZGxOQlRrSlRkazV5Wm5oSFFYYxAB
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.author: Assaro Pacharatam
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.text: The food itself could be one of the best Com Tam in town. Meat is juicy and taste really nice. Anyhow their service was terrible esp. if you go during their peak time like lunch. Many customers waiting for the table while some bad customers take the table without queuing.   They should think about better system. It took so long time until you can order and another long waiting until they serve you the food. Price is far above standard.

ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.name: places/ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214RlptcGZTVEZoYkhSd1NESXhURFF0UldZd2RrRRAB
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.author: Joshua Vo
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.text: Got there towards the end of lunch service so most of their extra toppings were no longer available. But it was a tasty plate of rice and glistening & lacquered meat. Love the charcoaled flavour, fluffy broken rice, and everything was well balanced

ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.name: places/ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSTllURk9aaTB4U1RWbk15MWhXazB3VFZKS1pHYxAB
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.author: Ellen Galperin
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.text: Arrived around 1pm and only had to wait 5-10 min for a table. The pork chop was HUGE and really delicious. Definitely recommend getting. There is one single user gender neutral bathroom. It was clean but bring your own toilet paper.

ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.name: places/ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xBMU5tSTRTR2RZYVVGclRsTmpkVVpxV0RCVFZtYxAB
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.author: 1780 Jameson
ChIJceyE634vdTERO_tDiCJDyJw.text: I've walked by this place many times, and this time I happened to be walking by. Even at 9 a.m., it was still packed. The menu is in multiple languages, which is very convenient. The pork chop was incredibly large. It tasted great. The service was also very friendly. This place was a real surprise.

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.name: places/ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmMHM2YjdBRRAB

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.text: Many cơm tấm places sell tough and chewy pork chops, but over here it is surprisingly tender and juicy. Not very attentive services, but it's fine to me as long as food is good

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.author: Ryan Lowe
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.text:
This place was so good that I ordered two plates!

The fish sauce on top the pork chop is one of the best dishes I’ve had in Vietnam. This place is a must try

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.name: places/ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMzNjVuSFRBEAE
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.author: Middlewest
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.text: On the side of the road, but the sidewalk is big and the tables are clean. I got a pork chop with rice and everything was tender and flavorful. No menu if you need English, but they were kind anyways

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.name: places/ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNCd2NybzVRRRAB
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.author: Pachi Kooki
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.text: Loved the com tam here! The char, fattiness and the sauce makes the perfect balance. Quick and cheap too!

ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.name: places/ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNCdHVYTDlnRRAB
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.author: Nick Nguyen
ChIJLfkVWh0vdTERcTV4xiQHHoU.text: Always Delicious, along with fast and friendly service!

ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.name: places/ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkU1oySlRlVTVEU1Vkdk9URnlOVVE0YkhabFgyYxAB
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.author: lynn koh
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.text: I din a lot as I was full. I ordered the grilled pork and fried spring roll. Overall the food was good! Especially the grilled pork. The service was above averaged, we was serve by a young guy, he recommended their must try food n beverages. He was very friendly.. Thumb up to him! Please keep it up.

ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.name: places/ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25neFNXcFliRWN4WW1RdFRFOUlUVFpUUmkwNWQwRRAB
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.author: Joyce DV
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.text: Food is bland. Staffs would ignore you. Prices does not include tax or service charge. We ordered bun cha but did not give us water for the rice paper until we asked for it. Will charge you for wet tissue. The only thing interesting in this restaurant is the interiors. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else. 😭

ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.name: places/ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOeUxYUk9hVzFzYlRWMVRHRnpZbEIzUkhaSlVFRRAB
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.author: Porter KHOR
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.text:
Food not great.  Vi Da Vietnamese eatery at Ben Thahn market was so much better.  Feels like typical chain restaurant using frozen meats cooked without any soul.

My pork chop and braised pork belly tasted like microwaved leftovers. Dry and hard at some parts. Don't get fooled by photos on menu.  The real dishes all turned out alot smaller.  Crab meat ball is one good example.

Pricey not great.  Walk out for better food .  I'll never be back here again.  Bill was 480k for two pax

ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.name: places/ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCTFptaEVjSGt0TTJOSk9GbGZXVTh3U0VzeWVGRRAB
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.author: Jessica Le
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.text:
I had such an amazing experience dining here! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere was cozy yet modern, making it perfect for both a casual meal or a special occasion.
The food was absolutely outstanding — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into the cooking. My personal favorites were Cơm Tấm, but honestly, everything we tried was delicious.
Service was quick and efficient, and the team made sure we always had what we needed. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes and the quality you get.

ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.name: places/ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5SGRVaGtXamxVWWpKa1prRlNiRFJCVW5WaWFXYxAB
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.author: Joe Kwong
ChIJF-t8ikcvdTER6FoyEbN9uNw.text: In Saigon Centre, B2 floor (Ho Chi Ming city) you will find this little Vietnamese restaurant. Looks like they’re serving different broken rice here, it’s authentic and tasty. Besides, we found other dishes are really nice too, the taste of their food is just right and details, with reasonable price as well. Recommend.

ChIJfxqV1cYodTER4QneDp0SI-A.name: places/ChIJfxqV1cYodTER4QneDp0SI-A/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pBeGNtSnFTV1pFVDFKNGEwdDFTM05xTmxkZlUxRRAB

meat is marinated really well
egg is cooked perfectly runny and seems very healthy chicken
sauce is yummy
chả is a little weird … maybe old (we did came late)

ChIJfxqV1cYodTER4QneDp0SI-A.author: Jack Tran
ChIJfxqV1cYodTER4QneDp0SI-A.text:
5-Star Review for Cơm Tấm Tài – Không Chi Nhánh:
I had an amazing experience at Cơm Tấm Tài – Không Chi Nhánh and I'm excited to share this review. This place truly impressed me from the ambiance to the food quality.
First, the space is clean, spacious, and well-organized, creating a comfortable dining atmosphere. The service is quick, friendly, and the staff is attentive and helpful.
As for the food, the cơm tấm here is absolutely delicious. The rice is soft and fluffy, the grilled pork is fragrant and perfectly marinated, not too greasy. The side dishes like the shredded pork skin, egg, and Chinese sausage are fresh and well-prepared, complementing the main dish perfectly. I particularly love the balanced taste of the dipping sauce—it’s flavorful without being too salty.
The price is reasonable, considering the quality of the food and service. Cơm Tấm Tài – Không Chi Nhánh truly deserves a 5-star rating, and it's a great choice for anyone craving authentic Saigon-style cơm tấm.
I’ll definitely be back to try more delicious dishes here!

ChIJfxqV1cYodTER4QneDp0SI-A.text: A local cơm tấm (broken rice) eatery with a rustic atmosphere, no parking space for cars. The interior is quite cramped with many tables. The food offers a variety of toppings to go with the broken rice, though the flavor leans a bit salty in my personal opinion, and the grilled pork is on the dry side. Overall, the quality is average, and the price is relatively high compared to the common price range in Ho Chi Minh City.

ChIJnaR7sMQvdTER2RWEBQURVwo.author: Christopher Wu
ChIJnaR7sMQvdTER2RWEBQURVwo.text:
The pork shop on rice was probably the most authentic one I’ve been to. You walk in and can see the street and all the cooking happening right in front of you, with trays of freshly marinated pork being brought from the back to the front — proper local vibes.

The meal itself wasn’t perfect, but when you’re paying under $10 AUD for a full set, you can’t complain. The serving of meat I got was a tiny bit chewy, but the rice was fluffy and fragrant, and all the sides worked well together. They also give you a chilli sauce to pour over the rice for extra flavour, which tied everything nicely.

Overall, one of my favourite com tam I had in Vietnam — didn’t try too many, but this one was pretty solid.

ChIJYVkplPsvdTERou8Pmu9gWk0.author: James Smith
ChIJYVkplPsvdTERou8Pmu9gWk0.text: Com Tam Phuong Suon Nuong on the corner of Tran Quoc Toan street # Pasteur is a popular restaurant but makes a strong impression thanks to its rich flavor and stable quality. The biggest attraction is definitely the grilled ribs, which are carefully marinated, grilled to just the right level, retaining their softness and characteristic aroma. When eaten with fluffy broken rice, fatty but not greasy scallion oil, and rich fish sauce, all the ingredients blend together very well. The restaurant has many side dishes such as pork skin, sausage, fried eggs, all of which are prepared cleanly and fresh. The prices here are very reasonable, suitable for workers, students or those who want to have a full meal but not expensive. The restaurant space is simple but airy, the tables and chairs are clean and always neatly arranged. The staff is friendly, bringing a comfortable feeling like eating at home. It is the combination of delicious, affordable, reasonable price and friendly service style that creates the restaurant's unique appeal.

If you're looking for an authentic, quality Cơm Tấm experience outside the usual tourist areas, this is it. Just note their short hours-you have to time your visit right!

ChIJcQHmfn0udTERUtLAsRlQwMQ.text: The eatery might have the largest number of customers in the area. However, they also have a large staff so the service is remarkably quick. The grilled pork chops were excessively large, so I requested they be cut into smaller pieces. Surprisingly, the staff brought scissors to the table for this task. Unfortunately, the chops were rather dry, lacking the usual tenderness. The fish sauce lacks viscosity. The portion of rice is generously sized and accompanied by an assortment of pickles and a basic soup. For an additional cost, seaweed or bitter gourd soup can be ordered, with a single bowl being sufficient for two people. Notably, the spoon and fork sets are meticulously wrapped in plastic, appearing clean but the daily accumulation of waste is concerning.

ChIJcQHmfn0udTERUtLAsRlQwMQ.text:
Came here with a group of local guests.  My first impression was awesome, better than expected.  The place was very clean.  Staff were friendly, helpful and efficient.  I had stewed fish and bitter melon soup (one of the best soups I have ever had).  My husband had pork chop, steamed egg meatloaf and shredded pork skin.  I tried some of his, and they were  very tasty.  The pickled vegetables were also yummy.  The food of others in our group also looked delicious!
I didn't know how much the food cost, but I heard that with this quality, the price was reasonable.
I will definitely recommend this place and come back to try other dishes when I am in Vietnam.

ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.name: places/ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aRGVubHdPRlpaUVhGV1JVVXlSbmg0UmtOUGNrRRAB
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.author: Tri Tran
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
As a Local Guide and a big fan of Vietnamese cuisine, I can confidently say that Cơm Tấm Bụi Sài Gòn is a must-try spot in District 1! I visited this place after reading some good reviews, and it absolutely lived up to the hype.
The broken rice (cơm tấm) here is flavorful and well-balanced. I tried the grilled pork chop with egg and pickled vegetables — the meat was juicy and marinated perfectly, and the rice had a nice texture. The fish sauce (nước mắm) was delicious and not overly salty. Portion size was generous for the price.
The restaurant is clean, organized, and gives off a very local and authentic Saigon vibe. Staff were friendly, helpful, and served food quickly even during busy hours. Also, I loved how the menu was easy to understand even for non-Vietnamese speakers.
It’s conveniently located on 100 Thạch Thị Thanh, just 8 minutes from the city center, and stays open until 10 PM — perfect for late lunch or early dinner.
Highly recommend this place to tourists and locals alike looking for a high-quality, affordable Vietnamese meal.

ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.name: places/ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvcWIzMWJREAE
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.author: Sarah Richins
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.text:
Saw this place the other day while walking and made a mental note to come back. So glad we came back for lunch today as it was delicious!

We were greeted by a friendly employee in English. We told him what we wanted. He offered to have an egg added to each of our plates which we definitely wanted. It's not listed on the menu but it looks like from other reviews they give it as an option upon ordering.

We took a seat and our food was served in under 5 mins. We did not order tea but it was brought to us. I'm not sure if we were charged for it but my husband said each of our meals cost about $80k.

We both ordered the honey pork chop which was so juicy and flavorful! Cannot wait to come back again.

There was nothing special about the atmosphere. Could have been cleaner but not unhygienic. You get what you pay for.

ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.text: I wouldn’t recommend Cơm Tấm Bụi Sài Gòn. Their menu is very misleading. It lists “bì, chả, ốp la” as 12k/1 phần, which implies that all three items together cost 12k. But when the bill comes, each item is charged separately. This feels dishonest and misleading. The food quality and taste are just average—not worth the confusion or the surprise at checkout.

ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.name: places/ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmcF91REhBEAE
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.author: James Murnane
ChIJe02E3cwodTEREiQiQfWPNJg.text: 🍚 🍖 🥕 solid com tam, good portion size and great for lunch. The fish sauce is not as sweet here. I prefer a bit sweeter but this may be good depending on your taste. Good location and comes with iced tea of course.

ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.name: places/ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRdEx5NFBREAE
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.author: Dude
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.text:
In A Nutshell:

-Ba Dat is a nice com tam (broken rice) restaurant.
-I like the low prices too.
-The food is freshly made, you just pull up & pick what you want on your plate.
-They even have stuffed bitter melon too.

Overall, this is a great choice in District 2.

ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.author: vanchai narinthavanich
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.text: Local broken rice witu grill pork, taste good , reasonable price

ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.author: Trung Huynh
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.text:
Quick lunch cơm tấm
Tables are not cleaned usually
Good food

ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.name: places/ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURad1B1NFJREAE
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.author: Val
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.text: I lived in D2 for 5 years and pretty much I ate every week. And when I moved out there, still sometimes I crave their Com Tam I wouldn’t mind to come back and eat. Their grilled pork chops seriously good, moisture (depends on the day if you lucky), not a dried hard piece of pork. Free soups and tra da always. I love a combo “cơm tấm sườn bì trứng kho” with the stew egg and pork skin in toasted rice powder.

ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.name: places/ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNlaXVfV29nRRAB
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.author: Ray Yeon
ChIJ1YRc-BomdTERTna4bTTZ0Tw.text:
A restaurant that I was drawn to by the smell of grilled meat of com tam~~~
At first, I was hesitant because it was a local style restaurant. But once I tasted it, I kept coming back and eating com tam.
And later, I took out  com tam and introduced it to my family.

My favorite is com tam with beer and spicy green small chilli~~

ChIJwSIdi1UudTER9SE9Q1zsM-4.name: places/ChIJwSIdi1UudTER9SE9Q1zsM-4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNNX2RTRkVnEAE
ChIJwSIdi1UudTER9SE9Q1zsM-4.author: Tai Vang
ChIJwSIdi1UudTER9SE9Q1zsM-4.text: Delicious food. Reasonable price for office workers.

ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.name: places/ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzanNHQmx3RRAB
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.author: 無名
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.text: I think the food is quite good here. I especially liked their canh chua soup. I can't believe they only charged 15000₫ for a bowl of it. The place looks like a typical low-rent Vietnamese small restaurant, but the service was good enough, and they got a little bit of English on their menu which is always helpful - actually not always. I like the street it's on too with its wide variety of restaurants. It's my go-to area for Vietnamese food.

ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.name: places/ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM1c3FEZnVnRRAB
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.author: M
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.text:
On a block with several different restaurants all right next to each other, I walked by, saw the food, and decided to try it. The girl working doesn't speak English (again, not like she needs to or is supposed to), upon finger pointing, she informed me the meat I wanted (the one closest to me in the photo) is the first one on the black menu binder; it's only 50K ($2). I don't know if it comes with an egg, but the menu photo shows one. I wanted two, and the total price was 65K ($2.60). Either, it's 15K for 2 eggs or per egg.

The guy was BBQing when I walked in, I'm guessing the meat was freshly grilled. It tasted great, especially considering the price. Seems to be a good place.

ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.name: places/ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURsLTVucEx3EAE
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.author: Sansitny Ruth
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.text:
The best Cơm Tấm Sườn I've had in the week I spent in Saigon. The meat is tender and has a perfect smokiness from the grill. The fish sauce has a good saltiness (not too sweet) that balances well with the meat. Finally, the steamed egg (egg pie) is one of the best I've ever had. Soft and flavorful, almost a creamy texture.

I also had the bitter melon soup on the side which was good. Personally I would op for a soup that's slightly more bitter, with a broth that has a bit more texture, by simmering it in the meat for a bit longer. I really wanted to try the sour shrimp soup but they had sold out.

ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.name: places/ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqOHN1dmZ3EAE
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.author: Sarah Richins
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.text:
This is a no frills restaurant with delicious plates of food.

English really isn't spoken here which is understandable. Although I ordered something different, we both got what my husband ordered, #3. I happily ate my meal and everything was delicious.

My husband tried ordering water and showed the server Google translate and the server kept saying "Pepsi", so we ordered a Pepsi. Again this is not their fault, we're the ones not able to communicate properly.

For just over $2 each, we ate a filling and tasty meal. I would definitely come back here during our stay.

ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.name: places/ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURiZ3Z1OEpBEAE
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.author: Quynh Nguyen
ChIJER5B08IvdTER1zrtZqVpbEw.text:
Taste is ok, price is ok, hefty protein portion for the price. I ordered cơm tấm thịt bì but the bì is a little pasty looking and could be better.
This is one of the signature dishes of Saigon, I’m on the lookout for a better tasting place.

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.name: places/ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLdkR4ZjdXcklhaHlBRRAB
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.author: HoangAnh Pham
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.text:
In the morning, I ate the old ribs grilled from yesterday, tough and dry
The water spinach was fermented and smelled of alcohol, old and dirty
I ate a little rice and threw the rest away
45k will never come back

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.name: places/ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNwaHFISHBnRRAB

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.text: Broken rice with pork chop is quite delicious. The service is also quite good. The downside is that the restaurant space is a bit small and not very airy.

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.name: places/ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNBcVlxZDdnRRAB
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.author: 烏八咫
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.text: It's cheap and the food comes out quickly. The taste is average.

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.name: places/ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3OExfM1dBEAE
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.author: Huong Thu
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.text: Morning I bought broken rice with ribs for 45k (only ribs) the sour food was like it had borax, it smelled so bad, the meat was so soft like it wasn't fresh, rotten, the rice was cold. I bought a portion of 45k but the patient and family couldn't swallow it... the food was really bad... It was worse than the broken rice with ribs restaurant I ate at Cau Calmette, District 4, portion 35k (the restaurant owner should try to eat and learn to survive in Saigon. If the restaurant owner doesn't know the famous restaurant in District 4, look it up on Google) The first time my mom ate rice and couldn't swallow it... you know how bad it was. I thought if I tried to add more food, I would have to sit on the toilet all day. (EVERYONE SHOULD NOT BUY IT TO EAT)

ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.name: places/ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNQemUtZzlnRRAB
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.author: Tu Thai Nhat
ChIJk4yDxmUvdTEROkGvmw2lhK4.text: The restaurant doesn't have spare ribs, they're for promotion. The food is bad, the patties are tiny and not clean. You shouldn't eat at this restaurant.

ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.name: places/ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toaGVuSlZRbFpzYWpONmRYcGpNbU5XWVZKQ2RHYxAB
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.text:
New broken rice restaurant on Nguyen Thi Dinh street, district 2. Due to road construction, the front is quite dusty, the facade is recessed so it's easy to pass by the restaurant. 

The restaurant's colorful decoration is also youthful and very Saigon. Everything is clean and tidy. 

The restaurant mainly sells broken rice. The rice grains are not very delicious, but the dishes such as ribs, sausage, soup, and fish sauce are quite delicious. 

The ribs are rich and soft, very fragrant when grilled. 

The sausage is a bit thin but delicious. 

The pickles are pickled cabbage, very ok to eat. 

The fish sauce is mixed with candy, permeates the rice. 

The soup is quite good quality with a lot of vegetables and minced meat inside, not just water. 

The iced tea served at the restaurant is made from Thai green tea and is also very cool to drink. 

The owner and staff are all friendly.

ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.name: places/ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210bmFXbzRNbmx1YkY5cldqbEJXbkpyV0ZCUWFIYxAB
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.author: Thị Hòa Hà
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.text: Office workers who eat on the street have found a restaurant that they really like. Just opened and tried it, but it's surprisingly delicious. This restaurant's ribs are well marinated and always hot and fragrant. The grilled pork vermicelli I tried was also delicious. The restaurant is simple, not fancy but clean, the saleswoman is cute, her conversation is heartwarming, I work far from home and every time I stop by, she asks me how I am like my mother. I accidentally stopped by and I'll always remember it. If anyone passes by and is hungry - stop by, you won't regret it!

ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.name: places/ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xOb2IyZHJaSEJKVDFwaE56VXpjWEJ6TjI4d1dXYxAB
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.author: Doanh Trần
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.text: The ribs are delicious, very suitable for the taste, the owner is very cheerful and enthusiastic

ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.name: places/ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tsVlgzSlNOVkJqU0V3ME4yZFhXRU15VDNsUlZWRRAB
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.author: Unuunu
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.text: The broken rice here is very delicious, suitable for my family's taste. The fish sauce is rich so I really like it. My family and I often order broken rice with pork chop, pork skin, and spring rolls, and grilled pork vermicelli. Although we don't live nearby, we still come by 3-4 times a week to order. The restaurant is clean, airy, and quiet. The owner is cheerful, enthusiastic, and very cute.

ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.name: places/ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKM1EwSkpORUpLYm5ONFdFOXJObXBJVFVGblpuYxAB
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.author: Lia Nguyen
ChIJW_JTcAAldTERaXVGts4wUZo.text: My family and I happened to pass by a newly opened restaurant and tried their food, and we really liked it. I liked the fish sauce with the rice; it was rich and flavorful. My family usually orders rice with pork ribs, pork skin, pork sausage, and Chinese sausage. The grilled pork vermicelli with spring rolls is also great. Since we live nearby, almost every time we don't cook lunch, we buy food from there right away 😋😋

ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.name: places/ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CQmFVRTRVMnN5TUZneU9WbGliWGRvVjNGclpIYxAB
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.author: Joe Unkx
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.text:
I had crispy lean pork (nạc giòn, 50k VND) with steamed crab meatloaf (chả cua, +10k). The rice portion wasn’t enough, so I ordered extra rice for +5k. The meal was okay overall, though the crab meatloaf tasted a bit strong for me. Next time, I’ll stick with just grilled pork and maybe add a fried egg.

Things I liked:

* The place is clean, bright, and airy, with a high ceiling

* Outdoor seating available

* Free self-serve iced tea

* Opens early at 7 AM

- 2025/09/27

ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.name: places/ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WdlpYbHdTWFJIWDNaM1JUVkViamRSVDBsb2RXYxAB
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.author: Darren Ong
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.text: Traditional com tam place in a local area. The pork ribs were tender and juicy. Rice was fragrant and texture is interesting as it is soft but not sticky.

ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.name: places/ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUREMk1IeERBEAE
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.text: While the broken rice with pork jowl is this eatery's signature dish, after experiencing it, I left thought that this eatery was completely overrated. Their shredded pork skin lacked the satisfying crispness and the distinct toasted rice aroma. The portion size was meager, the rice undercooked with a rough texture, and there was no complimentary soup included. An additional VND 20.000 per cup buys you soup, but the selection rotates daily between just two options. On Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, the soup is made from pickled mustard greens and beef tendons. On Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday, there will be seaweed soup with pork cartilage.

ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.name: places/ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNieDUycVNBEAE
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.author: Thanush Karthikeyan
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.text:
I went there at about 5pm, just as they were setting up and about to open the store for dinner time.

This area is relatively far away from the touristy part of HCMC, therefore they were no other tourists around when I went in the evening, there were lots of locals there eating, which made me feel that the food should be good, and indeed the food was amazing!!!

Although none of the store staff speak English, they made me feel so welcomed and comfortable, they communicated with me viz Google translate.

There is this really sweet old lady working there, I think she might be the owner of the store. Although she doesn't speak English, she was super friendly and welcoming, she was so nice and checking up on me if I enjoyed the food and if I wanted to order anything else.

Definitely would recommend this place although it's quite far away from the city center!

I spent vnd45k for my pork ribs option.

ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.name: places/ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMzODY3UUhREAE
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.author: Hà Minh Dũng
ChIJu6dThdYodTERPWbff_EopDI.text: eating here since a long time already. really worth a try. positive attitude of service and good food. price is affordable. a bit hard to find only. hope this review encourage you to try out. take the nạc giòn bì la, it is my fav

ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.name: places/ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SUFlqQkxZV3ROTTFOWlRsWkpPRlpSV2w5TVJXYxAB
ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.author: Candice Tran
ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.text: Been eating Com Tam Saigon at Bason and Thao Dien. Best Com Tam in HCMC!  Always friendly service. With this new location, I can eat my favorite Com Tam before flying! Price is reasonable too.

ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.name: places/ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGc1ZEaHdOMkZ5ZVVSdVVFdFRiVWR0UVZsQ1RYYxAB
ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.author: Tracy Nguyen
ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.text:
I had lunch here before my flight. When I ate, I only felt that the meat was marinated quite strongly, and it felt a bit mushy.

After checking in and waiting for the flight, I got food poisoning, constantly dizzy and vomiting and had to seek medical help.
Before that, I had nothing else to eat but food and water at the restaurant.
This was a very bad experience

ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.name: places/ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsWlNrbEJRbWd0VG1kcVptVklURXQ2YkU1U2VIYxAB

ChIJdQ0f1EMpdTERSgnUea_b3gw.text: The broken rice here is super delicious. In addition to selling broken rice, there are also office lunches with many dishes to choose from ❤️❤️

ChIJg98m1ZkldTERZrochLwF3yw.text: My favourite dish, 51. Great place with lots of different options to eat with very fresh ingredients. Definitely worth it!

ChIJg98m1ZkldTERZrochLwF3yw.text: A bit pricy but delicious food, warm and cozy atmosphere. Would like to come back again.

ChIJoTmIfwDXdDER3tHLyEDHSr0.text: The restaurant is true to its name, tried it and it was really delicious :)))

ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.name: places/ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRblktaHdBRRAB
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.author: André Mohr
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.text:
Great cơm tấm spot in a lively, very local neighborhood in District 3. The pork chop is well-marinated and nicely grilled, with a good balance of flavors and less sweet than others. A generous portion with pork chop and egg costs 57K, which is a good deal for the quality.

It’s just about walking distance from Pham Ngu Lao, making it a great option if you want to escape the tourist-heavy areas and try something more local. Well worth the effort!

ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.name: places/ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPeU0zX1dnEAE
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.author: Ak
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.text: I have to say this is the best Com Tam I have ever had after spending 3+yrs in Vietnam eating out every single day. I have probably tried 50+ com tam stores across Vietnam, but this tops the rest. The meat is tender and marinaded perfectly and it is super tasty. I got a full topping for 55k, but without any topping is 35k. Even the toppings were excellent, so you wanna make it worth if you are making a trip here. They even served free tea with ice and that also separates from the rest of com tam stores.

ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.name: places/ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPNGN1QU9nEAE
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.author: Melvin Tan
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.text:
Took the effort to find this gem of a place, pretty difficult to find and had to ask a local for directions.

But it was totally worth it. By far the best com tan I’ve ever had in my entire trip and will specially make a stop here again the next time I’m back in Vietnam 👍👍❤️

Ordered a com tan with extra egg and extra pork chop hahaha

ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.name: places/ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNvdVpuaUNnEAE
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.author: Fayt 117
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.text: Low plastic chair seating, medium noise alley, slightly windy/cool. The food (steak/egg/paste) is excellent. Price is above average but not too expensive.

ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.name: places/ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQwMFlHeFlREAE
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.author: Phil Witcomb
ChIJQ2XS-1EvdTERQ0elM6Rt8VE.text: Part of a food tour - this place does authentic northern pho. Delicious, nutricious and cheap 👍🏻. November 2019.

ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.name: places/ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2Njh6dU1REAE
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.author: Warren Ong
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.text: Hail Ye! Hail Ye! Hail Ye! "Com Tam An Duong Vuong is a broken rice paradise, and I’m not kidding when I say it’s probably the best in HCMC. The pork cutlet - Charcoal-grilled perfection, marinated so well it might as well have its own fan club. The sauces - Complimentary magic that ties the whole plate together. Tried the chili-stuffed meats and BBQ frog too—bold move, but totally worth it. Each bite was like a flavor party I didn’t want to leave. Prices are almost criminally affordable, and the staff - Super friendly, like they know you’re about to have a life-changing meal. Can’t stop, won’t stop coming back!"

ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.name: places/ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNocmN6ejhnRRAB
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.author: Thinh Nguyen
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.text:
Foods is delicious and in good quality. I love grilled pork, shrim, egg paste, squid...
Paid parking for cars and free parking for bikes
However, as It's a family business, the staff is not well trained.

ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.name: places/ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIeE92ekd3EAE
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.author: Sylvia Yong
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.text:
I saw on google map and their reviews seem to be ok, then i went here after 10 minutes walked from the hotel.

Sadly they didn’t speak english, so i tried my best to talk in vietnamese through google ckckckckck.

Almost their food contain pork, i just pointed food as if i choose a mistery box, yeay i ordered egg omelette again i needed to choose on 3 different taste without any clue, coz they kept talking in vietnamese, the girl was very nice, she allowed me to have a bit to try,,, yeah it was very good solution.

I picked pork skin, it was like rice noodles but it doesnt. They slice very thin ❤️❤️❤️

Then i chose pork with veggie, nice one also.

Rice with omelette, pork veggie, pork skin and soup it cost 130,000 VND.

I will come back to try their other food.
It is really easy to find, their resto in prime area, also got alot of seats.

ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.name: places/ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoeUlTaU9BEAE
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.author: Mike “Mike” Winn
ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.text: A very nice com tam place for breakfast. We heard this place is popular for their 30-40 years in business. The taste was delicious, but the price was way too much. It was $10 USD a dish! Most com tam in Vietnam only cost $2 to 3 dollars max.

ChIJEdKMruIudTERmj6mGCIR3Es.text:
Steep price for what it is. Not that tasty and food was very sweet. Not the nicest people as well.

80K com tam, 60k for whatever on the counter. Extra 50k for anything else on the counter. Was told I could mix and match the 60k dish but ended up getting charged extra!

ChIJE5yw9E8vdTERXaukLtHu9ho.text: Randomly search this place on google and decide to have a try. Surprisingly it was very delicious. The pork ribs taste good and the rice as well.

ChIJE5yw9E8vdTERXaukLtHu9ho.text:
It's super local, probably because of the location there's no tourists.

ChIJE5yw9E8vdTERXaukLtHu9ho.text: Generous portion, delicious taste, good price

ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.author: Tam Pham
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.text: Delicious cơm tấm. Big juicy meat. Nước mắm is a bit salty. Place is full of smoke and noisy from the fans. Very crowded.

ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.name: places/ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3d1lPVndRRRAB
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.author: tran thang
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.text: The portion is quite big for the meal others than that not think special. The taste is so so in my dish the porkchop is a bit hard and rough.

ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.name: places/ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNCcHF5dzFBRRAB
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.author: Mark King Vuong
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.text:
There are many cơm tấm places in the area but none are as awesome as this place.

Pork chop is huge, tender and so flavorful. All the other sides are just as good. First time I came, I ordered sường, bì, chả, ốp la and lạp xưởng with extra rice and bittermelon soup. It was wayyyy too much but I still finished it all because it was just that good. Now I only order 2-3 items and it's more than enough.

If you come at night, be prepared to wait a little bit because the line is literally out the door. You will end up sitting outside and the lady who sells drinks sometimes gets very cranky if people sit in her area but not order any drinks. Service is as good as it can be given the volume of people that show up and limited amount of staff they have so definitely have that expectation. The food is worth the wait so it's not a concern for me.

Prices are so cheap!!!

ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.name: places/ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwaUxMTkt3EAE
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.text:
A popular dinnertime rice shop that's hard to miss with its bright lights, filled seating and a billowing column of smoke, grilling dozens of porkchops at once. The pork is charred beautifully to develop a caramelized flavour, courteous of a sweetish umami glaze on top and a moist texture. The broken rice is cooked nicely and does a great job of soaking up all the juices that leaked out of the pork.

Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts!

ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.name: places/ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEa3FlSlFnEAE
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.author: Khôi D. Nguyễn (Tommy)
ChIJ1Sr_qoIvdTER9Fe1KBoI1T4.text: A bit pricey if the atmosphere and comfort were put into the equation. The dishes were above average, but nothing unique came to mind.

ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.name: places/ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmZ0lMVHFBRRAB
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.text:
This hidden broken rice spot is tucked away down a little alley, and is mostly frequented by locals. They sell out super fast, so if you arrive around 10:30 AM, you might find them already packing up for the day.

There is a few seats lining the alley and some inside a house, but the pork chops are grilled right at the entrance to the alley. Hence, no smoke smell even the space is limited.

The pork chops look fantastic, but I found them a bit sour and chewy. I suspect the meat might have been marinated for too long or perhaps the charcoal was a bit too hot.

Overall, the broken rice is decent value for money, and the ladies who run it are really friendly and welcoming.

ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.name: places/ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkb3R6a2xRRRAB
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.author: Linh Tran
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.text: A hidden gem with delicious food, friendly people, inexpensive, and nostalgic childhood alley breakfast spot. 10/10

ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.name: places/ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSeFlUbWV3EAE
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.author: Lucy Baylin
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.text: Super lovely owners, in a peaceful area. Delicious food & tea. Very yummy 100% recommended 😋 Thank you so much 🫶💕

ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.name: places/ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzMmJybFdnEAE
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.author: Nhân Nguyễn Trọng
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.text:
The rice here is delicious, the restaurant is in a small alley and is very crowded with customers.
The ribs are soft, fragrant, well-seasoned, and the pork patties are normal to me. Especially the restaurant's rice is hotter than the rice at the places I usually eat at, I'm in love with it🥰
In addition, the owner is cute and often jokes with guests. Well, there's a review saying the owner's daughter is very pretty but I didn't see anyone when I visited, so disappointed😞
This rice restaurant has been added to the list of broken rice restaurants I love.

ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.name: places/ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMwdzdIanJRRRAB
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.author: Nguyễn Xuân Nguyên
ChIJW00wKlYvdTERtrLxis6ETUQ.text: Broken rice restaurant in a small alley, affordable price but relatively delicious. The ribs are marinated very well and have a lot of skin. Rib rice costs 25k, (skin, sausage, fried egg) each dish costs 5k more (June 2022). The restaurant has free hot tea and iced tea.

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.text: very delicious and the owner is very funny, the assistant seller is also cute. Everyone should come and try 😍🥰😘

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.name: places/ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMTDdzYVNmek5uZ0d3EAE
ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.author: Minh Anh Lê Dương
ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.text: This rib rice dish is truly excellent! The ribs are well marinated, grilled until golden brown and fragrant, soft and sweet to the bite but still retain an attractive light chewiness. The rice is fluffy and hot, served with pickles, pork skin and fatty soft-boiled eggs and skillfully mixed fish sauce to make the flavor even more complete. Absolutely delicious!

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.name: places/ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6dk9UWnZRRRAB

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.text: A portion of rice as shown in the picture is 47k. The ribs are not that great, the sausage is bland, and the taste is not clear. There are only a few vegetables to eat. The price above is for the ribs and sausage, without soup. In general, it is expensive compared to the general level of District 11.

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.name: places/ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSbS1QU0hnEAE

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.text: Delicious, many dishes, fluffy rice, delicious skin, soft ribs, delicious bitter melon soup.

ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.name: places/ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNVbVp2UE9BEAE
ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.author: hoàng an
ChIJR5vnFJAudTERPQARQBJT-Ts.text: Just arrived in Saigon and was taken to eat here so I quite like it, sometimes at 11pm I still go in to buy some to eat. The food below is rice with spare ribs, I recommend eating rice with spare ribs and pork skin, it's really delicious. But there's not much rice, after finishing it I have to buy another plate. The price is quite high, but it's delicious, so it's not a problem. 35k for rice with spare ribs and pork skin. The restaurant is closed on Saturdays.

ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.name: places/ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tKU1dIVkhWMGhaVGpCVU5sOWpSemRNVm5rdE1IYxAB
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.author: Kaylee Nguyen
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.text:
Visited as a tourist and I’d rate it around 7.5/10. The food was decent (though the broken rice here wasn’t as good as other spots I’ve tried). Service is friendly, and the place feels more suitable for solo diners or couples since it’s quite busy and rushed.

Prices are very reasonable at 55–60k VND in District 1, so no complaints there. I’d call it a local food vendor with decent quality and good value , just don’t expect too much.

ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.name: places/ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toWWEyOVpXVVJHU2tsTVpVNTBPWEJ2VEhCQmRrRRAB
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.author: Sarah C
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.text: Such a bummer I have to write this but twice they tried to scam me here. Ordered #7, they “forgot” the shredded pork skin. Fine okay honest mistake. Went to pay, gave her 200,000 and gave me change short of 100,000!!! I caught her and was like ???????. She was like “oh sorry” and returned another 100,000. I hate that this happened, especially since I know how hard a job it is running a restaurant but when you’re a dishonest business you deserve to be called out. I went at 10pm, there was 1 other person dining, I look Asian but they realized I was a foreigner and guess that changed their attitude. Food? Subpar, nothing exciting to be honest had to douse a bunch of sauce over everything. The rice was meh, pork was fine, the pork skin was not good. The area outside to dine was littered with garbage and puddles and missing spoons and sauces on the tables and they didn’t give a shit until a local came and asked for those items. Pass on this place even at the “affordable” price.

ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.name: places/ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214MlQzTkRUak0yY0VSd1RGQnJZbmR6VVc5bFJXYxAB
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.author: B. Razote
ChIJUR-uXo8vdTERVmSPsBAsly0.text: Super good especially if you wanna eat like a local. Ate twice here and the food never disappointed. I always picked #4 with an extra order of egg. Highly recommend for those who wanna experience Com tam!

The grilled meat is plentiful and flavorful, the most impressive thing is the crispy spring rolls with shrimp inside, the spring rolls look like handmade ones because they are very firm and not like the ones that are just rolled with mushrooms growing inside.
The restaurant also sells other types of sweet rice cakes and rice noodles, which are also fatty and delicious but the price is a bit high (40 or 50 something, I forgot, because when I bought them, I calculated the total price of 2 boxes and didn't ask the price before buying).

ChIJR3iQHMMvdTERZ3rXQ74UszU.author: Hong Luu
ChIJR3iQHMMvdTERZ3rXQ74UszU.text:
The restaurant sells Hu tieu mi, Sui wonton, Mi vit nam. But the name has been changed to Phi Lu Mi Gia.

In general, the food is okay, the staff is okay, only the owner is unstable. Talking to regular customers is very cheerful and friendly. But when I sat down to eat, I felt something strange, like the smell of gunpowder wanting to fight. When leaving, I forgot my key and my wife turned around to get it. Standing outside looking in, I saw the owner staring at my wife, as if she wanted to eat her alive, she even raised her eyes to tell the staff to look over, and continued to stare until she realized I was staring. Insolent attitude, impolite, disrespectful to customers. Didn't even thank the customer when paying. Or was it because I asked for the special Mi Sui Wonton but didn't eat it, or was it because I didn't order a drink??? After finishing the bowl of noodles, I wanted to throw up and returned it to the restaurant. I have never written like this since I reviewed a restaurant until I came across this restaurant.

The best dishes are the ribs, both versions. The marinade they use is nice. Aside from that, the meatballs, stir fried green beans and beef, and the braised fish are all really good too. The chicken has really nice flavor but can sometimes be a bit dry.

This isn’t really a destination sort of place, it’s good everyday food

This shop is busy cause of YouTubers.

Where are the trash bins? It was a bit dirty inside the eating area.

Can definitely find better in Saigon, there’s plenty. It’s a shame, the workers are friendly.

ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.author: Calvin Bui
ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.text:
“Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền – where broken rice breaks your willpower”

This isn’t just cơm tấm. This is the cơm tấm. The kind that ruins all others for you. The pork chop here isn’t some sad, dry slab thrown on a plate. It’s a monster—thick, smoky, caramelized perfection, grilled to the point where the edges are crispy, the fat melts like butter, and every bite punches you with sweet, savory, and charred goodness.

Then there’s the rice. Soft but with just the right bite. Each grain soaks up that ridiculous fish sauce blend like it was made for this exact moment. The pickled veggies, the runny fried egg, the little side of chả trứng that adds an umami bomb to the mix—it’s a masterpiece of textures and flavors.

The place itself? No frills, no fancy plating, no unnecessary fluff. Just stainless steel tables, tiny plastic stools, and the intoxicating smell of pork sizzling over fire. The kind of joint where locals crush their plates in minutes and tourists look around wondering why they ever wasted money on hotel buffets.

If you’re in ho chi minh city and haven’t eaten here, you’re doing it wrong. Bring an empty stomach, a love for smoky meat, and the patience to wait in line—because this is the best damn cơm tấm in the city.

ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.name: places/ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfZ1BhdWJ3EAE

ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.text: Best com tam my family and I ever had. We went to this place because of Max Mcfarlin. The guy that owned the place was super nice. The way they cooked their pork was super good :). We had the pork jowl for the first time. It was better than the pork chop (suon). Where has this been all our lives? And the broken rice, soft boiled egg, egg cake and way-too-cool lardon made for an unforgettable meal. Can't wait to get back as our (USA) com tam does not compare!

ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.name: places/ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR4cjVicGN3EAE
ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.author: Ngoc Minh Duy Nguyen
ChIJG7nXwEApdTERIybmLVh785s.text: Very good food, the broken rice to me is one of the best I also love the sunny side up egg and the egg meat loaf. Owner is very friendly. Everything is great.

ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.name: places/ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNvOXB5SnJ3RRAB
ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.author: Phoi Bui
ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.text: Vietnamese rice with wide range of choices like fried eggs, BBQ pork ribs, etc... Price is a little bit higher than others in this area.

ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.name: places/ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBLUlYYkVREAE
ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.author: lqt
ChIJxW1duM8udTERjX87H9mf1dw.text: Not special food. I'm from Long Xuyen but this food is not same with Long Xuyen rice.

ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.name: places/ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkaWF6UnhTVVJvZW0xUlgxTkpNbmhFYTFOUGNsRRAB
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.author: Thi Truong
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.text:
The restaurant is on the spacious sidewalk of Cach Mang Thang 8 Street, the price is affordable, 30,000 VND for a plate of ribs, each additional dish is 5,000 VND more. In the city center, the price is already 35,000 VND, so the price is cheap. The fish sauce is quite good, the portion is enough, there is a little bit of pork fat and a bowl of soup. 
The minus point is that the food is cold, the rice, ribs and soup are all cold, the meat is not marinated well. 
The two young people selling are quick and friendly.

ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.name: places/ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5YVIyNXhNVU5xWjIxMFZHbEtNMUpUVnpsaloyYxAB
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.author: Khang Từ Vỹ
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.text: The restaurant is opposite the park, easy to find, the sidewalk is wide so you can park and sit comfortably. The restaurant is great, ribs, pork skin, sausage, eggs, soft, well-seasoned meat, rich fish sauce. The owner is also cheerful. The spoons and forks are clean, open late so anyone who wants broken rice at night can come here.

ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.name: places/ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKdXEwT1dwakt5NW9nRRAB
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.author: Nhat Dang
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.text:
The restaurant is opposite Le Thi Rieng park, cool to sit, watch people passing by, and even when it rains, there is still an umbrella.

The utensils and food cart are clean, the owner is friendly.

I ate ribs and grilled ribs, which were very flavorful and had their own unique flavor and characteristics of the restaurant. Although the ribs were not a sure bite, I personally found them very delicious. Because I was too busy eating, I only took a picture of the clean rice dish :D. The best part is the fish sauce, suitable for both people who like light and salty food... must try!

Definitely have to stop by here to eat after tiring working days or stressful football matches or training sessions.

The restaurant is open from 5pm to night.

ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.name: places/ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNX3UySW1wdnJYRkRnEAE
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.author: GIA Hi
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.text: The ribs are really delicious, just like the taste I used to eat when I was a kid. Here the ribs are hot, the rice is hot, the eggs are hot. I will definitely come back again ;)

ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.name: places/ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMRExwZWlGdHVHUEtBEAE
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.author: Phú Phú
ChIJM5dtdgAvdTERTTYAt-5-PCA.text: The food is delicious, cheap and the owners are also cute.

ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.name: places/ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNVLVpLeERBEAE
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.author: Hoang Nguyen
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.text: Good steak, and yummy. Price OK for office.

ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.name: places/ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25FeVNqVkhSQzF3ZFVKdlZsZFhibkZWZUVwbFJWRRAB
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.author: Tuấn Trần Anh
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.text: Everything was okay. I had rib rice which was seasoned well. The staff was friendly and cheerful. There were many dishes to choose from and the menu changed every day.

ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.name: places/ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURHc3JMVW9BRRAB
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.author: Mai Trang
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.text: Honey grilled ribs were delicious, well seasoned but not very tender. Chicken thighs did not taste like fried in fish sauce, the inside was still a little red. Bitter melon soup was of good quality, 1.5 fruits, each piece was stuffed with enough meat; it was not too bitter. Fish sauce was quite disappointing, too sweet, if it was a little sweeter, less sweet it would be better.

ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.name: places/ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR1aktfYllBEAE
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.author: Nhut Luu Nguyen
ChIJuZ9mvhkvdTERQWtxeJBq3hM.text: Delicious rice, cheap price, large parking lot, a bit hot inside.

ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.name: places/ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tKcFpUSkJOR3BhVG1Gc2JHSmpOMlZLUVhRMGJsRRAB
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.author: Ben Herman
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.text: This is an incredibly popular local joint that serves up the best grilled pork chop I’ve ever had. It’s huge, pretty tender, fatty in all the right spots and delicious. The rice is a dream - pillowy and soft. I particularly loved the fish sauce as well. It’s absolutely worth stopping in for a plate. Service was fast and there is additional parking across the street.

ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.name: places/ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WVGRWWnBSM0pETm10aWRHODVRVFF3UzNwU2IyYxAB
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.author: EC Chan
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.text: The BBQ pork chop, chicken drumstick and pork ribs were grilled to perfection. The smoky charred meats were flavorful! Some may find the meat slightly tough but overall it's yummy. The super thick meatloaf is awesome. Ordered their sour salty fish soup which is very mouth watering. Come here if you don't mind eating where the locals will go to next to a busy road.

ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.name: places/ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sVlZrZE5TMkpDT0VaTmJEZEROalYzUjFoWVRuYxAB
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.author: Nhi Bui
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.text: One of the best cơm tấm spots in Saigon. The special dish costs 130,000₫ and comes in a huge portion (something to keep in mind if you have a normal appetite). My brother couldnt even finish his. Everything was good, but the place was extremely crowded, so be prepared to share a table with strangers

ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.name: places/ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNvcF9mLTl3RRAB
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.author: Jesus Estrada
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.text:
Returned for dinner. Tried the chicken, sausage, and omelet. The chicken was good but not as meaty as the pork chop. Yhe skin was crispy. The sausage was ok. The omelet was good. It had sauted ground meat inside. Enjoyed the meal. Will return again.

Walked by, and it was really busy. Decided to stop. The staff are friendly and helpful. There is a simple menu, no pictures or descriptions. The options are visible at the stand. Got the pork chop with a fried egg. It was delicious. The meat was flavorful and tender. Even the gristle/fat was tasty. The price was very reasonable. The place has ambiance but pretty grimy. Will definitely return. Paid in cash.

ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.name: places/ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205UlRsSkxYMlpKTnpKUlJXcGhkWEZNTkZCVlJuYxAB
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.author: Sandrina Yap
ChIJJ1PXvGsvdTERh2MhYPwhYgM.text: One the best meals i had in ho chi minh city. Do not miss out. Only locals eat here, so you know it slaps. Seriously, you will regret leaving this city without trying this.

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.name: places/ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwOHVudXZ3RRAB
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.author: Bobby KT
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.text:
Good value for the price we pay. Great variety of dishes to choose. The quality is above average. Staff are helpful, although not that friendly. Tables are arranged a bit close to one another so I think it could get quite crammed during peak hours. Plenty of space to park, maybe even for cars.

Would recommend to try their bitter-gourd soup, as it tastes really close to that homemade taste.

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.name: places/ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKaHR6UmpRRRAB
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.author: Vaan Huynh
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.text:
High end street food in Vietnam when you have a “brand” on the food.
We got the typical marinate pork chop. Taste is so so -> 3.5/5 score. The portion size is small, I think. But beside pork, they also have chicken.
The place is clean, so it give a safe feelings of the food handling process is good here?

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.name: places/ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkMDY3V0xnEAE
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.author: Nguyễn Jamie
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.text:
The food was alright and the atmosphere was nice for a very sunny day.
They open during tet holiday so it was great to have good food around that time

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.name: places/ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIMEpfNXpRRRAB
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.author: Mia Nguyen
ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.text:
Order lunch to eat at the store on Saturday 12:30. No long queue but staff seemed busy, possibly with Grab orders. The girl took my order told me to not get combo, but separate dishes instead, she said it’d be cheaper. Total bill for 1 is 92,000 vnd. One week prior I ordered same chicken dish combo 1 soup & 1 cocacola for 69,000 vnd, could not remember if any discount was added. Then the bill printed out for main dish for 62,000 vnd. I wanted to pay by momo to the restaurant’s account, but she asked me to scan QR code to a personal account instead for the total bill.
Food was ok as always, but the staff is seriously not honest. The chain should look into this.

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.name: places/ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBN2QybGtRRRAB

ChIJP-ymOn8mdTEROBDMkAMftyw.text: Affordable price. Good taste but not many choices. Normal customer service

I ordered 2 rice dishes: pork ribs and crab ribs.

Free iced tea, parking in front of the restaurant. Quick service.

ChIJmZt7IAArdTER12Zpppa7moM.text:
My girlfriend and I tried crab cake and salted egg cake, both were delicious, the price was quite good with good service, will come back if there is a chance
The fish sauce is quite sweet and rich.
The salted egg cake is similar to the filling of salted egg meat dumplings, quite ok.
You should order more pork rinds to eat more

ChIJmZt7IAArdTER12Zpppa7moM.text: Delicious food, reasonable price, clean and cool restaurant. Lovely staff

ChIJmZt7IAArdTER12Zpppa7moM.text:

The rice was a lot but the sauce was a little bit fishy, ​​didn't ask the customer if they wanted chili or not, so the rice was delicious but the experience was a bit incomplete, hope to receive feedback so the restaurant can update
The restaurant is spacious and cool
The rice was okay, the price was okay, only the skin was missing :( there was a strange crab cake, a lot of rice. The restaurant wasn't too crowded so we had to be careful with the order control, otherwise customers would complain about the restaurant, still give 4 points

ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.text:
Delicious rice, suitable for the taste of marinated meat, rich in fish sauce, not too salty
Affordable restaurant with ok prices

ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.name: places/ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKNFA3dk9nEAE
ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.author: Duy Ngo
ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.text: Too delicious, fluffy rice, well marinated ribs, good fish sauce, skin and sausage are normal, in my opinion the deliciousness has decreased compared to 2 years ago.

ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.text: Food is prepared hygienically, seasoned just right, no sugar abuse. Enough to fill you up for dinner. Location is easy to find. Tables, chairs, and dishes are clean. Free iced tea.

ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.name: places/ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdWEyQmh3RRAB
ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.author: Tấm (scveditor)
ChIJ6-VSigwpdTERorNbee8dP4Q.text:
186 Truong Chinh Ward 13 QTB

87k - 2 rice dishes (rice with egg ribs, rice with pork ribs and Chinese sausage)

ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.name: places/ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmODltYXNnRRAB
ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.author: L. Tran
ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.text:
Very good tasting traditional Vietnamese food. Reasonable price. Five stars overall.

We ordered a small canh chua cá hú (sour fish soup), cá thu chien xoài (fried salmon), rau muống sào tỏi (garlic morning glory), rice, and muc xào hành cần (squid). Final bill is 235K VND. So good value and taste.

The fish soup has 1 slice of fish, but it was good and fatty fish. Also, the fried salmon dish was awesome with mango.

The dish that I may skip is squid, which was decent, but not as savory like others to repeat.

ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.name: places/ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM1NHNEYl93RRAB
ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.author: Reardon
ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.text: Pretty tasty food but I expected the pork chop to actually be more fried like it looked in the picture. Was definitely grilled more. Still delicious. Good serving of rice too. Fresh and hot. Was interesting as I sat with all local people who might’ve been shocked to see a white foreigner eat here. Refreshing lemongrass juice too. Staff was friendly but no English here. Okay for me because I point and choose. I recommend it as it’s affordable and under AC.

ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.text:
Litlle restaurant specilized in broken rice meals but also other standards available
Quality is good , servjce efficient and casual atmosphere
To enjoy vietnamese daily life , people going there during a break in the working day. Many families.are.going there the week end with the kids
Nice place

ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.name: places/ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaRFpsZGtiR3QzYzI1RVNHZHNPUzFVYUZCWGRWRRAB

ChIJO7WoaM0odTERvAh5eus5hME.text: Good vegan options if you combine few of them. Always enjoying eating here!

ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.text: You shouldn't eat it because it's very dirty and not delicious or clean =))) cucumber and rice have worms like the picture, I saw 1 or 2 so it must have been an accident so I didn't say anything while I was eating and almost finished, I saw another worm. ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.text: 42k meal??? Unbelievable. Disgusting. The pork belly was burnt black. No second time.

ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.author: Nguyen Thi Kieu Trinh
ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.text:
Separate broken rice, well-seasoned ribs, hot soup, reasonable price, enthusiastic owner, clean restaurant. Address right at 93 No Trang Long (No Trang Long - Phan Van Tri section), in the morning another owner sells pho, from 11am - 10pm the ladies sell broken rice with ribs, skin and sausage. 
At the beginning of the alley of Binh Hoa church. Very easy to find. Stop by to support the ladies often.

ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.text:
Price: A bit expensive compared to the portion
Quality: Clean appearance, small portion. I'm a girl and I eat a little but feel a little full. Nothing special about the NCL, won't come back.

ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0.name: places/ChIJzwLnbb4pdTERCgkeGAet4s0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xFeGJYWXRVbFZCU0hONlNXVmtURkZKV1Rod2FXYxAB
