ChIJkTJ8kBomdTERhaGCwPe1U5M.name: places/ChIJkTJ8kBomdTERhaGCwPe1U5M/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNXM2ZMemJnEAE
ChIJkTJ8kBomdTERhaGCwPe1U5M.author: Fat & Foodrious !!!
ChIJkTJ8kBomdTERhaGCwPe1U5M.text:
Good weekly option for lunch!

Hygiene 😐
Toilets are okich in terms of cleanliness but the access is right in front of the room, with a very thin door, so everyone can see you.
On the tables, cleanliness is variable depending on the waiters, some clean well, others dont pay so much attention.
The spoon and fork are wrapped inside a plastic cover, pretty good

Menu and Quality 😁
Large choice of different Com Tam and soups.
So you can eat regularly there.
I like the quality of the rice.

Price😁
A bit pricier than a Com Tam you can eat on the street of course..
But still comparable to other Com Tam franchise.

Service 😁
This time was good, nothing more to add.
(Sometimes no thar good, but again depends on the waiters and the training they receive from Management)

Location and Deco 😁
Good accessible location.
Deco sucks but hey, i am looking at my plate, especially at lunch time.
Not a place for a romantic dinner with ur love one, but more an efficient regular meal.

Overall,
Good option for regular lunches, in a clean place with a large choice of Com Tam and Soups.

ChIJi3uvDNUpdTERbnjQs1a2elE.text:

The side dishes look so attractive, there are many dishes, I want to eat every dish but usually when I go to a broken rice restaurant, I will always eat the traditional dish which always has ribs. The broken rice here is delicious, the ribs are marinated well, the fish sauce is not too outstanding but the overall dish is quite good. The accompanying soup looks like that but it is okay
The restaurant looks hot from the outside but inside is cool, clean and especially does not smell of grilling
The price is quite reasonable, my portion is just like the picture, only 95k

ChIJ-wzyp_oodTERMYW7Bnns8uI.author: Khanh Nguyen (Theodore)
ChIJ-wzyp_oodTERMYW7Bnns8uI.text:
After a very long time of city lockdown, this broken rice restaurant is opened again.

The packaging is quite clean and tidy in a small box like this, food decoration is also very nice. The sauce here is also very thick and sweet, maybe it was inspired by the taste of Me Kong provinces.

Pork is tender and flavorful, all toppings are a lot. However, therr is still one thing that i need to recommend that the rice should not stick together.

Overall, this place is very good for broken rice, i think it's very popular in Go Vap district because too many recommendations and comments on all food delivery apps.

So i am quite pleased that I had mt first plate of broken rice after city lockdown 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🤩😘😝

ChIJ-wzyp_oodTERMYW7Bnns8uI.author: RayRayRay Tan
ChIJ-wzyp_oodTERMYW7Bnns8uI.text:
A pretty serious fast food com tam place that focuses on quantity instead of pure profitability.

Portions are large and reasonable. Com tam suon bi cha trung cost me 66k VND.

Loads of options, not just pork, and ample seating although you might have to wait a bit while they turn over a table.

For a fast food, highly commercial operation, they do a good job.

Would I eat here every day? No.

Still not suitable for balance or satiety. Big quantities but something’s missing in the recipe whether it be marination or … love.

Still 5/5 stars. Can’t fault them.

Oh and bank transfer plus MoMo accepted, which is a bonus.

Will I come back? Possibly. This still remains one of the best food options around Go Vap Market.

ChIJp1uX7psvdTERI6RcefaAqBM.text:
Found this spot through social media and it’s definitely a 10/10 for Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang in HCMC. 🍜 Fresh toppings, comfortable seating, and quick service. Both the dry mix and soup version were super satisfying!
Price: 90k vnd per bowl

ChIJp1uX7psvdTERI6RcefaAqBM.name: places/ChIJp1uX7psvdTERI6RcefaAqBM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2aS1IamtRRRAB

ChIJp1uX7psvdTERI6RcefaAqBM.text:
A Phnom Penh noodle soup specialist, quality as expected.
The broth is one of the best broth I ever tasted for a soup Phnom Penh (Hũ Tiếu Nam Vang).  The portions are generous and the noodles are just perfect, not too sticky not too raw. Ingredients are fresh (two large fresh shrimps come along with tasteful meat, and quail egg). The brown sauce is too sweet though for my taste, but still ok. Price range is rather upmarket (expect around VND 93.000 / per bowl) but worth the price given the freshness and quality of the ingredients. Recommended.

ChIJp1uX7psvdTERI6RcefaAqBM.text: I've been eating here for 8 years and the flavor is still the same. I would say it's a very good bowl of hu tieu/mi for a steep price (100k/bowl) so it's fair for the price. It opens 24/7 and the restaurant is always kept clean.

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.name: places/ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGMU5Ga3lhRVZCV1c1aVEwNW1iMjVCZDBSUFIxRRAB
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.text:
Food @bredgyeats for more follow posts!

The rattling of the Saigon morning rush is the antithesis of the quiet serenity of the early Toronto mornings, the streets filled with hungry citizens searching for their next breakfast. I settled into a bowl of Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang – clean, sweet pork broth that’s aromatic with fried garlic and shallots, with tender minced pork and plump, fresh shrimp. Rice noodles were springy, just holding the broth, while fresh herbs and veg added a gentle, fresh bitterness. The jar of pickled garlic on the side, quickly emptied.

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.name: places/ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJRHNtNzNzMU9mTGRREAE

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.text:
My husband loves this restaurant. First time bring him here .
The soup were delicious and ingredients were fresh and tasty

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.name: places/ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzME1fMzFRRRAB
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.author: A B C Traveller
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.text: Recommended by a good friend. The place has regular customers. The restaurant offers very good noodle soup. The soup is tasty and the special is packed with meat and prawns. The portion is generous. It is considered one of the best hu tieu in the area. There is no parking space, but you can park on the opposite if you are coming over at night. If you ride motorbike, it is welcome to park in front of the entrance. They are open for delivery as well. Satisfied. Highly recommended.

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.name: places/ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkT2NHMVNaekJDVldaTGNHRmllVlJ2V2xSQ1RVRRAB
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.author: Phoebe Hoang
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.text: I had lunch here with my friends and experienced a surprising attitude from their SUPERVISOR (Tiến). I chose this restaurant after seeing it rated 4.3 stars with over 2,000 reviews. Since it was our first time dining here, we simply asked for a menu, but he ignored us and instead insisted on reading their signature dishes out loud. I asked politely for the menu again, and just before he walked away, he ROLLED EYES AT US. For context, it was around 2:30 p.m., and there were only two or three tables occupied—nowhere near busy at the time. The food was edible, but the service was completely unprofessional for a big restaurant like that.

ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.name: places/ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxb09qbnZRRRAB
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.author: Tchongi
ChIJsVVEWZUudTERhNCdMofMopc.text:
Delicious Mì & Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang. A must try in this area
Just realized I often take my soup in this crowded and quite capacious restaurant in Âu Cơ street but never wrote anything about it. Fault confessed is half redressed.
You can order either Mì or Hủ tiếu to your liking. Both soups are really well prepared, tasty broth, fresh ingredients (two large shrimps will ornate your soup), staff are active, quick to the uptake and know their role. The bowl of soup looks appetizing when presented. Take a mouthful and enjoy the explosion of savours, highly recommended

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.name: places/ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KVVYxTjNZMjVFTmtKUFFUSmxVekpWZFUxQ1EyYxAB
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.author: Alvin Terence
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.text:
Fantastic noodle shop! The noodles are excellent and the ingredients are always fresh – from the vegetables to the toppings, everything is prepared with great care. The place is very clean and well-kept, which makes the dining experience even better.

It can get really busy during peak hours, so be prepared for a bit of a wait. Most of the staff don’t speak much English, but the younger server can manage basic English, which helps a lot.

If you love noodles with a variety of fresh ingredients, this is definitely a spot worth visiting. Highly recommended!

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.name: places/ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tzNE16QTJVVFExUWpVeFZHaFpjRWhFVERJME9GRRAB
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.author: Drew
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.text: I ordered the Hu Tieu Muc for 65k. It was good but nothing special. It did have the most noodles ever for a hu tieu spot. Wished there was more Muc (squid) though. Way too many hu tieu spots in the area to try, but doubt I’ll find my way back here.

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.name: places/ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSNFlLSEpBEAE
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.author: Cyndi Travel
ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.text:
We ordered two plates of noodles, one in a soup version and the other in a dried version, both of which were outstanding. Although the noodles resembled Malaysian pork noodles in appearance, the flavor was distinctly different and superior. We highly recommend this hidden gem to anyone looking for delicious and authentic Cambodian noodles.

For those who want more food recommendations in Vietnam and Malaysia, feel free to follow iamcynditravel in Instagram.

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.name: places/ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUeE9Yb1ZREAE

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.text: Food was delicious. Order one dry noodles and one soup noodles. Realised I left my phone in the Grab (cab) on the way here. Lady at the shop was so kind as to help me speak to the Grab driver using my partner’s phone as we don’t speak Vietnamese. Grab driver came back to return my phone. The lady refused to accept some tips as my token of appreciation—really kind spirit! Totally recommend this shop and will definitely visit again!

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.name: places/ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURJMWRhT3h3RRAB

ChIJ2bwbhSEvdTERjPDEzGiDR3c.text: Pretty good deal. Went there by mistake and had no idea what to order because they don’t have a menu. ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.name: places/ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25NM1VFaHlZbWhKTlhSTFlqbENVMmxRZVhwVWVrRRAB
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.author: Hoang Nguyen
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.text: I recently stumbled upon the cleanest hu tieu restaurant, and I'm so excited to share! 🍜 The food was incredibly fresh. They even clean the shrimp guts! Broth bursting with flavor in every single bite. I highly recommend trying their special; you won't regret it, trust me! 😋 The service was also top-notch, making the whole dining experience amazing. This place is a hidden gem that everyone should check out, and I can't wait to go back soon. ✨ #HuTieuHeaven #CleanEats #FoodieFinds #MustTry

ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.name: places/ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sVGRXUm5jakJFTFZGT1ozQXlRamN6ZVY5T1oyYxAB
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.author: Ron Weksler
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.text: We had the soup special. Definitely one of the best soups we had in all of Vietnam. Wonderful nice and friendly staff. Would 100% recommend! We will definitely be back! See you again soon!

ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.name: places/ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCd2RXMUdWelZLZG1vM2MwVTRPVFJ1WDNGNE0xRRAB
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.author: Derek
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.text: I had the dry special noodles. Very fresh ingredients - love the prawns and the delicious soup which tastes like the bak chor mee in Singapore. The place is also very clean. Must try!

ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.name: places/ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfNjZuRzd3RRAB
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.author: Faith Teo
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.text: One of the best noodles I’ve had in town, recommended by my local friends as a must-try. The soup was just to my liking, and the ingredients were incredibly fresh. The iced tea is a must-try in HCM City as it’s really refreshing! :)

ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.name: places/ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tZMWEzbDFhMUZNVFVnelpIZFBVamhMU2xOaFdWRRAB
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.author: Bao Lg
ChIJAwwefhkvdTERdA9wAXn7Ccc.text: I love this place! It is like home foods, it is running by sister’s grandmas and aunty. They are all so awesome and I adored this place. Must try to eat here, def coming back every time I’m back in Sai Gon.

ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.name: places/ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214VU0ycHdSRzlNUVRsdWRHOHhXVFpoYlhsTVlrRRAB
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.author: Nguyễn Trần Phương Hoàng
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.text: I really loved my meal here. The wonton noodles were delicious. The broth was tasty and comforting, and the wontons were soft, fresh, and full of meat. The crispy shrimp doughy thing on top added a great crunch too. Everything was served hot and fresh, and the portion was generous. The place is clean, the staff are friendly, and the prices are very reasonable.

ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.name: places/ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNYNGV2bU93EAE
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.text:
Despite its reputation as a long-established Chinese eatery that has been maintained through many generations, I personally find the taste of the food here to be the least authentic Chinese cuisine among the Chinese eateries I have experienced.

The noodles are dry and overly firm, with a golden hue but excessive greasiness. The toppings are unremarkable, and the broth is notably bland. The eatery is situated in a narrow alley, making it difficult to spot, and there are limited parking options for motorbikes. Even though the eatery was not overly busy when I arrived, I had to wait a considerable amount of time to be served.

ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.name: places/ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJcXJEMER3EAE
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.author: Kelvin Pham
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.text:
We’ve been here already where we already had our dinner. This is the second time me and my gf been here. I must admit this local res is still the same.
The taste the flavor and dimsum tasted same as usual. Nothing changed still delicious and tasty.
We ordered 1 mix noodle with dimsum and noodle dimsum. 1 bowl equals 70k and har gow that costs 30k/4 piece

ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.name: places/ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJbUlMQXRnRRAB
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.author: Gliese
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.text:
After seeing a video about their handmade noodles, i visited Thiệu Ký Mì Gia, noodle stall serving Saigon since the 1930s. They did not disappoint, springy and classic noodle! The owner and staff were very friendly, and I was amazed by their cantonese speaking level. It was a great experience being able to order in cantonese away from home.

Don’t miss their 虾饺(shrimp dumplings) and 烧卖(siu mai), both are delicious. Highly recommend for authentic cantonese style handmade noodles in Ho Chi Minh City!
*Will be back again for my next HCMC holiday!

ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.name: places/ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM5dEtfOFl3EAE
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.author: Hai Phan (Francis)
ChIJSaUfje0udTERRLbSTf_Rjp8.text: A long-standing Chinese noodle shop in a small alley.  It has now expanded to a number of neighboring houses so the seating is quite spacious and comfortable.  Delicious dish, chewy noodles.  Staff are quite friendly.  However, the shop is located in a small alley so it is more convenient for motorbike riding.  If you come by car, you have to find parking on nearby streets (parking is allowed on even and odd days) and then walk into the restaurant.  The price of the dish is about 50 to 60 thousand per serving

ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.name: places/ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OUk1DMU5ZMmhmUm01ZmNERjRjVzlRTkdRd1oxRRAB
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.author: T O
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.text:
This restaurant, famous for its southern Vietnamese soupless noodles, was featured in our guidebook.

Since it was close to my hotel, I stopped in for breakfast.

The food was as delicious as I expected. Thin, white noodles were topped with generous amounts of ingredients like crab, shrimp, and liver, and drizzled in a sweet sauce. It also came with crab soup (there was pepper on the rim of the cup), and the price was 70,000 VND.

In addition to the condiments, green chilies and lime were also available on the table.

They also had a vegetable and meat pie and a coriander pie, but these were charged separately. (The pies themselves were delicious, but they were also great dipped in soup! I saw locals buying them in bulk.)

It's delicious on its own, but it's also great with vegetables and coriander. I recommend adding lime halfway through for a refreshing taste, or pouring the soup over it at the end.

Since I was alone, I ordered the noodles and soup (the noodles were yellow) and ate it while it was still hot.

As a big eater, I had a great time!

*This restaurant follows the local style of cooking on-site and eating outside.

ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.name: places/ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3czUzd1JnEAE
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.author: Lora Huang
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.text: Stayed across the street while visiting the city and saw this place from outside my window. I always saw people there eating and decided to try it out. When walking by, it doesn't look that inviting, but it is worth a stop. They have a nice menu with photos so you can see what you are ordering. They didn't have a menu in English, but that is part of its charm. Sometimes, you just order and end up getting more than expected. The soup was fragrant and flavorful and had little bits of ground meat, regular beef slices, and a prawn; it comes with a side of veggies. They had some pickled garlic and hot peppers on the table which added even more to the flavour. I suggest you eat half a bowl as is before adding the sauces. Sure, you can go to an actual restaurant with air conditioning, but I feel this is part of the charm of being in Vietnam.

ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.name: places/ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNQzgxX20tcXVuS2ZREAE
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.author: Jesus Estrada
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.text: Went for breakfast on a weekday. It was busy but not crowded. The staff are efficient. Some speak a little English. They have a menu with pictures and but no English descriptions. I ordered the noodles with crab. It was delicious. Had several crab claws, pieces of crab, minced meat, and a quail egg. The noodles were a little difficult to pry apart but still really good. Came with soup and veg. The soup was very flavorful. Also got a pate pastry. The pate pastry was ok. Probably better when it's fresh. Paid in cash. The location is meh, but the food is really good. Recommended.

ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.name: places/ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNcS1zYVdQaU9UeDBRRRAB
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.author: Rebecca Hoang
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.text: Tried the local street-side breakfast in Ho Chi Minh City — kway teo noodles, one dry and one soup. Both were flavourful and satisfying. The setup is simple, with tables and chairs along the pavement. It’s all part of the charm, though not the most polished setting. Prices are very reasonable, making it a great option for a quick, authentic bite.

ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.name: places/ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCZlYzSkRTREJSYkVKaFlWUmFibVJKZVhKa1RHYxAB
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.author: ZEB
ChIJxc6LMEcvdTERcQFk6K9xsM0.text:
Walked by this shop early morning.

Give it a try. It was surprisingly good tasting.

ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.name: places/ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25WR09WTkNWalppTlZkU2NGRnNXR2QxZEVSeE9HYxAB
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.author: Van Ngo
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.text: I went for the wonton noodle soup instead of the Cambodian one because it seems like they no longer serve the non-organ option. The dish is done well but nothing special. However, the pork bun is definitely a highlight. Very mouthful and delicious with all the ingredients like quail egg, salted egg, and Chinese sausage. Nice portion and careful packaging. Service and ambience is good. Not cheap but worth the price.

ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.name: places/ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toU2NqbEZRa2xzYTBkWmRtOUhlWGRXVW5aUWQzYxAB
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.author: Nhi Bui
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.text: Best hủ tiếu in SG, especially their vegetarian one. Every time someone craves hủ tiếu, this is where we go or order from. Everyone I’ve recommended it to fell in love with it. Visited all their branches - enjoyed them all. Definitely coming back & recommending more people here

ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.name: places/ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGalJrODNabWxTVUROcGRsb3RMVkpDVEdkSWRHYxAB
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.author: russell ng
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.text: This was a very good meal and one of my favourite Cambodian noodles in Vietnam and I had this one last year so I was very happy to come back here again and have this meal once again. I think the noodles are my favourite part about this the spring rolls  were not my favorite. But I thought they were very cute and small. It was very nice ambiance inside and this is a very nice place to go. Try some good Cambodian noodles I’m happy because in Vancouver we have one as well, but there’s a lot more expenses and it is also not as good to compare to you dumb but if I ever crave these needles, at least I can come back to the one in Vancouver

ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.name: places/ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xSbWVWUXpiSFJaUW1kVlQyWjBlbk5vZFZGb1VHYxAB
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.author: 曾学莉Sally Chan
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.text:
Credit must go to Pat (a staff member at 389 Ban Co Ward). He was very attentive and knew it was our first time trying Vietnamese food. He helped me prepare the sauce for Ven Hang, switched the menu into Chinese, and even changed the background music to Chinese (even though we were the only table there). All these thoughtful touches were thanks to Pat.

On top of that, the food was delicious—especially the meat buns, which were really amazing! Definitely worth a try.

ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.name: places/ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twQmVXTnhOSFJCZDJaSlJuQmtjVXhhWm13eE1IYxAB
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.author: The MY World
ChIJa84CUSIvdTERyXeHC2uw9K4.text: It's laxuary Hu Tieu restaurant, which was selected as "Selected" by Michelin. The shop  were comfortable and their service was nice, very friendly and taking care of many details. I had Hu Tieu Chay (Vegetarian). It cost nearly tripple comparing to the one on the street Lol. but I found that it's completely different food and level. It tasts really good and well designed and considered. It's expensive but I don't complain because of their quality.

ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.name: places/ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMwcXBEeW9RRRAB
ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.author: Anh Tran
ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.text:
Lovely and tasty food. The squid is nice and the soup is full of flavour. Love it.

The owner of this place is nice and friendly when she gently provide suggestion for new guest about the food in her restaurant. You have to give it a try.

ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.name: places/ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURRMS1Ud2t3RRAB

ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.text: The noodle with cuttle have good taste, I would come back a next time

ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.author: Nobody
ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.text: Price is reasonable for fresh ingredients

ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.name: places/ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNReHNQcUhnEAE
ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.author: Thanh Danh
ChIJ-atOpM8udTERYLNbbSfsMw0.text: A wow Noodle but dish is small. Have to take 2 dishes per time.

ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.name: places/ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ORk4xOW1XbUZzVFdkVWJGSXdkMjlCVm01RFNYYxAB
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.author: Melvyn Lee
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.text:
Before anyone takes this the wrong way, its just my honest opinion alright so here goes.

Had a night to settle my dinner alone as my local crew all had plans *rightfully so its the weekend, and this place was listed in their recommendations for local food. Anyways i never really cared about reviews score above 4 stars and just went for this joint.

Needs alittle navigation through a small alley but its not rocket science just follow the sign right infront of you. Not sure about before but i appreciate that place is decked out with traditional low bamboo seats and tables , yet in the other room modern steel tables and chairs.

Now for the food i believe all cuisines came from their culture and history so that being said , i was very surprised the flavours were so relatable and delicious. The soup was clean and briny to perfection from the squids being cooked on order, hu tieu noodles just tender to the bite and soaks up the broth in every mouthful. Also love how they blanched the greens on the side not distracting the flavour of the broth with its greeny taste. And from the photos , i cleaned up everything also all these for just ONE PERSON.

So please give authentic joints like this a try , im sure your tummy will thank u.

ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.name: places/ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pobVpVVjJUVUozYkUxTFgyRkNUbTVFU0ZjeWQyYxAB
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.author: D.
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.text:
As far as trad Vietnamese places go, the bamboo slatted tables and cozy, clean utensils + spices will not leave you wanting more.

Proprietress speaks Cantonese (and English, quite well- actually, everyone there communicates well in English). Will upsell you special tea & spring rolls, but it don’t matter because the seafood in the broth is cooked to *perfection*. I often hate soup & scallops in shrimp because they’re egregiously overcooked, but not here. Delicious, light but also somehow filling.

ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.name: places/ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wNE5VaDRVblZ6UW05Mk0waEtUelpaWDJwbGFrRRAB
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.author: Kevin Nguyen
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.text: If you are finding a good distinct style bowl of squid noodles in a distinct style,this is the place. The brooth has a squishy taste and smell while the squid itself is surprisingly soft and tasty. However,service would be quite unattentive and unwelcoming… The shop is located in a hidden,dark and muddy alley in the heart of Saigon.

ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.name: places/ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOb1pEWk1XVWsxVVhVMVFteGtWM1F6Y0ZKSlJFRRAB
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.author: Leonard Mah
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.text: Absolutely delicious Hu Tieu with one of the best broths I’ve had. We had the scallop and the pork rib (unfortunately did not realise the shop was named for their squid!). A hidden gem in the alleyway!

ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.name: places/ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN1eHBEbm1BRRAB
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.author: Alex Low
ChIJ487QY7wvdTERq6XWah2EVcQ.text: Hidden gem in the back alley of the busy district 1. Looks simple, taste superb. Clean, fresh & delicious. Will recommend all tourist to give it a try. They don’t have deep pockets for marketing like those big organizations. But good food can still be shared by normal people like me😉

ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.name: places/ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twNmJrVkdiV3RJU1doRFRWVnJOM2h6ZGtwclJYYxAB
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.author: David Zhang
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.text:
The noodles are fine
The toppings are good
The soup is too sweet for me

Normally, I drink all the soup when I’m done, but in this case, I couldn’t drink any extra soup at all

ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.name: places/ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNacDUzaGZBEAE
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.author: Emma L
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.text:
I love your pho so much.
The taste of it brings back my memories of my first trip in Vietnam.
all the staffs are so friendly even though we can’t communicate in English or Vietnamese but they still provide great services to me.
The shop owner is very kind to me as well.
I’ll come back and visit you guys every time I go back to Vietnam😘

ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.name: places/ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURCbzVtSWdBRRAB
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.author: Case Woo
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.text: Ordered one Hủ tiếu and one Mì Tươi, each bowl came fully loaded with choc full of meat ingredients, chunky prawns, quail eggs, including separately well-packed extra herbs, veggies, bean sprouts, lime, cut chili, soup and sauce. Definitely add the sauce and a bit of soup to stir it all up. Awesome tasty stuff. Love the soup. Very shiok.

ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.name: places/ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMweV8zWUhnEAE
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.author: My Nguyen
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.text: So delicious noodle, very tasty and clean shop. However, staff sometime not concentrate in their job much, and when crowed have to wait for food long time.

ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.name: places/ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNpLUpfSWR3EAE
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.author: tai nguyen
ChIJt4yrU5kvdTER5eSNEzxL_kk.text: Rice vermicelli soup with shrimp, pork meat ... its ok. Not so delicious.

ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.name: places/ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3a2JyR1h3EAE
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.author: Hà Minh Dũng
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.text: nice local noodle shop with different choice of noodle. from egg noodle to rice noodle. with various topping from pork intestin to charsiu, fish and shrimp. the soup base is sweet but without using umami powder. the shop is clean and tidy. staff are nice and plenty of motobike parking

ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.name: places/ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNaaTdtTkh3EAE
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.author: X Lou
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.text:
Truly deserving of their 5 stars rating. Food was absolutely delicious and supremely flavourful. Noodles were cooked perfectly al dente. Ingredients were fresh, cleaned well and generous. The garlic infused noodle and dipping sauce was packed a punch. The owner/chef speaks some English too which helps. Our noodles cost 92,000 dong per bowl.

Highly recommended HCM if you like this pork noodles.

ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.name: places/ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNaaTVuV0F3EAE
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.author: Larence Chong
ChIJ8SQRfmkvdTERu5lWdkc7lT4.text:

ChIJczgnxNwpdTERePJbyCIEhSo.text:
quán hủ tíu nam vang thành đạt is the real deal for cambodian-style noodles

THE BROTH THAT HITS DIFFERENT
this spot serves up a crystal-clear pork broth that's pure comfort in a bowl. it's light yet packed with flavor, simmered for hours until it's straight fire.

THE TOPPINGS SITUATION
they absolutely load up your bowl with the good stuff. ground pork, quail eggs, slices of liver, and perfectly cooked noodles. the portion sizes are generous and every component is on point.

THE NO-FRILLS VIBES
this is a proper local joint with plastic stools and zero pretension. the constant flow of regulars says everything you need to know. it's authentic, affordable, and always hits the spot.

THE PRO TIP
the real move is ordering it "kho" (dry). the noodles come separate from the broth with all the toppings and a special sauce. it's a local hack that absolutely slaps.

THE FINAL CALL
if you're chasing a comforting, flavor-packed noodle bowl that won't break the bank, this place is an absolute serve. don't sleep on the dry version.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJqRioikktdTEREgnfNrRtA9I.text:
- A restaurant that has been open for quite a while (I've known this restaurant for about 2 years now), part of the Nam Vang Dai Thanh noodle chain.

- The most memorable memory when coming to this restaurant is that I ordered soft noodles, which are actually beautiful noodles.
- With the noodle soup, I rate this restaurant quite well, the bowl is quite nice and full, with fried garlic (sometimes with garlic skin), minced meat (boiled in the noodle soup, not stir-fried), shrimp most of the times I eat is very fresh, sliced ​​pork liver (thinly sliced ​​and then blanched in the noodle soup, pork also cut before blanching, and pig heart, the general feeling is that the noodle soup is stewed in addition to bones and shrimp, there is also dried squid and the taste of the toppings, but sometimes for some reason, there will be times when the noodle bowl has too much MSG (rarely). Served with raw vegetables (curly lettuce, celery, bean sprouts, chives).
- I highly rate the dry noodles here, the noodles are chewy, delicious, small, rich in the flavor of the mixed sauce, when eating mixed noodles, there will be a few more sweet and sour lotus roots, delicious.
- In addition, this restaurant has plum sauce, very delicious, when eaten with noodles, in addition to xa te restaurant This has a strong lemongrass flavor, but is very spicy.

ChIJT082HQAvdTERrDTEPklsu6M.text:
I had walked past the restaurant on many occasions and often had seen the proprietor usually sitting outside and looking very like his advertising image. This time we chose to dine there and it was everything that we had expected. The front of the restaurant gives a very professional and polished image, and the eager staff were quick to seat you either front dining area, which on the day we chose to dine there was a little warm, despite the ventilation that was offered. We were however directed then to the very large air conditioned dining area, which really suited a Westerner dining on a hot soup or Hot Pot.
The Special Shrimp and Squid Noodle Soup was exactly as titled,
with a wonderful flavourful soup filled with colourful seafood, and with extra bean sprouts and vegetables to be added to suit. It was special indeed and very reasonably priced.
This place will be a regular revisit, as the service was remarkably fast, and very comfortable to dine there.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

ChIJeUVh_UQvdTER8mWG7ZR5TqY.text:
I've been on a quest for the perfect bánh bao (steamed bun) ever since I moved to Ho Chi Minh City. There are so many places selling them, but I was looking for something that tasted less like a mass-produced snack and more like a warm memory. I'd heard whispers about Quán ăn Cả Cần and their legendary buns, so I decided to give them a try for a takeaway order.

From the moment I got home and unwrapped the paper, a wave of nostalgia hit me. The smell of the bun was a perfect blend of sweet dough and savory filling, instantly transporting me back to my childhood. The buns themselves weren't perfectly round or uniform; they had that wonderful, rustic, handmade look that makes you feel like someone poured their heart into making them.

And the taste? Oh, the taste. The dough was soft, fluffy, and slightly sweet – not overwhelmingly so, just enough to complement the filling. The filling itself was a revelation. A generous mix of minced pork, a savory quail egg, and a slice of Chinese sausage, all seasoned just right. It wasn't greasy or heavy. It was comforting, familiar, and utterly delicious.

This wasn't just a snack; it was a moment of pure comfort. Eating that bánh bao felt like a gentle hug, a reminder of the simple, honest flavors I grew up with. It was a taste of home in a city that's still new to me.

While the service was quick and efficient for a takeaway order, and the buns were a little bit on the smaller side, it honestly didn't matter. The emotional connection I felt to the food was what made this experience so special. Quán ăn Cả Cần doesn't just sell food; they sell warmth, tradition, and a little piece of home. I'll definitely be back, not just for the bánh bao, but for that feeling again.

ChIJ9fYT1JovdTERz_apMeWNkcs.text:
hủ tiếu toàn quán is serving up that noodle bowl realness

THE BOWL BREAKDOWN
hủ tiếu is vietnam's iconic clear noodle soup that absolutely slaps. nam vang refers to the phnom penh style with that fire combo of pork, shrimp and rich broth.

THE DRY VERSION MOVE
the kho (dry) version is an absolute serve where noodles come separate from broth with a special sauce. you mix it all together for maximum flavor that hits different.

THE FLAVOR SITUATION
their hủ tiếu is lowkey fire with quality ingredients and balanced broth. the noodles are not bad at all and get the job done right. the dry version lets you control each bite for that perfect custom experience.

THE NO FRILLS VIBES

if you want proper hủ tiếu with that dry option flex, this place is a total yes. that nam vang style will have you coming back for more

ChIJpxp-mUwvdTERqhBb3X08mVA.author: Julia Kooper
ChIJpxp-mUwvdTERqhBb3X08mVA.text:
Hủ Tiếu Mực Như Ý - Bắc Hải is a well-known restaurant in District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, famous for its delicious and healthy seafood noodle soup. Since opening in 2017, it has gained a strong reputation among locals and visitors alike.

Food Quality

The signature hủ tiếu mực (squid noodle soup) is made with fresh ingredients, including squid, shrimp, quail eggs, minced pork, and fragrant herbs. The broth is light yet flavorful, offering a naturally sweet taste from simmered seafood. The noodles are perfectly chewy, complementing the rich toppings.

Aside from squid noodles, the restaurant also serves hủ tiếu with shrimp, oysters, and scallops, providing a variety of seafood options to satisfy different preferences.

Service & Atmosphere

The restaurant is clean and spacious, making it a comfortable place for families and groups of friends. The service is fast and efficient, with staff members who are friendly and attentive. Despite being busy, the wait time for food is usually short.

Price & Convenience

The prices range from 55,000 VND to 75,000 VND per bowl, depending on the ingredients. The restaurant operates from 6:30 AM to 1:30 PM and 4:00 PM to 9:30 PM, with peak hours around 7:00 PM.

For added convenience, delivery is available via ShopeeFood, Grab, Be, and Gojek. Customers can also reserve tables in advance to avoid waiting.

If you're looking for a nutritious, tasty, and well-balanced seafood noodle dish in Ho Chi Minh City, Hủ Tiếu Mực Như Ý - Bắc Hải is an excellent choice. With fresh ingredients, quick service, and reasonable prices, it’s a must-try spot for seafood lovers!

ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.text: Since discovering this restaurant, my boyfriend and I have been coming here at least once a week. I am so in love with the noodle soup of this restaurant, with super full and quality toppings. The shrimp, squid, and meat are all very fresh and clean, and most importantly, there is a lot of it. I finished all the noodles and still had a lot of toppings left. The owner and staff are friendly, plus the "cat-faced" employee is super cute and approachable. Every time I come to the restaurant, I feel like it is clean, airy, familiar, and of course "DELICIOUS". This is important and needs to be mentioned many times.

ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.name: places/ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURudTZxX0ZnEAE
ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.text:
Branch 2 after branch 1 in Phan Boi Chau, Binh Thanh district. Many years ago, I ate at branch 1 but rarely visited because the food did not leave any impression. 

Now branch 2 has opened in district 2, closer to my house, located right on the front of Song Hanh highway, so it is very spacious and airy, and it was a rainy day so it was very cool to sit. When I had a chance to have dinner, I found it more delicious than branch 1. 

A large bowl costs 60k but the toppings are many and fresh, so I found this price cheap. The squid is very fresh and quite a lot, up to 4-5 pieces. Especially the liver and lean meat are delicious. Order dry noodles with very delicious mixed broth, evenly sticking to the chewy noodles. The broth is sweet and clear, clearly tasting from the marrow bones and dried shrimp and squid. 

The couple selling here are very cute and take good care of customers.

ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.name: places/ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJbHZHc0lnEAE

ChIJmQTqfh0ndTERFkoUp2yDBHI.text:
This is the first time I've eaten rice noodles like this – thicker than those I've had at other places – chewy, soft, and very satisfying.

The squid and shrimp toppings are fresh and crispy, plus liver, lean pork, and minced meat, so I think the 60k VND is well worth it.

The broth is subtly sweet, and I don't feel any unpleasant aftertaste from MSG.

The sauce is rich and flavorful, and the owner is quite generous with it, so those with a preference for milder flavors might find it a little salty.

ChIJS1AoiQMvdTERyWI4ThnjxpA.text:
I usually eat mixed dried noodles, but Chu Cao's soup version has completely won me over. The flavour is simple yet strangely captivating, leaving me wanting another bowl after I finish the first. The dipping sauce here is extremely delicious. Its incredible flavour likely comes from the fragrant lemongrass used in the satay.

The service, however, was a bit confusing. Upon arrival, I approached the counter to order, only to be told to find a table and sit down first. Once seated, another server inquired if I would already ordered, then kept asking if I wanted the full topping option (thập cẩm, probably because this one is priced higher) even after I clearly stated the specific dish I desired.

ChIJdRG7sTQldTERGtN21xuvF8A.text:
Seeing that the restaurant has many 1-star reviews, I was a bit surprised when I had breakfast here many times - I'm familiar with it and haven't encountered any problems like the 1-star reviews, so I'm reviewing it now. 

The menu is very reasonable in price for the administrative center of Thu Duc city. 

The restaurant is clean and located right on the corner of the street, so it feels airy on all sides, and there's plenty of space for motorbikes and cars. 

I ordered dry Nam Vang noodles and dry bone noodles, the portion was very full. 

- The broth is very delicious, with a strong aroma of dried shrimp, dried squid and the sweetness of the bones. Don't overuse sugar when cooking. 

The dry noodle dishes have a rather sweet sauce, and the noodles are also a bit sticky and don't separate. Add a lot of minced meat and fried garlic until fragrant and crispy. 

The dry noodles have toppings of lean meat, pork heart, shrimp, quail eggs, all very fresh. 
- Dry noodles with 2 bones with a lot of meat and marrow, very fatty. The bones are soft but the meat is still quite moist, delicious. 

The restaurant staff I saw were a bit unhappy, but the owner who was also the cashier was friendly and hospitable, he was also enthusiastic, running around the restaurant as well as outside.

ChIJtaKzyGkvdTERlZ0MOohTCoY.text:
For years, I had passed this eatery in Ho Thi Ky market, always curious but never venturing in. Today, finally drawn by the aroma, I stepped inside and instantly regretted my tardiness. Tucked in a narrow alley, the friendly owner will help you navigate where to park your motorcycle. Seating is available indoors, or you can choose the vibrant atmosphere of a handful of outdoor tables mere inches from the elementary school wall. Here, motorcycles zip past a hair's breadth away, creating a slightly terrifying yet strangely captivating dining experience.

The star of the show seems to be the dry mixed noodles (as it is always the choice of diners when coming here). Despite the constant crowd, these arrive remarkably fast. The chewy noodles are tossed with flavourful minced meat and crispy shallots, all tied together by the aroma of freshly ground black pepper. A homemade sauce sits on the side for those who prefer a touch more flavour, but do not miss the addictive vinegar-soaked garlic, their garlic is irresistibly delicious. The accompanying broth packed with six toppings: rib cartilage, pork heart, pork stomach, char siu, shrimp, and a quail egg. At VND 50.000, this is absolutely a steal!

ChIJiRFapyIvdTER-tEtetPU64o.author: Scott Nguyen
ChIJiRFapyIvdTER-tEtetPU64o.text:
Bánh tằm bì is a beloved Vietnamese dish known for its unique combination of textures and flavors. The dish features thick, slightly chewy rice noodles, known as bánh tằm, which are paired with bì—a savory mixture of finely shredded pork skin and thin slices of pork. The noodles and pork are typically served on a bed of fresh herbs and lettuce, providing a refreshing contrast to the rich, savory elements.

A highlight of bánh tằm bì is the special coconut milk sauce, which is poured over the noodles. This creamy, slightly sweet sauce adds a luxurious richness to the dish, enhancing the flavors of the pork and noodles. The dish is also accompanied by nước mắm chua ngọt, a tangy and mildly sweet fish sauce dip, which ties all the components together and adds a burst of umami.

The dish is often garnished with crispy fried shallots, roasted peanuts, and fresh herbs like mint and basil, adding crunch and aroma. The combination of chewy noodles, savory pork, creamy coconut sauce, and fresh herbs makes bánh tằm bì a delightful and satisfying meal.

Bánh tằm bì is usually enjoyed as a breakfast or lunch dish, and it's a great choice for those looking to experience the diverse and rich flavors of Vietnamese cuisine. Its unique texture and the interplay of savory and sweet elements make it a standout dish in Vietnamese culinary culture.

ChIJsbl4NQAndTERZLQ4U_dMMBI.text:
So, I popped into this place, which I think is the sister branch of the famous Ha Ky chicken noodles. They specialize in Cambodian noodles or Hu Tieu Nam Vang, and you can get them either with broth or dry. I went for the dry noodles this time around.

When the dish arrived, I was surprised to see they’d used tomato ketchup to flavor the noodles, which was a bit unexpected. I usually prefer the classic sweet soy sauce, so this didn’t quite hit the spot for me. The noodles came with three shrimps—they were small but fresh, which was nice.

Overall, it’s a decent choice if you’re craving noodles, but it didn’t wow me like my go-to Hu Tieu Nam Vang. That said, the shop’s clean, bright, and the service was quick, so it’s not a bad spot to grab a bite!

ChIJFz8H5WcndTER0L9Rt6kkYTU.name: places/ChIJFz8H5WcndTER0L9Rt6kkYTU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRdmZqeWhnRRAB
ChIJFz8H5WcndTER0L9Rt6kkYTU.author: Stephen Lewis
ChIJFz8H5WcndTER0L9Rt6kkYTU.text:
I was lucky to find this hidden gem. Tron - Hủ Tiếu Bò Viên, in District 9, Thu Duc City. I ordered the special, hủ tiếu bò viên (beef ball and noodles), and it was absolutely incredible. The noodles were cooked to perfection, not too firm but definitely not soggy. There were four different beef options to mix and match, and the broth was unlike anything I’ve ever tasted. Rich, flavorful, and not overly salty.

Despite being tucked away on a secluded street, this place clearly has a loyal following, and for good reason. The service was excellent, and the food came out quickly while still being freshly prepared and delicious. Now that I know how amazing it is, I wouldn’t mind waiting in line for a bowl of this soup!

The restaurant is spotless and has a welcoming atmosphere. I also had the pleasure of meeting the owner and her mother, who were both kind and passionate about their food. It makes sense that their other restaurant, run by the owner’s mother, has been in business for 20 years.

This is the kind of place worth traveling for. I will definitely be back and can’t wait for my next visit!

ChIJFz8H5WcndTER0L9Rt6kkYTU.text:
Tron Beef Ball Noodle Soup is a popular beef ball noodle soup restaurant in District 9, Thu Duc City, Saigon. However, the restaurant is always crowded with customers thanks to the delicious food quality and reasonable prices. The broth here is delicious, not too salty, not too thick or too much MSG. The menu is diverse, the prices are reasonable. 

The beef balls are well seasoned. The noodles are blanched just right so they are not too tough or too soft. Inside the bowl of noodles there are also layers of green onions and fried onions. The dishes are always served quickly so customers do not have to wait long. The presentation of the dishes is also very eye-catching and attractive. The restaurant also offers home delivery service through food ordering applications.

ChIJy80IpdkndTERTVWC-YJsXQM.text: Well, I ate so many times before, so the quality is 5 out of 5 for all criterias, hygiene space and food plates, knifes, spoon…, delicious food, this is why its always full of people. The menu is very diverse with many categories, from Vietnamese traditionals to Italian spaghetti, Korean chilli noodle… which can serve all ages and tastes. The staff are also friendly. Cash and VNPay (QR code) are accepted payment methods.

ChIJy80IpdkndTERTVWC-YJsXQM.text: Top tier fried rice but they offers more than just fried rice. The menu has large variety of dishes suitable for every group sizes. Also good choice for family dinner.

ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.text: “Chinese noddles” includes noodles, “hoành thánh”… is very delicous. Price is 65k/pax

ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.author: Dòng Nhạc Vàng
ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.text: Delicious restaurant. Although it's on the street, it's very clean. Free iced tea. Food is okay.

ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.name: places/ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM0b0plV3F3RRAB
ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.author: Lan Vo
ChIJzRyJWhYndTERfRd57eDb7AE.text: This noodle shop is located near the intersection of Pham Van Dong and Kha Van Can (the last section). The egg noodles are very fresh and delicious, especially the sausage and pickles that go with it are delicious. However, the price is a bit higher than the average in Thu Duc, this bowl without the fried dough sticks is about 45k. If you have the opportunity to pass by Pham Van Dong street and are hungry, you should stop by and try it. The shop is open from 4pm to late at night, but go early to still have sausages.

ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.name: places/ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCMmJEVXlNVEY2U2pab2JFOXRXbUo1VjJVd1oyYxAB
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.author: pitty papha
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.text:
Overall:
• Suitable for 1 people dine in with reasonable price
• My favorite place for dinner from portion and the taste

Food:
• Recommended Banh Canh Cua (Crab Noodle). The portion is suitable for 1 person and I’m full ❤️ You should mix it with fresh chili and lime~
• I also order Mushroom Noodle. They will mainly add mushroom as topping along with 2 shrimp but it may not that too full because you will eat vegetable for this dish.
• They also have fried bun, I dont know how to call it in English but my hometown country also have this bread type. I’m so wonderful that they eat with the noodle soup and it’s delicious.

Service:
• Staff may forget some of your order in rush hour as they need to handle lot of customer.
• English menu is available.

Atmosphere:
• A bit hot as no air condition.
• Normal style of local restaurant in Vietnam.
• They have motorbike parking but not that much since the restaurant size is medium size.

ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.name: places/ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tKaGEwOW9XRGt4YUVkd1drNU5RbVJrWTNneGVsRRAB
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.author: K Chen
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.text:
Here's a quick review for Banh Canh Cua 14:
"Banh Canh Cua 14 in District 5 is anhit! The broth is packed with a delicious, super 'crabby' goodness, and you can choose any combo of  toppings you want. The place is clean and bright for a local spot, and it's always full of locals, which is a great sign. A huge thank you to Lee, who was incredibly helpful with ordering and making sure we had all the right condiments. This is another must-try local spot in Saigon!"

ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.name: places/ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tocWVqQXlaa2hJTmtOUVdsSXdhM0J2U1hwZlZXYxAB
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.author: Dolyn ho
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.text: Hands down the best crab noodle in Saigon. We tried 2 other Crab noodle but this is the best. The portion was just nice, the price is super reasonable. The staff could speak English and taught us what sauces goes well with which dish. Amazing service 👍🏼 I will come back Hcm just for this again.

ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.name: places/ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tFM1gyaFBNRzh3ZERGQlJYQmZaR3hYZWpOMldtYxAB
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.author: RCSC
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.text: Ordered via grab. It was my 1st time trying and OMG I LOVE BANH CANH CUA. How did I not know about this dish!!!!! Love the slightly thicker noodles. Soup was so umami. Toppings were yummy and generous, I love the crab cake! Omg I would totally fly to HCM go eat banh canh cua again 😋😋😋😋

ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.name: places/ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tkMlVUTklkMVZ0VUhaNmVFaEhjMDE0Wm1WbmMwRRAB
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.author: Eric K
ChIJl5Hp8RwvdTERzEOyi5tG-Bo.text:
Went there at 5 pm and wasn't busy. Plenty of tables.

Food (10/10) - Ordered the signature crab noodle soup and it was the best I tasted in HCM so far.

Price (10/10) - Very reasonable price based on location and restaurant ambience.

Ambience (9/10) - Clean, spacious and was quiet (not busy time).

Service (10/10) - Staffs were courteous and helpful.

Location - (8/10) - Close to Ben Thanh Ward in District 1. Great place for a meal after shopping on Nguyễn Trãi Street.

ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.name: places/ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eE1DcmhBRRAB
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.author: Nghia Nguyen
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.text:
I absolutely love this place! They are very popular and their business is driving to the point where they have four units side by side for their one restaurant on a main street. You can't afford that unless your food and service are excellent! The food is great and the atmosphere is pretty good. But what is the most kindness and hospitality with the owner and staff has bestowed upon me. My family came here to eat the special crab udon noodles soup. After the meal, I was stranded alone and couldn't book a ride because it was raining during rush hours. The owner recognized the distress expression on my face and had one of her waiters drive me back to my hotel. 🥰
The next day I came back to try a different dish, crab rice noodle soup, which was also very good, the owner, Út Lệ, again offered me a ride back to the hotel. But I told her it wasn't necessary because I was actually on my way to somewhere else. But I really appreciate her generosity and hospitality. When she heard that, she had her husband, Quân, drive me to my next destination. I said it wasn't necessary but insisted on helping me. 🥰
Their generosity is enough for me to recommend this place. But I recommend this place for everything: the service, food and hospitality!

ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.name: places/ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tad01GUmZibU01U1VwcmNucEVaVFZwT1RVeWQwRRAB
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.author: Hien Nguyen
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.text: This spot serves amazing bánh căn, a specialty from central Vietnam. The mini pancakes are crispy on the outside and soft inside, with delicious dipping sauce. It feels like a hidden gem. I always tell friends to try it if they want something different from typical Saigon street food.

ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.name: places/ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqXzZIWDBBRRAB
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.author: Thanh Trung Dang
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.text: The restaurant is spacious, the prices are reasonable, the service is quick and polite, the crab noodle soup is okay but the bagel twists have oily smell (it made me feel that cooking oil was reused many times), there is free parking for motorbikes.

ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.name: places/ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNwd0tLVXVRRRAB
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.author: Everymile Global village
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.text: Not bad experience as the soup has reasonable carb taste according to their price, 60k to 70k. I guess there must be some better ones nearby.

ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.name: places/ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN4d0xEUzJRRRAB
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.author: Tinori
ChIJwZmUjtoudTER65ulc8qUo-g.text: A local friend of mine told me about this place. Their main dish is crab noodle soup, must try! I've had this same dish at home in Melbourne Australia (only 1 place makes it). The noodle soup here is more delicious, the fish cakes, the bread dipping and quail eggs all add extra flavour to the dish. The only thing lacking is the crab meat but you expect this when you're only paying $60000 VND($4AUD). The price I paid in Australia was $29 aud(it does have more crabs). The place is packed with locals and I will return to order more. Fantastic!

ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.name: places/ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xVM1RHbE9XbmwzZHpFMFFrVjBSa3ROY3poQllYYxAB
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.author: Ben Herman
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.text: I stopped in for lunch on a rainy afternoon and this was a super comforting bowl of crab noodles. The broth is great, and the noodles were perfectly cooked. Definitely get the quay breads, they are great with the broth. The bowl comes with a shrimp and a cube of congealed pig blood. Just take it out if you don’t like it. Service was super fast and the space doesnt have a lot of tables but we were able to get one right away. Theres parking space available for motorbikes.

ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.name: places/ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCMlluUmZUVWxDTkhsTFRUVk9jUzFuTkZsb1gzYxAB
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.author: Michelle Cho
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.text: One of the best crab noodle soups I've ever had. I rarely finish soups but I did with this one. Get the bagel twists (deep fried dough that's been cut up), for those who know, it's often had with congee (rice porridge) BUT soaks up this thick broth beautifully! I know some people might be upset by little pieces of crab shells in the bowl but it was no big deal to me and just proves it's real crab meat too. Definitely recommend it. Has great portion, textures and tastes. This bowl ($50k VND + $5k for the bagel twists) also comes in a larger size meant for 2-3 people ($110k). Worth it but my one tummy couldn't have finished it 🤭

ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.name: places/ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xa1gwRXpZemRHWXpBeGJsTnFPRUZKYlUxMU1HYxAB
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.author: Kin Monyleap
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.text: I had breakfast here with my friend on the second day of our Saigon trip. The food was tasty, affordable, and had a very local flavor. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy an authentic local meal!

ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.name: places/ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2paemJWRnJWR1JsVlhKSGIxTTFlVzFxWjNkRVdYYxAB
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.author: Eunice Eunice
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.text:
Hidden deep in an alley, this bowl of Vietnamese crab noodles totally blew me away ！
The soup was rich and flavorful, and it came with so much topping — every bite was loaded with crab meat and freshness!
Such a satisfying find in the most unexpected corner.

ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.name: places/ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VOeWR5WlNWd0xPdENREAE
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.author: Jeremy Hiew
ChIJ9fj-0j0vdTERBjWey60OKL8.text: Really enjoyed my meal here! The food was excellent, and I loved the unique, hidden location in a house on a back street. My only small comfort note is that the tables and chairs felt a bit too low for me. Despite that, I had a very good experience and would recommend it.

ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.name: places/ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214TFFsbGlaWGRyY1ZOWk4wRlVRblUwZG5OS2JYYxAB
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.author: J G
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.text: Very delicious Banh Canh Cua, broth was really tasty and there was lots of crab meat which is not always the case with other places, a little more expensive but worth it, restaurant is down a small alley from the main road

ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.name: places/ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25nNFJtNWFlbE5CWTBneExYVkRMVEl6ZUVSbmVXYxAB
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.author: Nhật Nguyễn Minh
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.text: Overall it is fine for the price. I wouldnt put it must eat or whatever like that. There are better places out there. The crab meat is ok but rather than 75k, 50k-60k is a more reasonable price for what you are getting.

ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.name: places/ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3bE03bFhnEAE
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.author: Phan Nhan
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.text:
Food: Very delicious, I ordered a bowl full of crab, fresh crab meat, delicious, medium broth, sour and sour dipping sauce, fried cake served with it, I must say it is the best sweet and spicy, the best in HCM that I know

Space: ok clean

Price: Okay, suitable for quality

Service: quick ordering, free parking

Every time I have a chance to go to Q10, I stop by to eat.

There are no other notes

nhanbdsreview

ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.text:
"Ngon" / good over 30 years

Giá (price): 70.000 VND
(about 3 USD)
I accepted that I took the high expense to get a good food, so I would not be regretful with your money pockets.
Just enjoy here.

ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.name: places/ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIMVlhY3V3RRAB
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.author: Tim Nguyen Tran
ChIJn-sP8OUudTERiSif7aut2rU.text:
Overall not too bad. We ordered 2 large sizes, but the portion is quite small.
Taste is okay. Not special
The crab meat doesnt taste fresh.

ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.name: places/ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GbkxVSmFRMFUwVWtvMFgwdGtZblpOT1dWeWVtYxAB
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.author: Eric Nguyen
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.text:
Banh Canh Cua 87 delivers standout crab udon with a broth that’s rich, clean, and unmistakably crab forward. The noodles have great bite, the crab meat is fresh and plentiful, and the flavors cut through with real precision. From a product standpoint, it outperforms a lot of more commercial spots.

Atmosphere is a 3 minimal, functional, and clearly designed for quick turnover. Service is a 3 – fast, direct, and very “sit, eat, and go,” which fits the local street-shop operating model but isn’t meant to be leisurely.

Even with the stripped down setup, the food quality carries the experience. If you want premium banh canh cua without the noise or the gimmicks, this shop remains a high value, repeat worthy choice.

ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.name: places/ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xreE1VazNVWHBZTVRWRU9FaFFPRzlNVkdkTWRVRRAB
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.author: P
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.text:
Delicious local spot for crab noodles!
The noodles are chewy and a bit like udon, but with their own unique texture. The broth is rich, flavorful, and slightly salty by adding a bit of lime makes it even better. Everything tastes super fresh, from the crab to the shrimp and squid. The menu has multiple languages, so it’s easy for tourists to order. Simple setting, friendly staff, and truly satisfying bowls of noodles.

ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.name: places/ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGdk1IVlZaazVsUjJ0bU5FVnlOMFV5U2tSc1kxRRAB
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.author: Meagan
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.text:
As a tourist, this is the best local/street food meal I’ve had in Saigon so far. I’m not the biggest fan of seafood, which says a a-lot.

Broth has a medium-thick consistency and all the seafood is fresh. Very delicious & affordable!

ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.name: places/ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1R1JYbDJWMWxITUhaUlkwSlpObWs1YmtSbVRHYxAB
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.author: Ray Sim
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.text:
My food rating guide:
2.5/5 ‐-------> Average taste
5/5 ‐--------> Scrumptious! (My comfort food! 🤩)

Light gooey savoury sauce. Smooth and soft silver needle noodle/老鼠粉/bee tai bak. Came with prawn, quail eggs, crab meat, crab meat cake (I think), blood cake, and sliced pork.

The suace might look thick but it was like soup. Satisfying.

The bowl of noodle was a 4.2/5

ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.name: places/ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aMlNXaERNMTlYU20xcFJVY3dkazFZUWs0MFJFRRAB
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.author: Jasmine (Jas.eats)
ChIJBYD4rjgpdTERYZY2MCqxlio.text:
ORDERED:
🍜 01 Phần: 55,000 đ
🍩 Bánh Quẩy: 3,000 đ

REVIEW:
❤️ Delicious food.
1 option means this is definitely a specialty store.
I also adore soup that isn't too gelatinous (I prefer mine more watery), a strong taste from the sweetness of the crab, decked full of flavour.
Genuinely delicious and would go back.

Dipping the fried doughnuts into the soup at the end softened the crispy batter. It's a fun way to end the meal as well.

Service is straight forward, and you might share a table with strangers. It's not as compressed as Hong Kong, so I was alright.

ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.name: places/ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1MWRtOTVTSFJZVEZscWEyMVhWRTkzV1U5VFZtYxAB
ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.author: Võ Nguyễn Kiều Trinh
ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.text: Bánh Canh Cua Phong at 156 Bà Hạt is easy to find and really worth trying! The bowl costs 45k but has a lot of crab and generous portions. The place is clean, airy, and comfortable to sit in. Delicious food and great value for money!

ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.name: places/ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tzMlpWZ3laRU5SWVhkSlRYWkdVRzQwVHpGQmRGRRAB
ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.author: HY Lee
ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.text:
Quiet chill local restaurant not that far from the crowd city centre.
There are 1 uncle & 1 grandma working together, the food was extremely nice. Even better than the touristy restaurant which is Bánh Canh Cua 14.

The portion of crab & seafood was just nice. Soup is little thick but i liked it. The uncle was shy but could feel that he is really kind.

I really enjoyed my lunch here.

ChIJ9b6rvigvdTER8SIk-gKdoLo.text:
Fun fact, Banh Canh Cua is one of the easy to make but hard to master dishes, and this place makes one of the best bowls I've ever tried

The broth is clear and the taste is balanced, not too sweet or salty, so you can slurp the whole bowl w/o any taste related problem. The toppings are quite little, but the crab meat however, is quite generous. The prices range from cheap regular bowl all the way to Jeff Bozos bowl, so you can choose accordingly to your appetite.

The green sauce is the main selling point. It's handmade and it goes extremely well with the food. You can ask the nice auntie to sell it for you for cheap if you like.

In conclusion: nice food, flexible price, good sauce 8.5/10

ChIJWyedfZAvdTERQvDvwSLt07I.text:
This restaurant had been on my Ho Chi Minh food list for a while, and we finally got the chance to try it. The highlight for us was definitely the tapioca noodles — soft, chewy, and perfectly complemented by the rich, thick soup base. That part did not disappoint.

However, all four of us agreed that the fish cake was a major letdown. It simply didn’t taste fresh or enjoyable, which was surprising given how popular the place seems to be. On top of that, the prices felt a bit high for what we got.

The service also left much to be desired. Staff weren’t very attentive, and they placed jelly and fish crackers on the table without asking — be aware that you’ll be charged if you eat them, even though they appear complimentary. You can reject it, of you don't want.

We were also looking forward to trying their signature crab dish, but to our surprise, the staff told us there were no crabs available. It’s odd for a restaurant to be out of its best-selling dish.

Overall, an okay experience — worth trying for the noodles, but definitely some room for improvement.

ChIJjVM5kDEpdTERjl2p1AMmsl8.text:
If you are looking for a bowl of delicious, affordable and authentic Central Vietnamese noodle soup, then Co Dan noodle soup is a choice worth trying. The restaurant is small and simple but always crowded, especially around noon and afternoon. 

The bowl of noodle soup here impresses with its clear broth, sweet from the bones, not greasy. The noodles are soft enough, not too crumbly or too tough. Diverse toppings: from fish cakes, pig's feet, lean ham to quail eggs. The price is quite reasonable - about 50-100k/bowl. 

The owner is cute, serving quickly even though the restaurant is always crowded. The space is not too large but clean and airy. There are simple stainless steel tables and chairs, just like a traditional popular restaurant. 

Another plus point is that the restaurant maintains a stable flavor, eating many times still feels delicious. Co Dan noodle soup is truly a restaurant worth visiting whenever you crave a hot, delicious and filling dish.

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.author: Kevin Truong
ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.text:
I have mixed feelings when writing this review, but I'll give it a pass in my book.

Food: The broth and the noodle itself is nothing special, I'll say below average compared to many places I've tried over the year, but there are redeeming qualities that turn the table around. The ingredients are fresh, especially the prawn and the crab meat, which you will find aplenty in your bowl. The sour sauce is ok-ish, but i know there are people out there who will appreciate the taste.

Price: Cheap, there are cheap options ranging from as cheap as 30k, and even the best option only costs 60k (as the time of this review). I chose the best option and It's worth every penny spent since the stall is very generous on the toppings and crab meat.

Atmosphere: Nothing special but the place is very well sanitized and the owner is very friendly with us so this is a huge plus.

In conclusion, although the broth and noodle bowl is nothing out of the ordinary, the quality and quantity of the ingredients drag the review back from a "Meh" to a "It's good, just not a Wow".

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.text: Fantastic Banh Canh Cua. I got a special bowl and it had a lot of real crab meat in it, so I have to say the value is great. This place is pretty clean for a local store as well. One the best crab banh canh place in this city.

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.name: places/ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR4dnNmMzNRRRAB

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.text:
Absolutely delicious and affordable crab noodle soup! Come a little further out of the main tourist district and enjoy a more local experience eating here. Highly recommend the special bowl (60k vnd) and you can add on other ingredients that you fancy too. Place is clean and run by a family, will be back again next time!

Note: Just be careful of the crab shells in between the meat :)

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.text: Its good overall. Not sure if its the best. I had the special for 60k, get the quay for an extra flavour. I wished their soup would be near boiling when i was there

ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.name: places/ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURadmQ2NG5RRRAB
ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.author: Tom Wallace
ChIJx4SWYW8vdTERWIQr3e0xu78.text:
Totally concur with Samuel’s review of this place: it’s fantastic!
District 4 has been my favourite place for eating out in HCMC for over a decade, and I love a bowl of banh canh cua with the thick melt-in-your-mouth noodles, big chunks of tender crab meat and an assortment of other delicious goodies, but I have only just discovered this place, tucked away in a Q4 backstreet so that you’ll need a map to find it.
There is a banh canh restaurant in Q10 that used to be my HCMC pick for crab soup, but this place surpasses that one in every way: cheaper, better variety of ingredients (make sure you order the ‘Dac Biet’), more convenient location and more friendly service.
This joint gets the highest possible recommendation from me and my entire family.

ChIJFxT-wvoodTER9iU_jDwyGOI.text: Delicious crab noodle soup, one bowl will make you full for the next day. Price from 50k, with pickled garlic and pickled chili, very spicy. Delicious, everyone should try it.

ChIJFxT-wvoodTER9iU_jDwyGOI.author: Thao Nguyen
ChIJFxT-wvoodTER9iU_jDwyGOI.text:
The famous crab noodle soup in Go Vap market, located right at the entrance to the market so it's easy to find. 
This noodle soup is exactly the type of noodle soup I like, cooked thick and soft noodles. The bowl of noodle soup here is always full, so you'll be full. I really like restaurants that serve full dishes like this, the price is a bit high but I think it's worth it. The shrimp is plump so you know the shrimp is fresh, there are some noodles that smell of fish but it's not 100% fish cake, there's also a lot of crab but the day I went to eat, I felt the crab smelled a bit fishy, otherwise it's delicious. It suits my taste. The noodles are not eaten together but when combined with lemon, chili, and fish sauce with chopped chili, the flavor is explosive. 
The restaurant is crowded with customers eating on the spot and buying to go, in the market but it's quite clean, the restaurant says it's open in the morning but I didn't see it when I stopped by. The restaurant doesn't accept bank transfers so remember to bring cash when you go to eat

ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps.name: places/ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3NUl2TnBBRRAB
ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps.author: Nhan Nguyen
ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps.text:
- About the service : 5* ++  for the service, they are thoughtful in the way of paying good attention on how customers eat the whole crab, they provide you full gears to open the crab yourself such as gloves, a bowl of clean water cold ice + citrus, free wet wipes, and even hair rubber bands 😳( if you ever order the whole crab like mine in the picture/ or you can order crab meat ready for more easy).
Easy to read and imagine, visualized menu, easy to order, just point as you go.
Free quail eggs as snack while you are waiting for the dish to be prepared. (At first I thought it will be on the bill, but was suprise no quail eggs on the bill)
- About the food : 5*, good broth that kept warm in the ceramic pot, boiling hot, you have time open your own crab, and the broth is still  warm. Big chunk of ham, good selection of vegetable (morning glory / sprout). Fresh and sweet crab, Vietnamese seafood has never disappointed me. Satisfying!!!
- Overall : the owner tries to keep everything professional, by the chef's uniform and the kitchen facilities, and her friendly attitude in her tone of voice. Personally I like the broth and the seafood.
Definitely will comeback.

ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps.name: places/ChIJG7NTEEgpdTERHHvb2kYW7ps/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKNjZUU1ZBEAE

When It came with paying the bill we had to ask them twice again to have the bill. Worst experience ever.

Normal price.

ChIJgcLtbtIodTERZgvEtwJZo3s.text: Holy COW, this was an excellent dish! No pics, we forgot our phones at home rushing to beat the rain. Extraordinarily flavorful and satisfying, if a tad bit salty (especially the nuoc mam on the side, verrrrry salty and unbalanced in the dish as a whole. Bo vien is usually served with thuong den, a dark, thick sauce that is slightly sweeter.) The giant meatball was perfectly cooked, and the banh canh noodles were AWESOME - exceptionally thick and flavorful. The soup base was also stellar. Honestly, besides the fish sauce on the side (which I must add is optional to use), the banh canh bo vien is a perfect and deeply satisfying dish. Highly recommended!

ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y.name: places/ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaTWNFNWpOSFpNY21oR2VrNTNkbDlDUzI1RE1VRRAB
ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y.text:
Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts

A loaded bowl that’s infamous for its high prices - although you'd understand why when this heavyweight hits your table. The three giant crab claws, pork, shrimp, squid ball and blood pudding together are more abundant than noodles. The crabby broth had a thick, slightly viscous texture, a gentle sweetness, a hint of black pepper and a pleasant salinity that the bouncy tapioca noodles soak up. While a satisfying bowl, it would've been better if I didn't have to pay for it.

ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y.name: places/ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xack9GOVlUR1Z4VVhKQ2MxbFVaMGd5YVdKblNrRRAB

ChIJe99aGA8vdTERnxBhFYjZd_Y.text:
Crossed all the way into District 3 just to try this — and yes, it’s absolutely worth the hype!

Today’s menu: Bánh Canh Cua (/băhn kahn goo-ah/) — a thick, comforting crab noodle soup that’s one of Saigon’s true local favorites. 🍲🦀

Let’s break down the name:
• Bánh → thick, round noodles, similar to Hainanese noodles
• Canh → soup or broth
• Cua → crab

The soup is rich, silky, and full of flavor, with the sweetness of fresh crab blending perfectly with the thick, starchy broth. It’s often topped with chunks of crab meat, shrimp, quail eggs, and sometimes even pork or fried shallots for that extra crunch.

It’s the kind of dish that warms your soul, whether you’re a local or a curious traveler wandering the streets of Saigon.

A bowl of Bánh Canh Cua isn’t just food — it’s a taste of southern Vietnamese comfort. 💛
