ChIJ6V0rVwAldTERc9kRGuGNvXk.text:
I accidentally surfed GG map and saw that the restaurant had many good reviews so I stopped by. The restaurant has only been open for a few months and is open all day.

The space is spacious, airy, clean, and the utensils are kept in boxes to avoid dust.

The owner is originally from Gia Lai. She is very cute and gives enthusiastic advice. We were wondering whether to order rice noodles or noodles (Hue-style tapioca noodles), so she told us to try half and half. The tapioca noodles are very chewy and a bit tiring to eat, I'm not used to it, but rice noodles are still my favorite. The broth is sweet and light, a bit bland for me but still acceptable because I didn't add anything else. Those who like saltier dishes can add a little fish sauce. The white sausage and pork skin are very delicious, there's only a little bit of skin, not much. Fish cakes have fish cakes in pieces, fried fish cakes and I think there are also boiled fish cakes. For me, the fish cakes are normal, nothing special, because I have eaten many types from snakehead fish, mackerel,... No vegetables to go with. 

My portion of 45k is full, delicious, nutritious and cheap. The restaurant accepts bank transfers and sells on the app.

ChIJFa9qeQAvdTEROZFo3OP-0tU.text: I usually pass by here after work at night. I come home around 6pm, but sometimes the dishes are gone, and sometimes I see the pots have been washed and the shop has been cleaned. It's super crowded. Yesterday, I came around 6:10pm and there were no more to buy. I ordered 2 portions of mixed lean meat noodle soup for 55k/portion. 2 plates of noodles cost 118k in total. Very delicious, worth trying. Oh, I heard people say the wait is long, but when I came, I didn't have to wait because there were a lot of customers, but the lady worked quickly and there were many assistants. It's cool in the evening, so it's ok.

ChIJFa9qeQAvdTEROZFo3OP-0tU.text:
Update feedback 09/13/2025:
It was raining heavily so I couldn't stop by to eat so I had to buy takeaway, bought 2 special portions but was given 2 regular portions (1 portion with only shredded crab, 1 portion with shrimp and little crab), and told them over and over again to remember to put in some green chili salt bags, because I'm addicted to the noodle soup here because of the dipping sauce, but in the end I still didn't.
The operating time is until 19:00, but around 17:30-18:00 the restaurant is sold out and closed.
In general, the restaurant sells delicious quality food and is very crowded, so it seems like they don't care much about the customer experience. Very disappointed.

Old feedback: Sometimes when I go to Vo Van Kiet street, I see this restaurant is crowded and smells good, so today I stopped by to try it, and take shelter from the rain. Unexpectedly, a portion of 35k-45k has a lot of crab meat, a huge bowl takes forever to finish, the taste is delicious and the ingredients are fresh, the most impressive thing is the green chili salt dipping sauce is extremely attractive, the chrysanthemum tea is also very fragrant and not too sweet. Even though the restaurant is crowded, every step from the waitress to the parking attendant and the cashier are very cute, I will definitely come back and order some for my relatives to enjoy together 🫶🏻

ChIJOwZmBXMvdTER8DcfI6JZ1uo.text:

There are many toppings, can eat soup or dry. Recommend dry because the soup is quite delicious, but eating soup is also delicious because of the strange taste (not as strong as dry).
Basic toppings: shrimp, tofu, dolphin, beef balls.
In my opinion, it is 8/10 but 5 stars because the strange dish stimulates the taste buds.

ChIJOwZmBXMvdTER8DcfI6JZ1uo.text:
People often compare, 
"The cuisine of Jiangsu and Zhejiang is like a beautiful woman; Jiangnan is elegant; the cuisine of Shandong and Anhui is like a simple and rustic man; the cuisine of Guangdong and Fujian is elegant like a rich young man; and the cuisine of Sichuan and Hunan is like a talented scholar" 

Chongqing noodles belong to the Sichuan cuisine group with a spicy and rich flavor. This is a strange and rare dish in the heart of Cho Lon, worth enjoying. 

🇻🇳 By Dung 63 🇻🇳

ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.text: The banh canh cua at VND85k is filled with ingredients. Worth eating as it's flavorful and tasty. ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.author: Nuno Neves
ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.text:
Phenomenal shrimp soup and seafood patties.

Updated: they moved to the opposite side of the road, and now there’s this big old man shouting at his employees all day. It adds an unnecessary stressful vibe to the place, even though the food is still top notch.

ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.name: places/ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNwdXFTNmFnEAE

ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.text:
The best Banh canh cua in town . I have been eating here for almost more than 10 years since they were old location

Still recommend .

ChIJtfYXokEvdTERNmJPwhSRTqI.text: As a lifetime fan of this seafood noodle, i would recommend this place for everyone who visit Ho Chi Minh City. A decent crab and shrimp fusion taste.

ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.text:
I went at noon, it was a bit hot when eating in a stone pot. If you like hot food, this is the place to go. The restaurant is quite clean. The fried fish is crispy and delicious. The noodles are made of rice flour noodles, quite tasty. The broth uses chives from the Central region, a familiar taste for me. There are about 5 pieces of fried fish fillet, white cabbage, small green cabbage and bitter herbs to eat with.
The staff serve quickly, the owner is cute. The restaurant is a bit hot, otherwise ok

ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.name: places/ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tORVdWcDNVSGgxU1d0M2RtMXBZVVprUVY4dE9YYxAB

ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.text:
Hot stone pot noodle soup to the last drop. Rich broth. Fresh vegetables include bitter herbs, mustard greens, and fresh cabbage.
The fish seems to have a strong fishy smell and is not fragrant.
The restaurant is spacious, clean, and airy. The time to eat is double the normal bowl because the hot stone pot cannot be eaten quickly. Delicious.

ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.name: places/ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twcWFFbG1ObmswWVZCRmJFVlVlamwyWlVJNVNsRRAB
ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.author: Huỳnh Trang
ChIJ-dy5NgAvdTERfUC3GEiH3dI.text: The restaurant is very bright and clean, so I stopped by. Delicious food, sweet taste

Clean restaurant

ChIJMZ6t6ygvdTER3e7HMYFFbB8.author: Huy Doan
ChIJMZ6t6ygvdTER3e7HMYFFbB8.text:
If you are planning to try it based on online reviews, I sincerely advise you not to.

I arrived at 8pm and there were still some customers but the wait was terrible, probably about 10 minutes before the dish was served.

I ordered a full bowl that day for 55k but it didn't look as full as the pictures posted. The topping had a few pieces of crab meat, the meat was a bit flat and crumbly. The lean pork was hard and dry like old or old food. 1 peeled shrimp that wasn't very clean, 1 quail egg. The broth didn't have a very distinctive taste, it smelled a bit like burnt pots and pans. The noodles were quite a lot.

I don't think the restaurant is very clean. It's probably only suitable for workers and students to eat cheaply.

ChIJMZ6t6ygvdTER3e7HMYFFbB8.text: According to reviews, this is the best crab noodle soup restaurant in District 7 because of the braised crab. I usually eat crab noodle soup and slurp it all up, but today was my first time eating there. When I arrived at 7am, it was deserted and there were no customers, so I didn't dare go in because I was afraid it wouldn't be good, but I went in anyway. The broth wasn't too thick, a bit oily, probably because of the braised crab. The fish sauce wasn't as excellent as everyone reviewed. I ordered the lean ham early in the morning and it was all gone.

ChIJE6FMY20vdTERMar8srALeQM.author: Kevin Truong
ChIJE6FMY20vdTERMar8srALeQM.text:
The embodiment of the word "average"

The food itself, compared to every single Banh Canh Cua places I've been to, is average at best. The broth got a hint of umami in them, making it a little sweet and making our neck stiff for awhile after eating. The amount of topping is ...barely passable in both quality and quantity aspects (and we had the special bowl). The sea food sauce is also not bad, but nothing to praise either.

On the bright side, the place seems very sanitized and clean. The old lady is quite nice to us and the food is fast. The price is also on the cheaper side, with only 45k for a bowl.

In conclusion, this place is so mediocre that everything is just a big Meh.

ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.text: Local noodle shop which serves thick noodles (banh canh) with mantis shrimp. Soup is flavorful.

ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.name: places/ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaSk1WTk1abGs1ZUVFMVgzUlBhMjE2YlMxVFJrRRAB
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.author: Hoang Cao
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.text:
The Saigon Banh Canh Quay Chi Ba restaurant offers a very unique flavor with delicious, sticky handmade rice noodles and rich broth. There are a variety of toppings with fish, shrimp, squid, and there are also porridge and noodles to choose from. Among them, I especially like the shrimp and squid noodle soup - fresh seafood, natural sweetness, very tasty. The restaurant space is bright, clean, creating a sense of security when enjoying. The owner is cute, enthusiastic and friendly. This is definitely a culinary place worth trying when you want to change the taste and enjoy delicious standard banh canh. 

Updated November 2025: The quality of service has started to decline. The seafood noodle soup has 2 uncooked shrimps, peeled off and poured into the bowl with a fishy smell. When asked, instead of changing the bowl, they said sorry and re-boiled the 2 shrimps. The fishy smelly bowl was inedible. I have eaten here dozens of times, but this time I give up. I will never come back.

ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.name: places/ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25nM1NrUlVjRUZ4U2pOc2RFY3hOMVpaYVhCd2JsRRAB
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.author: Song An Lê
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.text: The restaurant is located on the main street, convenient for transportation, the interior is decorated with sturdy wooden tables and chairs. However, the restaurant has a low ceiling, is not airy and quite hot because the kitchen is right next door. Dishes include porridge, tapioca or rice flour noodles with a variety of toppings, fresh ingredients, rich flavors. Reasonable prices compared to the general level. #cuisine

ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.name: places/ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toeWNYaHhOVFF3YUhOQ1NuUjJkelJ3YkhKWGMxRRAB
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.author: Tuyết Trinh
ChIJadFGtNovdTERNzYbcPEd5PA.text:
Accidentally visited the restaurant for the first time, had to come back for the second time to review because I was so satisfied
1. The restaurant is extremely friendly, welcoming and cute to talk to
2. The food is only made when ordered by the owner, but very quickly, most importantly it is delicious
The fried fish is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside without oil, super delicious
The squid and shrimp rolls are fragrant, not fishy, worth trying
3. The restaurant is clean from the tables and chairs to the spoons and chopsticks
4. The chili pepper and lemon dipping sauce is sweet and sour, very suitable for dipping toppings
Want the restaurant to be known by more people, because of its cuteness and delicious food.
Super worth trying

ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.name: places/ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2taMFQyOUdUV2htVEVWeFREbHZXWFJuTFVORGRtYxAB
ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.author: Markus Huynh
ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.text:
⚠️ They offer coupons/discounts for 5-star reviews — that’s why the rating is so high. Don’t trust it.

We went here recently, and it was honestly a bad experience. First of all, the place didn’t smell very good, and the food was just meh. Not the worst thing ever, but definitely the worst-tasting food I’ve had while in Vietnam — which says a lot, because food here is usually amazing.

We ordered six bowls, and one of them was straight-up foul. It smelled off, like it had gone bad, and my little brother couldn’t eat it at all. We asked the staff to compensate for that one bowl, but it turned into a long, annoying back-and-forth. They eventually did something, but it took way too much effort just to get the bare minimum. It felt really unprofessional.

This place doesn’t deserve a 4.7 rating. It’s misleading. We saw a sign on the table offering a discount or coupon if you leave a 5-star Google review — so now we understand why the rating is so inflated. It’s honestly kind of a scammy tactic.

The whole experience made me question the reliability of Google reviews in general. I’m now more hesitant to trust other highly rated places because I’m scared of getting tricked again.

Be careful — and honestly, just don’t go here. Not worth it.

ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.name: places/ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pJeFVta3RaV3R2VVRFemFEUlFiVzV2TW1waFVuYxAB

ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.text:
One of the best Hủ Tiếu restaurant in HCMC.
They have a strong sense of hygiene.

ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.name: places/ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxMk02VThnRRAB
ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.author: Luffy3D2Y
ChIJURyZVUQvdTERyyDPjFJzYB0.text:
FOOD & DRINKS
Even though this restaurant probably is more known for its squid noodle soup, I went for the fried chicken with rice.
The chicken was fried a tad too long and therefore a bit dry. Otherwise food was ok.

SERVICE
A bit more cheerful would have been nice.

ATMOSPHERE
It sits slightly above the typical local eating places. They keep things very clean so I can recommend it for foreigners who shy away from street food stalls.

RATING
When judging the food, I always try to take into account the price and location.
They offer good prices for a restaurant. Maybe I picked the wrong dish but I think they can do better. It doesn't need to be fancy, just a tad more juicy.

Lots of vegetables, especially bitter vegetables. However, the shrimp is not peeled so the soup does not penetrate the meat, making it out of place in the overall dish. The price is quite reasonable compared to the quality of the food
- Restaurant space: a bit narrow and hot, few seats.
- Service: when I went there, it was quite crowded, but the service was quite fast. The staff's attitude was normal, moreover, this is a popular restaurant segment, so you should not be too demanding about the service attitude.

ChIJOU4PJcApdTEREte_uOUdwPE.text:
NOODLE SOUP CA LOC TRAN - VO OANH is truly a culinary address worth visiting if you are a lover of rustic noodle soup, rich in the flavor of the Central region. Right from the moment I entered the restaurant, the friendly atmosphere and the attractive aroma from the pot of broth made me feel very comfortable. The broth here is cooked to taste, clear and naturally sweet from bones and fresh snakehead fish, not fishy at all. The noodles are soft and chewy, combined with snakehead fish that is boiled to perfection, white, firm and sweet. 

A big plus is that the restaurant always serves quickly, even though it is crowded, it still maintains stable quality. Raw vegetables, chili, lemon and fried onions are fully prepared, clean and fresh. In addition, the price is very reasonable, the portion is full so it feels "worth the money". The restaurant space is not too large but clean, tidy and airy. 

The owner and staff are very warm and friendly, making diners feel comfortable as if they are eating at home. If you are looking for a delicious, quality and traditional snakehead fish noodle soup restaurant, Tran Snakehead Fish Noodle Soup is definitely a great choice!

ChIJLV-QdAApdTERJ1Mobh1nnD8.text: Banh Canh Cua restaurant has a fairly large space with a high ceiling and plenty of tables, making it comfortable for groups. 5 stars for crab noodle soup.
My current top 1

I ordered a 65k bowl: lots of crab meat,

ChIJLV-QdAApdTERJ1Mobh1nnD8.name: places/ChIJLV-QdAApdTERJ1Mobh1nnD8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xdFh6VnljREJZZEdGb1JuTjBVVTg1VFdaMkxXYxAB
ChIJLV-QdAApdTERJ1Mobh1nnD8.author: BìnhThới Võ (Si Fu)
ChIJLV-QdAApdTERJ1Mobh1nnD8.text:
Crab Noodle Soup – Hai Cua 2 is located at 1 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, right next to Yet Kieu Water Sports Center. This is a familiar address for Saigon diners who love delicious, flavorful crab noodle soup. The restaurant space is located under the cool, airy shade of green trees, bringing a pleasant feeling to customers who come to enjoy it whether in the morning or evening. 

The menu features crab noodle soup, pork leg noodle soup, crab soup... made from fresh ingredients every day. The broth is light, naturally sweet and fragrant from crab and stewed bones, combined with soft, chewy noodles, creating an unforgettable rich flavor. In particular, the firm crab meat and red brick are attractively presented, making the dish even more eye-catching. 

In addition to banh canh, the restaurant also serves machine-brewed coffee and fresh fruit juice, perfect for those who want to enjoy a quick breakfast or relax after exercising at the nearby sports area. With a central location, reasonable prices and friendly service style, Banh Canh Cua - Hai Cua 2 is an ideal stop for locals and tourists when coming to District 1.

ChIJtSqtSm0pdTERoO6stSLqKW0.name: places/ChIJtSqtSm0pdTERoO6stSLqKW0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3aUk3cnRRRRAB
ChIJtSqtSm0pdTERoO6stSLqKW0.author: Kevin Truong
ChIJtSqtSm0pdTERoO6stSLqKW0.text:
I'm loving it.

The bowl itself is pretty good, but the things that make it really stand out is the sauce. There are 2 kinds of sauce, the green (herb and spices) and the red (sweet chilli), and both of them are extremely good. You can even buy a bottle of sauce if you want, since it's made by the owner himself.

The price is also a plus, with only 45k for a bowl and only 1k for the wet wipe. The owner is also very friendly and chatty about his food adventures too.

The place is a little cramped tho, with limited seatings and some seatings even placed at the side of the alley. There are little cooling options too so it might get a little hot.

Overall, the complement sauces are the real MVP here, which really enhances the fish bowl significantly . I recommend you try both of them if you have a chance to visit this place.

ChIJtSqtSm0pdTERoO6stSLqKW0.text:
I rarely review, but this restaurant has to be reviewed. It's better than expected. The restaurant is clean, cool, and you can sit and chill. The owner is cheerful, cute, and thoughtful. Everything in the restaurant is homemade, the chili sauce is delicious. Put it in a bowl of noodles and sip it, it's great. In particular, the snakehead fish head is carefully prepared so it doesn't smell fishy (this is my favorite). 

She moved to a new place on Ngo Tat To 3 years ago, but not many customers know about it. Before, she sold it on Truong Sa and it was very crowded. I don't know anyone, I just find it delicious and want to help honest, quality business people get known so they can continue to maintain their business. Everyone should come and try it. So addictive 😊

ChIJbTZiURcrdTERklr4UoDwGis.text:
Snakehead fish noodle soup with the special thing is that the noodles are handmade, the raw dough is carefully kneaded when customers eat, then cut and blanch as much as they want. 
The restaurant sells noodles with meat, head, and intestines of snakehead fish with a rich, aromatic flavor. The snakehead fish is not frozen like in the countryside, but it is a small type of fish, raised in intercropping so the meat is not loose and smelly. In addition, the snakehead fish is medium-sized, so it is not boring to look at. 
The price is affordable, 25,000 - 30,000 VND. 
In addition, the restaurant serves spring rolls and quail eggs (you pay for as much as you eat).

ChIJ_wxH-sUodTER83OhbKn4jOs.author: Bảo Spears
ChIJ_wxH-sUodTER83OhbKn4jOs.text:
Bánh Canh cua Mạ Tôi, nestled on Van Kiep Street, beckons with the promise of indulging in a classic Vietnamese delight: banh canh. This small restaurant offers a variety of toppings, ranging from crab meat to pork bologna and pig blood curd. However, despite its enticing menu, a visit here comes with mixed feelings.

The restaurant's popularity is evident in its crowded atmosphere, which can add to the lively dining experience but might also infringe upon the desired relaxation and comfort. Additionally, the prices lean towards the higher side, causing patrons to expect an exceptional culinary experience.

Unfortunately, the flavor of the banh canh doesn't quite match the anticipation set by the diverse toppings. While the options are plenty, the taste falls short of delivering an exceptional sensation on the palate. The flavors are average, and considering the higher cost, one might hope for a more memorable gastronomic encounter.

The overall experience at Bánh Canh cua Mạ Tôi can be summarized as a modest one. With a 3 out of 5-star rating, the restaurant struggles to stand out in a sea of culinary options. While the variety of toppings and the concept of the banh canh is promising, the execution and flavor leave room for improvement. If you're willing to overlook the crowded environment and the relatively high prices for the sake of trying different toppings on your banh canh, Bánh Canh cua Mạ Tôi might still satisfy your curiosity. However, those seeking an exceptional dining experience might want to explore other options in the bustling world of Vietnamese cuisine.

The price is quite reasonable. From 35k to 50k for a bowl of banh canh or instant noodles. I ordered a special bowl of banh canh for 50k and instant noodles with beef and beef balls for 40k.

The broth is a bit bland, not sweetened, so the MSG team is very excited.

The beef, lean bones, and beef balls are quite delicious, the quality of the supply is quite good compared to the price.

The blood is edible.

The fish cake is bad, not very delicious.

Please feel free to add more.

The owner is extremely friendly, enthusiastic, and very thoughtful. Everyone in the shop is great.

ChIJESmXq0wndTERgT2pdz4pqhw.text:
A unique and rare coconut milk noodle soup in Saigon.

I ordered a special coconut milk noodle soup for 60k. I'll tell you in advance that it's a lot, and it also comes with a large plate of raw vegetables. The bowl keeps the heat for a long time, so you don't need to blanch the vegetables first, just dip them into the bowl as you eat. There are tons of toppings in the bowl with noodles and coconut milk broth.

- The broth is a bit bland, but when you add fish sauce, it will be more flavorful. Coconut milk is indispensable, very fatty, if you're not used to it, you'll get bored quickly.

- Toppings include 2 meaty bones, minced meat, snails, crab sausage, fish sausage, crab soup, snakehead fish and quail eggs. Everything is fresh and delicious.

The restaurant space is quite small and hot, old and very messy. The saleswoman is also old so she often forgets, everyone don't rush or blame her, she will do it slowly.

ChIJESmXq0wndTERgT2pdz4pqhw.author: Kato Mayumi・ mãi yêu mình
ChIJESmXq0wndTERgT2pdz4pqhw.text:
After relieving myself in the neighborhood, I stopped in for a late lunch and had Bánh canh nước cốt dừa tom. It's what we call shrimp coconut milk soup udon in Japan. Immediately after ordering, I was a little worried, thinking, "Hmm, coconut milk udon... did I make a mistake?" But after just one sip, the gentle sweetness of the coconut milk and the rich dashi broth... were irresistible. ♡
And I understood why it was so delicious!

The combination of tapioca and milk in the all-time popular tapioca milk tea is delicious, fun, and addictive... this is it!!

Bánh canh, made with tapioca flour, is easy for Japanese people to relate to if you imagine chewy udon noodles. That's why it's so delicious when eaten with the gently sweet broth in hot Ho Chi Minh City! My favorite shrimp, plenty of vegetables, and quail... it was so much more fun and delicious.
Finally, I dipped some quẩy (a kind of fried bread) in the remaining soup... and ate it all!!
I... love this! I want to eat it again!
For Japanese people, this combination may seem off-putting at first glance... but I'm sure it will be a masterpiece that will take you to another level of deliciousness...♪
So, it's a perfect 5-star rating, but... the staff was cold to me (Japanese?)... so I'll deduct one star for service (lol)
※Oh, I... added chili sauce... but if you don't mind sweet things, it might be better to leave it out while eating it with the noodles for a milder flavor. Adding spiciness changes the flavor from 🇻🇳 to 🇹🇭, so it's a shame (^^;;

ChIJ67gu3_AndTERgrygK3PTU1M.text:
Delicious snakehead fish noodle soup on Nguyen Tuyen street. Opposite the old Binh Trung Tay ward people's committee.

The price is very reasonable. The noodles and vegetables are added for free. When customers order, the owner will cook, and each bowl has a separate pot and stove, so the wait is a bit long. I ordered a mixed bowl for 40k and an additional bowl of noodles for free.

- The broth is sweet and clear, cooked from fish bones, with a strong ginger smell to remove the fishy smell of the fish. Fried garlic oil is added so it is very fragrant.

- Steamed snakehead fish and fried snakehead fish are both quite delicious, the fish is fresh, not fishy, the 40k bowl has 2 thin pieces of each.

- Nha Trang fish cake has 2 pieces. The fish cake is chewy, a bit sweet, ok to eat.

- The accompanying vegetables are fish sauce and bitter vegetables, I find the bitter vegetables fresh and delicious.

- The dipping sauce has salty fish sauce and spicy chili. But the restaurant also has tamarind sauce which is very delicious, sweet and sour, salty... like in the picture, I added 1 spoon of tamarind sauce to the bowl of noodles and a little bit of spicy sate.

The owner of the restaurant is friendly and works quickly, maybe she is the only one doing everything so everything is a bit rushed and takes a long time but it's okay. Another downside is that the atmosphere in the restaurant is very hot, especially the row of tables near the entrance, exposed to enough sunlight from morning to noon, making it even hotter.

ChIJ3ciMHlMndTERuRz_qq-O8xs.name: places/ChIJ3ciMHlMndTERuRz_qq-O8xs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKSG82dUNKOTZDTWtnRRAB
ChIJ3ciMHlMndTERuRz_qq-O8xs.author: Khải Nguyễn Thanh
ChIJ3ciMHlMndTERuRz_qq-O8xs.text:
Snakehead fish noodle soup is a rustic, famous dish that bears the culinary mark of Central Vietnam, especially in the Binh Tri Thien region (now the three provinces of Thua Thien Hue, Quang Tri and Quang Binh). Although there is no specific document clearly recording the exact time of birth of this dish, its history is closely linked to the daily life and culinary culture of the people of the Central region.

Origin and characteristics
* Origin from the Central region: Snakehead fish noodle soup is said to have originated from the Central provinces, where the climate is harsh, creating a rustic and rustic cuisine. Snakehead fish (also known as snakehead fish) is a popular freshwater fish in Vietnam, easy to find and is the main ingredient for this dish.

* Noodles: Traditional noodle noodles are usually made from rice flour, giving it a characteristic sticky and fragrant texture. In some places, people also use tapioca flour or a combination of both types of flour.
* Broth: The broth is the soul of snakehead fish noodle soup, simmered from fish bones, pork bones, combined with vegetables such as onions, white radish and spices. In particular, this dish often has a mild spicy taste from chili and pepper, a characteristic of Central cuisine.
* Elaborate preparation: Although it is a rustic dish, the preparation of snakehead fish noodle soup requires meticulousness and elaboration. Snakehead fish must be carefully prepared to remove slime and fishy smell (usually using salt and white wine). The fish meat is skillfully removed from the bones, marinated with spices and then stir-fried. The bones and fish heads are often crushed, wrapped in gauze and simmered to get sweet water for the broth.
Development and spread
From the Central region, snakehead fish noodle soup has gradually spread to other regions of Vietnam, especially the South. When introduced to Saigon and the southern provinces, this dish may have some small variations in ingredients and flavors to suit local tastes, but the core still retains the characteristics of the Central region. For example, in some places, the noodles may be softer and chewier, or the broth may have a lighter sweet taste.

Today, snakehead fish noodle soup is not only a familiar dish on street stalls and sidewalk restaurants, but also appears in many restaurants, becoming a specialty loved by many tourists when coming to Vietnam. Some brands have even developed packaged snakehead fish noodle soup, bringing this dish to the international market.

In short, snakehead fish noodle soup is a simple dish but contains the culinary quintessence of the Central region, reflecting the creativity and ingenuity of Vietnamese people in turning familiar ingredients into attractive dishes, rich in the flavor of their homeland.

ChIJt9NC86UpdTER-VadepaFsf0.text:
Small, clean restaurant, delicious, hot snakehead fish noodle soup, fast service.

**
Bitter vegetable snakehead fish noodle soup is a special variation of the traditional snakehead fish noodle soup, featuring a harmonious combination of the sweet taste of the fish, the softness of the noodles and especially the characteristic slight bitterness of bitter vegetables, creating an extremely unique and attractive flavor, especially popular in the provinces of the Southwest.
Highlights of Bitter Vegetable Snakehead Fish Noodle Soup
Different from the usual snakehead fish noodle soup, this bitter vegetable "version" has its own highlights:
* Unique flavor from bitter vegetables: This is the "soul" of the dish. Bitter vegetables, a popular wild vegetable in the West, have a slightly bitter taste but a sweet, refreshing aftertaste. When eaten with snakehead fish noodles, the bitter taste of the vegetables is not unpleasant, but on the contrary, it helps balance the sweet and fatty taste of the fish and broth, creating an interesting contrast, stimulating the taste buds and making the dish not greasy. 
* Delicious chewy noodles: The noodles in this dish are usually made from rice flour or tapioca flour (tapioca starch), with a characteristic soft and chewy texture. The noodles are boiled until cooked, pure white, when poured hot broth, they will be soaked in flavor. 
* Sweet, firm snakehead fish meat: Snakehead fish (snakehead fish) is carefully selected, usually wild snakehead fish to ensure the fish meat is firm and naturally sweet. The fish is cleaned of slime, thoroughly deodorized with lemon, salt or vinegar, then stir-fried with onions, garlic, shallots and a little seasoning (usually turmeric or annatto seeds to create a beautiful golden color) until firm and flavorful before being added to the broth. 
* Rich, clear broth: The broth is simmered from snakehead fish bones, pork bones or dried shrimp, along with shallots, grilled ginger and other vegetables (such as carrots, white radish) to create a natural and clear sweetness. The broth must be clear, not fishy, and have a characteristic aroma.
Experience when enjoying
When a bowl of snakehead fish noodle soup with bitter vegetables is served, you will feel:
* Aroma: The fragrant smell of the broth, of the marinated and stir-fried snakehead fish, mixed with the characteristic aroma of bitter vegetables and onions and coriander.
* Color: A bowl of noodle soup usually has a beautiful light yellow color from turmeric or annatto seeds of the fish, the white color of the noodle soup, the lush green color of bitter vegetables, green onions, coriander, dotted with a few slices of red chili.
* Taste: Take a spoonful of the broth, you will feel the sweet, rich flavor spreading. Pick up a chopstick of noodle soup with a piece of snakehead fish, add a few leaves of bitter vegetables, and take a light bite. The noodles are chewy, the fish meat is soft and sweet, and then the slight bitterness of the bitter vegetables will flare up, then gradually fade away, leaving a very unique sweet aftertaste. This combination creates an unforgettable symphony of taste. 
* Feeling: This dish is not only delicious but also brings a cool, refreshing feeling, very suitable for hot weather days or when you want to enjoy a dish with a unique, different flavor. 
Snakehead fish noodle soup with bitter vegetables is not only a dish but also a typical culinary culture of the river delta region, demonstrating the ingenuity and creativity in combining local ingredients to create unique flavors. If you have the chance, don't forget to try this dish!

ChIJmdfNawApdTERfuBqVN8i7Io.text:
Satisfying Crab Noodle Soup Sprinkled with Salt by Ms. Ngan: Delicious, Full of Belly!

Okay, I have to talk about a "true love" place for seafood lovers: Ms. Ngan's Salt Sprinkled with Crab Noodle Soup at 574 Nguyen Thai Son. From the first time I "tried it", I was completely conquered. Not only the taste, but the overall experience is extremely worth the money!
What will "shock" you immediately is the super large amount of food. Really, super large! A bowl of noodles or vermicelli here is enough to make you full, sometimes even having to "resist" to finish it. But don't worry about it being too much but not good, the crab is very fresh, the meat is firm and sweet. Ms. Ngan's divine "sprinkling of salt" creates a unique, salty, rich flavor that is hard to find elsewhere. Whether it's soft and chewy noodles or flavorful vermicelli, each choice has its own deliciousness, making you want to slurp up every last drop. And the absolute "scorer" is the service. I tried ordering delivery and have to admit that the delivery was incredibly fast. Moreover, the shipper even provided full eating utensils, so thoughtful and cute! From the quality of the food to the convenience, Ms. Ngan's Salted Crab Noodles deserves 10 points. If you are in Ho Chi Minh City and craving a bowl of quality, filling crab noodle soup or vermicelli, this is the place you can't miss!

ChIJi0W1JO4pdTERXFi7o4q69R8.text:
“A Map” – A noodle shop with a fat name but all the dishes are delicious and heartwarming!

As someone who often travels and camps in the jungle, I believe in simple things – like a bowl of hot snakehead fish noodle soup on a rainy afternoon or a hungry stomach after setting up camp. And A Map – a noodle shop with a fat name but not “cheap” at all, has been with me for… 4 years without any deviation.

A bowl of fried snakehead fish noodle soup here is a lifetime memory. The broth is clear, sweet from the stewed fish, no “fake” MSG. The fried snakehead fish is crispy on the outside, soft and moist on the inside, not fishy, ​​not dry – the standard of “beautiful interface, quality content”. The raw vegetables are washed clean, green, and served with it, very suitable for vegetable lovers like me.

The space of the restaurant is simple, neat, a bit crowded during peak hours – but that’s okay, how many people can find a restaurant that is both delicious and authentic without being crowded?

If you are looking for a place that is delicious – fast – cheap but still full of love in every spoonful of broth, then A Map is the one for you. A gentle suggestion is to try the combo of banh canh – bun – hap – chien, after eating it you will have enough energy… to climb the mountain!

⸻

“A Map” – The big-named noodle shop that delivers bite-sized happiness!

As a camper and nature-chaser, I often find comfort in the simplest joys – like a steaming bowl of fish noodle soup after a rainy hike or post-campsite hunger pangs. And A Map, with its hefty name and hearty portions, has been my go-to for the past 4 years.

Their crispy fried snakehead fish noodle soup is my forever favorite. The broth is clear and naturally sweet from simmered fish – no MSG tricks. The fried fish is golden-crunchy on the outside and tender inside, zero fishy smell – a perfect example of “looks good, tastes better.” Fresh herbs and greens on the side are clean and generous, ideal for veggie lovers like me.

If you’re hunting for a tasty, quick, budget-friendly meal that feels made with care – A Fat should be on your list. Pro tip: try the combo bowl with fish done 3 ways – it’s energy-packed enough to fuel a hike right after.

ChIJ6VXyyn4ndTERU7Lereq9o2Y.text:
Tran Kha Van Can Snakehead Fish Noodle Soup – Central Flavor in the Heart of Thu Duc

If you are a fan of snakehead fish noodle soup, Tran Kha Van Can Snakehead Fish Noodle Soup in Thu Duc is definitely a destination not to be missed. Located on Kha Van Can Street – a bustling street – the restaurant impresses with its rusticity, closeness and especially its rich Central flavor.

The highlight of the restaurant is the sweet broth, cooked from well-boiled bones combined with fresh, non-fishy, ​​thoroughly cleaned snakehead fish. The noodles are slightly chewy, not mushy or broken, just right. The snakehead fish is boiled just right, torn into large pieces, the meat is white, fragrant, served with raw vegetables and fried onions, creating a harmonious and attractive dish.

In addition to traditional noodle soup, the restaurant also has additional options such as stir-fried snakehead fish noodle soup, crispy fried snakehead fish to eat with, suitable for the diverse tastes of diners. Reasonable prices, ranging from 30,000-45,000 VND/bowl, depending on the type. A full bowl, full without feeling full.

The restaurant space is simple, clean, the service is fast and friendly. Even during peak hours, there are many customers but the waiting time is not too long. This is a big plus for those who are busy but still want to enjoy delicious quality food.

In conclusion, Tran Kha Van Can Snakehead Fish Noodle Soup is a place worth visiting if you want to find a rich, quality meal at a reasonable price. A choice that will not disappoint diners who love rustic delicacies in the heart of Saigon.

ChIJo8c89BkvdTERDOpgTcKHqoE.name: places/ChIJo8c89BkvdTERDOpgTcKHqoE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xScVpXZG5jMHhEV21VMFZHUlhUakpTVFVwQ2NsRRAB
ChIJo8c89BkvdTERDOpgTcKHqoE.author: Manuel Dresselmann
ChIJo8c89BkvdTERDOpgTcKHqoE.text:
We were looking for a restaurant that specialised in Chao for quite some time so we were really happy when we found this place online.

When we got in noone seemed to work there. There were some guests eating but no waiters or waitresses. So after a while standing at the entrance we took a seat. Some minutes later we walken around looking for someone we have found our later waitress sitting with her back facing the entrance all the way in the back of the restaurant.

Looking online we found a great variety of dishes, so we were pretty puzzled when out waitress gave us a small breakfast menu card without prices. Turns out she thought we were hotel guests from the hotel above the restautant. Although we explained in english and vietnamese that we were normal guests she did not understand us.

From the small breakfast menu we chose the braised pork porride with coffee and artichoke tea. The artichoke tea is a hibiskus tea, it seems there was a issue with the translator.

After ordering the waitress came back 5 minutes later asking for our order again. It just seemed like it was not her day.

The porridge as is was was perfect and definetly worth 4-5 Stars. Sadly through the pork rips were that tough that we needed many toothpicks. Either the cooking time was not long enough or the quality of the meat was not good enough.

Afterwards while paying it turned out that again the waitress put us in the system as hotel guests. At that point we felt like being pranked.

All in all the porridge as it is was really fantastic, sadly the service and the meat destroyed what could have been a perfect experience.

ChIJUwbo180odTERQ6tFYQ6Wdpk.author: Nam Nguyễn
ChIJUwbo180odTERQ6tFYQ6Wdpk.text: The porridge is delicious! They have lots of toppings you can freely choose to go with it, like heart, liver, intestines, xíu mại (steamed pork/shrimp balls), fresh egg yolk, boiled quail eggs, and century egg. They even have cháo quẩy "fried dough sticks". The porridge looks white so you might think it's bland, but it's actually very flavorful and perfectly seasoned. You could add more fish sauce, but I didn't find it necessary. If you go with two people, you might want to order an extra plain bowl of porridge. A great touch is that the green onions (scallions) are served separately, so those who don't eat them won't have to pick them out. The shop is small and tucked away in an alley, so it's a bit hidden, but it's easy to find since it's right near the entrance, you'll spot it quickly. It's quite cozy, clean, and tidy.

ChIJvdjNICMvdTERhgYyIywCYlE.author: Evan Lee
ChIJvdjNICMvdTERhgYyIywCYlE.text: I'm pretty picky when it comes to pork intestine porridge (chao long). It sounds disgusting, but it it tastes amazing if you give it a try. It's one of the easiest dishes to prepare, but is extremely hard to pull off right. Everything from the blood sausage, to the boiled pork blood and even the Chinese donuts are done really well here. Prices are very reasonable (see attached menu) with a small bowl at 40kvnd to a large bowl for 50kvnd (about 2usd). I could barely finish the large bowl and they are very generous with the meat. You can order extras of everything also. Service was very fast and friendly. We came at 4pm and the place was absolutely packed with to go and delivery drivers picking up orders. Heard a lot of good things about this location and it's apparent why. The food is really good, clean and friendly service. Highly recommend!

ChIJ_6uwWhQvdTERL5wBke7qNI4.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJ_6uwWhQvdTERL5wBke7qNI4.text: This eatery has both indoor and outdoor seating. Head outside for the best experience even if you come here at night, the fresh air is much more pleasant than the stuffy indoor space. I opted for a medium mixed organ portion and two bowls of blood porridge. While the mixed dish were a bit overshadowed by the pork liver, the owner allows customisation before mixing, so feel free to speak up. The shredded onion is sweet and mild, not overpowering at all. And to truly personalise your dish, there is a selection of spices on every table including fish sauce and sliced lemongrass. The price is spot on, not too high, not too low. This place will definitely be my go-to for future porridge cravings.

ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.text:
Co Van porridge, located right in To Hien Thanh pharmaceutical market. Only sold in the evening.

Although the display looks eye-catching, the taste is not really good, not as delicious as many review websites. The display cabinet has all the popular side dishes like many other white porridge - bean porridge shops. The price is quite cheap, like I ate red bean porridge + fried shrimp for only 20k.

- Bean porridge is cooked so that the rice and beans are soft, but the coconut milk is not delicious, the pot is too bland, the flour is too fatty, so it loses the coconut flavor and is probably thickened with tapioca starch.

- There are exactly 5 or 6 fried shrimp. The shell is different, the meat inside is shrunk to a tiny bit, the shrimp frying seasoning is okay.

The 2 saleswomen are not as annoying as some recent reviews.

ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.name: places/ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKblJGQnVaR3RzYm1GNWMwbzBjbHBTVDE4M1RWRRAB
ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.author: Đào Phan
ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.text:
I went to eat and the owner looked down on customers, when I read the reviews I realized I wasn't the only one who had this problem.
I went to the restaurant at 7pm but there was no place to sit so I had to turn the car into the alley next door, the owner kept rushing me to "go sit at the hot pot restaurant" and the customers didn't pay attention to what they ordered and made everything wrong, I ordered minced meat porridge without onions & pickled fish sauce, but the porridge was served WITH ONIONS AND SALTED DUCK, when I asked to change the pickled fish sauce, they didn't say a word, I stirred the porridge with onions and told the restaurant "I told you not to put onions in" the owner just replied "take it out".
Ok restaurant, I really hate this kind of food and can't even swallow this bowl of porridge, consider it bad luck.

ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.name: places/ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xJdFEyMTRUVkJKVGxsSFNFdFVVMlZPUkcwNGFWRRAB
ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.author: Vicky H
ChIJj6MQMwovdTERFBX8Z6vCstc.text:
“YOU SELL 1000 CUSTOMERS, ONLY 1 CUSTOMER WILL EAT LIKE ME” x 3 times loudly
I have eaten here many times, not the first time. I usually only eat pandan porridge (green) and side dishes. That day, I ordered minced meat porridge - I didn't know that the restaurant sells minced meat porridge with white porridge, so I didn't have time to tell them. When it was brought out, I just gently said that I forgot to tell them to get pandan porridge, I will tell them sooner next time. The staff immediately replied to me: "My boss doesn't sell it like that" 😨 "It's so bland, how can you eat it?"
Oh my gosh?!?!?
When I was paying, I asked the owner again, and the owner loudly yelled at me like above, over and over again. In addition, he also said "here, I cook according to the taste of normal customers, but only 1 out of 1000 people eat like me"
Oh my gosh!?!?
She explained that there were customers who ordered the food on the app, ate it blandly, and then complained on the app. What?!?!?
Although the food was quite good, I will never come back again. Really shocked!

ChIJk5ZEtfUudTER_EQyEAWKiUs.text:
A normal porridge shop, for those who are eternally craving white porridge when it's late for dinner. Seeing that the shop is crowded, I heard it's been around for a long time, that's not important.

White porridge is a simple dish, anyone can make it, the shop doesn't have anything special except for the rich menu with many types of food to eat with porridge. This time I ordered salted eggs, pickled vegetables with anchovies. The anchovies are soft, have some grit, and taste okay. The pickled vegetables are young pickled watermelon, sweet and crunchy, which suits my taste.

The porridge only has white porridge, no pandan leaves or anything.

The shop is crowded with family members serving, so the dishes are served quickly, and talking to each other is a bit noisy. The sidewalk space is more airy than inside. Payment by bank transfer is available. Prices are generally high, nothing impressive to come back.

ChIJIZaj_yIvdTERpQ6icJSTz6M.author: Trong Nguyen
ChIJIZaj_yIvdTERpQ6icJSTz6M.text: I heard that the Cháo Bụi Đặng Thanh Mai (a type of Vietnamese porridge) has been passed down for over 40 years. I came here after watching a cooking show by Viet Huong. The second time I went, around 4 PM, they still had some left, but the first time, by 5 PM, it was almost sold out, only the blood porridge was left. Overall, the place is small, old, and seems a bit run-down. If it rains, it can probably only seat about 6-8 people. On sunny days, it can seat more, around 12-15 people. As for the porridge itself, it's excellent. Very fragrant, sweet with the flavor of bone broth and offal, and very delicious. The rice grains are very soft and smooth. The offal is very tender, sweet, and not mushy, bitter, or smelly at all; the best parts are the intestines and pig skin. The intestines are sweet, soft, and fatty, the skin is crispy but soft, and especially clean of hair (I really dislike having hair). The blood porridge isn't very good because it's thick, not watery. If you want to eat offal, you should just order the offal porridge. Since I ordered the full bowl, there wasn't much offal, so the owner added some pork ribs instead. The ribs were delicious, tender and sweet, but a little chewy. The price is quite reasonable for the quality. It's best to go early, between 2 PM and 5 PM, to get some. Otherwise, they'll be sold out. There's a detailed price list for your reference.

ChIJFycFqKQvdTERForVyOfwwVg.text:

Each bowl of porridge will be 1k. Each bowl of porridge is scooped by the uncle with 2 bowls of porridge. The porridge is fragrant. The shop has many toppings from salted pickles, mixed melon, anchovies, salted egg sauce, century eggs, and pork floss. Each dish is only 5-10k. Very easy to eat. There is also ginseng water, only 5k a bottle. I think other places sell it for 10k-12k. It's a bit surprising.
The uncle has all kinds of dipping sauces and salt and pepper on the table for self-service according to everyone's needs.
The owner is very easy-going, always smiling.

11/2025

This pandan white porridge shop is delicious~~

The porridge has a light pandan scent, is hot and easy to eat. The shop has a lot of side dishes, beautifully arranged, just looking at them makes you want to try them all.

The day I visited, I was sick so I didn't have much appetite, only ordered salted egg porridge and pickled vegetables.
The salted eggs are fatty, salty enough, eaten with hot porridge, it's just right. The pickled vegetables are crispy, rich, and fragrant in a rustic style, very delicious with porridge.

The price is only 23k for a portion but it's quite filling, extremely reasonable.
When I'm well, I'll definitely come back to try more dishes!!
5 stars~~

ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.text:
If you love duck porridge like I do, this is one of the best places to visit in Ho Chi Minh City.
The duck meat is tender, easy to eat, and has minimal bones. The porridge itself is absolutely delicious — full of flavour and comforting. The staff are friendly and quick to suggest the right dishes based on the number of people in your group. We ended up ordering more because everything was just that tasty! The prices are reasonable and suitable for both locals and tourists. Highly recommended!

ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.text: Tried the duck soup with the glass noodles today! It was delicious! One of the best dishes I’ve had during bf my time in Vietnam. The duck was juicy and tender and the broth was packed full of flavour for only 45k! Highly recommend you try this restaurant.

ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.name: places/ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBa042TG5RRRAB
ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.author: Nguyet Mai
ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.text:
I tried the Bun Man Vit, and it was incredibly delicious. The dish featured succulent duck served with vermicelli noodles, all swimming in a rich and aromatic broth. The combination of fresh herbs and dipping sauce added layers of flavor, making each bite a culinary delight.

The restaurant is tucked away in a charming alleyway, giving it a cozy and authentic atmosphere. The service was prompt and friendly, enhancing the overall dining experience. The ambiance was relaxed and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for a casual meal with friends or family. The prices were reasonable too, considering the quality of food and service.

Overall, this hidden gem is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Highly recommended for food lovers who appreciate local cuisine.

ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.name: places/ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYejVXLTRBRRAB

ChIJH4Q8qyQvdTER8fJZD9F5T3c.text:
Two of us got a duck breast salad and two bowls of bún (without the duck) and it was plenty to fill us up. We only paid about VND 140.000 for everything, including a bottle of herbal tea. Pretty good value, right?

The duck was amazing! So tender and tasty, no weird smells at all. The bún was a bit of a miss though, still a bit too much bamboo shoot flavour for our liking. The salad was alright, nothing special, but it looked pretty with all those colourful, fresh bits.

The service was quick and everyone was super friendly. I asked about one of the salad ingredients and they were more than happy to explain.

The place is down a narrow alley, so it is not really car-friendly. Even finding a spot for a motorbike can be tricky, let alone a car.

ChIJ5RxGmjMvdTERvSNH5uLbKRQ.author: Hiếu Phạm
ChIJ5RxGmjMvdTERvSNH5uLbKRQ.text:
My lover and I recently had the opportunity to visit Vit Ngon 68 to enjoy duck dishes, and it was truly a memorable experience. 

The restaurant has a clean, neat, airy space, creating a pleasant feeling right from the moment we entered. Although not too big, the arrangement of tables and chairs is reasonable, not cramped. 

The service here is very attentive and enthusiastic. The owner is warm, friendly, always welcoming guests with a warm smile, creating a feeling of closeness like at home. 

Regarding the food, the price is reasonable compared to the general level in District 2. The broth is sweet, rich, and seasoned very well. The duck meat is soft, fragrant, not tough or smelly, and very delicious. In particular, the restaurant has a variety of duck-related dishes, so you won't have to worry about getting bored. 

I was really satisfied with the meal here and will definitely come back on another occasion to try more dishes. If you are a fan of duck dishes, this is a place worth visiting!

ChIJB-4V2fgrdTERY1pKoXYbWf0.name: places/ChIJB-4V2fgrdTERY1pKoXYbWf0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VON0kzOF9VanBTb29BRRAB

ChIJB-4V2fgrdTERY1pKoXYbWf0.text:
If you are looking for a place to eat delicious Singaporean frog porridge at a reasonable price in Ho Chi Minh City, then Big Frog Porridge is an option not to be missed!

Food:
The porridge here is cooked in Singaporean style - smooth, hot white porridge, served with very rich braised frog. The frog meat is fresh, firm, flavorful, especially the spicy, fragrant black pepper sauce - very appetizing.

Space:
The restaurant is small but clean and airy. Neat tables and chairs, fast service, so even if there are many customers, you don't have to wait long. There are indoor and outdoor seats, suitable for both dining alone or in small groups.

Service:
Friendly staff, quick service.

Price:
The price is reasonable with the quality of the food and service, it is completely worth it.

Summary:
A delicious frog porridge restaurant, worth visiting many times. If you are a fan of Singaporean cuisine or simply want to change up your dinner, Frog Porridge is definitely a great choice!

ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.author: Hai Phan (Francis)
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.text: Come back to this restaurant after long period of time. Everything still perfect as it is. From the parking staffs to the waiters are all very friendly and alway appear to help whenever you need them. They have the best duck dishes that I ever tried in HCMC. The price of course a bit higher than some other duck meat restaurant but at acceptable level. All the dishes here are good. Car parking available opposite with the place with very helpful assistance of the staffs. Everything is perfect

ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.name: places/ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNvNE9TbzVnRRAB
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.author: Khoi Nguyen
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.text: There are 3 similar spots on this strip. Go to this specific one! Food here is really fresh. We had coconuts and their congee with duck. Duck is so tender and moist. Loved the flavor and generous portion. Flavor was on point and prices are reasonable. This place is huge and has plenty of seating for large parties. 1 large bowl should be enough. Usually not a fan of congee but don't pass up on this spot!

ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.name: places/ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoMWZtYmFREAE
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.author: Cuong Nguyen (Alfred)
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.text: Yummy steamed duck, tender and juicy. They have a very simple menu, with base options like porridge, glass noddle and vermicelli.

ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.name: places/ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURNZ1pMeUdBEAE
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.author: George Hamton
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.text: Duck was great, not sure how they prepare it but no gamy flavor at all. I tried the congee and it tasted great. The salad was very refreshing and the fish sauce had a nice blend of salty/sweet/sour. The duck you get tasted fine, but definitely an acquired taste. Over all worthwhile trip to visit and taste the food here.

ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.name: places/ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNwbk9xQnpBRRAB
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.author: thesydneytram
ChIJPcM3OJwodTER--J40mGYzUc.text:
Stopped by this restaurant to try their signature duck salad with congee. You can also pair it with glass noodles soup. The duck was tender, a perfect pair with ginger fish sauce and Vietnamese cabbage salad. The congee had a bit of duck smell and was more on the watery side.

Service was very quick. There is indoor seating with AC if you prefer.

ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.name: places/ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURtME8yekFREAE

ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.text: Delicous and reasonable prices. Having place for car parking.

ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.text: It is change to Goat Meal no more Chao ca Mien Tay

ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.text: Very tasty and superd reasonable price

ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.author: Dan Vu Van
ChIJ53HR06cndTER6cV1VaRWOeA.text: Cheap and good, a bit hygienic care needed

ChIJJwACzogrdTERgEoOnJe0wPw.name: places/ChIJJwACzogrdTERgEoOnJe0wPw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMteXJ1R2V3EAE
ChIJJwACzogrdTERgEoOnJe0wPw.author: Ngọc Hân Trần
ChIJJwACzogrdTERgEoOnJe0wPw.text: One of my favorite porridge shops, where the rice is not fully expanded. It makes you feel full and chews better!

ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.name: places/ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmek5INXBnRRAB
ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.author: Vy
ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.text:
Oyster porridge used to be 25k, cheap and delicious, but now it's no longer that price. But the other porridge dishes are also delicious.
If you crave it late at night, you have to eat it. The couple sells it quickly, sometimes by 10:30 it's all sold out
It's a bit hot to eat at the restaurant, if you put tables and chairs outside it's probably cooler

ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.name: places/ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3dmYyNWh3RRAB
ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.author: Nguyễn Xuân Tiến
ChIJdfNrf6IpdTER7x5lcVMF4hQ.text: The porridge is quite ok, the fresh oysters are delicious but the name of the porridge is night porridge, is it only sold until late at night or something? The space of the restaurant is normal because the restaurant often sells take-out.

ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.name: places/ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wSU1rWXlOMDVDTjJWWE9FWjZhVTlvZUROeU5sRRAB
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.author: Ak
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.text: Local bun thit nuong spot located right in front of a super popular one, but it still gets some customers, so I decided to give it a try to compare. Their bun thit nuong is quite similar to the spot across the street, and the bowl looks almost identical. The flavor is close too, though I slightly prefer the other one more.

ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.name: places/ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwbE1IbHBhV1ZNY1ZoeE0xRm1PWEpvYWtFeGRtYxAB
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.author: Jun How Chew
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.text:
This unassuming stall away from District 1 serves affordable and tasty Bun Thit Nuong.
Pork was well marinated, juicy and well grilled infused with smokiness. Fried spring roll was not greasy.
Pair it with the sauce and fresh vege and herbs.

ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.name: places/ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGRlIxQjVUVU5JWkVKYUxVVjJNWE0xYUhKS2JWRRAB
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.author: Casually Mentioned
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.text:
Tried it. Liked it.

Standard fare done right. Spare portions but that's expected. The Cha sausage is charred properly and bites nicely along with the regular grilled pork. The Nem (egg rolls) is fried well but starts to get a bit funky aroud 3pm--nothing their sweet sweet Nuoc Mam (fish sauce) can't fix.

5 stars for the benefit of the doubt, and grandpa hacking his lungs out in the corner.

ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.name: places/ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZNm8yY1hBEAE
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.author: Jesus Estrada
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.text: Went for early dinner on a weekend. It was busy but not crowded. The staff are helpful and efficient. Some speak English. The menu has no pictures and no English descriptions. The food is solid and affordable. You can have another round of noodles and greens at no additional charge. The springroll is decent. The grilled meat was a bit dry, and the pork patties were soft. The passion fruit juice was tasty. Paid in cash.

ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.name: places/ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQSHR0ZXFWbUw3Q0ZREAE
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.author: Vicky
ChIJey0xKtsudTER035pcPfrTvY.text: Decent food and you can get refill on rice noodles and vegetables, the portion is big enough so we didn’t go for the refill. The boss was also very nice and friendly. Highly recommend to try!

ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.name: places/ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNyOFpuQlJ3EAE
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.author: Rob P
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.text: Delicious bowl of bún thịt nướng which is quite filling with good quality ingredients. Hard to find the place but well worth it.

ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.name: places/ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUREODhiSFFREAE
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.author: Adventurous
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.text: Delicious, the portion is quite large, worth the price and quality. Have eaten many times..! Thanks

ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.name: places/ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUREMWRhdWZnEAE
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.author: Aaron
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.text: This place is pretty amazing.  Everything is delicious, and the portions are very big. They always seem quite busy, but there is never a waiting time. Go and enjoy with total confidence

ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.name: places/ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURCaXU3alJ3EAE
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.author: Richard Ibarra
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.text: This is most likely the best bun thit nuong I've come across. The portions are large but the prices are not, though it is slightly more than the average bowl. With the rate of sales that they have, they  prepare your order very quickily. The pre-prepped bags make the to go orders almost instant. The only problem for me is that it is hot inside.

ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.name: places/ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMteF9YbDFnRRAB
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.author: Gielle
ChIJf8-rGgYvdTERK5QwJci33Ms.text: Large serving! So full yet afforable. Spent only 46k for the bun thit nuong + tra tac 👍

ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.name: places/ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sxaWIwdHJjbVJrU1hkV2MxZHdNVFJzWldKWlZWRRAB
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.author: Julie DeMarco
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.text:
As a Westerner, it can be difficult to know the best places to eat in a foreign country. We lucked out at Bún Thịt Nướng Chị Tuyền as our tour guide Dao at Indochina Heritage Travel Group, made the recommendation to stop here for dinner. The food was amazing, we had the Bún thịt nướng chả giò - grilled pork & deep fried spring rolls with fresh noodle and Bánh mì hấp thịt bò - steamed bread and stir-fried beef. Even though the dining space is tight, we were able to sit and eat as a group of 5.

They made sure we were eating it properly and I’m sure were quite amused with our efforts. They were friendly and helpful. Learning it was my daughter’s birthday, the suddenly showed up with a scoop of delicious ice cream which was so thoughtful and special. Such kind people and I hope we get a change to go back.

ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.name: places/ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pjeWJteGtOVlJaYW13d2MxRlViVVphWkdWc1RuYxAB
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.author: John Gleason
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.text: My expat friend and I decided to try this highly rated restaurant.  Our review:  Mediocre and expensive.  We arrived at 12:30pm on a Monday and it was very busy.  Many Grab bikes doing take-away. Two floors of seating we were quickly accommodated and we ordered the signature dish: bun thit nuong cha gio plus ice tea.   The food came quickly.  Unfortunately,  it was meh. Not distasteful.  Just very average.  Also, the price is a premium over what a shop catering to a local clientele would charge.  Oh well....

ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.name: places/ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kQmJtOWZaSFY0U1hBMlQwMVFhRWhpY2tKQk5YYxAB
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.author: Pham Xuan Phu
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.text: Absolutely delicious! The grilled pork was tender with a nice smoky aroma. The crispy spring rolls were cut into tasty small bites. Everything was perfectly bonded through sweet fish sauce. Totally recommended!

ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.name: places/ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xOdVlXSlFaRE5FZVRFeFMwaDZkSFoyYVhOSGRrRRAB
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.author: Andrew Do
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.text:
As a vietnamese aussie visiting vietnam for the first time, this place was on our itinerary list as a must try. We walked to the location near 6pmish which is a bit difficult due to bikes and cars so be mindful how you get here.

The food however was INCREDIBLE. favourite dish thus far and want to go back again. Becareful to not use the wipes unless you want to pay like i did haha.

ok bye bye

ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.name: places/ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tnNFUxUTFOVE5JTUhSZlNFeHBSVWxzWkRaNk9XYxAB
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.author: Kerima Sonaco
ChIJs6sAxtovdTERD0D38cp6FKg.text:
We walked to this place and while it was packed, we were able to get a seat. The food was immediate and delicious, perfect with their cold jasmine tea. The meat was well seasoned and the spring rolls are crisp.

My aunt was curious as to what brand they use for the cold tea and the lady owner (?) graciously gave us a sealed pack 🥰

ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.name: places/ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSa2VVWmFOMXBDYVVOcVlWUnJYMWRwVDFsNFRWRRAB
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.author: Euan Ta
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.text: 45k for a special bowl of rice noodles consist of grilled pork, roasted pork, spring rolls and veggie.

ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.name: places/ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eS02cm9nRRAB
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.author: Bella Lay
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.text: So so SO YUMMY! One of my favourite places in HCM to get bun thit nuong, have come here multiple times in the past year, highly recommend! Also the tra da is delicious!

ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.name: places/ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMakwtSllBEAE
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.author: Ulee Soropos
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.text: The food… well, just delicious!! And the service was so welcoming that they wouldn’t even let me pay!! Highly recommend

ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.name: places/ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQxaTRpZEFnEAE
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.author: Lex C
ChIJV_RgFkIvdTERbcinz7eKpcI.text: Bún dac biet was really good, and the ladies that work there were extremely nice to us as visitors that aren’t from the area. Will come again when I’m back on HCMC.

ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.name: places/ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsSVVUYzBiMDFTWVRkU2JrRkdja3MxT1RoaWVGRRAB
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.author: Michelle T
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.text:
Good simple food with a couple of drink vendors conveniently in same area.  It gets very busy so be prepared for a bit of chaos (mainly yelling and screaming from the food vendor to each other trying to organise seating and food). The old lady with the sugarcane cart makes the best drinks (not the one right next to where they make the good but a few steps down).  She offers a larger range of fresh fruit juices and much more friendlier than the other vendor.
All the vendors work together and share seating space so you can easily order the food and also a juice from a different vendor.

ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.name: places/ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5Mk5WOUJUM0ZGUVZkcE9IUklXbWd3UzFoT1lXYxAB
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.author: Lauren Taylor
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.text: I thought the perfect bowl didn’t exist. Favourite thing I ate in Vietnam and I don’t say things like that lightly. Literally had 3 bowls in 2 days. Felt emotional taking the last bite, don’t know when I’ll be able to have this again 💔

ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.name: places/ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCRGEwdG5kWFJIZVZscGNFaHJZM1ZDUzBKZmEzYxAB
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.author: Pritama Oly
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.text:
A couple months ago before I flew to HCMC, I watched Danny and Diggy’s video — and they were eating here. It looked so yum! 😋 So, on one hot Saturday afternoon, I finally came to try it for myself.

And you know what? OMG, damn — it was SO good! The noodles were clean and fresh, the veggies were crisp, the grilled pork was perfectly seasoned, and the spring rolls… wow, they all mixed together so beautifully with that sauce. 🤤

It was so good that I actually went back again on my last night in HCMC!
Oh, and listen — you have to try their lemon tea. I swear, it’s the best one I’ve ever had — refreshing, tangy, and just perfect for the hot weather. 🍋🧋

Enjoy your day in HCMC, and don’t miss this place — totally worth it! 🙌

and there will be a staff that will always asking "where do you come from?" and I answered "Indonesia" and he'll replied "enak?"
he always do that to everyone 😅
so friendly

ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.name: places/ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201YWEzbG1iMEpTUlVkbmRYTjFSWEJ6WDBGRFZFRRAB
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.author: Jade
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.text:
This is easily the best meal I’ve had in my 1 month stay in Vietnam. I ordered 6 bowls of their number 2 (pork bowl) over 3 days and it makes me sad that I won’t get to experience this again.
Every single ingredient in the bowl played their role to such a high standard it’s ridiculous. Do yourself a favor, if you’re in Ho Chi Minh no matter where you’re staying come eat here.

ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.name: places/ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCRll6WmZZMmt6ZUhGTVIyWlplVWg1ZGtaeVRVRRAB
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.author: Summer C
ChIJt-SgqDgvdTERiaoamOe4cSY.text: i would give it 6 stars if google has it. wonderful, truly authentic place. the noodles with sauce, veg, grilled pork and spring roll had such flavour. especially the spring roll, the rice paper seemed a bit sticky, and it was so good we ordered one more. ambience was plastic chairs and table with flies. but really worth the food and experience. highly recommended !!!

ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.name: places/ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvaU9YaFN3EAE
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.author: tran trungtin
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.text:
I have been eating since I was a student, and I still stop by whenever I have a chance. The quality of the food is unquestionable: the meat is marinated well, rich in flavor, grilled but still soft. Especially the spring rolls are always freshly fried, hot, with quality fillings, and the spring rolls are sold separately, unfried. The restaurant is small and cozy. 

I usually order a full bowl with some noodles and 2 more spring rolls. 

When I first graduated from school and went on an internship in 2018, I brought foreign customers from the company to eat there and they still talk about it to this day. 

The owner and the ladies talk gently and cutely. 10/10

ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.name: places/ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaVVdWOW1YMEZMZVdnMk1GWnBSbVYxU1VKdWJtYxAB
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.author: Jack Krupen
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.text:
The restaurant is crowded so it's quite slow but acceptable
The ribs are marinated very well and taste good

ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.name: places/ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURLMnI3NENREAE
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.author: lê hải hậu
ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.text: This restaurant has been around for a long time. The grilled pork vermicelli is quite delicious. I remember when I was a student it was 17k. Now it's 25k-30k depending on your choice. But overall it's quite delicious here.

ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY.name: places/ChIJOfwJf8IudTERucs8eaQ4DOY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURBejV2WHdBRRAB

ChIJS2FZ65YvdTER8gMKEpJU6-8.text: We came in for a pretty early lunch right after they opened to avoid the lunch rush. The prices are great and the food was fine but nothing special. It should be noted this is one of a local chain. We asked for two bowls with everything (in vnese) and he repeated it back to me correctly but they came out with no nem nuong. You can get your first extra servings of bun and veggies for free and after that it’s a small charge per refill. I probably wouldn’t come again. Lots of motorbike parking out front.

ChIJS2FZ65YvdTER8gMKEpJU6-8.name: places/ChIJS2FZ65YvdTER8gMKEpJU6-8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR6X3VtZGZREAE
ChIJS2FZ65YvdTER8gMKEpJU6-8.text:
Found this place on Google maps, there's a rival shop across the road selling the exact same menu so I decided to try both. This is the place with the white signboard.

Food was served instantly. Springroll was a bit too hot, you could tell it was refried, the skin was a bit too doughy and greasy, this took away from the overall taste of the ingredients. The thit nuong was at room temp and lacked the smokey notes you want, it tasted pan grilled not charcoal grilled. The sauce was okay but I wish it had a tad bit of acidity to help cut away the greasiness of the spring roll. Owner was a bit rude, maybe because I didn't speak Vietnamese. I told her table for one and she got the waiter to serve me food immediately without asking for my order, just assumed I wanted the standard.

Overall, the quality of the food was at a lower standard compared to the one across the road.

One more thing to mention, this shop is the one with several chain outlets. As I found both places on Google maps, I was unsure so I asked their Facebook page if they were a branch of "Bún Thịt Nướng Quán 339" and they replied yes. They did later clarify the right address, but did not clarify that Quán 339 was a different shop which struck me as a bit dishonest.

ChIJBSQENAAvdTERv4a9e_4io4w.text:
Hidden in an alleyway in Nguyen Hue Street, you have to get past a painting shop to enter. There are no signs to mark where this shop is, and as you enter, the walkway can barely squeeze you through.

I came at a very busy time where there were many locals and businesspeople around, waited about 15 mins. The food was delicious, and there is a homely feel to it. The store is run by three old ladies, but they know how to run it well. Pork was super juicy and tender, and the spring rolls were the best part. Noodles over the tangy sauce was even better. The nail in the coffin is discovering that this was only 60k dong. Well worth!

ChIJ7acIcp8pdTERAftWtg-wEaU.text:
There are a lot of great bún thịt nướng places in Saigon but make sure to visit Bún Thịt Nướng Nàng Thơ before anywhere else!

This one was better than great! It was phenomenal. It exploded with flavour and was fresh tasting with perfectly springy noods and loaded with all the good things, what's not to love?

The spring rolls were divine and the proportion was great for an extremely reasonable price. The menu has a few options but were sold out on the tapioca noodles when I arrived (it was quite late in the day so get in early because this place is popular with the locals for food reason). Staff were extremely friendly and attentive and it's brightly lit and a clean establishment to dine in.

A true hidden gem in District 14!!

ChIJ85Vi6DQvdTERRA57e-4QP7o.text:
this bun thit nuong works in a jam

THE REALITY CHECK
the bowl was okay but lowkey didn't live up to the hype. maybe i caught them during a slow period but it just didn't hit different like i expected.

THE SILVER LINING
the staff stays super friendly and attentive which absolutely saves the experience. their good energy is an absolute serve.

THE NEIGHBORHOOD VIBES
this spot gives major local joint energy with its no frills setup and straightforward approach to classic vietnamese street food.

THE LOCATION SITUATION
tucked away on mac dinh chi, it's in a prime spot for grabbing a quick meal while exploring the area.

THE FINAL WORD
if you're in the neighborhood and craving bun thit nuong, it's worth a try. just don't expect life changing bowls and you'll have a decent meal.

don't forget to ❤️.

The atmosphere is casual, cozy, and perfect for a comfortable meal, whether you're dining alone or with a group. The restaurant's focus on traditional flavors and fresh, quality ingredients is evident in every dish.
The signature bowl was 52k with grilled pork, fried roll, Nem pickles, salad and herbs.
Very good value for D1.

ChIJ897E5p0vdTER0a7xiIKZ-_U.text: very friendly couple with a sweet dog and good tastes so good and fresh. they even gave us plums from hanoi to finish off our meal, very quaint homely space. i’ll come back for sure!

ChIJN_5VAZ8pdTERPj35-iSPUPk.text:
An interesting place. I saw a clip on YouTube saying this place offered one of the cheapest meals in town for 25k Dong. Rice noodles with some barbeques pork and 2 pices of cha cho and the regular trimmings of herbs and sallad leaves.
The dish it self wasn't that bad but t wasn't special at all and didn't  move me. But the interesting part of eating here was that one side of the eatery is reserved for parking the motos! Don't be alarmed if you see people riding the motos in to the shop. They are allowed and accepted by the owners.
For me, I sure didn't like to eat of bowl of dry rice noodles and accompanied by exhaust fumes and engine oil smell from the motos.

ChIJN_5VAZ8pdTERPj35-iSPUPk.text: I could eat there everyday! 'Thit nuong' and 'nem nuong' are... so delicious, combined  with the nuoc mam..omg, want to order one more bowl.
