ChIJN_5VAZ8pdTERPj35-iSPUPk.text: Noodle is fine. Vegetable is fresh and clean. Tasty grilled pork. Spring roll ia always hot. Only thing to be improved is fish sauce. Parking area is a little bit tiny.

ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.name: places/ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmN3F5bHdRRRAB
ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.author: An Nguyen
ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.text:
+ This is the restaurant I eat at the most when I come home late from work, the meat and noodles are quite delicious, including the fish sauce. A full bowl of meat is only 40k.

+ The ladies are very friendly, all the food in the restaurant is handmade. There is an LGBT lady. If you meet them, remember to call them "sister" or "younger sister" as they will get more meat, if you call them "uncle" you will be careful not to eat more chili.

+ The restaurant is on the roadside with affordable prices so it is not too strict about the atmosphere, only plastic tables and chairs. Parking on the street. The restaurant is quite expensive but does not have a toilet paper bin, so after about 2 hours the table is full of paper. Luckily, every few hours the ladies take turns cleaning it so it does not become a landfill.

+ You should try this restaurant, the reviewer was still drooling with longing when reviewing it.

ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.name: places/ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNndnBtVnN3RRAB
ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.author: Yen Ctv
ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.text:
The roadside stall, with a few tables on the sidewalk, is a bit cramped. The ladies don't put trash cans, so I have to push them down to the ground, every time I pass by it looks very dirty, quite uncomfortable. But because of the way they do business, I don't know if they've changed or not, so I have to accept it.

The price of a full bowl is 40k. I think it's quite a lot. Personally, I don't think the spring rolls are delicious. The outer shell is crispy, dark brown, but the inside is tough like it's not fried well enough. I've eaten it several times, not just once. The spring rolls and meat are marinated with a sweet taste, true to the Western style. The grilled meat is very hit or miss, some days it's very delicious and soft, some days it's very hard. In general, the taste is rich and sweet. Those who eat bland food will feel thirsty after eating.

I'll stop by here to eat every once in a while when I go to Coop-mart Hoa Binh, because the dirty paper-covered dining area looks boring, and it's also cramped, so many people choose to buy it to take home.

ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q.name: places/ChIJ1XfbBuEtdTEREMLhhu-x27Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3cGRta05BEAE

The spring rolls were not crispy, dry

ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.name: places/ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCbmFVZGFkblI2U2xsbWQwUjJPVXBtZEhoWmJuYxAB
ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.author: LexTeo8888
ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.text:
Was trying to find the roast pork Banh mi and when I saw a long queue at this eatery, silly me thought this was it. Halfway through I realised they were selling grilled meats and vermicelli and decided why not.

Ordered a full set plus an additional plate of grilled meat and iced tea for VND76,000...which was very reasonable as there were proper seating and fans (no Aircon as per norm).

Was abit disgruntled when I was served the meats which were not even warm but all my disappointment disappeared when I tried my first taste. It was really not bad for a 4.1 Google rating. Not mind-blowing but I got my money's worth for sure!

What got me swooning was the chilli mixture that you put together with the fish sauce dipping. It was spicy 🔥 but in a good way! Really elevated the dining experience from not bad to good!

Gave only 4 stars though as this is Vietnam and I have higher expectations whereas if this was served to me in Singapore...maybe 4.5.

ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.name: places/ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214dlJtRlVhUzB6VEROdVlXdzFjVTR0WjJVemEwRRAB
ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.author: Manuel Dresselmann
ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.text:
We found this place on Google looking for foodplaces to be in the City. We almost passed the Shop since downstairs looks more like a garage for motorbikes than a Restaurant.

At a very small counter you order your mal which is either grillen pork, minced pork or springrolls in a combination with glass noodles and greens. You can also mix it for a combination of All 3 Extras. If you wish for more noodles additions are free.

After your order you can go upstairs, take a seat and wait for your order to arrive. The dining area is very minimalistic which gives the place a unique feel. The food is what it is all about. A whole 2 liter Bucket of "nuoc mam" the local fish sauce makes the dish. Its fresh, its well made and screams "umami".

We enjoyed it a lot.

ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0.name: places/ChIJ0bszZuAvdTERpouhodSCRo0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2taamRuQm1WR2Q0U1VOeFptRlZMV2xCYVdGUU5FRRAB

33k vnd for 1 bowl

ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.name: places/ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR0bzl5RFVREAE

ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.name: places/ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMd29YRkZnEAE
ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.text:
In the middle of a forest of seafood restaurants on Vinh Khanh Street, there is a late-night gem (open until 2 AM) offering something different: grilled pork with rice noodles. This eatery usually serves their specialty in stainless steel bowls. Unfortunately, on my visit, plastic ones were used, bringing down the presentation.

The grilled pork, was not quite what I expected. I prefer a deeper caramel colour for that smoky-sweet flavour. Additionally, the fish sauce could have packed a richer punch.

However, this spot does have some interesting twists. Their rice noodles are served with shredded mango and laksa leaves. And surprisingly, for a grilled pork with rice noodles eatery, their black sugar pearl milk tea is fantastic! Both the tea itself and the chewy tapioca pearls were a delightful fragrance.

ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.name: places/ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNabjZTWE93EAE

ChIJHf4cML4vdTERuWmKAmJOV1A.text: The food is so yummy and clean. I love the spring rolls and grilled meat. They are very juicy and tasty.

ChIJ166mnOUpdTERx0x9km-PiGk.text: I ordered the special grilled pork vermicelli, and it truly lives up to its name with a generous amount of meat. This dish is perfect for hot Saigon days, balancing the rich, savory flavor of the pork with the refreshing crunch of the noodles, greens, and pickles.

ChIJ166mnOUpdTERx0x9km-PiGk.name: places/ChIJ166mnOUpdTERx0x9km-PiGk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfZ3VXOTF3RRAB
ChIJ166mnOUpdTERx0x9km-PiGk.author: Tita Pizza
ChIJ166mnOUpdTERx0x9km-PiGk.text:
Michelin guide

For our first visit, we arrived at 8 PM on a Friday, only to find the place already closed. Fortunately, we encountered a staff member who kindly explained that they had to close earlier due to selling out (Google listed their closing time as 8:30 PM).

Determined to try their food, we returned on Sunday around 2:30 PM and finally got to experience it—and wow, it was worth the wait! Their Bun Cha is absolutely delicious. Among all the Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurants we've tried in Saigon, this one truly stands out.

The dish is straightforward: noodles, vegetables, spring rolls, meatballs, and grilled pork, with the sauce as an optional seasoning. Despite its simplicity, it tasted incredibly fresh and "clean."

As someone who isn't a big meat eater, I was surprised by how much I enjoyed the grilled pork and meatballs (which you can order extra!).

With only one dish on the menu, you know they’ve perfected it. Most of the customers were locals, and the high volume of takeout orders confirmed its authenticity. The fewer tourists, likely due to its less accessible location, made it feel even more like a hidden gem.

The staff were friendly and welcoming. We complimented one of the owners serving the bowls, and his warm smile was a lovely touch.

Sad that we only got to try this place on our last day. If we had found it earlier, we would have definitely come back at least a couple more times.

Two thumbs up!

ChIJCTWJJYUvdTERZfhimpQhKmU.author: Elfra Frat
ChIJCTWJJYUvdTERZfhimpQhKmU.text:
This is hands down the best place to eat in Saigon! The food is incredibly fresh, flavorful, and surprisingly affordable. Every dish bursts with authenticity, making each meal an experience rather than just a bite to eat.

What truly sets this place apart, though, are the owners—two incredibly warm and welcoming ladies who make you feel like family. One day, as we passed by, they even offered us something special they were cooking for themselves—something not even on the menu! That level of generosity and hospitality is rare and made our experience unforgettable.

We loved it so much that we kept coming back throughout our stay in Saigon. I’ll especially miss the delicious banh cuon (perfect for breakfast) and bun thit nuong (our go-to for lunch), as well as the wonderful conversations and genuine kindness of the owners.

If you're in Saigon, do yourself a favor and visit this place—you won’t regret it!

2025: Clear plastic container now. Another staple food not to be missed, thinly sliced pork marinated in a sweet and savoury sauce is caramelized on hot coals, often paired with grilled sausage that also brings a hint of sweetness and crispy spring rolls. The filling yet light base comprises springy vermicelli noodles, shredded lettuce, cucumber and herbs that soak up the delicate, savoury fish sauce. ChIJg1W29aYpdTERUxU830g5Z3g.text:
THE HIDDEN ALLEY GEM FOR A QUICK GRILLED PORK NOODLE FIX

·

THE BOWL BREAKDOWN
bún thịt nướng is vietnam's iconic grilled pork noodle bowl that absolutely slaps. we're talking tender marinated pork, fresh herbs, and that legendary fish sauce that hits different.

THE PRICE TO FLAVOR RATIO
this spot is quite good with flavors that don't break the bank. the affordability here is an absolute serve for your wallet and your taste buds. it seems to be a busy lunch spot for locals.

THE LOCATION QUEST
tucked away inside a hem alleyway, this place gives major local secret energy. finding it feels like unlocking a culinary achievement that's totally worth the hunt.

THE STAFF VIBES
the team here stays kind and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. their good energy is lowkey infectious and good for the soul.

THE FINAL VERDICT
if you're chasing proper bún thịt nướng with authentic alleyway vibes and kind service, this spot is a total yes. your stomach and your budget will both thank you.

ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.text: A bowl of bun thit nuong costs 33k, and with additional meat, it's 48k. The taste was decent, though the meat was a bit dry. Located in an alley, look out for their cart. While they don't have street-side seating, you can enjoy your meal inside the house on low tables and stools. Perfect for those seeking an authentic Vietnamese dining experience and a taste of local flavours.

ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.name: places/ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNveFlYYTR3RRAB
ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.author: Am I XNhi?
ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.text:
The grilled pork noodle shop is hidden in the alley opposite the company so I stopped by for lunch. The space is simple and plain, with about 5-7 tables inside and outside, covered by a cool, pleasant silver screen. 

I ordered a bowl of spring roll noodle soup for 33K, plus a skewer of meat for 15K. The food here is very clean and has little seasoning, I found it easy on the stomach. 

- The grilled meat is not soft and fatty, but is lean meat so those who are not used to it will find it a bit dry. The seasoning is also moderate, not too sweet like the Western style in other restaurants. 

Pre-fried spring rolls are a bit weak, the filling is not special, should not order! 

Will come back to try the noodle soup tomorrow

ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.name: places/ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c/reviews/ChRDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURna054ZBAB

ChIJmc1PHg8vdTERVgxL-NFUH3c.text: The restaurant is small and located in an alley. It's close to the company so we often stop by. The grilled pork vermicelli is a bit sweet for my taste but still delicious. The noodle soup doesn't look appealing but the taste is okay. Overall, it's a sidewalk restaurant so the quality is okay. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor spaces. You can join tables, I think the capacity is about 20-25 people. It's quite crowded at noon, so the wait is a bit long. The owners are quite enthusiastic.

ChIJUYyzV6gpdTERDJi_yLu5E8o.text: Grilled pork vermicelli is delicious, high quality, the meat is super thick but still very flavorful. The noodles are small and not boring to eat. The thing is, the spring rolls are not the kind wrapped in regular rice paper, so you can feel the layer of flour on the outside (you can see it in the picture), they are not crispy, the filling has taro, similar to vegetarian spring rolls but not rich but a bit bland, so it's a pity. My bowl is 40k, I saw someone order a 30k bowl without spring rolls. Someone ordered a 50k bowl. In general, I think eating grilled pork vermicelli alone is delicious, 30k is enough. Right at the intersection, small tables, not many seats.

ChIJUYyzV6gpdTERDJi_yLu5E8o.text:

The bowl of noodles includes pickles, scallion oil, fried pork fat, grilled meat, peanuts, raw vegetables and bean sprouts, just enough to blend the flavors together, both fatty and delicious.
Go to the restaurant and order your food right away.
The restaurant has been open for a long time, from the afternoon until about 7:30 pm.
There are many restaurants around: congee, spring rolls, sugarcane juice, smoothies... all cheap and delicious. Full.

ChIJddDXkvovdTERag9AjbuJYCk.author: Hương Hoàng
ChIJddDXkvovdTERag9AjbuJYCk.text:
DELICIOUS - but have to wait a bit long

- Delicious grilled pork vermicelli, 25k/bowl: thin noodles, raw vegetables, pickles, grilled meat skewers as shown.

- The meat is tender, tastes just right, both meaty and fatty so the meat is not dry. Outdoor grill, pleasing to the eye
- There is free iced tea, drink together in stainless steel cups.

❌Minus points:
- Disposable cups are more hygienic. But the cost is high so the owner may not choose this method. So after eating, I chose not to drink water
- I parked my motorbike on the street
- The restaurant space is low and small
- There are many customers, but everyone has to wait a long time, because there are only 2 sellers + 1 griller.

ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.text:
There are two stalls selling bún thịt nướng at the market, but I tried Huệ's stall. Finding it can be tricky since it is tucked inside Thai Binh Market. Look for the broken rice shop outside the market, you will find an entrance next to it. Drive or walk through that entrance, then look left to spot Huệ's stall.

A full bowl for VND 35.000 includes a charcoal-grilled pork skewer, a piece of grilled meatball, and a fried spring roll, all delicious with the chilli fish sauce. They even offer free extra noodles! However, the market location means cramped space and there can be unpleasant sewer smells. There is also a nearby drink counter offering pennywort juice for VND 15.000, a refreshing drink, but not necessarily the best pairing with bún thịt nướng.

ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.name: places/ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfbE5tQlBnEAE

ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.text: This is my favorite Bun Thit Nuong place and my favorite 35k bowl to eat in Saigon. Keep in mind there are 2 spots side by side selling Bun Thit Nuong. Make sure you order from Bun Thit Nuong “Ut” when you sit at the silver tables to the left. In order to be seated you must order drinks from the lady who runs the seated area. Drinks vary from 10-20k. The 35k bowl isn’t meant to fill you up, but she serves 3 different types of high quality sides (eggroll, grilled pork, and nem nuong). For 50k you can double up on 1 of the 3 mentioned items. You can also just order 1 type of meat if you like. Worth a try as I bring all my expat friends here.

ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.name: places/ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNWXzhIN0tREAE
ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.author: Thanh Ly
ChIJwfjrkhcvdTERN-uQSr4ywPA.text:
An incredible local eatery in the heart of the local market. This market is pretty central but as it's a 20 minute walk from District 1, not many tourists make the journey to this neck of the woods. I took a Grab bike here, it took 5 minutes from my hotel (I stayed next to the Opera House). The total cost was 14k VND for the journey.
As it's a local market, it has a wet market and meat market, so be warned.
The food area is at the back of the market (if you're walking in from the main road). Here there are 6 food stalls, from all the local classics like noodle soups, com tam and even mi quang.
I had to stop first to get freshly squeezed sugar cane juice as it was a sweltering day. That was 15k VND for the large size.
After assessing all the options, I decided on Vermicelli option because 1) the wonderful smell of pork being cooked over charcoal filled the air, 2) I haven't had this particular dish yet on this visit to Vietnam.
I asked for a portion with a bit of everything (To Day Do on the menu). The bowl of Vermicelli came topped with BBQ pork, BBQ Nem (minced pork meatball) and a spring roll. You add the pickled daikon and carrot, pour on the nuoc mam sauce, then add chilli to taste. A word if warning, the chillies were very, very spicy. So add them slowly until the heat is right.  Once you've added the condiments give the whole bowl a good stir as the salad and fresh herbs are at the bottom. You want to make sure each strand is coated with the sauce.
Everything about the dish is perfect, the BBQ meats are cooked just right - not dry at all and they had a lovely smoky element. The spring roll was seasoned well and very crispy. The bowl of noodles had the perfect mix of sweet, sour, savoury and spicy - though I may have added a bit too many chillies as it was pushing on the heat level.
The freshly squeezed sugar cane juice complemented the dish very well and very much needed as I say rather close to the BBQ... It was very hot.
This is very much a local spot, there weren't any tourists eating here when I ate.  The menu isn't in English but you can order easily by pointing at what you want. This stall was busier than the others.  The three aunties who were working here are lovely, they are taking, joking and laughing as they work. They were having a good laugh with some of the customers, who I would guess were regulars and perhaps market stall holders themselves.
If you're looking for a local hidden gem outside of the tourist traps in District 1, venture here for lunch (I think they close quite early). You won't be disappointed and you would have a fantastic local experience.
I paid 35k VND for the Bun Thit/Nem Nuong, plus 15k for the sugarcane juice. 50k VND (£1.65/$2).  I would have been happy to pay much more.

ChIJExE7_N4vdTERYzfNl9mOhsI.text: Another staple food not to be missed, thinly sliced pork marinated in a sweet and savoury sauce is caramelized on hot coals, often paired with grilled sausage that also brings a hint of sweetness and crispy spring rolls. The filling yet light base comprises springy vermicelli noodles, shredded lettuce, cucumber and herbs that soak up the delicate, savoury fish sauce. A side of pickled carrots and daikon offer a refreshing crunch, along with a mild sweetness and acidity. Your mileage may vary; just look for the long queues.

ChIJExE7_N4vdTERYzfNl9mOhsI.text:
I had a bad experience here.
• First of all, the plus points: the food is quite ok for the price, the fish sauce is sweet but still rich and suitable for the taste. A portion is quite full, not too much and not too little.
• The minus points: because there is a lot of grilled meat, whether you sit down to eat or buy it to go, there will still be a lot of smoke and smell, there are few tables, it seems chaotic and not in order. My friend and I ordered two full portions, when the first bowl was brought out, there were only spring rolls and two pieces of meat. My friend asked why there were no spring rolls, and he said it was because the spring rolls were not ready in time, so he sympathized (even though he didn't tell me when he brought it out, he waited to ask before telling me). LESS THAN 3 MINUTES LATER, the second bowl was brought out with full spring rolls. Why didn't you wait a bit to bring out exactly what the customer ordered, but instead changed it arbitrarily, restaurant?

ChIJN2_rrcEodTERkn2dJrLfty0.text:
Sau Cau Restaurant: "Delicious, Nutritious, and Cheap" Grilled Pork Noodles at Phan Van Tri!
Sau Cau Restaurant - Grilled Pork Noodles at 113 Phan Van Tri is a place that I must put on my "delicious, nutritious, and cheap" list of Binh Thanh immediately. For only 40k for a portion of noodles, I received a full bowl, the quality of which surprised me. The bowl of noodles is a perfect combination of many toppings: fragrant grilled meat, spring rolls, beef wrapped in betel leaves, and crispy spring rolls—an extremely complete combination of flavors.

The quality of the food here must be said to be good. The grilled meat is marinated just right, grilled to a soft and fragrant texture. Especially the beef wrapped in betel leaves and spring rolls are both carefully prepared, not greasy at all, making me eat the whole bowl in one go. The sweet and sour fish sauce is also mixed to taste, poured into the bowl of noodles and all the flavors suddenly become absolutely harmonious, stimulating the taste buds.
In terms of space, the restaurant is airy, clean, creating a comfortable feeling when sitting down to eat. However, it must be admitted that the restaurant is a bit old, but that creates a rustic, close-knit feel, true to the traditional Saigon restaurant. The most important thing is still the excellent food quality compared to the price. If you are looking for a bowl of grilled pork noodles with full flavor at an affordable price, Sau Cau is a no-brainer choice!

ChIJZUcaYLMpdTERLEQKNm-NhGo.text:
The grilled pork vermicelli was not delicious, the meat was cold and dry, the restaurant did not grill it on site and did not microwave it so it was cold. The spring rolls were also a bit mushy, worse than the frozen ones in the supermarket.

The fish sauce is an important factor in deciding whether this dish is delicious or not, but the fish sauce was bad, too salty and not mild, very difficult to eat. Normally I find this dish easy to eat, but here I couldn't swallow half a plate.

And the attitude of the staff was also indifferent to the customers, couldn't open their mouth to say a word, looked at the customers but glanced, and looked up at the sky 🫢

In general, I will never eat again.

ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk.author: Dũng 63
ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk.text:
Lai Thieu's famous sticky rice vermicelli 🍽️

A specialty that anyone passing through Lai Thieu must visit at least once is Co Be's restaurant. The purple sticky rice vermicelli with a gentle aroma is eaten with spring rolls and spring rolls. The grilled spring rolls here are slightly chewy, the marinated meat is delicious, the spring rolls are crispy. The fish sauce is slightly sour and sweet, adding steamed jackfruit to the pickles makes it more delicious... ♨

A portion for 2 people is 80k. The tray is full of rice vermicelli, spring rolls, spring rolls and many kinds of vegetables. If you don't eat the tray, you can order a bowl of vermicelli and rice vermicelli for 40k / bowl / person.

🇻🇳 By Dung 63 🇻🇳

ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk.name: places/ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNlanJmdEF3EAE
ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk.author: Fii
ChIJSUsjJL7XdDERquhZyf_IrAk.text:
The restaurant is spacious, clean, the staff is friendly and enthusiastic, this is where I often have breakfast when I come to Lai Thieu. There are grilled pork vermicelli and rice vermicelli. I often eat rice vermicelli rolled with vegetables.
Rice vermicelli: has 2 colors, purple sticky rice is more fragrant than white, slightly sweet.
Vegetables: lettuce to roll with cinnamon, perilla, fish mint, ... can ask for more vegetables.
Dipping sauce: fish sauce mixed to my taste, slightly sour, slightly sweet and rich, with added pickles and fresh chili, very delicious to dip, roll continuously.
Nem: spring rolls are slightly chewy, meat is moderately sweet, spring rolls are crispy, hot, grilled meat is fragrant, slightly dry, marinated to taste.
Price: 40k/ portion, in the picture is a tray of 2 portions. Grilled pork vermicelli 35k, bread 16-20k.

ChIJrV9kHGovdTERFoJyc5AT2aU.author: Real Walk TV
ChIJrV9kHGovdTERFoJyc5AT2aU.text: Bò Né Thanh Tuyền is an absolute must-try! Stepping into this place feels like you've found a hidden gem of authentic Vietnamese street food. The sizzling beef steak (bò né) is incredible—tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked right in front of you. The hot plate with the runny egg is a culinary masterpiece, and the price is unbeatable for the quality you get. The atmosphere is lively and bustling, giving you a true taste of local culture. I can't wait to go back for another delicious meal!

My comfort food! 🤩

The meal was a 5/5

Check out our channel for a full review of our experience: Hungry Two Travel.

The issue is why should I need to eat.
They served the dish with canned Sardine , a piece fish of cake and an fried egg with which I have no comment at all.
The salad carried very little vegetables….
The juice is expensive in this set up.
No no no la.

ChIJx8lIe9EtdTERFnMPHG6rXqg.text: Extremely delicious and tasty with high quality of food. Should try this if have a chance to visit HCM city. Will be back later with my family

ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.author: Lizzy
ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.text: Disappointed with this place. We came for breakfast to try their Bò Né, but it was a letdown. The food was nothing special and even felt like a kiddie meal since our Bò Né came with fries. It’s also pricier than other spots but lacks both taste and quality. Service wasn’t great either—our server got our order wrong, missed one dish, and the staff were chatting at the counter while customers were still dining. Drinks were overly sweet as well.

ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.name: places/ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25ab1pFSjVZbUZtVjBGRFZWUmhjM2R4WlhCNk1YYxAB

ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.text: Good spot, outside breeze and no other Bo Ne spot nearby. Price is cool and it was packed, cashier let me slide bc they didn’t have tap pay, so I asked the front desk girl to scan pay them 24k today, that was my fault. Cool spot, chill and no others in a radius, worth it.

ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.name: places/ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tsSGNGTjJkMVpsYWpkc2JrbDNRVzB0V21scUxWRRAB
ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.author: AngBRYANKoh
ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.text: Bò Né is the reason I came back to Vietnam. I think I could eat it every day. I’m not even sure what exactly I ordered, but the food was divine. It had beef, pâté, cream cheese, and eggs, all topped with a special sauce that brought everything together beautifully on one plate.

ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.name: places/ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR1Z3VMNkJBEAE
ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.author: Ashley T.
ChIJ-eDWKDsvdTERI4sPNMgJQiQ.text: Great place for a later dinner. Passed by around 9:30 and they showed no sign of closing soon. Enjoy their thin sliced beef a lot. Very tender and juicy. Personally i think the sauce that costed around 5k did not do much, a simple substitute of soy sauce and chilli sauce does the job too. Their breads were of good texture. This place is very affordable for those who want to spend little on a good beef meal.

ChIJtdGt5UwvdTERTC0Zw2ztke4.text: Bò Né Cô Út is almost always crowded, but the staff does a great job taking care of customers. The prices are reasonable considering the high quality of the food. The portions are generous, enough to keep you full from lunch well into the afternoon. The beef is cut moderately thick and cooked to be tender and succulent. I ordered extra sausage and pâté to try. The pâté is good, but not outstanding. However, the sausage was delicious. The crispy fried garlic chips is a great addition to the dish overall, but quite bitter for my taste.

ChIJtdGt5UwvdTERTC0Zw2ztke4.name: places/ChIJtdGt5UwvdTERTC0Zw2ztke4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3b2FhZ2RREAE

ChIJtdGt5UwvdTERTC0Zw2ztke4.text: Fantastic little neighbourhood to explore and get a sense of the culture. Fellas playing board games, barking dogs, general banter. Love it. The beef was tender and thick. Pate went well with the Vietnamese Baguette. Sunny side up egg with fried onions with a Side Salad. So so good. My new go to breakfast spot. Staff are really nice too and welcoming. Bonus.

ChIJU9Hk4S8vdTEReDD4wSLY-8Q.author: Khanh Vu Huu
ChIJU9Hk4S8vdTEReDD4wSLY-8Q.text:
I visited Bò Né Ba Núi today in Saigon, as it happened to be just around the corner from our hotel. The place is clearly popular, there were both locals and tourists dining there, and we had to wait about five minutes before a table became available.

The food is cooked right in front of the restaurant over a large open flame, which creates quite a bit of heat. Because of that, I wouldn’t recommend sitting too close to the grill area. We ordered the bò né trứng pâté and the nui xào bò, which had a nice wok-hay flavor. Both dishes were delicious and freshly prepared.

Overall, I really enjoyed the experience and can definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for tasty and satisfying bò né in Saigon.

ChIJHWx0a7wodTERAHsU5I7PoWw.text:
★★★★★ A great local spot for bò né lovers!
Bò Né 68 Thành Nhân is definitely a hidden gem in Bình Thạnh. Tucked away in a small alley, this place gives off a true local vibe. Despite the narrow entrance, it’s always buzzing with people — a good sign that the food is worth it.
I ordered the classic bò né and it came out sizzling hot on a cast iron plate. The beef was tender and flavorful, paired perfectly with the egg, pâté, sausage, and a side of crispy fries. The butter and onion on top added a great aroma and richness to the dish. They also served it with a fresh baguette, which was perfect for dipping into the egg and sauce.
The staff were quick and efficient, and the food came out fast despite the crowd. Prices are very reasonable — you get a full, filling meal for under 100,000 VND.
If you’re looking for an authentic and satisfying Vietnamese breakfast or brunch experience, this is the spot. I’ll definitely be coming back again. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to try real local bò né!

ChIJy5IxwMgudTERZx83sJfTMOY.author: Tùng Nguyễn
ChIJy5IxwMgudTERZx83sJfTMOY.text:
A "legendary" beefsteak with a strong student character and unforgettable flavor!
This Bo Bo beefsteak restaurant on Dat Thanh Street is truly an indispensable part of the memories of many generations of Nguyen Thai Binh High School students, including me. With more than 10 years of existence and development, the restaurant has become a familiar culinary address, an ideal meeting place after stressful school hours.
What makes me always remember Bo Bo is the typical, delicious beefsteak flavor with extremely "student" prices. Tender beef, well-marinated, fatty fried egg, fragrant pate, rich meatballs, all blending on a hot, sizzling cast iron pan. The feeling of blowing on it while eating, dipping it in a little spicy chili sauce, is truly an irresistible culinary experience.
Not only delicious, the restaurant also scores points for its simplicity and friendliness. The restaurant space is simple but always crowded with customers, especially during school hours. Looking at the bright faces of students, enjoying the familiar beefsteak dish, I feel like I am returning to my memorable school years. 
Compared to the extremely affordable price, the quality of the food at Bo Bo is truly outstanding. This is the reason why the restaurant has always retained customers over the years. Although there are many new beefsteak restaurants, Bo Bo still maintains its own position in the hearts of those who have been attached to this place. 
If you are looking for a delicious, nutritious, cheap beefsteak restaurant with a "youthful" flavor and close to the life of students, then Bo Bo beefsteak restaurant on Dat Thanh street is definitely a great choice. Come here not only to enjoy the food but also to feel a part of the simple but precious culinary history of this area. 
With all the great memories and flavors, I totally deserve to give Bo Bo beefsteak restaurant 5 stars and will definitely come back many more times!

ChIJLxvDAgApdTEREkQfA3GWERI.text:
bò né trịnh is that spot for your sizzling plate fix

THE SIZZLING PLATE EXPLAINED
bò né is vietnam's iconic sizzling plate dish. think a personal hot plate arriving still bubbling with beef, eggs, pâté, and veggies that you mix together like a flavor party.

THE SPEEDY SERVICE
this place operates on another level of fast. your sizzling plate arrives quick but never feels rushed. the efficiency here is lowkey impressive.

THE FOOD THAT HITS DIFFERENT
we're talking delicious flavor that absolutely serves. the bò né comes out sizzling with perfect eggs and quality beef that melts in your mouth. everything tastes fresh and cooked right.

THE VALUE SITUATION
the prices are so reasonable for what you get. generous portions and quality ingredients make this spot an unreal deal that's good for your wallet.

THE CLEAN VIBES
unlike some street food spots, this place keeps it proper clean. the tidy setup and organized kitchen give you confidence in what you're eating.

THE FINAL CALL
if you want a killer meal that's fast, affordable, and actually delivers on flavor, this is your move. no cap, this place is a total win.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJ80xaK0MpdTER2Wr4dYFZ8Ug.text:
📍 QUALITY sizzing-beef (bò né) in CENTRAL district !

This shop took over a long row of sideway; tables were packed with customers. We came & ordered a beef-five way plate & meatball plate. Meals came relatively quick; with complementary coke & picked veggie.

First impression was their on-point seasonings. Steak was indeed a bit chewy but it binds well with the bread & other toppings. Meatball was amazingly savory, both fatty & meaty.

Another specialty is the good-old fries with butter & sugar. A classic Vietnamese snack in party tables.

Overall, 174k for an extra-bò né experience was worthy!

ChIJ80xaK0MpdTER2Wr4dYFZ8Ug.text:
It might be more expensive than other places with the same food, but it wasn't bad. I wanted to try the idea of a skillet with eggs and sausage more than I probably liked what I had. Mine was a mix of meat for 58K ($2.40). A friend wanted the picture of the skillet with the fries - his didn't come with fries. His was more beefsteak, patê, and an egg; 68K ($2.80). We had a small plate of fries that came with butter & sugar for 25K ($1). They give you at least one cup of free Coke.

[Update] Not many places I've tried more than once. Tried this again because it's always popular. Tried the đặc biệt (which means "special"). I might just not like Vietnamese skillet dishes - which is absolutely stunning since I love them in America. The meat isn't that tender, at least here. The fish was okay. For it being 82K ($3.40), there's many other options elsewhere.

ChIJPXR0VQAldTER_NwgVkd9zbk.text: The food was okay, delicious, the beef wasn't tough, just right. When I asked to pay, there was a black-haired male employee wearing glasses. At that time, I was in the middle of a job that needed to be checked urgently and couldn't pay quickly. I told you to wait a bit, I had your job, there would have been nothing if he hadn't made me deposit. Actually, at that time, I had urgent work that needed to be focused, but he kept talking to me, making me uncomfortable. It's not that I was being difficult or disrespectful to him. He talked to my nephew, I was still happy, but at the same time, I had some urgent work to do, and he kept asking me, so I had to postpone the job. I didn't let you wait for too long, about 1-2 minutes, and then I paid. I hope the restaurant will consider it. If the customer has a problem and needs to consult a CV, and you keep asking like that, the customer will be very upset.

- The beef is well marinated, with the familiar flavor of the 3 Ngon beefsteak brand, and comes with soft drinks
- Because it's a sidewalk space and the day I ate it was raining, the seats were a bit waterlogged and there was Mr. Ti running back and forth
- The minus point is that the additional dishes felt quite superficial: The extra sausage was cold as if it wasn't processed and kept bringing it out (I asked the restaurant to reheat it), the salad I ordered didn't have vinegar oil but just chopped lettuce, the extra bowl of beefsteak for 30k/bowl had a bland taste, not like the original beefsteak I ordered
- I hope the restaurant pays attention and maintains consistent quality in the dishes

ChIJ49CZSw0vdTERIt3MXou1Ofc.text:
Branch of the 3 brothers system. Almost the same marinade and service methods.
The beef is soft, has a characteristic aroma, not too much five-spice powder so it is easy to eat.
The side dishes such as ham, sausage, pate are also quite good. The pate is considered delicious.
The marinade is absorbed into the meat so there is no need to add soy sauce or chili sauce to eat.
The bread is dense, always warm so it feels delicious to eat.
The space is small but cozy
There is a place to park motorbikes, but no place to park cars, please contact the restaurant for this.
Rating: 8.5/10 (quite good for beef)

ChIJe6DWz-8rdTERU1tVwqYFlLw.name: places/ChIJe6DWz-8rdTERU1tVwqYFlLw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZck9xc0VREAE
ChIJe6DWz-8rdTERU1tVwqYFlLw.author: Katy Ng
ChIJe6DWz-8rdTERU1tVwqYFlLw.text:
Regularly eat beefsteak and spicy noodles at the restaurant on weekends, the overall food is delicious and the price is reasonable.

Beefsteak has many options, priced from 50-70.
The beef is marinated to taste, the most prominent is the salty taste mixed with delicious margarine.
The egg is soft-boiled, not too runny.
The pate is soft, fragrant, okay
1 portion comes with 1 bread to eat with, a little bit of pickled vegetables dipped in vinegar.
If you add a little more pickled vegetables, it will be less boring.

High quality spicy noodles, ~50k.
The noodles are full, you can eat for a long time, the Korean noodles are chewy and not boring.
The beef topping is the same type of beef as beefsteak, cut into thick slices, the beef is not marinated, not seasoned. The amount of meat is enough to eat with noodles.
The noodle broth is more sour than kimchi, the remaining salty, sweet, and spicy flavors are balanced just right, easy to eat, and there is definitely margarine in the broth. The amount of MSG is not much.
Eating okela, anyone who does not like sour broth will not like this dish

What I like most is that the dish is always placed on a hot pan, hearing the sizzling sound is very pleasant to the ear.

When you finish eating, the pan is still warm, so you know that the heat retention is very good.

The restaurant gives away a glass of iced tea for each meal.

The space of the restaurant is also worth the money.
This area is a chessboard street, the road is super wide with few vehicles, clean, no trash, and has many big, green trees, shading the whole area.
The space is very cool and airy, the morning wind is cool
The restaurant is not too big but the seats are super comfortable, big tables, wide aisles.
Sitting for breakfast is very comfortable and pleasant

The staff is enthusiastic, the dishes are served quickly

A plus point for me is that the restaurant is very clean, as soon as customers leave, they clean up neatly. Very ok.
And the waiters are also neat and tidy, smiling a lot.
In my opinion, the point that I don't think is good is: the restaurant is a bit cramped. The road can still be used normally for one to two people at a time, but when it's crowded, it's cramped.
As for the price, you get what you pay for. I think it's ok, if you don't think it's ok, then forget it.

Fried were very oily and the banh mi's were ok, but nothing special. Would come back if sround if the beef portion was bigger.

ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.author: Olivier Guillard
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.text:
Overall 5 star ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ experience, eating Bo Ne for breakfast for the first time.

First, it's quite the experience walking through the alleyways of this neighborhood to find the Bo Ne restaurant. A couple is running this very small space, maybe has enough space for 4-6 people. The lady is the cook and the husband is in charge of the service and ensuring you're happy and satisfied.

We were very happy and satisfied, the Bo Ne is prepared fresh in front of our eyes and served perfectly, with a plate of vegetables, some fresh baguette and the different condiments which were clearly explained to us!

ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.name: places/ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsVFgxaFZlbDlFV0ZKbGIyZDNZM3BWWVhKdldsRRAB
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.author: Angela Randazzo
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.text: You have to walk down and alley to get to this place but it’s sooo worth it!! The Bo Ne wa incredible - the bread was fresh with a good portion of beef and pate (the pate was super flavourful as well). For only 35k dong it’s also a bargain!! The woman cooking was so friendly, would definitely return if in HCMC again :)

ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.name: places/ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25kaFVWSXdiVTV6WDJsR1gzRXdTbDlTTVY5clIxRRAB
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.author: Andrew J
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.text: Tucked away in a small alley is an incredible little bò né spot that made for a perfect breakfast. It felt like a true local experience with scooters passing by, neighbours chatting, and kids on their way to school. We ordered the bò né with an extra egg. The portion was just right, the eggs were perfectly runny, the beef was full of flavour, and the pâté was rich and delicious. It all came with a fresh bánh mì that tasted like it was baked that morning. A wonderful meal from start to finish.

ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.name: places/ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tNelYzSm1Sa3AwYmtOdlVrWjBZakJsU0hWWVgyYxAB
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.author: Bubba Bri
ChIJCYtGu5YvdTERQ_aRoH0hTZI.text: Not really hard to find if you have Google Maps, and definitely worth the search!  Like others have stated, the savoury, satiating nature of this meal, between the caramelized onions, fried eggs, slices of marinated beef, pate, side veggies (lettuce and sliced tomatoes) and the impossibly light and crisp mini-baguette "hit the spot" perfectly for breakfast.  I could have used just a slightly bigger baguette to have had enough to fully sop up the deliciousness at the end, but nonetheless I left full and happy.  Would definitely return if I had the time!

The minus point is that the bread is too crispy and dry, just a slight impact will break it so you can't eat much.
The owners are cheerful, enthusiastic, and friendly.
The price is reasonable in District 2.

Iced tea for 2k
Delicious stir-fried noodles
5 pieces of beef (beef marinated with spices)
1 slice of fresh tomato
1 slice of cucumber, peeled cucumber
4 fresh salad vegetables
Delicious chili sauce
Not delicious tomato sauce
Normal soy sauce but the stir-fried noodles are delicious, no need to add soy sauce like other restaurants, other restaurants usually cook sweet soy sauce
The restaurant is not very hot, there is a fan outside, eat around 11am
Clean restaurant
Cute owner
410 Nhat Tao beefsteak restaurant 410 Nhat Tao Street, Ward 6, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City 6am-11am

LoL no wonder this place got such low rating, if this business wants to survive, the owner seriously needs to tackle the issue. ciao never go back !

But we’ve been ordering fast, ate quietly and always paid. So sad we can’t go there

ChIJq_3XehkmdTERoZebiP296zA.text: The bò né here is super tasty, definitely worth a try! The owners are incredibly friendly and welcoming, which adds a nice touch to the experience. If you’re in Thảo Điền and looking for a hearty and flavorful meal, this spot is a great choice!

ChIJE77AJAcpdTER_KlfwFfGOIo.text: Convenient location, easy to find. The beef is tender and delicious, very cheap. I ordered 1 part beef number 1, and 1 part beef number 2. It looks like the picture, there is no sauce here but I think the food is quite good. The pate is not very hot yet, at this price you can't expect anything, it's very crowded but pvu is very agile, sitting at the table only takes 3-5 minutes to have the food brought out. Free iced tea + coke. Each serving includes 1 bmi. Eat well!

ChIJE77AJAcpdTER_KlfwFfGOIo.name: places/ChIJE77AJAcpdTER_KlfwFfGOIo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxenVmT0t3EAE

ChIJE77AJAcpdTER_KlfwFfGOIo.text:
Location: Near the intersection with Cong Hoa, people driving should pay attention when entering and exiting because there are many vehicles passing by this section.
Parking: in the evening from 6pm-8pm, the restaurant is crowded so there are many vehicles, they are parked outside along the sidewalk.
Food: the pate is not fresh, the bread is a bit hollow, the service attitude is not very good. The flying fire beef looks good but it is not delicious, it has a foul taste.

ChIJVS0lQfIpdTERxFxcn2nkmrU.author: Sam The Bam
ChIJVS0lQfIpdTERxFxcn2nkmrU.text:
Amazing value for $$$, family cooked meals, Italian style menu with all your favorites from pizza’s 🍕, pasta’s 🍝, Panini Sandwiches 🥪, salads 🥗 and more…

Simple and quaint family restaurant with amazing food at great value. Medium 200g cooked steak with variety of steak sauces with sides and drink @ 180k for the combo and the fresh bread is served for free…

Felt like I was being fed by my grandma 👵, eating a home cooked meal… loved it 💕

ChIJVS0lQfIpdTERxFxcn2nkmrU.text:
Really cozy spot with a great selection of both Vietnamese and Western dishes.
The Western food honestly surprised me – it felt like being back home.
Make sure to try their homemade bread, it’s easily the best I’ve had anywhere in Vietnam.
Thanks for the wonderful experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!🤗

ate once, went at night but the staff was cute and enthusiastic, ordered 2p, it seemed a bit more than 100k but it was delicious and worth it 🫶🏻 sausage, sausage, spring rolls, meat, eggs, pate were all delicious although each one was a bit small, but it must be delicious hahahaha.

The restaurant space is moderate, serving 10 or more customers at a time. 

The sidewalk parking lot is small, only allowing 4 to 5 cars, everyone. 

The restaurant's operating hours will have a lunch break from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Everyone, please take note. 

The portion I ate as shown in the picture is BEEF NUMBER 2. And I also ordered 1 more plate of vegetables, 2 glasses of water. 

The restaurant accepts the following forms of payment: Cash, bank transfer, MOMO

ChIJ-UISYVwpdTERkhHUXXjXqh4.text: My childhood restaurant, my family and I have been eating here for 15 years. The restaurant is now only open on Saturdays and Sundays. But just eat the standard portion and you'll be full because I eat a lot, it's different 😂 The total of the 2 dishes in the picture is 115k. The beefsteak here compared to the popular brands today is guaranteed to be better, not worse. The flavor of this restaurant is top notch, there's no need to discuss much. The restaurant space is a private home, using the front house as a place to do business, the owner is very clean and cleans carefully, don't worry about dirt. The car is always parked in front of the restaurant, just come and the owner will guide you. There are no employees here, only the homegrown products of the owner, friendly and enthusiastic attitude.

ChIJb3OtDQApdTERFpiOWq5bc2I.text:
I visited a restaurant that specializes in steak and decided to try their small portion, which is 100g (they also offer a 150g large portion). One nice feature on the menu is that you can choose how you want your steak cooked. I ordered mine medium rare. Although it was cooked correctly, the meat was tough to chew due to having many tendons, which really affected the experience.

The sauce was nice, and the vegetable garniture—broccoli and corn—was a good touch. The sunny-side-up egg served next to the steak was also a pleasant addition. However, the lettuce was starting to rot, and it was disappointing that it was still served.

Overall, considering the quality of the food, the price felt too high. Would I recommend this place? Not exactly.

ChIJ-bbn9PEndTER6HoCv5BytGo.author: Nguyễn Thảo
ChIJ-bbn9PEndTER6HoCv5BytGo.text:
Today, August 20, 22, I stopped by Dinh Phong Phu branch to eat and the staff in the picture had a very bad attitude. 

When I was cooking beef, I don't know why, but he put a chair down on the floor and we were talking, which startled me. Then he stood up on the chair and continued working, but with an unpleasant attitude. The meat tongs were left on fire and hit the shelf below. He kept grumbling about something. 

At this time, there were only 2 of us. When there were many customers, he didn't stand on the chair to cook anymore and his attitude was less like when there were only 2 of us. 

I've eaten here many times, but this is the first time I've encountered such a bad attitude. When the beef was brought out, they didn't even bring bread or vegetables 🥲. When the beef was finished cooking, there was no water left at the bottom, it was almost burnt. I asked before bringing back the bread and vegetables. 
Paying for food is like we just came to eat for free

ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc.author: Hải Phùng
ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc.text:
Bo Ne 3 Ngon is located right on the front of Duong Thi Muoi Street, quite easy to find but the space of the restaurant is small, the tables and chairs are placed close together so it is a bit cramped, especially during rush hours in the morning or evening. However, the quality of the food here is really commendable - tender beef, fragrant eggs and pate, hot and crispy bread, rich sauce, very appealing to eat. Compared to the affordable price, the portion is full and the quality exceeds expectations. 

What makes many people a bit surprised is that the image on Google Maps is no longer the same as in reality, maybe because the restaurant has changed the location or sign, so when you come, it looks a bit different. However, that does not affect the dining experience because the food is still delicious and served quickly. 

The staff is friendly, the dishes are served quickly, and the temperature of the dishes is always hot. Suitable for breakfast, lunch or light dinner. The restaurant has parking right in front of the door, but if there are many customers, it will be a bit cramped.

ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc.name: places/ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xSTlJsVnJYMjlXTVVoWWNqRlNRMlJyYjE5TE4yYxAB
ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc.author: Katy Ng
ChIJUYQzeQApdTERvocI-T61NBc.text:
Royal quality under the banyan tree. In just 1 month, I came to eat 3 times and will definitely come many more times after that.

This place specializes in beefsteak and pasta. The portions are very full, the quality is absolutely 10/10.

The sauce is rich, the sauce is thick, not too candy, the color is eye-catching, the outstanding flavor is dark soy sauce mixed with extremely fragrant fried garlic, adding a little bit of sweetness. The sauce will be a bit rich, has been reduced in saltiness, and it tastes very harmonious.

The beef is incredibly delicious. The beef is not too fresh but still has a juicy texture, cooked over medium heat, the chef watches the doneness very well.

The meat is soft, sweet, and thick, making the bite full and quality.

The pasta is stir-fried so it will be a bit greasy, but eating it with the sauce is still the best.

Fried dishes such as chicken rings, potatoes, and sausages will be fried crispy, quite dry, and seasoned with a little salt. Easy to eat and in harmony with the portion.

Each meal will be given a plate of salad mixed with spices (sweet and sour) and a glass of soft drink.

The food is always impressively delicious, really touching my taste from the first time.

The quality is extremely top-notch and meticulous, the price is super reasonable, I find it even better than many current beefsteak restaurant chains.

Update: I have been back a few times, the restaurant is getting more crowded and the restaurant pays great attention to customer experience.

The entire cast iron pan has been replaced, cleaner, more luxurious.

The accompanying black pepper sauce has been reduced in saltiness
However, the portion of pasta has been reduced.

+ The beef is soft, the bread is reheated (I don't eat pate so I don't take it). Excellent

ChIJ65bfzcXXdDER-n-3Fw5AhTg.author: Ngan Nguyen
ChIJ65bfzcXXdDER-n-3Fw5AhTg.text:
The beef steak portion as shown in the photo is 32k.

• Includes a fairly large piece of beef, thinly sliced. The beef is soft, the seasoning is just right, the aroma of pepper is fragrant, and a little coriander is added on top to enhance the delicious flavor.

• The eggs are half-cooked, the yolk is fatty and the eggs are also large. With the addition of American corn and onions, the sweetness of these two dishes balances the rich flavor of the beef, making it delicious.

• The pate is fragrant, not too salty, spread on bread, dip in a little sauce and it's delicious.

The restaurant's bread is crispy, fragrant, and has no insides.

The salad with vinegar and oil is very tasty, the amount of vinegar and oil and the amount of vegetables, pickles, and tomatoes are balanced, very delicious.

The owner is very cute, enthusiastic, and always cares about the customers. The restaurant space is neat, tidy, clean, and free of flies. The processing area is very neat, and every dish looks delicious.

In short, the restaurant is worth the money and worth the experience.

A very busy location on the corner of two major roads.

The staff are fast and friendly. The food was hot and fresh. The squash soup was surprisingly tasty with good amounts of both squash chunks and chicken, seasoned with fresh coriander.

There is surprisingly generous amount of parking space, and the parking attendants make good use of it and are prompt.

However, both times I’ve eaten there, there have been a lot of flies around and on the tables, which does detract from the eating experience.

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.text:
What I liked about it : The taste of the food is not bad at all. For me, trying Singapore and Malaysia Jollibee, I feel that this taste in HCM is the closest to home.
: Service is quite fast. Even during the lunch service. Been here 2 days in a row and both times, the service is acceptable.

What can be improved : The Sundae is underwhelming. Ice cream is more icy than creamy.
: I wish they can have the Chickenjoy Gravy and Burger Steak and Palabok. 🥺

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.text: As proud PINOYS, we are excited to try a new "cooking" style, particularly when it comes to our beloved fast food company in the PH. I have to say I really miss the taste of Chicken Joy, in Vietnam the chicken isn't exactly the same as what we have back home in the Philippines, but it's really still good even without gravy. The crispy skin and juicy meat took me right back home to those moments enjoying Jollbee with friends and family.

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.text:
As a Filipino, Jollibee will always make you happy whenever you see one.

Definitely different from PH but affordable prices with a Vietnamese taste!

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.text: The food was delicious — I ordered spicy chicken with rice, and it was crispy, juicy, and full of flavor 🔥🍗 But the service was a bit messy. I ordered cooked rice, but the staff forgot it. When I reordered, they brought me French fries instead 😅 I even pointed at the rice picture on the menu, but had to ask a third time before it came. Hope they improve the service, because the food is actually worth it!

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.name: places/ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKMmIwNHhNVFJXTjBsRlYwZG9WVmRoU21sMUxWRRAB

ChIJvQHa0TYvdTER1l4tFbwnlYo.text:
- As a Filipino local, it’s a must try to try out Jollibee in a different country to compare it from the local experience 🍗
- Ordered the chili chicken ~ not really spicy, more on the sweet chili side akin to the Jufran sauce + love the side vegetables & pumpkin soup, making fast food somehow a healthy option here
- Jollibee is def cheaper in Vietnam huhu how I wish PH branches also have the same price point
- Will try other food in the menu next time! Didn’t order the regular chicken because there’s no gravy 🥲
- Staffs are nice and accommodating despite the language barrier

We tried combos in Jollibee but it were not that great .
Chicken was not that crispy . Rice was also not well cooked . The sauce was good but very spicy .
French fries were soggy.
Chicken was not tender .
Noodles were okay types .
The Ice tea was great must recommend drink.
Place was small and sitting arrangement was not good . It was very tough to adjust .
Would recommend KFC over this.

ChIJr7NFDDsvdTERQoULsBaEZqY.text: The food at this place was absolutely delicious and of high quality, served at very reasonable prices! I enjoyed it immensely with my family. However, I would love to see the management take a step towards sustainability by reducing or eliminating single-use plastics. Even though there's no government ban, let's do our part for Mother Nature. Small changes can make a big difference. Looking forward to seeing this in the future. Highly recommend for the food, though!

ChIJr7NFDDsvdTERQoULsBaEZqY.text:
For a satisfying and affordable meal!!

I visited Jollibee Saigonstar and was really satisfied with my meal. The fried chicken here is crispy on the outside, the meat inside is tender and sweet, and the sweet and sour sauce is great. The rice and soup are also very good. The price is reasonable for the quality. The staff is quick and friendly. If you are looking for a place to enjoy delicious and affordable fast food, Jollibee Saigonstar is a good choice!

ChIJL5W_tDwpdTERLf_aQVKguRA.text: Very nice place close to the center of Saigon. The main place where the restaurant is actually is very cozy and calm, unfortunately there's not so many  tables there, so we need to sit outside on the street where it is a bit noisy. In the beginning we got  miso soup for free that was delicious, and I ate two bowls. Sashimi and sushi are also very nice. Staff is very affordable and open to help. I will definitely visit this place again, hopefully it will be a free table in the small street ☺️

ChIJL5W_tDwpdTERLf_aQVKguRA.text: This small sushi resto is situated in a small alley on Nguyen Van Cu street. But one can't never really judge the foods that is served here based on the look of the store. We ordered 3 dishes, Hana Cheese, Rainbow and Neigei tempura. All of them are very delicious and they weren't really that  expensive. The taste of the dishes is fine tuned for Vietnamese palette but foreigners are welcomed to try as well. Wasabi paste and prickled pink ginger are already on the table. They also served you a small bowl of seaweed and mushroom soup before the main dish is brought out. If you like watching the street while eating, they have some tables set up on the sidewalk out of the alley. Definitely coming back here again.

ChIJrxqoTQ0tdTER_l9m5uEyEK4.text:
- When I ate on the morning of December 3, the staff said that the teddy bears were out of stock. The staff firmly stated that they would have to wait until tomorrow to have them again. But 10-15 minutes later, they brought out a lot of bears and gave them to the shipper to deliver to customers. Is this an act of favoritism towards one customer over another? Because I went to the store to eat but it was not as expected. I felt very uncomfortable.

- As for the food in the morning, I felt that the chicken was cold and very dry. I have eaten here many times at noon and in the evening, the chicken was not dry and quite hot. I don't know if the store reused the old chicken from yesterday or not. I am really dissatisfied with the meal today.

- I hope the store will have a satisfactory explanation for the 2 points I complained about above.

The staff were friendly, polite, and served everything quickly. The place was clean and welcoming, great for a casual meal with friends or family. Even during busy hours, the service was smooth and efficient.

Highly recommend if you’re craving fried chicken and Filipino-style fast food in a convenient location. Will definitely come back again!

ChIJGSHiWYwldTERB0mtfXHf3T4.text: I ordered the combo just because I wanted to get the cute reindeer bear, but the food I received was better than I thought. The combo included 2 pieces of spicy chicken (I changed it from crispy chicken so I added 4k), 1 portion of spaghetti, 2 glasses of water and 1 portion of BBQ potato chips. In my opinion, this combo is best for 1 person to be really full. The spicy chicken sauce is absorbed, the spicy taste is easy to eat, not too crispy but still okay. The spaghetti is soaked in sauce, the taste is okay, especially dipping the noodle sauce into the potato chips is surprisingly delicious. The BBQ potato chips are the most surprising dish, the seasoning is just right, when received it is still hot and crispy, very satisfying to eat. The reindeer bear is cute, just looking at it is adorable. Overall, the combo price is reasonable and the experience is okay.

For service, them able to speak a little English was nice - they didn't seem to get frustrated or confused. I also would end up leaving one earbud/my earbuds case on the table, returning 2 hrs later, and saw they held on to them for me - awesome.

The chicken was standard fastfood (in Asia) chicken. It tasted pretty good. The spaghetti was a bit small (as part of the combo). It didn't taste bad, just it tasted as I'd expect. I think the Lotteria spaghetti might be better(?)...

The cost of the 1 piece + spaghetti + soda was 73K ($3.00). Upgrading the chicken from original crispy to chili sauced is 2K ($0.10). Most items were 30~80K.

ChIJWRb5lB7VdDERxYgsppAPy7k.author: Nhật Tuấn Trần
ChIJWRb5lB7VdDERxYgsppAPy7k.text:
The newly opened Jollibee Quang Trung branch is very new, clean and tidy. The restaurant is located right on the street front, easy to find, has a red umbrella and a prominent sign so you can see it from afar. The space inside is airy, bright, has cool air conditioning, and tables and chairs are arranged reasonably. Although customers come and go continuously, the staff cleans quickly, keeping the restaurant clean and does not smell of cooking oil like many other places. 

I went at noon, the restaurant was quite crowded but the service was still fast and friendly. The staff greeted and guided me to order dishes enthusiastically, everyone was happy and friendly. I ordered a combo of crispy chicken, spaghetti and soft drink - the chicken was hot and crispy, not dry, the spaghetti had a rich tomato sauce, very tasty. The soft drink had strong gas, cool and thirst-quenching. 

The general atmosphere is very pleasant, suitable for families with young children or groups of friends gathering for a quick meal. Overall, Jollibee Quang Trung Hoc Mon is a new branch but works professionally, has delicious food and clean space, worth coming back next time.

ChIJeznAjEIpdTERuaGhn-CJkNQ.author: Kevin Truong
ChIJeznAjEIpdTERuaGhn-CJkNQ.text:
The pros: The chicken coating is nice, very crunchy and stays crunchy for awhile. There are a bunch of different sauces to choose from and the pricing is reasonable. There are also free side dishes (taken from the extras table) and cheap side dishes options to add to your meal. The place also has aircons so it's pretty enjoyable, but can get crowded at the time.

The cons: Some sauces are good but some are quite eh. The amount of sauces given for the small portion is too little while the sauce for the big portion is too much. Anything but the chicken legs; drumsticks; and wings are uneatable due to the dryness.

Recommendation: It's a pretty good place for a group of 4 or 6, since the pricing is focused on a larger group rather than a smaller group. Don't order anything related to breast  or half/whole chicken and for the love of fried chicken, order wings/legs/thighs.

ChIJ62Sw18oodTERcIzI52vafj4.author: Hoàng Quỳnh
ChIJ62Sw18oodTERcIzI52vafj4.text:
Ovenmaru has been around for a while, and I remember trying it 7-8 years ago. It’s still one of the best spots for chicken lovers. Their focus on chicken dishes is the real highlight. They offer a variety of sauces, and the prices are very reasonable. A small portion costs around 1xx k but is big enough for 2-3 people, which makes it way better value than places like KFC, Texas, or McDonald’s.

One thing I really like is the free sides they serve when you dine in: a mixed salad, pickled radish, and kimchi. If you need more, they’ll charge about 25k VND per portion, which is still pretty affordable.

The food here is so good. Aside from chicken, their cheesy fried rice are must-tries — so much cheese! They also have buttery bread with dipping sauces, which is super tasty, and the rice rolls are also worth mentioning. Even their seafood sauces are decent. For the price, I’d give the food a 9.5/10.

That said, the ambiance could use some love. The space feels a bit old and isn’t super inviting — maybe a 6/10. The staffs are okay, friendly enough, but not super attentive, so I’d rate the service around 8/10.

All in all, if you’re into chicken, Ovenmaru is totally worth it. The food really stands out, and the prices are great for the portions you get!

ChIJ8RkvzCEvdTER_dHGviWTfTM.text:
recently ordered the Rice and Chicken Combo with Pepsi and a Shrimp Burger from KFC on August Revolution Road. The Shrimp Burger was crunchy but slightly dry, which could be improved for better taste and texture. However, the Rice and Chicken Combo was satisfying—the combination of flavors and portions was just right for one person. KFC offers a good variety of options, making it easy to choose a meal.

Since I opted for takeaway, I can’t comment on the dine-in atmosphere, but based on past visits, KFC usually maintains a standard setup with basic seating and a clean, organized environment. The service was efficient, and the food was prepared as expected. Overall, it was a decent meal—the combo stood out, while the Shrimp Burger had room for improvement. If you’re craving fried chicken with rice, this combo is a reliable choice, but you might want to pair the Shrimp Burger with a sauce to enhance its flavor. KFC remains a convenient spot for quick, familiar fast food."

ChIJbW7IsecvdTERad6fMyjEb1k.author: G Maya
ChIJbW7IsecvdTERad6fMyjEb1k.text:
Last time, I visited Chicken Plus with three colleagues, making a group of four. Overall, the experience was quite enjoyable, especially in terms of food quality and how well the ordering line at the food court was organized. We didn’t have to wait long, and the process felt smooth. The fried chicken was crispy and flavorful, just as expected. We tried a few different flavors, and everyone found something they liked. One small plus was that there was no seaweed filling in any of the dishes, which we appreciated since some of us don’t really enjoy seaweed.

However, we were a bit disappointed with the customer service. The staff didn’t greet us properly, and no one gave any clear instructions on how to place an order or where to pick up the food. It felt a bit awkward at first, especially for first-time visitors. The staff seemed uninterested and not very friendly, which slightly took away from the overall vibe.

Still, if you’re going mainly for good chicken and a quick meal with friends, Chicken Plus is worth a try. Just don’t expect too much from the service staff. Hopefully, they’ll improve that part soon!

ChIJbW7IsecvdTERad6fMyjEb1k.author: Phuong Tran
ChIJbW7IsecvdTERad6fMyjEb1k.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Chicken Plus located at Sư Vạn Hạnh Street, and it was a delightful experience from start to finish. As a food enthusiast, I always appreciate restaurants that not only serve delicious food but also provide a welcoming ambiance and excellent service, and Chicken Plus delivered on all fronts.

Firstly, let's talk about the food. The star of the show, of course, was the chicken. I opted for their signature dish, the Korean-style fried chicken, and it was nothing short of amazing. The chicken was perfectly crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, and the Korean spices added a delightful kick that left me craving for more. The portion size was generous, making it perfect for sharing or indulging in a hearty meal.

I particularly enjoyed the self-served rice with a ton of toppings. It allowed me to customize my meal exactly to my liking, adding a personal touch to the dining experience. The variety of toppings available ensured that every bite was bursting with flavor and texture.

Aside from the chicken, the menu at Chicken Plus offers a variety of options to suit different tastes. Whether you're a fan of spicy flavors or prefer something milder, there's something for everyone. The sides and sauces complemented the main dishes perfectly, adding depth to the overall dining experience.

Moving on to the ambiance, Chicken Plus has a cozy and modern atmosphere that makes it ideal for gatherings with friends and family or even a casual date night. The seating could be more spacious. We came with a family of 6, and it was a little cramped.

Last but certainly not least, the service at Chicken Plus deserves praise. The staff were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. They were happy to make recommendations and ensure that every guest had a memorable dining experience.

ChIJt6jnb30pdTERiE6GBiKXK9A.author: TFI Travel Food Information
ChIJt6jnb30pdTERiE6GBiKXK9A.text:
recently had lunch at KFC in District 3, conveniently located within walking distance from the Ramada Saigon Hotel. As always, KFC lived up to its reputation—consistent, tasty, and a top choice for quick meals. One thing I appreciate about KFC in Vietnam is its locally adapted menu, which offers some unique options compared to India while keeping the classic favorites.

I ordered my usual go-to meal: crispy fried chicken and the Rice & Chicken Combo with a soft drink. The chicken was perfectly crunchy and juicy, just the way I like it, while the rice combo was flavorful and filling—ideal for a satisfying lunch. The portion size was generous, and the meal was served fresh and hot.

KFC is my first choice when I need a quick, reliable meal, especially when other options are limited. Whether it's the familiar taste or the efficient service, I know I can count on KFC for a good experience. Though I took my food to go, the restaurant appeared clean and well-maintained, as expected from the brand.

If you're in District 3 and craving tasty fried chicken, this KFC outlet is a great spot to grab a fulfilling meal without any hassle. Highly recommended for both locals and travelers!

ChIJB2crw9AvdTERwZoVOpzn4j0.author: TFI Travel Food Information
ChIJB2crw9AvdTERwZoVOpzn4j0.text:
I recently had dinner from Texas Chicken in District 3, conveniently located within walking distance from The Lion Hotel. Similar to KFC but with its own flair, the menu offers a wide variety of options, including crispy fried chicken, rice combos, pastas, wraps, and cold drinks. Prices are moderate—neither too cheap nor expensive—making it a good value for the quality.

I ordered a combo featuring crispy chicken, a chicken burger, and a chicken wrap, along with a serving of chicken pasta. Every item was delicious and mouthwatering, with the crispy chicken being a standout—perfectly seasoned and crunchy. The wrap was fresh and flavorful, while the pasta was a hearty addition. Since I was short on time, I opted for takeaway and enjoyed the meal in my hotel room.

Staff is friendly and knows English language which is plus for the foreigners who are not aware of local language.

Though I didn’t dine in, the restaurant appeared clean and well-organized, typical of a reliable fast-food chain. The service was quick, and the food was packed neatly for travel. Overall, it was a satisfying meal, and I’d definitely order from Texas Chicken again. Highly recommended for fried chicken lovers looking for a tasty, convenient option in HCM!"

When I asked when it would be ready, I was told, "Everyone has been eating fried food, only I'm eating noodles") :))) Oh, I'm eating noodles, so do I deserve to wait??? Customers came 2-3 times, but I came first, ordered, waited for 1-2 tables with food, and still hadn't come yet. The restaurant can make fried food at once, then go in to make noodles. Who made you bring it all at once, why are you complaining? I don't like this attitude of the restaurant, bringing food, eating fries with cheese, and forgetting to shake cheese, remembering, just saying "Oh, I forgot to shake cheese" and then walking in calmly??? Why carry so many dishes when every dish brought out is like there's none, the chicken is already cold.

Oh, and when I first arrived, I chose a table, 2 tables of the same size They are the same, they are both rectangular, but the difference is that they are made of plastic and iron, but when I was about to sit, the Water Shop said "that place is for 6 people, you guys go sit over there"? That place is for 6 people, I probably sat on top of someone else :)))

=> IN SUMMARY: The food is suitable for SNACKING lovers, but the service attitude is not for HOT-TEMPERED PEOPLE, those who are easy-going should let it go

ChIJU-swNwIndTERXtgSubtKvEk.author: Calvin Bui
ChIJU-swNwIndTERXtgSubtKvEk.text:
KFC Nguyễn Duy Trinh in Ho Chi Minh City delivers an exceptional fast-food experience that stands out from the crowd. From the moment you walk in, the restaurant is spotless, well-organized, and inviting, making it a comfortable spot to enjoy your meal. The staff are friendly, efficient, and always serve with a smile, ensuring a pleasant dining experience.

The food, as always with KFC, is top-notch. The fried chicken here is consistently crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned, living up to the brand’s reputation. The menu offers a variety of options, from classic chicken meals to local favorites, all served fresh and hot.

What I love most about this location is the quick service and attention to detail. Whether you’re dining in, taking out, or ordering delivery, the quality remains the same. It’s also a great spot for families or a quick solo meal.

If you’re in the Nguyễn Duy Trinh area and craving some delicious fried chicken, this KFC location is a go-to. Highly recommended for its cleanliness, great food, and excellent service!

ChIJH1VSUTwvdTERjf1yC_Ywq7Y.text: I know Bonchon is a popular eatery but honestly it was my first time trying their food. Unfortunately there wasn't love at first bite. I actually saw my Chicken Burger sitting at the counter and no one care to pack it up and get ready for me. What an inefficient team working there. So how was the burger? It was good actually but nothing fantastic, the spicy sauce is punchy and the chicken is flavorful. Unfortunately it was a little cold after sitting out there for so long.  Oh.. I was given two forks and two spoons, even I only order one burger but the strange thing is they packed two spoon as a set and two forks as other set. Strange huh? The dining area is fine, spacious  and clean, decor is simple and modern. However the menu is really difficult to read and confusing.

ChIJ19vR-c4odTER51UOC_Bpvgw.author: Daniel Ngo
ChIJ19vR-c4odTER51UOC_Bpvgw.text:
This place has slowly grown on me to the point where it has completely replaced KFC and any other fried chicken franchises in the area. The food consistently comes out hot, crispy, and flavorful, and the portions feel generous for what you pay. Service is another highlight—the staff are polite, attentive, and the reception is warm enough that it feels more like a neighborhood spot than just another fast-food joint. It has become our family’s default choice whenever we want to indulge in some finger-licking chicken.

That being said, there is one drawback that keeps it from being flawless: the drink machine. On too many occasions, it doesn’t mix the soda base and syrup properly. Sometimes you get just soda water, other times it’s overly syrupy, and when it happens, it really throws off the overall dining experience. An upgrade here would go a long way in matching the quality of the food and service. Still, despite this hiccup, the place has earned a permanent spot on our list of family favorites.

ChIJu1KqusIpdTER-MwC50laqBM.author: Thuận Đồng Tấn (Steve)
ChIJu1KqusIpdTER-MwC50laqBM.text:
I need to provide feedback about my recent experience at this restaurant. The service was completely unacceptable, particularly regarding order accuracy. I ordered a combination meal consisting of 4 pieces of chicken, 2 drinks, and a chicken fillet burger. While the items were served sequentially, the final item - supposedly my chicken burger - was actually a fish burger. I only discovered this error after taking a bite, which was extremely concerning as I have a severe allergy to seafood, especially fish.
The allergic reaction affected my ability to taste, and even as I write this feedback, my tongue remains numb. This situation could have been dangerous, and while I fortunately only experienced mild symptoms, it highlights a serious issue in your ordering system.
I strongly urge management to implement proper training for cashiers on order confirmation procedures. Staff should be required to verify orders carefully rather than making assumptions. While I experienced an allergic reaction rather than food poisoning, this type of mistake could have severe consequences for customers with more severe allergies.
