ChIJg0N_Zc4pdTERtAtaSzn7WC8.text:
Review of Dao Hai San 🦞🐟

⏰ Time of visit: 7:30 pm

Today I visited Dao Hai San to get the soy sauce-marinated salmon size M (249k) pre-ordered on the website. The staff called to confirm the order very quickly, said the item was available and I could come to the store at any time. When I arrived, I just had to show the order code on my phone to receive it immediately, extremely convenient.

While waiting, I walked around the store and saw all kinds of seafood for sale: fresh, frozen, packaged sushi & sashimi. There were many promotions, I bought more Thai-sauced jellyfish for 69k, it was crispy, well-seasoned, sweet and sour, very tasty.

In addition, Dao Hai San has a new member program with a 50k discount for orders from 200k and each bill sold will receive an additional 30k voucher for orders of 200k for the next time.

⸻

Detailed review:
• Product quality: 9/10
Fresh seafood, delicious Thai jellyfish, flavorful soy sauce salmon.
• Service & staff: 8/10
Staff called to confirm quickly, good support at the counter.
• Store space: 8/10
The store is spacious, with many types of fresh & frozen seafood, but because it is crowded in the evening, it is a bit cramped.
• Price & promotion: 9/10
Reasonable price compared to quality, many attractive promotions (discounts, vouchers).
• Overall experience: 8.5/10
Fast and reliable shopping, many options to come back and try other dishes.

👉 Summary: A place to buy seafood worth visiting, especially when you want to eat quality sashimi/soy sauce salmon at a reasonable price.

ChIJvas-Q_QvdTERaJAr1eZF5g4.author: Quỳnh Ngô Thị Hương
ChIJvas-Q_QvdTERaJAr1eZF5g4.text: It's been a while since I last ate at the seafood buffet at La Vela. I remembered lunch being okay back then, with fewer options than dinner, but tonight’s dinner was terrible. The price was extremely high, but the quality of the seafood was awful. There was barely any seafood for a place that advertised itself as a seafood buffet. They had lobster and king crab, but both were so overcooked that they were dry and tough. Other seafood options like crab, shrimp, oysters, and mussels weren’t fresh and were grilled until dry. The crabs were tiny. For that price, I thought Lotte or Nikko would have been a much better option, or if you didn’t care about lobster and king crab, you could have gone to Cửu Long Vân at Bitexco where you could have feasted on fresh, steamed crabs and shrimp, along with a variety of freshly grilled seafood. The dessert selection was also limited, with very few cakes and fruits, which felt quite poor. The only redeeming item was the bread pudding that reminded me of the ones I used to have in Europe. Overall, I was really disappointed with La Vela. The quality was terrible, the service was slow, and it definitely wasn’t worth it. I won’t be coming back.

ChIJYwzOXdwvdTERkAklbW97Myw.author: Joey Esguerra
ChIJYwzOXdwvdTERkAklbW97Myw.text:
Ohh this place is a restaurant we didn’t see coming. It’s the kind of spot you go to when you’re craving something familiar and comforting. My fiancé and I dined here for some seafood boil and gosh it was the perfect choice. Such a great place for a welcome dinner or lunch especially after a long day of travel.

For 2 to 3 people my recommendations:
1.	Calamari
2.	Option 3 Seafood Boil in Cajun Sauce (ask for it a little spicy) with scallops, crawfish, shrimp, and the sausage that comes with it was amazing
3.	Hong Kong Style Mud Crabs around 710 grams which was priced at about 1 million dong, more or less, and worth every bit
4.	Optional Rockefeller Oysters, very juicy and fresh but I think they’re even better eaten raw with lime

For drinks:
Loved the Lychee Iced Tea and if you want something alcoholic try the Zing

THE STAFF ARE GREAT!! THEY’RE ALWAYS WATCHING OUT FOR YOU AND ALWAYS ON THE GO! SUPER ATTENTIVE AND FRIENDLY!

Our plates were switched out frequently and the trash bowl emptied multiple times. They even saw us struggling with the crab and offered to crack it for us lol. We ordered a 1/2 kg of tiger prawns, snails, and the popular milky crab roe (which also comes with the rest of the crab). Highly recommended to stop by if you’re into Cajun-Vietnamese fusion seafood!

The venue also offers a lovely terrace. All in all a great option for refined dining in D3.

I loved the place, it has indoor and outdoor area, nicely designed. Seafood is delicious, portions are good. I tried fresh and baked oysters and giant shrimps in curry. The only note is the food is not coming in the right order, the servings is a bit slow.

ChIJBbxyrRovdTERmxrTIHh7s_k.name: places/ChIJBbxyrRovdTERmxrTIHh7s_k/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN0N2FYTWxBRRAB
ChIJBbxyrRovdTERmxrTIHh7s_k.author: Monique Ly
ChIJBbxyrRovdTERmxrTIHh7s_k.text:
I went to this restaurant after visiting the War Remnants museum and it was such a pleasure after going through the museum which was a a little heavy on the heart.

It’s an international seafood place with the dishes prepared similar to other countries with a Vietnamese twist.

I ordered the curry crab, clam and shrimp. I loved the clam the most, it’s cooked with coconut juice and I was advised to eat the clam with the juice and some of the sweet and sour sauce.

Service was amazing, the waiters and waitresses were so attentive and helpful.

Now the decor….beautiful. I actually walked around a bit to take it in.

Thanks La Sirena!!
xx

It's not so cheap, but also not so expensive for the good quality. You can enjoy them.

ChIJN9vXXS8vdTER6efFhN49vvw.text:
Seafood restaurant located 15 min. away (by car) from downtown.
They have quite huge fish tanks separately managed for kinds of fish and shellfish where fresh-looking live seafood is. And they have many tables for guests and some rooms on ground and 1st floor as well where we can enjoy lively atmosphere or have private gatherings.
Furthermore, they have quite wide range of menu we can choose and menus we ordered were quite good. I think we may have good dish whatever we ordered, steamed, fried, raw or stirred.
Along with nice foods, cups of beer with ice were really nice and refreshing in this hot weather.
It could be a good choice to visit this one for nice food in affordable prices.

You can find a wide selection of seafood here. They even have live king crab!

I had dinner here and ordered the steamed grouper in soya sauce. It took about 20 min for the food to come. I had high expectations for this place since the seafood looked fresh, but the grouper wasn’t cooked well. There was too much onion and the sauce was bland, making the fish tasteless since it’s already a bland fish.

The restaurant itself has many seatings both indoor and outdoor. I’d recommend sitting indoor to avoid mosquitos.

Exactly what means Restaurant...

Near my house, no need to travel downtown to find a good eatery...

- beef salad : fresh, crunchy. Well balanced between acid and sweet, bitter as it should be, not too much. Beef well marinated and cooked.
- shrimp... Fresh from the aquarium. Well grilled, super tender, juicy. Not dry at all.
- shells also well cooked. Just enough to taste the iod....

Thank you for the good experience. Don't change the chef.

So I know everything is huge even it was not opened because the building itself is huge. Anyway even the dry seafood market, it's very fun. They sell only big unit (from 1kg usually) but it's affordable for us, not only for business.

ChIJjcKn7fApdTER07GwNUz-3jM.author: Wilson tjhia
ChIJjcKn7fApdTER07GwNUz-3jM.text:
Lots of confusion in this restaurant, first when we arrived, we ask for high chair for the baby and they said they don't have, restaurant this big should at least have some, maybe because it's just opened.

After that we have issue ordering because we don't speak Vietnamese, but finally there is one staff that can speak Mandarin and spoke to us.

Food and service itself is actually good but the biggest problem is the delivery of the food to the table. At first the veggies and fried rice, come right away, after that the shrimps also come a lil bit after that. It get worse from there, we almost finished all the food on the table, but our crabs, fish and clams are not there.

We can see the table next to us also frustrated due to the long waiting time. We ordered 4 crabs, the 2 crabs came first but after that there is a long delay for the fish and clams (we keep asking for them, waiters keep saying it's coming). In the end only the 2 crabs that's not on the table while we already ate everything else. We waited almost 1 hour for the last dish 2 crabs, but it's not coming out.

So we gave up and asked them to cancel and just pay for the bill. They brought out the bill but still showing 4 crabs, we said we already waited almost 1 hour for the last dish and it's not here yet, so we request to just cancel and pay for the rest.

During that process, suddenly the last dish arrive but at that point we already tired, so we told them no, but they keep insisting for us to pay for the crabs. We got into long arguments, after screaming at 2-3 different staffs, finally they agreed to cancel the crabs.

Even then we have to wait almost 30 mins to pay for the bill, we have to keep asking the staff for the bill.

This is really a bad experience all around, I understand the restaurant is new, but they need to do better job at managing the kitchen and notify their customer about the issues.

Note: somehow they didn't hammer the crab too, so eating it is very time consuming and hard

ChIJnbtjZf8odTEROaCjrUkMBHw.name: places/ChIJnbtjZf8odTEROaCjrUkMBHw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqNjV6VHFBRRAB
ChIJnbtjZf8odTEROaCjrUkMBHw.author: Dominic Nguyen-Kessell
ChIJnbtjZf8odTEROaCjrUkMBHw.text:
Nestled in a tranquil street that comes alive at night, Hải Sản Tươi Ngon Seafood Restaurant is a hidden gem for those in pursuit of the freshest seafood, exceptional service, and remarkable value for money. Despite its modest size, the restaurant cleverly extends its seating into the street, offering diners an authentic local experience that's both intimate and vibrant.

The standout feature of Hải Sản Tươi Ngon is undoubtedly the seafood. Sourced daily, each dish served is a celebration of the ocean's generosity, prepared with care to showcase its natural flavors. The portions are generous, ensuring that diners leave satisfied, both in terms of hunger and culinary delight.

Service at Hải Sản Tươi Ngon is exemplary. The staff are not just friendly; they embody hospitality, welcoming every guest with warm smiles and going out of their way to accommodate special requests. This level of service, combined with excellent food and value, makes dining here not just a meal, but an experience to remember.

Dining on the street adds an exciting dimension to the meal, allowing guests to soak in the atmosphere of the bustling night, making Hải Sản Tươi Ngon an ideal spot for those looking to immerse themselves in the local dining scene. Whether you're a seafood enthusiast or simply in search of a memorable dining experience, Hải Sản Tươi Ngon promises to deliver on all fronts.

ChIJnbtjZf8odTEROaCjrUkMBHw.text:
From Nha Trang to Saigon, my lover took me to this restaurant to eat seafood 😂 I eat fresh seafood every day in Nha Trang, but I still tried it because the street restaurants nearby are too crowded and noisy... and it was surprising and beyond my expectations
The seafood is fresher than the street restaurants that I have eaten many times before, you can tell that the seafood is fresh that day, not frozen and sold in season. The sea urchin is medium sized, not as big as in my hometown, but fresh and the rice is thick enough to hurt your armpits. When cooked, the flavor is 9/10 for me, the dish is hot and hot quickly.

There are 2 waiters and the owner who are very enthusiastic. The space is relatively quiet, with little traffic. Comfortable parking. Reasonable place to chill. Reasonable price =)) compared to Nha Trang, it's a bit more expensive here, haha

The shop doesn't sell alcohol, but when I bought it, I was surprised the second time, the shop didn't charge extra, enthusiastically brought out glasses to drink wine 🥰 + 1000 points
Next time I come back, I'll come back to the shop again, thank you for the mango dish from the owner even though my lover ate it all unconsciously without leaving me a piece =))))))

ChIJc-6GjK8pdTERibSiijGyIdk.author: Thanh Hảo Lê
ChIJc-6GjK8pdTERibSiijGyIdk.text:
Stepping into Cô Tư Cà Mau felt less like entering a restaurant and more like being transported, just for a moment, to the breezy, rustic atmosphere of the Mekong Delta. If you’re like me, sometimes the hustle of Ho Chi Minh City can be overwhelming, and this place was a truly needed escape.

My personal connection to Southern Vietnamese food made this visit really special. I came here specifically for the famous Cà Mau Crab, and let me tell you, it did not disappoint. When the crab was served, it was so fresh—the shell was firm, the meat was incredibly sweet, and the richness of the crab roe was exactly the flavor of "home" I’d been missing. It honestly brought a little wave of happy nostalgia.

Beyond the star dish, the other seafood tasted genuinely 'sinh thái' (eco-friendly/natural), which you can immediately tell from the freshness. Everything was cooked with that unmistakable, authentic Southern Vietnamese seasoning—bold, a little sweet, and perfectly balanced.

The Emotion of the Experience:

I'm giving it 4/5 stars because while the food was practically perfect and the ambiance (with its riverside view and rustic decor) was wonderfully charming and relaxing, the service, while friendly, was a little slow. It felt like they were busy, and we had to flag down staff a few times.

However, the quality of the main event—the freshest, most authentic Cà Mau seafood I've had in a long time—made the wait completely worth it.

If you're craving a genuine, soulful taste of Vietnam's deep South and want a moment of peace away from the city noise, Cô Tư Cà Mau is a heartfelt recommendation. Just try to be patient; the delicious payoff is coming!

I enjoy the salted egg flavor and thai flavor here but it was not that great in my last visit. The one before that was good. Taste also vary extremely by location as it taste so much better in district 7. For this location, I recommend to eat in weekend for super fresh and good food.
Service: considering the price you pay, it is great but not at the level I expect at this price. But overall, it’s good service. However, parking is a major headache here, especially for car!
Atmosphere: new and looking great. Nothing fancy to be wow’ed of.

ChIJgfSun44ndTERbiesp-wWNJc.author: Bowen Lim
ChIJgfSun44ndTERbiesp-wWNJc.text:
Clean and hygiene place including the toilet, airconditioning is comfortable.

Server will clean the mess on the table whenever it gets too messy.

All the prices are shown according to weight of the seafood you chosed and weighed immediately to show you the cost for your reference.

The river prawn is huge and the buttery cream inside was delicious. Around 140k each as big as your palm which in my opinion, it's affordable. We had 4 of em.

Lobsters average at around 1.5mil per kilo. We chosed Canadian Boston lobster it was very fresh and tasty.

We did not order the live grouper because they only had 1.5kg onwards which were very huge. The price per kilo was also reasonable in my opinion.

People should know how many kilograms they are getting so they don't claim that they've been scammed. Normally first timer who couldn't gauge what amount they could eat will end up over ordering with a bill that they claim to be too expensive. So my advise is to know the size and amount of protein you could get out of the shell before you rush to order.

We will definitely come back again in the future

Doing everything by the KG makes it hard to tell what the price will be and many items are far more expensive than the market rate in Vietnam.

We were charged over 500k for 4 scallops.

Overall, the meal was good, but at 3.2ml for a very modest meal for 4 (that didn't include any king crab or lobster), the value for money simply isn't there.

If the price were better matched to the ambiance and product, the star rating would be higher.

You could get so much more for that price.

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.author: Дарья Назаркина
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.text:
Had an absolutely outstanding experience at this Italian restaurant. The pizza was, without exaggeration, the best I’ve had in my life – perfect crust, amazing toppings, and so much flavor. The desserts and appetizers were just as impressive: very well-balanced, with interesting and harmonious combinations of tastes.
The interior is super stylish and cozy, and the atmosphere makes you want to stay longer. Service is on an incredible level – attentive, professional and genuinely friendly. Our waiter, Nhi, was especially amazing: incredibly kind, friendly and very polite, which made the whole evening even more enjoyable.
Everything here is beautiful, but most importantly, incredibly delicious. Highly recommended.

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.name: places/ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOQlVuaE5hbTFaU3pGdlFrWTBhMlp4Y2xWSFlVRRAB
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.author: Judas.K
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.text:
We recently visited this restaurant after hearing a lot of buzz, especially about their pizzas, and overall it was a pretty mixed experience. The clear standout of the night was the Four Cheese Pizza. It absolutely lived up to its reputation — rich, creamy, and wonderfully balanced in flavor. While it wasn’t mind-blowing or surprising, it was undeniably delicious and definitely the kind of dish you’d come back for. If you’re a cheese lover, this is easily the safest and strongest recommendation on the menu.

We also tried the Squid Ink Risotto and the Spicy Squid Pasta, and these were unfortunately more on the average side. The risotto had a decent texture but lacked depth and complexity, and the pasta, while flavorful, didn’t offer anything particularly memorable. They weren’t bad dishes, just not standout compared to the hype around the place.

One pleasant surprise was the Cheese Gelato. It’s not something you find everywhere, and it had a unique, pleasantly creamy flavor that makes it worth ordering at least once. The Mushroom Soup tasted very natural, almost like freshly blended mushrooms with minimal seasoning — some might appreciate the simplicity, though others may find it a bit plain.

Overall, come for the pizza, stay for the gelato, and manage expectations for the rest.

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.name: places/ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ab2FVUkpTMUphYWw5d1NIWmFZMEZXYjNCR1YwRRAB
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.author: LAK
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.text:
Pizza 4P’s Hai Bà Trưng keeps impressing me with how good everything tastes and how polished every dish looks. The food always feels carefully prepared — clean flavors, balanced seasoning, nothing sloppy or rushed. What stands out most is the presentation: pizzas, risotto, and salads all come out looking refined, tidy, and consistent, like the kitchen actually cares about every plate that leaves the pass.

It’s one of those places where you can trust that the dishes will be both delicious and beautifully put together every single time. If you want quality and attention to detail, this branch nails it.

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.name: places/ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21jeVVIQTRiM010WVdwbldXWTFOamxmVkhOU1EzYxAB

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.text:
Hands down one of the best Italian restaurants I’ve ever been to — and I’m saying that from Vietnam! Every single dish was phenomenal, full of flavour and perfectly cooked. The prices were amazing for the quality, the service was fast and genuinely friendly, and the whole vibe of the place was perfect — warm, stylish, and relaxed.

A big shoutout to Cam Space Tu, who took great care of us (along with the rest of the team — they were all incredible). If you’re in the area, this place is an absolute must-visit! 🇮🇹🍝❤️

ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.name: places/ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poUmRVaHVPSFpETVdwalgybHBSMWg2YURJNFNVRRAB
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.author: onJuice Nguyen
ChIJC-nWiTYvdTERGMJvRSoZ2f4.text:
Pizza 4P’s really impressed me. The staff were warm, welcoming and genuinely attentive, which set the tone right away. It’s a popular spot, so having a booking helps, but even without one the wait wasn’t too bad thanks to the size of the restaurant.

The space itself looks great. Clean, modern and stylish without feeling overly fancy. I went for the half and half pizza so I could try more than one topping. I chose the spicy prawn on one side and the scallop on the other. The pizzas are proper wood fired and you can taste that difference. The spicy prawn was the standout for me. Packed with flavour and a good level of heat. The scallop one looked good but needed more flavour to match the other half.

I also ordered the carbonara. The presentation was incredible and almost looked like one of those plastic display dishes. It had a truffle note to it, which isn’t my favourite, but in terms of texture and creaminess it was excellent.

Overall, it’s a great spot for pizza and pasta. You walk out satisfied, and the quality feels consistent. Definitely worth visiting if you want something comforting and well made in Vietnam.

ChIJoQ0-agAvdTERuyzp7dQQCmo.text:
many of u have heard of pizza 4P’s, but not many know of this hidden (like literally) neapolitan-style pizza spot that offers half & half option too!! tucked away in this alley/residential area that is easy to miss, is a family-run business whr the pizzas are crafted by this young guy on the spot & u can tell that he is truly passionate abt his crafts! apparently he learnt how to make pizzas himself thru youtube which is like wow…😳🍕

3 of us got 3 pizzas to share which means we got to try 6 flavours!! woah we were soooo full but my friends & i esp loved the pesto one hands down our fav!! 😆🙌🏼 the pizza dough was light & airy on the outside & soft and chewy on the inside, giving it a satisfying bite ⭐️

the ppl thr r incredibly friendly & attentive too!! my friends & i initially didn’t know abt the half & half option until we finished ordering! but they so kindly let us change our order so that we cld try more favours, he also asked if we were sharing the pizzas & thoughtfully divided them for us— it’s the little things like these that rlly elevate the whole experience!! 🤩✨

pls go give it a try don’t miss out on this place when ure in hcmc!!

The restaurant is gorgeous and location is convenient! No wait when we went at 8pm on a weekday.

It is on the very top floor and it is stairs only.

ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.name: places/ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w4elFYSmhUa0pWVVdsRWNVSnhVa3BWYzA5eGEwRRAB
ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.author: Karen Higashi
ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.text: We were greeted for an Italian so kind and friendly. The pizzas were amazing  the tomato sauce so fresh and the pizza dough crunchy and soft on the inside, just great. We hadn't booked a table and they were full until late, but while we waited for our take away on a table beside the over he let us stay and we enjoyed a good chat, good pizza and drinks. The stairs are well worth it.

ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.name: places/ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201b1prMVFWRWhDV1dOUk4wNVRPSEo2WlZGclQzYxAB
ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.author: Gabriel Long
ChIJGXYMzUsvdTERICMQj1O9RFU.text: The stairs are worth it, rooftop spot looking over the markets in the center of it all. Great range of classic Italian dishes w. a Venetian twist. We had diavola, squid ink risotto & burrita. The staff, too kind to describe. A real 10/10 when you're looking for a break from all that amazing Vietnamese food. Best pizza is Saigon

ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.name: places/ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSd1owbFdVWE52Tm5aTWVYWkNabkpZTldwNVFWRRAB
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.author: Aleksandar Popovic
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.text:
We stumbled upon this cozy little Italian restaurant in Ho Chi Minh and were absolutely delighted by the experience. We started with a warm and velvety pumpkin cream soup — rich, comforting, and full of flavor. For the main course, we shared a pizza that was half pepperoni and half quattro formaggi — both sides perfectly balanced with fresh ingredients and a crisp, wood-fired crust. We also tried another pizza topped with prosciutto and fresh arugula (I forgot the name, but it was incredible!) — the combination of salty, savory, and peppery notes was just right.

Beyond the food, the staff was exceptionally polite and attentive, adding to the relaxed and welcoming atmosphere.

ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.name: places/ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwYWVsSlZPVkZIU1hOU1QzQnVVell4Y2s5T1UwRRAB
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.author: Tri minh Nguyen
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.text:
Disclaimer: i am here 2nd time because fell in love with the motto. Become Local eat local well it happens to become a thing i guess.

I had the garden greens salad 100k huge portion green salad sum rucola/rocket some dryed raisins tomatos yoghurt dressing and a basalmico cream on the side salad is more on the sweet side if u want that order something else.

The Paté Pizza was Bomb. As always.. it‘s like eating vietnam on a Pizza.. right amount of rough Paté means some creamy some had pieces of meat to bite on. A little bit of „do chua“ carrots/daikon pickles for the sweet and the tangy to counter the fattiness sole chillies/bell peppers & cilantro… i definately reccomend this Pizza it‘s fusion kitchen made with thoughts behind it u‘ll notice the love.

Overall a good experience as always!

I‘ll come back!

ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.name: places/ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZME5YZ1NREAE
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.author: Nikita Kytin
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.text: The restaurant has a cozy and pleasant atmosphere with very friendly and attentive staff. We tried the salad with cheese, and smoked salmon. It was beautifully presented and pretty delicious. The pizza was also really good)  Also we had salsa with nachos, but forgot to take a pic) Everything tasted fresh and well-balanced. Overall, I really liked the experience and would definitely come back when we in Saigon again)

ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.name: places/ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRNmQ3cjBRRRAB
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.author: Hayley Smith
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.text: We tried the truffle fries and both ordered half and half pizzas as we wanted to try multiple flavours! The fries were incredible and a sensible serving. The pizzas were delicious as well and they had wonderful service. We were the only people there initially so looks like we got lucky! Hard to know what the quality of Italian food will be in South East Asia but these guys exceeded our expectations.

ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.name: places/ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3bDRXMThnRRAB
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.author: Annie Ph
ChIJMS8pNsEvdTERZ6gvKr-iy6A.text: A small and cozy restaurant. The carbonara was a bit salty, and the chicken wasn’t quite to my taste, but the main dish—the pizza—was truly excellent. The cheese was delicious, the seafood was fresh and crispy, and the staff took good care of us. I’ll definitely come back!

ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.name: places/ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGNVVqWlRORVpyVkd4a1Iyc3lNV0pWUkhsSlJGRRAB
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.author: yumz
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.text:
pizza 4p's on lê thánh tôn is the og spot that started it all

THE ORIGIN STORY
founded in 2011 by a japanese duo with a vision for sustainable dining, this flagship location launched what would become a nationwide favorite. their journey from this first spot to empire status is lowkey inspiring.

THE LOCATION QUEST
finding this flagship spot is part of the experience - tucked away in a hem (alley), making it a proper hidden gem that feels like a culinary treasure hunt.

THE HOUSE-MADE CHEESE SITUATION
they produce their own cheese in-house which is impressive, though keeping it real, it didn't fully win me over. still major respect for the craft and commitment to doing it themselves.

THE QUALITY INGREDIENTS
we're talking next-level fresh ingredients that actually taste vibrant and make you feel good about what you're eating. their produce game is straight fire.

THE CHILI OIL THAT SLAPS
their signature chili oil is a total game-changer – that perfect balance of sour, tangy and spicy that elevates every single bite. you'll want to put it on everything.

THE PRACTICAL PERKS
the wet naps at every table are lowkey brilliant for keeping things clean while you dive into that perfectly messy, delicious pizza.

THE FINAL CALL
if you're chasing quality pizza with history and flavors that actually deliver, this original location is a total win. that chili oil alone is worth the alley adventure.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.name: places/ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KR1lXdHVPV0ZPVm1sa1VYSnhibEpoYlhWaVpWRRAB
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.author: Tanayos Son
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.text: While the food was truly delicious, the service provided by Han was the real highlight. When my girlfriend mentioned she was cold from the air-conditioning, Han immediately went above and beyond by bringing her a blanket. This kind of warm support and attentiveness is rare and highly appreciated. Cheers!

ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.name: places/ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KaVV6WlVhVVZPVTFwTWJqTjNXR2t4TkhoRVUwRRAB
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.author: Supasin Sriprasittipap
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.text: A MUST TRY PIZZA in Ho Chi Minh City. Their foods and services will never let you down. We didn't booking but fortunately we got a seat at the counter to see the dedicated and passionated staffs making their very best pizza. We received excellent service from Diem, our nice and lovely staff. Hoping to revisit this place soon.

ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.name: places/ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xoTFdVZHdjRkprWHpOTmQwUjNUV3gzY2taMFVIYxAB
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.author: Rena Ku
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.text: Everything is great less the food. I mean…. If you are looking for authentic Italian food, this is not the place for you. But you just craving for something different from Vietnamese food, yeah you could give it a shot. For the price, is still worth it though. Remember to make reservations before coming, its a very popular place. Special mention to the service: is extremely good, they even provide free raincoat and umbrella during rainy weather, the toilet has everything you need even hairdryer.

ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.name: places/ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201T1dWcHljMmRTTW1zd1RUZElkVk10YkUxdk9FRRAB
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.author: Ma. Andrea Gabrielle Yap
ChIJHUDLN0kvdTEROYEfxmcCW5g.text:
Tried this place and the food did not disappoint! The pizza was perfectly cooked with a soft, chewy crust and great flavor—half Margherita, half cheese, and both were delicious. The meat platter was a highlight too: tender slices of beef, well-seasoned sides, and tasty dipping sauces that complemented everything well.

Will definitely recommend to my friends in PH if they will visit HCM!

ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.name: places/ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tsUVQxRnlUWFZFZGt3ek5tUTFNbXh1TlZneGRWRRAB
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.author: Shi Yin C
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.text: This place truly surpassed expectations. It is best to make a reservation, as it tends to get busy, and for good reason. The pizza was delicately put together, with a perfect balance of crisp crust and fresh toppings. I like that each ingredient can be tasted on its own, and when they come together, the flavours blend harmoniously. The squid ink risotto was the highlight for me! Just the right amount of x-factor, creamy, and deeply flavourful without being heavy. Service was warm and attentive, rounding off what felt like a genuinely satisfying dining experience. Kudos to Bao and the team for making it memorable.

ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.name: places/ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25SdlMybzJSRWRtVG5ka1oxTnBjalpHZFdoTU5tYxAB
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.author: CD Le
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.text: It kinda pains me to write this review because I've been to several 4P's locations and the experience has been great so far.  But I don't think what I'm writing reflects this place any other day, only today. We ordered 2 pies, a burata pie (my absolute favorite), some cheesy potatoes and a mushroom soup. Everything was as expected, until the salami/pepperoni pie came out, which was super salty, like unbearably salty. Please note that this isn't my first time ordering this pizza from 4Ps so needless to say I was quite surprised. The seafood pie was ok but the sauce they brought out was also heavily salted and it did not do the pies any favors. Fortunately, the service, as always, was top notch, super attentive staff with great attitude and genuine interactions. We gave feedback regarding the pies and they gave us 2 complementary desserts, which is a nice gesture.  Will I be back here? The establishment, yes; the location, maybe.

ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.name: places/ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214eGRtRm9WMEoxTWxZNGFsWkNkV2REYVdFMldYYxAB
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.author: Faustina Joyce Fernando
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.text: We had a great meal here. We were served by Sinh who made great recommendations and served us with a smile! He took the time to explain the menu and kept checking in with our table. Overall great & friendly service and a yummy meal!

ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.name: places/ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aM2VFMTBUV1V3TURjd2REUlNia1JMTFdadk5IYxAB
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.author: Jiani Ong
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.text: Food (Pizza/Pasta everything) is really good, wish i could take them back home! I am from Malaysia. I went to pizza 4P second time during my 4days HCM trip. Service is outstanding! Sinh and the entire team are all so friendly and very accommodating! They gave us complimentary dessert because of my request they could not make it (Not their fault tho) Will definitely keep coming back here when I visit HCM again. Thanks so much! ❤️ I enjoy my trip so much because of pizza 4P.

ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.name: places/ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aT01tNU9hVXRCTUdOelFVSTFWRkJWVG1VdE1FRRAB
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.author: Raymond Bo
ChIJw-_FOzQvdTERqaFY67fP2Zs.text: Came on a Saturday morning around 10am without a reservation and found a queue already forming. We ordered the crab spaghetti, perfectly al dente and full of flavor. Also had the half Parma ham burrata and half beef pizza, which had a thin, crispy crust and was absolutely delicious; one of the best we’ve had. We’ve tried 4P’s in Hanoi and Danang on past trips, and this outlet is just as good. Definitely worth a visit!

ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.name: places/ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0TmFESkRRVGRaUTNVNVMzWlFXRk5SV2tWVWVtYxAB
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.author: Ross Lorenzo
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.text:
Amazing spot - super consistent of all the other branches. There were 14 of us and it was able to cater for such a large group. Simply book on their website or through Google maps.

Excellent food, service and ambience. Extreme value for money, specially for quality of food. You'd pay at least 2-3 times more in other countries

ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.name: places/ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xnMllsSkdhWE5GWVVOUGRXeGtZbWhPY1doRFNFRRAB
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.author: Digital Food Nomad
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.text:
Pizza 4P’s serves excellent pizza, made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. They only offer one size—a medium, which is light and satisfying without being too heavy. The menu ranges from simple classics to creative, exotic combinations, giving plenty of variety depending on your mood.

While the prices are on the higher side, the quality and craftsmanship of the food make it worthwhile. They also serve a good selection of pasta and other Italian dishes, all presented beautifully. Overall, it’s a great choice for Italian food lovers looking for quality and consistency in Saigon.  This place does get crowded, so reservations is required at dinner time.

ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.name: places/ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sxT1REWTNOMmsyTWxod1Yxa3RYM1JSV0d4ZlNWRRAB
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.author: Teresa Nguyen
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.text: everything is made fresh and you can see them make each pizza pie in their oven! service and hospitality is beyond amazing. i always come here everytime i visit vietnam, and quality is so coónitent❤️

ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.name: places/ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25ZNWRWY3dlREJZWTNoTk1rMHlRVXB2VWtSTmVHYxAB
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.author: vu nguyen
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.text: Was recommended by my Airbnb host so decided to give it a shot. Started by some Japanese dude in Saigon and is super popular. Pizza has many Asia influences and you can do half pizzas which is a big plus to try out their many different pizzas. The crab pasta was also on point and exceptional service.

ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.name: places/ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKWVNtbDRka05uTVVwcGFHd3RjMTlwTkd4cGMyYxAB
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.author: Foo Jun Qiang
ChIJyzkiI1AvdTER763wasUcMW0.text: Absolutely phenomenal! This isn't just food; it's an experience. Every bite was a masterpiece of flavour. Incredibly savoury, deeply satisfying, and cooked to perfection. Hands down the best meal I've had in a long time. An absolute must-try!

ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.name: places/ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kRk1ISlVPVFJRWVhoQllVZFRZbDlXTmxBMlJWRRAB
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.author: Chris Thompson
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.text: Superb location really close to the famous independence palace. The service was really quick, polite and friendly. The burrata salad was very good and the pizza's are quite good. The place looks like it needs a bit of a make over and a deep clean which could easily be arranged by their owners.

ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.name: places/ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tzeVJsSTBlbVZZY0dOMlIxTnlVMTlYYTJKTFRrRRAB
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.author: Toby Crawford
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.text: Unreal pizzas, great friendly staff and delicious drinks. Was reluctant to try because it was so quiet and the surrounding restaurants were busy, but came in and it was great. The we had a good chat to the owner, he was really friendly and made us feel very welcome.

ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.name: places/ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25od2NHcDJXRUl0WTFrMllYZHJSRjlSWjJ4M00xRRAB
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.author: Lisa Apostoli
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.text: We are very critical about pizza and we have eaten pizza  all around the world. The pizza was delicious and lived up to our expectation. If you’re looking for a traditional Italian wood-fired pizza in Hoi Chi Minh then Italians”s is the place to go.

ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.name: places/ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNudVltNHBRRRAB
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.author: Nhân Nguyễn
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.text:
I recently visited this charming restaurant and was thoroughly impressed by both the food and the exceptional service. The restaurant is located along a slightly busy pedestrian path, but inside it feels cozy and inviting, with beautiful décor that adds a warm and pleasant atmosphere.

We had the chance to try a few dishes, and the pizza was the highlight of our meal. It was fresh, flavorful, and the toppings were abundant and well-balanced. The crust was perfectly baked—light and crispy—and it complemented the rich flavors of the toppings wonderfully. The restaurant clearly puts a lot of care into the quality of their food.

The service was top-notch as well, thanks to the wonderful staff. Rambo and Tracy really stood out. Rambo was attentive, ensuring that we were well taken care of throughout our meal. Tracy was incredibly friendly and warm, making us feel welcomed right from the start. Both staff members spoke excellent English and went above and beyond to provide a memorable dining experience. They shared engaging stories and were always ready to help with a smile.

In conclusion, this restaurant is a fantastic spot to enjoy a delicious meal with excellent service. Whether you're looking for great food or a welcoming atmosphere, you won’t be disappointed. I’ll definitely be back for more!

ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.name: places/ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2psdVozbFBZelZ1YlV4Qll6TmxVM05uTTBaeVRYYxAB
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.author: Kat
ChIJYzWnjDcvdTERsuS6UCsUbCE.text:
I was wandering around and I was in need of a beer.  I saw a sign for beer- the place was empty, but hey, you don’t need a lot of people to enjoy a beer.

After an hour or so. I decided to order some food. Wow. What an amazing pizza. I got the 4-mushroom  goat cheese, and it was incredible!

Also. My waitress was the friendliest woman ever. The biggest smile, super enthusiastic, and chatty.

10/10. Great food, and great night.

ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.name: places/ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tscWNHaHhPR2xuUzNRdFEwMVNVbXQ2Tkhab1ZrRRAB
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.author: Mai Anh V
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.text:
Maybe I'm late to the game cause I ready had a comfort pizza place I usually visit but damn, this place just beats it and became my fav Pizzeria in town.

PIZZA: the crisp, the crust, the burnt, the fresh and salty tomato sauce (some ppl don't like it salty, I do) and good quality, fresh toppings all come together and please each of my tastebuds.

We came here twice and tried a few options: half Gustosa half Esagerata, half Terraviva half Spicy & smoky, Meat Lovers, Diavola...
All are delicious but our favourite is Diavola, the good old simple combination of tomato base, cheese, salami and that's it.

Terraviva is also quite nice and an interesting combination.

DESSERTS: chocolate gelato tasted nice, tiramisu is also good but I personally prefer it creamier.

AMBIANCE: cozy, chilled, warm-welcoming and make you wanna come back. Nice seating area especially outside and the chairs are really comfortable.

SERVICE: amazing staff - fast, attentive and welcoming and nice owner/manager, who passed by each table and greeted customers.

Overall, absolutely loved the food and whole experience I had here. Will definitely come back.

ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.name: places/ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ZeWExcDBlWGxoUW5OMU5rMUtTVEJVVTJobGIxRRAB
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.author: Rachel S
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.text: The salad, pasta and pizza here are excellent, with authentic flavours and quality ingredients. The restaurant offers a warm, inviting atmosphere that makes a comfortable dining experience. The staff is attentive and genuinely helpful, ensuring guests feel well taken care of throughout their visit.

ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.name: places/ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25BeFIxVmtiSE5WYlVOaGNIa3dWRVpGYXpFdE0zYxAB
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.author: Nguyen Tan Dat
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.text:
Absolutely loved this place! If you’re looking for real, handmade, European-style pizza, this is the spot. The dough is freshly made, thin, and perfectly crisp — just like in Italy. Toppings are high quality and well-balanced, not overloaded like many places. You can really taste the difference.

I was impressed by how every pizza comes out with that rustic, wood-fired flavor. It feels like a small pizzeria you’d stumble upon in a quiet town in Europe. Cozy, simple, and delicious.

Highly recommend for anyone who loves authentic flavors and appreciates handmade quality. Definitely one of the best pizza places in town!

ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.name: places/ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOemRERlpNbFZtVVRGeWVubFJUVVJZVm1OQ09XYxAB
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.author: Briana Le
ChIJ8RNFYkUndTERx02sx5ULkkM.text:
Came here for date night with my boyfriend and had such a lovely time. We sat upstairs with a view of the downstairs and between the twinkling lights and light rain bouncing off the roof, it felt very cozy and romantic.

We ordered the diavola and rustica pizza and both were delicious. We really enjoyed how authentic this pizza is - my boyfriend swears it’s just like the pizza he had in Naples, Italy and says this is the best pizza spot in Vietnam. We also shared the tiramisu at the end and that was very lovely.

I want to really commend this place on their staff. Every person we encountered was SO attentive and nice - from the parking attendant, to the host, to the several servers we interacted with. Genuinely some of the best service we’ve ever received in Vietnam.

Amazing date night spot with amazing staff and amazing food.

ChIJucoDKx8vdTERdR8DOnlNUeQ.text: The food is deliciously. You can take children to here. It is located on city center, easy to catch transport to here.

ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.text: Good service, attentive, roomy and clean toilets, you are not overwhelmed with anything negative. The atmosphere is romantic and probably good for a date! ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.author: Jess
ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.text: Pepperoni pizza was light, with a beautiful tomato base. The garlic knots were to die for!! No photos of the actual food as we ate it too quick haha. A great place if you’re craving Italian in HCMC.

ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.name: places/ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfenQ3R3VBRRAB

ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.text: Love this place! Just was walking by and decided to try it out. The interior modern but very cozy and vibey. The staff were really kind and attentive🫰. Got the pesto chicken pizza and a coke as part of the lunch deal which was great. Pizza is thin crust and really good quality. Super duper yummy and the pesto was so flavourful. ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.name: places/ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURuNXNQY0x3EAE
ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.author: Nguyen Nhan
ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.text:
Great Food with Room for Improvement

The restaurant is new with decent staff and well-made food. The atmosphere is quite nice and cozy with modern decor, though the wood-fired pizza oven makes things feel a bit busy.

We chose the Funky Wolf Pizza, which was decent, and the crust really showed that the dough was made with care. The creamy lemon pasta with prawn was also enjoyable. The prawns were nicely cooked with a touch of garlic, which didn’t overshadow the lemon zest in the cream sauce.

Things to improve, in my personal view:

•	The staff could be better trained and more confident in both English and Vietnamese to explain the menu more clearly.
•	There should be a wider selection of pizzas.
•	The prices for drinks and pizza are higher than at other places with similar quality. For people to return, the restaurant would need to offer something more special.

ChIJ_4KKoCkvdTERqZ4aOkGu9Es.text:
Cozy & Impressive Fusion Pizza!
Loved the cozy vibe at Leonardo Pizza! Their fusion pizzas are amazing – super tasty and unique. The Salmon Pizza & Lá Lốt Pizza were especially impressive. We also enjoy Lemon Prawn Spaghetti. Great flavors, and a really comfortable place. Highly recommend!

ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg.author: Han Ly
ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg.text:
I’ve been eating here since they first opened and it’s seriously addictive. The pizza has a super crunchy crust and soft dough, and the toppings are delicious. I especially love the cheese since it goes so well with the honey (and spicy honey that you can also order). We always get the combo that has fries and salad, and the salad dressing is amazing too. Overall, highly recommend you try this place and experience all the options, bring friends if you have to.
The staff is always so nice and attentive, but they’re a small crew, so please be patient. However, my food always arrive promptly so waiting time is not even an issue.

ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg.text:
This restaurant is hard to find, but it is very cozy and atmospheric. Stylish premises, which are very fresh and smell nicely of baked goods, with cute paintings.
The pizza is very original, I would rather call it a pie. The dough is crispy, fluffy, with cheese - the best kind of pizza.

ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg.name: places/ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205RVdrOW1VRWhSYlRWT1kweFBTSFUzWnpCS1EwRRAB

ChIJgfAC0E4vdTERRkrU-pq1iHg.text: We got recommended to try this after some shopping and it was so good! Thuy, our server, was so friendly and the pizza was very tasty. I’ve had Detroit style pizza back in the States and this was some of the crispiest pizza I had!

My go to place for pizzas in Ho Chi Minh city.
You just can't go wrong with it.

The price is on the higher side, sure, but the taste! Ingredients are tasty and the pizza quality in general Great!

Impeccable service with good atmosphere comes as the cherry on top!

I vouch for this place as I've been probably 6 ~ 8 times and the quality was always there!

ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.text:
I’ve tried many pizza places, but this one impressed me the most with the amazing flavors of its dishes. The cheese is delicious, and the creamy cheese pasta has an unforgettable taste. The beer here is also excellent — definitely worth trying!
The staff are friendly and approachable, and the restaurant’s cozy decor creates a warm, inviting atmosphere that’s perfect for dates or catching up with friends. 😍😍😍

ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.text:
My favorite pizza place in the city! Better than most pizza places around, in my opinion. The staff are always friendly, fluent in English and attentive. Ingredients are always fresh, pizza and pasta is simply to die for.

Keep up the good work guys!

ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.author: Son Luong
ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.text:
My favorite pizza place — it’s always warm, lively, and full of good vibes whenever I drop by.
I always go for the half-half pizza with Quiet American and Fisherman toppings, plus the Madam Vy Signature salad — super filling! I still haven’t made it to the pasta menu because I just can’t give up my go-to combo.

Prices are reasonable, parking is free and easy.
Staff are friendly and attentive, and they’ve got a full range of chili sauces and condiments on the side.

ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.name: places/ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KZmVURm9aV3hGZG5CSVZHbG9URkZWWDNOaGIxRRAB

ChIJ85luhjMvdTERtglUwcrgS_A.text:
I had a really nice meal here ❤️ The “Meatball Spaghetti” was comforting and full of flavour - rich tomato sauce. The Pizza was spot on, and had a lovely balance. Thank you Team 🍕🍝
- Thursday, 05 June 2025 -

ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.text: This space is very special for those who want peace and good food in a shopping mall. It is worth enjoying the Italian delights handmade by the chef. I recommend all types of pizza because the dough is long-fermented.

ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.text:
It is clearly not a good Italian restaurant for western customers. however it is adapted to local taste, having some ideas from
p4p restaurant.

Price is reasonable but a bit more expensive than p4p, food taste is above average , not as good as pizza4P. Pizza dough is good tho.

ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.text: Beautifully freshly made pizzas with lots of flavor, we were really happy with what we ordered which was a meat lovers and a pepperoni, the staff were really friendly an overall was a great experience to come to this restaurant.

ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.author: Jason Stevenson
ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.text: We had a fantastic meal here for a really reasonable price. Their pizza is wood fired with fresh toppings, and the pasta was quite unique. Both were excellent. They have some great specials during the week, but the regular prices are still pretty good. Our server, Quy, did a wonderful job as well, being both knowledgeable and friendly. We will definitely be returning!

ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.name: places/ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzMExMRG9BRRAB
ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.author: Kathy Kharchenko
ChIJteY2_cEvdTER86yaXPJhpTw.text:
It looks like an expensive and nice restaurant based on furniture and vibe. But the service and food is awful. Appetizers get served with CHOLIMEX, on the picture there is a sauce. No plate, no cup, waiter just put a pack of cheapest sauce on our table.
Cheesesticks - awful, oily, bready, no flavor.

Ordered lasagna- after 20(!!) minutes of waiting they come to me and say they don’t have it.

We waited 30 minutes (!) for a salad that is supposed to be “recommended”. Salad came out with very fatty desssing, yet, flavorless. Leaves were soggy.

Chefs work with no gloves, touch cooked pizza with bare hands, even though gloves are next to the oven. Pizza is okay, but again, much much worse than other places.

Go to another pizza restaurant that has “4” in its name, it will be a million times better with similar price.

ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.author: Công Huy Vũ
ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.text:
Convenient Ordering, Decent Food

Pizza Hut Quận 5 offers a smooth and convenient dining experience with its QR code ordering system, making the process quick and hassle-free. The pizza takes about 15 minutes to be served, which is reasonable.

As for the food, the fried chicken is fairly average, nothing too special, but the vegetables are fresh, which adds a nice touch to the meal. Overall, it's a decent option for a casual meal with the added convenience of quick ordering.

ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.name: places/ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmbE5pdndnRRAB

ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.text: I am writing to thank you and your staff for the delicious food and the professional service. ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.author: Me Try
ChIJwydLKeQudTERYHKPm6OKQis.text: Don't have many deal. Staff are nice but the company needs to cut down on plastic. Pizza pesto (i can't remember well) is the best

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.name: places/ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0WFlsRjBXVEZzZVZjeFQyNUZSWEphU25OblYyYxAB
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.author: yumz
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.text:
pazzi pizza is lowkey hitting different for your pie cravings

THE PIZZA SITUATION
the slices here are an absolute serve for the price. way more affordable than those big name spots and honestly pretty fire for what you pay.

THE VIBE CHECK
the ambiance is next level with romantic date night energy. the whole space gives intimate cozy feels that absolutely hit different.

THE LOCATION QUEST
you gotta drive into a hem (alleyway) to reach this hidden gem. the search is part of the adventure but totally worth the hunt.

THE RESERVATION REALNESS
this place books up fast so make those reservations in advance. they stay consistently packed for a reason so don't sleep on planning ahead.

THE VALUE FLEX
getting quality pizza without the fancy price tag is lowkey clutch. your wallet and your taste buds will both be happy with this move.

THE FINAL VERDICT
if you want solid pizza in a romantic setting without breaking the bank, this spot is a total yes. just remember to book first

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.name: places/ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvelpHVVNBEAE
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.author: Quốc thảo Trương
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.text:
This is an honest first-time experience—no seeding, no prior booking.
1. I was genuinely impressed and pleasantly surprised by the flavors. The seasoning suited my taste perfectly. I normally don’t go for Western dishes because they don’t quite match my palate, but from the very first bite, it just clicked—it really worked for me as a Vietnamese diner.
2. A solid 10/10 for the staff—super attentive, intuitive, and friendly. Even with a full house, they remained helpful and welcoming throughout.
3.The ingredients were fresh beyond question, and I loved the open kitchen concept—it was great being able to see how the dishes were prepared
I absolutely loved the Creamy Mushroom Spaghetti and the blueberry soda.
Definitely coming back for more! Thanks

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.name: places/ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205Vk1teHBXRTh5UzJSYWFGaDFSRzFKV1Y4eGRFRRAB
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.author: Trang Trieu
ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.text:
came here for lunch and the place was literally burning hot 🥲imo the food didn’t really hit. we ordered the mortadella pizza, roast beef pizza, a caesar salad, a pasta (can’t remember which one), and a crème brûlée. not a fan of soft, doughy pizza, so it felt kinda undercooked to us 😭the texture just wasn’t it also the salad came with huge whole leaves which was super inconvenient to eat.
overall the meal was pretty mid but the prices are super cheap, and I’d definitely recommend checking out their location in D10 instead!

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.text: Such a little hidden gem! Me and my Italian husband absolutely loved the place, the food, and the staff. The pizza is cooked perfectly, and even the pasta is al dente! Reasonably priced also. Packed in the evenings, lunch time is easy ❤️

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.name: places/ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGc1VrTm1aRXhWWlY4NGJUQjFPVlk1UVZoWE5VRRAB

ChIJ9cikMBYpdTERudeagGyrM3E.text: honestly, i would to say that the steak here is extremely bad, it is like long standing frozen meat that brings us to eat, soft pizza the taste is very bland, salad is very bland too, the spaghetti is even more lighter than eating as not as good as the convenience store. ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.name: places/ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5bU1GSnBiek5oU21waFQzaE5XbkZwVTJGWFFWRRAB
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.author: Kimberly Reyes
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.text:
It was my first time dining at Pizza 4P’s near Ben Thanh Market and I had such a great experience. I ordered the Crab Tomato Spaghetti, the Sea Veg & Sake Martini, and the Creamy Pudding 💖 everything was delicious and worth the price. The ambience was cozy and welcoming, which made the whole meal even better.

A special shoutout to Quôc Huy 🥳, who really made the dining experience amazing!  He helped me choose the pasta, and when I ordered the drink, he made sure to let me know it was quite strong. After I finished it, he and another staff member checked on me to ensure I was okay and not feeling buzzed. As a solo female traveler, that level of care means so much. Their thoughtfulness and attention truly stand out.

I’ll definitely come back before I fly home in a few days, and I’ll make sure to visit again the next time I’m in Vietnam. Highly recommend! ☺️💖

ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.name: places/ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xWVlVaGtiMnhFYVdwdFMzTjBPRkp6UTJjM2FXYxAB
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.author: Kamil
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.text: It was a busy day but we got in after 20 mins (you write down your name and phone number and the staff calls you when it’s available so that you don’t have to stand there and wait). The staff was very nice and helpful every step of the process and really went out of their way to make sure we have everything we need and spoke good English. The food was very good, the staff made sure that it came in the order we asked for and that we had enough time between each meal. Each meal was delicious, the fresh pasta  in carbonara and quality ingredients were really standing out. The appetizer was refreshing and really set the mood for an amazing evening to come. Would definitely recommend the place.

ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.name: places/ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOTVNUZGhUV3hyUzBsRE1rUTFTRkYxU0U4MVlrRRAB
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.author: Joel Ng
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.text:
Very good prices and the food were all great.

The proscuito ham pizza is a must order for me. The ham was just salty enough and portion was sufficient, which was complimenting the burrata creating a flavorful palette. This was served on top of really thin crisp pizza which had the stone-baked taste embedded into each mouthful, together with the toppings which created the texture foundation for the flavors.
The crab pasta with the home made pasta is my suggested as well, the crab taste was not overpowering and just creamy enough to compliment the chewiness of the pasta. Definitely a taste I couldn't find elsewhere and worth a try if you are here

Tomato caprese was abit bland, could be more tangy. Soy beef pizza was ok as well. Parma ham wrapped with ricotta cheese was worth to try as well.

ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.name: places/ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xOT1dYQXlOV1ZHTldOdldsRXlVR3BoWjBGUE0yYxAB
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.author: Audrey Nadine
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.text:
Had a great dining experience at Pizza 4P’s! We absolutely loved the salad and the spicy seafood pasta — both were fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared.

What really made our visit even better was our server, Minh Nhat. He was very attentive, friendly, and always had a warm, genuine smile. His service made the whole meal feel extra special.

Highly recommend this branch — great food, great ambiance, and exceptional service. Will definitely be back!

ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.name: places/ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4S01YUlJjVkpVTm5oaGFWRndSalptYUVkS1NGRRAB
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.author: Sebastian Gilbert
ChIJfYtYmHkvdTERhCNHqNTzQ48.text: Delicious pizzas, lovely service and excellent cocktails. Despite arriving with no booking we were asked to join the electronic queue which had been gauged as 45 minutes but we received a call after 30 minutes which was plenty of time to enjoy a beer at Pasteur craft beer nearby. We were shown to our seats where another server recommended the new cocktails. I truly enjoyed the Sea Veg & Sake Mrtini and the Mekong Harvest Season. My partner wasn't sure which white wine to choose from that available and was even offered a taster to try. They even asked me for my thoughts at the end of the meal. Minh Nhat served us with a cute smile and attentive detail, refilling our waters whenever they were close to low. The unique selling point of the chain is their half and half pizzas where you can try more of their toppings. My partner enjoyed the camembert with ham + margherita. I went all in on the burrata parma ham margherita which did not hold back on the parma ham! Fortunately we only wanted pizza anyway but apparently there was a problem with the kitchen this night (2/12/2025) where no pasta and select salads were being served. Also, two white wines were not available.

Great pizza for a place in Saigon. The taste size and value are great.
We had the Seafood and a Pepperoni and sausage pizza, mozzarella sticks and dill pickles. We also had drinks. Highly recommend for something different.

Probably my favorite pizza in HCMC

ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.text: New York Jimmy is my new go-to pizza spot! The crust is that perfect balance of chewy and crispy, just the way New York–style pizza should be. Toppings are fresh, and the cheese is always gooey and delicious. The staff are super friendly, and the service is quick even when it’s busy. If you’re craving authentic New York–style pizza, this place really hits the mark. Highly recommend grabbing a slice!

ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.name: places/ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210elMxQjVNbmRsWVVocVNrVXdObmhJYmw5dUxYYxAB
ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.author: Geet F
ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.text: We tried Jimmy’s Pizza in D1 and ordered two large pizzas. The Buffalo Chicken Pizza was perfectly cooked with a nice base, but the buffalo sauce was overloaded with Tabasco so sour it was hard to eat. Next, we tried the Classic Cheese Pizza. Again, the crust and ingredients were great, but it had way too much tomato sauce and very little cheese, leaving only a sour tomato taste. After we complained, they offered to swap for a medium pizza, but we just asked them to add cheese. Overall, despite good cooking and quality ingredients, the flavors were poorly balanced. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on our experience.

ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.name: places/ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGSlpUbE5WekZMTXpNeFMzQmphREJRYlhGTFptYxAB

ChIJBzVs_0gvdTERvHlVkGGBUdI.text: I cant believe how delicious and quick the pizza arrived. It was perfectly created, cooked to a crispy crust below and above. Pizza and delivery exceeded my expectations and they were so quick to communicate about my order the whole way. It tastes even better than any pizza you can order from an American fast food chain. If youre craving pizza, THIS is the place to curb your hunger. Our pizza arrived so fresh and hot, with free delivery. I really enjoyed my experience from start to finish and it absolutely hits the spot ❤️ thank you jimmy !!

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.text: Very authentic Italian food. The pizza was perfect, nice crust, thin base, the burrata was creamy soft, really love their pizza. The Ceasar salad was good too. Restaurant located in small street so a bit difficult to get parking as it quite full of car. The service was fast and friendly.

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.name: places/ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJN2k4ZFRWbnM3b1FBEAE

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.text:
This is one of my favorite pizza places, always highly rated.
The pizza size is just right, not too big, and the side dishes are always tasty and consistently good. Never once disappointed!
The space is cozy with only a few tables, which makes it feel warm and inviting.
Service is quick and efficient.
Only downside: the outdoor seating can have a few mosquitoes.
Still, a solid choice every time.

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.text:
The pizza here is fantastic - we tried several kinds, and each one had that authentic Italian flavor that’s hard to find.

The staff seemed a bit unorganized at times, though it didn’t feel intentional - likely just busy.

It’s clearly a popular spot and often fully booked, so make sure to reserve a table in advance!

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.name: places/ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvdFlla0hBEAE
ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.author: Thọ Trương
ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.text:
Hidden in a quiet corner, this restaurant is truly a hidden gem.
The food is absolutely delicious, offering unique and memorable flavors.
Our family favorites were the Carbonara Pizza and the Truffle Spaghetti — both rich, flavorful, and perfectly crafted.
To end the meal, I treated myself to their decadent chocolate dessert topped with smooth vanilla ice cream — the perfect sweet finish to an exceptional dining experience.
Highly recommended for those who love discovering culinary treasures off the beaten path!

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.name: places/ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xjNWVrTlhTRmREYlZkWGEyWm9WRE4wU0hCMVRrRRAB

ChIJTxJYjEcvdTERZx08rXFC5kM.text: This is an authentic Italian restaurant, situated in the busy Phu My Hung residential area. The sauce was something else, something so different from all the pizza i have ever tasted in Vietnam, with a linger sweet aftertaste, which require no other sauces to enhance the experience. The desserts were also quite nice and my favourite is the affogato ice cream and tiramisu 😋 unfortunately i forgot to take a picture so you will have to trust me on this.

ChIJXZXe7k4ndTER-xebj7ADlwI.name: places/ChIJXZXe7k4ndTER-xebj7ADlwI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmbzllX0ZBEAE

Took over 30 minutes just to place the order. Even if this was better than mediocre pizza, it wouldn't be worth the trouble.

ChIJXZXe7k4ndTER-xebj7ADlwI.name: places/ChIJXZXe7k4ndTER-xebj7ADlwI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURIeDRDUzB3RRAB

ChIJXZXe7k4ndTER-xebj7ADlwI.text: I usually order on grab from this location, but their pizza and chicken today was so awful that it compelled me to write a Google review. And again, the pizza was cold so the cheese was solidified. The chicken, also cold, tasted very bready and starchy. Are you guys even trying anymore? Do you guys care? Doesn't seem like it.

So disappointed.  Dominoes near here was fresher and tastier.  Think I'll order from another pizza hut if I do order from them again.  Hopefully, this pizza hut location improves.

ChIJ-ac-S5UudTER0G9JTSPB0u0.text:
I'm only reviewing based on their Korean style fried chicken cause I didn't try their pizza oddly enough.

Anyways I was really surprised at how much I liked their fried chicken. It was really crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside with a sauce that wasn't too sweet but pretty flavorful. I didn't need the honey mustard sauce. I ordered the 2 piece but liked it enough that I ordered the spicey version to go and ate some of it over an hour later. Despite how much time had passed it still had a considerable crunch even with the sauce, and even the breast meat was still pretty juicy. Totally surprised and would actually recommend it.

The downsides was mainly the price is like US prices, but at the end I still paid for it. Also the watermelon tea was just ok, wouldn't get it again.

Some of the staff are friendly but management and others can sink the whole business. I will never give my hard earned money to this store ever again. Too many mistakes and wasted time to ever go back. I understand buy 1 get 1 night can be crazy and busy but......this store was not busy at 7:50 pm. I waited after the first mistake for 50 minutes to receive 2 cold old pizzas. I'll never return to this location again. Had a problem the last trip as well. Order Pizza Paolo or Em's Kitchen or Vittiorio Pizza or Paper Plate Pizza or Lamie Pizza or Lam Pizza or Jimmy's New York Pizza or 7 Bridges Pizza or Pizza and Bia. Dominos or Pizza crap Hut is better than this.

ChIJ-zv6zIkudTERcZn3OCkzhB4.text:
Found this Pizza Hut on the way back from Chinatown.  Overall, the food was delicious! We ordered chicken, pasta, and a large Meat Lover’s pizza. Prices were reasonable. They offer combo meals that include a variety of items, but it was a bit too much food for just the three of us—so we went with individual orders instead.

Surprisingly, the chicken was really good—crispy and flavorful, comparable to a dedicated chicken chain. The pizza was tasty too—not too heavy on the sauce and generously topped with meat.

The staff member who took our order was sweet and soft-spoken. We sat upstairs, enjoying our lunch while watching the busy street below and the people passing by. The upstairs bathroom was pretty clean. The music playing was a mix of Western and Vietnamese pop, adding to the laid-back vibe.

Overall, a great spot to chill and enjoy some Western comfort food. Definitely worth a try if you're in the area!

ChIJ7zkjTj4vdTER-yPQ9jwm88k.text:
I don’t understand why this place is so well rated

The pizza is pretty average I would say. The cheese quality is good, but the sauce is not very flavorful and the dough was undercooked.

Also, their business practices are very misleading. They say that pick up is 10% off and includes free sauce, but it’s not the sauce that you would get if you ordered it. It’s actually just a packet of ketchup and chili sauce.

Also, when I went to pay with Grab, they increased my price by 25% which coincidentally is the same as the Grab discount amount which I’m pretty sure is against their terms of service. If they’re willing to pay to advertise on Grab, it is very misleading that they would then shove that advertising cost onto the consumer.

I would not recommend this place to anyone.
