ChIJ-bnDrJMvdTERO0hAVlMauxo.text: I had to change my 3 stars to a 5 stars this place has improved. I see they're really going out of their way to make sure the customers satisfied. I noticed a lot of places charge you when you change something or add something extra it's always a headache. Not with pizza inn they just get it done. The cheese crust pizza is very good for the price you pay its worth it.

ChIJ-bnDrJMvdTERO0hAVlMauxo.name: places/ChIJ-bnDrJMvdTERO0hAVlMauxo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURRejhtTTFnRRAB
ChIJ-bnDrJMvdTERO0hAVlMauxo.author: Nguyet Nguyen
ChIJ-bnDrJMvdTERO0hAVlMauxo.text:
Small and hot. The service is too slow. We must wait for more than 15 mins to just have such pizza. The waiter are rude. While we are looking at the menu, he asked where will we sit, we responded him slow and heard his high tone, repeated his same question!
Nothing special with the food, the waiters and waitress were making more noise than the customers.

ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.name: places/ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205dFZVc3hhVkY2U25CSGVrSkdaWE5ZU2pFMmNGRRAB
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.author: Misa
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.text:
- Space: Quite small.
- Service: Good.
- Food: Delicious.
- Price: Reasonable.

The restaurant is quite small. It has an open-air concept, so it was a bit hot despite the fans and air conditioning.

The staff were quick and friendly, and the food arrived quite fast. I was very surprised by the quality of the food. The pizza was delicious and not dry at all, and the salad greens were very fresh. The portion sizes were generous. There were four of us, and we couldn't finish everything, so we asked the staff to pack the leftovers to go. They were very careful and polite when packing our food.

What really surprised us was how reasonable the price was for such high-quality food. This is definitely a place I would recommend to everyone for delicious pizza at a great price.

ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.name: places/ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRN2ZidlRnEAE
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.author: Benedek Krisztián Törőcsik
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.text:
A nice place with cool decor and friendly staff.
Mellow western music in the background.

I have tried their pepperoni pizza.
It's all right.

If you are from the UK, imagine your high street indian or arab pizza place. That would be the best comparison. Don't expect Italian level.
Although for around 4 quid, there is nothing wrong with it.

If you are staying in the area, like me, try it.

ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.name: places/ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuZ3BHOE1REAE
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.author: Justin Le
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.text:
My girlfriend and I stumbled upon this restaurant on Google Maps and decided to give it a try. The space is cute, clean, and tidy. Even though it wasn’t crowded, we had a very comfortable experience. The staff was friendly and sweet.

The food quality was good, and the prices were reasonable. We were pleasantly surprised at how great everything was for the price. We highly recommend this restaurant to everyone. Hopefully, more people will discover this gem!

ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.name: places/ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUX0lpUS1RRRAB
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.author: Carole A
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.text: Best price for value hands downs. I get one pizza per person. 115k with that stringy cheese, hot right out the oven and perfect crust. Obviously not a high end area and fancy AC but the pizzas, sides, drinks and staff totally win you over. And you even get a free pizza for 5 stamped pizzas.

ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.name: places/ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRbl9tazJRRRAB
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.author: Tim Hansen
ChIJ9Q4XMcwvdTERXKsKthdeRes.text: Great little place, hidden away in District 7. We had a pizza and egg salad, enough for 2 people unless you are really hungry. Will return 😊

ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.name: places/ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poYWFrMXZVMmRhTXpNMk56UjRRME53U1VWQk0zYxAB
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.author: Louis Slattery
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.text:
Easily the best pizza I've had in Vietnam and generally it's top tier. Nice thin crust, came out quickly, good dipping sauces, and friendly staff. Our party had a 3 year and a 6 month old and the staff made a big fuss.
I also love the decor, we sat outside but the red booths inside looked really cool.
Pizza selection was good, we did 3 medium for 4 people which was perfect.
10 out of 10, would go again.

ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.name: places/ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRenNqVTJRRRAB
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.author: Josiah Johnson
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.text: Perfect corner spot for a beer and some pizza for lunch or dinner. Beautiful park directly across the street with plenty of seating if you want to take it to go. Decent NewYork style pizza, (could have been cooked slightly longer to crisp the bottom of the crust.) Very nice atmosphere would highly recommend. 👌 Great music playing on the speakers while I was there! 🤙

ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.name: places/ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURva3M2bnlRRRAB
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.author: C Greene
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.text:
This is our favorite pizza spot in Ho Chi Minh City, hands down! Jimmy, the owner, and his family are incredible. They have a great relationship with their customers and go out of their way to make the experience worth it.

Every time I come, they inquire about my children, even the ones who've since moved back to our home country. For my youngest child's birthday, Jimmy himself gave my daughter and her friends full control over choosing the music that evening. The regular playlist has tons of old school music, and I love that!

The pizzas are big and flavorful, just like back home. The homemade blue cheese is fantastic. We love to get a side of Buffalo wings and mozzarella sticks with our order as well.

We've been coming to Jimmy's for 3 years now and will definitely come back for visits once we move out of Vietnam.

We pray this establishment continues to flourish for many years to come because it is the perfect atmosphere for bringing family and friends together.

ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.name: places/ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEdzlEX2ZBEAE
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.author: Red 6
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.text:
THE BEST authentic American style pizza I have tasted in HCM. We started with the mozzarella sticks and we knew we were in good hands. The marinara sauce was proper. If you zoom in on the crust of our supreme pizza you will see that it is 100% authentic. Every ingredient tasted like home/America. No shortcuts with local ingredients were taken. If you are a foreigner living here, you will appreciate these details.
I had the pleasure of speaking with Jimmy for a solid 15 minutes. He is a great guy and genuinely values and cares about the happiness of his customers. Jimmy was onsite to make sure everything was running right. As a result, everything was clean and service  was spectacular.
I give Jimmy’s Pizza in D7 my highest recommendation.

Update. Been back twice and ordered the same thing. That is how good it is. My wife is addicted to the fried mozzarella sticks.
We even tested the delivery. Excellent service. All aspects are consistently outstanding.

We were adventurous and tried half inferno half bbq chicken. Both were outstanding. Everything we have tried is great.

ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.name: places/ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPcHRLQTRBRRAB
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.author: Dr Barry Burris
ChIJI1BFKuwldTERIemFz15TmJ8.text: Most delicious New York–style pizza I’ve eaten in this part of the world. The pizza had a characteristically large hand-tossed thin crust. The crust was thick and crisp along its edge, yet soft, thin, and pliable enough beneath the toppings to be folded in half to eat. The owner, Jimmy was welcoming and it was obvious that he has a passion for creating a quality pie! Looking forward to my next visit.

ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.name: places/ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25wVWFYWm1kMWwxU25oa2RFczBZV3N5WWt0WlRsRRAB
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.author: yumz
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.text:
pizza 4p's is bringing the elevated pizza experience to phú mỹ hưng

THE QUALITY EATS
the food here absolutely hits different. we're talking fresh, thoughtfully sourced ingredients that come together in dishes that taste as good as they make you feel.

THE CHILI OIL SITUATION
don't sleep on their signature chili oil. that tangy, spicy kick is an absolute serve and takes every slice to the next level. it's the kind of condiment you'll wish you could bottle up.

THE PRACTICAL PERKS
the wet naps at every table are lowkey genius. no more messy fingers when you're diving into that perfect cheesy crust.

THE PHÚ MỸ HƯNG VIBES
this location brings that polished neighborhood energy with its sleek interior and reliable service. it's the kind of spot that just gets it right.

THE FINAL CALL
if you're chasing quality pizza with ingredients that actually deliver, this place is a total yes. that chili oil alone is worth the trip.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.name: places/ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21GNlVuazBTVUpXU200eWRteEdNM28wUmpSYVkzYxAB
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.author: Hanh Nguyen
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.text:
One of my all-time favorite pizza places in Vietnam! The quality is consistently excellent, from the homemade burrata and fresh mozzarella to the perfectly baked, thin-crust pizzas. Every bite feels like a treat.

The service is professional, attentive, and always friendly – they really know how to make you feel welcome. I also love how the space is designed: cozy yet modern, perfect for both casual meals and special occasions.

Highly recommend trying the Four Cheese Pizza with honey – it’s an unforgettable combo. And don’t skip dessert! Their tiramisu is top-notch.

A must-visit if you’re in Vietnam. Consistently great food, great service, great vibes.

ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.name: places/ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21oUmRVNWtlRVIwUVU5Tk1sWXdTRkZGZEVjdGNXYxAB
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.author: Tram Huynh
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.text: Pizza 4P’s never disappoints! Their pizzas are incredibly tasty, thanks to the high-quality cheese that really sets them apart. The flavors are unique and never feel boring like other brands. I always order the burrata fruit salad as a side—it elevates the whole meal. The service is attentive and professional. It’s a popular spot, so I highly recommend booking in advance. A must-visit for pizza lovers!

ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.name: places/ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWQk9YcEpYM0p6WjFoTGRXWTJZbGhCTURaVVZVRRAB
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.author: ellie magalona
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.text: I’m happy to know that they use locally sourced ingredients. All the food we ordered tastes great. Their interiors are very nice and have sections for a more private space. We have a table reservation and were seated upon arrival.

ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.name: places/ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SWmJGUnNPR0ZmYlhWWVFuRkhjMjV6YVdST1VIYxAB
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.author: Eddy
ChIJ5_KFG48vdTERXQaGkFmJG18.text: Absolutely wonderful and flawless. If you ever have a date in Ho Chi Minh City, this place is an absolute must-visit!

ChIJG3MEr_4ldTER_ahDgLopQK4.text: It’s a pizza chain based in Thailand, and it has the distinction of being the only place in Sài Gòn that I’ve found which makes a true thin crust pizza. ChIJG3MEr_4ldTER_ahDgLopQK4.text: Great pizza. We had a small error with our chicken. The staff was very helpful and resolved the issue perfectly.

ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.author: Sean Yam
ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.text: Their pizza is really delicious—the crust is soft and thin, and the toppings are rich and flavorful. They offer a wide variety of pizzas. I’ve already been here two days and tried six different types, and every single one was tasty. The Spicy Garlic Shrimp is my absolute favorite. Besides pizza, they also serve other dishes, but they’re not as good as the pizza. The dining environment is quite upscale, and the staff are patient and attentive when explaining the menu. Definitely worth recommending.

ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.name: places/ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvek42b0FnEAE
ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.author: Tony Ong
ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.text: Our family had a pleasant experience tonight at this location. The food was excellent and the service was top notch. Unfortunately, almost lost a star for us because we thought one of our appetizers were forgotten about possibly? On a typical night where it wasn’t super busy, there didn’t seem to be a logical reason for it to come out after our appetizers and our main meals. Although, when it did come out, it was very good. It was resolved at the end of our dinner when they showed us their system malfunctioned, so understandably not their fault. Our waiters( I believe her name was Kim Nguyen and I didn’t get the others name.) were lovely and very kind to deal with. They were on top of our service and would like to thank them for a pleasant experience.

This is probably the best Pizza 4P experience I’ve had, and all my guests agreed.

We want to shout out the lovely Ai Hiep who served us. She was so attentive and caring it made our dining experience so easy yet special. ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.author: Tam Nguyen
ChIJhW-BZPovdTERICMrDx-0L7s.text: My family had lunch here on National Day. I reserved a table the same morning (definitely a must because they're almost always packed) and we were seated immediately. We ordered a full parma ham pizza, half and half salmon miso + seafood spicy tomato sauce. These pizzas are well made and delicious, probably on the same level with the pizzas my mom and I had in Italy so we were delighted. The price isn't cheap (especially on holidays with the extra service fee), so this is definitely a place for special celebrations.

ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws.author: Bách Hữu Tuấn Trần
ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws.text:
I’ve dined at several Pizza Company branches, but my experience at the Crescent Mall location was extremely disappointing.
The issue wasn’t the food—it was the staff. They were noticeably impolite and unprofessional, giving off the impression that they had no interest in serving customers.

When I first entered the restaurant, the staff only began cleaning a table for me after I arrived. Once seated, it took a long time before anyone came to take my order, and even then, the attitude was sluggish and indifferent. This was especially surprising given how empty the restaurant was and how many staff members were present.

Additionally, I couldn’t understand why the food took so long to arrive. I’m not sure if the management here pays attention to customer feedback, but I’ve seen other reviews also complaining about poor service.

Unfortunately, this is one branch I would not recommend for dining.

ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws.name: places/ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5WmFqbHliekJsU25wVU5pMXhNVFJaZG1oSE0xRRAB
ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws.author: Mỹ Trần
ChIJs1Gsou8vdTERfpoaQiENpws.text:
Service: Extremely disappointing.
I ordered three dishes — pasta, a Mexican sandwich, and a salad. The pasta plate was visibly broken into a large piece but was still served as-is. The salad, which I ordered first, didn’t arrive until I had nearly finished the two main dishes. It only came after my mother had to ask about it.

To make matters worse, when the salad was finally brought out, the waiter spilled part of it but made no effort to replace the spilled portion or even ask if I wanted it redone. All he said was, “I’m sorry,” and then returned to the kitchen, laughing and joking with staff as if nothing had happened.

This branch clearly needs serious retraining on both customer service and food service procedures — particularly the proper order in which dishes are served. Without urgent improvement, I don’t see how this location can operate successfully in the long run.

This is meant as constructive feedback, but I will definitely not be returning to this branch.

Today, we ordered pizza from local Domino’s to our hotel, and the experience exceeded our expectations. The pizza arrived in less than 25 minutes—earlier than anticipated.

Since we don’t speak Vietnamese, we used the app to place our order. The pizza shop promptly contacted us to request our phone number, ensuring they could notify us when the driver was en route. The staff was incredibly efficient, kind, and helpful throughout the process.

We ordered a pizza, chicken wings, a potato wedges combo, and a few drinks. Food was delivered hot and tasted delicious. The delivery driver was polite and professional.

We were particularly impressed by how well the staff communicated with us in English, which made the ordering process smooth and stress-free. I would definitely recommend this Domino’s location for their excellent service and great food.

ChIJb4fniyovdTERS_mlwySwCwg.text:
Last night, I had the pleasure of dining at The Pizza Company, located beside Ramana Hotel Saigon in District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. I tried their Pasta Shrimp Rose, and it truly exceeded my expectations. The dish was beautifully presented, with a rich, creamy sauce and perfectly cooked shrimp that complemented the pasta wonderfully.

The ambiance of the restaurant is clean and comfortable, making it an ideal spot for people who enjoy pizza, pasta, and a good selection of drinks. The seating arrangement allows for a relaxed dining experience, whether you’re visiting solo, with friends, or family.

What impressed me most, aside from the food, was the attentiveness of the staff. They were polite, welcoming, and well-versed in English, which made communication smooth and enjoyable. Their service added to the overall pleasant experience of the evening.

Overall, The Pizza Company offers a great combination of tasty food, friendly service, and a cozy environment. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to enjoy a quality meal in District 3. It’s a solid choice for casual dining in Ho Chi Minh City.

dough might be a tad off, but the crust is that perfect combo of chewy and crisp, the sauce is tangy fire, and the cheese pull is everything. their caramelized onion & bacon situation is lowkey illegal. sweet, smoky, and actually to die for. it's the kind of spot that just gets it right, no cap.

an absolute must-try for pizza purists and anyone tired of overcomplicated pies.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJa_eSqOYvdTER4tHifsm8qv0.author: Marika Sorichetti
ChIJa_eSqOYvdTER4tHifsm8qv0.text:
Pizza 4P’s is hands down the best Italian restaurant experience you can have in Vietnam.
I visited the one in Ho Chi Minh City (though they also have locations in Hanoi), and I can confidently say it’s the best Italian food I’ve had outside of Italy.

The restaurant is clean, modern, and has a welcoming vibe that makes you want to stay. The staff, while speaking limited English, are extremely kind, attentive, and efficient—you really feel looked after.

Now the food… incredible. I highly recommend the cheese platter—authentic, creamy, and full of Italian flavor. As for the pizza, I ordered one with two flavors: zucchini and margherita. Both were delicious, with fresh ingredients and the perfect crust.

A nice surprise: water is included and refilled, something rare in Vietnam. Prices are also very reasonable: two pizzas, a beer, and the cheese platter came to around 30€ total, which is excellent for the quality you get.

One important tip: make sure to book your table in advance.
All locations are very popular and almost always full—walk-ins are rarely successful.

I especially recommend their buy-one-get-one-free pizza event every Wednesday! You get two pizzas for the same price, making it a great value. It was a great meal that really lifted my spirits.

If you're looking for pizza in Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend a visit to Estelera Pizza Company.

Estelera Pizza Company Review

I've previously been to Pizza Company in An Phu, but this time I visited Estelera Pizza Company. The atmosphere was clean, and the pizza was safe but enjoyable enough for anyone. It's a great place to come with family, friends, or a significant other, as it sticks to the basics without being too pushy.

I especially recommend their 1+1 pizza event, which takes place every Wednesday! Being able to eat both plates for the same price was truly great value. It was a meal that even made me feel good.

If you're looking to enjoy pizza in Ho Chi Minh City, Estelera Pizza Company is a must-visit.

My Russian friend visited Vietnam for the very first time and he said he loves this place, special the mushroom soup come up with his mom’s dishes.
I hope they add pumpkin soup to menu again.
Recommend you the shrimp pizza and Bac Xiu coffee, Kombucha.

ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw.name: places/ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2cTlfM2lBRRAB

ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw.text: Ordered a half classic cheese & half pepperoni. First of all, there was loaded tomato sauce hidden below the cheese and it wasn't warned in the menu. Apparently, it's not like the usual half and half pizza - they did it the easy way and made the whole pizza with the same base then added some pepperoni. And tbh, even the pepperoni was flavourless, just salty...Staff were nice tho. That one extra star is for them

ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw.name: places/ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNBdnYyUmJnEAE
ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw.author: Sean O Cillín
ChIJd2McRfondTERn6hc6vXpjGw.text:
I’ll try and keep this short as I’ve wasted enough time already.

This place is not going to last unless serious attention is given to staff training.
I was left sitting there for 30 minutes and when I questioned my order, I was told it was burnt and they were doing it again at the 25 minute marker.

Someone should’ve said something at least,  because that put me late for my next appointment and the Snowball continues.

I’m sitting in one of four booths.
The waitress is so busy chatting that she does not notice a group of three which she had to move out of the way for so they could go in and fill the last empty booth.
She never even brought the menus.

On a number of occasions they try to get her attention, but she was so focused on chatting, that they failed.

Then I was shocked to see that they went online on each of their phones and looked at the menu while she was chatting,
Clever and smart but should never happen.

I was furious about this on top of my 40 minute wait at this point, I yelled out to the horror of everyone else and pointed at the table and made her realized at least give the menus.

The youth of today don’t care and when you put your new expensive precious business in their hands, all I can say is good luck.

I’ve also noticed that only positive reviews here get a response, that’s a little weird isn’t it?
And because of that, it makes my care factor even less.

There’s too much competition around to look like you don’t care.

🍕🍕🍕🍕🍕🍕
I don’t know how to make a new review so I’m just gonna add on here and hopefully that works.

After my last experience, I was pretty convinced I would not return but a friend of mine reminded me I promised I would bring them there, so I did return two days later.
I have to say I was absolutely stunned at the turnaround and the difference in customer service in that short period of time.
Clearly, my words were heard and I don’t say that in a way that it’s all about me because as a business owner myself, I know the investment and what’s on the line and I am so happy that I will assume “Jimmy” took action and made a difference and an absolute monstrous difference in the customer service, which was instantly noticed.

I did always say that the food was 10 /10, and now the customer service matches it.

Is this my new favorite place?
Absolutely without a doubt, because the food matches the service which matches the atmosphere and collectively it’s perfect.
Thank you Jimmy for your responding to my review and take an action.  👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽

ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.name: places/ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGcWRrNVdVV3hOU2s5SVF6WkphVTFpZVZKVFZsRRAB
ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.author: Joe L
ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.text:
I really liked that this place felt very western. I’ve been missing my pizza and burgers from back in the States, and Napoli Pizza gave me that feeling like I took a little trip out of Vietnam just for dinner. The music and overall vibe made me feel at home. Service was super friendly, and I was able to speak English comfortably with the staff, which I really appreciated.

As for the food — I think I made a mistake adding burrata to my pizza. It came out cold (the center was still a bit frozen), and the moisture from the cheese soaked into the crust, so it lost its crisp. I’ve since learned burrata is supposed to be served cool, but not that cold — so that’s partly on me for overloading toppings. I could still tell the pizza itself was legit though; I was born and raised in New York, so I know a decent pizza when I see one.

The seafood pasta was easily my favorite dish of the night, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The burger, on the other hand, wasn’t really for me. The bun was crisp and a bit tough, and I personally prefer mine softer. But to be fair, I was the one ordering a burger at a pizza spot, so that’s on me too.

Overall, I’d definitely visit again, just skip the burger/sandwiches and the burrata on pizza. I’m looking forward to trying their pizza again with a simpler topping combo next time!

ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.text: The staff is nice trying their best to make you happy but unfortunately the food isn't as good as the reviews and my expectations. The burrata tomato salad disappointed me so much, the tomato is the one I buy for 5k from the local market on that street, and they charged me for 195k. Pumpkin gnocchi feel like marshmallow without any taste and no sugar. Last but not least mosquito is everywhere they bite my legs and butt. Pineapple juice has no ice, like come on !?!!?! Eventho they gave me the pineapple for free but honestly this meal isn't worth it, speaking of the food quality, location (big containers pass by every 5 mins, super outskirts of HCM) and atmosphere. Not sure if the 5 stars review down there are authentic or this is their first time eating Italian food, the chef and manager should be ashamed of their work.

ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.name: places/ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6eHIyWFd3EAE
ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.author: M
ChIJj6KWS1QndTEROTV779uM6GM.text:
I ordered delivery, so I don't know what it's like inside. I also ordered through the website instead of Grab because the menu is slightly different. I couldn't find burgers on Grab.

The large pizza is a US medium in terms of size, but the quality is pretty good; more of an artisan type dough/bake. I tried the Turkish Lamb, which had some seasoning compared to the lamb burger. There wasn't a lot of cheese, so I would have ordered extra cheese had I known. Even though I didn't love it, I felt it was a good pizza. I probably would have liked one of the other ones more. I had half the next day, and it tasted equally good reheated. 205K for a medium 250K/$9.80 for the large.

The lamb burger was done/well done. It wasn't very juicy, a little dry. The meat tasted gamey (like it should), but it wasn't a great lamb burger in opinion. However, just like the pizza, I feel it's pretty high quality, especially considering the price. Some of the better burger shops around usually cost 250K+ per burger.

They didn't have gorgonzola cheese, so they called to ask if I wanted a different one. Knowing my name wasn't Vietnamese, the guy spoke to me in English - which was nice. I believe I settled for brie. 160K/$6.30 for the lamb burger plain + 40K for cheese. It did come with a few fries, separately.

I will try a calzone next time.

The delivery guy also spoke English, if not the same guy. 30K/$1.20 delivery charge to Vinhomes.

ChIJ_zP6aacpdTER3w1f2AvB9-c.author: lieschen 288
ChIJ_zP6aacpdTER3w1f2AvB9-c.text:
We came in the afternoon, when barely anyone was in the restaurant. They greeted us warmly and left us to choose from the various choices on the (english) menu first, which was very well structured, before coming over and taking our order. The lady was very nice and could speak a bit of English as well.
Our food came fairly quickly and tasted very good. My Chicken-Mushroom-Macaroni bake was delicious and the cheesy garlic bread is also very tasty, would definitely recommend. There were only a couple of small things that could have been done better. For one, the portions are too small. If you are hungry, you need to order at least two meals. The creamy mushroom pasta could do with a bit more sauce, the pizza was very thin and the Lipton Mojito Tea was a bit too sweet for our taste, but otherwise alright.
They play upbeat music sang specifically for Pizza Company (made for a good laugh) and decorated the room nicely for Halloween. It might have been a tiny bit too cold for me, but at least they have an AC.
I think it's a good restaurant with reasonable prices and various combo deals.

ChIJfbqr0s0odTERc8lpac0CYGE.name: places/ChIJfbqr0s0odTERc8lpac0CYGE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMyM01yeG1BRRAB
ChIJfbqr0s0odTERc8lpac0CYGE.author: Ky-Anh Lê-Hoàng
ChIJfbqr0s0odTERc8lpac0CYGE.text:
I was extremely disappointed. It's not very bad but it's not good either.

It started with the Kir. It was not cold and too sweet using bad sparkling wine. We should have known from there that the rest of the meal would be underwhelming.

I had the steak tartar. While the meat was good, you need to ask for more capers and stuff to make your own mix. The bread they gave me was so bad! It was hard bread crackers, while they could have properly toasted the baguette-like bread they had available instead. Furthermore, it didn't come with butter either. I had to ask for it, and they gave me Vietnamese sweetened margarine. I'm not even sure they washed the eggshell before putting it directly on the meat (as shown on the picture). I could have gotten salmonella. That was outright disgusting... 🤮

Otherwise, the second dish was lamb and it was way overcooked. Lamb should never be well-done but medium-rare! A huge letdown 🤦🏻‍♂️

The price was not as cheap as the sign says. I found the price to be pretty average for the quality. You get much, much better food for the same price at Cocotte.

The service was Vietnamese and they were clueless about how French food should be eaten. I'm from Europe, so I am pretty picky here. The place itself looks so kitsch, but it is spacious.

Too many missteps here, wasting my time and money. I can't give more than 2 stars. I didn't see any foreigners eating there. This place is really for Vietnamese across the board.

If you're a westerner, do yourself a huge favor and avoid this place at all cost!

ChIJbYNofhYmdTERpA1r9Y3mb6U.name: places/ChIJbYNofhYmdTERpA1r9Y3mb6U/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdDV5OEJBEAE
ChIJbYNofhYmdTERpA1r9Y3mb6U.author: Mark Ong
ChIJbYNofhYmdTERpA1r9Y3mb6U.text:
Not in plain sight , was recommended by locals. Well rounded french restaurant that I willing part my cash on the indulgence.  A detailed breakdown of my experience is as follows:

Bread is crumbly , warm n crisp
Butter mild.  Lightly salted.

Egg scrambled with truffles is rather meh.  Runny scrambled with way too coarse pepper.  Giving individual a chock on the throat. No very distinctive truffle taste. Only a little well cooked mushroom bits on it.

Appetizer of lobster n asparagus
Foam sauce is great, multi level of taste anchor with lobster umami
Asparagus could be more crisp 😁  bite.  Love the caramelised onion. Well done.
Lobster is filled with favour and wholesome bite.
Palet cleanser of lemon sorbet is light in favour yet distinct acidic kick.  A change of taste of the plum assorted give it another elevated level of balance.
Main
Beef cheek with fore gas . Fantastic.
Bater beef cheek give off a excellent crisp in contrast with it's inner softness.  Fore gas is crisp yet not overpowering fatty.  Mash potatoes is semi mash with bits of unmash inside giving it an additional texture. Sauce on its on mild bitter but the combination of all 3 is perfect.

House pour red flowery sweet.  Spice end.

Cheese mild cream cheese with assorted toppings. On the sour side. Olive was a nice combination but overall nothing impressive.
Additional strong cheese give much more kick . Leathery textured and taste of cured fish.

Dessert pear was lovely done.  Mild sugary sweetness with fruity after taste. Pair with congac is perfect. Bringing our the oak favour of the spirit. Vanilla ice cream is smooth and rich.  Almond provided is roast to smoky . Dark chocolate sauce is bringing a balance to the dishes.

Overall a good experience, not to much patron is a good thing too.

ChIJH64Mv8QodTERh6dbPMQNgIg.author: Ashley T.
ChIJH64Mv8QodTERh6dbPMQNgIg.text:
Lovely vegetarian restaurant. Highly recommend for literally everyone because this place is worth the try.

Space: big restaurant with 2 floors. Lots of seating choice. The ambience is warm, kind and cosy with the dimmed orange lights (which is spot on for me who doesn't light extra bright white lights). Seatings are comfy. Tables are big and weren't placed literally an arm length from one another.

Food: scrumptious food with lots of choices. Well seasoned, well balance, not too oily. The tofu was a but salty but it was supposed to be paired with rice so no complaint. Their signature rice is great, i could feel the herbaceous aftertaste which was my fave part. Stir fried was fresh. Their spring rolls were super super good, gooey yam fillings. Fried wonton could be improved though since it was a little too flat, there was no volume to the shape, texture while the fillings was spot on. Ice tea is free fyi.

Price: super affordable. We had a big meals with 5 dishes or so and it costed 210k, which came to our surprise despite the prices were already listed in the menu lol. It just felt like we ate a lot, that's why.

Parking: a bit chaotic since you just park wherever at the fron gate and the security guard would handle the rest. Also, the guard was extremely helpful and polite, this man needs a raise!

Overall, such a pleasant experience. Defo coming back to try out more.

ChIJK-0nejQvdTER4MqqlNWadoE.author: KellyNguyen
ChIJK-0nejQvdTER4MqqlNWadoE.text:
Our family recently celebrated a birthday at this restaurant, and it turned out to be such a beautiful and heartwarming experience. From the moment we stepped inside, the atmosphere brought us back to the feeling of a small French countryside restaurant — warm, intimate, and full of charm. It almost felt like being transported elsewhere, only without the crisp, cool air of Europe.

The food was prepared with care, adapted slightly for Vietnamese tastes, yet it still carried the soul of timeless European flavors. Every dish evoked a sense of nostalgia, reminding us of old memories and the essence of Western cuisine that once flourished in old Saigon. It wasn’t just about eating — it was about reliving moments of childhood, of family gatherings, of stories passed down through generations.

What touched us most was not only the flavors on the plate, but also the way the whole experience brought us together as a family. It felt meaningful, almost poetic, and made the birthday celebration truly unforgettable.

If you are looking for a place that combines delicious food, heartfelt ambiance, and a touch of nostalgia, this restaurant is definitely worth visiting

ChIJiyNONr0vdTERM5lFM_87sgk.text:
Le Monde Steak is a complete disappointment. The meat I was served was grey, soft, and tasted exactly like the reconstructed beef I’ve had before — definitely not proper steak. They advertise it as “premium, high-end French-style steak,” but what you actually get is a low-quality cut that doesn’t even resemble real beef. The texture was off, the flavour was bland, and it left me wondering what I was actually eating.

If you’re expecting an actual steakhouse experience, don’t waste your money here spend another 100k and get a real steak. There are far better places in Saigon that serve real imported beef.

Sides and atmosphere are good but I’m sure this steak isn’t high end import steak cuts.

ChIJubktZfMvdTER5B19MiTkJrk.text:
My Favorite Hidden Restaurant in Saigon 🍷🍜

Honestly, I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve eaten at La Maison since 2014—it’s just that good. Tucked away in a quiet alley off Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa Street in District 3, this charming little gem feels like a mini escape every time I return.

The vibe? Super cozy and intimate, like dining at a stylish friend’s home. The space radiates the same warm, positive energy as the owner. And the staff? Absolutely wonderful—attentive, friendly, and helpful from the moment you book a table to the very last bite of dessert. Truly top-tier service.

The food? You can taste the passion and expertise in every dish. It’s a flawless fusion of French elegance and Vietnamese soul. And the drinks? I don’t know what kind of magic they’re working behind the bar, but I’m officially obsessed.

Honestly, I keep thinking La Maison deserves to be Michelin Selected. I’m genuinely surprised it hasn’t been recognized yet. Fingers crossed that changes soon—they’ve more than earned it.

PS: La Maison never misses. I’m already looking forward to my next visit—probably way sooner than I should admit. 😄

ChIJZ15KYTEvdTERxWiAWc4Y12I.name: places/ChIJZ15KYTEvdTERxWiAWc4Y12I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SWk1tTmlPSEY0TVU1TGIyRlZaMDFmVHpJemJWRRAB
ChIJZ15KYTEvdTERxWiAWc4Y12I.author: Angelo III Evangelista
ChIJZ15KYTEvdTERxWiAWc4Y12I.text:
My fifth son was born on May 10, 2025, in Saigon, Vietnam. When we applied for his birth certificate at the District 7 People’s Committee, they gave us one with the nationality section left blank. They also insisted he must have a Vietnamese name, saying it’s the rule. But this confused us, our second son is a Vietnamese citizen and has a non-Vietnamese name on his documents.

We were disappointed. Our son has the right to Vietnamese nationality, and as parents, we should be free to name our child. Some people say these offices act this way because they expect bribes, a sign of corruption.

Recently, the national government made a law clearer: children of a Vietnamese and a foreign parent can have a foreign name. So my wife returned to request the correction. But the same staff refused again and told her to go to the Department of Justice.

At the Justice Department, the staff was raising voice maybe to intimidate my wife, saying he served 15 years and he will never be wrong. He claimed such a birth certificate should not exist, indirectly blaming District 7. He told my wife to go back and just agree to give the child a Vietnamese name and denounce his other nationality, saying, “It’s just a name". He dismissed her and called the next customer.

But if names “don’t matter,” why deny a foreign name? Names do matter, they reflect identity, culture, and family decisions. It is the parents’ right to choose a name, Vietnamese or not. Maybe these people who say it is just a name, they won't bother them if them or their children or loved ones will be called names they do not like.

So the real question is: why are local offices not following the national law? Even in a communist country, shouldn’t government officials obey the laws from above? Ignoring national law is a form of lawlessness, and corruption, worser a treason.

What’s worse, those who speak up for their rights may be labeled as troublemakers, while those in power who break the law face no consequences.

This also causes confusion abroad. My wife’s name, for example, has caused issues in foreign systems due to duplication or mix-ups. If the government encourages people to have both a Vietnamese and a foreign name, it opens the door to identity problems, even crime. It’s not a safe or wise system.

Department of Justice but serving citizens injustice.

ChIJZ15KYTEvdTERxWiAWc4Y12I.text:
At the time I wrote this review, I couldn't do the Criminal Record check online so I had to do it the offline way.

Didn't have much high hope of the whole government procedure, but turned out I was somewhat amazed on how quickly and pleasant my experience was.

However, the prerequisites to have such experience would be (1) be there early, not on time because the queue might be hectic, and (2) make sure you bring all the necessary documents/POI/whatever you have to do what you want.

I went there 1st in the morning at 10AM, didn't even get a chance to queue up because the Parking security told me so, and I believed him (had to). So I went back there early at around 1PM, the queue was average, and people walked in peacefully, no hassle. I got my reservation ticket at around 1:10PM, and finally the whole thing happened to me in just 30 minutes of waiting. So basically I could finish all that before 2PM.

I just hope that they could have made the Online procedure ready because surely I don't want the people to just go through what I've been through, as most people are busy with life.

Hope this review is useful to someone out there.

P/S: this is an independent review, based on my personal experience, different experience for you may vary.

ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.author: Daniel Tee
ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.text:
Tried the discovery set for two, it was decent overall. The chef’s compliments were a nice touch, and the duck confit stood out as one of the highlights. While the meal was good, there weren’t many dishes that truly impressed or surprised.

As for the atmosphere, what you see in the photos and videos is exactly what you get - a small, cozy compound with a simple setup, not much in the way of grandeur.

The staff, however, were easily the best part of the experience - friendly, engaging, and professional while keeping things light and fun.

All things considered, for the price point, it’s a bit hard to recommend - especially when restaurants like Truffle at Landmark 81 offer a more elevated dining experience for around the same cost. Still, if you’re after a quiet and intimate spot with good food and great service, this place is worth a visit.

ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.author: Ray Sim
ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.text:
My food rating guide:
2.5/5 ‐-------> Average taste
5/5 ‐--------> Scrumptious! (My comfort food! 🤩)

My 2nd visit. By chance I was there 8 years ago and had been wating for the opportunity to return. It was as impressive if not more.

Fresh and high quality ingredients. Superlative taste. Individual ingredient taste was pronounced, yet created an excellent symphony of taste when came together. Could literally taste the heart, thought, passion and love of the chef behind the creation.

The Alaskan black cod fish (US) in thyme and rosemary butter chanterelles, seashell and beetroot jus emulson, Blue Brittany lobster (FR) riso black truffle, sea urchin jus, and Bood Orange sorbet with Grey Goose vodka (FR) were the creme de la creme in Menu Privilege.

The breads and butter were heavenly.

The strawberry, pineapple, and apple jam were scrumptious.

The Le souffle poire et chocolat 70% was overshadowed by the preceding dishes. It was good per se, but got cloying after a few mouths.

The complimentary macaroons, tarts, and éclairs were a mismatch. Appreciate the gesture, but it did ruffle the overall taste sensation.

Their wine menu was huge! I got lost in it for about 10 mins 😆

The service was top notch. New set of cutlery for each dish. Crumbs cleaned off the table timely. Warm, friendly, and polite services from the staffs.

Love the ambience. Not overly serious for a fine dining setting. Smart casual dress code. It had a warm family/closed friends vibe amid the fine dining ambience.

The overall experience was a 4.8/5

ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.name: places/ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5eWRFcEJSVkJSZFZORlJFb3RTMnRqV25NMWNGRRAB
ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.author: Jose Latour
ChIJI9kl2-8udTERM0Vd5pSDQWA.text:
Our client wanted an elegant dinner for his last night in Saigon and we decided to go to La Villa, to which we had never been before.   While La Villa's excellent reputation is common knowledge, its high-end French cuisine comes at prices one would expect in a major U.S. or European city...as in WAYYYYYY more expensive than virtually any other restaurant in Vietnam.

Four of us dined there last night and the experience was, in a word, sublime.  Located in a beautiful colonial French villa in District Two, you pass a beautiful courtyard to enter into a grand dining room with a magnificent staircase, stunning decor, and impeccable service.  Since the client was leaving on an early flight today, the intriguing Set Menus were not an option, but instead went a la cart, ordering appetizers and a main.

Before the appetizers came, we were treated to a sequence of canapes and amuse bouches, all original, beautiful, and  delicious.  A delicate shrimp tartare was followed by an chilled tomato gazpacho topped with a little scoop of basil sorbet.  But the big winner was the "Micro Burger" (see photo), a delightful little beef burger resting on a bed tiny grilled onions and snuggled into a tiny little brioche bun...we're talking about a 1 square inch masterpiece with the flavor profile somewhere between a classic Castle burger and Robuchon's Le Burger (sans the fois gras.)  Serious stuff.

The appetizers continued to impress and my Hokkaido Scallop carpaccio topped with a perfectly seared fois gras was superb.  But next time, I'm ordering the Irish Crab and Osetra caviar appetizer my partner ordered...absolutely the most original, delicious, and decadent seafood appetizer I may have ever tasted (they fly the live crabs in from Ireland!)  The briny bursts of the Osetra eggs punctuate the crisp, clean, delicate flavor of the Irish crabmeat.  Appetizers were followed by a refreshing palate cleanser consisting of home made kumquat sorbet floating in a small pool of white rum...a deconstructed daiquiri of sorts (I know this because I am Cuban (-; )

By the time the entrees arrived, we were already quite satisfied from all the small bits and appetizers but they too did not disappoint: the Black Angus tenderloin was perfectly executed, the Satsuma wagyu melt-in-your-mouth, and my duck - tournedos of Cannette de la Dombes, as authentic as it gets.
(We skipped the desserts but they brought us an assortment of macaroons and other sweets.)

With two glasses of white wine and two vodka martinis - well,  two HALF martinis because they are consistently dinky in this part of the world - the total bill for the four of us came to a jaw-dropping  U.S. $600 - roughly twice the average monthly paycheck in Vietnam.  La Villa, is, accordingly, a luxury for special occasions but the restaurant delivers an extraordinary French culinary experience equal or superior to the best I've had in France.

As we left, Chef Thierry scrambled out from the kitchen to greet us and asked us if we enjoyed our evening, which we enthusiastically confirmed. Having worked in Saigon for the last 15 years, my belated visit to La Villa (due to my price-based hesitation) was a welcome discovery.  Exquisite service, stunning food - both visually and in flavor - and a beautiful ambience make it perhaps the most elegant restaurant in Vietnam.   Merci beaucoup, Chef Thierry!

ChIJi8QgZ5ondTERtx3uw5FtVzM.text:
delicious food
reasonable price, airy space
enthusiastic service, next time will bring friends to support the restaurant

ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.name: places/ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkRmJGOVFSa1ZUZGxWSGVHWlphWFZIZW1WTWVsRRAB
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.author: Petalize (Saeng)
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.text:
We visited this vegan spot on our very first day in Vietnam and were pleasantly surprised! I tried the herbal drink and the vegan Vietnamese fermented “fish” noodle soup. While the herbal drink wasn’t quite to my taste (I’d rate it 2/5), the noodle soup was absolutely refreshing — I’d give it a solid 4.5/5. The tangy hint of pineapple in the broth, the mix of mushrooms, and the delicious vegan fish cakes made it a standout dish.
We enjoyed it so much that we returned the next day and tried the rice with vegan curry — another satisfying meal that's definitely worth trying! The rice with three curries was priced at 65,000 VND, and the noodle soup was 43,000 VND — slightly higher than we expected, but the quality made it worthwhile. For those ordering from the rice and curry menu, I’d recommend checking prices in advance just to be sure.

Overall, a wonderful place for vegan food lovers looking for tasty and thoughtful plant-based meals!

ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.name: places/ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURWaGJPcU9BEAE
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.author: Brina
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.text:
Nice vegan restaurant. I had lunch from the buffet to take away, and a bag of vegan curry with tofu. Everything tasted good and was quite filling.

I paid 75k for both items. Based on what I pay at other vegan restaurants, and after reading in the reviews what other customers paid, I'm feeling a little overcharged. Therefore minus 1 star.

ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.name: places/ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNDNS0zQ19BRRAB
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.author: Khanh Nguyen (Theodore)
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.text:
This begeterian restaurant is a very good place to try, especially for vegeterian. Food is well-prepared. They offered so many options for you to choose from rice to noodles. Tables and chair are clean and well-organized. Staffs are very friendly anf supportive. The flavour of the food is very good, it is not too salty.

I recommend this restaurant for vegeterian.

ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.name: places/ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMtamIzWVN3EAE
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.author: Jenny
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.text: So friendly place! The mum who cooks makes great dishes – the jackfruit I had was the best jackfruit I had in my life, super juicy and flavourful. Very nice vibes in this place that keeps open all day (6.30am-8pm I believe) and has put a lot of thought into its buffet menu.

ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.name: places/ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmd01qb0N3EAE
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.author: Tony Huang (Saigon Cheeky)
ChIJscW8dM0odTERBxf0aVDrL6Q.text:
Location location location
Clean
Organized
Friendly

Food quality above average

Prices are fair

Defintely my new top of mind in this corner

ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.name: places/ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCYWRsOXhhMVpLYTBzM1gwUTBkSEZIYnpaR1kwRRAB
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.author: Raquel Ordóñez Giménez
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.text: Small western restaurant, focus in French cuisine. Everything was very good, and the prices were in line with the quality. The service was also good! The salads were hearty, both very tasty. And the wild salmon was exquisite. This place was a great surprise. The space is tiny, so I recommend making a reservation just in case!

ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.name: places/ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KTlIxVnRPRmhDYm5oM2RqZG1SMEpSTVZKRFZIYxAB
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.author: Benjamin P
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.text:
So disappointed by our steak, tasted off and gristly.

Sauce for steak was served in a tiny 2 divider sauce dish.  Both sauces lacked flavour and hardly enough of either.

As one of the other comments said the best thing at the restaurant is the bread.  Nothing else was good including our pesto pasta too.

INCREDIBLY overpriced.  So many other good steak places for cheaper.

Not sure how this has such high ratings.

I came here once for a haircut upstairs in this same alley and it was the worst haircut of my life.  I’m never coming back to this alley way.

Can’t recommend to come here for French or western food again.

ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.name: places/ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KRWRWUndiM2gwUnpKSU4wUmtYMkZJTlRWb1VGRRAB
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.author: Gina Loh
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.text: Great affordable French food in a small cozy restaurant. The duck confit was cooked nicely not too dry and the foie gras was really great, seared perfectly with juicy fats

ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.name: places/ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKTDd1Y3FvMnJXNzJBRRAB
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.author: Nga Le
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.text:
The steak was probably the worst cut of beef we ever had. And it’s not cheap either. It also looked unappetizing. They even messed up the pasta which is the easiest dish to make. I guess they were trying to go for al dente but it just ended up being too hard and dry. Maybe we ordered the wrong dish but that was so disappointing. I could make better steak and pasta than that and I’m not even a professional chef.
Overall, a hidden place that really should stay hidden

ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.name: places/ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tkbGNHbHdlVmx0TUZaaFl6Qk5TVmR0WkZkNlpuYxAB
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.author: Steve Danielewicz
ChIJ2zTlSSUvdTERL9BZ7g--_zQ.text: We went to Chef Thien on our last evening in Vietnam after our month long trip. This restaurant has nice ambience, it is small and romantic. Nice music, not too loud. Good menu selection. We had French onion soup and the chicken with pasta in cream sauce, and the banana flambe for desert. All were very delicious and the prices were reasonable. Really enjoyed this restaurant and highly recommend it.

ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.name: places/ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR0dkpTSHNBRRAB
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.author: Michael Holt
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.text:
Menu offers a number of beef entrees and some non traditional meats like ostrich, crocodile, and lamb. The beef steak was cut thin and cooked decently well. Meat is a bit tough. Crocodile was chewy and tasteless. Sides were a bit bland.

Inside has AC and a nice atmosphere. Staff was friendly and responsive.

ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.name: places/ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sNWRHWXRVMGx5TjBOSU1sOVROR0paWDFCSGVXYxAB
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.author: Daniel Ngo
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.text:
I was introduced to this place years ago by a colleague, and while the food has always been decent enough to bring me back from time to time, the parking situation has become unbearable. There is no official permit or system—just random people posing as “parking security” who demand money. When I asked them for proof of authorization and warned I would call the police, they ran off.

This is nothing more than a scam, and it tarnishes the experience of dining here. I strongly encourage customers not to give in to these frauds. If they persist, call the police or make the issue public. Businesses and authorities should step in to put an end to this shady practice.

ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.name: places/ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuNF9xbWZREAE
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.author: Toan P
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.text:
I was a fan of this resto with price at mainstream, but today am quite disappointed about the quality of food.
I want the steak in green pepper sauce, but they dont have steak as whole flat piece; they only have already-cut (in smaller pieces) steak: each piece has different level of hardness, 1/3 is soft and remaining is very hard (kind of over cooked).
No complain bcuz price applied is lower, and we accept to try it but the fact that it’s weekend and they still dont have stock of their best seller item to serve is quite disappointed. I simply hope they can maintain their stock in weekend, they can maintain their customers.
Other than that, their service is ok, waiter and waitress are not smiling but this is mainstream resto so we dont expect more; overall atmosphere is good as normal.

ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.name: places/ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUd3BYaVdREAE
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.author: Gielle
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.text:
You get what you pay for. Don't expect too much quality.

We enjoyed the sauces especially for the salad. Lamb meat is soft and goes well with the pepper sauce. French fries was sadly dried and hard to chew. Beef steak is mediocre. Red wine is surprisingly good tho. 🤭

Space can be cramped and really noisy.

ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.name: places/ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURVLWNuSXpRRRAB
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.author: Myhan Nguyen
ChIJOZKmT8kodTERb3I7kAlIBBc.text: It is a cozy restaurant where is a bit crowded during evening time. The tables and chairs are knitting, they are close to one another as there are so many guests and they even have to wait in queue for dining. It is an obvious proof the food here is nice amd the price is reasonable. I usually order beefsteak with cheese sauce as I am a faithful fan of dairy product. Don't miss the raspberry drink, it is just so good.

ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.name: places/ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25ONFExRktVR1ZTVTBscGNYcHpUMDFOWHpOYWNXYxAB
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.author: Chris Thompson
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.text:
When it first opened, Truffle seemed "inaccessible." Its positioning from its location on the 73rd floor gave the impression that it was a stuffy, high-end restaurant with a price tag to match. Today, however, the reality is completely different. Truffle is the stage for a talented and humble chef from Marseilles, Pierrick Maire, who showcases his take on authentic Côte d’Azur-inspired cuisine. His impressive pedigree, which includes leading the Michelin-starred Phenix in Shanghai, shines through in every dish.
The restaurant itself offers a comfortable and spacious dining experience with world-class, panoramic views of the Saigon cityscape. The dining room is managed with class by Oum, a Bangkok University graduate with a strong background in Thailand's top restaurants.
The value here is surprising. The tasting menu, priced at just 2,800,000 VND, is a beautifully balanced showcase of fresh proteins and natural ingredients, enhanced by a careful use of truffle and exclusive Petrossian caviar. For an additional 1,600,000 VND, you can add a perfectly matched wine pairing.
Pro Tip: Arrive around 5:30 PM to catch the stunning sunset from the outdoor deck. You can access the restaurant via the Vinpearl Marriott Hotel elevators.

ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.name: places/ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkeE1FdHBWSHBMYW5CUWEzcHlZeTAwU0VKdGRYYxAB
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.author: Tan T.
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.text:
The staff were very friendly and attentive from the very beginning. I was personally welcomed at the entrance of Landmark 81 and escorted upstairs to the restaurant. Since I was dining alone, the staff thoughtfully arranged the table so that I could fully enjoy the beautiful view over the city.

I chose the Set Elegance Above Saigon menu and enjoyed every single course. Each dish tasted fantastic. The view from the restaurant was truly stunning, making the evening even more special.

A big thank you to the team. I really enjoyed my evening here and will happily recommend it to others.

ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.name: places/ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25kdWRHcHlOWEprTUVkc1QzQlRSMWhRUlZad1VIYxAB
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.author: 이수영
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.text:
The view is absolutely stunning from the 73rd floor of the Landmark building. Every dish was flavorful and amazing. And the best part? You actually get a full, happy belly while enjoying the view✨. The staff were all so sweet and friendly. This is a perfect spot for a date or if you’re just in the mood to switch things up with some French cuisine💕

Thanks Truffle team for the wonderful dinner

ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.name: places/ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNU1NvOXJ3dU11MklREAE
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.author: Anna Tran
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.text:
Amazing view and lovely atmosphere. Staff attentive* and friendly. Entrance is through the hotel lobby (there’s a walkway from the mall) and lift access requires assistance from staff. Food was delightful across the board with beautiful presentation. No one dish blew us away; recommend exploring other fine dining restaurants. Overall a delightful experience.
*Once we paid, the service declined; they did not assist us in going down (as swipe access is required for two different lifts) which was disappointing.

ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.name: places/ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VON1l2WnpMaXVqNmxnRRAB
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.author: Vernice Chu
ChIJNUquq6YpdTERCniLES2zOvk.text: Very nice experience of dining in the sky. The menu provides different experience for different courses. Usually main course has no surprise for fine dining. However, the beef is very tender with well matched source. 5 star service.

ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.name: places/ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KRE1VcERSWEk0ZG5FNVlXeFpiMWRIVjBKRmRuYxAB
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.author: Nhi Ho
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.text: Lovely French restaurant with amazing food, dedicated service and great ambiance. Bluebird has been my go-to for years now. Excellent French playlist too. 10/10 recommended to anyone.

ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.name: places/ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxb3V1V2d3RRAB
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.author: Thuong Nguyen
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.text: Everything is well seasoned and decently cooked. We ordered green salad, beef risotto, pumpkin soup, and mashed potato. The price was reasonable with the quality we received.

ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.name: places/ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xSmJUaE1ha2w2TTFobVRVTmpTMHN5WTJoUVpGRRAB
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.author: Maria Børstad
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.text:
I and my husband have visited this restaurant several times before, and Bluebird has received my highest praise in a review.
Things change. The last few times I have had to send food, pasta carbonara, back to the kitchen because the food was not sufficiently heated in the microwave. It peaked when my wife and I ordered our usual favorite. Apparently the food has been kept in the refrigerator for too long, because we both became acutely ill with severe diarrhea.

ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.name: places/ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOVFpXczNlR2d0TlUxSk5GZFZPRXR0VVV4WmVVRRAB
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.author: Alexandre Curé
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.text: As a french, it really hurt me when a restaurant put in his name "French restaurant" but they do Pasta Pizza and Risotto. It's like I open a Vietnamese restaurant and do Pad Thai....

ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.name: places/ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqOXVIT3ZnRRAB
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.author: Mahmoud Youssefi
ChIJW-cE3KwpdTERemLCZlV20lM.text: Typical French restaurant, where nobody in the staff has. Any idea what French food is about!  The food was generally tasty, however, stay away from the ostrich! It's very tough. The shrimp dish under appetizer, is very good. Number six I think. Just go there and order like five of those and you're fine. Besides that, it's all hit and miss!  You might want to call ahead and ask them to turn on the air conditioner! 😜

ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.name: places/ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4aE1XUnZNR1p3TTJoUlMyMXlabXQ0WkMxV1NtYxAB
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.author: francis lau
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.text: Went to this restaurant for the first time yesterday. The place is very cozy inside a square through a small alley. It is actually very accessible as it is just opposite to the Park Hyatt Hotel. Service is lovely (but....) and the food is good quality and delicious.  I had a 3-course lunch (asparagus soup, sea bass and a dessert and a glass of wine) which only cost US$10. Everything was supposed to be perfect. The only issue I experienced was that I ordered a glass of white wine from the menu which I was then told is from thr Al la Carte menu (I misunderstood it was part of the set lunch) and I have to pay the FULL PRICE of US$8. Not too expensive but I don't understand if they charged the full price for that white wine, why they didn't serve me the glass which is supposed to be included in the set lunch. Anyway, I cannot blame them as I didn't ask in detail (assume it is just normal practice that I just pay a bit more if I order a better wine). Stupid me... Anyway, I will go back again but just don't order anything but set lunch.

ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.name: places/ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pJMk9ITTBhRXRIV1RWYVYxaDNWSFZtTUZoUWRWRRAB
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.author: Shayne Valerie
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.text:
We had dinner at The Refinery Bistro, a French restaurant tucked inside a charming courtyard in District 1 — and wow, the whole night felt like a mini escape to Paris.

Here’s what we ordered 👇

🥩 Traditional Steak Frites 300g Prime Steak – Tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked, served with crispy fries and a rich pepper sauce.

🍆 Aubergine, Spinach & Lentil Roulade Gratinée – A hearty, earthy vegetarian option with creamy textures and deep flavors.

🌿 Asparagus, Mint & Lemon Risotto – Fresh, bright, and beautifully balanced; the mint + lemon combo makes it so refreshing.

🥩 Beef Wellington (Special of the Night) – One of the stars of the night! Golden pastry, juicy beef, and an amazing red wine sauce that ties everything together.

Desserts are a must here 👇

🍫 Home-made Chocolate Mousse – Silky, rich, and made with Marou chocolate, giving it that bold, premium Vietnamese cacao flavor.

🔥 2 Crêpes Suzette Flambéed Tableside – The highlight! The server prepares it right in front of you, flambéing it with Grand Marnier liqueur. So entertaining to watch — and it tastes even better than it looks.

They also served complimentary sourdough bread, and the server mentioned it’s made from scratch in the restaurant. I loved it; soft on the inside, perfectly chewy, and with that mild tangy flavor that makes a great sourdough so satisfying. 🥖✨

They also have an extensive drink menu with both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options. We tried their house wines, which paired perfectly with the dishes and rounded out the night so well. 🍷✨

The ambiance was so relaxing — warm lights, elegant French interiors, and cozy courtyard vibes. Truly the perfect spot for date nights, special dinners, or just treating yourself to a beautiful evening in Saigon. ✨🤍

ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.name: places/ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOaVEyNUZVbXBDUTBoMGNrRlpTbEpIZDBOaE9HYxAB
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.author: Benjamin P
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.text:
Really enjoyed lunch here. Had the lasagne 🍝 which was rich and proper comforting and the fish was fresh and cooked spot on. Both dishes hit the spot 👌 also profiteroles for dessert were so delicious. 🤤

The place has a laid back charm to it. Tucked away off an alley in a quiet little courtyard under cover in the rain is cool and feels like you’re miles away from the chaos of the city. Cold beer, warm fresh bread and butter when you sit down 🍞🍺 Simple things done right.

Juices were good too especially liked the super orange one.

Service was friendly and chill and the whole vibe just felt easy and relaxed.

They also have indoor dining but outside wasn’t hot.  I like how dark it is when blind is covered but some might not.

Will 100% come back ✅.

ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.name: places/ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWM0xTMDVUMmhWWlVkbFZHaG5ibnBNTlhRM2VrRRAB
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.author: Danh Tran
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.text: The Refinery is a fantastic spot with a lovely terrace that’s perfect for relaxing and enjoying the atmosphere. It’s my favorite place for fresh, delicious salads that never disappoint. The vibe is chill and inviting, making it an ideal hangout. Plus, its central location makes it super convenient to visit. Definitely a go-to place for good food and a great ambiance!

ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.name: places/ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tveE9YVkRTa1pOUjB4TmFHOXRMVUprTkRkbWIyYxAB
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.author: Liam Nguyen
ChIJc6e8IEYvdTERvVBcEDgRF9I.text:
I had the pleasure of dining at The Refinery, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the charming atmosphere, with a lovely blend of French inspired décor and warm lighting that instantly made me feel welcome.
The food was absolutely outstanding. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavor. You can tell the ingredients are fresh and the kitchen puts a lot of care into every plate. Whether it was the appetizers, mains, or desserts, everything was perfectly prepared and exceeded my expectations.
But what made the experience truly special was the service. A huge thank you to Boris Trung, who went above and beyond to make sure our evening was perfect. His professionalism, friendliness, and attention to detail were exceptional. He made us feel well taken care of throughout the meal and added a personal touch that really elevated the whole experience.
If you’re looking for a place with great food, beautiful ambiance, and outstanding service, I highly recommend The Refinery. I will definitely be coming back and I hope Boris Trung is there to greet us again!

ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.text:
Space: airy, clean.
Service: friendly staff, quick service.
Food: delicious dishes, fast serving speed, reasonable order of dishes.

ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.author: Tú Vũ Ngọc
ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.text: The food is delicious, the staff is also cute; reasonable price

ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.name: places/ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqc2Nxdkx3EAE
ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.author: Dai Fung
ChIJLwlIo1kvdTERirZHcsL1MJY.text:
I ordered 1 Kobe beef, 1 cheese salad, 1 spicy orange salmon, 1 goose breast pasta.
The Kobe beef was soft and melted in my mouth, served with black pepper sauce which went well.
The salad included kale and rocket, the sour taste, various types of cheese, and the salty smoked sausages went well together.
The salmon was a bit salty, but when eaten with the spicy orange sauce and the slight spiciness on the tip of my tongue, it was ok.
I forgot to take a picture of the pasta, overall the cheese sauce was quite bland, with a light cheese aroma, which went well with the salty and fatty smoked goose breast, and the sliced ​​sausages were so salty that my tongue was numb.
The crispy toast was given to me for free, served with unsalted butter and tomato jam, which was quite bland so I sprinkled salt and pepper on it.
The chocolate lava cake, the cake and cream were both ok, but the crumbs were quite bland (milk and flour smell), it would be better if I used butter biscuits.
I personally found the creme brulee delicious, like flan but softer, melting in my mouth. But my brother who studied abroad in Europe commented that it was different from the ones he had eaten there.

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.name: places/ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toMFUyMTRObTgxWjFKc2QzbzVNbk0wVTBOUVpVRRAB
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.author: Hung Hoang
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.text:
A Warm ans Cozy Treat
I had such a wonderful experience at this pastry shop! The atmosphere is genuinely warm and cozy, making it the perfect place to relax.
The pastries themselves were fantastic, especially because they are made with less sugar, which really lets the quality ingredients and natural flavors come through—a huge plus!
Service was top-notch; the staff were incredibly nice and attentive, offering genuinely good service throughout my visit. As a lovely surprise, I was also gifted two pieces of their delicious cheese tart! Highly recommend stopping by for a perfectly balanced sweet treat and welcoming environment.

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.name: places/ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pBMmRIUmtiblE0YnkwMFdrOHdTa1J0UVZSUlJIYxAB
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.author: Lâm Linh Lý
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.text: The space is pleasant and visually appealing, and they offer a buy-one-get-one-free happy hour. What I appreciate most is that the place has a brand story to tell — every detail feels thoughtfully connected. Those who pay attention to design and storytelling elements will definitely enjoy this.

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.name: places/ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSb1VuaE1jSEpTVkMxWWVXSkRTMWxrTkVNemVYYxAB
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.author: Quoc Viet Tran
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.text: Bakes Bakery Thao Dien deserves a full 5/5. The prices are a bit high, but the quality is outstanding with beautifully crafted and delicious pastries. The shop has elegant decoration and a cozy atmosphere. The staff are friendly and professional, and special mention to Khoi, the store manager — such a nice and welcoming guy. A perfect spot for dessert lovers looking for premium treats!

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.name: places/ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0MVpsZHZWRU5pTnpnNGEwUnVNa1ZrU2pSUVRXYxAB
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.author: T Nguyen
ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.text: Beautiful and relax atmosphere to chill with good drinks and pastries. Best croissant so far in HCM. Best deal buy one get one free after 7:30pm.

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.name: places/ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OUFZuQk1RMng0UlZOTlRtczNhRXBmVGsxak0wRRAB

ChIJ-3xt6cgndTER8tWyT9-cF-8.text: It’s one of the places I constantly go back to - especially when I crave European style pastry with Asian cuteness. The drinks are so refreshing and the pastry is always on point - no matter if I order a croissant or a cheesecake. It’s a very clean, laid-back cafe with attentive service and relaxing music.

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.name: places/ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25wMU4wTXlZbVpLVDFkVFNYZHFWRVJvTldKaVMwRRAB

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.text: The chief is capable of putting four seasons  into one plate. Every taste gives customers a mixture of harmonized flavor. The service is very professional as well. The dining experience is a wonderful french cuisine journey.

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.name: places/ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s4eU9EVkZOMGhZT1VsUVQzRnJka2w1TjNWVGNtYxAB
ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.author: Mark Chandley
ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.text: Was looking for some Kobe beef while visiting and this was a short walk from our hotel. Excellent service, wonderful dishes and we sampled all of the Kobe on the menu. Each was unique and flavorful as well as perfectly prepared.  Really like the trio of sauces offered as well with the mushroom being my favorite. Finished with the crème brûlée.  I would check it out but make reservation during busy times.

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.name: places/ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xJM2RVNXdaV1J3Tm1WRFNEZEpVME5FWnpoUlZWRRAB

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.text: Wow, what an amazing experience! The dinner menu has a wide variety of choices and each one sounds sooo good. The abalone appetizer was delicious! The meat lover main course did not disappoint. The A5 beef was so tender and juicy. Highly recommended to anyone who wants something different and delicious in HCMC.

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.name: places/ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21Nd05VODRkalJ3UkRKQlJIbFBNamR5VUdOaGQwRRAB

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.text: Marvelous restaurant.  Renewal opened  recently.  I visited here for lunch with my friend.  Two lunch courses there.  Every single dish is perfect✨

ChIJtW7Qdl8vdTERcWbYoOdRCFY.text:
We ordered the Michelin Special set menu during lunchtime. It is exquisite,particularly the steak.
This restaurant doesn't provide many seats,so reserving a table in advance would be advisable.

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.text: I attended the A1 and A2 courses here, and it has been going well. I highly recommend it to anyone who is busy and looking for effective online courses.

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.name: places/ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t3MmVGSnpZelpYWVhScVZURlZVa00wYUMxd1VrRRAB
ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.author: Hằng Thân Thị Thu
ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.text: I just completed the B1 course at the center and I am very satisfied. I will continue to take the advanced course to achieve my B2 goal in the near future. Thank you very much to the center and the teacher.

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.name: places/ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VKZWJnc21Oc2M2ZVlnEAE

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.text: I just finished the A2.2 French course (taught in English) at Cap France and I loved it! The class was lively and encouraging. I’m excited to move on to A2.3 with them! 😊

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.name: places/ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWcGRDMUdSRFZXZERNeFdHMURNWFJ5UmsxeWRtYxAB

ChIJKXgoTKkvdTERAOuSKCQAe78.text:
Very good classes!
I really like Cap France. The teachers are very kind and explain things well.

ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.author: Geeves
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.text: This is a great place to go even for lunch. They have a tasting menu or a la carte portions that you can order.
