And you can't beat the city and river views! 🏙 I'll definitely come back!

ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.name: places/ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2psdWJsbFVaa1YyUWs4MU5uQnZaMDVJUm5SQlpFRRAB
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.author: Anthony N
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.text: The food was exceptional! Fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Service was warm and attentive, making us feel truly valued. Add in the stunning views (perfect for sunset dining!), and this place is a must-visit. Highly recommend for a memorable meal!

ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.name: places/ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25vMFRrWlpaRzlNYkVod1NUQnFYM3BrWTNGT2FVRRAB
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.author: lbc
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.text: The fish soup is minced with small amount of fish one would believe there's nor enough taste ro endure. However, once you taste of it, it blew me away. Fantastic with unassuming presentation. The bisque is smooth and lobster stewed texture. The fish - seemed ro be Bay scallops compliments with de joure. The seafood pasta is just as great that would satisfy any pallet. Btw, I paired it with Godfather.

ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.name: places/ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Obk5UaEJOa2xRVlU1V1VtaGFNek51UVdrMFEwRRAB
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.author: Steve Morris
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.text:
All I can say is WOW!
Came here for my 50th birthday! And it certainly didn’t disappoint. The food was spectacular delicious. The views over the city just amazing. This place is a must try experience!

ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.name: places/ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205SWVURkpkV2hDZVhsQ05XOW9iMFpwVEVOWGRWRRAB
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.author: Dimitris Apollonas Poseidonas Venetis
ChIJ8XZF34AvdTERzL6YaiECm3E.text: I am vegetarian and the menu is full of meat and fish. But I found two dishes. If you are vegetarian this is not a good place for you. However, everyone should come here. The restaurant is amazing. Staff extremely professional and food is delicious. Cocktails delicious two. I was there at 5;30. I had the chance to see the see during day and night light. I definitely recommend you come here. Level 51 is Japanese restaurant and level 52 is the French. I chose the European as I am European and I prefer this cousine. It is better you come here rather than going to an observatory.

ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.name: places/ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aclZuaElabFZQTVdSNWNXOXBUbWhRV1hoTGFHYxAB
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.author: Na (Now)
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.text:
The food and atmosphere of the restaurant are wonderful, but the service is terrible.

I visited for lunch. The Vietnamese dishes, adapted to be more accessible for international guests, were visually appealing and delicious. The dessert crepes were exquisite, and it was fascinating to see them cooked right in front of us; however, caution is needed due to the remaining alcohol.

Unfortunately, the service was extremely disappointing. The staff was not only unfriendly, but none of the details I discussed over the phone in advance were communicated at all.
The warm main dishes were served while we were still eating our appetizers, so by the time we got to them, they were already cold.
The birthday plate I had reserved by phone was provided when we received the bill (after we had already finished the dessert, leading to a second dessert being served…). This was the worst service I have ever experienced, especially in a first-class hotel.

While this may be one of the top luxury hotels in Ho Chi Minh City, the service at this restaurant is shocking if you have any expectations.

ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.name: places/ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VQckFnTUtmcUliaWx3RRAB
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.author: Danny Bùi
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.text:
Square One continues to be a restaurant that amazes and disappoints me at the same time. The only reason I keep coming back is for the incredible food quality, it never misses. The Beef Wellington (now cheekily renamed Beef Napoleon to match the French theme) is absolutely to die for. The flavor, execution, and presentation are all top-notch. Just voilà.

However, the service is consistently underwhelming. Interactions with staff feel very transactional and cold, lacking the warmth or attention to detail you’d expect from one of the most prestigious hotels in Saigon. There’s no personal touch, no moment that makes the experience feel special. As for the atmosphere, it feels a bit dated and doesn’t quite match the level of sophistication the brand aims to project.

ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.name: places/ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJOEtuQzd3RRAB
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.author: ELVIS C
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.text: The worst restaurant I have ever been. This is not a French restaurant. They serve salty Vietnamese food and tasteless Chinese food. The meat dish was terrible. I would never visit again even they pay me to eat. Avoid it at all cost. I can’t think of any restaurant worser than this one.

ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.name: places/ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNBMDZuOE9REAE
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.author: Will LL
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.text:
The steamed grouper was tender and flavorful, and the wagyu on the stone was a true delicacy, cooked to perfection.

For dessert, the small soufflé was enough to  serve three people, a sweet end to a great meal.

ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.name: places/ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNQNlB1c0JREAE
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.author: Joe
ChIJUc5tJEYvdTERQHf-PVO_Ss8.text: I didn’t expect a common Chinese dishes (from my knowledge) on a western style restaurant’s menu, out of my expectations. And it tastes like any fast food restaurant in Hong Kong. Other than that, it is fine.

ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.name: places/ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pnNFl6Y3piRzFFWW14WlpHaDRWMGh3TmxCd1NuYxAB
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.author: Tung Nguyen
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.text: cute restaurant with nice outdoor seating in a parisienne bistro setting…however the quality of the food is highly variable.  onion soup was well made, sweet onion cooked slowly allowing for depth in flavor, along with french bread toasted with grated cheese.  mussels in white wine sauce to be avoided as these are FROZEN from chile so they are fishy tasting and tough.  escargot comes from a tin can so no shells and no fresh snails, which are plentiful anywhere all over Saigon.  skip this dish.  steak with fried potatoes in mushroom sauce was delicious, tender, cooked to medium rare and mushroom sauce was great.  french baguettes was crispy and dense with butter.  do not order crème brûlée.  it is nothing more than a flan right side up, lacking cream in the crème and lacking vanilla flavoring, so the flavor is very eggy!!!  fail on this dish.  floating island used a boxed pudding mix for the island to float on, so if you want pudding in a box, skip this too as thr pudding tasted like it sat in the fridge for a day and sucked in all the various flavors of things stored in the fridge.  i gave feedback to the service people to relay to the cook but was told this is how we have always cooked this by the waitress.  feedback is a gift and apparently they don’t care for constructive feedback, and don’t want to improve.  buyer beware.

ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.name: places/ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oNldtY3RVMWx4TWtKaldHWmlUVlJ2UkMxRVMyYxAB
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.author: Khanh Le
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.text:
Was it exceptional? No. Was it good? Average.

Food
Onion soup- Hmm, a bit salty for my taste. And it tastes like the bouillon cubes, exactly that.
Steaks- The steaks we got were quite bland. The 400k one was tender but the other was quite tough. The sauces were ok. Not too flavorful and again, the main flavor is the bouillon cubes.
Profiteroles - this was rather disappointing. The most expensive dessert on the menu and it tastes like the cheap choux pastry that you get in the convenient store. The best one we have tastes so far were from Cocotte.

Staff
- waitress: woman of few words, really thought I was in Paris for a moment. Didn’t seem to care to answer to advise clients on the food
- parking: after the disappointing dinner, we had to pay for parking which is 10k. Which is the same amount that I left for them.. which think again I should have take those 😬

Great atmosphere tho, when sitting outside. We enjoyed it.

ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.name: places/ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tFMmFVcGFSRmc0VVd0eU5tZDNlUzFSVGs1clNFRRAB
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.author: G Whizz
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.text: We had a very good lunch at Le Jardin in Phu Quoc. The setting is absolutely stunning, right by the seaside with a relaxed and elegant atmosphere. The food was tasty, nicely presented, and service was attentive throughout. A perfect spot to enjoy a meal with ocean views.

ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.name: places/ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210c2R6VnNSamRSU1RWUVdsUTRSRE0zVDFWbVpFRRAB
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.author: Gaby Gigi Vo
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.text:
I have known this restaurant for many years but it seems there is nothing changed since my last visit 3 years ago. The decoration is quite dated, outdoor area is very hot during noon time while the indoor area is lacks of ventilation. Tables are set too tight next to each other while the smell of lemongrass oil is very strong over the room.
The main reason to come back is the food. Good quality, taste and reasonable price. Still, I love this place as it brings back some good memories to me.

ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.name: places/ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201Q1NtNXNUM2RMY0hWNWVsSnRPRWRMV1ZGWVFuYxAB
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.author: CY H
ChIJkfSehpEvdTERFSmxNwYmkpY.text:
Recommendations: Onion Soup & Moules marinières
Price reasonable and very delicious.
All of the dish that we ordered are great!
PS. There’s indoor and outdoor seats to choose.

ChIJJ65MRDwvdTERTtKz69Xj2bo.name: places/ChIJJ65MRDwvdTERTtKz69Xj2bo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwWFlWbENRamhrVTFOSlgwMUZabGw2UmxGNlJsRRAB

ChIJjwDDpbsvdTERk43_Om7p9AY.author: Mai Nguyen
ChIJjwDDpbsvdTERk43_Om7p9AY.text:
I’m Vietnamese, and this is honest feedback from someone who has tried beefsteak at many restaurants.

Food quality:
The beef was fairly alright. I also ordered an octopus dish (priced around 200k VND). However, the portion felt quite small, and both the sauce and the octopus tasted overcooked. For the Beef Nachos with cheese (around 100k VND), I was expecting something more substantial. The nachos seemed similar to packaged snacks from the supermarket with beef sprinkled on top, so the dish didn’t feel very special for the price.

Service & experience:
The entrance door was unexpectedly difficult to open — it took quite a bit of effort, which made the experience feel less welcoming right from the start. The staff were friendly but not as professional as expected for a restaurant at this price point, both in greeting and communication.

It was my friend’s birthday, and we wanted to try this place for a nice dinner, but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing.

For comparison, I’ve tried Topping Beef before, and honestly, there is a lot L'Entrecote could learn from them — from the way dishes are presented, to the flavour execution, to the professionalism of the staff.

I hope this feedback can be helpful for future improvements, because the restaurant has potential, but the experience we had did not meet expectations.

ChIJ4QR0yDgvdTER8zPQAsgAtOc.text:
This COCOTTE outlet near Ben Thanh Market offers a cozy, casual, and festive atmosphere that captures the charm of a Parisian bistro. The French-inspired dishes are generally well executed, and the prices feel reasonable for the quality and portion sizes.

The duck is definitely a highlight, cooked well and full of flavour. However, I was a little disappointed with the Onion Soup — the broth leaned noticeably sweeter than what I’ve had in France or even other places in Asia, which threw off the balance for me.

Overall, it’s still a pleasant spot with good value, but the Onion Soup could use a tweak to better match traditional expectations.

I don’t want to judge Cocotte based on just one visit, but the service was decent, and the overall experience showed potential. I’d be curious to come back and try more dishes before forming a final opinion.

ChIJzXlzakkndTERVqNWBHduiM4.text:
📍 NOLSTAGIC taste of Bình Định CUISINE in Dist 2!

My girlfriend craved for hometown food so I scrawled around GoogleMap & we ended up here. Staffs were all locally accented, which signals original taste coming soon!

We ordered three local specialties: Bánh cuốn Tây Sơn, Bánh hỏi lòng heo, and Bún chả cá giò. Such a fullfilling experience!

Bún chả cá was impressive. The broth resembles thicky, glassy taste of bánh canh. The noodles are unique from the region. Pork knuckle is meaty and even-rationed with fat. Perhaps, they nailed the sauces & seasonings so dishes were all savory.

Cheap, savory, and great service. Couldn’t ask for more in a food spot!

ChIJzXlzakkndTERVqNWBHduiM4.name: places/ChIJzXlzakkndTERVqNWBHduiM4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGR2FqVnBTRlJ3ZWxodlFYUkxRMWs0VW5SNGNGRRAB
ChIJzXlzakkndTERVqNWBHduiM4.author: Đỗ Hoàng
ChIJzXlzakkndTERVqNWBHduiM4.text:
It's hard not to be moved by the warmth and sincerity of the restaurant, from the food to the service. The restaurant offers a truly "home-made" culinary experience, very cozy and intimate. 
Rolled tray and signature dishes
The porridge with pork and rice vermicelli is the highlight of the restaurant. The porridge is cooked smooth and well-balanced, combined with the soft rice vermicelli to create a harmonious, very distinctive and unforgettable flavor. 
However, the real "star" of the meal is the rolled tray. This is a unique and creative dish, showing the sophistication of the chef. A tray full of fresh ingredients and vegetables, skillfully rolled, when eaten, you can feel the fresh, cool taste, not boring at all. 
In addition, the restaurant's menu is also very rich, with many other delicious dishes for you to choose from. All dishes are meticulously prepared, preserving the traditional flavor. 
Served like family
Another big plus is the enthusiasm and friendliness of the waitresses. Even if it is your first time coming to the restaurant, you will feel like you are coming home, being cared for and looked after by the waitresses. This warmth and thoughtfulness creates a very comfortable and pleasant atmosphere, making the meal even more complete.
If you are looking for a place to enjoy traditional Vietnamese cuisine in a cozy, sincere space, try stopping by here. Surely you will not be disappointed with the taste of porridge with rice vermicelli, unique rolled rice paper, and the enthusiasm of the restaurant owners.

ChIJvyC1xhYmdTERGzZWtduzMXA.text:
Maybe I should have stopped coming since the last time I was here 2 years ago.
First time was in 2018 and I love it.
But standards have gone down and this time in Jun23, its a sad sad reflection of what it once used to be.
As is in life I guess. Was fit, now unfit. Was handsome, now bald and handsome.

If I stopped coming, my first memory of this place would have stayed as it was - good food, good coffee, good croissant etc...

But now the coffee is just coffee-flavoured milk, the croissant is super oily, the scrambled eggs are so so.

I've had better in cheaper and more local offerings.
Bye Saint Honore, I'll store you in the memories from 2018 and delete all other visits to your restaurant and I'm not coming back.

I'm not angry. I'm just sad.

ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw.name: places/ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3NTZQWkFnEAE

ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw.text:
Restaurant Saigon: I recently had a business lunch at Le 17 Bistro at Sofitel Saigon Plaza, and it was a delightful experience. The lunch is available from 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM and offers a well-priced 3-course set menu at VND 300,000++ or VND 350,000++, which includes a tea or coffee.

I started with the Creamy Corn Soup (SOUPE DE MAÏS CRÉMEUSE), which was rich and flavorful, with perfectly pan-seared chicken and a drizzle of olive oil. For the main course, I chose the Grilled Sea bass (BAR GRILLÉ), which was tender and well-cooked, served with potato brandade, fresh romaine lettuce, and a delicious seafood sauce. There’s also an option to upgrade to Iberico Pork for an additional VND 150,000, which I might try next time.

Dessert was a Pineapple Rice Pudding Tartlet (TARTELETTES ANANAS RIZ AU LAIT) that was light and satisfying, accompanied by a crunchy almond tuile and creamy vanilla ice cream—a perfect way to finish the meal.

If you’re in the mood for a drink, you can add a glass of house wine for VND 150,000 - VND 190,000.

Overall, Le 17 Bistro offers a great setting for a business lunch, with a good variety of dishes, attentive service, and a relaxing atmosphere. Highly recommend giving it a try!

ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw.name: places/ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxaHF6RG9BRRAB

ChIJpV-7MUovdTERiIb_9OSYcEw.text: We dined at le Bistro 17 and had an absolutely perfect experience. For our starters, we savored the fresh oysters that tasted of the sea, followed by sumptuous lobster and perfectly cooked beef for the main course. The oysters were remarkably fresh, while the lobster boasted a meaty texture. The beef was cooked to perfection and paired exquisitely with the accompanying foie gras, resulting in a wonderfully flavorful and well-balanced dish, complete with a delightful salad and gratin potatoes.  Customer service was outstanding and very attentive.

ChIJV_-fUWwvdTER1mekTC8k8Hg.text:
During my visit to Korea House - Món Ăn Hàn Quốc (코리아 하우스), I had a delightful experience with my family of 8. We indulged in a variety of dishes that left us craving for more.

Firstly, we ordered the "Box Busan," which was a tantalizing combination of steaks, Kimbo, and spicy tokbokki. The freshness of the meats, coupled with the vibrant flavors of Korean spices, made this dish a standout.

Next, we tried the "Lau cha ca mandu," a hotpot dish brimming with a variety of fish cakes, remen, and fresh vegetables. The broth was rich and aromatic, enhancing the flavors of the ingredients and making each spoonful a delight.

Finally, we couldn't resist trying the "Ga sot tu vi phomai," a dish featuring succulent chicken pieces smothered in a creamy cheese sauce. The blend of savory chicken and the richness of the cheese sauce created a harmonious flavor profile that pleased everyone at the table.

Throughout the meal, the ambiance of Korea House added to our experience, with its cozy yet lively atmosphere. The attentive service and the authenticity of the dishes made our dining experience truly memorable, leaving us eager to return and explore more of their menu.

Kept advertising their "good" foods, but as someone who has worked at a family Korean restaurant before, I know a lot were just them being lazy to cook and clean. When getting takeaway as well  the younger girl was so easy to get annoyed. Can't imagine those who are unable to speak Vietnamese...

I really don't understand the high reviews.

ChIJJ_YTX4IvdTER-Bo0wjUNwdE.author: Brewforone
ChIJJ_YTX4IvdTER-Bo0wjUNwdE.text:
📍 ʙʀᴏꜱ ᴋᴏʀᴇᴀ

- Another birthday, another special spot to bring my friends to. Walking in, it instantly felt like stepping onto the set of a K-drama. The noise, the smoky air from all the grills, the servers darting between tables, chaotic all way round. It’s as traditional as Korean BBQ gets, right down to the sizzling charcoal and the buzz of overlapping conversations.

The food was absolutely delicious. The meats were great and portions were okay. You could have your server handle the grilling but I always prefer doing it myself so we can keep the conversation in-between the group haha. Service was lively and very polite despite the volume, and it’s clear they work hard to keep things running smoothly.

That said, it’s definitely a high-energy spot. It's not unusual to wait up to two hours (what I've seen) for a seat so a reservation is definitely the better option. It’s not the kind of place for a slow, quiet dinner. I had a great time celebrating and soaking in the atmosphere, but my introverted side was ready for silence by the end of dinner.

ChIJJ_YTX4IvdTER-Bo0wjUNwdE.name: places/ChIJJ_YTX4IvdTER-Bo0wjUNwdE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sNVpucDFTMHRKWkMxNFNWOWZXRTltY0hkclJXYxAB

ChIJJ_YTX4IvdTER-Bo0wjUNwdE.text:
Food was very good, but experienced a pretty long wait. We waited 45min-1hr to be seated, and when we entered, the waiter and I couldn't understand each other because of how noisy it was. We eventually managed to order by pointing at the menu, so it was fine moving forward. Our server helped us cook the food and we thoroughly enjoyed the meat, but especially the seafood on the dinner menu.

Note that you are only allowed two hours, so make the most of it :)

Value for money was okay but would have been better if we didn't have to wait so long.

WE LOVE VU!!!

Came here with my family at around 6pm. Food was so good. Me and my sister loved the beef short ribs and my parents loved the oysters. The oysters were flame torched and they said it tasted very fresh.

The service was the main thing that stood out to us. Our waiter Vu was so approachable and proactive. He recommended the meats and helped us cook everything to perfection. Every time he came back to help us to cook the meat, he also offered more food and asked if there was anything else he could provide.

At around 7 pm, it got very busy and Vu was taking care of 3 tables. He was so fast and still smiling even though it was so busy.

My dad said that this was the best KBBQ experience he has ever had (even better than korea).

The food was amazing, but Vu’s service really bumped this experience up. 100/10!! Would definitely recommend everyone to come here.

ChIJvVmcIoAvdTERop3E100d1AM.text:
Palsaik offers a really enjoyable Korean BBQ experience that balances quality, service, and affordability. The highlight of the visit was definitely the staff — they were very attentive, helpful, and genuinely friendly throughout the meal. They explained the dishes clearly, helped with grilling, and made sure everything was comfortable, which added a lot to the dining experience.

In terms of food, Palsaik doesn’t focus on premium, high-end cuts of beef like some luxury Korean BBQ spots. Instead, the menu is designed to be accessible, with prices kept at a very reasonable level. This makes it a great choice for everyday dining, fitting well within the budget of most people while still delivering satisfying flavors. The side dishes (banchan) were plentiful, fresh, and varied, which paired nicely with the hot pot and grilled items.

Overall, Palsaik is not about exclusivity or premium luxury — it’s about good Korean BBQ that’s affordable, served with excellent hospitality. Perfect for groups of friends, families, or anyone looking for a hearty and friendly dining experience without breaking the bank.

ChIJ95Bm8eQudTERNlH5Uo2ZHTU.text: So, I have been in many Korean Restaurants in Ho Chi Minh, and this place was not very authentic, the food taste has been adapted for Vietnamese to eat, which makes a big difference. One of the big advantages of eating at Korean Restaurants is the SIDE DISHES, if you eat at a Korean Restaurant this is one of the first things to notice, if taste is good, if there are many or some side dishes, it will give you an idea of how the main dishes will be. In this case, once I saw the side dishes, I knew it will not be the same. For the service, they have to improve it, usually Korean Reataurants will always have the best services. All in all, I only give it 3 stars because of taste and service. Hope they take this comments in a positive way and try to improve.

By the way, the restaurant already say that they serve Korean popular food with cheap price. So with 160,000 VND (about 7 USD) where can you find a restaurant with that facilities, that quality of service, in Saigon and for 3 dishes? And does they have aircon for you?

Don’t blame them for everything with your own experiences.

P.S.: I am not the restaurant owner nor employee. Just passing by and see something wrong with 1 star. Actually, this place is not perfect but good.

ChIJ3xfy6C0pdTERUPvgrpnzbho.text:
Let me start by saying I stumbled upon this place by accident, and I'm so glad I did!  Kimbap Hoàng Tử  on Lê Văn Sỹ  isn't a fancy place - it's a small shop with a few tables inside. But don't let that fool you. The staff were incredibly friendly, even though there wasn't much English spoken.  They were patient with me as I tried to decipher the menu and pointed out their specialties.

Speaking of specialties, I went with the kimbap, of course! It was delicious. The fillings were fresh and flavorful, and the rice was perfectly cooked.  The portion size was just right, leaving me satisfied but not overly full.  I also tried some of their pickled vegetables, which were a nice tangy complement to the kimbap.

Overall, Kimbap Hoàng Tử was a great little find. It's a great place to grab a quick, delicious, and affordable meal. If you're looking for a fancy sit-down experience, this might not be the spot. But if you want authentic, tasty kimbap in a friendly atmosphere, then this is definitely worth checking out!

ChIJV7aRPQAvdTERjm-WeyFDcv0.text:
Right in the heart of District 1, Dogalbi Saigon feels like a polished, modern Korean BBQ house — warm lighting, sleek tables with built-in grills, and a steady buzz from lunch through late night. The location on Lý Tự Trọng makes it an easy meet-up spot before or after a downtown stroll.

The Food
Expect clean, bold flavors and quality cuts that sear beautifully at the table. Sauces lean balanced, banchan arrives crisp and fresh, and the whole experience is designed for sharing — from quick weekday sets to linger-long dinners. The brand highlights premium pork and Korean-style grilling, with periodic lunch deals that draw a crowd.

Service & Atmosphere
Service is organized and attentive — staff manage grills, keep the pace smooth, and offer tips if you’re new to Korean BBQ. The room stays lively without tipping into chaos, making it good for dates, groups, or business dinners.

More Details
• Vegetarian options: Limited (BBQ-centric); some sides/salads available — ask staff for meat-free combinations.
• Dietary restrictions: Common allergens include soy, sesame, gluten; sauces can be adjusted mildly. Cross-contact possible at the grill.
• Parking: Central D1 location on Lý Tự Trọng — street/nearby paid options; scooters are easiest.
• Kid-friendliness: Lively but family-friendly; sharing format works well for groups.
• Wheelchair accessibility: Street-level frontage; interior can get tight at peak hours — call ahead for accessible seating.
• Good to know: Typical service windows split lunch and dinner (midday and evening). Check same-day hours before you go.

Final Take
Dogalbi Saigon brings polished Korean BBQ energy to the center of Saigon — quality meats, smooth service, and a downtown address that makes planning easy. Five stars for a reliable, crowd-pleasing grill night.

ChIJSTx6a5EvdTERC9BdeFrZVJc.text:
When I visited, the place was full of Korean customers — a good sign that the food probably matches their taste well.

The portion sizes are surprisingly big! Given the generous serving and solid quality, the pricing is very reasonable.

I had the **Jajangmyeon (black bean noodles)** – the sauce was flavorful and balanced, and it came with a good amount of meat. One portion could easily fill you up.

Since it was just the two of us, we didn’t order the sweet & sour pork, but went for the **fried dumplings** instead — and they were *really amazing*. Crispy on the outside without being greasy, piping hot, and stuffed with well-seasoned meat.

The restaurant itself is quite plain, nothing fancy or photogenic, and the service was average — not particularly warm, but efficient.

Next time, I’ll come back with more people so we can try more dishes. Definitely worth a revisit for the food!

ChIJ93TbhMgvdTERRMmlvrAvggM.text:
Amazing Experience at MAPO GALBI - A Must-Visit!

I recently had the pleasure of dining at MAPO GALBI by Mr. Park during the holiday season, and it was a fantastic experience! This wasn’t my first time here, but I can honestly say the place has really stepped up since my last visit.

First off, let’s talk about the starters. The initial dishes, which are entirely free, are a great way to kick off the meal. They’re simple yet delicious, especially the stir-fried glass noodles. I’m a big fan of Korean cuisine, and these noodles were on point—light, flavorful, and super easy to eat. They set the tone for the feast that was about to follow.

Now, onto the star of the show—the BBQ! The marinated meats are just delightful. I tried the grilled pork skin, and it took me right back to Korea. The texture and seasoning were spot on, and it’s a dish I’d highly recommend if you’re looking for something authentic. The other meats were also beautifully marinated, tender, and full of flavor. You can tell they use quality ingredients and take pride in their food.

But what really made this visit stand out for me was the service. I’d read some mixed reviews about the service in the past, but I’m happy to report that it has improved significantly. The manager was incredibly welcoming, introducing herself and the dishes with such enthusiasm. She made us feel like valued guests, checking in on us throughout the meal, and even seeing us off with a warm goodbye. The rest of the staff were also very attentive, making sure we had everything we needed without being overbearing.

A special shoutout goes to the security guard—such a friendly guy! It’s clear that this restaurant cares about its guests’ experience from start to finish, including the safety of our vehicles. The area is secure, so you can enjoy your meal without worrying about your motorbike or belongings.

All in all, MAPO GALBI has won me over once again. Whether you’re a regular or a first-timer, this is one place that’s worth visiting. From the free starters to the authentic BBQ and much-improved service, you’ll leave with a full belly and a smile on your face. I can’t wait to return!

10/10 Korean BBQ Experience at 0C – A Hidden Gem!

First impression? Stunning. The space at 0C Korean BBQ is beautifully designed — open, airy, and super comfortable. You walk in and immediately feel like you’re in for something good.

And wow, they deliver.

Let’s talk about the banchan (side dishes) — every single one was flavorful, well-balanced, and high quality. Nothing felt like filler. Bonus? Free refills. That’s rare and appreciated.

What really surprised me: they gave us a free serving of raw beef and marinated crab — totally unexpected and genuinely delicious. Such a thoughtful touch.

Now onto the main event: the meat. Absolutely phenomenal. I’m usually quite picky when it comes to flavor and texture, but 0C blew me away. Everything was fresh, well-marinated, and grilled to perfection.

Staff? Super attentive, kind, and always checking in without being pushy. You can tell they really care.

Pricing is more than reasonable for the quality you get. Honestly, I’d give it a solid 10/10. Already planning my next visit.

If you’re craving Korean BBQ that gets it right — this is the place.

Atmosphere: new and modern decoration. I was put in a private room and I enjoy the privacy.

ChIJJzLGyesndTEREVPYAuYwYjA.text: Very nice experience with multiple side dishes. Service is very good and the staffs are very nice. Will definitely come back.

ChIJJzLGyesndTEREVPYAuYwYjA.text: I have several times to come here and the food was really nice, the service is amazing, the staffs were super friendly.

ChIJZ7bV17IrdTER7Uy0JWbYvW8.text: I love the atmosphere of this coffee shop. It's cozy, with comfortable seating and soothing music. The coffee is delicious, and they also offer a great selection of teas. A hidden gem!

ChIJZ7bV17IrdTER7Uy0JWbYvW8.text: I was there tonight Jan 10th. The food was great.  There was a large party outside with the most beautiful girls in Vietnam.

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.author: to English the way
ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.text: I tried the Lunch Hot Set combo and had a great experience. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and quick to help with everything we needed, which made the meal even more enjoyable. The food was delicious, especially the meat fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. One small suggestion is that the meat actually tastes better without adding salt, as the natural flavor is already very good. Overall, it was a satisfying meal with excellent service. I would definitely come back again!

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.name: places/ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJX2E2R3lRRRAB
ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.author: son nguyen
ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.text: Came here for lunch with my wife, didn't have high expectations since there are so many Korean BBQ in the area. However, after first bite I will definitely come back. Everything was very fresh and the kimchi is my favorite both cooked and uncooked. I recommend to order small main dishes before seeing their side dishes. They gave me a generous amount. I underestimated the portion. I highly recommend try their pork belly. It's a must.

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.name: places/ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5T09XMU5jMVY0WTB0WldtNUxjVkI2UlRkSFluYxAB

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.text: The food and side dishes weren't bad, but I don't understand why smoking is allowed inside the restaurant. Why do Koreans smoke in Korean restaurants? There were five tables besides mine, and I couldn't understand why they were smoking

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.text: we really enjoyed the meal ^^ the staff is helpful and the banchan is generous! Will def comeback!

ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.author: Anh Duong
ChIJbazPLBEvdTER5LMoNy80Y_o.text: Found this place on google map and was decently surprised by the food and service. The space is relatively spacious, pricing is generally on the higher end but that's to be expected since it's located in district 1.

ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.name: places/ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZc0lQS3dRRRAB
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.author: Giang Than
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.text: The panchans are spice bombs, my favorites are kimchi, fermented vegetables and mashed pumpkin. The restaurant will keep refilling these small dishes for you so you know you’re in for a great dining experience. The food is fresh, there are non-marinated meat options which is a plus for me. Beef and pork taste good. The potato and meat soup are quite spicy in a palatable way. Overall, this is a place worth frequenting, check it out!

ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.name: places/ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2taTlZqaHRWRTlHVEc1a1EyeG5Xak5ZTTB3MVdtYxAB
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.author: Hanh Dinh
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.text: To me Cha Cha Cha Thảo Điền is the best Korean BBQ place in HCMc. Love the banchan with a variety of kimchis everytime we come. The service is quick and professional. Most importantly, their price is ver reasonable.

ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.name: places/ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNvNTZ5dEN3EAE
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.author: Anh Phuong Nguyen
ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.text: Spacious and comfortable space. A variety of side dishes (mainly vegetable-based banchan). Reasonable prices. Attentive service. Large and convenient parking.

ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.name: places/ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJOE5ielN3EAE

ChIJxQc0y2EndTERoN99N1VUMhE.text: We appreciated the server’s assistance with grilling, though it would be great if they could stay to finish the task without needing to be called back. The meat was slightly tough, and offering a wider variety of side dishes could enhance the dining experience.

ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.author: Trang Le
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.text: Very generous portions and the taste is 90% authentic. Staff is nice and they have rooftop seating available if you want to enjoy fresh air while grilling your bbq meats. However you can still choose to sit here if you just have the noodles. We ordered three dishes and it could easily feed 5 of us well. Highly recommend!

ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.name: places/ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfZ1pMdFFBEAE
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.author: Julian H
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.text: We ordered one of the specialties : Jajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce), along with gun-mandu and fried pork. The food was tasty, with good portion sizes and reasonable prices. However, one of the servers seemed a bit slow and distracted, even though it wasn't during the lunch rush. Overall, a nice spot for Korean food in District 2 !

ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.name: places/ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3bDVDeWtBRRAB
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.author: Lana
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.text:
I’d say this is good value for money. Costs much less than the average korean restaurants within the area but still provides everything needed for a kbbq

If you want something quick and affordable, this is the place to go

ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.name: places/ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3bnVMcTFnRRAB
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.author: Nhan To
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.text:
Affordable & satisfying Korean comfort foods. We ordered two bowls of noodles (cold & spicy seafood) and grilled pork.

Grilled pork was pleasantly seasoned and tender; this can be a great complimentary for any high-carb dishes.

As a meat lover, noodles didn’t impress me that much. However, the portion was pretty decent for its price.

400k for a light dinner is a good place to spend time sometimes.

ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.name: places/ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ/reviews/ChRDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYeUw0ehAB
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.author: Lucia Ngọc Nguyễn
ChIJO70bwAEndTERQIwTxrRrmdQ.text: Spacious restaurant, gentle and polite staff. We ordered cold noodles, spicy seafood noodles and grilled pork. The grilled pork was delicious. The noodle portion was quite large, so we shared it with 1-2 people.

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.name: places/ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUbUlyR0xBEAE

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.text: We had a yummy dinner after yoga. The small side dishes "banchan" are plentiful (I like fried sweet potato). Real taste of Korean basic meal which price is very reasonable for 3 persons

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.name: places/ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxdWNyTEtREAE
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.author: ivan Kim
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.text: Here is famous place for basic korean foods. All dish is delicious, and the staff is kind. If you want to try basic korean style food, This is the best place near here. Only one problem is.. sometimes, attitude of owner is not that good.

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.name: places/ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPcjZDdjFBRRAB
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.author: Nhi Nguyen
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.text: We had octopus, fried fish and tofu soup with oyster. Personally the octopus was a bit plan for me but the fish and soup were pretty good. They also have best kim chi. Will go back to taste crab. The menu is a little bit limited though.

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.name: places/ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxc0tmRFJ3EAE
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.author: Albert Lee
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.text: Enjoy the appetizers that they serve different than other Korean restaurants. Food taste was not bad, suitable for 1 person lunch that most dishes serves 1 bowl of rice. Price is also reasonable here. Will visit again som other time !

ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.name: places/ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNscHRtRFdREAE
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.author: Victor Huynh
ChIJHcH6sacndTERN23Gjx5SPfA.text: Nice Korean restaurant with delicious food. They offer a lot of free side dishes. It took long times to prepare and they ask customers to order 1 set / person.

ChIJI7Ft9DUndTERSLnUKgyVQR4.name: places/ChIJI7Ft9DUndTERSLnUKgyVQR4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqeGMzWnFRRRAB
ChIJI7Ft9DUndTERSLnUKgyVQR4.author: Clyde Ng
ChIJI7Ft9DUndTERSLnUKgyVQR4.text:
Korean Buffet that costs 100k per ticket flat, no VAT, no extra charge for drinks.

They also have an AC room upstairs but it seemed a bit claustrophobic so we stuck with the outdoors. They have a variety food including giant octopuses, chicken breasts, bacon slices and Teokbokki for hotpot, Gimbap, instant noodles, veggies, and some fried food. i did find that the fried food was stale, probably from being left under warm light for too long. The soda was also left out so there was minimal carbonation.

100k per ticket so I can’t complain.

ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.text: Korean food, cheap and tasty, my recommend isMandu

ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.name: places/ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNteWItdzBnRRAB
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.author: TsungHan Lu
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.text: The food is average, but the environment is tidy

ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.name: places/ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNjdTVLQWFnEAE
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.author: Minh Văn
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.text: This time I came back to Bodo and was a bit disappointed in the quality and price. I ordered 3 dishes, only the fish cake soup was ok, the rest of the spaghetti was very strange and the topokki had only a few pieces. The price increased and the amount of food also decreased, the quality was not as good as before... - fish cake soup: this dish is still the best, the taste is still as good as the first time, the fish cake was chewy, the cooking taste was ok. - Spaghetti with tomato sauce and mushrooms: the taste is very, the traditional spaghetti sauce but when cooked it made me frown. Usually tomato sauce is smooth but here I saw that the sauce was cut into chunks (big pieces like for soup), and they forgot to remove the tomato stem ***pictured). The chicken was cut into big pieces, very dry, the chicken did not absorb the flavor, the noodles tasted the same, the chicken tasted the same. The important thing is the flavor of the sauce did not go well at all. - Cheese tokbokki: this portion only has 8 rice cakes, a few slices of fish cake, 1/2 egg, delicious taste, a bit spicy, thick sauce, rich taste. . - Grilled meat kimbap: normal, unevenly rolled, sometimes with meat, sometimes without meat, delicious dipping sauce, but a bit too little... The price of the restaurant has changed, higher than a few times I've eaten before, the menu added some dishes like pasta and desserts. There are many staff, a bit sparse customers, beautiful space, warm tone restaurant is ok

ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.name: places/ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURrbmVya1NBEAE
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.author: Trang Dai
ChIJ3_GnqL0odTERJ66H7igHsww.text:
Today I found a Korean restaurant that was quite ok, the price was very reasonable and it was close to home so I went right away 😋😋😋
Three people ordered 5 dishes and were full ☺
🌵Kimchi fried rice: the rice was a bit mushy
🌵Traditional rice cake: delicious and not boring
🌵Korean stir-fried noodles: very tasty
🌵Steamed mandu: I saw many people praising this dish so I tried it and felt a bit disappointed, 3 people went but no one found it delicious
🌵Fish cake soup: the soup was delicious
The plus point is that the restaurant space is very spacious, clean and airy, the staff are very cute and enthusiastic 😀
💟 Total bill: 150k/5 dishes (due to the 30% discount code)
🌎 Bodo - Korean food 139/23 Dinh Bo Linh, Binh Thanh, HCM

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.author: Willow Phan
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.text: Delicious bbq with a of banchan, free hibicus drink, milk tea, fruit and ice-cream. Price is acceptable for the meat quality and everything you get.

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.name: places/ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZOHJYYS1RRRAB
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.author: Bruce Lin
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.text: Attentive staffs make sure to serve meat of your desired texture. They emphasize the use of whole house water filtration system, which can be a sign of quality guarantee. As a cherry on top, they also offer supercooled fresh beer.

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.name: places/ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvbWVqNWp3RRAB
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.author: Ngoc Truong
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.text:
Best Korean BBQ in the town.
The food is so good.
Definitely will come again.

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.name: places/ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNKM0l2cFdnEAE
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.author: Kaylee
ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.text:
✔️ Food: the meat!!!!!!! They age their meat so it has very juicy, tender but still chewy(?) texture to it. Amazing. I have never personally seen pork belly 'sliced' before. Their aged pork belly is sliced. Not thinly but thickly sliced! Cold noodles 냉면 was a bit too sweet and sour for me but my kids loved it. Cheese kimdchi fried rice was also good but you have to order before you finish what's on the kingstone grill because they fry the rice in front of you on the stone. I ordered mine after we turned off and cleaned everything on the stone so we had to waite quite some time to reheat the stone 😅

✔️ Staff: floor magaer is very professional and cares about customers. Grill staff is also professional and knows what she is doing. 사장님 so nice and kind!

✔️ Atmosphere: just like any other Korean BBQ place, they are open seatings and you can hear other tables 뒷자리 아저씨들이 쌍욕하시며 싸우셔서 (말로만) 좀 무서웠는데 어쩔 수 없죠. 아저씨들 욕좀 하지 마세요. 무서워요.

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.name: places/ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfMkozZk1BEAE

ChIJBZkzDXcndTERHXobAseTeUU.text: Staffs are so careful and helpful in doing all bbq for us. Reasonable price, perfect dessert of ice cream

ChIJHfLZzd8ndTERpuofYnijzOw.text: Great variety of sauces and delicious fried dishes, beautifully presented.

ChIJz22QQkQpdTERmaooOApesM0.name: places/ChIJz22QQkQpdTERmaooOApesM0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xBeFNHZG1WSEV3VDNsZlVrRlZRVTVtVVRCNk1HYxAB
ChIJz22QQkQpdTERmaooOApesM0.author: Yên Lưu Trọng
ChIJz22QQkQpdTERmaooOApesM0.text:
Accidentally stopped by the restaurant when looking for a new place. The space is full of Korean culture, the customers are mainly Korean, only my family is Vietnamese. 

Fast service, dishes are served quite quickly
My family tried 3 dishes and was full. The cold noodles were extremely delicious: a light sour taste that was very refreshing, the smooth ice stayed cold until the end of the meal, the noodles were chewy and not mushy. My baby really liked this noodle. 

Large portion, reasonable price
2 adults + 1 baby ate 3 dishes and were full. At the end of the meal, the restaurant gave us extra rice crispy soup and cinnamon water - a light spicy taste, cool to drink, very impressive. 

Friendly owner
When leaving, they were also seen off at the door and given a cake for the baby. Didn't have time to take many pictures because I was busy taking care of the baby eating. 

⭐ Summary: Quality Korean restaurant, good service, delicious food - worth trying!

ChIJUccur_gndTERnO_24mF4vwY.author: ilam luc
ChIJUccur_gndTERnO_24mF4vwY.text: The service at this restaurant is quite bad. Many dishes on the menu are covered. ​I'm giving a 4-star rating because, unfortunately, I encountered a significant lapse in cleanliness: I found ants inside the menu I was handed and a small bug on my plate. Given my history of eating here often without any previous issues, I believe these are fixable oversights, not a standard.
​Overall, this is a great place for delicious pasta and more, and I'm confident the small cleanliness issues can be resolved.

ChIJ71AzbkYvdTERvgGE88nbV_o.name: places/ChIJ71AzbkYvdTERvgGE88nbV_o/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvdVl2Skp3EAE
ChIJ71AzbkYvdTERvgGE88nbV_o.author: Hoàng Quỳnh
ChIJ71AzbkYvdTERvgGE88nbV_o.text:
Ciao Cafe & Restaurant is absolutely iconic in the Nguyen Hue walking street area. It’s almost like a signature spot for tourists, hard to miss with its bold yellow facade right in the heart of the city. If you’ve ever strolled down Nguyen Hue, you’ve definitely noticed this place, and the entrance makes for a great photo spot too.

Honestly, I’d always assumed Ciao was either overpriced or just a “touristy” spot with average food. But after finally trying it, I was blown away. The food is genuinely delicious, and the prices are actually quite reasonable, especially compared to other places nearby. Most main dishes are in the 100,000–200,000 VND range, with generous portions.

The service is great too. Staff greet you right away, pour water, and take your order at the table, very professional and attentive, giving the place a bit of an upscale feel. The only downside is that the space is pretty small, so it’s best for groups of 2–6 people. Larger groups might find it a bit cramped.

Overall, I’m definitely planning to come back. The food, especially the fried rice, is super flavorful, authentic Vietnamese taste but still very accessible for everyone. I’d give Ciao a solid 9 out of 10. Highly recommended!

ChIJPV5yS84odTERct1Z2mK1GbQ.text:
Pasta Paradise PXL is one of those places you stumble upon by accident and never quite forget. The taste hasn’t faded a bit since my first visit—it still holds that quiet confidence only good kitchens have.

Top picks: the roasted duck fillet salad, cream and bacon spaghetti, and the rolled egg fried rice—each dish feels familiar yet distinct. The steak’s fine, but the pizzas can be skipped. Prices sit comfortably in the middle, honest for what you get.

The interior feels calm and a little nostalgic, a break from Saigon’s restless hum. It’s not trying to be anything fancy, and that’s what makes it lovely. A small gem tucked away in the city, waiting for someone else to find it the way I did.

ChIJte1xu9stdTERY7Sg1lFn1TQ.author: Ngô Nguyễn Như Thủy
ChIJte1xu9stdTERY7Sg1lFn1TQ.text: Today was my second time visiting Go Gelato and it impressed me just as much as the first. From the first moment, Go Gelato makes a strong impression  with its pastel-toned interior and warm golden lights. Each detail of the decoration is carefully curated, creating a space that feels both modern and cozy where you just want to sit back and chill for hours. In addition, the highlight of the restaurant is definitely its gelato which is smooth, creamy and pleasantly sweet with every flavor tasting amazing, from classic vanilla and chocolate to more unique options such as green mango or salted plum. Another point worth noting is that Go Gelato is not just about ice cream but also serves equally impressive Italian dishes, from wood-fired pizza, creamy pasta, all of which are made with quality ingredients and topped generously. What's more, the staff are incredibly friendly, always ready to recommend dishes, serving with warm smiles and attentive service. Overall, I’d honestly recommend Go Gelato as a place everyone should visit at least once for the food and the overall experience.

We opted for a gnocchi dish where the sauce had split unfortunately and a penne dish, they weren’t bad by any means but just a bit bland

Overall a 7/10 for the experience

ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.text:
If you’re looking for a dining experience that combines culinary artistry with impeccable service, Truffle & Co Restaurant is an absolute must-visit. We went on a Thanksgiving night so there’s that.

Ambiance: The restaurant boasts a sophisticated yet cozy vibe, with elegant decor that makes you feel high-end bistro without being stuffy. Perfect setting for a special night out or even a casual dinner with friends.

Food: The menu is an absolute standout. The focus on truffle-infused dishes is a game changer for anyone who appreciates earthy flavors.

Service: The staff was knowledgeable and friendly, offering excellent recommendations without being overbearing.

Overall Experience: A top-tier dining experience. It’s clear that a lot of thought and care goes into every aspect of the meal. Whether you’re a truffle enthusiast or just someone looking for a unique culinary adventure, this place will not disappoint.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy a luxurious and memorable meal!

I have had such a great experience here with my friend for her birthday party. The restaurant offered basic birthday decoration, which we found quite cute. We tried different dishes in the menu, and I must say that we were satisfied with all of them. The attitude of the employees was amazing.

For dishes with truffle (not sure if it's real truffle or just the essential) in it, the flavor was really strong, and I must admit that I love them.

ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.name: places/ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sRE0zVlVkakpJTTI5ek5FTndUV1pCTkhSamJrRRAB
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.author: Hong Anh Pham
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.text:
The food didn't meet our expectations. The pizza's thin crust was too crispy, and the combination of Vietnamese toppings—fried onions and pork floss—didn't work for us. Additionally, we had hoped for a more pronounced truffle flavor in the other dishes.
But overall, the experience was nice and their service was excellent.

ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.name: places/ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tNeGFuRlJhM0ZGYWpaS1JsSldZMUpMV1VSQ1NGRRAB
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.author: Tommy Truong
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.text: Place is good. The truffle wasn't as strong as i expected. The carpaccio was good. Fries should come with more truffle sauce, very little for the fries portion

ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.name: places/ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvLXUzd0h3EAE
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.author: Huyen Anh Trinh
ChIJUQqLZlEvdTERLrTzlEp3vU4.text:
ad dinner at Truffle & Co. and overall, the experience was decent. The restaurant ambiance is well-designed—cozy, stylish, and comfortable for an evening out. The staff were attentive and polite, which I truly appreciated throughout the meal.

The food presentation was quite nice, with attention given to plating and visual appeal. However, I personally felt that the dishes lacked the sense of freshness and didn’t quite reflect the feel of freshly cooked, made-to-order meals. Some items gave off more of a ready-made or pre-prepared impression, which left me a bit disappointed in terms of overall food quality.

While the atmosphere and service were on point, I would have hoped for a more satisfying and freshly prepared dining experience from the kitchen side.

ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.name: places/ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GMFRqVmpWekprTld4dVNsVmpiRzFWUWtVMmExRRAB
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.author: Trang Le
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.text: I’ve been here many times and the food is always excellent—fresh, flavorful, and consistent. However, service could really use improvement. Staff are often inattentive, which affects the overall experience. Still worth visiting for the food, but hoping to see better service soon.

ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.name: places/ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkTmFIaEJhMWt3YjNaQ1JFRnVXakJPWWt4alZVRRAB
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.author: Paulin Jeremy
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.text:
Tucked away in the heart of District 2, this Italian restaurant is a true culinary gem. The pizza might take a little time to arrive, but trust me—it’s worth every second of the wait. The dough is spot-on: light, airy, and full of flavor, with that unmistakable taste that transports you straight to Italy.

The pasta dishes are equally impressive, crafted with care and bursting with authentic Italian flair. You can tell the kitchen takes pride in every plate they serve.

If there’s one small bémol, it’s the side offerings—breadsticks and pizza dough served alongside are a bit too dry and plain, with the sticks leaning toward overly hard. But honestly, that’s a minor note in an otherwise fantastic dining experience.

The ambiance adds to the charm: cozy, welcoming, and perfect for a relaxed evening out. Whether you're a pizza purist or just craving a taste of Italy, this spot delivers.

ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.name: places/ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214bVdrZHpOVzlVTWtJME1HSmxkbVZ6TkVsV1RHYxAB
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.author: Anna Pham
ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.text: Everything is perfect except the pasta, gnocchi is overcooked and the sauce was not impressive, I like the cheese truffle pizza and salad should be more rocket to balance the taste.

ChIJ9Z0ZRiImdTERhg22J1qFLdg.text: Special place! I may it a point to come here because of all things they make great Instagram Reels. Very cute sense of humor. Well, the food is also impressive and I’m so glad I traveled out of D1 to experience it. I ordered the muscle app and a Toscan style (thick) noodle with a Gorgonzola sauce. Absolutely delicious! Staff was great and the atmosphere is sweet and simple outdoor seating which is covered thankfully because the sky opened up while I was there. Can be a tricky place to find but that just adds to the fun!

Fantastic for fresh pasta.

The restaurant looks a bit hidden even though on the main street but definitely worth trying. I highly recommend trying the truffle pizza, smells extremely great. The roasted cashew is definitely a nice touch on the pizza.
I am very happy with their food, services and prices.

ChIJZ5iWyUAvdTERYexxsHGC9Qs.text: Absolute rip-off! I ordered via GRAB. 75K for 2 tablespoons of Mac & cheese. 65K for the spaghetti bolognaise. ChIJZ5iWyUAvdTERYexxsHGC9Qs.text: I order pasta from this place often through GRAB. I feel like this place might seem misleading, but it has some of the best pastas here in Vietnam. The flavor of their sauces are delicious! Portions and price are more than reasonable, compared to other places who sell pasta. I order the pesto, creamy mushroom and tomato based pastas the most. I also get the cheesy fries and cheesy corn for extra sides.. Super good-- you will not be disappointed.

ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.text: Booked here for lunch and catch up with a friend and the food was lovely, service friendly and drinks tasty! I had the calamari, sea bass, and the Silk Smoothie. I enjoyed the whole experience and recommend it.

ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.text: After renovation, I think the place is greatly upgraded. ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.name: places/ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oU2VEY3dUME5hZGsxNk1EaFhka3hRTVRrMllYYxAB
ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.author: Duong Maggie
ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.text:
3 stars for the food but given this is restaurant in a 5-star hotel , it only deserves 2 stars overall.
I'm a die-hard fanatic for Italian food , so I was excited to try out Basilico.

I went there for lunch and the restaurant was packed as the space was quite small.

Now onto the food , I can't believe how subpar everything I had.. We ordered Burrata salad , 200g steak tenderloin with truffle mash , carbonara ,  seafood spaghetti, and tiramisu.

The most disappinting dishes were the pastas. They were SO bad. Both were overcooked and mushy. The pasta shape looked like cooked ramen lol, and despite I ordered 1 spaghetti and 1 fetuccine - both of my pastas came out to be the exact shape. The seafood w/ tomato sauce pasta was so salty , had too much sauce. The carbonara was so bland , I think they forget to put any seasoning in. I haven't had bad pasta in a while !!

The burrata salad was alright but quite bland. The steak was quite mealy, but the truffle mash potato was tasty.

Overally, mediocre food and preparation , awful pasta. My bill total was 2.1VNDmillions PRE VAT and SVC , which was super expensive for the quality.... luckily I had my Marriott club vouchers so the total came down to 600k.

The Opera restaurant in Park Hyatt provides a much upscale, quite atmosphere, with nicely cooked Italian food at the same price range.

ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.name: places/ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGeGVIbElObWxXV1dKRWQyOXdjamM0ZUhSRGVVRRAB
ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.author: Tang Ricky
ChIJG9DAt0kvdTERjWTOy_-hQyQ.text:
⭐️ Great Italian Food & Amazing Service at Basilico!

I had a great experience at Basilico! The food was delicious – especially the seafood risotto, creasar salad and four cheese pizza (which i forgot to take a picture). Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor. I also ordered a tiramisu for dessert and you should try it too!

The place has a cozy, relaxed vibe – perfect for dinner with friends or a date night.

Big shoutout to Khang, our server. He was super friendly, helpful, and really made us feel welcome. Great service makes all the difference!

Highly recommend!!!

ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E.name: places/ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3c3BIeU9nEAE
ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E.author: Ray Tan
ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E.text: Serves really nice pastas! Ok they may not be traditionally italian style but at the very least the pastas are al dente. Ordered the Bo Luc Lac Sate (Vnd39k)which is some kinda beef spaghetti aglio olio and their signature scotch egg(Vnd35k). The aglio olio tasted really decent for the price. The scotch egg is gd as well! Yolk still relatively runny. Nice layer of meat wrapped around it the way it should be. Not the best ive had but really no complaints for the price! Generally super value for money! My kinda place for comfort food anytime of the day!

ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E.name: places/ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6MS1LVlZ3EAE

ChIJSURFHx8vdTERd71jcaqAI0E.text:
This restaurant has become our "go to" when we crave for good Italian pasta.

We had been here twice in a week because the food is good and the price is great. Food: 5 stars

Services: fantastic welcoming, helpful staffs, they gave us the menu and an order form to fill out (this is to avoid any misunserstanding), then patiently waiting faraway for us to give back the form. We really like it when the server paid attention to us but not standing too close waiting for the order made us feel rush. Services: 5 stars

Atmosphere: nice, very busy but good flow, we took off one star because there is no airconditioning, even though there were many fans, airconditioning is still a must for us personally, 4 stars

We will be back, will tell all our friends about this restaurant because the food is good and the price is right.

ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.name: places/ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tzd09UZzBZVnBqUlMxc2VsUmpZWFUzUmpCd1kzYxAB
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.author: Steve Nguyen
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.text:
If you're craving real Italian flavor, this place delivers the full experience. Every bite and sip transported me straight to Italy!

☕️ Coffee – Smooth, rich, and full-bodied. Easily one of the best Italian espressos I’ve had outside of Italy. No bitterness, just perfectly roasted beans.

🍕 Pizza – Thin, crispy crust with that wood-fired char. The tomato sauce was fresh and vibrant, and the cheese melted just right. Simple ingredients done perfectly.

🍝 Lasagna – Layers of love. Homemade pasta sheets, savory meat sauce, creamy béchamel, and just the right amount of cheese. Comfort food at its finest.

🍨 Gelato – Silky, not too sweet, and bursting with flavor. Incredibly creamy and authentic.

The staff was warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere felt like a cozy Italian trattoria. Whether you're a foodie or just looking for a satisfying meal, this spot is a hidden gem.

Grazie mille for such a wonderful dining experience! 🇮🇹💖

ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.name: places/ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2d09Tc2JnEAE

ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.text: A very beautiful restaurant and tasty Italian food. With the swimming pool surround , I have felt like I was in the resort . It’s very relaxing, peaceful when to sit in this restaurant. The owner is very friendly and welcoming her guests . The waitress and waiters are English speaking fluently , i recommend you to come to enjoy real Italian food in this restaurant

ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.name: places/ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2NThtMUZ3EAE
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.author: Rose ann Diones
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.text: first of all  I was amazed at this place because it was a great place to hang out with the family.  we went with my family to relax here.  their italian food is delicious, the taste is unique, it gives good vibes.  also the meal fee is worth it because the quality of their food is good ,the staff are very accomodating and attentive, it's easy to communicate with them because they know how to speak English.  their coffee is unique and delicious.  you will feel the Italian breeze when you are in this place.  I would highly recommend it.

ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.name: places/ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2dElYUzRBRRAB
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.author: Bích Ngọc Lý
ChIJb_FPjeIldTERJ-8ui4MOpqI.text:
An exceptional original, a truly pride of Italian cuisine. The Roman-style pizza was a slice of heaven. Each bite was like a love letter from Italy, with authentic ingredients that made me feel like I was dining right in the heart of Rome.

The toppings were so fresh, I half expected them to sing “O Sole Mio” as they arrived at my table. Every flavor was perfectly balanced, from the tangy tomato sauce to the creamy mozzarella that melted in my mouth. And let’s not forget the crust, yes, it deserves a second mention, so light and airy, I almost considered taking it home and framing it.

It wasn’t just a meal; it was an experience. This is the place if you’re looking for pizza that feels like a Roman holiday for your taste buds. Bravo to the chefs—you’ve earned a standing ovation.

ChIJqW6p4I4ldTERvFCKmSW2-pg.author: John Nguyen
ChIJqW6p4I4ldTERvFCKmSW2-pg.text:
•	Atmosphere: 4/5
Mamma Mia is in a beautiful, picturesque location right by the Saigon River. We visited with another couple for Valentine’s Day and really enjoyed the outdoor seating with the river view. However, if you’re sensitive to smells, you might want to avoid sitting right by the water, as there are occasional odors coming from the river. Additionally, multiple nearby restaurants have live bands, and the music tends to overlap, which can make for a slightly chaotic soundscape rather than a relaxing ambiance.
•	Service: 3.5/5
The staff was clearly working hard, as we noticed them constantly running around attending to tables. However, the service felt somewhat disorganized. Our starters arrived almost at the same time as our main courses, except for the seafood BBQ plate, which came out 15-20 minutes after everything else. By the time it arrived, we had already finished our main dishes. Getting the bill was another challenge—it took another 15-20 minutes before we could settle up. Sitting by the river also made it difficult to flag down a server when needed.
•	Food: 3/5
We ordered a variety of dishes, including the Greek and Thai beef salads, sweet and sour fish, pizza, chicken pesto pasta, and the seafood BBQ plate. Overall, the food was mediocre in flavor. The chicken pesto pasta was quite bland,I had to request salt to add some flavor. The pizza had a cardboard-like texture, and while the pizza itself was edible, it wasn’t anything special. The Greek salad was heavily overdressed and had very little feta or olives, which made it disappointing. The sweet and sour fish was the most flavorful and enjoyable dish of the meal.

Final Thoughts:
Mamma Mia is worth visiting for the beautiful location and relaxing outdoor seating, but be aware that the food leans more toward Vietnamese-style Italian rather than authentic Italian cuisine. The service, while well-intentioned, could use better organization, and the food quality doesn’t fully match the stunning setting. If you prioritize the atmosphere over the dining experience, you might still enjoy a visit.

ChIJo46i-bYodTERhgucn5IrgVk.author: M
ChIJo46i-bYodTERhgucn5IrgVk.text:
I didn't see a clear sign about a buffet or the price, so I just went by other reviews. Maybe it's in Vietnamese?

But, this is in fact, a cheap vegetarian buffet (30K/$1.15).

They have quite a large selection for a veg-buffet and especially considering the price. I have had cheaper ones and in particular one in Thủ Đức was 20K (if I remember correctly) and tasted very good if you came at the right time.

Maybe that's the same for here. Most of the dishes were cold or lukewarm. They had multiple tofu dishes, which I like, but they tasted average. Again, most weren't warm.

The best one (the most popular for everyone) was mixed with tomatoes. I only took a little (one, to test it and two, to let others have some), but I waited about 10-15 mins for them to bring out some more after it was emptied and they brought the tray to the kitchen. Either they don't replenish, or maybe it's really slow. They never brought out any more and just rearranged the existing trays.

Most of the stuff didn't taste exactly fresh, to me. I personally liked only 3 or 4 items. The price is very cheap, though.

I think Quán Chay Lá and Quán An Chay (both 50K) are much better. Chay Lá is about 2 km away and right next door to another buffet, I didn't think was that good, so try the correct one. And An Chay has a much smaller selection, but is probably higher quality than Chay Lá, about 1.5 km away. A little further away is the best around (for lunch) I've tried so far, An Duyên (also 50K).

ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c.name: places/ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGTFpreG5Wbmt6VGtobk0yNXpTMFJpUkdaVVRFRRAB
ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c.author: Kevin Dinh Nam
ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c.text:
A Mixed Plate: Great Food, But Service Needs a Serious Rethink

My partner and I recently dined here to celebrate our anniversary, and I must start by giving a huge shout-out for the effort made by the staff to arrange a lovely setting for us—that personal touch was truly appreciated.

Now, let's talk about the food. The creamy truffle seafood pasta was excellent. The truffle aroma was clear without being overwhelming, and the addition of grilled seafood made it truly special. We also thoroughly enjoyed the starter of caramelized onion with bread and cream cheese; it was a lovely combination of sweet and savory. Unfortunately, the other dishes we tried, specifically the steak and the melon parma ham, were not that good and felt like a miss.

However, the major drawback that significantly impacted our experience was the service related to the set menu. It's clear the team lacks experience in serving multi-course menus. Courses were served based on a predetermined, rigid order, completely disregarding the eating speed of the guests. For example, if I finished the first course before another guest, I had to wait for them to finish, and then they were served their second course before me, just because that guest were served the first course first. This meant we were often sitting idle, the mood of the night relied on the eating speed of other guests.

I tried to provide constructive feedback to a service staff member, explaining that timing the courses based on a table's eating speed is critical for a set menu. To my disappointment, her ego was far too high. She was dismissive, refused to listen, offered non-sense excuses, and tried to blame the kitchen instead of acknowledging the fundamental flaw in their service process. Her over-confidence and insistence that she "knew it all," despite clearly not understanding basic set menu service etiquette, was incredibly off-putting.

In summary: The kitchen shows promise with standout dishes like the truffle pasta. But a great meal can be ruined by poor service. Management needs to seriously train their staff on proper multi-course service flow and address the unprofessional, high-ego attitude displayed by some of their team members.

ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJoePl0UsvdTEROxNnzJ8tN6c.text:
Follow @bredgyeats on instagram for more food posts!

No, this isn’t your typical “Western” restaurant inside some mall.
nonê is an intimate and moody environment that sets the stage for delectable Italian-style delights. Perfectly executed and expertly seared, the salmon flakes apart with a gentle push of the fork, while the skin gives a crackly crisp texture and an indulgent, fatty mouth feel. Accompanying the fish is a wedge of lemon that accentuates the natural aromas of the salmon, while the sriracha butter sauce is undeniably addictive - blending richness, spice and umami together, and I’m glad they gave me a generous amount, too. The smooth butternut squash puree and roasted broccolini round out the dish.

Thoroughly swirled in a gentle truffle cream sauce, the fettuccine noodles cling onto the earthy and silky lusciousness like its life depends on it. Paired with smoky and crisp pieces of shrimp, squid and mollusks, the overall dish is light and doesn’t sit heavy in your stomach. An inventive take on shrimp cocktail, poached shrimp are paired with a crispy apple salad and topped with a mild cocktail sauce, served with tortilla chips for a crunchy texture contrast.

I had the pumpkin soup and it's so delicious. Crab pasta is very rich and creamy, well balance taste. The restaurant is small, cozy, especially warm welcoming thanks to the attentive servers. Highly recommend!

The ambience is amazing, and the staff are extremely friendly and approachable.
Overall, service is impeccable, and the food is great!!!!
Definitely recommend this to everyone, a meat lover or not!

ChIJE7y7lUYvdTERU84Rs8JV3Vs.text:
We dined here when we stayed at the Reverie Saigon Hotel. It's located right on the right side of the hotel.
They have a ramp for wheelchair. Very thoughtful. They also have outside seats.
When we were there it was quite loud because there was a party reservation inside. Not a big deal. The staffs let us know beforehand and willing to accommodate us other seats if the noise was an issue to us.
Service was on point.
We liked the Lobster salad. It was interesting because it was served cold with grapefruit. The dressing was quite nice. It's salty and very similar to the Vietnamese dipping sauce used for fresh fruits.
The pizza was good not excellent.
Forgot to to pictures of other food but everything was nice overall.
Great location and fun to grab a quick drink as well.

If you get the chance, you should definitely check out the restaurant.

ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4.text: The second time I’ve eaten here, and it was 5 stars again. Finally, the Pad Thai is a comfort dish and always makes a Thai meal complete.  Prices are very affordable too

ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4.author: Hoang Anh (ZD)
ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4.text:
Thân thiện vs gđ có em bé nhỏ, đồ Thái okiela

This small Thai restaurant offers medium-to-good Thai food and great hospitality, making it perfect for young families. We visited with two adults and our 11-month-old baby, and the staff were very supportive. They quickly set up a high chair and provided non-flavored fried chips and a plastic bowl for our baby to taste while his mom chose the order.

We tried Pad Thai, seafood glass noodles salad, grilled pork skewers (xiên heo nướng), and Thai iced tea (trà thái hồng). The food was served quickly and tasted good, rating about 7.5/10. You can adjust the chilies to your preference.

The total cost was 400,000 VND, including tax.The space is cozy and clean. We will definitely return for the excellent service and good food.

ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4.name: places/ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYbXZiQ0lBEAE

ChIJSaL4mVUndTERgLtnEm0BRU4.text:
Compared to the fancy Thai place I went to a couple days prior, this place is more casual. The menu is much bigger here than the other one. Although the quality of the food is a little lower.

That being said, I would probably be more likely to return to this one than the other one. I probably liked the food more at this one, but it tasted more standard.

The wings (120K/$4.75) were pretty small. Some were even smaller than the others - I don't know how many total (6-8)... The Tom Yum flavor was the first I've had for chicken wings, so it was interesting.. if the wings were a little bigger and a little less dry, they would have been really good.

The pad see ew noodles (120K) were also a first for me (I didn't know what they were), I might not be able to distinguish it from pad Thai. I think the pad kee mao noodles are the same except spicy (I don't know, though). The chicken verison is good. The portion looked a little small, but I ended up being ok.

There is 8% VAT, so my total for the two was comparable to the other place's one dish I had.

ChIJJx_vC4MvdTERzQzfO-UvLww.text:
Beautiful ambiance, great rolls, but disappointing sashimi
Visited Naked Sushi for dinner on a Wednesday evening. The location is tucked into a quiet, dead-end street, which adds a hidden-gem vibe. The interior is sleek, modern, and well-designed. It was fairly busy by 6 PM, and the staff were attentive and fast. It’s also kid-friendly — they had both a booster and a highchair available.

What we ordered:
•	Kiku Sashimi (899k): Unfortunately, this was the low point. The sashimi tasted waterlogged and flavorless — like fish that had been thawed poorly or sat on ice too long. Texture was soggy and lacked the clean, buttery freshness you’d expect at this price.
•	Soft Shell Crab Roll & Salmon Unagi Roll: Both were delicious — well-balanced flavors and great texture.
•	Grilled Saba: Just okay, not memorable.
•	Beef Sukiyaki: Underwhelming. Lacked richness and felt flat in flavor.
•	Sushi Combo (with Toro Roll): The toro was unpleasantly fishy, not the melt-in-your-mouth experience it should be.

Overall, the sushi rolls were solid, but the sashimi and hot dishes were hit or miss. I’d come back for the rolls and the atmosphere — just not for the premium sashimi.

ChIJJx_vC4MvdTERzQzfO-UvLww.text:
