However, the food quality was good with fresh ingredients, and I was especially happy with the desserts. I tried three: sakura cake, matcha ice cream, and creme brulee —all rich creamy taste, soft and not too sweet.

I arrived 15 minutes late for my reservation and informed the restaurant, the staff quickly arranged a table for me after 10 mins more. Throughout dinner, two staff members (Hào & An) and a supervisor were attentively taking care of our table and orders. The seating area was also spacious and comfortable, not overcrowding. I spent about 1.2 million VND for a meal for two, and received a complimentary facial gift voucher for the spa upstairs.

Overall, it was a good dining experience with professional, thoughtful service but cannot give 5 stars this time because I think the quality of the japanese dishes could be improved.

ChIJnWvOUj8vdTER24zFOQEDfC8.author: Yani G-H
ChIJnWvOUj8vdTER24zFOQEDfC8.text:
Sadly very average. TLDR = Go to Sol across the road or a smaller local place for a much better time.
Reviews looked promising so we were interested in trying it out, but everything was not very good. The vibe was off & the staff were disorganised with multiple people coming to ask if we wanted to order, after we had already ordered with another staff member. This happened about 3 times, as we were ordering in stages. We ordered some drinks & some sushi to start. The food was bland & it was too loud to talk to start with. I've had better sushi from a shopping mall at home in Australia. Then a band set up & started playing. It was loud to the point it was actually painful through all of the venue speakers. A real shame because the band was actually really good! No negativity for the band here, just the venue for how they set it up & handled it. To add context I am a musician who has played some very loud rock/punk/metal shows, so I can confidently say that the volume was set to a level that would cause hearing damage & definitely not something suitable for any restaurant. Okonmiyaki arrived, it was tiny & bland too. I asked a staff member if it was possible to turn the inside dining speaker volume down a little but their response was that they had no control over it. So I asked if we could move to a different table where it's not crazy loud & it just seemed to confuse an extra 2-3 staff members in the process. We ended up at a table outside, where it was still painfully loud. Some tempura arrived. Not sure how to make tempura this tasteless but they succeeded. We ate a little bit & decided to leave because everything was so bad. We didn't finish the food & after we had paid & left, I realised that we had also ordered & not received karaage chicken. Guess the missed chicken on the bill is my fault for not checking more carefully but a reasonable service probably could have caught it too. Long story short - if you like loud music, find out when they're doing it here, eat somewhere else & bring earplugs

ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM.text: Stumbled upon this super cute Japanese restaurant after walking through the alley. What caught my eyes was the Happy Hour! ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM.name: places/ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xU01WVm5lVVppV2trd2JubFdWRXRhZWpsc1FsRRAB
ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM.author: Kenny Tsang
ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM.text:
Tried this Japanese spot today and ordered their yakitori. Overall, pretty solid. Everything was grilled to order, super fragrant the moment it arrived at the table. The chicken skewers were juicy and tender, seasoned just right. The beef tongue had a nice bite to it, surprisingly good. Even the veggie skewers were flavorful and not oily at all.👍😏

The place is clean with a cozy vibe, and the staff were friendly and attentive — always helping refill water and clearing plates. Prices are mid-range and match the quality.

If you’re into yakitori, this place is definitely worth checking out. I’d come back again.

My favorite sushi spot in Saigon!
Izakaya is truly my favorite sushi place in Saigon. I’ve tried many others, even the fancier ones, but the atmosphere here is so unique, friendly, and cozy that now I only want to have my sushi here. The fish is incredibly fresh - it just melts in your mouth. Absolutely love this place!

ChIJp3B-RlgvdTERbx6vcEa0WjM.text: Place is nice! Food is also decent (soups are just ok, not as flavorful. Got tempura, soy marinated tuna- nice and soft!, salmondon and ara soup. ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.text: My uncle was referred this place by a trusted friend, and so we went! The owner, Van, is very passionate about his craft. I was a bit skeptical about eating sushi in Vietnam, but considering its nearness to Japan, all of the fish was actually so incredibly fresh and delicious. You get tons of premium cuts for a great price. We had a great time and would highly recommend to everyone!

ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.name: places/ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sSGQySkhkVjlSVm5wVlZsSjRTbXhmVHpOMFJFRRAB
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.author: Ofer En
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.text:
I never give less than perfect score unless there is something really wrong.

Food was amazing and divine, but the service was a total flop.
We waited just 50 minutes for our first dishes to arrive. And had to wait again and again for any kind of attention.

3 out of 8 dishes were completely forgotten and were never brought to the table.

To top it all off, we sat for another 40 minutes at the end because no one came to check on us.

ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.name: places/ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aeFoxQlFiekJYV1VaaE4yTmZjV3RSV1ZZeE5YYxAB
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.author: Eric Stevelman
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.text:
Here’s a revised version of the review, emphasizing the chef’s exceptional qualities and the intimate, personalized experience, while incorporating your sentiment about wanting to give more than 5 stars:
This dining experience was an unparalleled 10/10, a culinary symphony that left us in awe. Imagine the artistry of omakase seamlessly intertwined with the abundance of a buffet—a perfect union that felt like a culinary love story. The chef, a true maestro, elevated the evening to extraordinary heights with his unmatched skill and passion. His attention to every detail was nothing short of remarkable: each dish was a masterpiece, meticulously crafted with precision and creativity, showcasing flavors that danced on the palate. The fish, impossibly fresh and vibrant, was a testament to his commitment to quality, while every plate was presented with such elegance that it felt like a work of art, almost too stunning to eat.
What made this experience truly special was the chef’s ability to make it feel deeply personal. Despite the bustling energy of the restaurant, his care for every dish and every guest created an intimate, almost private dining experience, as if the entire evening was curated just for us. His warmth and dedication shone through in every interaction, making us feel seen, valued, and celebrated. On our final night in Vietnam, which also marked our anniversary, this restaurant transformed our evening into an unforgettable memory. If we could give more than five stars, we would—words cannot fully capture our gratitude for the chef and his team, who made this night so profoundly special and etched it forever in our hearts.

ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.name: places/ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxUFgzVjNibkJZVUdKMFUyVTFiVTVLYzJrdFZIYxAB
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.author: Евгения Gin
ChIJC2Ofrd4vdTER8RCTCDCyusY.text:
Ichihana Sushi is a place you’ll want to come back to again and again!
The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and you can feel that the owner, who is also the head chef, puts his heart into every dish. He’s incredibly attentive and caring – always checking in with guests, recommending what to try, and describing each dish with such passion that you’ll want to order the whole menu!

The sushi is exceptionally fresh with perfectly balanced ingredients, the rolls are a harmony of flavor and presentation, and the plating rivals that of the best restaurants in Japan. Everything here is done with genuine care for the guests, from the service to the smallest details of the interior.

This isn’t just a restaurant – it’s a true culinary experience created by someone who truly loves what they do. Highly recommended!

ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.name: places/ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkWFUzbHhUR1ZWV1dobFdsUllibEJSZWprNWRYYxAB
ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.author: Min Min
ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.text:
I came here because the restaurant name sounded reputable, but it turned out to be one of the most disappointing dining experiences I’ve had in a while. The overall food quality is mediocre at best. Most of the ingredients taste far from fresh — you can immediately tell that the seafood and meat are not handled properly. The grilled salmon, in particular, was extremely salty and unpleasant to eat. Even the rice and side dishes lacked flavor and quality, which is surprising for a restaurant that tries to present itself as a Japanese-style place.

Another major issue is how the restaurant keeps pushing fake promotions. Staff repeatedly approach customers to ask for 5-star reviews in exchange for a free grilled frozen scallop. The scallop itself is clearly not fresh, likely just defrosted and reheated. This kind of behavior feels dishonest and manipulative — they’re more focused on boosting their ratings than actually improving the food or service. It gives a very bad impression of their business ethics.

Overall, this is not a restaurant I would recommend. The quality is poor, the ingredients are low-grade, and the way they pressure customers for fake reviews is unacceptable. If you’re looking for real Japanese food or even decent grilled dishes in Phan Xích Long, there are many better options around. I definitely won’t be coming back.

ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.name: places/ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWdVpVTkVRemhvY0VOS1JEZDRWVEF3T1RjMFZHYxAB
ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.author: nguyen son
ChIJQah-PmwpdTER3-PlSHgA4I0.text:
​Unatoto on Phan Xich Long is an absolute must-try for any fan of Japanese cuisine, especially if you love unagi (eel)! I instantly felt transported to a cozy Izakaya in Japan the moment I walked in—the traditional wooden decor and soft lantern lighting create such a warm and authentic atmosphere.
​The star of the show, of course, is the Unagi Don. The eel is grilled over charcoal, giving it a wonderfully smoky aroma and a perfectly crisp exterior, while the meat inside remains incredibly tender and melt-in-your-mouth soft. The savory-sweet tare sauce is rich and perfectly balanced with the Japanese rice. At such a reasonable price point, this quality is unmatched in the city!
​Beyond the unagi, their yakitori skewers are excellent, and they have a great selection of sake. The service was fast, friendly, and attentive, making the whole dining experience delightful. If you’re looking for high-quality, authentic Japanese comfort food with a lively Izakaya vibe, look no further. Five stars all the way - I can’t wait to come back!

ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.name: places/ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25kRlIycHRWVk5yTkhwMmJrMXBiM2gyYjNJd1JWRRAB
ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.author: Nguyen Thanh Phi
ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.text:
Machiya – A Hidden Gem on Nguyen Hue Walking Street

Perfect location — tucked neatly inside a small old apartment on the first floor, yet the moment you step in, you’ll go “wow”!
The indoor space is warm, cozy, and always smells clean and pleasant. There are also two small outdoor tables facing the walking street — ideal for people-watching or enjoying a smoke.

The food is super fresh and delicious, especially the sashimi and signature dishes, all beautifully prepared with authentic Japanese taste and Machiya’s own twist.
Staff are polite, attentive, and genuinely kind, which makes the whole experience even better.

👉 If you’re looking for a quiet yet vibrant Japanese dining spot right in the heart of Saigon, Machiya is absolutely worth a visit.
Highly recommend

ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.text:
This is the first time I’ve gotten sushi where the rice was noticeably bad (gluey, sweet, no rice vinegar) & the fish was so unevenly sliced that it was visible. My boyfriend, who has only taken one Airbnb experience sushi making class, is able to slice sashimi-grade fish better.   To be clear, the quality of the seafood is fine- it’s just the rice (which, alas, is actually the most important part) and the preparation of the fish (I do not want tendons).

The only thing we enjoyed was the sea grapes seaweed & takowasa.

ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.text: It was a nice experience at Matsuri, overlooking Bach Dang harbor. Food is high quality and fresh, up to the true Japanese standards. ChIJ66-d5TYvdTER2zGgvZzxvI0.text: Quality of the fish here is fresh, definitely suggest giving the scallops dish a try! Service was a bit slow even though we were the only ones in the restaurant for quite some time. It took well over 30 minutes for our cocktails to be made. Overall, this is a good restaurant but I would say to only dine here if you aren't short on time.

ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.author: Nga Le
ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.text: Quite possibly the worst katsu don I’ve ever had. The rice and breading were soggy and wet but the pork was so tough. The match was so bad, probably the lowest grade of matcha ever. The staff was nice though but I won’t be coming back here for sure. The sushi was alright and nicely decorated though.

ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.name: places/ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJeWR0TEhMajlQdFl3EAE

ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.text: This spot delivers delicious and affordable sashimi that's definitely their strong suit. Other dishes are okay, but the sashimi is where they shine. The kitchen and service staffs are kinda slow though.

ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.name: places/ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOd1h6aGpWRWxaVEdkRE4xZ3pSa3RvWVdaVk0zYxAB

Have to leave this 1 star.

Don’t come here.

ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.text: Nice restaurant with great service and atmosphere. We were even gifted a complimentary sushi set for a national holiday. ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.name: places/ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMzNzhIalZREAE
ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.author: Tee Wang
ChIJNZEE8o0vdTERS7A5vjN6gRk.text: I love this little sushi place so much. Food was fresh and delicious. Staff are very friendly. The restaurant is nicely decorated and love the atmosphere. Well definitely come back the next time to try the rest of the menu.

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.name: places/ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2taSVEyNDViREZCYVZsSFIxSTJSbFp1VUVKRVExRRAB
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.author: Tim Doan
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.text:
One of the must-try Japanese restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City!
We came in for dinner on a Tuesday night — the food and service were both on point.

We ordered the grilled crab cake, Hamachi with ponzu sauce (very spicy with Thai chili), Hotate Aburi, baked oysters, and fried Australian beef with rice. Everything was fresh, well-presented, and delicious.

Prices are on the higher side, but the quality makes it worth it. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a solid Japanese dining experience in the city!

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.name: places/ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqNGJfLVZBEAE

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.text:
This place offers a cozy and tranquil atmosphere with soothing music that creates a spa-like experience. The food is meticulously prepared and beautifully presented, making it an excellent choice for both family outings and romantic dates.

However, it's worth noting that the prices are significantly higher compared to other sushi restaurants.

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.name: places/ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMMHF1dlJ3EAE
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.author: Madeleine Cao
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.text: Came before last order at 9pm, referred by a friend but didnt get my veggie omakase as expected. I got a vegan salad and udon which i believe it's not their strength. Cozy place with Japanese style even owned by a Vietnamese. It's not fair if i judge the food but based on other reviews, it must be good place for sushi & sashimi lovers. (Sorry for the photos, i forgot to take picture).

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.name: places/ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRN2NyTEt3EAE
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.author: Don Huynh
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.text: I thought Hokaido was good until I came to Yume.  My favorite sea urchin was available and super fresh.  Other sashimi were so good and tasty.  This will be my go-to when I want sushi for sure.

ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.name: places/ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoN082Q293RRAB
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.author: Scott Nguyen
ChIJKwqdKxEvdTERYslf53cgDR4.text:
Yume Restaurant offers a cozy and inviting dining experience, known for its focus on Japanese comfort food with a touch of fusion influences. The ambiance is warm and casual, making it an excellent spot for a relaxed meal with friends or family. The menu is diverse, offering a wide range of dishes, from familiar favorites like ramen, udon, and donburi bowls, to more creative options that blend Japanese flavors with a modern twist.

The food at Yume Restaurant is well-prepared and flavorful, with a focus on fresh ingredients and thoughtful presentation. While the restaurant doesn’t specialize in sushi or sashimi, it offers a variety of other Japanese classics that are satisfying and hearty. The portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable, making it an accessible option for those who appreciate Japanese cuisine without the high-end price tag.

The service is friendly and attentive, with staff quick to offer recommendations and ensure a pleasant dining experience. Overall, Yume Restaurant provides a comfortable, unpretentious atmosphere where diners can enjoy quality Japanese-inspired meals in a relaxed setting.

ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.text: The food quality here is disappointing and falls far short of expectations. Having dined at Manmaru in Osaka, I can confidently say this restaurant doesn’t come close in terms of flavor, freshness, or authenticity.

ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.text: We had a good meal with friends. Prices are okay. It's fun to see many people enjoying the food too. ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.name: places/ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNncGNhM0tBEAE
ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.author: Kien Tran (Kin)
ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.text:
One of my go-to Japanese spots—good quality at a fair price.

Sashimi? Fresh, clean-tasting, not overly fishy. Sushi rolls? Decent, though nothing mind-blowing. Tempura? Light and crispy, but could use a bit more crunch. Fried chicken? Juicy inside, crispy outside, but not the most flavorful.

The space has a cozy izakaya feel, and if you’re not into loud chatter, head upstairs—quieter, more private, and perfect for a chill meal.

ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.name: places/ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRak03NW1BRRAB
ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.author: 陳奕澄（Eason Chen）
ChIJ1cVVwDQvdTERs2E_Iu8cSQ0.text:
Located on the corner near Le Van Tam Park, MANMARU OSAKA RESTAURANT is a truly authentic Japanese izakaya-style restaurant. After a long workweek, I decided to bring my entire team here for a Friday night gathering.

Ambiance & Space
The restaurant is spacious, with two floors:
Ground floor: An open-seating area with a lively, casual atmosphere that feels just like a local izakaya in Japan.
Second floor: Tatami-style private rooms, perfect for small group gatherings or business dining.

Food & Drinks
We practically ordered everything on the menu—sashimi, sushi rolls, grilled dishes, fried items, seafood, salads, donburi, and more. Every dish was flavorful, but the grilled oysters with mentaiko sauce stood out the most—so fresh and delicious!

And of course, no Japanese izakaya experience is complete without beer! Their Sapporo beer is a must-try, priced at around 30,000 VND per glass. Let’s just say, we drank to our hearts’ content—especially some of my colleagues, who downed a glass every three seconds! (Check the video! 🍻😂)

Pricing & Verdict
The average cost per person was around 500,000 - 600,000 VND, which was quite reasonable for the quality and experience.

ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.name: places/ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCc2RUbEJUMDk0U2treWNWOUlTRXBJT1RVNVFrRRAB
ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.author: Kaitlyn Tran
ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.text:
Food was good, as expected of its price point, but nothing spectacular.

The staff recommended various items on the menu when asked and walked us through each page, pointing out the popular items. There was a mix up with our order where we ordered the wrong item and didn’t realize until it came out but the staff was trying to troubleshoot the issue for us.

The atmosphere and decor were great, very picturesque. No wait to be seated since we came when they were fairly empty and near closing.

However, when the bill came out, I noticed we were charged for wet towels when these were already present on the table when we were sat. I didn’t mind the wet towels wipes but am disappointed that there was no transparency about the additional cost we’d incur for them, especially since they were already there, leading us to believe they were complimentary.

ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.name: places/ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkRk9ESk5TVGN4U0ZjelJIVnlMVmwwTVVwNVZIYxAB
ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.author: Cao Son Le
ChIJPzxAYNAodTERuy_Rrv9pKg0.text:
If you're a fan of fresh sashimi and vibrant Japanese cuisine, this sushi restaurant is an absolute must-visit. Upon arrival, we experienced a short wait of about 10–20 minutes, which was expected given how popular the place is. Thankfully, the staff made the wait feel effortless — they were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and impressively efficient in managing the flow of guests. Their positive energy set the tone for what turned out to be an exceptional dining experience.

The star of the evening was the stunning sashimi platter, beautifully presented on a bed of ice and garnished with edible flowers and fresh greens. Each cut of fish was top-quality — from buttery salmon to tender scallops, octopus, mackerel, and even sea grapes for an extra layer of texture. The variety was remarkable and the freshness unmistakable. It’s clear the kitchen takes great care in both selection and presentation.

Another highlight was the crab pasta dish served inside a crab shell with a rich, creamy sauce. It was indulgent without being overly heavy, and the crab meat was generous and sweet. The small bowl of black fish roe added a delightful briny pop, tying the whole dish together.

The sauces and condiments on the side — from the soy sauce to chili dips — were all thoughtfully paired to enhance the seafood flavors. Overall, this restaurant delivers not only in taste but also in atmosphere and service. Highly recommended for a special night out or to satisfy your sushi cravings with style.

ChIJZ6ji6Y4vdTERbE4g7pp4LOY.text:
Delicious, fresh, and beautifully served – amazing value!

Haru Sushi completely exceeded expectations. From the elegant Japanese-inspired interior to the generous portions of fresh sashimi and chirashi, everything felt high-quality but still very affordable.

The sashimi platter was ultra-fresh and artfully plated.

Loved the salmon & avocado don – full of flavor and great textures.

The hot dish (seafood stone pot rice) came out sizzling and added a nice variety.

Service was kind and attentive, and the space felt calm and welcoming.

For the quality you get, the price is honestly so worth it. Definitely coming back!

ChIJSfvvNQEpdTER2CD7mV-k4BU.name: places/ChIJSfvvNQEpdTER2CD7mV-k4BU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tKSlpXVk5kbEJxVFV4R1dXd3RUekJsUmtjMGRGRRAB
ChIJSfvvNQEpdTER2CD7mV-k4BU.author: Ray Mak
ChIJSfvvNQEpdTER2CD7mV-k4BU.text:
Upon my arrival in Ho Chi Minh City, my girlfriend whisked me off to iSushi Trường Sơn Tân Bình, just minutes from the airport — a thoughtful move to ensure I wouldn’t arrive hungry after the flight.

Stepping inside, the restaurant greeted us with an elegant yet relaxed ambiance, ideal for unwinding after travel. At iSushi Tân Bình you’ll find an impressive Japanese buffet where each dish is crafted like a work of art — beautifully presented, generously portioned, and decidedly refined.

We were treated to sushi and sashimi that tasted incredibly fresh — indeed, the menu is celebrated for its fresh seafood and abundant variety.  ￼ One highlight was their steak — we believe it was premium Australian Wagyu — rich, buttery, and absolutely delicious. And despite the upscale presentation and quality, the prices were refreshingly reasonable.

If you find yourself in Ho Chi Minh and craving authentic Japanese fare near the airport, this spot is a strong choice. One note from my girlfriend: the branch at iSushi Diamond Plaza offers even smoother service, so it might be worth trying that one if service speed is a priority for you.

#Isushi #japanesebuffet #japanesefood #hochiminh

ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.name: places/ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWclVqVklOR05JV1VwS09EUlpVVkpqUjNNMVFrRRAB
ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.author: Leonard Lim
ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.text: Unatoto is the first Japanese restaurant dedicated to serving grilled eel, and it lives up to its reputation. The eel is perfectly prepared — smoky, tender, and full of flavor — making it a true highlight for anyone who enjoys authentic Japanese cuisine. What I especially appreciate is the variety on the menu, which offers far more options than their Singapore branch. From traditional donburi bowls to creative side dishes, there’s something to suit every taste. A great spot for both casual meals and a more indulgent dining experience.

ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.name: places/ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsM1FUWm5VbEJGTVdSSmRqWnpMVXhpVGpWck5YYxAB
ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.author: Digital Food Nomad
ChIJ5zjusocvdTERlu9kRYR1De8.text: Izakaya Unatoto is well-known for its grilled eel dishes, and the combination meal I ordered was delicious. The eel was savory, tender, and flavorful, cooked perfectly with that signature smoky glaze that makes it stand out. The presentation was neat, and the portion size was satisfying without being too heavy. Highly recommended if you’re a fan of grilled eel (unagi) or want to experience one of the best Japanese comfort meals in town.

ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.name: places/ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLLWx2dGFHek83WVZBEAE
ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.author: K Phan
ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.text:
The only thing good about this restaurant is the atmosphere.
The food was awful, especially for the price. Soggy chips, super salty egg soup, and the eel rice bowl was so cold and dry.
Felt like eating leftover food and chips.

Service wasn’t great either. Asked for a sharing bowl but the waitress just told just to use the small plate for the soup…
The waitress also dropped the fried ebi when putting the food on the table, and she used her BARE FINGER to pick it up back into our food bowl…

Would only recommend if you want a place to take Instagrammable pics. Other than that, there are way better local restaurants around with better value.

ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.name: places/ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSOTdDNnVRRRAB
ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.author: Sam Schubert
ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.text:
Go a long way down an ally, seems sketchy but actually totally safe with families living there. Once you find the tiny entrance the welcome is warm and friendly!
Service is excellent, comfy seating and of course the food is homely and comforting.

I love that they have mini servings of things as I like trying different dishes. I ordered way too much food but the price was very reasonable and everything was delicious!!
I tried the mixed sandwich, two mini bowls, a croquet and the cheesecake.

I absolutely LOVE that the cheesecake was just on its own - so many times people add fruit or something, and for me, that takes away from a good cheesecake. It doesn't need anything when it's this good.
One of the best cheesecakes I have ever had in my life. So glad I didn't let me full belly stop me from ordering it and when I couldn't finish it they happily gave me a takeaway container.

Well worth the effort to visit here and I'll be back next time in in Ho Chi Minh 🙂

ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.name: places/ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNoc0pPZFpREAE

ChIJ8cnTT0ovdTEREBWnpxLrZTA.text: My 2nd time here with my girl and everything stays perfect just like our first time. We always fancied raw fish and Mexican-styled shrimps so we jumped right ahead, and they didn't disappoint us. Tasty and distinctive. Plum wine is second to none and the best dish of the bunch is double-dipped eel rice with egg roll. Service is impeccable and prompt.

ChIJ97IY2qwldTERgO2sKONGVzQ.text:
It was my son’s birthday and I book a table about 1 hour in advance.
The restaraunt has a good review on google maps, so I trusted and decided to book a table.
The salad was good, sashimi and rolls were so so. But they cooked sooooooo slow. I preordered because they asked, but when I arrived I have to wait 20 mins for the salad, 1 hour for sashimi. I was the only one client at that time. They asked to wait because they have many online orders but there was only one grab shipper waiting for the udon and after waiting for 25 mins, he left without taking the order. NO ONE else.
After waiting for 1 hour but less than half of my food arrived on the table.
This place gave me really bad experience.
They gave me 10% discount but it couldn’t compesate all my dissapointment because all my kids were left hungry.
If the owner reads this message hopefully they will change otherwise there only one way to close the restaurant forever.

ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.author: Chris Huỳnh
ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.text:
I was truly satisfied with the dining experience here. Every dish was carefully prepared, both in flavor and presentation. The salmon cheese roll was crispy on the outside, rich but not greasy. The Italian-style amberjack sashimi was the highlight – fresh fish with a well-balanced creamy and tangy sauce. The Sushi Combo 01 offered good variety, with perfectly cooked rice and fresh ingredients.

The steamed egg was smooth and delicate, while the avocado herring salad had a refreshing balance of flavors. Both drinks – hibiscus tea and peach orange lemongrass chia tea – were light, cooling, and paired well with the meal. For dessert, panna cotta and mochi were gentle and pleasant to finish with.

The restaurant was clean, and the staff, especially Nguyệt, was attentive and friendly. Overall, a well-deserved value for the quality of food – definitely a place worth coming back to.

ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.text: Celebrated my friend's birthday at this location. The food was awesome and very chill service. This gives winter, Hokkaido and fusion food vibes. Sunday morning is good. Salmon is nice. Would recommend. The room is cold but the food made us feel warm. Thanks 🙏

ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.name: places/ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmcWFYWE9nEAE
ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.author: Hoàng Quỳnh
ChIJC5bZcEMvdTERZ-x088yOc10.text:
I’ve visited Sushi Way a few times before they renovated, and now it’s clear they’ve stepped up their game with both the upgraded space and menu.

The restaurant isn’t very spacious, but the clean and minimalist décor reflects a true Japanese vibe. It’s well-organized and feels cozy.

One of the highlights here is how fast the food is served. The prices are also very reasonable, especially when compared to other Japanese restaurants in central locations.

The restaurant is easy to find with its prime location, making it convenient for both locals and visitors.

For vegetarians, while the menu doesn’t have a wide variety of options, there are still a few decent choices.

Overall, Sushi Way is worth a try if you’re looking for quality Japanese food on a budget. I’d rate it a solid 7.5/10.

ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.text: We always have Omakase for our wedding anniversaries and we have had Omakase in many places in the world. ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.name: places/ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OVWJuWmtObUV3VERkd1NVdE9VbTVaV2pkNGJVRRAB

ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.text: We got the private room and had the best experience. Every dish was delicious, service was top notch and chef was super friendly. I can see why it’s the most popular omakase in HCM. Would definitely return!!

ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.name: places/ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLbXEyWS0zMWVPSTR3RRAB
ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.author: Claire Apple
ChIJ4_bVqDsvdTERjiol0QilKHI.text:
This place is 10  stars 😂 it’s the BEST omakase I’ve ever had anywhere

Went for their 2.2m vnd omakase (rhythms) at lunchtime. Wow. The level of imagination is insane. Imagine chawanmushi latte - coffee cream dripping on top of snow crab chawanmushi, resulting in almost a delicious umami creamy soup. Or cotton candy ensconced anago sushi - they melt the cotton candy and the malt drips on the anago sushi. Chefs kiss!

Fresh food and excellent service is a given at a restaurant this price point, together with personalized attention from the chef - but where Yuzu scores is the level of imagination involved. You’re eating the marriage of imagination and gastronomy.

The only small downside (and this is me just being very very nitpicky) - The rhythms lunch time is 1.5h. So once you’re done with each course they serve the next one. For those of you that like to take your own sweet time, have pauses between each course do note that the pace could be a little faster but this is a very very very minor nitpick.

On my platinum tier for places to eat in HCMC!! Overall I rate the rhythms menu:

Food: 10/10
Service: 10/10
Value for money: 10/10

ChIJEUvc87IodTERp7ugTqDw4_I.author: Madhu M.
ChIJEUvc87IodTERp7ugTqDw4_I.text:
✨ Sushi Nhi – Hidden Gem in Ho Chi Minh City! ✨

Just had a wonderful family dinner at Sushi Nhi, tucked slightly off the city centre in a cozy little alley — and it was absolutely worth the find! 🍣🌟

The food was fresh, delicious, and surprisingly affordable, making it a great spot to enjoy quality Japanese cuisine without breaking the bank. My kids loved it too, which is always a huge plus for us when travelling.

Even though the staff didn’t speak much English, they were super helpful, patient, and attentive throughout our meal. They guided us through the menu and made sure we were well taken care of the entire time. Truly appreciated the warm hospitality. 🙏

Overall, it was a memorable dining experience with the family — cozy vibes, great food, and genuine service. ❤️🍱

ChIJEUvc87IodTERp7ugTqDw4_I.author: Briana Le
ChIJEUvc87IodTERp7ugTqDw4_I.text:
This restaurant came really well recommended from my friends for a good date night. My partner and I came on a Friday evening without a reservation so we had to wait a short bit for them to organize a table for us! We ended up sitting on the balcony which was nice because it was small and secluded - only two tables out there.

They have such a vast menu, it took us a good amount of time to get through it and narrow down what we wanted - everything looked so good.

We ended up getting a sushi combo, the diet sushi roll, gyoza, and a pork kimchi fried rice. We tried to order fried chicken as well but it somehow got cancelled. He ordered a Sapporo and I ordered a soda water.

The food was so good. It’s insane how affordable this place is - we will definitely be back. Everything was delicious and came out fast for a busy Friday night.

We will definitely be back!

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.author: Sandra
ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.text:
The location is rather convenient with the overhead link to Thao Dien station just a stone's throw away.

Requested for omakase counter seats but was asked to put a 900k deposit. But when we didn't confirm, they proposed we come on time and we did. ( Frankly, I would have simply chosen another restaurant for omakase had they not replied.)

There were limited number of seats in front of the chef, however some corner seats weren't ideal as they face the display panel of sashimi or the sink. Given the beautiful deco of the restaurant, more thought should have been put into the design of the omakase counter if they advertised it.

The omakase set was prettily presented, but not as exciting as I hoped. The chef speciality turned out to be overcooked salmon and there was a dish of mediocre shrimp rice and boring piece of brownie. Saving grace were the stuffed chicken, shishamo and some unexpected extra dishes that was not printed on the menu.

So the verdict is don't expect much from omasake unless you choose the highest range, maybe 🤷. Better off ordering ala carte, I suppose.

That said, I am impressed that there are many people visiting the restaurant on a weekday evening, some to celebrate special moments.

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.name: places/ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJLV81S2JFaGJfcHRnRRAB

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.text: The food is absolutely amazing. They have unique and delicious dishes here, some of which I've never tried at other restaurants. When I arrived, the Omakase counter was already full, so I ordered à la carte. There are so many dishes to choose from—I’ll definitely come back to try the Omakase.

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.name: places/ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfb3QyUlhnEAE
ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.author: Vy Phương Võ
ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.text:
We chose Ume for our birthday dinner and requested a private room, which made it perfect for a family with kids like ours.

The sushi rolls here are, in my opinion, the best I’ve had so far. The quality of the rice and the fresh ingredients—like the avocado, salmon, ikura, and crunchy toppings—are outstanding and perfectly balanced.

The sashimi platter is especially worth mentioning. It’s not only fresh and delicious but also an excellent value for the price—definitely a must-order!

Finally, the restaurant’s decor adds to the experience. The cozy atmosphere, enhanced by beautiful bonsai trees, makes it a truly delightful place to dine.

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.name: places/ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURIc2EtVG5nRRAB

ChIJydgLbFgndTER1Z6sjglZP9I.text:
Arrived in with some friends & had a fantastic experience at Ume! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

The staff was friendly and attentive. Their variety of fresh, melt-in-your-mouth sashimi is incredible, and the extensive sake menu pairs perfectly. Prices were reasonable for the quality of food. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, perfect for a casual meal or a special night out. Will be back!

Staff were friendly - and one spoke English too.

My friends had some handrolls which they enjoyed along with a beer. There was a side salad dish, and also a dessert option at the end that I had to skip due to time.

They take card or cash. There was the service charge, and the VAT tax on our bill.

Would happily pop in again if this was my neighbourhood.

ChIJd10aZIMpdTERv2aPiXHZ9Bk.author: David Zhang
ChIJd10aZIMpdTERv2aPiXHZ9Bk.text:
Let’s start with the fish

I got the salmon and fatty salmon sashimi, so I can only speak to those two but overall I would say the quality of the fish was average. The regular salmon was a bit flavorless like it was frozen for too long, but the fatty salmon was decent.

The highlight of the meal was definitely the rolls. We got three types of rolls and all of them were excellent, very full of flavor and also the texture was great.

The low point of the meal was definitely the udon. The broth for the udon tasted like Shin instant noodle seasoning. The noodles were fine, maybe a little on the soft side. The toppings were mostly standard but there was some weird tasting chicken that threw it off a bit for me. The egg was eggselent though, perfectly cooked and tasty.

Aside from the food, the atmosphere was pretty enjoyable overall. There were tons of little touches everywhere, and the walls were decorated with aesthetic backgrounds. While none of the decorations were that special, it all added together to contribute to the charm of the place.

ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ.author: Brewforone
ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ.text:
📍 ɪꜱᴜꜱʜɪ - ᴍᴜʟᴛɪᴘʟᴇ ʙʀᴀɴᴄʜᴇꜱ

- Had one of those gluttonous moments and decided to treat myself to sushi. For me it was spontaneous, I often head to Golden Gate Spoons restaurants knowing the standards are solid, and a street near me had several of their restaurants, so I landed on iSushi.

If you’re craving all-you-can-eat Japanese with a decent price tag, it’s well worth a try. The vibe is modern, the staff pretty friendly, and you get access to a wide variety of sushi, sashimi, yakitori, and more.

Their menu is a 3-tiered system with the lowest starting at 439k | $16.69 | ₱980, do keep an eye on their app since it's not uncommon for them to have discounts running. During my visit I ended up getting a decent discount for the middle tiered option which brought the price down a bit.

ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ.name: places/ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQNkJuNmF1MEpmMWVBEAE
ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ.author: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
ChIJJ6E0ZY4vdTERIbd6bbnoZtQ.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at iSushi Cao Thắng, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience that deserves a solid 5-star review! The invoice I received reflects not only the quality of the food but also the variety and care put into their offerings.

First off, I ordered a  Buffet ISS Sakura NL(C), priced at 579,000 VND. The buffet was an absolute delight—fresh, flavorful, and packed with a wide selection of sushi and Japanese dishes that left me spoiled for choice. I also tried the Tiền Hàng Được Dùng Khuyến Mãi (promotional items) at 1,130,000 VND, which added even more variety to my meal. The total before VAT came to 1,220,400 VND, and with VAT included, the final amount was 1,320,400 VND—well worth every penny for the quality and quantity provided.

What really stood out was the attention to detail. The presentation of the dishes was beautiful, and the ingredients tasted incredibly fresh. The staff were attentive and friendly, ensuring that my dining experience was seamless from start to finish. I also appreciated the cleanliness of the restaurant and the modern, welcoming ambiance, which made the meal even more enjoyable.

The invoice also shows they accept a variety of payment methods, including VN Pay, MoMo, and ZaloPay, which made the checkout process super convenient. Overall, iSushi Cao Thắng exceeded my expectations in every way—delicious food, great service, and a fantastic atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back, and I highly recommend this spot to anyone craving top-notch sushi in the area! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

ChIJmZ4Q2S8vdTERg9_DxAbs0Cg.name: places/ChIJmZ4Q2S8vdTERg9_DxAbs0Cg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0VmFrZFlMUzA0YWpOSmRYZHNSVTQzVTFCTFRWRRAB
ChIJmZ4Q2S8vdTERg9_DxAbs0Cg.author: Dan V. Sousanis
ChIJmZ4Q2S8vdTERg9_DxAbs0Cg.text:
- Disappointing!
- We went there last night about 8pm, no hostess or host at the door, only the security guard told us how to get into the restaurant on the second level, Yen on the ground level had nobody inside that I could see?
- There is an extremely low thing hanging in the doorway, so of course you have to bend down very low to enter the restaurant - bad design here, especially for older people or people with bad backs (is this really Japanese style?)
- Upon entry into the restaurant, there is no staff or customers in view, we walk all the way in and see all of the dining staff on their cell phones & there are only 4 tables of guests & a private room of guests.
- The level of the beer is very disappointing too - so much foam on top!
- The food was decent, but it took a long time for everything to come out though (2-3 kitchen staff, saw 2 eating in the kitchen too, 1 was eating)
- I saw someone who looked like they were supposed to be a manager a few times briefly, but he went back into the beverage area mostly - we had to flag over the staff every time we needed something, they never asked us how was our meal either (didn’t expect it really)
- The decorations are very nicely done, that’s what got me to want to go & try - plus al of the Facebook ads recently too!
- Music came from a portable WiFi speaker on the counter, nobody was sitting there.

- With so many choices for good Japanese food in Saigon, I will stay away from this place - especially with the rent prices in Saigon, this place should packed with people like it is in Japan Town on Le Than Ton street or Pham Việt Chan, Bình Thanh!

- Better costumer service is the biggest problem here in my opinion, giving attention to the guests, and no cell phones in the dining room area for staff.

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.name: places/ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pJMmNVSndXVkoxWlhsWGMyRllUVzVPV0d0VWRtYxAB
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.author: Eric Nguyen
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.text:
Sorae delivers a top-tier dining experience anchored by its unmatched 51st-floor vantage point. The panoramic city views elevate the entire meal, creating a premium atmosphere that feels both refined and memorable. It’s the kind of setting that adds immediate value before the first dish even hits the table.

The sushi and sashimi quality is consistently high. Cuts are fresh, well-sourced, and plated with intention. From the sashimi platter to the individual nigiri, every item reflects disciplined craftsmanship and clean execution. Portions are balanced, flavors are precise, and nothing feels rushed or mass-produced.

Operationally, lunch service was seamless with zero congestion and no traffic headaches getting in or out. For dinner, booking ahead is a must, and the elevated demand makes sense given the location and offering. For anyone looking for premium sushi in Saigon with a dramatic skyline backdrop, Sorae sets a strong benchmark.

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.name: places/ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25SUU0za3RVbmhhYlRkMldGWnhUbGRoYmtGM2NuYxAB

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.text:
Enjoyable meal at this Japanese restaurant with an amazing view. The violin player was great, and the music only enhanced the dining experience. The food was delicious. A perfect spot for a special occasion or a relaxing evening out. The waiter bringing oit the meals provided great explanations.

Feedback was the waitress did not offer water through out the evening or check if we needed any other drinks. In addition, advised us that we'd need a main in addition to the food ordered in the picture which we struggled to finish.

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.name: places/ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKSGRrMWxSakozVjNaVVJXdEVaazk0ZWt0aU1GRRAB
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.author: Melanie V
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.text: Came for dinner in March 2025 was planning to do a review but life happened. The food was ok, a little too bland for my taste. The food presentation was really cool though and you can't help but appreciate how awesome the view of the city is at night with all the lights from so high up. The one thing I wanted to point out was the service. They were very attentive and asked if we needed anything quite often. We were seated right by the food window and high traffic area so we requested to move to a quieter area which they moved us right away. At one point I noticed one of my shoes broke and could not walk with it but I was too embarrassed to say anything until our dinner was almost over. I finally got the courage and asked one of the staff if they can help me get another pair of shoes somewhere. The girl I talked with said I could go down to the streets and lots of vendors around to buy from. That didn't help me much but the guy that was beside her immediately ran somewhere and came back with 2 used flip flops that the servers use as their accessory/uniform. The 2 flip flops were of different sizes but I didn't care. I just needed something I could use to walk back to my hotel. I appreciated his help so much I gave him a huge tip (to cover for the shoes plus)on top of the tip we gave for the dinner. I wanted that to be for him only but I think he shared it with the main staff. His quick thinking should be commended. I don't know his name but I want to say a big THANK YOU to that guy that saved me from a huge embarrassment.

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.name: places/ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNZnNoZHJQeE5hZ2lnRRAB

ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.name: places/ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pBeE56aG5kMFJwTlhOWE5VUTVlamhRTTBkeE0wRRAB
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.author: Grace Young
ChIJpXvdfT4vdTERAhMXaZYqP3M.text:
My parents visited this restaurant on their final evening in Vietnam, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience for them.

While the restaurant is located on the 51st floor with views of the city, the ambiance fell short of expectations - perhaps the view is better during the day. However, the interior lighting was so dim that they had to use their phone flashlights just to read the menu, which made the dining experience quite uncomfortable.

The service issues were significant. They waited over an hour for their food to arrive, which was far too long to be made to wait. When the dishes finally came, the tempura was served cold - a real letdown since tempura should be crispy and hot.

There were also mix-ups with their drink orders. My father specifically requested a non-alcoholic beer but was served a regular beer instead, which we are very upset about as he doesn't drink alcohol. Additionally, the staff brought them some revolting cocktails that they hadn't ordered, and seemed pushy about them accepting the drinks.

Given these issues, my parents asked to speak with the manager. To their credit, management acknowledged the shocking service and didn't charge them anything. However, by that point, my parents decided to leave and find dinner elsewhere as their dining experience at Sorae was ruined.

It's a real shame that this happened on their last night in Vietnam, especially since they'd had such wonderful experiences at other Vietnamese restaurants throughout their trip.

On a positive note, the live violinist was talented and enjoyable to listen to.

ChIJNc3Jzp8rdTERgq9jj81layU.author: XD Albert
ChIJNc3Jzp8rdTERgq9jj81layU.text:
Price & Value
Customers find the pricing reasonable given the high quality, with one review highlighting a buffet-inclusive meal costing about 379 k VND per person (which included dessert), and noted that children under height‑1 m dine free. The quality-to-price ratio was described as “way too cheap,” reflecting pleasantly surprising affordability.

Service
The staff are described as “lovely and fast,” with friendly and attentive service. The owner also gets positive mentions for being welcoming and prepared before customer arrival, showing a commitment to good hospitality.

Food Quality & Taste
Diners praise Gontan for offering some of the best traditional Japanese dishes in the area. One reviewer called it “Best traditional Japanese food ever,” particularly recommending their beef dishes. Portion sizes are generous, and dishes are flavorful and authentic.

ChIJaW64DPwpdTER5AfS7bHPdlw.text:
Did you see Bruce Lee in Game of Death where  he fought his way to the top? Well at Takumi-Tei it's Japanese cuisine presented in the different food presentation styles over 5 levels will excite your palate, and it is awesome!
Take your choice of Teppanyaki, Omakase, Sushi, Sashami, and more presented in deliciously and uniquely decorated beautiful rooms to suit the gourmet style, and you will be treated like an Emporer. The saying "You pay for what you get" is the case here (unlike another supposedly Omakase place in D3, where I gave the full raspberry and got an equally expected ineptitude reply ).
After gourmandising all the mouth melting Japanese steaks and seafood, you are also able to buy the ingedients to cook at your pleasure, available downstairs in their supermarket as well.

ChIJcySvrXkpdTERqOJVDJYT5oI.text:
I got to this restaurant by accident. I needed to have dinner, but there were no free seats in a good restaurant nearby and I was too lazy to look for another place in the rain. I really regretted my decision. The restaurant looks good, interesting interior, comfortable chairs, there are several halls on different floors. Also a good point was the service of a very nice girl waitress, who was very attentive.
But the food is very bad. I often place Japanese restaurants and have never given me spoiled seafood, here I was served an appetizer of spoiled octopus (which I did not eat after the second piece, realizing that it was dangerous to my health).
Maki was developed by a very good chef, but then they began to cook them with al dente rice, without mirin, such rice is served on the street with pork. It seems that the chefs of this establishment do not know how to cook at all.
In the end, after almost 40 minutes of waiting, my husband was brought shashlik with chicken, which was simply burned on the sides and not even cooked, it was raw and the cook saw this when he brought it to the guest.
I think I have not seen such poor quality establishments in the last few years. In response to my comments, the administrator said that everything was fine and it was not a problem...

ChIJ84r567IodTER7JDSrnXx4Pc.name: places/ChIJ84r567IodTER7JDSrnXx4Pc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CS1MwSkhjalphV2pCbWEyNVdSWFp0ZWpkVU0yYxAB
ChIJ84r567IodTER7JDSrnXx4Pc.author: Tram Ngu
ChIJ84r567IodTER7JDSrnXx4Pc.text:
Sushi Sake Restaurant Kiyota is a quiet little gem tucked away on Phạm Viết Chánh. From the outside, it doesn’t look like much, but once you step in, the space feels warm, intimate, and pleasantly calm — almost like entering a small, private dining nook in Japan.

The sushi and sashimi are fresh and thoughtfully prepared. Every course feels deliberate, with clean flavors and good balance. The omakase is also surprisingly affordable, especially considering the quality and portion sizes. I truly expected more — and at this price point, everything feels just right. It’s not flashy, not overly complicated, but it delivers exactly what it promises.

I’ve tried omakase at many places, and to be honest, this isn’t a jaw-dropping, unforgettable “wow” experience — but it is a very solid and safe choice. The type of place you can rely on when you want good sushi without any disappointments. Their willingness to adjust the omakase based on budget or preferences is a thoughtful touch, and the complimentary dessert at the end rounds things off nicely.

Service is friendly and attentive without being intrusive, and the overall pace of the meal is relaxed and enjoyable. Just keep in mind that the seating is extremely limited, so booking in advance is a must.

If you’re looking for a dependable, cozy spot for quality Japanese food — especially a quiet date night — this place is definitely worth visiting 🍣✨

ChIJj1PZwDEndTER1JqAkjVyKqQ.text:
My recent lunch experience at Yen Sushi Premium was truly unforgettable, thanks in large part to the outstanding service provided by Như and Tiên. They were attentive to my needs, offering helpful recommendations and ensuring that my experience was seamless.

The sushi was exquisite, with fresh, high-quality ingredients and creative presentations. Each dish was a delight to the senses, from the delicate sashimi to the flavorful rolls.

But what truly elevated my experience was the exceptional service provided by Như and Tiên. I was particularly impressed by their patience and willingness to go the extra mile to accommodate my requests.

I want to extend my sincere gratitude to their Manager, Ms. Ngọc Nga, for cultivating such a talented and dedicated team. I believe that she should recognize the exceptional contributions of Như and Tiên by promoting them to higher positions. Their dedication and passion for their work are truly commendable.

If you're looking for a place that offers both delicious food and impeccable service, I highly recommend Yen Sushi Premium. It's a hidden gem that will leave you wanting more
