ChIJDag3uxopdTER1KqK_LyXuJo.text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at this restaurant.
1.	They charge for wet tissues, which are simply the type that gets moist when you pour water on them. While the cost is minimal, they added it to the bill without even informing us. It’s not about the money—it’s about the principle. Customers should be asked before being charged for something like this.
2.	The service was a disaster. The food took way too long to arrive, and the order of service made absolutely no sense. Cooked dishes were served before raw ones, completely ruining the dining flow. It was clear that the staff had no proper understanding of how to serve food in a Japanese restaurant.
3.	The pricing was outrageous for the quality of food. While I understand that pricing is up to the owner’s business strategy, there was no justification for such high prices given the mediocre quality. It felt like a complete rip-off.

I will not be returning and would not recommend this place to anyone expecting decent service, fair pricing, or a proper dining experience.

ChIJDag3uxopdTER1KqK_LyXuJo.name: places/ChIJDag3uxopdTER1KqK_LyXuJo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNYbXYyWTRnRRAB
ChIJDag3uxopdTER1KqK_LyXuJo.author: Phương Anh Hứa
ChIJDag3uxopdTER1KqK_LyXuJo.text: Good food, good atmosphere, fit for dates or business dinners. Might be a bit pricier than other typical Japanese restaurants but the food is worth it.

ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.name: places/ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURabFlfbjB3RRAB
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.author: Minh Hiền
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.text:
Highly recommend to have sushi or sashimi here. The salmon here is really fresh and delicious. I’ve come here twice and never been disappointed of the food here.

Btw, staff is really nice to us. They serve food really quick.

ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.name: places/ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkNnBLRUJ3EAE
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.author: Ben Nguyen
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.text:
I dined here with my family on Valentine’s Day. The experience was below average, most of which could be attributed to the painfully slow service.

Food was standard. The salmon sashimi was fresh, but not the tuna. The rolls lacked substance I reckon. I feel the restaurant focused too much on the presentation, failing to deliver the exquisite taste that sushi customers including me always expect from a sushi restaurant.

The service was excruciatingly slow. I gotta give credits to the staff for their patience and efforts in following up with the kitchen; however, one dish every 15-20mins was simply unacceptable, considering the chain is positioned as an upscale one.

Again, the food was average. But no one with an empty stomach would ever appreciate the long wait. I do request the management team investigate and improve their service asap, otherwise no customers will ever return.

ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.name: places/ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkNXBMaUdnEAE
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.author: Manuel Brauner
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.text:
The food is very good, thanks to the people making it. However, the service is veeeerrryyyyyyyyyyyyy slow, not pleasant to wait 90 minutes and only get one dish at a time and have to ask several times to make sure nothing is forgotten. Also have to ask for wasabi which shouldn’t be the issue at a sushi restaurant. If the owner reads this, reevaluate your choice in the management. I will not visit this place again, it’s a shame because the food is really good!

Edit: I changed to 1 star and 0 for service, because they care so much, that they just copy and paste their replies, I am not Mr Nguyen. Unbelievable, shame on you.

ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.name: places/ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNveEpYd3JnRRAB
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.author: Carlos M
ChIJa4548s8pdTERjb8QcadpqNM.text: The food is usually quite good here. The price is a bit high for the location. They really lack with service. I only visit when it's not busy.  I always have to ask for drink refills, the staff does not check on you. I wouldn't go here during busy hours.

ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.name: places/ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQwZ1pEUWVnEAE
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.author: Alex Zegarelli
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.text: The food is good and the service is quick and responsive. Also nice decorations. Plus the price here is fair. But no takoyaki.

ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.name: places/ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM0ejlid0VREAE
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.author: Nhi Vân
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.text: Tried their tofu egg for the first time and it amazed me. Highly recommend that dish for appetizer.

ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.name: places/ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNRbV91MzF3RRAB
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.author: Nguyen Van Duc
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.text: Good in both food quality and service

ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.name: places/ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNOaGRHTTBRRRAB
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.author: Tâm Phan Minh
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.text: Japanese cuisine. Good food good price

ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.name: places/ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURtaXRqOWlRRRAB
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.author: Ninh Nguyen
ChIJW6hkz6EndTER47PqjeoGZEc.text: The Japanese food is good, light decoration, fresh sea food, ... But, only thing make me decide to mark it 1 start is the customer service, lack of professionalism, when I doing the paycheck to leave, I chose card payment, after I enter pin and signed on the pos bill, the staff leave without any thank or good bye, then I just waited for the final bill of the meal, and you know, there was no things come to me, their staff look at me like that, why don't you leave our restaurant? Your meal has been finished 🙂 So I think it could be the worst Japanese meal I ever had.

ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.name: places/ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURycHRfNEtBEAE
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.author: Baller_ily
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.text: All I need to say is the same as my rating. Everything tastes so delicious and high quality. I can taste the richness in each bite. Might even be the best sushi place in all of Ho Chi Minh. Would definitely recommend this place to people who live locally and outside of the country too! Service is top notch. The atmosphere is very peaceful. It fits a Japanese type of atmosphere. There is also a small play place for little kids and upstairs room for more guest. They also have a variety of food choices fit for everyone other than sushi. Drinks are really good too. Owner is around sometime and is very kind. Workers are polite. Everything is great. 5 STARS!

ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.name: places/ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRMjZlLUd3EAE
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.author: Trang Thuỳ
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.text: I visisted this place on a Saturday evening, and while it was quite crowded, it was pleasantly surprised by how easy it was to find parking. The food was excellent, fresh sashimi and flavorful sushi. However, it seemed like the restaurant was understaffed, as the service was a bit slower than usual. Overall, a great spot for authentic Japanese food, but be prepared for a moderate wait.

ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.name: places/ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNROTRMV1BBEAE
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.author: Sơn Nguyễn Hồng
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.text: Nice, cozy restaurant. I went with my coworkers during lunch time and the food came out fast. The chicken teriyaki bento is flavorful and the portions were generous. An added bonus is that the bento is served with hot miso soup. Definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good reasonably priced meal.

ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.name: places/ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURaMm9PaHNRRRAB
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.author: Duyen Vo
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.text: Nice place, great sevice, friendly staffs, lovely price, yummy and fresh sushi, highly recommend trying Lion King roll, Spicy TanTan Ramen, Beef Udon, so yummy and tasty, will be back 100%.

ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.name: places/ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSbHUzRVJREAE
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.author: Phương Quế Tô
ChIJmcnuFu4pdTERnYIpAH-qIS8.text: Recommend Lion King Roll, tempura, matcha ice cream, also shioyaki sakana, cheap price, good service, the staff were very friendly and helpful. I will comeback next time!!

ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.name: places/ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSbWVlU0ZREAE
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.author: Bá Đặng
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.text: Food is good and affordable price, worth for a-try. Decor was cozy with brown wood, so lucky was not crowded on weekdays. Recommend 4/5 stars

ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.name: places/ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNveE4zay1BRRAB
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.author: Carlos M
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.text: Food is decent and very affordable. Seems to be clean. Service could be improved such as making sure to bring all eating utensils and straws for drinking before serving the customer. Otherwise this is a nice spot to visit for affordable sushi.

ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.name: places/ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURvdzk2TmNBEAE
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.author: Chau Le
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.text: Food is delicious, friendly staff but a little bit slow. When it's not crowded then fine, but when it's crowded then expect your food to be served over 30' per dish. The environment is Not nice either, there isn't even AIR CONDITIONERS, just regular fans blow hot air from the kitchen to your faces. Price is good compared to other Sushi places around this neighborhood.

ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.name: places/ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNJb3UtM3p3RRAB
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.author: Andrey Kaminskiy
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.text: Good quality for the price. Nothing fancy or over the top but it's delicious and the place is nice. Best sushi in this neighborhood.

ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.name: places/ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURRNF9IY2dnRRAB
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.author: J Vaughn
ChIJ-YyGXqkpdTERDcdHL88XWAE.text: Sorry to say this place was pretty bad. The salmon sushi was mushy and had no flavor, and the tuna kimchi soup was made with instant soup powder. Even the wasabi was rather flavorless.

ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.name: places/ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJaHBYLU1REAE
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.author: M
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.text:
I liked the food.

The katsu donburi/deep-fried pork cutlet over rice (89K/$3.45) tasted a little bit cheaper than standard katsu. It's on the lower end for price, though. The portion was ok.

The saba shioyaki/grilled mackerel (69K/$2.70) is cheaper than most. However, I thought it was good. Few bones with good spice. I'd get the mackerel again, but I'd get something other than the katsu again.

15K/$0.60 standard low price for a bottle of water.

Surprisingly, no service fee or VAT.

Unless there's second floor seating, there's only 4 tables (so it's kind of small).

ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.name: places/ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2NTVXUkVBEAE
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.author: Jordan
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.text: I was there 3 weeks ago. Too mnay choices. Fresh made. Prices are affordable. I had a good time. After eating my first order, had cravings for more, so I had to order again. It was natural. Good taste

ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.name: places/ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURGX2VEMXhnRRAB
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.author: Thanh CiCi
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.text:
If you are fan of street food, it would be a good choice. The price and portion are really "Gõ". The taste is not really special to me (the Stire-fried Udon too much oil)
It's a bit of busy when I come, but the staff is super polite and supportive.

ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.name: places/ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmX0lIcm9RRRAB
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.author: ThuyVan Mai
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.text: Great service, food was delightful, fresh and tasty love coming here. Affordable price for quality food!!!

ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.name: places/ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR5b2RidTVnRRAB
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.author: Trang Ngo
ChIJ7Zq8xLIodTERUtEWZDQ96R8.text:
Best price in Binh Thanh district.
My team with 5 people, bill total 695.000vnd for 6 dishes. The fish is fresh and taste well, sushi is also delicious too. Will come back this place. It is reasonable price with delicious food.

ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.name: places/ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMeDhEM2dBRRAB
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.author: kaseki Izuma
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.text: The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes at fair prices. The food is delicious and very fresh, with options like sushi, sashimi, and fried dishes, etc. The staff is very friendly, although the seating area can be a bit hard to reach. I'd rate it 9/10.

ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.name: places/ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURNejZMMWpRRRAB
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.author: Quyen Doan
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.text: My mom said this place is ideal for students who grave for sushi and Japanese food while having little budget. It is very busy in the evening. We're lucky because after we sit at a table, so many customers come. The waitress greets us in Japanese and kindly show us a free table. After we order, they bring cutlery and a small of miso soup for each person. Food is in small portions, but for three people, these are enough (we left with full stomach). Everything tastes good and no mistakes are made. I'll visit it next time when I go back to Vietnam :)

ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.name: places/ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21oSVZXOXlMVXROZDI5d1lYRmxaVlU0YnpaVFpXYxAB
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.author: Tido Luong
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.text:
Instantly became my favorite place for sushi! Great taste, great price, it's very affordable, so understandably the ingredients will not be on par with other fancy places, but the food was nonetheless delicious, like really delicious. The space was also very nice and well thought-out, kudos for this as well. I was too focused in eating so didnt take any pic, thats how good it was.
Highly rec !!

ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.name: places/ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNpaTh6MDBnRRAB
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.author: Ben Herman
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.text: A great mid-range sushi and Japanese cuisine restaurant for those on a budget, but who like nice things. The maki rolls are plentiful and affordable, the udon grilled beef with soup was rich and delicious, and the sashimi was nice and fresh. We also tried the Japanese gelato, pink Himalayan salt flavor, and were pleasantly surprised, although it was frozen hard. Service was swift and friendly and the place is quite busy in the evenings, clean, and modern. The wasabi is a little runny, and the maki rolls are a bit skinny, but we enjoyed our visit overall.

ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.name: places/ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR1cWFmajdBRRAB
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.author: Bryan Ho
ChIJfam-cNwudTERSANYY0gu5Dc.text:
I have eaten in this restaurant since I was a student, it is delicious from then until now. With reasonable price and excellent food, you should try when visiting district 10, Su Van Hanh street.
The kitchen placed in front of the restaurant in order to you can see how the cook make your food, I appreciate this arrangement. All of room in this restaurant equiped with air conditional, but it is a litte hot in there.
When you are choosing foods, the staff will bring you a welcome miso soup, I was suprised at the first time coming here. Salmon sashimi in this restaurant so yummy but the piece of fish is not so thick, I prefer thick piece. Another food I like that grilled scallop with special sauce of the restaurant. and save the best for last, the salad in here is so perfect, you with enjoy the secret ingridient sauce of this restaurant with salad. You can also try grilled eel rice, it is one of the food you should try in here.
Finally, the price is reasonable for all foods in the menu and the employees are dedicated and friendly. You can choose this restaurant for family dinner or you could have a date with your mate in the weekend.

ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.name: places/ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25rek1GUldOR3d5VFZjNU9XSm5lRWQzVUVkeGRWRRAB
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.author: Vicki Nguyen
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.text:
We were a big group (8 adults, 2 toddlers and 1 infant) coming in with no reservation for lunch. We were sat in a private room upstairs which was great for our party to spread out without bothering other patrons. The food was delicious, fresh and satisfying. The only complaint I would have is that the cooked entrees portion is smaller than I would have liked.

It was also sad the desserts were all sold out.

ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.name: places/ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMd19HdlRBEAE
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.author: Victoria Sokolovskaya
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.text: Food was good, unusual items available, I liked that it’s not narrow and dark like most places in Saigon, however the service we did not enjoy. Firstly they totally forgot to bring 3 items from our order. Secondly, we came 30 minutes before the closing time, from entrance they were telling us to order fast, then when we eat to pay fast and everything fast, it was quite annoying for a couple dinner…I was surprised to get this kind of service in Vietnam generally known for a good service. It was not smelling nice in the restaurant and the prices are not cheap at all. Many tables were dirty I assume that’s why it was smelly. In general looks like they invested a lot into the place but very badly organized and no standards.

ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.name: places/ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OeVVFWkRUVEZKUkhkeFRGRmFZM2RzWHpaelZVRRAB
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.author: Sven Monk
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.text: Very good sushi, great variety of extremely fresh fish and seafood, incredibly cheap, with friendly and attentive service. My partner and I pigged out on sushi, sashimi, oysters and Wagyu tataki with a couple of rounds of drinks and dropped about $90AUD ($60USD) in total.

ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.name: places/ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ5bVo2Z1VBEAE
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.author: Dude ZZZ
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.text: Genuinely impressed with the quality and taste of the food. The taste of all the dishes was really authentic and totally comparable to the finest I've had in Japan. Really an awesome way to end a long day. Compliments to the Chef and all the kitchen crew who made this possible. Service is fast and good too. Would highly recommend this place to everyone!

ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.name: places/ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkMU5qNkdnEAE
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.author: Thiep Mai Phuc
ChIJGV0iWUcvdTERWd2T33HrWw4.text: This is a great Japanese style restaurant that I have experienced in Vietnam.  Their food is fresh, delicious and prepared properly.  The drinks are quite delicious, the staff is attentive.  However, the price is not for everyone, you should consider a little about money when coming here, in return you will receive great flavors here.

ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.name: places/ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRX2F6MGlnRRAB
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.author: Minh Cao Anh
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.text: Sushi is fresh and delicious, friendly owner. You will get a dish of fruit at a thanks sometime

ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.name: places/ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQxbVpHbTZ3RRAB
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.author: Eric Kingston
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.text: Decent meal, everything was fresh. Perfect for district 9.

ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.name: places/ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Cd1NYQkxRMHhEZVROMGR6TkVkVk13YWpsMFRHYxAB
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.author: Châu Anh
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.text:
The first time I ate, the salmon sashimi had a big bone stuck to it, bleeding all over the customer's mouth, the staff only apologized but did not do anything to fix it
The second time I ordered takeout, the photo showed tuna sashimi but when it was delivered, it was gone, replaced by shrimp and tuna. I texted the restaurant because I was very curious why the restaurant did not call the customer to let them know they were out of the dish so they could cancel the order but arbitrarily changed the dish like that, instead of receiving an apology, the restaurant replied that when the dish ran out, the restaurant had the right to change another dish, so that means as long as they delivered enough, it was okay, it was okay to eat, it did not have to be the same as the photo, right =)? The attitude made me extremely uncomfortable when I spent money and received such service
The price of the restaurant compared to other sushi shops is a bit cheaper, and I found the quality of the food as well as the service to be much LOWER than the price. After receiving low reviews, this shop called and texted me to bother me, saying that they had already compensated me more, even though I didn't need or want those compensations and they weren't what I paid for.

ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.name: places/ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRX2ZUYVJnEAE
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.author: Hồng Kim Nguyễn
ChIJwWxQbyQhdTERWNNDgv31JrM.text: I've become a regular customer. The staff is also very nice. The price is very cheap. I have a weak stomach and can eat without any pain.

ChIJJ3JS4XQrdTERqc--n0u7bTA.author: Vietnam 4K
ChIJJ3JS4XQrdTERqc--n0u7bTA.text:
Tucked away in Thảo Điền, Sushi Ơ feels more like visiting a friend’s home than a restaurant. It’s small, cozy, and run with so much heart. The chef really puts care into every plate — the fish is fresh, the rice is perfectly seasoned, and the balance is just right (not the heavy, overloaded style you sometimes get in other spots).

What I loved most was the vibe. There’s no rush, no show-off. Just simple, honest sushi that lets the quality speak for itself. The menu isn’t huge, but everything feels intentional. Even the miso soup and side dishes taste like they were made with patience.

Prices are fair for the quality, especially in Thảo Điền where things can easily get overpriced. Honestly, this place is kind of a hidden gem — not flashy, not fancy, but definitely memorable. Perfect for when you want real sushi in a calm, personal setting.

I cannot recommend this place and I think you should be careful before dinning here.

ChIJE96NN_UvdTERGWnKElLYk-Y.text:

The seaweed sheets are soggy and it’s so hard to chew. They can’t just reheat the seaweed?

Won’t recommend

ChIJQZNpHzgvdTERTMilVjydutM.text: Chiyoda Sushi at Ben Thanh offers decent Japanese fare with relatively fresh ingredients, though the overall taste was just average. The yaki soba noodles were a tad too dry and sticky for my liking, but their curry rice and sushi were quite good and nicely presented. Staff were friendly and welcoming, which made the dining experience pleasant. However, given the higher-than-average prices for HCMC, I expected a bit more in terms of flavor and quality. It’s not a bad spot if you’re craving Japanese food near the market, but it didn’t quite wow me enough for a repeat visit.

ChIJsQzjxDUvdTERyGXtE-plMlk.text: So we decided to try this place after receiving a voucher from Vagabonds next door. The interior was nice with its garden and multiple seating options: open space, private partitions, and bar seats. For the food, we ordered their sashimi, a salmon roll, a soft-shell crab salad, and a hokke yaki. The sashimi was all right, not super fresh. The salmon roll and salad were good, nothing too special. Finally, the hokke yaki was subpar in my opinion. Overall, the food quality and portions were not worth the price so this was an okay experience. There are better sushi places elsewhere in the city.

ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.text: Haru Sushi is my favorite place for having sushi. They serve very delicious foods with good price. Staffs are wonderfully polite. The place is nicely decorated. You can book in advance. Overall, i like this place and well done 👍

ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.author: Ben Herman
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.text: A great branch of the local sushi chain. The food was exceptional, especially the eel bbq rice. Service was excellent and very attentive and the interior is nicely modern, but playing some weirdly upbeat pop music. Prices were reasonable and my only complaint is that parking is not in front. Park your motorbike at the end of the alley to the left of the restaurant and you will get a card for free parking when you pay your bill.

ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.name: places/ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3M0tmdFVnEAE
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.author: Granny A
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.text: It's very good food I am recommend this place if you visit Ho chi min you should come here 10/1000 I am soo happy here all the staff are very friendly and helpful love it 🥰

ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.name: places/ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSblpmQ1dBEAE
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.author: Olivia iggstrand darvill
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.text: Quite a formal restaurant, not for a fun time but probably more for a date. The staff are very polite and attentive, but almost too much so so you feel quite pressured to be quiet and eat quickly. The prices average for medium quality sushi, the taste was good too but nothing spectacular. The fried foods were very tasty in particular, with the shrimp being not chewy at all and the quails eggs being very fresh

ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.name: places/ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMaGFlU1B3EAE
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.author: Entendre Entendre
ChIJn3D_U8AvdTERk201g-xXhi0.text: The food was excellent and well presented. The service was attentive and always proactive. An overall pleasant place for dinner. My personal preference would help the staff remove the face masks. It's always more personal to see someone's face.

ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.name: places/ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kd1RUbDRaMnRPVTNoRGQyZFVTbDlJWlZsTmJVRRAB
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.author: Daniel Tang
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.text:
This place definitely fixed my Japanese food craving while in Vietnam. The quality was good & atmosphere was relaxing & comfortable for being a more "casual" Japanese restaurant. If you want "food influencer" Sukiyabashi Jiro or Nobu vibes, you won't get it here.

I ordered an eel lunch set, a set of oysters with quail eggs, and some sushi. Although I had wished they had a wider variety of sushi on their menu, I acknowledge this Japanese restaurant aims to serve more than just sushi.

ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.name: places/ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5dlVEbENUbk5mWkRaMGNtMU1NbmgwZVZwc2NFRRAB
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.author: Timur Kasiev
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.text:
Great sushi, amazing sashimi, perfect udon.

Serving times are fast. Staff are kind and attentive.
The place is cosy and small, recommended to book in advance.

So far my favorite sushi spot in the area.

ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.name: places/ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1dWEybEJabGR3VldwNlExbHlSbGMwZG5ORGRXYxAB
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.author: Dana Dang
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.text:
Really good food. The sushi taste SUPER FRESH^^
I was here with my family and we had fun
They also had a phone case decoration event.
(Sorry I don't have pics of the food)

ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.name: places/ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkeF9LbjJ3RRAB
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.author: Paul Felstein
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.text:
It is so pleasing when the whole dining experience, matches the high rating that attracted us to the restaurant in the first place. The parking security was very helpful and welcoming, as was the server greeting us at the door. Its great when you are met with smiling staff that don't treat customers like an inconvenience, and wish you well, and welcome you to return another time . This tells a lot about the training and supervision that has been given to the wonderful staff.
The food was simply excellent, with an incredibly extensive menu, with so much choice made it difficult to choose beyond the thoughtfully selected platter for two persons. The meal was presented beautifully with flavours that matched the excellence of the service. I highly recommend this restaurant for its delicious and well presented food, and the very reasonable prices of both drinks and varied food options. Most importantly you leave the restaurant with a smile of being well served by trained staff that care about your eating experience.
WELL DONE RYO SUSHI.

ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.name: places/ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuX3BQRFVnEAE
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.author: Maria Demchuk
ChIJ2wGbZqIvdTERyIOz8tKSgw0.text:
Absolutely loved my visit to Ryo Sushi in Ho Chi Minh! ❤️

The fresh salmon was outstanding, and the rolls were perfectly crafted. The atmosphere on the second floor is inviting and adds to the overall experience. The servers were attentive and friendly, making our meal even more enjoyable.

Highly recommend this spot for sushi lovers!

ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.name: places/ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNaanZqc3JnRRAB
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.author: QuinnAnn Pham
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.text:
Great option to go if you want some cheap sushi.

🪑 Space: Located in Nowzone but the restaurant spaces seems pretty small. If you go in bigger group than 4, the group might be broken up. There was not much seatings that you can sit comfortable in. We have to switch from the booth to the regular table yet I still find it to be really small and uncomfortable when eating.

🍣 Food: For the buffet price of 200k, it was absolutely worth it with the variety of option that you can have. You will have 3 pages of food to tryout. Most of their rolls were really fresh and tastes good. I recommend the Nama-geso (chân mực). Their open spaces food (miso, soba, desserts) were really well-organized and tasted good. You’ll have a lot to choose from - ice creams, yogurt, fruits, snacks,… Additionally, the sashimi boat also tasted fresh and good too. Note that they don’t have tons of drink options to choose from other than water and some soft drinks.

💁‍♂️ Services: Staff are generally nice and helpful. We went when there was nobody at the restaurant . However, when more people show up, they struggled a bit as well

ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.name: places/ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSX05lbFFBEAE
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.author: Khoi Nguyen
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.text:
Absolutely worth it!

Me and my gf enjoyed the 5xx package which includes sashimi, those were fresh and tasty, the fried are good too, not so oiled, the desserts were not so special, only the durian cake was significantly appetizing. Free drinks as well

In opposite, the sashimi sets did not have the salmon-only option, and Nowzone mall is quite dull and boring

ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.name: places/ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMcmRXLUFnEAE
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.author: marcus marcus
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.text:
The raw food and the staff were awesome, especially the staff since they check on your table pretty often to make sure whether you need anything . The fish and the oysters were so fresh it’s like you are having a taste of the ocean at the tip of your tongue . If you invite Poseidon here I am pretty sure he will have no objection seeing his servant being served on a plate since they are soo delicious, with every bite leaving that squirt of sea juice into your mouth, it’s like i am eating freshly picked apple in the morning while sucking on Ariel’s bussom . Should really try the oysters while you are here .
The grill section is a nice addition to the menu but it ‘s not worth the 200K add-on to the platinum buffet price in my opinion. Still would recommend you try the raw seafood here

ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.name: places/ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNoeTlhZWd3RRAB
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.author: Victoria
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.text: Looove this place! Been here many times. They have an amazing deal for lunch. The food always tastes fresh,delicious, and looks beautiful. 100% would recommend Sushi in Sushi! Thank you 😊

ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.author: Kim T
ChIJP914V60vdTERyDMoqtM_ruY.text: I got the highest package buffet, seafoods are fresh except oyster, the menu doesn’t has much options to choose for sashimi & grill. But generally, it’s affordable buffet.

ChIJ8_2Q-xYvdTERExJyGgxZvFI.text: The food is fresh, not frozen like I've experienced at other sushi places.  Attention to detail in food presentation is high order.  The wasabi kicks a punch.  So good.

ChIJ8_2Q-xYvdTERExJyGgxZvFI.text: Actually ita soooo yummm! We were bit tired of vietnamese food and decided to to get some japanese. Ordered few sushi roll, miso, tempura and katsu which make our belly so happyyy! The people who work there also very lovely! 9.5/10 for this 🫶🫶

ChIJ8_2Q-xYvdTERExJyGgxZvFI.text: Decent sushi place if you want to have a quick & relaxed meal. It’s not a very high end restaurant but enough for your Japanese hunger pangs! Limited but good food & same is with the beverages. The team is very cooperative and friendly! Place is hygienic and neat!

We would recommend this Sushi Sun to others!

ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.text:
Amazing service, fast and efficient.
Really good prices and great sushi..
Highly recommend.

ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.author: Maja Skowron
ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.text: I’m speechless… The food at this restaurant was simply amazing. Sushi is my favorite dish, and I can honestly say that the sushi here was the best I’ve ever had! The staff and chefs were very friendly. If I could, I’d give it six stars because the food, prices, and service were outstanding. I’ll definitely be back to Sushi Wagao — I love your food!

ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.name: places/ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJLU9pUmpRRRAB
ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.author: AS
ChIJCWRtOw0vdTERnCjDpkp-sMQ.text:
We came on Sunday lunch time today. I would have given 4 star but one of staff  was quite rude so I changed my mind.
As you can see in the picture, when my husband was trying to pay by transfer, the staff (small girl) put the bill on his soup and left. The shop wasn't busy at all, it took only 1 minute to transfer, but for her it's too long to hold the bill and stand there. My husband didn't finish his soup yet, but we were rushing so tried to pay a little bit earlier. Then she put the dirty bill thing on his soup so at the end  he couldn't finish it.
Other staff (the lady with glasses and the boy who looks newbie) were fine, only this staff had grumpy face, no smile, and this impatience attitude. We would understand if they were super busy but she just went back to the  counter and did nothing there. If you don't want to work then go find another job that's not service industry.
Lunch meal wasn't bad but salmon was so thin like supermarket sashimi. Chicken was small so overall I feel it's overpriced.
Never come back to horrible service place.

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.name: places/ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1WVFrZENSMnBHU3paRWRVbDJPRUpJYlRCT1ozYxAB

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.text: All the menu that I ordered were great. However, the grilled mackerel dish didn't include steamed rice which was slightly a surprise. I'd definitely want to visit again

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.name: places/ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwSFdISnBZa0YyVGxvNFNWWjZNRVZEZUZWWk0zYxAB
ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.author: Huyen Anh Trinh
ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.text: Uchi Sushi in D4 offers a compelling concept, blending both buffet and à la carte options, which I found quite appealing. The presentation of the dishes and the table settings were thoughtfully done and added to the dining experience. There's also a good variety of dishes to choose from. While the overall taste was enjoyable, I did find that the freshness, particularly given the impressive setup, wasn't always at the peak I might have hoped for. It wasn't a negative, but something to note.

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.name: places/ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xoNFNqaGhPWE0wYzBoa1duY3dObGhOZDBGRWRWRRAB

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.text: I love it,the foods is great! (Phương)

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.name: places/ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURlMjhDRmt3RRAB
ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.author: Digital Food Nomad
ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.text:
Uchi Sushi is a small, clean, and welcoming spot that serves consistently great sushi at a reasonable price. The menu offers a wide variety of options, but if you want the best of what they have to offer, go for the single selection—like nigiri or sashimi—over the rolls. The quality and freshness of the individual pieces really stand out.

I’ve eaten here multiple times, and the food has always been top-notch. Preparation is precise, presentation is beautiful, and everything tastes fresh.

Service is also quite attentive. Just ring the call button at your table, and the staff responds quickly and courteously—making the experience smooth and efficient.

While the space is small, it’s kept very clean, and the cozy atmosphere adds to its charm. If you're in the area and looking for high-quality sushi without the premium price, Uchi Sushi is highly recommended.

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.name: places/ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21oSlRreDZlVmhHZFZwRVFtdEVTVUpIVVd4SmVtYxAB

ChIJayw8Rm0vdTERhMOL0t9aYhY.text: Good food! Good service, Ms Huynh Như is so supportive

ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.author: Tram Huynh
ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.text:
Haru Sushi exceeded my expectations in every way. The food was exceptionally tasty, and I especially appreciated the fresh wasabi that accompanied the dishes. The service was friendly and efficient, adding to the enjoyable dining experience.

While parking was a bit of a challenge, the overall value for money was excellent. I look forward to returning to Haru Sushi for another delightful meal. It’s definitely worth a visit if you’re craving delicious sushi and great service.

ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.name: places/ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tORlZrVnRaVXQwWHkxckxWOXBOekkwYTBseFRuYxAB

ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.text:
From the visual to the food.
No complains. Will visit again when possible.
Very good service and the upkeep of the dining place is very clean.

ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.author: Tom Bosschaert
ChIJwbObm3UvdTERHE50SWd6zXE.text:

I had about 6 dishes. All ok, but I won't remember anything about this place one week from now.

Michi Sushi, located at 42 Nguyễn Huệ, is a hidden gem! I recently had the pleasure of dining here and was blown away by the beautiful ambiance and delicious food.
The balcony seating area offers stunning views, making it the perfect spot to enjoy a meal while taking in the sights. The sushi selection is impressive, with a range of traditional and modern options to choose from.The food was absolutely delightful, with each piece of sushi expertly crafted and presented. The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff.
If you're a sushi lover or just looking for a beautiful spot to dine, Michi Sushi is a must-visit. The combination of great food, stunning views, and lovely atmosphere makes it an unforgettable experience.
Highly recommend!"

ChIJu-cAsecvdTERaKyHthsyU-0.text: I didn’t set high expectations when visiting this Sushi restaurant because the price looked so reasonable on Grab. I decided to visit it because it’s just within walking distance from my apartment building. Ordered salmon belly sashimi, steamed egg, American beefsteak, fresh oysters and 2 mocktails. The oysters were very fresh, 89k for 5; salmon was fairly fresh, large cuts but there were two pieces of hair under the salmon which i realized after eating all; steamed egg was well-seasoned but the pork belly and shrimp were not very fresh; the beef was overcooked tho i asked for medium-rare and the mocktails were like 25k each but very syrupy. Well, in general good prices for what you get so do not expect too much. The staff could have been more helpful instead of ignoring me. Asked for a fork which never arrived. So i ended up eating my steak w a pair of chopsticks which were quite awkward to be honest. I paid less than 500k for everything so it was a very good deal. If i ate at a fancy sushi restaurant it could have cost me double. My stomach got a bit upset in the evening but i’m not sure if it’s because of the food at the restaurant or something else i had eaten during the day so i cannot justify. So be mindful if you have a bad stomach!

ChIJu63jLcwvdTERaXDnxJigemA.text:
One of the best Japanese restaurants in Phu My Hung! I had dinner here with my wife and daughter on a Saturday night, and it quickly became my favorite Japanese spot in town.

The sashimi was incredibly fresh and naturally sweet, while the rolls were delicious. I was especially impressed by the eel and avocado roll, which had a unique presentation unlike any I had tried at other restaurants.

The ambiance was warm, private, and cozy, with beautifully curated decor that enhanced the dining experience. Though the restaurant is not on the ground floor and requires going up a flight of stairs, it adds to the intimate feel. Once inside, you’re immersed in an authentic Japanese atmosphere.

The service was excellent—waitstaff were attentive, well-trained, and added to the overall experience. If you’re looking for an exceptional Japanese meal in Phu My Hung, this place is a must-visit!

ChIJ774dZf8vdTERZORX3oUGyNU.text:
Hey Saigon foodies! 👋

Wasakura is a rare gem run by a passionate Japanese-Vietnamese couple. Their English might be shy, but their incredible food shouts volumes!

This Japanese Izakaya-Restaurant doesn’t just only serve stellar sushi and sashimi, but it also boasts Bun Cha Ha Noi that rivals the best! Despite a large menu, every dish shines—an impressive feat!

I’ve returned three times, hooked by their thickest sashimi cuts at unbeatable prices. And let’s talk omakase—Wasakura gave me my first experience, and it was worth every bite. Likely the most affordable 10-piece handcrafted omakase sushi set that you’ll find in Saigon!

Times are tough, wallets are tight—but trust me, this spot deserves a visit. Come hungry, leave happy, and start planning your return visit!

ChIJ774dZf8vdTERZORX3oUGyNU.name: places/ChIJ774dZf8vdTERZORX3oUGyNU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNXzNsSV95Z3BtUE93EAE
ChIJ774dZf8vdTERZORX3oUGyNU.author: John Salvador
ChIJ774dZf8vdTERZORX3oUGyNU.text:
A little Japanese restaurant with a full menu of Japanese dishes.

Only had the sushi and it was phenomenal. The pieces were fresh, flavorful, and they had an excellent selection.

They even had engawa (fluke fin)! Make sure you get it aburi (seared) with yuzu!

Ordered the maguro, chu toro, and toro and they all were excellent. The toro just melted in your mouth. No teeth required.

I cannot rave enough about the food.

Service and atmosphere was adequate. No complaints but neither aspect stood out.

My warning is to expect some wait if it gets busy. There is only one sushi chef and if the restaurant has a lot of customers, you will wait some time for your food but trust me the wait will be worth it.

If you are looking for a no nonsense sushi spot I can’t recommend a better place.

ChIJMzC2qucudTERRXkO4uNdE3g.text:
Sushi Cô Chủ Nhỏ is an ideal spot for family meals, offering a cozy atmosphere and a diverse menu at affordable prices. The restaurant also provides birthday decorations, making it a great choice for intimate celebrations. A major highlight is that customers who book a table in advance will receive a complimentary plate of cold noodles. Additionally, dining during the happy hour period comes with a 10% discount on the total bill, making the experience even more budget-friendly.
The dishes here are always fresh, beautifully presented, and visually appealing, ensuring a delightful dining experience. If you’re looking for a sushi restaurant that offers quality food, reasonable prices, and a family-friendly setting, Sushi Cô Chủ Nhỏ is definitely worth a visit.

ChIJhcjfDRMmdTER50Q32VNrQ-g.text: As an American living here 5 years I was delighted to find a good sushi place and had high expectations after seeing your reviews. We have now frequented your place for a couple years. However on the very first experience it was a less than favorable one. Being from the states I asked for a Philly roll which is basically salmon avocado and cream cheese actually the real recipe calls for smoked salmon and if you haven't tried it you should it's one of the most popular selling rules in the states I've been quite surprised that I've only found it in one place in 5 years in Vietnam. Some sushi places do not have cream cheese so they cannot make it for me I know you have cream cheese because cream cheese comes on your eel roll. It's a simple rule to make approximately 33% salmon 33% cream cheese to 33% avocado. The staff refused to do it. This would be okay again if you just didn't have the ingredients the fact that you do have the ingredients and refused to make it even when I agree to pay an extra fee made it the unfavorable experience. I think you're busy enough now and you need to raise your level of service. While writing this review in the air conditioning space of the third floor sitting just under the AC a waiter had there back to us just finishing at the table across from us my sister called him twice, it was clear he was ignoring us. I own restraints and business in multiple countries. There's room for improvement. You should remember busy can slow as fast as it grew, even fast actually. When you agree to make my roll the way I want, being that you have all the Ingredients, I'll change this to a 5 star. Service was lowered to 1 star for employee who ignored my sister.

ChIJE-nxjEkndTEReRMH0dugphE.text:
As usual, I came here expecting the same great experience — friendly staff and a good environment. But today I noticed something had changed. It seems the restaurant has a new chef, and unfortunately, the food quality and portion sizes are not aligned with what I’ve always loved about this place.

I ordered my usual, the salmon cheese sushi, but the portion was really small compared to before. The old chef used to serve generous portions and prepare them super quickly, but today it was very slow. My beef udon took over 35 minutes to come out, even though the restaurant wasn’t very busy. And when it finally arrived, I was surprised to see it prepared like a stir-fry dish instead of a noodle soup bowl as shown on the menu. The salmon pan was also too salty, small, and nowhere near as soft and satisfying as it used to be.

One positive: the lychee rose chia seed drink was still good, made the same way as before. But it’s disappointing that the drinks no longer have the nice decorations they used to — now all the drinks look exactly the same, which makes the presentation kind of boring.

I’ve been coming here almost every day because this restaurant used to be the one place that truly satisfied me after work. But with the change in chef, the taste and culinary style just aren’t the same anymore. I really hope the restaurant can bring back the old chef, because his dishes always left me full and happy.

ChIJq82Oa6MpdTERbkfMjvA4cek.text: Atmosphere was good. Nice looking space, Japanese style, and quite comfortable. The sashimi are the ones to try. ChIJq82Oa6MpdTERbkfMjvA4cek.name: places/ChIJq82Oa6MpdTERbkfMjvA4cek/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRdlpPWEtREAE
ChIJq82Oa6MpdTERbkfMjvA4cek.author: M
ChIJq82Oa6MpdTERbkfMjvA4cek.text:
There's several things I wanted to try, so I ordered 3 things.

The portion sizes were good. I was expecting them to be a little smaller. So, I was pretty full eating everything.

I've never had mapo ramen (only rice) and it's one of my favorite dishes for Asian cuisine. This did not taste great. Maybe the quality was good, but the mapo sauce was a little too sweet-tomatoey. I would not recommend this. Reasonable price, though (95K/$3.70).

I tried the salmon rice bowl. I won't say this tasted unbelievable, but it was good. I was impressed with the salmon. I expected it to be sprinkled on top and perhaps not very much. However, the salmon was spread evenly mixed with the rice throughout the whole bowl. There's some fried salmon skin put on top. Reasonable price, considering it's salmon (138K/$5.40)

I also tried the kimchi & beef sushi roll (55K/$2.15). They have rolls that are more expensive (100K+), this was one of the cheaper ones. I thought it was pretty good.

They only provide a small cup for tea water. I kind of wish they paid more attention to me drinking the water completely so I didn't have to ask for more water. I did ask once, I kind of made sure to be seen finishing off my water a second time. Didn't get another refill.

With the dishes (plates, etc.), this is a nicer place. The bar seats were limited, but they weren't very busy. I do think there's another floor that has tables, but I don't know for sure.

There's 8% VAT.

ChIJGXooYbIodTERv1ZpMxaZlV0.name: places/ChIJGXooYbIodTERv1ZpMxaZlV0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURveGVlZC13RRAB
ChIJGXooYbIodTERv1ZpMxaZlV0.author: Rin Nguyễn
ChIJGXooYbIodTERv1ZpMxaZlV0.text:
This spot is a great choice if you’re looking for a quick and satisfying sushi fix. The sushi here is fresh, well-prepared, and tastes genuinely good. You can tell they use quality ingredients, and each piece is nicely put together without being overly complicated.

The menu is quite varied, offering a solid range from traditional sushi rolls to sashimi and a few creative options, so it’s easy to find something you’ll enjoy. Everything I tried was delicious — fresh fish, well-seasoned rice, and balanced flavors.

Service is another plus. Staff are attentive, friendly, and the food comes out fairly quickly, which makes the whole experience easy and relaxed, especially if you’re stopping by for a casual meal.

The atmosphere is casual but clean and comfortable — nothing fancy, but it gets the job done. Prices are very reasonable too, around 150k VND per person, which feels like a great deal considering the quality and portion sizes.

Overall, it’s a solid place for anyone craving good sushi without having to spend a fortune or dress up. Definitely a spot I’ll keep in mind when I want something quick, fresh, and tasty.

ChIJnz7egrQodTERC_EYnF06RlI.name: places/ChIJnz7egrQodTERC_EYnF06RlI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNicDRfLUlnEAE
ChIJnz7egrQodTERC_EYnF06RlI.author: Andrew Lin
ChIJnz7egrQodTERC_EYnF06RlI.text:
This was the best omakase I’ve experienced outside of Japan and I’ve been to many 1-2 star ones across the world.

Firstly, I’d like to say this is a more traditional style tasting experience. I can tell everything we ate was sourced from the fish to the garnish specifically by the chef. A true omakase experience for enthusiasts of food.

Of course this comes at a certain price point when important high quality fresh ingredients from Japan. This was acceptable to us as people who love tasting the best a culinary experience can offer.

While a traditional tasting experience, there are still a good level of creativity. But don’t expect coming here for a experimental palate tasting. It’s not by any means boring, but the choices made highlight the best of the best instead of trying too much to impress people.

I’d also like to say the head chef was very friendly to us and explained every dish with detail and even an illustration of what fish or seafood we are eating which was unique. Some even came with his own personal story of that particular fish.

The service was attentive as you’d expect with only a few seats. I wanted for nothing. I never had to ask for anything, a glass was never empty when I wanted a drink. The servers poured when cups when empty and asked if I wanted something more without being pushy when I was finished.

We actually came here 2x. One of our first nights in Saigon and we went again on our last night on a trip and it was a great experience both times.

The decor was beautiful and put us in a good mood as a small intimate atmosphere.

I would not be surprised if this omakase receives a star in the future as Michelin has started to come into Vietnam. It was certainly deserving compared to other omakase that had 1-2 ⭐️

Well worth the experience and we will be back next time we visit Saigon.

ChIJm4qIPcQpdTERURKGylYFLrY.text:
Exceptional experience all around. Creative, thoughtful Vietnamese riffs on familiar nigiri such as adding fish herb to rolled saba sushi. Adding kanimiso accentuates the wagyu's umami, and it was very tender as well. The unagi with truffled mash was unexpected but worked very well together!

ChIJm4qIPcQpdTERURKGylYFLrY.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJm4qIPcQpdTERURKGylYFLrY.text:
Food @bredgyeats for more follow posts!

With flavours ferocious yet elegant like a tiger, Omakase Tiger combines high quality seafood with salivating accoutrements that sets it apart from other Japanese course meals. The light rice paper roll with soba and veggies was a light appetizer, lifted with a tangy dragon fruit fermented bean curd sauce. Then you jump straight into the neatly crafted, where the rice is artfully shaped to retain its smaller than average shape, a thoughtful nod to the numerous courses included tonight. The red bigeye was powdered with snow salt, an airy sibling to kosher salt that has an even milder taste. The A5 wagyu simply melted in my mouth, with an aromatic char and distinct beefiness that's elevated with a flavour-packed crab-miso sauce. Pursuing its common theme of taking the jewels of the sea and polishing it with various sauces, the choice of pairing chutoro with blue cheese was daring and bold, reflecting its unique creamy, funky taste that created a new, oddly satisfying but divisive flavour. However, the tried and true combo of fatty otoro and soy sauce is undeniable, further ameliorated by a subtle hint of earthy truffle. Look forward to the unagi hand roll too - a perfectly grilled eel, rendered and fatty with a caramelized char, sweet-savory eel sauce, and crispy burdock root, and a creamy burdock sauce. In the end, you'll leave satisfied with a warming bowl of miso soup and floral sakura ice cream.

Noriboi was such a great experience and memorable meal during my time in Ho Chi Minh. The interior is aesthetic and well-designed. There were also many servers accommodating you as you come in.

There are limited seats, so my friends and I booked a reservation ahead of time. You do have to make a deposit to maintain your reservation.

We each got the first set, and it was amazing! Chef Ha explained the dishes and made each plate meticulously right in front of us. There was a lot of coordination between the servers and the chef, which was great. Our server, Vy was always there if we had any questions and would fill our drinks before we would have to ask. The service was amazing! The food was also spectacular. The wagyu and sea bream were my favorite plates. The wagyu just melted in your mouth, and the fish were so fresh. Loved the smell of smoked fish and wagyu as they were making it.

I thoroughly enjoyed my time ay Noriboi and definitely would have to stop by the next time I visit!

ChIJ_VSzxBcndTERASffvqvt4H8.text:
I had a remarkable omakase experience at Omakase Tiger.
What stands out here is the intentional progression of the meal — something many restaurants attempt, but few truly execute.

The opening courses were clean and delicate, designed to wake the palate. Mid-meal dishes brought deeper umami and texture, and the pacing was excellent. The chef communicates through contrast: warm rice against cold fish, crisp nori against rich fillings, subtle seasonings that highlight rather than mask.

The uni + ikura gunkan near the finale was extraordinary — a true climax of creaminess, salinity, and warmth. It’s rare to taste a bite that feels like the emotional peak of the entire evening.

Drink pairing was also spot-on. The sake complemented the early, lighter courses, and the highball transitioned perfectly into richer, heavier bites.

Service was attentive without being intrusive, and the atmosphere is intimate, modern, and quietly confident.

A beautifully orchestrated omakase — absolutely worth experiencing.

ChIJGZFx_DwvdTERz2BcejODpsY.text:
Well… I don’t even know where to begin. I paid 3.5 million VND for an omakase experience and expected something at least close to that price point.

First of all, the rice was overcooked and kept warm in a rice cooker. When I asked the owner why, he proudly said it was his “special style.” That’s a bold statement, considering the rice is the foundation of nigiri – and here, it failed completely.

Then came the seafood. At this price, I expected top-tier quality, but it felt more like Hokkaido Sushi – except ten times more expensive. The uni and caviar were laughably basic, as the photo clearly shows.

And here’s the cherry on top: the chef first used a metal knife to scoop the caviar, then handed us a mother-of-pearl spoon to serve ourselves – as if that somehow fixed it. Anyone who actually cares about caviar knows that metal alters its flavor. It’s like polishing a cheap stone and calling it a diamond.

And just when I thought it couldn’t get more underwhelming, the dessert arrived – a so-called matcha mochi that tasted like something from a budget supermarket freezer. It didn’t just lack real matcha flavor – it hadn’t even been in the same room as actual matcha.

Overall, this wasn’t an omakase experience – it was basic fish on mushy rice, topped with culinary shortcuts and finished off with a fake-green dessert, all wrapped in a fine-dining price tag. I’ve had omakase from Tokyo to Michelin-starred restaurants in NYC, and this one wouldn’t even pass as mid-range. Disappointing is an understatement.

ChIJDZo3x64ldTERns_zS9k8Jdo.text:
Dining at Sushi Nishitsugu Omakase in Saigon is a truly memorable experience for anyone who appreciates Japanese cuisine at its finest. From the moment you sit down, the customer service stands out. The staff and chef go above and beyond, carefully explaining the origin of every ingredient, how it is prepared, and the story behind each dish. This not only makes the meal more enjoyable but also gives you a deeper appreciation for the art of sushi.

The chef himself is outstanding—both friendly and approachable, yet clearly very experienced and passionate about his craft. He takes the time to engage with each guest, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while still delivering food of the highest standard. His skill and dedication show through in every course.

The quality of the ingredients is remarkable. Rare and seasonal fish are flown in daily from Japan, ensuring that everything served is of the utmost freshness. Each piece of sushi highlights the natural flavors of the seafood while being perfectly balanced with rice, seasoning, and technique. Every bite feels thoughtful and deliberate, making the omakase experience truly worth the price.

What makes Sushi Nishitsugu stand out is not only the top-tier quality of the fish but also the attention to detail, presentation, and the personalized service. It feels less like dining at a restaurant and more like being invited to enjoy a crafted culinary journey. For those seeking authentic Japanese omakase in Saigon, this is undoubtedly one of the best options in the city.

ChIJp4yFIHYvdTER-EeoJzibGME.text:
Located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, just steps away from iconic landmarks, this omakase restaurant is a hidden gem.

Served primarily by Malaysian-born chef, Han. His expertise in Japanese cuisine is evident in every dish. During my Christmas Eve visit, the menu featured the freshest seafood, with highlights such as fugu and abalone. The ingredients were exceptional, and the attention to detail was unmatched. Certain dishes were elevated with touches like edible gold, and the wasabi was authentic and grated in front of you—far from the packaged variety. I learnt so much about food whenever I visit this restaurant!

A truly refined dining experience with a focus on quality and presentation!

ChIJwescQwApdTERFkAdfK_fKCI.text:
Ume Sushi & Omakase – A Refined Japanese Dining Experience

Ume Sushi & Omakase is a hidden gem for Japanese cuisine lovers, offering a premium omakase experience with beautifully crafted dishes and fresh, high-quality ingredients. From delicate sashimi platters and perfectly balanced sushi bites to seasonal small plates, every detail reflects precision and care.

The service is excellent — attentive yet unobtrusive — making the dining experience feel warm and personal. The staff ensures that each course is explained thoughtfully, enhancing your appreciation of the ingredients and preparation.

The restaurant itself is cozy and intimate, a little on the smaller side, but its Japanese zen-inspired décor creates a calm and inviting atmosphere. Soft lighting, minimalistic designs, and natural elements blend together to make you feel relaxed while enjoying your meal.

If you’re looking for a place where quality meets authenticity, Ume Sushi & Omakase is definitely worth visiting. It’s ideal for special occasions, date nights, or simply treating yourself to an elevated Japanese dining experience.

ChIJ5fLYZncvdTERgBI4OHHOuUc.text:
ORDERED: 1,500,000 ₫ / ~$87.00aud omakase set

REVIEW:
My cousin found this omakase place off TikTok.
As others have mentioned, the seafood isn't particularly fresh because some of my sashimi had a fishy aftertaste and was a little chewy. 🐟

🔪 The chef's knife skills were... interesting.
Usually chefs make a clean cut through the sashimi, but I watched as a chef at Sushi Taka was sawing into the flesh (in 2 motions).
Perhaps the knife wasn't sharp enough, but avoiding a clean cut impacts the fragile texture of it.
This might've led to my slightly chewy kingfish.

⭐ Although the service was engaging at first (proactively introducing the dishes), it dropped off after that and the waitress resorted to just placing our dishes in front of us. It would be great if they continued the engaging service.

Overall, to me Sushi Taka felt less like a personalised, intimate dining experience and leaned more into a casual, approachable environment. Definitely see why some reviewers are saying they would come back here for casual drinks and eats. 🍸

ChIJSe8EdAAndTERHlakK9Wtp2A.text: Excellent omakase. Only one set comprising of 6 sashimi, one grilled fish, chawan mushi, 9 sushi and a desert. All in that order. We couldn't tell the difference but every piece was sublime. Well marinated with the right balance and for the sushi, rice at the right temperature and ideal vinegar concentration. My favourites were the shirako, torigai and amaebi. Even the yuzu sorbet was fantastic. We highly recommend Hung and will be back for another season!

Adding to my review:
We had an amazing first visit to Hung Omakase—fresh, high-quality seafood and impeccable service. Hung’s attention to detail really stood out, and it felt like a true culinary experience.

However, on our second visit with family (party of 5), the experience was a bit lackluster in comparison. Service wasn’t as smooth, possibly due to staff still being in training. The menu also seemed less premium—missing standout items like lobster and abalone from our first visit. One concern was the inconsistency in what was served: while we ordered the same package as other guests, we didn’t receive the oyster course they did. For an omakase experience, consistency matters.

Still a good spot, but we hope to see more attention to detail and quality control across all seatings in the future.

ChIJxX3ohP8pdTERiO6LP6VYx6w.text: This is probably the worst restaurant I have ever been to. The name of the restaurant is omakase but the food here is made by the chef behind the curtain and then brought out to do a few embellishments like spraying gold dust, creating a layer of smoke. I came to the restaurant on a rather empty evening but there were still 2 employees trying to squeeze in next to me to take pictures of the food for pictures. The lighting here is quite dark, the loud music drowned out the chef's introduction of the food. The food was quite fishy, ​​cold, and too salty for my taste. I left almost everything after trying the first bite of each dish. After eating almost half of the menu, it started to rain heavily and the ceiling of the restaurant started to fall down in many places and we had to move around 2 or 3 times. Overall, the meal was terrible, costing more than 2 million. I hope the restaurant reads this review and considers making improvements so as not to affect the customer experience when dining out.

ChIJxX3ohP8pdTERiO6LP6VYx6w.text:
I tried the omakase 750k/pax but I felt like leaving after the 3rd dish.

The ingredients here are very normal (if not diverse and unique) compared to going to a normal sushi restaurant and ordering a single dish. The chef works in a closed kitchen and then brings out a few sentences about the ingredients before going in. The view to sit and eat is the sink, gas tank, electric switch... It's like I'm dressed up nicely and smell good and then go into the kitchen, not inspired to eat. Ginger is not added compared to normal sushi restaurants. Finally, they push me the rice to make me feel full at the end of the hour. I still try to sit and wait to see if there's anything interesting at the end but I feel like it's a waste of time and money.

In total, I spent about 1 million/pax to sit and eat about 10 meals for 1 hour and I feel it's not worth it. Compared to ordering a single dish, each person will spend less than 500k to be full. But if you pay an extra 500k for such a service, it is not worth the money. In short, it is not worth trying!

ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.author: KELLY
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.text:
The sashimi was exceptionally fresh, and the seasoning was perfectly balanced to my taste. The staff's enthusiastic explanations of each dish while we enjoyed sake added a delightful touch to the dining experience.

The restaurant's location is easily accessible, and the ambiance is comfortably inviting. They offer private rooms, which are ideal for groups of friends, business meetings, or anyone seeking a more intimate dining experience.

I'd like to express my sincere gratitude to the Chef for crafting such a truly perfect dinner."

ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.name: places/ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYOXVqTVlBEAE
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.author: Healthy Life
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.text: I recently dined at Sushi Koji and it was an outstanding experience. The menu was thoughtfully curated, combining traditional Japanese flavors with creative twists, all at a very reasonable price for the high quality offered. Each dish was finely prepared, and the presentation was impeccable. The authenticity of the cuisine, paired with a touch of innovation, truly enhanced the dining experience. I thoroughly enjoyed every bite and will definitely return.

ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.name: places/ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBcFpQUmVBEAE
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.author: HT
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.text: I had an omakase evening at Sushi Koji in the beginning of Feb 2025. The restaurant is located on the 4th floor of a building on Ngo Van Nam street. I was greeted and led to my seat by the staff and then started my dinner. As the head of the restaurant is an Japanese chef who hold so many years of experience in different countries, the ambience of the restaurant made me feel like I was in Japan. There are 2 menus which are the Ume and Take that cost around 2 mils and 2.6 mils respectively. The one that costs more have a few more dishes to go with. The taste and the vibe of the dinner were impeccable. As you know, omakase is like eating while watching a show by the chef, it is interesting to be able to observe how the chef prepare your food with their skillful hands. You can even chit chat with the chef on his history, the dishes, etc which is such an amusing opportunity as usually, you only get served sushi at your table at a normal sushi restaurant. I strongly recommend you guys to try this once when you are in town.

ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.name: places/ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMdXI0YUxaOE9iX05REAE
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.author: Thang Nguyen
ChIJOR83TAAvdTERoPqV6bHPPHE.text: Top omakase in Vietnam! Sashimi so fresh and delicious. Service is the best class. Should not miss this restaurant while you are in Ho Chi Minh City.

ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.name: places/ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKU1J6TkJSamhZVDB0UFgxSllVa3BrYzA1YVVuYxAB
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.author: 虫でんでん
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.text: It’s an experience. This place had very fresh seafood imported from Japan. Chef was a work of art himself. We loved it. Also notable were the very friendly and attentive staff.  The preparation area looks clean enough and all that but I personally had to commence my meal by killing ants and flies. Well in spite  an overall pleasant and enjoyable experience I have to minus one star for the obvious signs of a poorly maintained restaurant. Such as the numerous ants and tiny flies running around  ( very annoying ones ). Also the walls by the entrance show signs of a persistent water leak and stains. Kind of what you sometimes see in vacant houses. The main door was also giving trouble opening and closing. All these aren’t  something you’d expect in a restaurant for this price and stature.

ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.name: places/ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pNNFlUTnlja05YZUZFd1VHdE1SMjgxYW1acFZYYxAB
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.author: Yogurt
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.text: The sushi here is of good quality, and the atmosphere is inviting. The staff is very friendly, and the chef pays careful attention to every detail. However, I haven’t found any dish that truly impressed me. That said, considering the price and the portion sizes, I think the overall experience is quite good.

ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.name: places/ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGakxVaHJkWFZHVmpaM1JVMDBNVkEyV0RkTmVuYxAB
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.author: Mai Trần
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.text: Had the chance to try Omakase for the first time over the weekend at this restaurant. It’s tucked away on a small street just off Nguyen Hue walking street. Despite being a weekend, the place wasn’t too crowded, which made it peaceful and perfect for chatting with the chef about the dishes or just enjoying a relaxed conversation with friends. The staff were attentive and thoughtful. As for the food — the freshness and quality were absolutely top-notch. Each piece of sushi just melted in my mouth. All in all, a wonderful experience and definitely worth trying, especially for a date night 🫶🏻

ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.name: places/ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25WZmRIWXdNa0pJTUZneE9FRnhhakpETVVGT2EzYxAB
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.author: Vinh H.
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.text: We came in last month and the experience was amazing! Hoàng, Tuấn, and Tùng (apologies if I got your names wrong!) were terrific at explaining and walking us through the courses. And of course, all the food was fresh, high quality, and delicious! Highly recommended. Check them out!

ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.name: places/ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OaU1uTnZkVXN0YldGRE1EVXpkamx2VkRSNk1FRRAB
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.author: Daisy Tran
ChIJCQ43nzYvdTERBEVfmM85Yi4.text: The ingredients were quite fresh, with some unique and tasty fish selections. However, the number of dishes felt limited for the price, and there wasn’t much creativity in the presentation or flavors. The seating wasn’t very comfortable, and the lighting was a bit too bright, which took away from the overall ambiance. On the positive side, the staff was professional and attentive. Overall, it was a decent experience, but not memorable enough to make me want to return.

ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.name: places/ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pZeGREZDJaRTV2V2tORlpEZG5WMGxxWldaMFYxRRAB
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.author: John Michael Ditchon
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.text:
Omakase Yuu is a small cozy place located in the bustling street of Phan Xich Long. Despite the small space, the food is fantastic and is very fresh. This omakase is definitely one of the places I will continue to visit. From appetizer to dessert, everything was served to perfection. This place is very well recommended and will definitely go back here from time to time.

Thank you for the wonderful meal and accommodating us on my birthday dinner yesterday. 🫶🫶🫶

ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.name: places/ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sNmJHaDRlVmR1Y1hjMFVqbDZTVU4wTTNkck5WRRAB
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.author: Tina Nguyen
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.text:
I had an extremely good experience here. I’m someone who normally doesn’t like eating raw fish, but that day my friend invited me to dine here. I mentioned this to the chef, as I was worried that I wouldn’t be able to fully enjoy the meal and might trouble the chef by asking to have the raw fish dishes cooked even though I knew that was quite an odd request.

However, the chef gave me an amazing experience. The food quality here is excellent, and the chef even prepared special dishes just for me. To my surprise, I tried raw fish for the first time, and it was nothing like I imagined,  it was actually delicious.

Besides the quality of the food, the chef and staff also paid great attention to the customer experience. They always checked in after each dish, introduced and explained in detail every ingredient, how it was prepared, and the proper way to enjoy it.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I think you should definitely give it a try.

ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.name: places/ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGWVZWVXdWVTF4ZVZOd05UaGxkWGQzVTB4TVZXYxAB
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.author: Thuyyy
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.text: Cozy spot that’s truly worth the price and quality. Every dish, crafted by the head chef, looks simple yet reveals complex preparation and a story behind it. Def recommend

ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.name: places/ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CUU4wWmliM2hZY1Vzd1lrTlpYMkZFV0U1R01HYxAB
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.author: Kathy Nguyen
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.text: Reasonable price for good quality of food. Will come back

ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.author: Helena Truong
ChIJOWn_fBMpdTERtsqHP24NjtU.text:
Located in Phan Xich Long food street, Omakase Yuu has 3 menus: En 700k, Shin 1,200k, Tsui 1,600k.

It was my first time here so I tried the En menu with a total of 14 dishes. Including 2 appetizers, 3 types of sashimi, grilled dishes, spicy dishes, 4 types of sushi, egg cakes, miso soup and ice cream mochi dessert.

The food is fresh and delicious, I was impressed with the crispy black sea bream. The staff and chef are enthusiastic.

Especially the super cute security guard, enthusiastically leading the vehicle and guiding customers. If you want to experience omakase, Yuu is a place worth trying!
