ChIJIYhCh4kndTERvCAYMibJXTo.text:
Near Tet, the air is a bit chilly, finding a delicious vermicelli with shrimp paste restaurant like H-Famil is truly a wonderful experience. The restaurant space is cozy, clean, bringing a feeling of relaxation and comfort after a long day. (I like the restaurant with 2 fronts, very airy, motorbikes or cars can park)

The vermicelli with shrimp paste here is beautifully displayed on a traditional bamboo tray, full of crispy fried tofu, fragrant sticky rice sausage, soft and sweet boiled meat and rich fried sausage. The highlight is the shrimp paste mixed with the right flavor, fragrant but not too strong, add a little kumquat, chili and sugar to make it delicious and impeccable.

On the occasion of Tet, the restaurant still serves attentively, the staff is friendly and quick, making the meal even more complete. If you are looking for a delicious vermicelli with shrimp paste restaurant to gather with friends or enjoy the taste of Hanoi in the heart of District 2, H-Famil is definitely a choice not to be missed!

👉 Rating: 10/10 – Will come back again!

The vermicelli is soft and fragrant, the green rice sausage is ok, the pork leg is soft. The price of 89k for a full serving of toppings is cheaper than a glass of branded drink, but it's too filling. If you can upgrade with a little Hanoi spring rolls, it would be excellent. The food comes out quickly, the staff is friendly.

ChIJfdKuDAArdTERdsJjmTQK09g.text:
🌟 Review Bun Dau Pho Gam Cau - Tay Thanh (Tan Phu)

Space & location
The restaurant is located on Tay Thanh street, easy to find and has indoor and outdoor seating. The space is simple but clean, the wooden tables and chairs create a comfortable feeling, suitable for groups of friends or families to come and have a light meal.

Food quality
A full plate of noodles with a variety of toppings: crispy fried tofu, fragrant sticky rice sausage, soft and sweet boiled meat, golden fried spring rolls, delicious chewy cartilage sausage and fresh raw vegetables. The shrimp paste is mixed well, has a characteristic aroma, not harsh - eaten with soft noodles and toppings, it is extremely delicious. The ingredients are all fresh, the taste is very Northern, making me feel like I am eating in Hanoi.

Service & experience
The space is clean, the dishes are served quickly and the staff is friendly. I always order another plate every time I finish eating because the quality is so good, I don't get bored at all.

Reasonable price
Prices range from about 40k – 120k for a full plate—and with such quality and filling food, I think it’s worth it.

⸻

** In summary**:
Bun Dau Pho Gam Cau Tay Thanh deserves 5 stars in my heart: delicious food, quality toppings, comfortable space and reasonable price. If you’re craving authentic Northern-style bun dau near Tan Phu, this restaurant is the perfect place!

Bun Dau Bao - Review of delicious food on Tan Ky Tan Quy Street

Located on Tan Ky Tan Quy Street, Bun Dau Bao is an ideal destination for those who love traditional bun dau.

** Strengths:**
- Fresh, quality vegetables.

- Fried tofu with meat is both crispy and delicious, creating a unique flavor.

- Vermicelli is soft and delicious, suitable for Vietnamese taste.

- Shrimp paste is a bit sweet but not too cloying, creating a unique flavor for the dish.

There is free wifi service, convenient for customers.

- The price is relatively affordable, suitable for the quality and service. 1 portion for 4 people costs 320k for mixed portion.

** Weaknesses:**
- Shrimp paste may be a bit sweet for some people's taste.

In short, Bun Dau Bao is a great choice for a delicious, nutritious and affordable lunch. With a comfortable space, quality food and attentive service, this is definitely a destination worth experiencing on your culinary journey.

ChIJMyXgaCUpdTERR3Bp1S5B9Y0.author: Cyndi Travel
ChIJMyXgaCUpdTERR3Bp1S5B9Y0.text:
If you're in Vietnam for over a week, chances are you'll start to crave rice. In the vicinity of the pink church, there's a fried rice joint that's all about that dish. The place has a local vibe, with green and yellow being the dominant colors. When we visited, seating wasn't an issue, but it might be busier during peak hours.

We went for the Yangzhou Fried Rice and the Pork Fat Fried Rice, which had similar flavors, but the rice texture wasn't on point. It was harder and drier than we would have liked, but the dish was still filling and had some decent taste to it.

If you want to read more reviews about places in Ho Chi Minh and Malaysia, do follow me on Instagram by searching iamcynditravel.

ChIJMyXgaCUpdTERR3Bp1S5B9Y0.name: places/ChIJMyXgaCUpdTERR3Bp1S5B9Y0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQybE15R1pREAE

ChIJMyXgaCUpdTERR3Bp1S5B9Y0.text:
The interior design is inspired by Ha Noi ancient town. It reminds me so much about Ha Noi 😙

Staffs are very nice, they offered us with best-sellers dishes. So many sizes for Bun Dau that you can choose. The fermented shrimp paste is so delicious, you can never go wrong with this paste.

Noodles is quite big for one bite, should cut it smallers for guests. Meats and intestines are fresh and well-cooked. This meal cost around nearly 100k/person which is very good.

Tables are clean, staffs served very fast and food are so delicious as well. In overall, i give this place a 10/10 for quality and service. Will definitely come back again.

If you can't rat shirmp paste, they will have soy sauce or fish sauce for you but Bun Dau won't be delicious without shrimp paste guys 🥺🥺🥺

ChIJad24HAApdTERJeih4FVSHeU.text:
I ordered it around 9pm, the shipper delivered it and the staff was struggling not knowing what to do but still completed the order for me. Thanks for saving my hungry stomach.

It was quite late at night so I didn't expect much about the quality at the end of the day, but on the contrary, I was extremely satisfied. I ordered 1 portion of Bun Dau Cha Com and extra beans and noodles, the portion when opened was extremely large. I even had to divide it for 2 people.

The fried beans and Cha Com were hot. The beans were crispy and fragrant, the inside was still soft and smooth. The cucumbers were cut into thick pieces, the vegetables were clean.

The packaging was very neat, super good impression.

But the downside was that my boyfriend was constantly calling for work that day so I couldn't eat completely! 🥹

I have updated the photos and menu, please like my review or like my photos if you find my contribution useful! I will be motivated to review more places for you! If you need to review any restaurant, please comment ❤️💪🥰

ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs.name: places/ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6bVBLc0pREAE
ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs.author: Darren
ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs.text:
Authentic local Vietnamese experience in a well furnished restaurant. Excellent food with a nice view of the street from the upper floor. Snails with minced pork were huge, fresh and bouncy. Very generous filling in their spring rolls, served hot and crispy.

Interesting specialty soya beancurd dessert - the left half of the bowl was hot and salty, the other half of the bowl was cold and sweet! All this with mini sparkly, bouncy, chewy glutinous rice balls.

ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs.author: Desmond Phua
ChIJVZH45-0ndTER0nDcr-1VQVs.text:
A very authentic Vietnamese restaurant in Thao Dien serving delicious food. It may be hard to spot the restaurant as the front of the restaurant is not very obvious from main road, however upon entering the restaurant, you can see a lot of locals enjoying their meal there.

Ordered a combination of fried tofu, sausages, meat, vegetables, shrimp pancakes, fermented pork for sharing among colleagues. Everything taste really good, just like home cooked food. For non-Vietnamese, it would be good to get local friends to bring you there as the menu are in Vietnamese.

I visited the branch on Nguyen Duy Trinh. The road is under construction so it's a bit dusty
Mac Van Khoa vermicelli and tofu restaurant is quite crowded, especially on weekends, so if you go during peak hours, you should be prepared to wait a bit.
The shrimp paste here is very delicious, rich in flavor and mixed well - a big plus compared to many other places.
I tried it once and found it more delicious than many other vermicelli and tofu restaurants I've eaten at before, I will definitely come back.
The restaurant space is dominated by yellow tones so it's a bit hot to the eyes, but it's clean and also has its own style.
Overall, it's worth a visit if you like authentic vermicelli and tofu.

The crocodile water is normal like other restaurants

The restaurant has crab hotpot, next time I will definitely try this dish.

The restaurant is very high quality, so I will stop by to eat

ChIJ5Siz_6UrdTERgeED3iMcsbM.text:
This is my review 3 months ago, I only gave it 2 stars because of the quality, service, and space. But the other day I came back and was served by the owner of the bun dau shop (Mr. Toan). 

As a shop owner, he knows how to keep customers, he is older but he communicated with me very politely. He did not stand there pointing and ordering the staff to do things, but he took the initiative to welcome customers, park their motorbikes, order for customers, clean up everything when customers finished eating without having to wait for the staff to do it, serve shrimp paste, spices (sugar, lime, chili...) thoughtfully even though I did not have them on my table, he still brought them for me. As for chopsticks, I complained about them last time and they replaced them for customers. To be honest, I went to eat late that day (11pm) and it was cold due to the rain, when I got there I was very satisfied with the service. 

I just hope that when you recruit employees, you train them in communication skills at work with customers and be more proactive like you, then I think our shop will develop even more.

ChIJdxKXcRgpdTERHraLB5Jn30Q.text: Great place to try one of the most smelly dishes in Vietnam, Bún Đậu Mắm tôm. Mắm tôm here is well mixed and what you need to do is add some lemonade and/or slices of chilli depending on your preference. People also get 1 free ice cream stick if their bill is more than 200,000 VND. What I love about this place is how cute they are. If you can understand Vietnamese, I can sure that you will have some enjoyable moments since reading poems and sentences written on the board hanging on the wall~! Moreover, the staff here are really helpful so don't hesitate to ask them for help! This is just a small warning that If you can't stand with Mắm tôm (a most foetid Vietnamese sauce), don't go in because it will be a nightmare 😅. Enjoy!

ChIJE-LBqKcndTERbCpq5tZdNYw.text:
📍2D Street No. 17, Linh Chieu, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh

I found the restaurant while browsing on Maps, saw a lot of good reviews so I stopped by to experience and this is my personal feeling (a person who really loves vermicelli with shrimp paste 🤭)

The restaurant has a spacious and clean space, serving 8 tables, the distance between tables is just enough. Fully equipped with chopsticks, chili scissors, small knives to cut kumquats, tissues, sugar jars, fried onion jars, and trash baskets at each table. Kumquats and chili will be brought out while you wait for your food.

The staff are cute, friendly, and take good care of customers. However, the parking lot in front of the restaurant is a bit small, there may not be a parking space when the restaurant is too crowded.

Regarding the portion size, I honestly share with the restaurant and everyone that it is not as much as I imagined, just relatively full. The toppings include tofu, fried spring rolls, sausage, boiled meat, green rice sausage, spring rolls, and various vegetables. In addition, the restaurant gives away free mint candies.

Hope this review is useful to you. If you find this place interesting, please come and try it out!

Met Bun Dau is truly a destination worth trying! 🥢
The vermicelli with tofu here is delicious, the shrimp paste is mixed with the right flavor — both rich and fragrant. The restaurant is clean, tidy, comfortable space and especially the staff is extremely friendly and pleasant.

In addition to the famous vermicelli with tofu, the restaurant also has delicious fake dog meat. I only tried one bite and "fell into the trap", had to buy 1kg to take home. The meat is soft, fragrant, well-seasoned, and goes well with rice or vermicelli.

Anyone who loves vermicelli with tofu and shrimp paste and wants to change the wind with a delicious dish should definitely stop by and try it!

The space is cool, both outdoors and air-conditioned, cool and airy, without the strong smell of shrimp paste.

✅️ Food: the presentation of the dish is quite eye-catching, clean, hot, less greasy.
Bun Dau 85k: suitable for the taste, the noodles are mushy, when picked up they fall off, probably not pressed well.
Bun Cha 50k: not too sweet or too bland, light dipping sauce, fresh green vegetables.
After eating, you will be given a plate of fruit.
✅️ Service: enthusiastic and thoughtful instructions, dishes are served quite quickly.
✅️ Space: there are 2 areas with air conditioning and a yard, spacious, cool. The interior is decorated in a cozy, beautiful tone.
✅️ Price: not expensive but not cheap, sitting in the air conditioning is reasonable.
Vote: 7/10 🌟
The food is okay, the food and service are better than other restaurants in the same area.

This attitude is worth criticizing, an APOLOGY is fine, right? There's no need to compensate for another meal or refund, there's no loss, but I didn't receive anything from the staff.

ChIJgf2heqkndTERaaYp6gaVBqc.text:
I heard a friend recommend it so I stopped by to try it.
The space is chill, beautiful, clean.
The waiters are attentive but not professional.
I walked in, just asked what he wanted to eat, while the menu was on the table, not shown to the customer, then what to order. I had to reach out and take it myself and order.
As for the food, I was not very satisfied.

- There was no rice paper.

- The vegetables seemed not to be picked carefully, there were still rotten parts.

- I think the food is ok, just a lot of it, but I saw a lot of tofu, looking at the big tray, 1/3 is tofu.

- The biggest minus point is the fish sauce, the soul of this dish is not taken care of. The fish sauce is very salty, I squeezed 3 kumquats and 3 spoons of sugar to suppress that salty taste, but the fish sauce is not good. There is no hot oil in the fish sauce so it lacks the fatty and fragrant taste.
Probably won't come back. Damn.

ChIJtRT0QRQndTER2qhp36s3QTg.author: Kim Thoa Lê
ChIJtRT0QRQndTER2qhp36s3QTg.text:
The vermicelli and fried tofu tray here is beautifully presented with a variety of toppings such as crispy fried tofu, green rice sausage, boiled pork, cartilage sausage, fried spring rolls, and fresh vegetables, as well as rice paper and candy. 
The fried tofu is golden and crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, the green rice sausage is soft and fragrant, the cartilage sausage is delicious, the spring rolls are also ok, and the boiled pork is sliced quite thick. The shrimp paste here has a harmonious taste, mixed properly, not too salty or sweet, adding a little lime and chili to create a unique flavor. 
The staff is quick, friendly and always ready to support customers. The food is brought out quite quickly and always hot because I see the restaurant prepare the dish after I order. 
The restaurant space is cool with many doors, fans and trees. I ordered more sour plum juice to drink, which has a sweet taste and a slightly fermented smell. 
Overall, this is a pretty good choice for those who love Northern cuisine and want to enjoy vermicelli and fried tofu with shrimp paste, which I think is quite delicious and suitable.

ChIJNTg_40zZdDERjtMDFaRcOpw.text:
Today I visited Bun Dau Van restaurant along the University of Science road. The menu has a basic selection of dishes, but the prices are higher than other restaurants in the area, and the portions are quite small for the price. I felt the portions were a bit small.

The tables were relatively clean, but the floor wasn't cleaned regularly and looked a bit dirty.

The lime and chili in the dipping sauce were pre-cut and left out for a long time, so they weren't very good quality.

Most notably, there were an incredible number of flies in the restaurant. Flies were flying around and landing on me, the tables, and the food, which was very unpleasant and unhygienic. The restaurant seemed to be aware of the situation but acted indifferent, not trying to fix it.

Additionally, you have to bring extra rice paper wrappers with each order. This is something I can overlook because of the restaurant.

The only positive point is that they give you a breath freshening candy. Many shortcomings need to be addressed. This is my subjective opinion; it might not be the case on other days, but today was the case.

ChIJm0lL7dcvdTERLSUg4GlmdAc.text: Chicken sticky rice, Michelin star–guided restaurant, wasn’t that busy. ChIJm0lL7dcvdTERLSUg4GlmdAc.author: M Review
ChIJm0lL7dcvdTERLSUg4GlmdAc.text:
Nestled on a bustling street corner in Saigon, Xôi Gà Number One is a culinary institution that has stood the test of time, a true testament to the power of a single, perfected dish. This is not a formal dining experience; it's an authentic, immersive taste of Vietnamese street food culture at its very best. The atmosphere is lively and a little chaotic, with the aroma of fried shallots and simmering sauces wafting from the small, open-air stall.

The star of the show, and the reason for its loyal following, is the sticky rice. It's an art form here, with a texture that is both wonderfully chewy and incredibly fragrant. The rice serves as the perfect canvas for the generous toppings. The chicken, cooked to tender perfection, is pulled and served with a variety of accompaniments that create a symphony of flavors and textures in every bite. The crispy, fried shallots add a delightful crunch and nutty depth, while the rich, savory sauce ties everything together. The addition of a quail egg or a piece of Chinese sausage elevates the dish from simple street food to a truly satisfying and complex meal.

While the xôi is the main attraction, a visit isn't complete without trying the sugarcane drink. It's a revelation—freshly pressed and mixed with a surprising blend of citrus juices like orange and lime. The result is a drink that cuts through the richness of the sticky rice with a perfect balance of sweetness and acidity, a refreshing counterpoint to the savory dishes.

Xôi Gà Number One is more than just a place to eat; it's a piece of Saigon's history and a celebration of the simple, honest pleasure of good food. The prices are incredibly reasonable, offering a fantastic value for such a flavorful and filling meal. This is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience authentic, unpretentious, and unforgettable Vietnamese cuisine.

ChIJmbzh7ccodTER_rLFPiZa_io.text: Many of my friends told me this was the best Xoi Chien in town... They weren't wrong! I really wasn't disappointed! The sticky rice is good. Their char xiu is awesome, soft and flavorful. The fried chicken was tender and moist. The sauce was perfect! Damn it, I want more!

ChIJmbzh7ccodTER_rLFPiZa_io.name: places/ChIJmbzh7ccodTER_rLFPiZa_io/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURVMk9QVTFRRRAB
ChIJmbzh7ccodTER_rLFPiZa_io.author: Thanh Hảo Lê
ChIJmbzh7ccodTER_rLFPiZa_io.text:
As a traveler, there's nothing quite like stumbling upon a hidden gem, especially when it comes to food. That's exactly what happened to me at Ba Chieu Market in Ho Chi Minh City. I was wandering around the stalls, my stomach rumbling after a long day of exploring, when the aroma of sticky rice stopped me in my tracks.

Now, I've had my fair share of sticky rice throughout my travels in Southeast Asia, but this one was different. The vendor, a friendly woman with a kind smile, explained it was Ba Chieu Chicken Sticky Rice. Intrigued, I ordered a portion.

Let me tell you, it did not disappoint. The fluffy, perfectly cooked rice had a subtle sweetness that was balanced beautifully by the savory chicken. The chicken itself was a revelation - tender, flavorful, and with a hint of crispness on the skin. It was clear this wasn't your average street food chicken. Every bite was a delightful explosion of textures and tastes.

The portion size was perfect for an afternoon snack, and incredibly affordable.  But what really made the experience special was the atmosphere. The market buzzed with life, the air thick with the aroma of spices and cooking.  Eating this delicious sticky rice felt like being welcomed into a small piece of Saigon's culinary scene.

If you find yourself in Ho Chi Minh City and have a craving for something authentic and delicious, look no further than Ba Chieu Chicken Sticky Rice. It's a true hidden gem that won't break the bank, and a perfect way to experience the vibrant heart of the city.

ChIJPanzv1wpdTERcPFRU1aXYbA.text:
Hidden within residential area, we stumbled on this place before going to the Airport.

Food is hot and delicious. Sticky rice is cooked right and the dishes are savory. Serving size is also enough. 1 bowl is good for two but because it’s delicious you can have 1 each.

Apricot drink might not be a common drink option, but worth a try.

We ordered:
1. Xôi no ne (Braised pork, braised egg, dried shredded pork, pork patties, and sticky rice) - 74,000vnd
2. Grilled Pork Sticky Rice - 38,000vnd
3. Apricot drink - 28,000vnd

Total: 140,000vnd (for 4 pax - we’re not so hungry)

Pork is soft, and cooked well.

Would like to thank the staff to, especially the cashier, Jinny.

They assisted us in ordering, what to recommend, where is the nearest ATM, and very friendly and attentive. Answered all our questions and helped us how to eat the food.

Take note: as of October 2025, they are still on cash basis only, so bring cash to avoid looking for ATMs.

Recommend to try this out when you get here or before leaving.

ChIJPanzv1wpdTERcPFRU1aXYbA.text: Xôi Mềm is a fantastic spot for sticky rice. I love the variety of toppings, from classic braised pork to delicious shredded chicken. It's the kind of comfort food that feels both simple and special at the same time. The place has a chill, cozy vibe, and the staff are always friendly. If you're looking for a top-notch sticky rice experience, Xôi Mềm is the place to go.

ChIJGRXQLgYpdTERag9-TqUl8wo.text:
Xôi Ngoc: A Must-Try for Sticky Rice Lovers in Ho Chi Minh City

A visit to Xội Ngoc on Van Kiếp street is an essential

culinary experience for anyone who loves Vietnamese sticky rice. This popular spot is known for its generous portions and wide variety of delicious toppings, making it a fantastic value for the price. A single serving, often costing around 35,000 VND, is packed with so much food that it can be a challenge to finish in one sitting.

The star of the show is the sticky rice itself, which serves as a perfect base for an array of toppings, including roasted pork, char siu (BBQ pork), fried chicken, and a "special sauce" that many customers praise. The combination of textures and flavors in a single box is what keeps many customers coming back for more.

Be prepared for a crowd, especially at night, as this spot is a favorite among locals and is often busy. While the wait might be a bit long, the experience of a large, affordable, and delicious meal is well worth it. Whether you're a local or a visitor, Xôi Ngoc offers an authentic and satisfying taste of Saigon's street food scene.

The owner of the cart is very polite, funny and enthusiastic.

Even though a portion is a bit full due to the sticky rice, I still crave it. You should buy a few portions to freeze, steam them and eat them, it is very convenient. The price she sells is very cheap. When it is cold in winter, eating hot sticky rice is very happy.

ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.name: places/ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pRNU1UTjFWM05DVURsNlJtcGtPV05aVlhsc1VXYxAB
ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.author: Ha Lam
ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.text:
The sticky rice is soft and not too sticky, each bite is delicious, the filling is full of soft green beans, lean meat has been stir-fried well, and the fat melts in your mouth. Eaten with crispy fried onions and sesame salt, everything is so harmonious that you can eat it in the morning, but crave it at night. 

I came on a cloudy day, she only had traditional sticky rice. So I grabbed 2 balls. I bought more frozen sticky rice to bring home and steam it again, and the quality is also very good. Buying a lot to freeze and eat gradually when craving is also fine. She is sincere, cheerful, clean, neat, and very attentive to everyone's feelings. 

Oh, but the sesame salt has quite salty salt, because the fine salt is hard to see, so you guys should pour it in slowly, otherwise it will be too salty. This is what she told me when she saw me pour the whole salt packet in. It was okay when I ate it. After a while, I found it a bit salty. Hahaha. 

I am addicted to sticky rice, but it is hard to find a place that suits my taste. Searching on Google, I accidentally found your shop. Even though I live in Binh Duong. So I rode my buffalo to eat your sticky rice. It was really worth it.

A portion of sticky rice is just right, enough to fill you up, only 15k but it's hot, fresh, neat, full of heart and affection, in the center of the luxurious SG, it really makes life easy and comfortable.

I wish you good luck in business, good health, always happy and peaceful.

The picture is the sticky rice I bought and steamed at home. (Traditional and mixed). Sigh. Just finished eating and I'm craving again.

ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.name: places/ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KeVl6Rm5UbEZEZFVsaVRXSmZORGxTV1ZkaE5uYxAB
ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.author: Long Hoang
ChIJBefuAgApdTERaen5inM_8G0.text: I accidentally found out about her shop when I saw people only making sticky rice on Tiktok but was too lazy to make it so I searched on Google and her shop appeared near my house. So I had to go buy some to try and have been hooked ever since. The sticky rice is soft, not soggy, not dry, and I'm really addicted to it. Today, when I went shopping, it was raining and she even asked if she had a raincoat and let me borrow it. I wish her good health to maintain this delicious sticky rice dish ❤️

ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.name: places/ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sdk1sTkVPRkppUTJVeFdrVjRNa3RYZFdjd2NHYxAB
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.author: Jessie Lan Pham
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.text:
I’ve been following Xôi Làng Nghề on social media for quite a while, ever since they first started. Now they already have four branches in Saigon.

I ordered their special sticky rice box, which came with a soft-yolk fried egg, Chinese sausage, pâté, fried pork loaf, and braised pork. You can choose between plain sticky rice or xôi xéo (sticky rice with mung beans), but I prefer xôi xéo because it comes with an extra layer of mashed mung beans and fragrant fried shallot oil.

All the ingredients were of good quality. Despite how it looks, the sticky rice wasn’t too salty at all. The shop also provides a small packet of braised pork sauce so you can adjust the flavor to your liking.

I’ve never had this kind of sticky rice in Hanoi, so I can’t tell if it tastes authentic, but overall it was delicious and definitely worth a try. My box cost 58,000 VND (70,000 VND on delivery apps) and kept me full for the whole day.

ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.name: places/ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21GNFZHaFdSek5RWDNsRmJUTnZhalJSVW1oT2NWRRAB
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.author: Joe Bungee
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.text:
Place is clean, the staff are polite and humorous, they seem to be enjoying working there, a sign of a good restaurant.

The food is good too, just maybe the pork is too fatty. The glutinous rice is pearl rice, like normal Japanese rice.

ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.name: places/ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VKQ0k5T25rNUtQOWZREAE
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.author: amashogun
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.text:
A casual and easy place to drop by for breakfast or a light lunch.
There’s no air conditioning inside, but they have fans running, so it wasn’t too hot.
The meat was thick and filling, and the portion of rice was just right.
The staff were friendly and made ordering easy.
They also have an English menu, which was helpful.

ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.name: places/ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKUG9ncy0ydE1QY19RRRAB
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.author: Ben Herman
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.text: A small restaurant serving lots of variations on northern-style sticky rice. I got pork, Chinese sausage and an egg in mine and it came with a small bowl of pickles and an iced tea. It was very satisfying! Service was awesome and fast, and Theres room for motorbike parking out front on the sidewalk.

ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.name: places/ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKRk5VNDJSQzB0UldaUmJGZEthR1o0VG5veGRuYxAB
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.author: Phan Hồng Anh
ChIJTV0VdJ4vdTERaICc_mBcPTc.text:
Solid spot for homey earthy sticky rice, i would not say it tastes authentic compared to the one we have eaten in Hanoi.
The seats are not so cozy and comfy so this would be okay as a quick lunch stop

ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.name: places/ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSSVN6RnFWekprUTNnM2NXWk1NVmh1WjA5bVNsRRAB
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.text:
A famous sticky rice brand for decades in Ho Chi Minh City. From the first shop in District 6, it has expanded throughout the city, the branch I often visit is Ly Thai To. 

Binh Tien sticky rice has a savory sticky rice with a lot of coriander, completely different from other sticky rice shops, the soft sticky rice is served with pate, chicken, pork roll... the basic toppings are delicious enough. 

Binh Tien's sweet sticky rice is also very popular with diners, especially the super delicious cade sticky rice. Cadé is sweet and fatty, made from eggs, sugar and coconut milk, a box of 15k sweet sticky rice is also a lot. I ordered purple sticky rice to eat with cade, it's also delicious. 

Don't miss the charcoal sticky rice, the charcoal sticky rice still has a chewy outer layer, eaten with mashed green beans, shredded coconut and extremely rich coconut milk. 

Only selling take-out, I don't rate the staff much.

ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.name: places/ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJM1llVTB3RRAB
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.author: Quốc Hưng Chung
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.text: I bought a package of sticky rice with purple leaves and green beans and coconut milk (sweet type). Surprisingly, the price was very cheap, the sticky rice was a lot and delicious.

ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.name: places/ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYODUtR2dnRRAB
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.author: HẰNG NGUYỄN
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.text: Binh Tien mixed sticky rice (Ly Thai To street) is soft and chewy, with a full topping of pate, char siu, Chinese sausage, pickled radish, sausage, egg, scallion oil, ham and peanuts, creating a delicious, harmonious flavor. The restaurant is crowded, reasonable price 30,000 VND/portion.

ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.name: places/ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNBdTlTSUpREAE
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.author: Phuong Mai Vo
ChIJIx794uYvdTERTsGJhYVUbKc.text:
I ordered small salty sticky rice for 25k, ordered a little sticky rice, the sticky rice box was almost full of toppings with the typical pate sauce, almost a thick sauce, not as thick as traditional pate with liver meat

Vietnamese ham, Chinese sausage, shredded char siu, shredded pork, shredded chicken, 1/2 egg, sprinkled with crushed peanuts on top, especially here there is also Chinese-style char siu cabbage, the sticky rice is quite fragrant, warm and easy to eat, not hard and dark, with a slight smell of banana leaves

Overall, it is full and good quality, quite good to eat, worth the money, the staff cooks quickly, pleases customers, in addition to salty sticky rice, the cade sticky rice dish at the shop is also quite special, worth trying because it is hard to find anywhere else

ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4.text: He has been here a while. It-s really good.

ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4.text: Bad, super bad. Worse than Van Kiep branch. If you want to eat Ngoc sticky rice, try to go to VK branch, don't buy it at this branch. The sticky rice is bad, dry, little sauce, and the chicken has hair stuck to it. Unacceptable.

ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4.text: Delicious sticky rice, fragrant and soft. I have tried all kinds and like the char siu the most here. The shop only sells take-out, the owner is quick. Portion 35k/2 people is full. Maybe because I get bored, partly because of the pate.

ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4.name: places/ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VManE5b3FuNlo3OEt3EAE

ChIJx5-5n5svdTERF45rE79yCN4.text: I ordered a 35k box but it was super full, with my girl's strength, I wanted to roll over after eating. Toppings include char siu, chicken, chicken gizzards, quail eggs, roast pork, Chinese sausage, and pork floss. The toppings are so full that I can't see any sticky rice =))))) There is a divine sauce here that sticks together, it's sweet enough to taste but thick and rich, so delicious.

ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.author: Ben Herman
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.text: Awesome chicken sticky rice in the traditional style. Options include lap xuong, shredded chicken, fried chicken, pate, baby chicken eggs, chicken livers, crispy onions, and mo hanh. You pick and choose what you want. A great evening snack.

ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.name: places/ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GVFZXRmlUSGxaYVZacmRuSlZaRnB1YVZKUlEyYxAB
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.author: Quang Duy
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.text: Long-standing sticky rice shop next to Tan Dinh market. Reasonable price at 30k and lots of toppings, crispy fried onions, delicious sticky rice. The only downside is that the plastic spoon is too soft and inconvenient to eat.

ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.name: places/ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kSGNWQlVSVk5WZGxOb2NuVkNSalJVUjFaMFdXYxAB
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.author: Bianca Đặng
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.text: The sticky rice cart near the gate of Tan Dinh church is easy to see, the surrounding area is always crowded with people stopping to buy sticky rice. There are 3 quick and friendly sellers, 1 guy taking orders and 2 girls making sticky rice, so even though it's crowded, you don't have to wait too long. The seller often calls out "Hai oi Hai oi" which makes me suddenly miss my sister so much. The sticky rice here is soft, spongy, fatty with coconut water, doesn't make your throat feel sore or hot, full of side dishes, quail eggs, shredded chicken, pork floss, ham, Chinese sausage, pate, salted cabbage, fried chicken skin... The sticky rice is so much, you'll be full until noon. The box in the picture is full of salty sticky rice for 30,000 VND, buy an additional 5,000 VND for chicken skin. In general, the food is delicious, anyone who has the chance to stop by should try it.

ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.name: places/ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VPX2xwZS1jdUxDTGNnEAE
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.author: Tấn Phát Trà
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.text:
Chicken Sticky Rice 295 Hai Ba Trung

The sticky rice here is only sold to go, so there is not much to discuss about the service, mainly the guy will ask and bring the sticky rice to you, and this guy is very sweet :)))))))))
As for the sticky rice, it is very delicious. The sticky rice is soft, sticky and fragrant, not dry. The toppings are the same as other sticky rice shops, there is chicken skin, shredded chicken, fried chicken, pork roll, Chinese sausage, pork floss. This sticky rice has something orange on top of the sticky rice, very delicious. The problem is that because it is delicious, it is sometimes quite crowded, and Hai Ba Trung Street is extremely congested during peak hours.

ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.name: places/ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJMzRqZFZ3EAE
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.author: Daissy Dương
ChIJbQpuewUvdTERaeYqWAymFg8.text:
I stopped by early Sunday morning, from afar I saw the sticky rice cart was quite crowded compared to other carts.
The shop has 2 ladies making dishes and 1 guy taking orders.
I ordered the 25k portion, it was very good, with chicken, pork floss, pork roll, peanuts, and banana leaves lining, it looked hygienic.
Highly recommend everyone.

ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.name: places/ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMbXZPRDJnRRAB
ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.author: Mai Nam Vũ
ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.text:
Sticky rice has 3 price levels: 20k-25k-30k.

I ate here twice, both times I ordered the 20k portion as shown in the picture.

The first time the sticky rice was quite soft, softer and stickier than normal rice. The second time the sticky rice was a bit harder than normal. Personally, I think the soft sticky rice tastes better but is not as filling.

I think the 20k portion is a bit small compared to other places I have eaten in SG.

I think ordering less spicy sticky rice is the most suitable, if you order non-spicy, it loses the characteristic of sticky rice and is not as delicious.

What I like most here is that the sticky rice is wrapped in banana leaves and paper, not in a styrofoam box.

There are few tables at the restaurant, only 2-3 tables. And when eating at the restaurant, you have to order more drinks. The other day I ordered a glass of orange juice and it cost 20k. The orange juice was delicious, but I think that price is still a bit high.

I will still come back.

ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.name: places/ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURuMUlLSEVBEAE

ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.text:
This is the sticky rice package I bought for 30k.
Less than the 15k package at Mach Kiem Hung, less than the sticky rice with banana leaves at Tran Hung Dao.
The shop is deserted, no one buys
Advertisement, review loudly, review without ethics.
1 package of 30k, girls can't eat enough, boys can't eat enough, not to mention the 20k, 25k packages, how small are they

ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.text:
How about changing to another sticky rice shop every now and then???
To be honest, the sticky rice here is normal, not too special, a little spicy, overall it's okay.
The big box is 20k per portion (as shown in the picture)
@t4_eattheworld

ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.name: places/ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pBNFFWTnhZVEJDWVhneWJVcDZOV3R4ZUY5eVRrRRAB
ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.author: Wisdom Zen
ChIJK55QtvwudTEREdQaWhe-Rjw.text: The sticky rice package is too small for the price, when you go to buy it, they sell pre-made packages. The 20k package can only scoop out 4 spoons of sticky rice. Far inferior to xoi nha morgue, xoi Nhieu Tam, xoi Phung Hung and other sticky rice shops. The flavor is also not special, just sticky rice, sausage with pate, a pinch of pork floss, a pinch of peanuts, the sauce is not spicy, just a little bit spicy. Tried it once and have no intention of trying it again. Too expensive.

ChIJtWdq4kwldTERWjVi6UnJIlc.text: Everything here is amazing. I got both the banh mi and the sticky rice and they were stuffed full of toppings and ingredients. Everything was absolutely delicious and very cheap. I will definitely visit this place again.

ChIJtWdq4kwldTERWjVi6UnJIlc.text: Sticky rice is okay but the fried eggs have egg shells stuck to them. Every time I eat them, I see egg shells. The eggs are getting smaller and smaller, with only tiny pieces left.

ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.text: Very delicious, only from 25k. You should buy it.

ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.name: places/ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURaNHRXcEt3EAE
ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.author: Au Nguyen
ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.text: Only after eating did I understand why this sticky rice cart is always packed. Mixed sticky rice for 30k is delicious and plentiful. The best topping is fried quail eggs.

ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.name: places/ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUeHEtenB3RRAB
ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.author: Phuong Mai Vo
ChIJswdoBG4vdTERi7_nqptSfuU.text: Savory sticky rice with shredded chicken and signature fried cabbage dish, salty and sweet, the toppings are harmonious, the sticky rice is a bit mushy and the sticky rice grains are not separated, and the seller put the bag of pate into the hot sticky rice pot, which made me a bit worried because the plastic bag would leak out onto the food, I hope the seller can improve it.

ChIJqffPXCsvdTERNumIIfH44aU.name: places/ChIJqffPXCsvdTERNumIIfH44aU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKMkFuOVNNbFlTS3J3RRAB

ChIJ2cEbIQAvdTERT2uYYcDwhNU.author: Dũng Nguyễn (Dũng review có tâm)
ChIJ2cEbIQAvdTERT2uYYcDwhNU.text:
I won't say this is the best or cheapest place to sell Chinese-style sticky rice, but this is the place that sells out the fastest in Xom Củi market: from 6am, it's ready by 8am, all sold out 🤘
Every day, she only makes one bowl of sticky rice to sell because she's old and has to take care of the sticky rice by herself, and the bowl of sticky rice is also very large, full of toppings of dried shrimp, salted cabbage, Chinese sausage, scallion oil... and a lot of pork fat 😍

Usually people around her only buy a 15k box, I bought a 20k box, so it's full. We can ask them to wrap it in banana leaves in the old-fashioned style, but if they say there's a lot of sticky rice, they should put it in a box to eat it neatly and not let it fall off, and they should still line it with a layer of banana leaves so it doesn't come into contact with the box, which is super careful.

Everything in the picture below is delicious, the thing I don't like the most is the pork floss, it's a bit too sweet but it's still a delicious dry fiber, not powdery like many other stores. The rest is beyond reproach: delicious sausage, dried shrimp that's not fishy, ​​the cabbage has been rinsed of all the salt and is crispy and delicious... really try it and you'll feel that the seller is very attentive. The sticky rice is stuffed in a super full basin so it feels compressed (like some people often wrap sticky rice before eating) the box is so full that eating it makes you full... and you don't feel full, there's also crispy pork fat, it's so delicious.

I was about to finish the salty sticky rice when I saw that the sticky corn sticky rice was burnt 🤤 Oh my god, that part was chewy and fragrant, so delicious, I ordered a 10k package and asked for it to be burnt immediately 🤭
and then posted it like that, the corn was burnt and mushy, making me sick...🤔

Unlike the fire sticky rice where there was only one lady making it and the queue was long and tiring, this lady's side had 3 people making the box very quickly. The style of the men and women in the neighborhood passing by the sticky rice cart is: "Hello, stay home and have some savory sticky rice for breakfast, Ms. Tram's sticky rice is delicious, grandma often buys it, ok, grandma will bring it back later" then happily go to Xom Cui market to buy things and when they come back, there are boxes of sticky rice ready on the cart... cute huh 😆

👉Address: Ms. Tram's sticky rice cart in front of alley 965 Ba Dinh District 8
👉Time: 6am serving - 8am out of savory sticky rice - 9am out of everything - you need a bit of dignity to buy it, guys 🥲

ChIJBQzGMgAvdTERTcTj1dEzrjE.text:
🌸Eat Hanoi sticky rice with me🌸

🔥This is my first time eating sticky rice, the overall feeling is okay. The sticky rice has a layer of green beans on top, but it is quite dry, not as sticky as Southern sticky rice (maybe each region has a different way of cooking sticky rice, I have never eaten the original Hanoi sticky rice so I am not sure). Eating it alone feels like rice, but when eaten with braised meat, it is more delicious. The shop's braised meat is cooked soft and rich, so it is quite delicious.

🔥The menu is diverse, you can mix dishes to your liking. I ordered sticky rice with braised meat + pate + cốm sausage. The pate and cốm sausage are a bit salty, but when eaten with sticky rice, it balances the taste. The staff will ask if you want to add braised meat juice, I recommend it because pouring it on sticky rice makes it taste much better. A portion of sticky rice is quite a lot, you can eat it all.

🔥The price is a bit high, but with full toppings like meat, pate, and sausage, it's reasonable. If you've never had Hanoi sticky rice, you should try it at the shop, because I think the shop is neat, clean, and uses sugarcane pulp boxes so it looks nice and neat.

ChIJn--CbfwudTERh2KLFSXORjc.text: The “morgue” sticky rice restaurant on Tran Phu Street, District 5 is truly an interesting and worth-trying dining address. The name sounds a bit strange, but the taste of the sticky rice here makes diners remember it forever. The sticky rice is soft, hot, each grain is plump, not dry and hard. In particular, the portion is very rich with all kinds of toppings such as shredded chicken, Chinese sausage, sausage, braised meat, fragrant golden fried onions, all blending to create a rich flavor, standard Saigon sticky rice. The price is very affordable, suitable for students, students and workers around the area. Although the restaurant is small and simply decorated, it is always crowded because of the stable quality and friendliness of the owner. If you want to find a quick but still filling and delicious meal, Tran Phu morgue sticky rice is definitely an option not to be missed.

• Sticky rice is cooked to be soft and fragrant with the smell of sticky rice, not dry or mushy.

• The flavor of banana leaves permeates the sticky rice, creating a natural, pleasant aroma.

• Other ingredients such as green beans, coconut, peanuts, or meat are all fresh and well-seasoned.

2. Quality of ingredients:
• Sticky rice must be of high quality, carefully selected.

• Banana leaves must be fresh, clean, with no signs of damage or yellowing.

• Other ingredients such as coconut, beans, and meat must be fresh.

3. Presentation:
• Sticky rice is neatly and cleanly wrapped in banana leaves, creating a rustic and attractive feeling.

• The colors of sticky rice and accompanying ingredients are harmonious and eye-catching.

4. Texture:
• Sticky rice has moderate stickiness, is not lumpy or loose.
• When eating, feel the perfect combination of sticky rice and coconut fat.
5. Service
• Quick and friendly service staff.
• Reasonable service time, not making customers wait long.
• Clean, airy space, creating a comfortable feeling for customers.
6. Price:
• Price is suitable for the quality and quantity of sticky rice provided.
• There are options for servings to suit

ChIJA6WBi-gndTERLn3Yn6qxPR0.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJA6WBi-gndTERLn3Yn6qxPR0.text:
I stopped by at 8:30 pm, it was almost closing time so the food on the sticky rice counter was not very full. I bought a 30k mixed sticky rice box and a 25k char siu sticky rice box. The packaging was different.
- Sticky sticky rice, sticky rice, fragrant with coconut milk, sweet sticky rice flavor, it will be delicious if you like fatty and sweet food, but I find the sticky rice topping salty and the sweet sticky rice a bit strange.
- Mixed has dishes such as shredded chicken, pate, pork floss, dried pork floss, pork roll, fried chicken skin, quail eggs. I found the shredded chicken very delicious, the meat pieces are large, add a lot. Pork floss and dried pork floss are too sweet. Fried chicken skin left out in the air for too long becomes mushy and not crispy.
- The 25k white char siu box is smaller than the black mixed box, it looks like the owner only has char siu and adds a lot. The char siu sauce is not too strong. The char siu meat seemed dry, but it was okay.

The mother and son were selling gas stations, even though they bought it at the last minute, they were still enthusiastic. The son was still young but knew how to help his mother sell.

In conclusion, I found the sticky rice here to be sweet, from the sticky rice to the side dishes. My taste is not too sweet, so if you ask me if I like the sticky rice here or not, the answer is 50/50. It might not be my first choice when I want to eat sticky rice.

ChIJU5otL0AndTERRa3LEWsDTQU.text:
A peaceful complex of restaurants and cafés in the heart of Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, HCMC

This complex offers a calm and relaxing atmosphere right in the middle of Thảo Điền.
Although the parking area doesn’t have a roof (a small minus point), the security inside is excellent.

The restaurants and cafés are located close to each other, making it very convenient to explore different spots. The space is decorated in a countryside style, with green bamboo and a refreshing, rustic vibe.

Today, we tried Tiệm Xôi Mềm — the menu was diverse and appealing, the staff were friendly and attentive, and the entire seating area is open-air with fans instead of air conditioning. The setup feels like dining in a cozy home courtyard under a covered patio.

As for the food, I’d rate the quality of the sticky rice at 7/10. Overall, it’s a great place for anyone who wants to escape Saigon’s busy atmosphere — perfect for a small group gathering or a casual date. It truly feels like a “mini getaway” within the city.

All in all, it’s a pleasant experience, and I’ll definitely come back to try out other eateries in the complex.

ChIJqSUY9d8udTER3gWPfy0eMms.author: Bong Arquiza
ChIJqSUY9d8udTER3gWPfy0eMms.text:
I was on the hunt for a truly local, non-touristy seafood spot in Saigon, and Quan Oc Nhu delivered exactly what I was hoping for. I’m pretty sure I was the only tourist there, which instantly told me I had found the right place. Prices were very “local” with no tourist inflation, and every dish was bursting with flavor.

I ordered snails fried with chili, snails fried with garlic, sea mantis with garlic butter, and scallops with oil and green onions. Every single dish was fresh, perfectly cooked, and loaded with bold, addictive flavors. The pro move here is to buy bread from the lady walking around selling it for 14K VND, because that is the only carb you will get and it is perfect for soaking up all the amazing sauces.

The restaurant is tucked away in a small residential alley that might look intimidating at first. It has that gritty, locals-only vibe where you think only Vietnamese regulars would dare to go. But once inside, it feels completely safe and the payoff is so worth it. While eating, we were helped by a lovely lady sitting next to us who spoke excellent English. She immediately guessed we were not from Vietnam and her first question was how we had found Oc Nhu. That little moment confirmed it: this was a hidden gem that locals love, and it was exactly the kind of authentic food experience I came to Saigon for. Warning… Not for the faint of heart and the valley-girl-slash-UES-type eater. ALSO! Wet wipes are not for free.

ChIJqSUY9d8udTER3gWPfy0eMms.name: places/ChIJqSUY9d8udTER3gWPfy0eMms/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VKSDNpUHVrN0pQOFh3EAE

ChIJqSUY9d8udTER3gWPfy0eMms.text:
An affordable and extremely popular location to enjoy ốc and related delicacies within district 10.

You'll find this location nested deep within an alley in District 10. Don't let the narrow pathway fool you, the restaurant has a huge interior to host multiple large parties. During peak hours, it's extremely busy and you will have to wait for a seat (and service will be pretty slow). In exchange, the food, portion, and quality are definitely reasonably priced and you'll enjoy your meal. Definitely stop by if you're a fan of ốc, I will be back most definitely.

P.S. if you prefer a clean, upscale dining experience, this is not for you. The staff focuses on efficiency so service will be subpar at best.

ChIJW2SKwawvdTERC3i1B0RZSHs.name: places/ChIJW2SKwawvdTERC3i1B0RZSHs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxdVZYWTRia1pQWmswMFQwSmtaMFp0Um5wQ1ZYYxAB
ChIJW2SKwawvdTERC3i1B0RZSHs.author: Joe and Mindy
ChIJW2SKwawvdTERC3i1B0RZSHs.text:
A Flavorful Shellfish Haven

If you're seeking the freshest, most flavorful shellfish in the world, look no further than Ốc Đào Saigon. This place is an absolute gem!
We ordered five dishes, each a small but incredibly delicious portion. Even though there were only two of us, we easily could have devoured more. The rau muong (morning glory veggie) was a standout, perfectly cooked and seasoned with two types of garlic - crispy fried on top and roasted at the bottom. Be sure to mix it all up before diving in!
We also tried two clam soups, both of which were AMAZING! The ngheu soup featured a fragrant lemongrass broth, while the so lua boasted a spicy-sweet broth. Both were bursting with flavor and had just the right amount of heat. We honestly couldn't decide which one we loved more.
The so duong clams were another highlight, sauteed in butter, satay, and garlic. They also offer them with cheese, but we opted for the creamy cheese topping on our scallops. While the scallops were good, they were the only dish we wouldn't order again.
We arrived around 5 pm for an early dinner, as we heard the place gets packed later on. Most of the diners were locals, which is always a good sign.
Overall, Ốc Đào Saigon is a must-visit for any shellfish lover. The flavors are out of this world, and the prices are very reasonable. Just be sure to arrive early if you don't want to wait for a table!

ChIJvcU_PTMpdTERL4iwfK1dEX0.author: Ryan Adams
ChIJvcU_PTMpdTERL4iwfK1dEX0.text:
I give this one a 5* based on the food. The service is ok (not the best to keep the beer or ice flowing) and the ambiance is typical local seafood joint, the on street dining isn’t the cleanest and is quite loud given the busy road (and you almost sit in the road - see photo), yet the food makes up for it all. There is a reason it has 3 (4 if you include the scooter parking/bathrooms) storefronts in a row and has expanded over the years.

First of all - the selection. So many types of seafood. 19 types of snails alone, most with 3-4 ways to prepare. If you like snails, this is the place.  All we tried were very good, especially the salt roasted. All of the snails were perfectly cooked and very clean tasting. None of that fishy or muddy taste they can sometimes have. Very fresh.

For other seafood, the garlic razor clams were excellent, as were the Japanese scallops and surf clams. All as good or better than we had at famous seafood places in Nha Trang.

And all locals here. This is local Vietnamese dining exemplified.

ChIJtTjQkNgudTERX37Vm0QcUuc.text:
I was here with a friend on 5 June 2025. I tried a few of the food here, and I particularly like their oysters porridge, hột vịt lộn (duck egg), and the clam with soup (not sure what it is called).

The oysters porridge is mildly spicy due to the pepper and ginger, and it has the texture of a well-cooked Teochew porridge.

I cannot comment on the hột vịt lộn as this is the 2nd time I'm trying in Vietnam. However, the sauce that comes with it is tasty.

The clam with soup is my favorite of all the dishes I tried here. The clam has a chewy texture, and the soup is kind of addictive😋.

If you are looking to try tasty Vietnam dishes, this place is definitely worth a visit. However, do take note that the place is not air-conditioned. Although there are fans here, it can still get abit hot if you are eating the porridge here.

The seafood is fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned. The value you get for the price is unbeatable—high quality without breaking the bank.

If you’re in the mood for authentic Vietnamese street-style seafood with helpful service and great vibes, Ốc Loan is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

ChIJS_06kcIvdTER8lEYCbLp8K0.text: Authentic street food vibes with wooden chairs by the street and a random pup playing by the fire 😆 Prompt service & easy to order (you write down what you want). ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.author: Kien Tran (Kin)
ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.text:
this lil snail spot in saigon had me flashbacking to hanoi real quick—finally a place that does northern-style snails right!

if you’re lowkey tired of all the buttery, saucy southern ốc styles, this one’s a breath of fresh air. just simple steamed or boiled snails with lemongrass and ginger—clean, warm, and hits that nostalgic spot.

also tried the nem chua rán (fried fermented pork), crunchy and kinda addictive ngl.

only miss? their drinks were wayyy too sweet for me… like i just wanted trà đá, not sugar syrup haha. but still, def worth a visit if you craving that northern vibe in the middle of saigon.

ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.name: places/ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Gbk0yMVpkVk13YUVabU9VSlpVa1pIYWpGUU1YYxAB

ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.text: Good and fresh food but bad service . Had to wait for ordering and paying  the bill. by When the food came , we asked for Rau Ram. Also we had to ask them clean our tables, they didn’t do it on their own !

ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.text: All are boiled dishes, delicious, tasty broth, dipping sauce. Reasonable price, ok service, the restaurant is always crowded. Suitable for eating with friends on weekends. 10 VND

ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.name: places/ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkSmJWUlNjVEEzYjA5WmMzZDJlbWMyTW1wME5GRRAB
ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.author: Quỳnh Như
ChIJC7yVMI4pdTER5bCiBY9Yty4.text:
The restaurant is quite crowded around 6pm - 7pm, some dishes are sold out.
The staff are lovely.
The restaurant is located in an apartment complex next to the embankment, so it is airy and not bothered by traffic.
All kinds of boiled snails are fragrant, the snails feel fresh. The lemongrass fish sauce eaten with snails is to my taste. Boiled snails are brought to the table piping hot, the boiled/steamed snail water for each dish has a unique flavor of that type of snail, a little different, but the lemongrass scent is fragrant and enhances the snail flavor.
Fried sour sausage is delicious, eaten with chili sauce from the North.
The tea is also delicious.
After eating, you feel full and complete.

ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.name: places/ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQejNtdTNSXy1hZVNREAE
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.author: Quyen Huynh
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.text: The taste was too good and affordable. It has free parking area. They focus on snails rather than drinks. Snails were too fresh. I highly recommend you guys.

ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.name: places/ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSN3FyUkNBEAE
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.author: Ric Kee
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.text: The snail they sell is fresh and tasty. Price is reasonable, and the environment is clear, not smelly at all. If the rainy season you visit here, they have an indoor  seat provided as well.

ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.name: places/ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KalFtMXlTbEEyVTAxS2N6WnVRME4zTkhoVk1sRRAB
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.author: Trang nguyễn
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.text: This is a boiled snail restaurant in the style of Hanoi Old Quarter. Here, the main dishes are boiled snails, fried sour spring rolls, and very delicious dipping sauce that suits my taste. The restaurant is located right at the corner of Street 10 in the City Land area. There is no polite table seating here, mainly chairs. This type of experience is also very good.

ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.name: places/ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tkTWNXUlZSMmR4VERCNmQwWXdSRWh2T1VKbmRHYxAB
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.author: Son Hai Tran
ChIJjUgw-KQpdTERoYgPvx0QOUw.text:
Impressed by the enthusiastic and cute security guard

The restaurant is located below the apartment building, right on the corner of the airy street, so it's quite chill to eat. The restaurant also has tables and chairs inside, but most people sit outside for the cool air. There is plenty of parking. The staff is quick and enthusiastic.

ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.name: places/ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvck9iZVV3EAE
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.author: Kal Pas
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.text:
Food: salty for my taste, served fast. However, the seafood is not fresh.
Staff: friendly and helpful
Atmosphere: they didn't separate smoking and non-smoking area, I hate that. Moreover, they use bamboo tables which are home sweet home for cockroaches. I saw some reviews about this issue but they didn't solve it.
From Monday for Wednesday, free 1 dish of shrimp in kumquat sauce.
Not coming back😮‍💨😮‍💨😮‍💨

ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.name: places/ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2psR1V6WlRiV0oyTFdKRGJUbDBjVmh0YmkwMlFrRRAB
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.author: Wendy Nguyen
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.text: Staff was super friendly and cute . Food was good and came out hella fast ! Nothing to complain ! Btw free ice cream/ yogurt . We spent 800k for a family of 3, and I came in HUNGRY.

ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.name: places/ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VOSGRqSm1GbE03TmtRRRAB
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.author: Anh Luận Tạ
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.text: Good food, nice staff must try

ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.name: places/ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3d3Q2c1NnEAE
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.author: Nandos Pham
ChIJGaiw6k0tdTER55i_WMsrpTY.text: Place is very good service food is also fresh! Highly recommended

ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.author: ivan Kim
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.text: I visited here for the first time. It's located in small alleay near the canal in Phu nhuan district. With reasonable price, it has delicious seafood food. Eventhough it is not that spacious, it's enough to feel the breeze. I will visit again~

ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.name: places/ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNiaW9HZUxnEAE
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.author: Hung Phan
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.text: Street food in a alley in Sai Gon. Should try, but you may stand up several times why eating due to the cars passing. Should be there early, otherwise you will miss some dishes.

ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.name: places/ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKNThqeG1nRRAB
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.author: Nhật Minh Ôn
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.text:
Love it from the food to the service.
But please be aware this place is just a streetfood-style restaurant.

ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.name: places/ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPdDRxNUx3EAE
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.author: Trung Nguyen
ChIJyW8U0dAvdTERHkI7XN5TZEY.text: It's good for a street food shop

ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.name: places/ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnbGNLRDV3RRAB
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.author: Long Nguyen
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.text: The food was great, and the staff were courteous and attentive. While it’s not your typical OC restaurant, the unique atmosphere makes it stand out. You'll definitely leave with a smile after dining here.

ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.name: places/ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0SWMwSkpaWFYzYTBaQlVsOHRTelkxYW5GdVYzYxAB
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.author: Nathan K
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.text:
Local place - no menu, no sitting around and chatting. Their "mắm sữa" sauce is basically just sweet, condensed milk and fish sauce. Probably a huge hit with locals, but to a foreign palate it just tastes overly sweet. 35-40k per dish.

Fair price, fair food. Nothing incredible, but locals seem to love this place. I prefer other snail places in the market.

ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.name: places/ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQtc2N2NXRBRRAB
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.author: Tung Ho Thanh
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.text:
Everything here is at a fair price. You should bring cash bcz they don't have any online payment  method here.
It's kinda hard to get full with just what they have here. You should bring some bread to combine with a variety of sauces here

ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.name: places/ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNtLUp1SzV3RRAB
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.author: Tiger Le
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.text:
Place: this is a very well known place for Saigon people. Famous for its food and the special sauce called "mắm sữa", which get its name for the white color fish sauce. There are around 20 tables and usually crowded. But you won't have to wait long.

Service: Below average. They always rush you to finish to leave in order to take in other guests. Which is sometimes annoying but the other times helpful, for those who waiting in lines.

Foods: very quick served, well cook and ... Super good. Yes the "mắm sữa" sauce make every dishes special. Make sure to order the "điệp cút" (squill eggs with scallops). You will love it (check photos below)

Parking: nearby service, 5000VND per motorbike

Price: below average. Cannot be called cheap but everything is very reasonable priced. We paid ~350,000VND and eating full for 2.

Overall: 9/10 consider the price and the quality of the food, it offsets the service.

Comeback? YES, for that "mắm sữa" specialty!

ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.name: places/ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KMFJWZEpRbEV4ZUhFdFFtUnJSVFZGV2poZlJtYxAB
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.author: Emma
ChIJkVFGHbgodTERhBBTy2PSAwc.text: Soooo good. I came in January and dreamt about the scallops and quail egg since. The house special sauce is crack. Will come back every time I’m in HCMC

ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.name: places/ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM1NUxfWGt3RRAB
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.author: Tu Quynh Ha Lam
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.text: Very fresh seafood at affordable price..however the dipping sauces are not tasty enough for my liking. Friendly services and quick serving time.

ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.name: places/ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURTOGI3eVJ3EAE
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.author: Katie Huynh
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.text: A hidden gem in Bui Vien area, kind of hard to find but worth the efford. They have some unique dishes, and it's really delicious.

ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.name: places/ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5RGVXTlFUVWx6WjBVdGR6YzBVVmxGTldjMFJWRRAB
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.author: Un Segreto
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.text:
The snail shop only opens at noon from 11am to 2pm, located in a deep alley and crowded so you should book a table and order food.
The best here are the egg bowl, steamed clams with onions (all are super big), salted egg snails, garlic butter, Thai clams, stir-fried noodles are normal.
The seating is a bit hot and cramped because it's too crowded, the price is not cheap but the quality is good.

ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.name: places/ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNndGVfbThRRRAB
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.author: Hải Minh Phạm
ChIJi20lJRYvdTERYLqo_cXhAIw.text: The restaurant is in a corner, motorbikes can get in, but there is no parking space. The food is served quite quickly. There are quite a few tables. The salted egg snail dish is okay but not as delicious as Khanh's snail. But the steamed razor clams are amazing, no other restaurant is as delicious. After eating, there is fruit dessert. 3 people ate 5 portions and were full for 850k. The lime sauce was okay, but a bit oily.

ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.name: places/ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21acWNHcDVhSFUzU0RkdFluTnBiamxzZDBOUllsRRAB
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.author: Dravid M.E.
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.text: saw the menu mostly focus on snails and seafood, overall is okay but could be better.

ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.name: places/ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUZzRtaVRnEAE
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.author: Vinewood King
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.text: The food at this place was excellent, with a wide variety of dishes that were both delicious and well-presented. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it an ideal spot for catching up with friends. Whether you're looking to share a meal and enjoy a lively conversation, or simply relax and unwind, this venue provides the perfect setting. The staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring that our experience was enjoyable from start to finish. Overall, it's a wonderful place to spend time with friends and enjoy great food.

ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.name: places/ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2anZPWFZBEAE
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.author: Thuận
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.text:
- Seems like it took less than 10 mins that the foods came out already. The flavor was good.
- But for the food that made from raw shrimps and clams, they were not fresh.
- The staff is really accommodating. But when he’s not there, I asked a service from another staff, that another staff said I needed to ask the one attending my table. What was that???
- Parking fee is VND 10K/motorbike. It’s located on the other side of the road.

ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.name: places/ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3emJIS2lnRRAB
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.author: Jason
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.text: One of the best seafood restaurants in HCM, a place to go if you visit the area.

ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.name: places/ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3cmFidXh3RRAB
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.author: Hieu Dinh Minh
ChIJAfYMU2cvdTER4W9-vOmjXY0.text: Just fine, not exceptional, worth the price, very good service

ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.name: places/ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25acWJWcFNXV2w1VTA4dGVFSmhXSFIyVGtoNGFIYxAB
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.author: Tim Doan
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.text: A long-standing and well-known snail (seafood) restaurant on the vibrant Vĩnh Khánh food street. The dishes are tasty, clean, and suitable for both Vietnamese locals and tourists. While the snails may not be top-grade, the way they’re prepared is solid, and the prices are reasonable. Definitely worth a try.

ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.name: places/ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25JM1NIQkNSREF5WW5rMlZGWXdWbFZ1ZEUxM09YYxAB
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.author: Chris S
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.text: The seafood here is next level! Scallops, blood cockles and snails were so delicious and the service was impeccable. Do not miss this if you are a seafood lover.

ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.name: places/ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25JeGFGRTRaMXBVUlRKR2RVRndOMGRCUzNOTllYYxAB
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.author: Yao Yu Xie
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.text: My local friend brought me here for dinner. We had the sea snails in coconut milk (oc len xao dua), boiled mussels with lemongrass (chem chep hap sa), grilled/baked penshell clams with scallion oil (so mai nuong mo hanh), grilled tiger prawns, and seafood broken rice porridge. Everything was fresh and tasty. My friend told me that the salt fried sea crab (cang ghe xao muoi) is nice too, but we were too full to order it. This is a low chair/table, noisy (even chaotic) but convivial, cash / QR code payment only kind of place, but I see that as a quintessential local experience. Note that there's no English in the menu (Vietnamese & Chinese only), and the staff might not be conversant in English. Not exactly cheap, but I guess seafood is costly.

ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.name: places/ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xjNWVVbFphRlU1UWtFeVNVOWZOeloxVlhaTk1WRRAB
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.author: Leoneo S
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.text:
We had an amazing experience at
Oc Oanh, with incredibly fresh and delicious seafood, and quick turnaround. We ended up going back there because their food was just that good!

ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.name: places/ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfc0lPZlRnEAE
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.author: Alexandria
ChIJnYoWiGwvdTER_Y2JDWH0jZo.text: A very local eatery, and absolutely delicious if you are happy to sit in an environment that is crowded and bustling. Servers are very efficient as they are busy. Some dishes will require you to pay on the spot, like bread or sugarcane juice. The oysters were very fresh and the tamarind crab was a highlight. At the end of your meal, they count your dishes to give you the bill.

ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.name: places/ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN3a01fQjVRRRAB
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.author: Ethan Chan
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.text: The dishes are well seasoned but they ain't no fresh, especially the seafood. I mean the snails, muscles, clams, etc...they must be dead for a long time before they were cooked.

ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.name: places/ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQweVBIVDJ3RRAB
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.author: Vinh Nguyen
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.text: Good place for seafoods. Dishes are cheap, well cooked and have a very reasonable place. Often get overcrowded during holidays.

ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.name: places/ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSaGZuakZ3EAE
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.author: Phi Hong Nguyen
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.text:
Simply wonderful, i've been eating here with my team since 2018 till now (2023). The service is fast, menu update regularly, open space for smoking & vaping. Even tho, the food seem not to stay as fresh as the restaurant but it fit all budget, trust me, it not that bad ;)
Seasoning is the most impressive thing here, come and try

ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.name: places/ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNza0xhUWZBEAE
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.author: Thy Lee
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.text:
Just ok for the place like that.
Nothing special.
25$/5 ppl.
You can choose with kind and with style u want them to make it.

ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.name: places/ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN3bmV5a1ZREAE
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.author: Tài Lý
ChIJb-wjaKYvdTERSVMoO6eWcBc.text: Suitable for a cheap and good dishes. Actually it doesn't take it too long to have some dishes, you know. It's must take a quite long time to cook, the foods are raw and freaking fresh, and the tables are always full of guests. You can't demand more, so stay cool, hold on just about 15m or more to have a tasty meal for your dinner.

ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.name: places/ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25JelNHbGhORzA0UkZkNmFEaG1lSEUyYm5Sc1VIYxAB
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.author: Olivier Guillard
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.text:
Good seafood restaurant with very kind staff working extra hard to satisfy the big crowd they accomodate!

We had green onion scallops and some ice cold beers. The scallops were very good
Excellent atmosphere mostly locals eating there.

ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.name: places/ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNudXNyWmJREAE
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.author: Adam Jamieson
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.text: I’m from Canada and this is by far the best seafood experience I have ever had in my life. We had the Octopus and had to do a second round it was so good! Shrimp, scallops, squid … all winners!

ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.name: places/ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNWdnFlTDdnRRAB
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.author: Steffen Sonnenschein
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.text: Craving some delicious seafood? Look no further than Quán Ốc Vũ! This place offers fresh seafood and snails at a great price, and the quality is superb. I've been here 5 times already and can't recommend it enough! Unfortunately, the restaurant can get a bit loud, but it's worth it for the amazing food. If you're looking for a great seafood spot in the local area, Quán Ốc Vũ is the place to go!

ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.name: places/ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ5cy1mS0lBEAE
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.author: Thanh Ly
ChIJWSKlGcgvdTERnPRSqKlIRC0.text:
There are about 30 'Oc' restaurants on this street, and it's famous amongst Saigonese residents who'd frequent here with friends for drinks and Oc. No real trip to Saigon is complete without a night drinking and resting Oc like the locals do.
I've been to a couple of others on this street, and wanted to take my wife here for the local experience. Our friend and local tour guide recommended this place and we met him here. We ordered 7 dishes, including my favourites like the blood clams and creeper snails, plus octopus, grilled king prawns, scallops in spring onion oil, plus a couple of others. They were all booked so well, each dish was different from the others and the sauces were very much on point. It was very busy there, and the customers kept on coming. The service was good but a bit rushed, they do try and hurry you to order as soon as you sit down but I guess as it's busy I can kinda understand.
We had 7 dishes, a big variety, we didn't order anything extravagant (we did want a mud crab but they had sold out), the most expensive was the grilled king prawns at 150k VND for 6 large prawns, totally worth it.  We also had 7 Tiger beers between us. Total came up to 650k VND, really reasonable considering the quality of the food.
We had a great time here, great food, great company and great atmosphere - what else could you possibly want?
