ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.text: Eat with the locals! The bang xeo is full of shrimps and vegetables. The egg is crunchy and tasty, while everything inside is cooked and hot. ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.name: places/ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xOb1QwTTFaVjh0WlVKSlRYUnJVMUozYmtSb1RrRRAB
ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.author: onJuice Nguyen
ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.text:
This place specializes in banh xeo so be sure to come here for that. I ordered the ‘extra’ which came with big prawns, egg and more meat. It was massive. I would recommend sharing it with another person. Also ordered the spring rolls which were actually so good as well. Lots of flavour.

The banh xeo took some time to come out but once it did it was sizzling with goodness. It was perfect and had the crunchy crispy edges as you would expect. Great tasting banh xeo.

First time to try it here and would definitely recommend it to everyone.

ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.name: places/ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25rd2VGQm9NVGg2VkU1ak1tdDZjamhKTmt4TVFVRRAB
ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.author: Digital Food Nomad
ChIJOwpR9U0vdTER7VWboFERAEk.text: If you’re looking for a really great Bánh Xèo, this is the place to go. I wanted to see if it was overhyped—but the Bánh Xèo is excellent. The crepe is large, hot, and crispy, filled with shrimp, pork, and plenty of fresh vegetables, giving it the perfect balance of texture and flavor. The outdoor setting can be a bit warm and humid, but it adds to the authentic experience. Service is decent, and the food easily makes up for any minor drawbacks. Highly recommended if you’re a fan of Bánh Xèo or want to try one of the best versions around.

ChIJgVxmrsAudTERN-8CzlM31k0.author: yumz
ChIJgVxmrsAudTERN-8CzlM31k0.text:
thanh diệu is that spot in district 11 that just gets it right.

the crispy situation //
their banh xeo, that iconic vietnamese sizzling pancake, is a total game-changer. golden, crunchy, and stuffed with all the goods. the rice batter fries up so thin and crisp it lowkey shatters when you break into it, revealing plump shrimp, tender pork, beef and crunchy bean sprouts.

the wrap and dip method //
you know the drill. snag a piece of pancake, tuck it into rice paper wrap or lettuce with herbs, then dunk it in that tangy fish sauce. keeping it real though, they skipped the lime which would've taken it to the next level. still, the combo of hot, crispy, fresh, and savory is straight fire and totally worth the messy hands.

the no-frills district 11 energy //
this place keeps it real with plastic stools, steamy windows, and the constant sizzle of batter hitting the pan. it's pure, unfiltered street food joy that hits different every time.

the final call //
if you're chasing that perfect banh xeo fix, this place absolutely delivers. be ready to queue during peak hours. it's that legit.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJ_0CeDMAudTERlrKlCdX1rq4.text:
One of the best bánh căn in town, especially for its price.

Location: in District 10, very easy to access

Place: many table and small chairs, hygience is about average. Typically its pretty much normal and acceptable for a restaurant in this price segment in Saigon.

Food: specialized for Middle Vietnam food. You must try Bánh căn. There are 3 kinds of sauces (fish, peanut, and Nêm). Remember to try peanut sauce, you will not regret. There are also another good foods like Bánh bèo, bánh canh etc... All are vey tasty.

Service: below avarage but this is not a cons, because every cheap restaurant will have the same service.

Parking: free parking for motorbike (remember to get the ticket number from the keeper)

Price: Very affordabe!!!

Overall: 5 stars mean that. This is one of a very few places I rate 5 stars. Not for anything than the quality of food!!

ChIJV7vKKdsvdTERVUZQuLg32D8.text:
✨ A local recommended this spot in the market, and I’m so glad I tried it! We ordered both banh xeo and banh khot.

🥣 First things first—you have to eat both dishes with the fish sauce! If you like spicy food, don’t forget to add chili to the sauce for an extra kick.

🌮 The banh khot was freshly made and served crispy and you can choose the topping. The banh xeo was equally delicious. To fully enjoy it, wrap it in the fresh vegetables (similar to how you eat Korean BBQ) and dip it into the fish sauce. If you run out of vegetables, don’t worry—they’ll gladly refill them for you.

🥥 For drinks, we had fresh coconut and orange juice, both of which were refreshing and generously sized.

😊 Overall, I was very satisfied with the food and prices here. I’ll definitely be back!

ChIJH3_10qkpdTERZ2z69p0yX34.text: This humble bánh xèo spot is definitely worth a try. The restaurant space is quite small, so we decided to order takeout and enjoy it comfortably at home. ChIJFY8dLwsvdTERf7j922j6L4Y.author: 韦斯利
ChIJFY8dLwsvdTERf7j922j6L4Y.text:
A Must-Try for Banh Xeo Lovers
If you're looking to experience the quintessential Vietnamese street food, look no further than Bánh Xèo Quảng 7B/99. This place is an absolute gem!
Their bánh xèo is simply divine. The crepes are unbelievably soft and fluffy – the best I've ever tasted. It's the perfect balance of crispy and tender. The atmosphere is exactly what you'd hope for in a local eatery: bustling, friendly, and full of life. It's the kind of place where you feel like a local as soon as you step in.
I was lucky enough to get a table without a wait, but the place was packed! That's a testament to its popularity. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall charm of the place.

Trust me, this is the place to have your first (or next) bánh xèo experience. You won't be disappointed!

ChIJ4ymwUwAvdTERY9NmYxggW0Y.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my lunch there. I wouldn't say it was exceptional but it did the work. And for the price, it was definitely a good deal. I would come back from time to time with pressure.

ChIJ4ymwUwAvdTERY9NmYxggW0Y.author: son nguyen
ChIJ4ymwUwAvdTERY9NmYxggW0Y.text:
We went to the restaurant and figured out we were too early. However, the owner offered nem nướng while we waited for the bánh xèo which we came for. Both were surprisingly good and worth the trip to come all the way to get the bánh xèo from quận 1.
The bánh xèo is very crispy and tasting so delicious and good.
Well as written we were quite early and we have a conversation with the owner and the atmosphere is quite nice, feel like home.
5 stars for everything!

ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.name: places/ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oT2VrVlpjRWc0TW1SQmFWbHdYelZ3V1daVE1IYxAB
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.author: Legendary Puller
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.text:
The food is quite good, 5 shrimp and pork pancakes are 50k, 5 shrimp-free pancakes are 40k.
Binh Dinh fish sauce has a unique and fragrant taste
The corn spring rolls are delicious, but 5 pieces are 40k, which is a bit expensive
The downside is that the restaurant doesn't have a public menu, you have to ask the seller
The pancakes don't have prices, so I really like that the prices are on the same shelf as the vegetable basket

ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.name: places/ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCeVZUQjRTRXhZWTA5UFprWXRiR0p4YjNGTFVIYxAB
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.author: Hiển “Quốc” Lương
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.text:
The first time I ate Binh Dinh pancakes, I entered the restaurant, which was quite spacious and airy.
What I found strange was that there would be no waiters to ask customers like other places I've been to. Instead, the waiters here were older ladies. When I sat at the table, the ladies here would bring me a plate of various vegetables, a bowl of bean sauce, and especially 10 pancakes. If you finish them, you can order more, or you can pay for them as much as you eat. Any leftover pancakes would be returned. The price was 10k each, a towel 1k each, soft drinks and mineral water from 10k->20k.
In my opinion, the deliciousness was 7/10 points

ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.name: places/ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsdUxVa3RiRWR0U2s5SVRGaFViVVZaYlV0RFlXYxAB
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.author: Han Nguyen
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.text: I've been eating bx for 5 years now, when I go back to my hometown I crave it the most, bx is crispy and not boring, both types of dipping sauce are delicious. Seeing many customers rate the service and price here, only those who eat here often understand and get used to it, they will bring the cake out for you depending on the situation, you can still proactively change or call in advance, but when the restaurant is crowded in the afternoon and evening, I often sit and wait to chill because I'm used to it, and the price will be high compared to others, but for me, it's delicious so it's worth it. November 27, 2025

ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.name: places/ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2psS1FsRjZNa1JPU0ZaZmRqZFRlV3RKV1RKWVVrRRAB
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.author: Uyên Nguyễn
ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.text:
Seeing that everyone said the restaurant was delicious, I went to try it. But this is really the first time I had such a BAD experience when eating out!

First: the restaurant's menu is not public or lists prices, so it's very difficult for customers to order.
Second: the food absorbs too much oil, from the pancakes to the spring rolls, all of which are soaked in oil and when eating, the oil drips all over your hands

Third: 20k/1 fried beef pancake ????? I really don't understand why the restaurant is confident enough to sell 1 fried beef pancake like in the picture for 20k/1 piece. Too expensive!!!
Fourth: 5 pieces of shrimp spring rolls for 40k?????? while the shrimp is tiny and the fried rice is still soaked in too much oil
Thursday: When asked to pay the bill, the staff listened and then ignored it, making the customer have to call 3 times before they could pay, when it was time to transfer the money and show the screen to the restaurant, the restaurant didn't even look at it or bowed their heads (like they looked down on people v). Really, from the food to the service, it was not good at all
Hope the restaurant will review and make changes!

ChIJW-5Tn-4pdTERqf0m71nDFvM.text: The restaurant serves food quickly, hot rice cakes, fresh vegetables, rich dipping sauce, has a roof, cool and airy atmosphere, large parking space, and many tables.

ChIJKXGymJ8udTERSfnRc_niUGA.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJKXGymJ8udTERSfnRc_niUGA.text:
Follow @bredgyeats for more food photos!

These mung bean pancakes are one of my favourite Vietnamese dishes, its coconut milk batter exterior fried perfectly thin and crisp. Filled with bean sprouts, pork belly, shrimp and mung beans, it's a combination of crisp and tender textures whose flavours are amplified when dipped into the fish sauce. You can get a full sized ones or mini ones, which are heavier on the mung bean flavour. Of course, eating these pancakes with fresh herbs and lettuce are mandatory, adding a fragrant depth of flavour and an extra layer of crisp from the lettuce.

ChIJtRCGqnAvdTER2plQ-PLq0o0.name: places/ChIJtRCGqnAvdTER2plQ-PLq0o0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURUMzlfelBREAE
ChIJtRCGqnAvdTER2plQ-PLq0o0.author: Phuc Phan
ChIJtRCGqnAvdTER2plQ-PLq0o0.text: What’s there to say about a Vietnamese classic such as Bánh Xèo? Because it’s a staple, you should definitely stop by and try the Bánh Xèo here when you get the chance. They provide a plethora of different types of jungle veggies that you won’t find elsewhere to eat with your veggies. They elevate the taste and provide depth to a classic dish. The taste, quantity, and quality of the food is reasonably priced. Between 2 of us, we were bloated when we left. Bonus, they also have Bánh Xèo with Củ hủ dừa which you won’t find outside of Việt Nam. I would highly recommend going to this place if you’re in the area.

ChIJK5ben4IvdTER-tEbL_JOvIw.text: The food here is incredibly fresh and delicious! The owner even showed me the best way to enjoy Bánh Xèo, which made it taste even better. I highly recommend trying Bánh Xèo at Xém. The yogurt is also amazing!

ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.text: The Bánh xèo is great dish. Not piling like other places. They also serve other dishes beside Bánh xèo

ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.author: Robert Hoegerl
ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.text: Very good Banh Xeo! 3 Shrimps, some pork and plenty of vegetables in a crispy large egg pancake. I'll definitely be coming back next time when I'm in Ho Chi Minh City.

ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.name: places/ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMwdy1YY1hBEAE
ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.author: Sam
ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.text: Two of the best dishes here are banh xeo and pork organ porridge. Their dish has a Very crispy and thin skin which is really hard to make in terms of technique. At the end of the meal you will be served very nice “che xoi nuoc” sweetsop with just right level of sweetness, complimentarily.

ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.author: Ashley
ChIJjWp3GlwldTERwWd6Iwmepdc.text: Great Banh Xeo in d7. The Banh Xeo is thin and crispy the way i like it and the fish sauce is great too. 1 shrimp with pork Banh Xeo is 62k. They give 2 small balls of che troi nuoc with ginger syrup free at the end of your meal. Definitely will visit again!

ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.text: Very authentic rice pancake with shrimp and pork inside served with rice paper and a huge bowl of herbs all for just 30k! Very filling, one was enough. The herbal drink is worth trying as well. Nice atmosphere inside, served by 2 young children.

ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.text: Okay for people who like vegetables because the restaurant provides a lot of vegetables. The 35k cake has 2 big shrimps but 2 tiny slices of meat. I don't like green beans but forgot to tell the restaurant (it's easy to get bored and the cake is crumbly and less crispy).

ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.author: Trương Khánh Linh
ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.text: Full pancakes are usually 35k, specials are 40-50-60k. Western style pancakes have thin and soft crust, filling with bean sprouts, meat, green beans and shrimp. Lots of fresh and green vegetables. The food is okay but not too special, the shrimp are big and not very fresh. But overall it's ok for those who like Western pancakes.

ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.author: Tuấn Thành Đỗ
ChIJqZPqWCMrdTERzygHfpYQZ10.text: The service is very cheerful and enthusiastic, the pancakes are delicious and clean... the price is reasonable and affordable

ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.name: places/ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMQ2Y3dnZCenBfdkh3EAE
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.author: Migimega Itai
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.text:
I went to eat banh xeo.
There are tables inside. If you showed your intention to eat in, they would bring you a chair.

The street where this shop is located probably does not seem to be a place where many foreigners come, so you can enjoy the local atmosphere. However, including this store, there was no forced solicitation or rip-off of foreigners.

It seems to be local, and although the staff at the shop cannot speak English (or Japanese, of course), they do their best to communicate with you through gestures.
At first, as a foreigner, I felt wary (maybe it was my imagination?), but when I started talking to them, the staff greeted me with a smile. I was very impressed when he told me with a gesture that you should wrap the banh xeo with garnish leaves.

The price is also local (40k dong, I think), including garnish leaves, sauce, and chili pepper to your liking. conscientious

This is a recommended restaurant because of its atmosphere and the feeling that you are actually in a foreign country.

ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.name: places/ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURUeGJPWW5nRRAB
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.author: Vsneaker
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.text:
Located on the food street of Xom Chieu, easy to find
Price of crispy pancakes 40k
Price of banh khot 45k
Fish sauce in the Western style is delicious.
After eating, stop next door to eat some takoyaki balls.

ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.name: places/ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRdTVQdnZ3RRAB
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.author: Tu Antoine (Tnus)
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.text:
The restaurant is a bit dark and stuffy, but the food is quite good.
The pancakes are golden and crispy, with thin edges and shrimp, meat and bean sprouts filling, not greasy.
The pancakes do not use coconut milk like the Western style, so they are not as fragrant and fatty. In return, the crispy dough layer, with the addition of green beans, is quite good.
The fried food is not oily and does not get boring.
The fish sauce is a bit sour for personal taste.

If you like crispy and light pancakes, this is a place worth trying.

ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.name: places/ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Gd2RXMXFjSE10YTJoM1ZuVkVOSE0xWlhWSVdtYxAB
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.author: Long Lê Nguyễn Hoàng
ChIJbahtO3AvdTERfIPgH5vtiZE.text: Crispy pancakes, toppings of shrimp, meat, and bean sprouts are poured on the spot. The fish sauce is flavorful, the vegetables are plentiful and varied. Overall, it is worth the price.

ChIJeVc3QhImdTERaWpoPbRt1Zs.text:
I’ve been going to this restaurant for 8 years.
Not only is the food good, but the staff are also friendly, and I really like the quiet, spacious neighborhood.

ChIJeVc3QhImdTERaWpoPbRt1Zs.text: Good food, good service, wide and clean place, not too expensive.

ChIJeVc3QhImdTERaWpoPbRt1Zs.text: Price is high. Food is ok. Service is slow and staff needs more focus on work. I didn't take any pictures from this restaurant. We went there with 5 adults 5 childrent, bill is around 900 thousand.

ChIJeVc3QhImdTERaWpoPbRt1Zs.text: Amazing inexpensive viet street food, super easy to park and nice bite size pieces. They gave a lot of herbs and condiments. Check it out if you're in the D2 area.

ChIJB5ZypzwrdTER5pQBxWNXxGw.author: Carlos Rafael Fernandez
ChIJB5ZypzwrdTER5pQBxWNXxGw.text: They have a lot of choices in their menu to satisfy your cravings, not just Banh Xeo. Not the best Banh Xeo out there but great service from their team. Cleanliness is top tier, not like the street food you're used to.

ChIJB5ZypzwrdTER5pQBxWNXxGw.text: Quán sạch sẽ, phục vụ tốt, bánh xèo rất ngon, không chỉ bánh xèo mà còn rất nhiều món đặc sản quảng ngãi

ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.name: places/ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURUcGNMdmRBEAE
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.author: Adam Arjuna
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.text:
The best Ban Xeo And Ban Khot in Saigon for me.

The pancake was done perfectly crispy and well seasoned with generous amount of Prawns.

Cost me only Sgd$3.

I got no complaints whatsoever.
Perfectly delicious!

I will definitely come back for more whenever I’m back in Saigon.

🥰

ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.name: places/ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURiNG9TaGF3EAE
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.author: Isaac Lai
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.text: Although this may seem like a very unusual place for tourists to dine, The environment is very authentic and homely. They opened up for us even though they were closing and still accommidated us (8 people!). I recommend this place for all tourists or even locals to experience true authentic banh xeo. He was even so kind to take a photo for us! Highly recommend.

ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.name: places/ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25jNVRGaDJTbmRUTUdwV1JtZGhTRVl5YUMxWFdHYxAB
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.author: Nine Channel
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.text:
Introducing a hidden alley banh xeo restaurant
The banh xeo is extremely delicious. It's the first time I've had a delicious banh xeo in Ho Chi Minh City
Although I prefer banh xeo with rice paper, eating it this way is still delicious
The restaurant's menu is quite diverse: there are banh xeo, banh khot, and spring rolls
They sell many types of soft drinks
The space of the restaurant is on the sidewalk, airy and comfortable
There is limited parking space for cars

ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.name: places/ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLajhzN1dJcnNteEp3EAE
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.author: Hieu Le
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.text:
Came back after 2 years but was very disappointed. The banh khot used to be fried crispy and the shrimp were big. Now the banh khot is small, has a lot of flour, the shrimp is left loose and looks like three dots. Banh xeo is in the same condition. The only thing I can see is that the vegetables are still fresh and clean. Banh xeo 60k. Banh khot 70k/7 pieces and at this price it is very expensive :)
The clip is of me eating many years ago. The picture is from today

ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.name: places/ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLVFQ1WnE5cmViQ0FREAE
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.author: Thanh Trinh
ChIJfcUSgiovdTER367qEc-sfFQ.text:
One day, stuck in traffic and unable to go home with an empty stomach, my colleague and I stopped here. He had already eaten so he wanted to introduce it to me. 

The impression was that it was crowded, with people coming and going busily. I only ate banh xeo and I was full after 1. My strength is not weak, but it was full and boring, so 1 was reasonable. 

I also like fresh, diverse vegetables. A pity is that the fish sauce is not too special. Customers only add chili, but the quality of the restaurant's fish sauce is not very clear. 

The banh xeo is Western style, big, thin and full of filling. There are green beans, meat, shrimp... quite fragrant and delicious. 

The price is also a bit more affordable, but after eating 1, I think it is worth it. 

Come and try it when you have a chance 😋

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.name: places/ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURsZ28zWVdREAE
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.author: Zach Pierce
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.text: It's well worth traveling off the beaten path to find places like this one. This was a home cooked meal that would make any strangers feel like family. I've never had Bánh Xèo before, but I've eaten a lot of food since I've been in Ho Chi Minh city and this has been my favorite. The texture contrast and the flavors make this a perfect meal, with a Bia Saigon. The woman was incredibly nice for letting us into her home, and brightening out day with her smile. Give her a visit!!

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.name: places/ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURsMUkyaENBEAE
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.author: Toan Pham
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.text: Hidden gem! We just came back from Da Nang and Nha Trang, Co Chin bánh xèo here is just as good. Chef/owner is extremely friendly and welcoming.

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.name: places/ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvbDUyUDdRRRAB

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.text:
accidentally stopped by, delicious and cheap, the seller is cute too, near home

crispy pancakes wrapped in thick, flexible rice paper, and all kinds of vegetables 🌟

noodle soup is also delicious, delicious grilled fish cake

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.name: places/ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xjMmQzUm9TakZFWTJjNWJGaDROREJRYXpscVpWRRAB

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.text:
The price is ridiculously high, 30k VND per pancake 🥶🥶🥶 There were only 5 shrimp in each, and overall it was very expensive!!!!

It was just a regular pancake, not the crispy kind from the Mekong Delta.

ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.name: places/ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNQcTQ3UVVREAE
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.author: Eva Pham
ChIJ5-WYbIApdTERc2L96WzHDoA.text: I know the owner through a younger brother's introduction, my husband and I tried it and found it delicious. We have followed her since then... she just moved to another place that is more spacious and airy, the cake is delicious and crispy, rolled with vegetables, shrimp, mango... so delicious, the fish sauce is also delicious, my husband is a Singaporean of Chinese descent, he rarely eats Vietnamese food but when he eats this dish, he is addicted and orders it every week hehe, the owner is easy-going, full of energy, I like the way she serves, attentive - the price is reasonable, 1 shrimp pancake is 25k, beef pancake is also 25k, egg pancake is 15k, I think the restaurant also sells rice noodles

ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.text: Personally the best I’ve Banh Xeo I’ve had. The pancakes are crispy and go well with the veggies.

ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.name: places/ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzZ28ta3pnRRAB

ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.text: Clean, hygienic, many kinds of vegetables, reasonable price. Park in front of the restaurant. 11/12/24 khot 40k, xeo 50k

ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.name: places/ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURWNjZxYmdBRRAB
ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.author: Ethan Tran
ChIJ6QqQy3cndTEREnjXOJZt85s.text: Delicious pancakes, clean vegetables, fresh ingredients and delicious dipping sauce. Very good and worth a try.

ChIJi-BpCtIudTERI_Cw6b61EWk.name: places/ChIJi-BpCtIudTERI_Cw6b61EWk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwOUlTYWFREAE

Will come back for sure!

Betel leaf beef vietnam ho chi minh city banh xeo crepes iced tea fish sauce for days shrimp vermicelli cucumber mint lettuce rolls

Food is good and the vegetables is abundant tho.

ChIJi-BpCtIudTERI_Cw6b61EWk.text: Friendly staff. Great food and prices. The restaurant is a bit dirty, but what do you expect

ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.name: places/ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSRWNYRlNNRjl1WDBaU1ZHSkRPV3RYYm5FMFEwRRAB
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.author: Luong Bui
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.text:
Super tasty and great prices for what you have! Definitely recommended!

Also owners and staff are super, it helps if you also know basic Vietnamese though.

ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.name: places/ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ1d3R2RV9nRRAB
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.author: Caldie
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.text: The Banh Xeo and Banh khot here are top-notch, easily the best I've tasted in Saigon. While there are several competitors nearby, I've heard that the place closest to the Main Street offers the freshest vegetables. Highly recommend!

ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.name: places/ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxNDQyU0dBEAE
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.author: Daniel Sgroi
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.text:
Anna from the Street Food Man tour introduced us to Banh Xeo and this place is a hidden gem. Banh Xeo Tom Thit, Vietnamese pancake with shrimp, pork and octopus was delicious, and served with fresh herbs. This pancake was not oil like other places. The banh khot were amazing as well, this was our first time trying Banh khot which is made from a batter of rice flour, corn starch, turmeric powder, water and coconut milk. They are usually topped with shrimp, brushed with scallion oil, and sprinkled with minced dried salted shrimp.
If you are looking for authentic Vietnamese food this is the place for you.

ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.name: places/ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoaE8yRXZnRRAB
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.author: s v
ChIJ-0g4ISQvdTERXXlBgGZjPrY.text: The Banh xeo was really good, we loved pairing it with the greens they provided and the dipping sauce. The Banh Kot was ok, we found it wasn't as flavorful as the Banh xeo. I'd definitely check this place out if you're near by. For the two plates plus an iced tea we paid 121k

Tables and chairs are neat, high tables are clean and airy
Each dish costs 8k, we don't eat a lot and order 10 but we feel a bit bored after about 8.
The cake is crispy without excess oil and the filling is just right
The vegetables felt clean and also had a lot of vegetables
Accompanied by dew-dried rice paper
The dipping sauce was a bit bland for me
The shop also has corn ramen and banh beo bowl
In the near future, the restaurant will have a few more dishes such as Quang noodle soup with vermicelli and gio

ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E.author: Paolo Rosete
ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E.text:
Hoang Yen Buffet Premier is an ok-to-visit for any buffet lover in Ho Chi Minh City. But you could do better. The buffet spread itself was ok, with enough array of seafood, sushi, grilled meats, and Vietnamese desserts.

Highlights:
* Seafood: The seafood selection was a standout, with an abundance of crab, prawns, and shellfish.
* Variety of Choices: There was something for everyone, from Vietnamese classics to international favorites.

While some of the dishes were better than others, the overall quality of the food was not really that great. The service was attentive and friendly, trying to give us a pleasant dining experience.

ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E.name: places/ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2N2VxTndRRRAB
ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E.author: Ronald Hee
ChIJY0NQRUcvdTERSjHLrQ4UE3E.text:
I like Hoang Yen buffet. I usually go once every time I'm in HCM. First time in a Hoang Yen Premier, and rather feel it's a miss, not a hit.

The crowd is the first sign. The Hoang Yen outlets I've been to have been usually filled to the brim. This outlet was a ghost town. At the peak, maybe a quarter full. And on a Saturday. Was it the steep price, and paying extra for drinks? At nearly twice the price, was it worth twice the fun?

Compared to a regular Hoang Yen, most of the dishes are there, with additional seafood dishes, which boiled down to shellfish done in different ways, sashimi and sushi, which didn't seem to move, and crabs stir fried and steamed. The steamed version was better. None of the premier dishes really stand out. Though the crabs were very popular with the locals.

I think the range of desserts is wider, but some faves were missing, such as the banana fritters. These worked so well with soft serve ice cream, which was also missing, to be replaced by four flavours in tubs. Other faves missing were some local dishes.

Between the two, regular Hoang Yen wins by a mile.

ChIJtY7mfgAvdTERyVYAQcVveP8.author: A N
ChIJtY7mfgAvdTERyVYAQcVveP8.text:
If you’re looking for a top-notch BBQ buffet experience, this is the place to go! I arrived before 5:30 PM and paid only 179K VND per person for the BBQ – such an incredible deal. I believe hotpot is an extra add-on, but honestly, the BBQ alone was more than enough.

The selection of meats and seafood is fantastic, everything tastes super fresh, and the variety is impressive. I’ve been to a lot of Korean BBQ spots and Vietnamese open-air buffets, but this place really stands out in terms of quality, service, and variety – all at a price that’s hard to believe.

The owner was very attentive and responsive to our needs, often anticipating them before we even had to ask. That level of service really made the experience even better. It is a bit of a way from the center, but absolutely worth the trip.

The total bill for two people was around $15 USD (roughly $7.50 per person) for all-you-can-eat BBQ and drinks (including soda, tea, and milk tea). You seriously can’t beat that! I’ll definitely be returning. If you’re craving a great BBQ experience without breaking the bank, do yourself a favor and check this spot out. Highly recommend!

It's not cheap by any means, but the food were fresh and tasty, the service were excellent that we definitely didn't mind the cost.

ChIJXa3Q43MpdTERmtv5qVsNzsw.text:
I recently visited Mr. Mlem BBQ in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was honestly one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in a long time. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, perfect for both friends and family gatherings.
The BBQ selection was outstanding – fresh, well-marinated meats grilled to perfection, and every bite was bursting with flavor. The sauces and side dishes were also on point, complementing the barbecue beautifully.
What really stood out, though, was the service. The staff were friendly, attentive, and always ready to help with grilling tips or recommendations. They made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.

A huge variety of different kind of food available (not only Vietnam style, but also international).
The atmosphere was so nice with a good soundtrack!
Staff really nice and kind!
Enjoy the lunch or dinner with a great view of Saigon river!!

ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk.text: I went during a weekend where they had fresh lobster, sashimi, fresh oysters, fresh crab, and prime rib steak.  Literally all my favorite buffet menu items and all less than 900k per person.  The restaurant is very roomy and is located on the 1st floor with a view of the Saigon river.  You are limited to one lobster per person which is a small size lobster, but everything else is unlimited.  Will definitely go back again.

ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk.name: places/ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xQ1NuRTRkRkpFUWpsVU1uYzNOMmRmYlhBNE0wRRAB

ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk.text: ✨ I really enjoy the seafood here, especially with the beautiful view of the Saigon River. This is already my fifth time coming back, and the staff are always so lovely — they even play with my daughter while I sip my wine. The white wine here is actually quite good too. I truly love this place and will definitely be back again. 🍷🌊🤍

ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk.name: places/ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tObllWcDBUVTUzVmxOR1FtTmFOVWRwTWxaVk1VRRAB

ChIJJ-gy00svdTER_6yovGC2lnk.text:
Liberty’s weekday dinner buffet costs over 500k per person. The food is really delicious, and it already includes beer, wine, and soft drinks throughout the evening. The staff are enthusiastic and quick.

For seafood, there are crab, shrimp, sashimi — all fresh and constantly replenished so guests don’t have to wait. The dishes are diverse enough. The atmosphere, tables, and decoration are elegant for parties.

I will recommend this place and come back.

ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU.text: This was an incredible way to end our group’s stay in Ho Chi Minh City. Us Canadians had the best hospitality and quality of food (including ostrich and crocodile!); it was a highlight of our trip. Thank you for the wonderful service and a meal to remember!

ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU.name: places/ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNVNWJ6ZTJBRRAB

In short of, I will come back this restaurant with my friends and familly

ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU.name: places/ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2padVZXcE5iVVJUWDJ0aFp6SkdNV3R4YlhOU2RIYxAB

ChIJ_WNM6aUodTERvJ8eLZjBnZU.text: I've tried many big buffet restaurants like Manwah, Gogi, D'Maris, Cuu Long Van, BBQ Nuong, Chai Village, Hoang Yen, and the buffets at Nikko and New World hotels. But honestly, this is the only place where everything feels properly managed — dishes come out quickly, the variety is decent, and even when you eat a lot, the staff don’t give you attitude. At other places, it sometimes feels like they’re trying to make you feel bad for eating too much. It’s disappointing.

ChIJR_EFmoQrdTERDIyI_kD5iZE.text: Poor customer service. Food was slow to come out to the line.. You'll have to wait a long time for them to get it. They'll charge you for everything here.  And don't forget that nasty bathroom.

ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.name: places/ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBN0stV2NBEAE
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.author: Sophia Y Binh
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.text:
Buffet Poseidon 🌊🦀 is a destination for those who love seafood buffets. With a spacious, modern space.

The menu here features fresh seafood such as crab, crab, abalone, squid, snails, and clams 🐚🍤. Crabs and crabs are always ready on the counter, so customers do not have to wait long. Abalone is also served in a fairly large quantity, creating a sense of satisfaction for diners who love this dish.

Seafood dishes are boiled first and then grilled again 🔥, retaining the delicious and rich flavor.

Drinks at the bar are calculated separately, customers pay for how much they order 🥤.

The staff is quick, enthusiastic 😊, always ready to support. With a rich menu, reasonable prices, and comfortable space, Buffet Poseidon Go Vap is a choice worth considering for those who want to enjoy a rich seafood feast. 🌟🍽️

ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.name: places/ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJMFlUZ19nRRAB
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.author: Nam
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.text:
A lot of seafood choices to choose from, & the servers work really hard here (they helped cook our Korean BBQ). Most of the food we tried tasted good, & we also enjoyed their dessert options (ice cream is provided at the bar).

I wish you could pay with a card, & finding a parking spot can be a little challenging, but those are my only complaints.

ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.name: places/ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNsbF96blBREAE
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.author: Toàn Vũ
ChIJJdqPzY4pdTERFT6WDUgC5xs.text:
PROS: + This place is great for seafood lovers , they have a huge variety of seafood including crabs, flowe crabs, snails, clams, prawns, mantis shrimp they even got a grill food and  hotpot which is a big plus.
+ Great ice cream

CONS: - The place is packed so there is not much room to walk around, and the tables and chairs are place so close to each other which make it impossible not to touch others at the nearby table.
- Apart from the excellent seafood, the rest of the menu is just overly seasoned dishes.
- The flan is too sweet so as all other deserts, the sticky rice is too dry.
- The Spageti is too salty and creamy imo, and the pasta is still raw.
- The fried rice is decent but they don't refill.
- The salmon is not very fresh which make it smells kinda bad and the cut is not clean so they break the meat of the piece.

AND THE LAST THING WHICH MAKE ME UPSET ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE IS HOW INCOMPETENT THE SUPPOSE "MANAGER" named Toàn  IS. => our bill was  2.560.000 VND (With VAT) but we didn't use the wet napkins so we returned it to get it off our bill, and this Toàn manager guy personally tell us that the bill will be 2.444.000. We gave him 2.500.000 (five 500 bills) but after 20 minutes wait another give us back the change only 16.000 VND which confused us. Then we get him to come back and ask about the change he said it was correct so we went to the fron desk with his manager sitting there and ask if the change was correct, Toan was ask by the manager to do the math again ( i don't know what school he learn this from and he use is damn phone too, and still get the number wrong). Then the manager do it herself then give us back the correct amount.

Even though it seems like nothing but his damn cheeky attitude ruin our experience.

ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o.author: Chino Yap
ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o.text:
From the moment we stepped in, D’Maris delivered one of the best seafood buffet experiences I’ve had. The place is spacious, and the menu is impressively broad, over 200 dishes spanning Korean, Japanese, European, Vietnamese and more.  The seafood is particularly strong: fresh sashimi, big prawns, oysters, and that beef-steak corner drew plenty of praise.  The dessert and sweets section also stood out as a highlight.
If you’re after a high quality buffet with top-tier variety and space to roam, this is a strong choice.

ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o.name: places/ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWS01VbDVkbkpqY1hCcGJtbHJNMUpZUlRGcVRrRRAB
ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o.author: Khang N
ChIJI5AR3jcpdTERJWJgbz6uR8o.text:
Like others have said, the place was difficult to find. It has classical European style decor and is overall clean and well maintained. The staff are attentive.

There’s a wide variety of food, including Western, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, and Korean cuisine, though the emphasis seems to be on Korean food. Even the receptionists greet customers in Korean.

I loved the smoked duck breast. It was absolutely flavorful and juicy. Other must try include the salmon head and the grilled garlic pork. The fish cake soup tasted authentic. The shellfish options were diverse but a bit bland in both flavor and cooking method. I didn’t try any of the raw food, as buffets aren’t usually the best place for that. However, others in my group did and had no issues.

After the meal, I enjoyed 2 cups of self serve coffee. Overall, I think this would be a great place to host a company party.

ChIJQXtKYwAvdTERlmUj1s7lSXw.author: Edsel Chong
ChIJQXtKYwAvdTERlmUj1s7lSXw.text:
If you’re craving seafood and grilled meats without breaking the bank, Buffet Cua Vàng in Ho Chi Minh City is a top pick. For around 310,000 VND, you’ll get access to a generous spread of over 60 dishes from fresh seafood and sizzling BBQ to steamed eggs and Vietnamese favorites.

The ambiance is cozy, styled like a mini Hội An with lanterns and warm lighting, perfect for casual get-togethers. While it’s not high-end, the value is unbeatable for the price you pay. Food quality is decent, with highlights like tender grilled meats and flavorful sauces.

Great for families, groups, or anyone looking for an affordable buffet with plenty of variety. Come hungry, you’ll leave full and satisfied.

Tip: Go early for the freshest picks

ChIJl32is4UvdTERaKCk4fxfp8w.text:
A Fantastic Vietnam Buffet Experience!

Its always HY buffet every time in HCMC! The variety of dishes offered was impressive, featuring an authentic spread of Vietnamese cuisine, from fresh spring rolls to delicious grilled meats and seafood.

The highlight for me was the seafood station, and I could customize it with my preferred toppings. The steam fish was another standout—soft on the inside, and filled with well-seasoned ingredients. The selection of dipping sauces, perfectly complemented the dishes.

The ambiance was warm and inviting, with a touch of Vietnamese charm in the decor. The staff was attentive and friendly, ensuring that everything was replenished and that guests had a great dining experience.

To top it off, the dessert section featured an array of traditional Vietnamese delicacies, making for a perfect ending to a fantastic meal.

Overall, this buffet is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic Vietnamese flavors. The combination of fresh ingredients, great variety, and excellent service makes it well worth the visit!

ChIJjyMQk6wpdTERgFpnLMWgLr4.author: Tran Pham
ChIJjyMQk6wpdTERgFpnLMWgLr4.text:
Review: A Hidden Gem for Hot Pot Lovers – Delicious, Affordable, and Veggie-Friendly! 🌱🔥
If you're looking for a budget-friendly hot pot buffet that caters to vegetarian (or even vegan) tastes, this spot is an absolute win! I wasn’t sure what to expect at first, but I was pleasantly surprised by both the quality and variety offered.
Price:
Super reasonable! For the variety and all-you-can-eat setup, the pricing is more than fair. It's perfect whether you're dining solo, with friends, or bringing family along.
Vegetable Selection:
One of the best veggie selections I've seen in a buffet-style hot pot. Everything was fresh and well-stocked—from classics like bok choy, napa cabbage, and enoki mushrooms to more unique picks like lotus root, pumpkin slices, and tofu skin rolls. Great variety of mushrooms too!
Broth Options:
Plenty of choices here, with clear, spicy, herbal, and even tomato broth bases. The staff were helpful in pointing out which ones were fully vegetarian.
Other Offerings:
They also had a modest selection of noodles, rice, and dipping sauces, along with plant-based protein options like tofu, mock meats, and seitan. A few cooked dishes and small desserts rounded things out nicely.
Atmosphere:
Clean, casual, and comfortable. Not too crowded, and everything was well-organized.
Final Verdict:
Whether you're a dedicated vegetarian or just looking to enjoy a lighter, veggie-forward hot pot meal, this buffet delivers on taste, price, and selection. Highly recommended for a satisfying, guilt-free indulgence!

Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts!

With the whole ocean at your fingertips, it’s difficult to hold back the saliva drooling from my mouth and from over-indulging. As you’re being taken to your seat, your eyes can’t help but peel away towards the dazzling selection of Western and Vietnamese appetizers, including a giant cheese wheel for a bite of freshly minced tuna tartare. The festivities truly started at your seat, as you place an order for the six different flavours of lobster and crab, coming straight off the grill and straight to your seat. The flesh was bouncy and sweet, the fresh lobster being complemented with my favourite sweet and savory tamarind sauce. They also had Wagyu beef flying off the pan, instantly melting away on your tongue like warm butter. It was a shame that each person was allotted ONE slice of lobster sashimi, because I wouldn’t have minded getting 20 more slices of its pure, sweet taste and bouncy bite. Finally, the saccharine spectacle that sits before you will awaken your crustacean-filled palate once again. The moist berry cake, tangy passionfruit mousse and chewy Vietnamese sticky rice were the most memorable, besides the almond ice cream that tastes like crayons (love genetics).

ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.name: places/ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGTFpucEJRbXMxTUhReE1Fa3hTSFJyWkZaT1YyYxAB
ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.author: Tien Vong
ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.text:
La Brasserie is one of the well-known buffets in Ho Chi Minh City, so I went in with pretty high expectations. I was genuinely excited to finally try it. The overall presentation of the food was impressive—everything looked fresh, colorful, and delicious. My husband enjoyed the meal a lot and had a great experience with the seafood and carving stations.

Unfortunately, my experience didn’t go as well. I must have gotten a bad piece of seafood, and I ended up with food poisoning. I felt sick almost immediately, threw up at the restaurant, and continued to throw up again after getting home. It was definitely disappointing and not what I expected from such a reputable buffet.

On the positive side, the staff were extremely kind and helpful. They assisted me right away and checked on me multiple times, which I really appreciated.

Because I felt unwell, I was only able to try the Wagyu steak and a few seafood items. The Wagyu was tender and flavorful, and the seafood selection looked great overall. For the price, I think you generally get what you pay for, and I can see why many people enjoy dining here.

I hope I can come back in the future and have a better experience, because the buffet itself seems promising—it was just unfortunate timing for me.

ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.name: places/ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxalZXUmFVMHhDWkUxaVVXWmpZVmh2UTNRNGJIYxAB
ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.author: David Lai
ChIJzfOsShkvdTERSeoX_lSUTOk.text:
If you’re looking for a buffet experience that truly delivers on both quality and variety, La Brasserie Restaurant at Nikko Hotel Ho Chi Minh City is a standout. This was my fifth visit, and once again, it did not disappoint.

The seafood selection is nothing short of spectacular—lobster sashimi, four different flavors of grilled lobster, and fresh crab, all incredibly fresh. The Wagyu meat, cooked on demand, was tender, flavorful, and absolutely top-notch. I even had a minor hiccup with one overcooked lobster, but the attentive staff quickly resolved it to my satisfaction.

For those willing to indulge, the premium price tag is worth it, especially with the free-flow wine that perfectly complements the dishes. Beyond seafood and meat, the buffet offers endless options: a wide variety of salads, hot and cold dishes, cold cuts, desserts, and a range of hot beverages.

Families with kids will also be happy—there’s a good selection for younger diners, including pizza, chips, and other child-friendly favorites, making it a spot everyone can enjoy.

Overall, La Brasserie combines an impressive spread with attentive service, kid-friendly options, and an elegant atmosphere. It’s a must-visit for anyone in Ho Chi Minh City seeking a premium buffet experience.

ChIJkbg9TUYvdTERy4KHGcRiibc.author: Liam G.
ChIJkbg9TUYvdTERy4KHGcRiibc.text: Fantastic, fantastic, fantastic! Took my girlfriend for her birthday for a Thursday night dinner. We both love seafood so this seemed like the perfect place for a fancy seafood dinner and a nice excuse to get dressed up on her special day. The food was really well laid out and separated into sections which helped us do a course per section. As nice as the cheeses and charcuterie-style meats were I do regret getting them as I could have used that extra stomach room for more seafood 😂 The seafood was by far the star of the show! So many things to try including lobsters, crab, river & tiger prawns, scallops, cockles, mussels, snails, octopus and more. All cooked to order with an array of different sauces and styles. The premade buffet dishes were ok and nice to have on the side but would recommend saving as much room as possible for all the seafood! We got the alcoholic drinks option too and the cocktails of the day were made very well, loved the negronis! Only slight downside I could potentially mention is that sometimes it did take a while for dishes we ordered to be delivered even though it was a fairly quiet day, I could imagine during peak hours that service could be slow. Overall food was fantastic, venue was really nice, servers were super friendly and given the price I would definitely go again!

ChIJ-Qld0RovdTERnFmHJTTakA4.text:
This is a seafood-focused buffet, with main dishes featuring crab, shrimp, squid, and shellfish.
There is also a variety of sushi and sashimi, including salmon.
Meat dishes and fried foods are also available in reasonable selection.
Several types of desserts are offered as well.

However, drinks are not included and must be ordered separately.
Since it is advertised as an "all-in-one buffet," it would be nice if at least basic beverages were included in the buffet.

That said, the quality, variety, and overall satisfaction of the food are well worth the cost.
Everything tasted delicious.

One thing to note is that many customers leave at the same time, so the cashier area gets crowded.
Also, while it depends on customer manners, a few inconsiderate people don't seem to care about others.
It would be appreciated if the staff could manage the line more efficiently at checkout.

ChIJ7xRqLgAvdTERAJqTHrTn1TA.name: places/ChIJ7xRqLgAvdTERAJqTHrTn1TA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1Q1lWaDNZbWxtZHpCUFJHbFVValZaT0dWelpVRRAB
ChIJ7xRqLgAvdTERAJqTHrTn1TA.author: Thanh Hảo Lê
ChIJ7xRqLgAvdTERAJqTHrTn1TA.text:
Going out for a buffet is always a little bit of a gamble, isn't it? You walk in hoping for a feast, but you secretly worry about the food quality, the crowded atmosphere, or the service. But my recent visit to N’Rona Buffet in Quận 8, Ho Chi Minh, was different. It wasn't just a meal; it was an experience that left a surprisingly deep impression on me.

I went with a close friend, and we were both a bit overwhelmed by the sheer scale of the place. The restaurant is located on the 4th floor of the Central Premium mall, and as soon as we stepped out of the elevator, we were greeted by a beautiful, spacious dining area. The lighting was warm and inviting, and the tables were well-spaced, which made it feel more intimate than your typical bustling buffet.

What truly stood out was the food itself, particularly the seafood. You can see the freshness right there at the counter. The shrimp, crabs, and various shellfish were all on ice, looking like they'd just been plucked from the ocean. I remember feeling a little spark of joy as I watched the staff expertly prepare our grilled oysters—the sizzling sound and the delicious aroma were a feast for the senses even before the first bite.

The sashimi was another highlight. The salmon and tuna were so incredibly fresh and buttery, they practically melted in my mouth. I've had good sashimi before, but this felt different. It was a moment of pure, simple happiness, a reminder of how good food can be when it's prepared with care. We also tried a bit of everything else—the hotpot, the sushi, and the variety of Vietnamese dishes. While not every single dish was a home run, the overall quality was consistently high, which is a rare feat for a buffet with so many options.

The only small issue, and it's a minor one, was that the service could be a little slow at times, especially when the restaurant got busier. But even then, the staff were always friendly and quick to smile, which more than made up for the wait.

For me, N'Rona wasn't just about the food. It was about the feeling of sharing a special, delicious moment with a friend in a beautiful setting. It was the feeling of being happy and full, not just from the food, but from the experience itself. It's not a perfect 5/5, but it’s a solid, well-deserved 4/5 in my book. It’s a place I’d happily return to, a place that reminds me of the simple joy of a good meal shared with a good person.

ChIJbZX_3hYvdTERSNQ4rhGC3uc.text: My wife and I had the MOST EXCELLENT dinner this evening at this restaurant in Pullman Saigon Centre - Food Connexion - and it was a Vietnamese and Western seafood-centric dinner buffet. When we walked into the restaurant, we were very impressed by the various food stations' display - they looked positively inviting and yummy (see the photos herein). Everything seemed and was fresh - freshly prepared and perfectly prepared. And the service here was simply OUTSTANDING - especially from the following ladies: Xuan, Vi, Tram and Anh, who very friendly, courteous, attentive and helpful. The dining ambience here was also very, very good. The dining spaces were ample and super comfortable. And apart from the buffet selections, the ala carte selections that came with the dinner buffet package were fantastic - my wife and I especially love the Lobster Thermidor. However, this dinner buffet is (according to the restaurant) available only from Friday to Sunday. So, if you are looking for a MOST EXCELLENT dinner buffet, I highly recommend Food Connexion at Pullman Saigon Centre.

ChIJbZX_3hYvdTERSNQ4rhGC3uc.text:
This is my absolute favorite breakfast spot whenever I'm on a business trip here!

​The food is consistently superb and very enjoyable. The breakfast menu is incredibly varied, thoughtfully catering to diverse international guests (my experience has been fantastic since June 2025). You get everything from perfectly cooked eggs and delicious smoked duck to noodles, rice dishes, vietnamese Pho, fruit and everything.
​The atmosphere is bright and pleasant, making it a great start to the day.
​The service is the highlight—the staff are extremely friendly and helpful.

Special thanks to T. Vi, Khang, Tram, and An for their warm and attentive service!

​Highly recommended!

ChIJ98imr54pdTERBbj6PwkjjcE.text:
I recently had the unfortunate experience of dining at Poseidon Buffet and I must say it was the worst seafood buffet I’ve ever been to. Not only was the food subpar, but the check in staff’s attitude was shockingly rude and unprofessional especially the white/light pink short hair girl who sat at the front. In additional when we came at 5pm, there were TONS of TABLES but one of the waiters kept insisting that we must share a table with other guests - how absurd!

To start, the seafood was far from fresh. Many of the dishes were either overcooked or had a strange, unpleasant odor, making it clear that quality and freshness were not priorities. The selection was limited, and several trays remained empty for long periods, despite numerous requests for replenishment.

Overall, Poseidon was a huge disappointment. The combination of low-quality food and disrespectful staff made for a truly unpleasant dining experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone and will definitely not be returning.

ChIJFadF9kYvdTEReW1kOAGOsx0.text:
We came by here for our dinner buffet on the 2nd day of our HCMC trip. The cafe has a nostalgic and vintage feeling with the historical decor and pictures around.

We arrived at 5.45pm despite of the heavy rain and we sat at the lobby. And the staff came and ushered us in at 6pm.

The buffet spread was not bad and quite extensive and you could enjoy nice local foods and BBQ grilled seafood and considering the price, it's actually good value for money. And a number of foods were yummy too (though some were either bland or too salty). Iced tea and orange juices were inclusive in the buffet but not coffee.

The BBQ grilled counter had two chefs manning, each cooking seafood like prawns and mussels, the other beef and meats. However, one chef, the male chef in middle aged had attitude problem and practised favouritism towards locals. Our group comprised of 6 persons (with few senior citizens) and so one of us went up there to collect the grilled prawns as the seniors had walking difficulties and also we did not want to crowd the counter, imagined if all of us went there to take. At first, the ready grilled prawns were there for diners to take (but then due to "high demand", it's the chef who cooked and then served you). We took 6 prawns but the chef stared at us and was unhappy and we pointed him to our table and each of us only had one prawn each.

As the grilled prawns were nice, after this round, we went back to take again. This time the chef told us we cannot take but he would plate for us and gave us only two prawns. Wasn't it buffet and freeflow? And we didn't waste the food. However, the diner behind us (who did not want the prawn but only wanted beef) had four prawns given to her by the chef, which she signaled she didn't want but the chef insisted giving her. And he smiled at her but showed us angry face.

Throughout our dinning, we rotated ourselves (less the senior citizen) to go up and took the prawns and each time the chef would show us an unfriendly and unhappy face but to others, he smiled broadly and his change of facial expression was like a "chameleon". At first we thought he might be in bad mood but not the case as his angry face was only directed at us  (we didn't even talk or raise our voice at him and somehow he didn't like our faces or because we were not locals) and not others. And he didn't cook the prawns well as some parts were still raw (grey in colour) and so we requested him to recook them thoroughly and he was even more angry.

Other than this chef, the other staff were generally ok and efficient in clearing our plates though they did not smile too (less the counter staff who ushered us in who smiled).

It's quite value for money considering the spread and price paid (it's 50% less than the buffet we have had the day before though that buffet included lobsters, fresh oysters, sashimi and beer).

Foodwise ok, but the chef service was terrible.

ChIJe-bsI4EtdTER5CWPb6ZdR0E.text:
I don't ⭐️, sop 1 ⭐️

⭐ 1/5 – Bad experience, especially food hygiene and safety

I went to eat buffet at KaKa restaurant on a weekday (ticket price 320,000 VND/person). The quantity of dishes is okay (tiny scallops, snails sucked sometimes there were some, sometimes there was nothing), but the most important thing is that the food hygiene is extremely poor.

While eating, I peeled a shrimp with sauce and inside the shrimp head appeared a whole DEAD FLY ☠️, soaked in sauce. I was really shocked because I didn't understand how a dead fly could be in the shrimp head like that and still be served to customers.

The staff standing next to me saw it clearly, immediately took the shrimp away and said they would report it to the kitchen. But since this is a buffet, saying “pay for another shrimp” really doesn’t make any sense. I couldn’t take a picture of the evidence because the staff standing next to me saw it and took it away.

The manager/owner of the restaurant apologized, but there was no form of compensation or support, even though I asked directly. I asked if there was any compensation, the restaurant said “I don’t know how to compensate” and gave a very vague suggestion like paying for a stuffed animal (?).

What disappointed me was that after such a serious incident, my table was still charged for the full amount of beer and wet towels. With such a high price, the quality of service and hygiene is really unacceptable.

The staff were enthusiastic and dedicated, but the restaurant’s solution was questionable???
If I hadn’t discovered it and eaten it at that time, what would have happened? The restaurant probably just said a sincere apology.

ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.author: Azusa Kanzaki
ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.text:
This is probably the buffet with the biggest variety I’ve ever tried! 🤩

It’s actually a Korean brand, so the style leans a bit Korean, but they’ve got everything — Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Western, and even traditional Vietnamese dishes. The seafood section was amazing — piles of fresh shrimp and crab, all-you-can-eat, totally worth it!

The dining area was super comfy, clean, and well-organized. The staff worked hard to keep the buffet area tidy, which I really appreciated.

And the ingredients were so fresh — they didn’t cut corners just because it’s a buffet. Everything was top quality!

ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.name: places/ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2b09YLUNBEAE
ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.author: lydia bae
ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.text:
Food was super delicious. There were many different kind of delicacies like Korean, Japanese, Chinese & western. They served many different kind of sushis but they only have 2 kinds of sashimi - tuna & salmon.

A live naengmyeon station can be found at the end of the sushi aisle, where you can choose between 물냉면 or the spicy cold noodles. The chef will prepare the bowl of cold noodles for you & after that, you can simply choose your toppings by yourself (beef slices, radish, kimchi, cucumber & eggs to choose from).

The Korean food selection was superb. Even the bulgogi & bossam tastes good. What surprised me was that they even have raw marinated crab (with soy sauce & also yangnyeom; the spicy one). Both crabs were packing in flavour & there were a lot of meat in them too. There were marinated cockles also, which was the first time I’m seeing.

The steam seafood was so good as well. The prawn’s head was so flavourful & the meat tasted sweet even without any sauces. Didn’t get to try the steak but I saw many people queuing for it. Will definitely be back again.

ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.name: places/ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNieThmb1h3EAE
ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.author: Red 6
ChIJSQjKPZ8vdTERARJ5HBYQI7w.text:
We have been to this location 6 times. I have noticed that the manager is always on the floor to make sure every detail is accounted for. I think she does a fantastic job.
The quality and value keep us coming back for more. For the price, you can’t beat unlimited seafood, sushi, and made to order steak. They have western fare which I really appreciate. A cream filled pastry tasted just like an American donut. I was very happy.
All staff are very polite, professional and accommodating.
The restaurant made an announcement requesting parents to keep an eye on their kids. I really appreciated that. Highly recommended.

ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.name: places/ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMcUlHTGZREAE
ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.text:
Hana Buffet should update to the new tablet ordering method to save staff time and optimise the process. The food took a long time to arrive. Even though I was one of the first customers to arrive in the afternoon, the service was still slow and a bit inattentive. I worry about how the staff manages customers during peak hours around 7 PM.

I have noticed that sometimes the kitchen does not prepare all the dishes I ordered, or sometimes the wrong dish comes up. Not sure if it was intentional or because of the staff's negligence while taking my order. I was disappointed that my order for grilled mussels with miso sauce was missing, while the table opposite me had it. Additionally, grilled oysters with cheese were served instead of my order of grilled oysters with scallion oil. Some items, like Edelweiss beer (priced at VND 30.000 on the menu but billed at VND 34.000), had price changes not reflected in the menu.

The manager's service left a huge negative impression. When my table had finished grilling but had yet left (still enjoying our desserts), he wanted to use our charcoal stove for newly arrived customers. He did not even have the decency to ask politely, instead opting to dump more charcoal right there, despite the coal dust flying all over my dessert. It was the height of rudeness and a complete disregard for our dining experience.

However, Hana Buffet has advantages that must be mentioned. A variety of dishes, from salad, beef, pork, chicken, seafood, pasta, pizza, hot pot, and desserts, are offered. Each plate is carefully seasoned and has a distinct flavour. Even though I consume a lot of meat, I do not feel bloated after eating. I especially praise the new employee named Lợi for his professional and enthusiastic service.

ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.name: places/ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ1X3JDYk53EAE
ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.author: Michael Holt
ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.text: Good quality beef and pork; better than Meat and Meet, and GoGi House. Oysters were not fresh. Spaghetti was surprisingly good. Service was fast and friendly. Atmosphere is not crowded and seating area is indoors with AC. Highly recommend.

ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.author: Mo Firefly
ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.text: Look you come here for the buffet selection not the decor, it can be a little shoddy but best believe the meat and sauce is memorable. Been here about 15mins and will always return.

ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4.name: places/ChIJOX_9TgUmdTER1oQDy_k8Wf4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURabXBuSXBBRRAB

Reasonable price

ChIJybtZnCYndTER-NTLiPtmSOY.author: MA Reyes
ChIJybtZnCYndTER-NTLiPtmSOY.text:
I first tried this place in one of their branches in Nha Trang and loved it, so I was happy to visit again here in Saigon before my flight back to the Philippines in the evening. While the Nha Trang branch had more options, I still really enjoyed my experience at this one. The variety of seafood they offer is unbelievable, especially for such an affordable price!

One thing I wish they could improve on is the drinks. There’s no free water, and you have to purchase beverages separately. They do serve free milk tea, which is nice, but sometimes nothing beats a soda or even just plain water. You have to prepare yourselves. Make sure to come prepared—it’s best to arrive on an empty stomach so you can really take advantage of the buffet!

ChIJybtZnCYndTER-NTLiPtmSOY.text: Excellent experience, food variety and quality, freshness. Staff super friendly. Worth the money u paid for. Highly recommend this business. Hope they will keep up their great service. Staff Thanh Truc was very good at taking photos for u guys 😻

ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.text: Enjoy the seafood feast with all you can eat at a single price. Fresh seafood and the choice is plenty. A place for seafood lovers.

ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.name: places/ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KUmJqSXdObkp4UkhOTFJtSnRkbWhhYm5GMVNHYxAB
ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.author: Tram Ha
ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.text:
This buffet restaurant can be a bit hit or miss. I’ve visited four times now, and my experiences have varied. On this visit, I noticed the food was restocked less frequently and some of the seafood was left cold. They used to serve abalone on previous visits, but when I asked about it this time, I was told they no longer carry it.
On the positive side, the staff are very helpful. They’re willing to bring dishes to your table, which ensures certain items stay hot and fresh when eaten.
Overall, while there are some good points, consistency is lacking, and I hope they improve the restocking and seafood quality.

ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.name: places/ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25vM2JFZFlVR0l3VDBkWVpVNTVNRTVhVGtKVE5rRRAB
ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.author: Annee
ChIJRXta8rEndTERYDglggfP0os.text:
Service: 1/5
We visited without a booking and were clearly tourists who spoke only basic Vietnamese. Although I may look Vietnamese, I don’t speak the language fluently - I was doing my best to communicate in both English and simple Vietnamese. Unfortunately, instead of patience or support, the staff seemed to mock us and exchanged funny looks. It left us feeling quite unwelcome, which really put a damper on the experience. However, they tried their best to fit us in without a booking.

Food: 2/5
There’s a huge variety of dishes on offer, but many weren’t restocked halfway through our dining time. While it’s great to have options, it’s disappointing when some trays remain empty for the rest of the session. The sushi, MOST sea snails, hot food... this wasn't restocked regularly or at all.

Atmosphere: 3/5
The restaurant is large and spacious, which is nice. However, children were running around the dining area with little supervision, making it tricky to navigate while carrying plates. It would help if this was managed a bit better.

Overall, Poseidon has potential, but I personally found the experience lacking - especially in terms of service and hospitality. The food was fresh though!

Just wished the staff would stop commenting on the customer's appearance & if food was restocked too - that would be good :D Otherwise not too bad.

ChIJU5-4wrsvdTERNksRnL7mwWY.author: Dallas D
ChIJU5-4wrsvdTERNksRnL7mwWY.text:
This hotpot place completely changed the way I see hotpot. I realized it can actually fit perfectly into a keto-friendly diet — just pork belly, meat, and plenty of vegetables. For only 150,000 VND you get your own individual hotpot, and it’s an incredible value: a full, hearty, hot meal that feels both satisfying and healthy.

The food itself was delicious, but what really stood out for me was the staff. One young man (unfortunately I didn’t catch his name) welcomed me warmly, asked if it was my first time there, and then explained everything clearly in English — which bowl is for what, how to use the setup, and how the process works. It was the first time in a long while that I felt truly guided as a foreign guest in a hotpot restaurant.

I’m deeply grateful for that small act of care, and for the wonderful experience of having such tasty, warming food at such an amazing price. 100% a hidden gem.

ChIJU5-4wrsvdTERNksRnL7mwWY.name: places/ChIJU5-4wrsvdTERNksRnL7mwWY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmMHFDMFFnEAE

ChIJU5-4wrsvdTERNksRnL7mwWY.text: The food is not as good as other spicy box. The sauce is too sweet. The line buffets is quite limited and not hot enough. There is no caramel deserts. There is no corn toppoki. The space is narrower than others. I will not go back there again.

ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.text:

ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.name: places/ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25NeWEwNVJSM05CWlhFeFJIRXdaMHR2ZUc5WmJtYxAB
ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.author: Anthony B
ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.text:
If you’re in Saigon and want to go all out on seafood, this spot should be at the top of your list. The vibe hits that sweet spot between casual and classy—plenty of energy in the room, but still comfortable enough to settle in and take your time. The spread is huge, fresh, and constantly replenished, so you never get that “picked over” feeling you sometimes find at buffets.

But here’s the real deal: the service is next level. Even when the place was packed and the staff clearly had their hands full, they still moved with purpose and handled every request like it was no trouble at all. You never had to wave someone down—they were already there with what you needed before you asked. It’s the kind of smooth, effortless hospitality that makes you feel like you’re in good hands the entire night.

Plates disappeared as soon as you were done, drinks stayed full, and they somehow kept the energy light and friendly while keeping the whole operation running like clockwork. That combination of attentiveness and genuine warmth is rare anywhere, but especially in a buffet where things can get hectic.

Dessert wrapped the night up perfectly, and the whole experience felt like you got more than your money’s worth. Between the endless fresh seafood, the lively atmosphere, and a team that really knows how to take care of people, this is one of those places you’ll be telling your friends about before you even get home.

If you want great food, a buzzing setting, and service that makes the night feel easy, this is the buffet to beat in Saigon. You’ll walk out full, happy, and already thinking about your next visit.

ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.name: places/ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VPVG5qLXlCdGNHYXZnRRAB

ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.text:

ChIJU1XFSxMmdTERevjdHHGczJc.text: Dmeris offer buffet and many variety of foods are available such as seafoods, cakes, fruits as well as coffees and teas. The buffet price is about 650K vnd per person.

ChIJqTOQHmgvdTERsk3IBR-4DhY.text: This place is amazing, with multiple floors where you can enjoy a delicious buffet. Each level offers a great dining experience with a wide variety of food choices. The food is well-prepared, tasty, and served in a clean and welcoming environment. I really enjoy coming here, and every visit has been a pleasant one. The atmosphere is vibrant, and the service is consistently good. I’ve been here several times already, and it never disappoints. Whether you’re visiting for the first time or returning, it’s a great spot to relax and enjoy a satisfying meal. I’ll definitely come back again.

ChIJqTOQHmgvdTERsk3IBR-4DhY.text: Great hot pot restaurant for a family and couple party. They have 5 different type of soup or hot pot broths you can choose from spicy to non spicy. The customer service is great and attentiveness from the staffs. We came in with a party of 5 people and they served us well. Definitely we will come again. A highly recommended from a local customers.

ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.text: The food was normal. But the restaurant was very dirty. Maybe it’s because we arrived there late around 9:30 PM but it shouldn’t be the reason for the bad hygiene. There were many leftover food on the floor. I couldn’t even look at them because it will make me throw up. So, I had to choose the table carefully. Also around the dessert table, it was very dirty. ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.name: places/ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xoamRVVmtNakZqTkhadk1WUk9Na2hwYVZVeGVFRRAB
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.author: Carl Grapenson
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.text:
Pretty affordable, with a variety of foods that you have to grill yourself (which we learned after buying the buffet) Unfortunately the food selection almost only consists out of meat, very few vegetables or sides.

Regarding service, we were shown to our table but afterwards left on our own. While trying our luck at barbecuing the meats the gas of our table stove ran out twice in a couple of minutes, and being beginner's it took us a moment to realise each time. The third time we got a full canister instead of an empty one and then it worked.

I'm sure this is a great spot for Vietnamese customers as it seemed very popular and lively. However, I thought it was difficult as there were no labels regarding what was what, and in addition to that there were also some food-hygiene safety concerns. Me and my partner left the restaurant after about 15-20 minutes, somewhat disappointed.

ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.name: places/ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJMUlLeUVBEAE
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.author: CURIOUS ABOUT VIETNAM
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.text:
It was a great meal, we were so busy eating that we forgot to take a picture! It’s definitely a bang for the buck at just 139K per person, with even unlimited boba tea. I was surprised at how well-marinated the meat was. We had a great time and highly recommend it!

One thing I wasn’t really happy about was how they pushed for reviews. The staff would ask for a review right on the spot just so they could take a picture. I understand it from a business standpoint, but I don’t think that’s the right way to treat a customer, it’s not pleasant and feels too pushy.

ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.name: places/ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJXzhXMk9REAE
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.author: Carl Truong
ChIJHTkOb58pdTERC0-gSocoRNw.text:
This is a local hotspot, the best way I can describe it is Vietnamese BBQ, similar to KBBQ. As a foreigner, it can be a lot all at once. But my advice is to skip the "all you can drink" add on for another 25K, unless you really like soft drinks.

I was impressed by the spread of meats, whole tiger shrimps, pork belly, chicken cuts of various types, enoki mushrooms wrapped in beef, octopus, squid, the list goes on.

They even have snails, clams, and a variety of other things to supplement your meal. There is a green dipping sauce, I couldn't get enough of it. It's kind of a mix of a minty / spicy sauce, really unique.

At 139K VND, this place is of extreme value. My only critique, the beef cuts are chewy and maybe not the best cut. All in, a really fun and delicious experience.

ChIJ8VNpDycpdTER5DKR_DBpu14.text: You must try . The meat is fresh. I go about 5 times a month. The shrimp is unlimited, so it's a great value for seafood lovers.

ChIJ8VNpDycpdTER5DKR_DBpu14.name: places/ChIJ8VNpDycpdTER5DKR_DBpu14/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNqd2E3RnJnRRAB

ChIJ8VNpDycpdTER5DKR_DBpu14.text:
As two tourists among locals we felt a bit lost at first, although the name speaks for itself - buffet bbq. The staff didn't speak much English and we unfortunately don't speak Vietnamese but they were very helpful and trying hard to help us, which we appreciated muchly. Basically you pay a fixed price and have unlimited buffet of raw meats and seafood which you later grill by yourself on a  little gas stove placed on the table. You are also provided a box of margarine for frying. There's some veggies, nuggets and sushi as well, unlimited soft drinks, and a couple of deserts. Great fun, and the food was good.
The atmosphere of the place gives a vibe of modern, chic place where young locals like to hang out.
Found it by accident, really glad we stepped in
