Tucked away and easy to miss, but the coffee is rich, smooth and one of the best I’ve had in Vietnam. Simple setup, friendly team, and a really calm vibe. Worth the stop if you want a proper brew without the chaos.

ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.name: places/ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxUU4yeFNSMWRWV0haR01HTlJVRFprVmpSWFJuYxAB
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.author: Joanne C.
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.text: Reasonably priced. Salmon and avocado brioche and the smoked salmon salad with Greek yogurt dressing were very good. Also ordered a tiramisu croffle to share and it was crispy and fluffy. Ichigo matcha was delicious with chunks of strawberries but might be a little on the sweet side. Matcha frappe was full of matcha flavour and not too sweet (which we prefer!). We didn’t encounter wifi issues when we were there. 2 mains, 2 drinks, 1 croffle and 1 dessert came up to be 570,000

ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.name: places/ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZMkxMUmVREAE
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.author: Duong Le
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.text:
From a Coffee person perspective, this is extremely a disappointing experience.
95k for a Orange Cold brew, and what I get is basically Orange juice and a tiny shot of espresso. Let me say clearly, I had so many much better orange cold brew with 60k,65k or even much cheaper. What I am complaining is with this price, the given quality must be much better than this, 1 word only: overprice.
As of service, the cashier did not look exactly happy when I ordered..and atmosphere, if you sit outside on a windy day, it would be nice. But inside, the interior design is okay with such a vintage orange tone, however, the common space is too small, and very noisy if everyone start talking. I would not highly recommend this place as a reviewer.
Let me drop some picture that I took here, which looks nice but I guess, for the actual experience, it’s up to you to try.
P/s: I did not try the food but it was also quite expensive…I would not recommend nhe🙏🏻

ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.name: places/ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJbU9mVmhBRRAB
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.author: Murray Herbert
ChIJ9ZtFSkYvdTERQoHrDARlkUc.text: Lovely cafe right across the road from our Hotel (Sherwood Residence). Delicious coffee and pastries, our family really enjoyed everything. The egg and bacon toasted sandwich was so amazing. Easy to read menus and even models of some food to help you choose. Could pay with card. Highly recommend!

ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.name: places/ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KUE5rUkRRVWRDZFhkR2RGODVOa056YjI5TlNGRRAB
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.author: Rohan Kumar
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.text:
Stopped by Oromia Coffee & Lounge in District 3 and loved the whole vibe here.
The place is cozy and beautifully decorated — warm lights, lots of
greenery, and even a small pond that makes the space feel calm and
relaxing. I tried their coffee and a slice of cake; both were solid. The coffee was smooth and well-balanced, and the dessert wasn’t too sweet.

ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.name: places/ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s4M1lWaHpaVzlLWTNFMlZ5MVlibVJrYW5ZeExYYxAB
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.author: JYC
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.text: Artistic cafe in a beautiful house. The interior makes you feel like you are in a artsy yet cosy home. The Menu is a little limited but the taste of the drinks are fine.

ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.name: places/ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNSzA5SjZyaFpYT2lRRRAB
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.author: VanDi Dang
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.text:
The café lied about promotion programs: promising to give bread free when ordering drinks from 7am to 10am - but when we came, they said they didn't have meat balls for the bread so no bread at all.
The food served is not the same as described in the menu (no pork ribs) with nothing special in taste.
The refill menu applies only after another drink has been ordered - not as described on their Facebook fan page.
But the ambiance is great with lots of trees and plants.
Won't return though, for it's not worth it.

ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.name: places/ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xkR1preFBWVGhTYW5aSlJsQmlkV3QyTkhrelJFRRAB
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.author: Jessy Tam
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.text: Comfy and cozy place to chill. Their drinks were really yummy and so was the food! And of course the decor is beautiful!!! Would definitely be back!

ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.name: places/ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSZmJIaEdXRUY2UjE5dWFVUkxTamx2Wm5WTmIwRRAB
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.author: Việt Hương Nguyễn
ChIJT9IBetEpdTERv1WHWPOkMLo.text: Ok spot for foods & I extreme love its "longan Cold Brew" (Cold Brew Nhãn), definitely the star of the shop.

ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.name: places/ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKRFdUTlFSV1JqZUdsUlgwMTRObVZLUm5aWVZFRRAB
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.author: J P.
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.text: Beautiful coffee shop that you can't miss  visiting. Nice and relaxing music. The view is excellent in the evenings, and you can also enjoy the airplanes landing... Pet friendly, super cute and nice staff... The barista is great because the caphe sua is very delicious and has the same taste as circle K vietnam ( High quality coffee and yummy condensed milk). You can see the river extremely near. They got cake and salty food. Parking lot entrance 4k. Best match with the exclusive  tofu with mushrooms from the local market ( 100mt to the left). They also have interesting workshops 🤔. Will come back for sure.

ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.name: places/ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3M1pmR0tBEAE
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.author: Sofia Sebastian
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.text: First of all, I appreciated that their drinks were served without sugar despite the absence of our request. This means that they understand the essence of serving pure and healthy drinks. The staff were attentive to having you constantly refilled with water considering the heat and since this cafe is mostly alfresco. The prices were very much affordable. There are a lot of young people who go there for picture taking since the ambiance is cool and modern, at the same time somewhat vintage with all the flowers and the house decor. They have some guitar lessons going on on the second floor. The best part of this cafe is when you get a chance to sit in front of the river. The flow of the river influenced by it's current is entertaining as it goes left and sometimes right; it adds to the chill ambiance.

ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.name: places/ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKNXZYckV3EAE
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.author: Ben Chowlah
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.text: Top spot for a date or just simply to chill the day away with friends alike. Cool little cafe beside the river. Outdoor sitting might attract some insects to your drinks but its to be expected in a natural setting.

ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.name: places/ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURocDktV1h3EAE
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.author: spring
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.text: The place zone is very spacious with a retro vibe, very chill. Many young come here to hangout and date. The drink (included soft drink and alcohol) and food menu is diverse, and the prices are not too expensive, ranging from 50K to 100K. At 7:30 pm weekends, an indie and pop ballad band plays very chill music. Oh, and there is a Monstera plant next to it, and a cute little Pomeranian that guards this place.

ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.name: places/ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3M29LVnFRRRAB
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.author: Le Khang Nhat Dung
ChIJn--8WisndTERngl6GS2QpKI.text:
A palce with nice view to the river. Drinks are ok, not too special.
Better to coma at sunset period

ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.name: places/ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xNMk5rbHpUV0pWVVVkVFkzaHFNVUUyZUVObFRXYxAB
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.author: Sean Campbell
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.text: Very nice guy working the front counter. Place is beautiful and full of art. This is a powerful reflection of the beauty in all the people if Vietnam. Coffee and food were both great. Love the eggs/bread. Coffee was excellent.

ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.name: places/ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT204NU4xZE5SVE4zTWpKdlpXaFJSMEl4UWxnMU5WRRAB
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.author: Indrajeet Ravi Menon
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.text:
Such a beautiful and well-maintained place!
It’s truly a work of art. I had the coconut ice cream, and it was delicious—not too sweet, just the way I like it. Perfect spot to relax, and I’ll come back next time I’m in town.

ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.name: places/ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21reWQxbGpORU5EZEhscFJXRmpka3M0TmtsRE5IYxAB
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.author: Anh Raph
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.text:
A pleasant surprise! While the downstairs is a bit cozy, the upstairs reveals a spacious and colorful room.

It feels like a private escape from the city's noise, complemented by a relaxing soundtrack of old-school French classical music.

The wifi was reliable, and the Arabica coffee was excellent and reasonably priced. Definitely worth a visit!

ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.name: places/ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvMHYyYWxRRRAB
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.author: Jastine Melos
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.text:
Bonjour Café The Art is such a hidden gem in Ho Chi Minh! From the moment you walk in, the ambiance immediately stands out…charming, cozy, and beautifully decorated with a French-inspired touch. It’s the kind of place where you’d want to linger, take photos, and just soak in the peaceful atmosphere.

I ordered a croissant, and it did not disappoint… fresh, buttery, and perfectly flaky. They also have a nice selection of drinks and other pastries, making it a great spot for a light breakfast or afternoon break.

One thing I really appreciated was that the staff can speak English, which made communication smooth and hassle-free. They were also polite and welcoming, which added to the overall positive experience.

Whether you’re looking to grab a quick bite, relax with a cup of coffee, or just enjoy a quiet, aesthetically pleasing space. Bonjour Café The Art is definitely worth a visit.

ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.name: places/ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvMTZfYkd3EAE
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.author: Huyen Suong Le
ChIJKyYzwU8ndTERA1zCwYeytGQ.text:
Absolutely lovely place! Super cute and well decorated. It was nice sitting inside and just vibing. Good place to snap pictures for IG or make a quick tiktok video.

We didn't try any food but did have the drinks! I got the lemongrass kombucha and choco nana smoothie. Kombucha was okay. Tasted kind of basic with no lemongrass flavor. I've had a lot better. The smoothie was good! Not too overwhelmingly one flavor and went down smooth. Crunchy banana chips on top were a nice little snack as well. My mom's peach tea had a good sweet and not too tart flavor!

Overall a good experience and would bring my friends here next year just for vibes alone.

ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.name: places/ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWc1RrTmZVRnBCWm5KWE0wdFJkemwzTjNsTWJuYxAB
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.author: Ann Ng
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.text:
☕ The Workshop has a cool industrial-style interior with spacious seating and plenty of natural light. The bar is lined with coffee equipment, creating a professional vibe — a great spot for coffee lovers.

This is my third visit, and the food and drinks are still up to standard:
•	Pour-over coffee: aromatic, smooth, and beautifully presented.
•	Omelette with toast & salad: fluffy, tasty, and just the right portion.
•	Croissant: crisp, buttery, and perfect with jam and butter.

The only downside is that the staff don’t seem very welcoming — a warmer smile and friendliness would make the experience even better.

Overall, still a great place to enjoy coffee, breakfast, or brunch. 🌟

ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.name: places/ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaTmFqQXlXWGN3WmxSSmNVRjVVa1ZZU1ZWTmRFRRAB
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.author: Polevy Ezekiel
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.text: One of the most recommended specialty coffee shop in Ho Chi Minh called @theworkshopcoffee, established since 2014 and located in the bustling Bến Nghé area. Located on the second floor of an old 1912 building, the classic vintage ambience feels very strong because many architectural elements are very well maintained. High ceilings with many window openings from various directions create good natural lighting, causing a warm, comfy and welcoming space. Various coffee menus are served here and the ones I recommend most are classic coffee and manual brew with various of the best coffee beans from various origins.

ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.name: places/ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poRU5tUk9UR2hFY25KVVFYQmtOR2hZYUVveU1IYxAB
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.author: Leonard Lim
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.text:
Workshop Coffee in Ho Chi Minh City is one of those places that stands out for its cool, industrial-chic vibe. It’s always lively and full of energy, popular with Chinese tourists and expats alike. Their coffee is excellent, and although the food menu is quite limited, everything I’ve tried has been tasty.

The only downsides for me are that the entrance is a bit hidden—you have to go up a flight of stairs to find it—and it can get really crowded and noisy during busy hours. Also, I personally find the chairs quite uncomfortable, which makes it hard to sit for long.

ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.name: places/ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xWlNIQndVMEZpWkUwd1dYRkRObE5OZGpKNVNuYxAB
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.author: Chuin Ling Ung (CL)
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.text: It's a quite hidden kind of cafe if you don't really notice the signboard. It's kinda cute though. The variety of coffee served here are really special and are so good. Tried their nutty cremina and salted iced coffee, and I can say the salted iced coffee is a must try! Panna cotta gives off a very balanced taste and it's really good.

ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.name: places/ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Sa1JHcHlTbmQwTm5oUGExVmtXRjlzZG1kUFkzYxAB
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.author: Giovanni
ChIJdyfroEYvdTER2m7eTz44Bns.text: Definitely the place where to have nice food and where to work at a laptop. They're built for that, there are plugs everywhere and the wifi is strong. The staff will not bother you, but it's good habit to order something every hour at least, and tip the staff appropriately. The food is good, big, and vote expensive. Good quality place.

ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.name: places/ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xJd04yTnpRVUZaWkVKTVp6SlRSRVZ4VFVsb2JFRRAB
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.author: Sofia Sebastian
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.text: Great for picture-taking. Atmosphere's cool and modern. Prices are fine but drinks are not super.

ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.name: places/ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s1TGJuQnlUbnA0TjBzM2IyVmhVVXRLV2xRMk9WRRAB
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.author: wenhao huang
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.text: Stylish interior and exterior design, very chilled place, drinks is just ok, still a good place to have a leisure time.

ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.name: places/ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GUlYycDRURTlGYWxJME4wbEVRVFkzTjJvNFNHYxAB
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.author: C.
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.text: Came on Sunday night. Had to pay extra 50k because of live band on weekend nights 8-10pm. A lot of people came to take Instagram photos. Plenty of parking available. Little bit secluded. The music and singing is too loud in enclosed area. Singing is good but unfortunately only Vietnamese song which I can't appreciate.

ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.name: places/ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3b2IzODlRRRAB
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.author: Hazel Joy
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.text: Dalaland Coffee offers a stunning and aesthetically pleasing space, making it a great spot for photos and a relaxing ambiance. The design and atmosphere are truly impressive, creating a cozy yet stylish environment. However, the food quality needs improvement. I ordered the fish balls, and unfortunately, they were not up to par. The drinks were just average, not bad, but nothing special either. Given how beautiful the place is, I expected the food and beverages to match the experience. If they work on improving their menu, this could easily become a top-tier café.

ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.name: places/ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURnbkpiSGFnEAE
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.author: Isabella Miriam
ChIJsfKJJP8ndTERqrIYh9evSb0.text: Incredibly pleasant experience here. The koi fish pond was super enjoyable, great for taking photos. Lots of backdrops to take aesthetic photos. Drinks were tasty, the coconut coffee I got was exceptional!! Highly recommend visiting.

ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.name: places/ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCNVNYcFZRblZyUzBsWWQyaHVPVzl5VDFRMFdVRRAB
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.author: Eric Nguyen
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.text:
We ordered the durian coffee and a matcha cake. The durian coffee was the clear highlight with strong flavor and good balance, while the matcha cake felt bland and didn’t offer much depth. For the price point, the drinks are solid and reasonable given the view you get here.

Service was basic and straightforward, consistent with the small café operations inside this apartment building. Staff moved efficiently but with minimal engagement, which works fine for a quick stop.

The atmosphere is the real value driver, offering a great city view and a relaxed setup similar to other cafés in the complex. With the pricing and scenery combined, it’s an easy spot to visit if you want a casual drink, especially the durian coffee, while enjoying the view.

ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.name: places/ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSTlVIZzJXWGgyYUhkSlFtMDFORTlRTUdkVldrRRAB
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.author: Lorraine Bmor
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.text:
It’s a nice and cozy cafe located at the 4th floor of the apartment. The interior is like an indoor garden bookstore. It’s just perfect for taking photos. 💕 There’s also a lot of seating space so you won’t feel pressured to leave or rush through your drinks.

We got the Peach & Orange Lemongrass tea and the Lychee Rose Tea. Both are super tasty. The tea itself is good with just the right amount if sweetness. They are also very generous with the amount of fruit and crystal jellies as sinkers. It’s so refreshing and is a must-try when here. 😍

ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.name: places/ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21GaVNsOTBTWFJUY1ZCcVduSnVaSGhhUTBFeWVsRRAB
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.author: Kim G
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.text:
Average coffee and average service. Took a good 20 minutes to make my ice coconut coffee when there wasnt much customer around. Coffee was bland and disappointed. Kinda expected with the price too since the whole building is a tourist trap.

Nice decor in the cafe and great view, nice social media photo op.

ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.name: places/ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2podlNXTnlSbFZSUlRCaWVHSm9lbTEwYmtsdmVWRRAB
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.author: Eizen Barleta
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.text: Such a pretty café at the famous The Cafe Apartment. We went during peak hours but were surprised to find only one other customer besides us. Like other shops in the building, they have a balcony where you can people-watch or simply enjoy the view of the city. The food was average.

ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.name: places/ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCdWRGOWhkV1JFU0c0eFlYZFBXa3RRZDNRMlpIYxAB
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.author: Niskie Ferrer
ChIJw7k36kYvdTERJ9L8Dd7o-0U.text: On the 5th floor of The Cafe Apartments, I had a banh mi and coconut coffee set for 150,000 VND (₱328). The alfresco view was charming and photogenic, but the food fell short. Nice for the experience and photos, but I wouldn’t go back just for the taste

ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.name: places/ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURodk8tZkRREAE
ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.author: Dung Pham
ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.text: Delicious peach tea, reasonable price, large parking lot hehehe

ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.name: places/ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoN3N1VjVnRRAB
ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.author: Thu Quynh
ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.text: Open, airy space, friendly staff, especially delicious drinks, affordable prices from 25-30k only. Worth the experience

ChIJdbIThdMrdTERD1iUzThud5o.author: tam phan

ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.text: This is the most beautiful restaurant in the city! 🤩 it is incredibly atmospheric, cozy, beautiful and delicious. many free seats. the decoration is impressive. fountains, colors, music create memorable pictures. here you can sit with friends and family. the menu is varied, the prices are very affordable, and the food is delicious. the waiters are very kind and serve guests quickly. this is our favorite place and we will come here with friends to sit beautifully and celebrate holidays 😍

ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.name: places/ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvMHNPRDRnRRAB
ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.author: Jastine Melos
ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.text:
Du Mien Garden is a gorgeous spot with a unique and peaceful ambiance. The lush greenery, calming atmosphere, and stylish design really make it a perfect place to relax, take photos, or just enjoy some quiet time. Whether you’re there for a casual hangout or a more intimate moment, the setting is really inviting and well thought out.

However, when it comes to the food, it’s just okay. While it’s not bad, it didn’t leave a lasting impression, and some dishes could definitely use a little more flavor or variety. But honestly, the food is almost secondary to the incredible ambiance that makes the place so enjoyable.

If you’re looking for a beautiful space to unwind and enjoy a peaceful moment, Du Mien Garden is worth the visit. Just don’t expect the food to blow you away… the environment is where this place really shines!

ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.author: Matthew Gray
ChIJKbnmWQApdTERwsotmjhioIE.text:
Du Miên Garden Café is one of Saigon’s most beautiful and thoughtfully designed cafés.  The creative use of space is incredible!  A lush garden built around flowing water features and towering old trees, with bridges, pathways, and a stunning treehouse that feels like something out of a movie.

The menu offers both quality food and a wide range of delicious drinks, all well presented and full of flavour.  It’s the perfect place to relax on a sunny day or even when there’s a light rain, as the setting becomes even more atmospheric.

Our visit was interrupted by a massive and torrential downpour, but the staff handled it, helping guests stay comfortable and dry.  Despite the weather, it remained a great experience. One that I'll definitely repeat.

Some parts of the roof drip but it was somehow comfortable and warm after we were served with a hot chocolate while it was heavily pouring.

Prices are reasonable and the drinks are okay.

ChIJA2lp-0cvdTER5k2PvZBCMg0.author: Michael
ChIJA2lp-0cvdTER5k2PvZBCMg0.text:
Sori Cafe & More is one of those places that immediately makes you slow down the moment you step inside. Tucked away from the noisy streets, it feels like a little sanctuary designed for people who appreciate a cozy, thoughtful atmosphere. The décor is modern yet warm, with plenty of natural light during the day, and soft, calming tones that create a sense of comfort.

The menu offers a well-curated range of drinks, from carefully brewed coffee to refreshing teas and creative specialty beverages. Their coffee is smooth and balanced, clearly made with attention to detail, while the fruit-based drinks are light and uplifting. Beyond drinks, the café also serves a selection of cakes and small bites that pair perfectly with an afternoon chat or a quiet working session.

What makes Sori Cafe & More stand out is the balance it strikes between being a social spot and a workspace. You’ll often see people reading, working on laptops, or simply catching up with friends. The staff are friendly and attentive without being intrusive, adding to the overall relaxed vibe.

Whether you’re looking for a place to focus, or just somewhere to enjoy a slow coffee break, Sori Cafe & More is a lovely choice worth revisiting.

ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A.name: places/ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2paME1EVXRlRzF4UlV0VVZUaDFWa05wZFdSU09YYxAB

ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A.text: A beautiful spot with lush greenery, tranquil water features, and plenty of cozy corners to relax. The garden setting feels like a hidden oasis—perfect for catching up with friends or enjoying a quiet moment alone. The drinks menu is extensive, with everything from Vietnamese coffee to smoothies and herbal teas. I especially appreciated the friendly staff and the variety of indoor and outdoor seating. It can get busy on weekends, but the atmosphere is worth it. A lovely place to unwind and recharge.

ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A.name: places/ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJS0dwTy1ZeHBXM013EAE
ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A.author: Annisa Shalsa
ChIJjZ1IDpEudTERNOJZY2MsE2A.text:
I found out about Miền Thảo Mộc Cafe from social media so I intentionally visited to enjoy and absorb the tranquil atmosphere of the cafe. When I first entered, I was absolutely mesmerized. There were waterfalls, fish pond, and Vietnamese decorations all over the cafe, and water sprayer to keep you refreshed, they also have amazing setting of seats. I recommend this place as a perfect escape from the heat and traffic of the city at afternoon, but I want to visit again next time at night when the lantern lights up.

The drinks were delicious, but the variety of the foods is a bit narrow. Nonetheless, everything I ordered was tasty. This cafe is a must-visit especially for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City for the first time!

ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.name: places/ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLVGd2YXIybnEzaFJBEAE
ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.author: Katrina Kirkpatrick
ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.text:
A quite sizable café with four floors, an extensive drink menu and a variety of seating options.

Parking attendants are prompt and professional, and there is large parking space.

The sticky rice with mango and coconut cream: definitely worth it. I had the tamarind drink with a few kinds of fruit in it. It is the first time that I’ve been served a drink in Vietnam which they DON’T add sugar to (this is a plus for me, although some people might find it rather tart).  What really impressed me was that the amount of ice was adequate, but not excessive - and the amount of fruit they put in was easily three or four times more than what you would get at another place, which made it a very filling and tasty drink. I would definitely return for these two menu items.

(The second time I went I ordered the olomg tea with custard apple; least 20% of the cup was fresh custard apple, and the taste of kumquat was clear and refreshing. And like the tamarind drink, it seems to be natural flavors with no sugar. I got the sticky rice with gelato, coconut cream, and variety of toppings. It was a feast for the eyes.)

They’ve maximize their space with a variety of seating options for individuals or groups; fixed seating as well as some loose furniture.

Men’s toilet is at the back on the ground floor; women’s toilet is at the back on the second floor.

I went with my friends on a Sunday at 3 PM and all four floors were full. It was challenging to find a space for our group of five (although that was partly due to a few individuals who were on their own, but took up a space that was meant for four or five people).

Mostly people 35 and under quietly working on their laptops, although on the ground floor, there were more who were talking.

There seems to be a problem with water leaking from various places: we were in the back room on the ground floor, and there was water leaking under the bench that spread down through the center of the room. Also on the ground floor, right in the middle of where people need to walk to get to the toilet or rear seating area, there was a lot of water spreading out. (This became a potential hazard as someone had a power bar on the floor, connecting to their laptop, very near that water leakage.) The women’s bathroom is the same problem: water going from under the sink into both cubicles.

They cleverly used dark colored tiles in the bathroom, so you don’t see how dirty it is, but the garbage cans (3) were all overflowing and all three trash cans were rusted; the soap dispenser spout is broken off.

There were multiple tables with used cups on them. I never saw staff cleaning up as customers left; in fact, there were one or two tables which the customers had self-designated and filled with used cups to clear a table for use. It’s true that when I arrived at 3pm they were quite busy, but when we left around 5:30-6pm, there were far fewer prole - but all four staff were still busy in the drink preparation area (which also looked really messy).

There was a cart at the back on the ground floor, and some customers put their used cups there. If that is what the café would like customers to do, they need to put the cart in a more visible and convenient place and put up signs tactfully suggesting this kind of behavior on the part of the customers. Nonetheless, the staff still need to clear that cart out regularly. On the ground floor beside that cart. There was a garbage can, and it too was overflowing.

I wouldn’t recommend going there at the weekend because it’s just so busy, it can be difficult to find appropriate seating.

ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.author: Doãn Võ Đình
ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.text: So crowded. This 24/7 cafe is popular among students, teens and young adults with their laptops. Operations is not so good, even with self service. I had my drink mistaken with someone else. No cleaning either as they're short of staff.

ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.name: places/ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSMDR5Qnd3RRAB
ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.author: Tâm An Võ Nguyễn
ChIJm4fyXQ4pdTER7E23mMlWcsw.text:
Quite impressed on the cafe's architecture. They made it unique, modern, and stunning. Combining with the Nhieu Loc - Thi Nghe view then I got to give this a 5-star rating.
The coffee here is good for my taste, just 33k if you pick the smallest size. Other beverages will go around 50k.
Suitable for both chatting and working. They got high tables with sockets on the wall or under your feet. Will be a bit uncomfortable for those who have back pain though.

ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.name: places/ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCS1YzcFFPREpxVlVGR2EzUmlkbHBoVDNFMVJuYxAB
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.author: Troy Parry
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.text: This is a small cosy cafe, and it’s quite popular and crowded. We had to wait 10 minutes for someone to exit before we were seated, which we didn’t mind. I ordered an egg coffee which wasn’t to my liking, and the drink my wife ordered was mostly ice, so she ordered a second drink which was once again mostly ice. Not value for money, we’ve been to other places which were better value.

ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.name: places/ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oVFpGbHhZa0k0TVZSNVQyRnJZMlZYWkVKSGIyYxAB
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.author: Bellie NeverLies
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.text:
Ok lah not bad.

Had to have some coffee since I climbed all the way up to 8th floor. This review was 4.9 stars so just try coconut latte and salted coffee that’s like super thick and creamy. Salted coffee tasted like salted caramel pro max.

ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.name: places/ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkNWRGTnNjMFF4TW5WeFZFSjZjM1puTjNCVU0zYxAB
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.author: GibbenTake
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.text: It's my first time to try the Egg coffee in Vietnam specifically Po Cafe, and I swear to God it didn't disappoint! Their egg coffee has table sugar on top and torched to create a creme brulee texture. The taste? It's perfection! I can't stop thinking about it. Plus its only my friend and I who are in the Cafe so the entire place is just for us! I recommend visiting here at an earlier time, like 8-9am, so you can enjoy the ambiance with your coffee.

ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.name: places/ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGbE1rMDRVMUZuZGxOS2JXazRUR2cyY1ZCT1MxRRAB
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.author: Richard Lowe
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.text:
A fantastic experience and atmosphere at PO cafe.  It's a required stop for aficionados of Vietnamese Coffee.

I sampled both their signature Egg Coffee and Salty Coffee, and they were superb.  The cafe is perpetually bustling with a constant flow of customers. Service was excellent from the staff.

Not readily apparent; one must navigate a covered alley to reach it.
A must visit and see in HCMC.

ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.name: places/ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21rMVNsOHRNbkpuV1U5Rk5qUnFVbHBGYm1OS1FXYxAB
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.author: Ibe Collera
ChIJVxAlvGAvdTER4Qlst-chVbM.text: 5/5 stars! I just tried the egg coffee and it's LOVE AT FIRST SIP! The flavor is rich and yummy, the atmosphere is a total vibe, and the crew is super friendly. Definitely recommend this hidden gem to anyone looking for a unique coffee experience! Don’t miss to try their signature coffee too!

ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.name: places/ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poS01TMVpja1JPTFdkR2FDMXZTRFYwTlVjMk5rRRAB
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.author: Lan Nguyen
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.text: Old school garden coffee shop, it is for family to gather in weekends with spacious areas inside and outside. Diversity of drinks and foods but not very special. Not my coffee style though. A bit pricey compared to the quality of foods and drinks in my opinion.

ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.name: places/ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGM1VEQjFXWE5zY214RmVIQTJiRkp6WkVWQlVVRRAB
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.author: Mark Tho
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.text:
Charming local restaurant. Lovely layout and garden like ambience.

Food was simple and very good value for money.

Apparently quite a popular restaurant frequented by locals as the railway restaurant - just next to the railway line.

ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.name: places/ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2taaGRtMUJWSGhVY0U1UWMxaGhRVEl3ZDJaa1kwRRAB
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.author: Tran V
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.text: I choose cookies chocolate smoothie and vegan vermicelli, the dish is decent and well-balanced flavoured, the drink is confort, intense cocoa flavor without too much sweetness, staff are very nice and quick reponse, definitely come back.

ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.name: places/ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURuemVfVVhBEAE
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.author: Tracy Yeo
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.text: Vietnam has many lovely cafes and this is probably one of them which I have been to.  This cafe gives you a very cosy feeling and makes you feel very relaxed the very moment when you walk in.  The entrance and surrounding are decorated with flowers, a pond in the garden and colourful seating arrangement which you thought you are walking into the 70s.  Also a great place for dating or hang out with some friends on a lazy day.  Most people will come here for the coffee or drinks as food wise is not that great but price is still reasonable.

ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.name: places/ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJU000Ym0xaUlDVDlBRRAB
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.author: daniel anderson
ChIJfxNZwSkpdTERfHMOehO61JQ.text: A bit on the pricey side for drinks, but given the atmosphere, that's totally okay. It's a really lovely place and I like the mood there a lot.

ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.name: places/ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214cFMyRndNbGhUUmtOVGIwSXpkblV4WVV4T1QxRRAB
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.author: Annee
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.text:
Just the kind of cafe I was looking for!!

This cozy little vintage cafe is tucked away down a short alleyway. You’ll know you’re close when you see a darker spot between the bright shops — there’s usually some motorbikes parked there. Head down that path and turn right.

I got the iced Vietnamese coffee and iced lychee tea — both were really good. The place has such a chill vibe, vintage decor everywhere, and even more vintage stuff downstairs you can buy. You can sit inside or outside, surrounded by plants. Honestly, it’s exactly the kind of spot I was looking for.

I’m sure you’ll love it too. Vintage vibes, great decor and lovely staff! 🧡

ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.name: places/ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kwNE5qUklaM3BMTjI5T1pWZzBlazVLZHpSSGExRRAB
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.author: Jeremy Ho
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.text: Wonderful hidden gem of a cafe. They had a sizable library of Vietnamese and English books, and very chill vibes.

ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.name: places/ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZy1tZWJBEAE
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.text:
As the cafe is situated in a narrow alley, those arriving by motorbike will need to park at the nearby Tran Huu Trang Cailuong Theatre and then walk to the cafe. The parking fee is VND 8.000, and the cafe will contribute VND 5.000 towards this cost by deducting it from your total bill.

Upon entering, you are requested to remove your shoes. The cafe provides indoor straw slippers, but I found these to be rather unsanitary, so I opted to go barefoot.

To order food and drink, head to the ground floor, where you can also choose to sit. The ground floor also features a display of handicrafts at reasonable prices. The first floor is often used for workshops and as a homestay, so please maintain a quiet atmosphere.

The cafe's strong point is its abundance of greenery, but on the day of my visit, the sky was overcast and the canvas cover had been pulled up, making the interior gloomy and damp.

I ordered a milk coffee and a matcha latte; the coffee was excellent, but the matcha latte was excessively sweet and unpleasant.

Fortunately, the presence of a cat named Mi Ú and a doggo named Cheese helped to mitigate some of the cafe's shortcomings.

ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.name: places/ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURqeklfOEt3EAE
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.author: Joanne Cheng
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.text: We googled nearby cafe and saw this cafe with good reviews 👍🏻 It is not difficult to find the place as there are signs to direct us. The place gave us home feeling and felt welcome. The staffs greeted us and we need to change to their slippers before going into the cafe. The drinks are reasonable price and taste good. There are souvenirs around for us to see and buy. My kids are attracted by the little pet in the cafe. Second level has seats for us too. You can go to the balcony and enjoy your drinks. The place is no air conditioned but pretty windy. The place is cozy and very relax. You can drop by the cafe and enjoy a cup of coffee in the midst of HCM.

ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.name: places/ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvMjVfQ1R3EAE
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.author: Glenys Thomas
ChIJHXwLgVYvdTERo2z2kZqEzFs.text:
Cute little ca phe, down an alley, then turn right.
Good iced coffee, not sickly sweet.
Sat on the balcony upstairs, cool and breezy.
Lovely staff, also runs as a home stay that you can book on Airbnb.

ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.name: places/ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKN3BIck1BEAE
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.author: Quý Khôi Nguyễn (Kaden Nguyen)
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.text:
Review by Khoi, Mon 17/07/2023
I absolutely love this coffee shop! It's such a great place to hang out with friends, study for exams, or just relax and enjoy a delicious drink. The best part is that they have bunk beds where you can sleep over if you need a break from the stress of life. The beds are super comfy and private, and you can even charge your phone and laptop there. The staffs are friendly and helpful, they always make sure you have everything you need. This amazing experience is packed within a reasonable price. I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves coffee and cozy vibes! 😁

ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.name: places/ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxRVdXbzBaV1ZGUlZKT2NsOVpZVTV1YW5abmJIYxAB
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.author: simika007
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.text:
Came for a quick coffee... clearly expected too much.

Menu only in Vietnamese — totally fine, I love guessing games before caffeine. Ordered a ice cappuccino, assuming it wouldn’t be drowned in sugar. Silly me. Real cafés usually let *you* decide if you want diabetes in a cup.

Then came the best part — the bill arrived *with* the coffee, like a surprise plot twist. I hadn’t even taken a sip yet. And oddly enough, I was the only one asked to pay immediately. Must’ve looked like I was planning a dine & dash with my one cappuccino.

But wait, there's more: we were served a glass of *hot water*. Not tea. Just... hot water. Is this a spa? A detox challenge? A social experiment?

In short: overpriced coffee, zero vibe, and an unforgettable experience — for all the wrong reasons. Can’t wait to *not* come back. ☕️💸

ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.name: places/ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN5N3VMNXN3RRAB
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.author: Ben Herman
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.text: A great 24 hour cafe with pretty good coffee. The ground floor has some big tables and a lot of smaller ones. Service is friendly. There are a few more floors with some nap areas. A bit of space for motorbike parking but not a lot. Nice and quiet and a good place to get work done.

ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.name: places/ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPb2RHX1JnEAE
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.author: Minh Le
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.text: Great place for 24/24 learning with coffee. The place is nice! By the way, need more cleaning in the capsule box. There is trash and sand.

ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.name: places/ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQLVlXMDFnRRAB
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.author: Hiệp Huỳnh
ChIJqSzg2GsvdTERKc9ntT0ezcA.text: I'm from Americano and I very like this place, the service is great. Employee so cute. 5 stars

ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.name: places/ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pndGNDMURhVXcyVUd0eFdHOTVaV0ZvUzJOS1dFRRAB
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.author: Andy Nguyen
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.text: We discovered this café online, conveniently located near our home in District 1. The space is clean, spacious, and offers plenty of seating. It's a fantastic spot for families—kids absolutely love it here! There's a charming fishpond, and you can choose to buy fish food to feed them, though there's no pressure to do so. The beverages are reasonably priced, and the staff are polite and attentive, making the experience even more enjoyable. If you've never been to a coffee shop like this before, it's definitely worth a visit. | Con chúng tôi rất thích nơi này và đã có những tràng cười sảng khoái, thật xứng đáng để đến đây.

ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.name: places/ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21saVptcDVaRlozYmxoSk9FNWpPRE4zY0VWM1RWRRAB
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.author: Sa We
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.text: Chill and clean but the atmosphere isn't all that. They have a lot of fans though so it's cool. There aren't many food options and the quality is extremely lacking, my cheese fries came in orange cheese powder? Maybe just better for a chill drink in the evening rather than anything else.

ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.name: places/ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5d05IcFNjRE5TT1VWMU1uSXRORGx4YkRKYVFtYxAB
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.author: Irin
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.text:
The moment I walked in, I was amazed by how many koi fish they have — the ponds are full of colourful, lively fishes swimming around, making the whole place feel magical.
The greenery, the water features, and the relaxing seating create the perfect calm vibe. The coffee and drinks were really good too, and the staff were friendly and welcoming.
If you love nature, koi fish, and peaceful cafés, this place is a must-visit. I’d happily come back again!

ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.name: places/ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21GbWFHUklla0ZtT0VSc1pWSkhkVEk1VUdGS1JsRRAB
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.author: Jun Lee
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.text:
Good place to spend a few hours, especially whe it pours down with rain.

Food is ok.

Place was nice and cool.

Only downside is that smoking is allowedil inside. If youbare lucky you would have the fan behind you which blows the smoke away. But there's a high chance that the cigarette smoke will blow directly to your table.

ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.name: places/ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkTVp6VnFhRFZTTWtwcmRWazBXa2RSVWxKWVJtYxAB
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.author: Ces Cabungcal
ChIJcbb3gugvdTERGChXJxGpHYc.text:
- It was a hot day in Vietnam and we decided to try some refreshments in Koi Garden Cafe ~ I tried the strawberry milk shake while my friends tried other drinks - on top of it, fresh cold tea was served
- Aesthetics of the place felt like you’re inside an aquarium with lowered seatings surrounded by koi fishes - what we didn’t like was that we felt like the kois weren’t well taken care of since they tend to overcrowd whenever we distribute fish food then they end up creating powerful splashes 🥲
- Might try food next time we go back here but we think there are a lot of aesthetically pleasing cafes in Vietnam to explore
- Lots of people at the front - not sure if it’s for the lottery or other stuff

ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.name: places/ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKMVNrMXRRMHBQU0dweGRVTXRiVGxwV2pOalZYYxAB
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.author: helen nguyen
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.text:
We came twice because it was so good. They have two seating spaces.

Their egg coffee was SUPER thick like a dessert. But still pretty good. Regular matcha latte was super yummy (comes with honey comb). They grow and use their own matcha powder. Their chocolate drinks were strong in flavour and quality.

Note: It’s a decent walk up a few flight of stairs.

ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.name: places/ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25BeGFXbDFlR2MwYnpCSlFXZE5YMDU2UTFKTVdFRRAB
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.author: teh andrew
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.text: Came here with a friend because of a Google review.  Am glad I took his advise to come.  When we arrived, we were greeted by the waiter who directed us to the 2nd floor.  We were recommended the egg coffee and we ordered  a croissant (very flaky and tasty) to complement the drink.  The matcha honeycomb  is also very nice.

ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.name: places/ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KQmFHSnRkSHBoVGxGeU56QTVZemxVU0d4dmNXYxAB
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.author: Johnson Chao
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.text: Absolutely loved this egg coffee spot! The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in. They explained that egg coffee is more like a dessert because of its smooth, creamy foam — and they were right! The flavor was delicious, and the cozy atmosphere made the experience even better. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!

ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.name: places/ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poWVpXbDFla3BDTURGUWJFMUZRM0F0U0hkb1VFRRAB
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.author: Clifford De Jesus
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.text: Best egg coffee you can taste in Vietnam!! I really enjoyed their egg coffee, making it a place I wouldn’t hesitate to return to. The baguette we ordered was flavorful and well-presented. Staff were friendly and attentive. Definitely worth a visit!

ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.name: places/ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OSVJtUjRhVU4zV0hVM1IzYzRkSEJyYkVKeFZYYxAB
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.author: Yusuf’s Hotspots
ChIJzaevQMcvdTERYE3UhLKg5NE.text: Very good coffee — really tasty and smooth! I also had a baguette (or maybe more like a soft sandwich) with chicken and cheese, and it was super good too. Highly recommend this place to everyone. It’s located on the second floor — you need to go up the middle staircase — and there’s a nice little balcony upstairs where you can sit and relax. Very cozy and friendly atmosphere. Everything was fresh and delicious!

ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.name: places/ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPak1XMWtRRRAB
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.author: Uyên Phạm
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.text:
A nice small coffee shop with good drinks and reasonable price. A peaceful atmosphere and good music made me want to come back again

Updated: a year later, I come back again. They are decorating for christmas, the shop is still nice although some places need to be renovated

ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.name: places/ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNNejh1M193RRAB
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.author: Tram Santana
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.text: Nice place for alone time or hangout with couple of friends. I ordered Cashew milk and it was really good. I like the way how they set-up the drink too. Small, cozy and cute

ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.name: places/ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNLeV9xRXhBRRAB
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.author: Khanh Nguyen (Theodore)
ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.text:
This is a very nice coffee shope with a vintage decoration theme. It has the vibes like some coffee shops in Da Lat.

There are so many instagrammable spots in this shop, and you are allowed to take photos here even with a DSLR camera with no fee at all.

The drinks are very delicious and cakes are yummy too. Staffs are very nice.

I love this shops so much for its cosy atmosphere and a very warm interrior design color.

I recommend this place for a calm weekend for you to enjoy with friends!

ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA.name: places/ChIJ1XTg9WgvdTER9ysnoXmdTcA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURka3ZxbnVBRRAB

ChIJF_p60y0pdTERT3UcCEGm4PU.name: places/ChIJF_p60y0pdTERT3UcCEGm4PU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210SlRXSlRXbGhFZERGaVNpMDJMWFo0U0hVMmRWRRAB
ChIJF_p60y0pdTERT3UcCEGm4PU.author: John D
ChIJF_p60y0pdTERT3UcCEGm4PU.text:
#NOTE: This restaurant may BE or is related to CHAY TABAHA, which on Google Maps is possibly a restaurant down the street (that's Gmaps in VN). Their meal menu has Tabaha clearly written on the cover. Don't ask me.

Raw review dump.

Amazeballs ambience with multiple interwoven terraces.   Good presentation.

The menu is blatantly overpriced at roughly twice the going rate for the items (and that's *cafe* prices). But still reasonable. Check the menu pictures.

One of the younger guy staff who spoke some English was a bit clueless and (edit: very) annoying but whatever. Other ones were good.

Good hours. Open even earlier than stated hours which are already very early. I got dinner at the crack of dawn!

I asked for sour soup and a vegetable plate, and the cook unilaterally decided to add a dish to the meal which balanced it better (some greasy but quite appropriate fried noodles type dish). The cook is above average.

If you want a "what are Vietnamese restaurants about" experience this place will fill you up and fill you in.

You need to *explore* the place as it might not be immediately obvious what is actually extant within it. Go up the stairs out back.

They are good on condiments etc.

I suspect that the quality here may vary even though I had a good experience.

I was looking for vegetarian food in the area, stumbled in to this place and wound up eating better vegetarian food than I might have gotten at a chay restaurant.

ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U.text: A haven of caffeine and tranquility in Saigon. Excellent coffee, comfortable areas to work, nice outdoor areas for meeting people. Roasting on site. Very helpful and courteous staff - many who have been working here for years. A great place. Highly recommended!

ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U.name: places/ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VQMjFuLWFpb0ltS29nRRAB
ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U.author: Dewi astina
ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U.text:
Really enjoyed my time at this cafe! The atmosphere is really nice—it's cozy and has just the right vibe for either relaxing or getting some work done. I especially appreciated how quiet it was, which made it easy to focus without distractions. It's definitely a great spot if you need to catch up on emails or just want a peaceful break.

The staff were friendly and service was prompt, which always makes a big difference. My only small gripe is that the menu is a bit limited, so if you're looking for a wide variety of options you might be a little disappointed. Still, what they do offer is tasty and well-prepared. Overall, I'd definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a chill place to enjoy a coffee and get some work done!

ChIJjdN6NR0vdTERWxIp9PGNd0U.text:
I visited this shop for the first time recently with some colleagues, eager to try their Vietnamese milk coffee.

Unfortunately, I was a bit disappointed with the taste. As a fan of traditional Vietnamese coffee, I found that it didn't quite hit the mark for me. The flavor wasn't as rich or robust as I'd hoped, and it lacked that distinctive, strong character you get from coffee made with a phin. It felt like something was missing from the authentic experience.

ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g.name: places/ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25RNWFVcEZWR0ZzT0dsb1lYbGhZMUpvWkZsc09FRRAB
ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g.author: Joe and Mindy
ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g.text:
A Must-Visit for Coffee Enthusiasts in Saigon

If you're a coffee enthusiast, MPA-COFFEE is a must-visit. This hip little coffee shop specializes in pure Vietnamese coffee, grown and roasted right here in Vietnam. The owner takes pride in using absolutely no chemicals throughout the entire process, from the coffee tree to your cup.
Language barrier? No problem! While the owner doesn't speak English, Google Translate comes to the rescue and makes communication a breeze. (Although, there was a hilarious mistranslation when he asked if I wanted my beans ground... but that's a story for another time!)
I couldn't resist buying a bag of their robusta beans to go – 500 grams for 350,000 VND (about $14 USD). A bit pricey for Saigon standards, but worth every penny. The owner mentioned it's low in caffeine, around 3%.
Now, about the coffee brewing... I have no idea what that contraption was, but it looked like something out of a mad scientist's lab! The end result was pure magic though. I highly recommend trying the robusta coffee. Sharing a cup with the owner made the experience even more memorable.

ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g.name: places/ChIJDVp7biEvdTERZhq-Pk06m9g/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sck9VWndkWHBoU2pOclMwTlhRVTFpVERaQlJFRRAB

We couldn't be happier. Strongly recommended.

ChIJR27YADMvdTERG009GYnel58.author: Tran Tran
ChIJR27YADMvdTERG009GYnel58.text:
“Lagom” means “just right” in Swedish, one of the servers told me that, and it’s pretty much how this place felt to me. Cozy, warm lighting, a little European corner where Belgian beer actually gets a chance to shine instead of just…get you drunk.

The food was nice, though my hokubee beef in red wine sauce was a bit too done for my taste - would be better if they asked how I like my steak. Staff were friendly and helpful, and it’d be even cooler if they shared more little stories behind each beer.

Overall, a really solid spot to sit down, sip slowly, talk a little, learn a little. I wouldn’t mind coming back for another “just right” night here 😊

ChIJR27YADMvdTERG009GYnel58.text:
As Belgian tourists, we had to visit this place.

It's a nice pub in the centre of Ho Chi Minh City. The interior is really beautiful. You can see they put a lot of effort in it.

The staff is very friendly and welcoming.

The choice of beer is astonishing. And, when you order one, you get a card with information about it. Their vision to bring Belgium to Vietnam is working really well.  You see that by the way they pour out the beer in the glass.

Worth a visit if you are around. It's imported beer, so you pay them as such.

AND, as Belgian tourists you get a discount on the bill!! 😁🙌

ChIJLZSvHzcvdTER6KEjhbzJm_Y.text:

Space:

Drinks: 8/10
Atmosphere: 9/10

ChIJ7f1qRyIvdTERj-N05a4567Y.text:
Bloom 92 is a charming little coffee shop with simple yet incredibly clean and meticulously arranged decor. The space is cozy, offering around 20 seats both indoors and in the outdoor area, creating an intimate atmosphere.

The highlight here is the tastefully curated drink menu, especially the beverages made from whole coffee beans. The baristas are all highly professional, crafting each cup with skill to deliver rich and authentic coffee experiences.

Despite its modest size, Bloom 92 truly stands out for its quality and attention to detail. It's safe to say this is one of the best coffee shops in the area, definitely worth a visit to enjoy a perfect cup.

Highly recommend if you’re in the neighborhood.

Tóm tắt: phục vụ đuổi khách.
I've been to this place several times, as I used to live in block E.
Last night, I was sitting and working there when, at around 8:30 PM, a staff member "kindly" asked me to clear my table. I had my  earphones on with music playing, so it took me a moment to realize she was trying to get me to leave. She explained that because there were no other customers, the shop needed to close early (?!). I was surprised but agreed. She then took my glasses for recycling, and I left around 8:35 PM.
The closing time is 10:00 PM, isn't it, owner? Perhaps you should take a look at how other nearby coffee shops operate.
TL;DR: Bad service. I will never go back.

ChIJcUtJy3wvdTERQIZ4d5vBYS8.text:
This café feels like a true hidden gem. It is a little tucked away, but once you find it the atmosphere is warm, relaxing and very inviting. The space has a calm and cozy vibe that makes it easy to settle in and enjoy the experience.

The food was great and the coffee was especially impressive. Everything tasted fresh and well prepared, and the quality of the coffee really stood out. It is the kind of place where you can sit for a while, sip your drink and just enjoy the peaceful environment.

The staff were incredibly polite and genuinely helpful. They even took the time to teach us some proper Vietnamese pronunciation, which made the visit feel even more personal and memorable. Overall, this place is definitely worth seeking out if you want great coffee, good food and a relaxing atmosphere. I would happily come back again.

ChIJcUtJy3wvdTERQIZ4d5vBYS8.author: Yunbal Joo
ChIJcUtJy3wvdTERQIZ4d5vBYS8.text:
⭐️ Found an amazing matcha spot in District 1, HCMC - CHEHO TEA!
​I was wandering around District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City and was totally drawn in by the beautiful exterior of this cafe. It must be new because it's super clean and the interior feels really high-end. (The staff's uniforms and hats are cute too haha)
​They have a huge menu, so it was hard to decide, but I ordered the 'Matcha Red Bean Cream Cheese Smoothie (Đá Xay Matcha Đậu Đỏ Kem Cheese)' and my friend got the 'Mango Coconut Smoothie (Xoài Xay Sữa Dừa)'.
​Wow... their matcha is the real deal. 🍵 It's not just astringent, it has a deep, rich, bittersweet flavor! The cream cheese foam on top is the perfect salty-sweet balance, and the combination with the red bean is just insane. (Price 79,000 VND)
​I stole a sip of my friend's mango smoothie, and it didn't taste like artificial syrup at all—just a refreshing, rich flavor like real, fresh-blended mango. (Price 75,000 VND)
​I saw on the kiosk that they'll "remake it if you're not satisfied," but honestly, with this level of quality, I doubt that ever happens.
​If you're looking for a place with high-quality smoothies or milk tea in District 1, I absolutely, 100% recommend CHEHO TEA!!

ChIJcUtJy3wvdTERQIZ4d5vBYS8.text: A fantastic coffee shop snugly tucked away on an upper floor of an otherwise unassuming building facefront towards the everbustling roar of Le Loi's streets in the busy heart of Ho Chi Minh City. I find quiet mornings here, with pour-over coffee from Okkio's vibrant selection of beans, to be a rocksolid way to start any day. The space itself accentuates this feeling, what with its rustic, quaint aesthetics, housing seats cosily yet aplenty, whilst a playlist of classics constantly accompanies one's time here. The staff are easygoing yet without losing a professional touch, whom are an easy chat and perfectly amiable. Exactly what I'd want from a coffee spot of its size and nature, hence the deserved fives on all fronts. Chanced upon the opportunity, I'd stop by any day. And given that opportunity—a memento (...mori) to remind myself—treat yourself to a straight cup of Wush Wush if and when it's on the menu, because my goodness is that some good coffee.

Egg in Hell

📍 Tiệm cà phê Mơ

- It might require some searching since it's inside a small alley in District 3,make sure to check their instagram/Facebook for instructions on how to get there. Sitting there, it genuinely reminds me of being in the countryside rather than a few minutes away from busy main roads

I ended up staying much longer than planned since I actually had a 3rd cafe planned right after this one. The space was full of people quietly working on laptops and chatting in low voices, and the staff were kind and attentive without being pushy. The staff was also kind to show me the parking area on the main street which is a bit far away.

The café has outdoor smoking areas, and when someone smokes toward the back, the fans can push smoke inside, which is noticeable if you are sensitive. Still, if you are looking for a quiet, cozy spot, definitely consider visting.

ChIJe5D-YNIodTERnaQwd7n9EfY.text:
Chiêu Cafe Sách is a hidden gem where coffee and literature collide in the most delightful way. From the moment you step in, you're greeted by warm lighting, vintage decor, and shelves bursting with books that invite you to sit down and get lost in a story. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee dances through the air, perfectly complementing the nostalgic scent of old pages—it's a sensory experience that truly awakens the soul.

The coffee here is nothing short of spectacular—bold, smooth, and crafted with passion. The friendly staff adds to the charm, making you feel like a regular even on your first visit. Whether you're a coffee aficionado or a book lover, Chiêu Cafe Sách offers the perfect sanctuary to relax, recharge, and indulge in a little escapism.

If you’re in Ho Chi Minh City, do yourself a favor and make a stop at Chiêu Cafe Sách. It's the ideal spot to unwind and let every sip and page turn inspire you.

ChIJscnnnpUtdTERLdmdJzvkf5M.text:
Hammock Cafe - A Warm Shelter for the Homeless

Open 24/7
Affordable Price
Safe and Friendly Environment
Enthusiastic and Attentive Staff

As someone who often passes through deserted neighborhoods at night, I always feel sorry when I see homeless people sleeping on the sidewalk, under the bridge. And then, I accidentally found out about the hammock cafe - a warm shelter for the unfortunate.

The hammock cafe is a simple but extremely warm space. The hammocks are strung close together, creating a special "collective house". Although this place does not have full amenities like a house, it gives the homeless a safe and clean place to sleep.

What impressed me most here is the enthusiasm and thoughtfulness of the cafe staff. They always have smiles on their faces, ready to help the homeless with all their sincerity.

The hammock cafe is not only a place to sleep, but also a place for homeless people to share and feel the love of people.

For those who are looking for a safe shelter for the homeless, I would like to sincerely introduce the An Tam hammock cafe. This is a great place to help the unfortunate people have a good and warm sleep.

Here are some advantages of the cafe:

Open 24/24: The hammock cafe is always ready to welcome the homeless at any time of the day.

Affordable price: The cost of staying overnight at the hammock cafe is very cheap, only from 20,000 VND.

Safe and friendly environment: The hammock cafe is equipped with a 24/24 surveillance camera system, ensuring security for those sleeping here.

Enthusiastic and attentive staff: The staff is always ready to help the homeless with all sincerity.

If you want to help the homeless, come to An Tam hammock cafe. This place will give them a good and warm sleep, and help them feel the love of people.
Thank you hammock cafe for creating a loving home for the homeless!

ChIJSYFRRWwrdTEREpIYNvRorWE.text:
Pretty Place, Just Okay Food – Hin Cafe, Ho Chi Minh

Hin Cafe definitely nails the aesthetic… the concept is beautiful, cozy, and Instagram-worthy. It’s the kind of place where you’d want to sit for hours just soaking in the vibe.

But when it comes to food and drinks, it’s honestly just okay. Nothing bad, but also nothing particularly memorable. With such a stunning ambiance, it feels like there’s so much potential to serve food and drinks that match the look and feel of the space.

It’s a nice place to chill, take photos, or catch up with friends, but if you’re coming for a culinary experience, you might walk away wishing for a little more.

ChIJc1YKSagtdTER6AXU1b2PXrw.text:
If I was ever find myself in the Tân Phú area, I will definitely make a stop to this cafe again. This is the first indoor cafe that I’ve seen in Việt Nam that features an integrated green space. There is a giant tree anchoring the center space of the building and various plants spread across the shop. You can tell the staff tends to the plant tenderly.

PROs:
-A great space for both chilling and those who love to check-in to take pictures. They have a plethora of seating options and multiple corners to take pictures with, so I would recco coming back here several times to enjoy the space and get those right angles.
-The drinks taste great and very affordable for the price.
-The staff provided great service and did a great job introducing their current specials for folks to sample.

CONs:
-If you live in the more central districts, this is far but I think it’s definitely worth the visit.

I would recommend this place to anyone visiting or looking for a new place to relax in. I will be coming back again (and again) at the next available opportunity.

Staff is friendly. Attentive.

ChIJY5LiLgAldTERnL7xhohlJqQ.text:
I chose the 89k combo and got 1 free drink, 1 dimsum dish and 2 hours of box usage. Here is my review:
- Plus points: this restaurant has a beautiful space and delicious drinks, I like the shop's melon tea. The box is comfortable, has a teddy bear, clean table and bookshelf. The staff is cute and good at customer service, the first time I came to the restaurant and experienced this, I found it ok 👌
- Minus points: in the 89k combo, I got 1 free drink and 1 dimsum dish, I chose 1 cup of melon tea and salted egg bun. The minus points also started from here: when I finished paying, the staff didn't give me the bill but took me straight to the box, in the box there was only a mattress, pillow and teddy bear, no blanket, and the air conditioner was set low so I felt cold after lying down for about 1 hour. Next is the water and food: I waited 1 hour for water and buns, I ordered salted egg yolk buns but the staff gave me mushroom buns and especially even though the buns were steamed, they weren't steamed well enough so the filling was still cold. Luckily, the melon tea saved me, I saw that the shop only had 1 employee and was busy showing other guests the room so I forgot to order. I'm okay with it because I'm not difficult, but with the first experience of this being good, this being bad, that being bad like here, I can only give it 7/10. 
-> In general, if you guys come to this shop, it's better to sit outside and drink coffee, but I don't recommend you guys to experience the box here

ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.text:
Nice view. Nice place. OK DJ. I had bottled beer so I'm not gonna rate their drinks.

The staff was friendly during my visit. But not very fast. We waited a long time for our hookah (shisha). While we were waiting for our hookah the staff brought one to a table next to us, the staff sat there and started smoking it themselves. 😂 The manager was nice and gave us some free drinks as a compensation for our long wait. But, when paying, we noticed we were charged extra for a "special hookah", not the one we saw on the menu. The hookah was neither special nor particularly good. 🤷🏼‍♂️

ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.name: places/ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPcHFuU1VnEAE
ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.author: Amia Le
ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.text: I came here with my friends and the place was pretty. We get seated and the server gave us the menus. We look at the menu and it’s 90,000 for a beer. Expensive but we were fine with it. We go to order it and the server was like “oh that’s the old menu”. It will actually be 119,000 based on the new menu. A new menu that he is showing us on his phone. Why would you give us a menu and then base the price off of a different menu that you pulled out of nowhere. We didn’t wanna cause a scene so we still ordered the beers. When the bill comes out, there were two different prices for the beers we ordered. We were not aware of a combo deal that they had for 5 beers. So my friends got charged 85,000 more because they didn’t do a combo deal even though they ordered 5 beers and we also ordered 5 beers but it was a in box. The serve we had was rude and had an attitude the whole time.

ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.name: places/ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPNXFTTHVBRRAB

ChIJidEBruMvdTERr61IuZpjuJU.text: I came here the other night with my friends. The server we had, tall guy, was rude. They overcharged us like crazy. Gave us a physical menu and then when we were ready to order. Our server brought out another menu from his phone saying this is the new menu. The beer was 90,000 on the new menu BUT on the “new menu” it was $119,000. Like ????? Even though we knew we were getting ripped off, we still ordered and wanted a fun night. Bill comes out. We got charged two different prices for beers. One set of 5 beers was marked up 80,000 because we didn’t order it as a “combo”. That we were not aware of. Will never come back or recommend to anyone.

ChIJKx6p-K8vdTERzPf5PBD4TxY.author: Gav
ChIJKx6p-K8vdTERzPf5PBD4TxY.text: This view from the top is really nice at night. Our group enjoyed being here for the view and for the fact we were away from all the noise you’d hear every second on the street level. The drinks were already on a premade menu, which for someone like me wasn’t a big fan of but found a drink that I liked. The prices here are really affordable compared to district one. Every time you order a drink the waiter will come by to confirm that’s the drink you want, they literally do it for every order through the website. Personally it’s better to put everyone’s order in the least amount of times as we did feel bad after realizing they literally confirm every order put in. The bill at the end can be split but do keep track of your drinks so that it makes life easier for the staff. This place does close a little earlier than we’d like 12:30pm but well worth it.

ChIJKx6p-K8vdTERzPf5PBD4TxY.author: Navis Trần
ChIJKx6p-K8vdTERzPf5PBD4TxY.text:
A cozy hideaway above the city buzz
Nestled high above the streets, this cocktail rooftop bar offers more than just a drink — it’s a serene escape. With warm ambient lighting, soft music in the background, and just the right breeze brushing past, it’s the kind of place where time slows down.

Lush greenery surrounds the seating area — climbing ivy, potted palms, and little herb gardens tucked into corners — making the whole space feel like a hidden garden in the sky.

Whether you’re sipping a signature cocktail under a canopy of stars or catching up with friends over shared laughter, there’s a natural charm here that gently pulls you away from the chaos of the world below.

A perfect pocket of peace in this gigantic world. Anyway, in another word, enjoy the vibes ~

ChIJ-xtMTT8vdTERsirbHQJbRNk.author: Gilbert Orosco (Erowid Spark)
ChIJ-xtMTT8vdTERsirbHQJbRNk.text:
Saw this place busy all day long, as I walked by it several times when departing/arriving at my Accommodation just half a block away.
Sat down inside one morning for a cup of coffee and very much enjoyed the delicious coffee and energetic vibe of the place.  American Jazz music was played on a Marshall AM/FM Radio which sounded amazing!
As the windows were all open, smoking is allowed inside the shop, which I found strangely comforting and nostalgic!  I only saw one man having a smoke inside, but it brought me right back to the 70’s!  Love it!  He looked so in the moment!  Try this place out… great place to people watch, especially in the morning when the windows are open and the sounds of District 1 envelope the senses!

ChIJEdLERHMvdTERXDgbLXBucGw.author: Aurore Barrut
ChIJEdLERHMvdTERXDgbLXBucGw.text:
Very relaxing place to sip a coffee or juice. The scenery is very pleasant if you can get past the littering (that is everywhere in HCMC, unfortunately). The boat itself has at least 3 levels and due to its age, can be considered a bit dirty. I don't mind and apart from that, they make sure to clean the floors regularly.

I went during the late afternoon, which was perfect, and got to see a couple of boats pass by. The entrance is a narrow opening between two chain fences. The very kind guard showed me the place because I really thought it was closed that day.

I'll be sure to come again the next time I visit HCMC.

ChIJvele0CAvdTER6wsJuWGus5I.author: nina vo
ChIJvele0CAvdTER6wsJuWGus5I.text:
I accidentally stumbled upon this little gem of a coffee shop about 2 years ago, hidden amongst the countless chilled and fancy spots in the area.

While there are tons of coffee places around, let’s be honest, only a handful really check all the boxes: green vibes, spacious seating, a quiet atmosphere, plenty of plugs for our gadgets, delicious coffee, and (the holy grail) a clean restroom! This place nails almost all of it.

The one thing I’ve been asking the owner and staff for ages was a non-dairy milk option for lactose-intolerant folks like us (shoutout to my staff, my aunty, and myself). It’s been my only reason for exploring other spots in District 8 and 3 instead of sticking around here.

But today? OH. MY. GOSH. They have oat milk!! 🎉 I’m so excited I could cry. This little change has made a huge difference, and now they’ve won me over completely. You’ll find me here every weekday from now on: working, sipping, and living my best coffee life.

Thanks for listening Orenchi and making it happen. Kissy kiss! 😘

ChIJQ2I3VAwvdTEROqhE7EuBvjY.text:
A cozy café, though not without flaws. Fresh pastries are ready at 8:00 AM, so don’t come earlier. By 9:00 AM the café is already full, so the best time to visit is just after 8:00.

Food & Drinks Tried (2 people):
•	Hot Dog (yesterday’s) – 2/5: Stale, not worth it.
•	Cheese Garlic Bread (fresh) – 3/5: Good idea, but too slimy.
•	Cheesy Mushroom Danish (yesterday’s) – 3/5: Average.
•	Salted Cream Coffee – 3/5: Basic but good Vietnamese coffee.
•	Iced White Coffee – 3/5: Same as above, reliable but standard.
•	Berry Cream Cheese Danish (yesterday’s) – 4/5: Safe, though a bit boring.
•	Coffee Milk Bun (fresh) – 2/5: Interesting idea, but tastes like an old-school vegan pastry.
•	Almond Croissant (fresh) – 4/5: Good, but the butter has a strange taste.

ChIJPdoyxwAvdTER-7tGszCGGO8.text:
One experience you HAVE to try in Việt Nam is the existence of coffee in bed. You have Chidori, a leading chain of with many locations offering this experience within Sài Gòn. You can choose to experience the common booth space, a semi-private level seat space, or book a private “bedroom” with pillows and blankets to relax in (they have cameras so it’s not dirty folks).

PROs:
-They have a variety of packages (2 hours, 3 hours, 5 hours, etc.) for space rental and come with drinks for those allotted time. It’s definitely worth it to get a private space to chill with your friends (or by yourself) without the prying eyes of strangers.
-The staff offers great service and will remind you when the time is up. So even if you fall asleep they’ll wake you up before your time is up. There is also a service button at each space so you can call them for help.

CONs:
-The drink are pricey for what it is if you’re just using the common space
-Some of the beds are not ventilated properly, so if you close the curtains, it can get pretty hot.

Overall, definitely one of my favorite place to go to get some studying done outside the house when I want privacy. I can study and lay down to take a nap if I want. I would recommend the level seat option for those who are going by yourself.

ChIJTz2gomAvdTER0BBOsx432Hs.text: A happy accident! Stumbled upon this xhs-famous spot and loved it. Great ambience, good coffee, and the upstairs has a totally different vibe. Highly recommend checking it out!
