ChIJTz2gomAvdTER0BBOsx432Hs.author: Krystyna Palafox
ChIJTz2gomAvdTER0BBOsx432Hs.text:
Linh Coffee has a cozy charm with its rustic, woody vintage interiors, feels like my lola’s home back in the PH 🏠🇵🇭 They were playing 70/80s American music in the background, which added to the nostalgic vibe. The staff were friendly and could speak English, which made ordering easier.

We tried the salted iced coffee and milk coffee (Vietnamese coffee mixed with condensed milk, which doesn’t come in the usual drip tin), both pretty good and cost 109,000VND (240PHP).

Lots of comfy seating both upstairs and outdoors too

ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.name: places/ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21rMmRISlpRemxmT1hjeU9XZDVha0pHVlRFM1IwRRAB
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.author: Joey Esguerra
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.text:
Another café that me and my fiancé really enjoyed, and one I’d highly recommend when visiting HCM. Their famous egg coffee honestly tastes like crème brûlée  rich, creamy, and comforting. If you’re trying egg coffee for the first time, this is the place to do it. Portions are generous too, so if you’re like me, the Eggs Ben can totally be shared by two people!

What we ordered:
1.	Egg Coffee — order it hot! It tastes so much better that way, like a warm hug in a cup. If you’re not a coffee person, try their Peach Iced Tea, it’s super refreshing.
2.	Pork Spring Rolls — if you’re Filipino, this will remind you of kikiam. Dip it in the spicy sauce for the perfect combo.
3.	Avocado Toast — when you’re in the mood for something healthy, this one hits the spot. You can really taste the fresh avocado. PS: ask for crispy bacon if you want that extra crunch.
4.	Eggs Benedict — don’t miss this one! It deserves a spot on your list, totally worth it.

Definitely one of those cafés that feels like home. Cozy vibe, good food, and just the right kind of comfort you’d want while exploring Saigon.

ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.name: places/ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCNmJqZE9TRFl5T1Y5WFpqVTNTbVkwZWxoUFdsRRAB
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.author: Judas.K
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.text:
Little Hanoi Egg Coffee is one of those hidden gems you stumble into and immediately feel kinda smug about discovering. Tucked inside a small alley, the place has this cozy, unpretentious vibe that just hits perfectly — like the kind of spot you’d bring a friend to and pretend you’re a local who “totally knows all the secret places.”

We tried both the hot and iced egg coffee, because obviously you can’t come here and not do a mini taste test. Surprisingly, the iced egg coffee won by a mile for us. The hot version is great if you love that rich, creamy traditional vibe, but the iced one somehow balances the sweetness and texture better. It’s lighter, smoother, and honestly just way more refreshing, especially with the warm weather.

One of the sweetest parts about this café is the little complimentary souvenirs they offer — tiny pouches, postcards, and other cute bits. You’re welcome to take one home, and all they ask is a donation of any amount that goes toward charity. It’s wholesome, it’s thoughtful, and it gives the place a really warm energy that you don’t always get in touristy cafés.

Overall, it’s a lovely stop if you want authentic egg coffee without the chaos of the bigger, more crowded spots. Chill atmosphere, friendly vibes, and the iced egg coffee is 100% worth coming back for.

ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.name: places/ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214M1NrSmtaVk41VkRVM1RuaEVVR2x1ZEMxUU5VRRAB
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.author: Farah Tugad
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.text:
I visited Little Hanoi at night, so the place wasn’t too crowded, which made the atmosphere feel extra cozy and relaxing. Since Christmas is coming, they’ve already decorated the café with warm lights and festive ornaments, giving it a soft, holiday vibe that’s perfect for photos and unwinding.

The prices are average, but the food and service really stand out. The staff were polite and attentive, and everything I ordered tasted fresh and well-prepared.

Overall, it was a nice experience. A calm, aesthetic, and enjoyable. Definitely a must-try spot if you’re looking for a peaceful evening café with good food and a Christmas feel.

ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.name: places/ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sQ1VYaFNOV3B2Ym1aSE9XRnVXRkV0WTFGTk1rRRAB
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.author: Ben
ChIJqZ7MThYvdTERh6VZ5ryLuDk.text:
A cute and homey cafe with plenty of seating on their 3 floors. Coffee is pretty cheap and there's usually plenty of seating to hang out or work.

Egg coffee: Great
It's in the name of the cafe so definitely try one here if you haven't already. It's also super cheap at 45k. Just a sweet, super creamy and dense coffee balanced by the strong vietnamese coffee

Bun thit nuong: Not good
I skipped lunch and thought I should just get some food here while i work. The meat is kind of dry and for 100k it's not really worth it either. Recommend almost any other local place if you're in the mood for viet food.

They have other food too and it looks good but I don't really care about American brunch when I'm traveling in Vietnam. Otherwise, yeah feel free to get some basic avo toast for 200k lol

Space:
It's a decent space that's simply decorated. Plenty of tables and the wifi is okay. Outlets are everywhere too. They give you tea and are usually pretty good with refills so that's nice :) It's a sit down place where you order after you sit so that makes it seem a little bit more proper than a cafe.

Drinks: 8/10
Space: 7/10
Service: 8/10
Price:8/10

Coffee was good with the right amount of coffee to milk ration in my latte. Although don’t know why both our lattes came in different cups.

Absolutely loved it…!!! Greatly recommend this place to anyone who wants to try the famous coconut coffee in Ho Chi Minn city….

ChIJN6S2MbcvdTERJnUj4sVsqAQ.text:
📍 ʜᴀʀᴜ ᴄᴀꜰᴇ

-Tucked in a large apartment(?) building similar to the one at Nguyen Hue. Haru isn’t flashy but it’s full of charm. Warm lighting, wooden tables, handmade ceramics, soft R&B playing in the background, and the true star: a chonky orange cat lounging around like he owns the place (and honestly, he kinda does 🐈). The space gives major comfort vibes—ideal for working, catching up with friends, or a solo chill session.

I tried their apple cinnamon tea (so fragrant and perfectly balanced) and a cheesecake to share (but too sweet for my personal preference). Everything here feels intentional, curated, and super chill. Staff are sweet, the prices are fair (~80k VND for a drink + toast combo), and you’ll definitely want to come back.

ChIJN6S2MbcvdTERJnUj4sVsqAQ.text: Love the food and atmosphere in this cute cafe. Would come back again for sure! Plus points for the cutie cats.

ChIJQQ1lAsQvdTER4Ek8KG3kvsk.author: Joe and Mindy
ChIJQQ1lAsQvdTER4Ek8KG3kvsk.text:
Authentic Vietnamese Coffee Off the Beaten Path

We were initially drawn to the Cafe Apartments in search of authentic Vietnamese coffee, but quickly realized it was a bit too touristy for our liking. After some searching, we stumbled upon Ghé Coffee, tucked away in an alley and up a few flights of narrow stairs. The journey was worth it!
The knowledgeable barista patiently explained the traditional Vietnamese coffee brewing process using a "phin" filter. Their exclusive use of robusta beans, known for their bitterness, surprised us with a smooth and delicious flavor. Blended with authentic Vietnamese condensed milk.

We couldn't leave without purchasing some beans to bring back home. If you're seeking a genuine Vietnamese coffee experience away from the crowds, Ghé Coffee is a hidden gem waiting to be discovered.

So excited I found this hidden gem in my quest for great coffee and unique experiences in Saigon.

Do yourself a favour and go find this place. Hidden down  cute alley, it didn’t disappoint.

I bought the beans and cannot wait to make it when back home.

And, as for the croissant, worth the 15 minute wait for the freshness and flavours. So buttery and delicious!

Situated on the 2nd floor down a short alley way.  Came here as it's near my hotel. Very happy with the creamy egg coffee. The Vietnamese condensed milk coffee was spot on too.

Very nice quiet atmosphere on a Saturday morning.

This café is a hidden gem in Saigon.
It can be a bit hard to find, even with Google Maps, but once you get there, you’ll definitely love it.
I really enjoyed the cozy vibe, friendly staff, and amazing coffee, especially the cold brew with lemon and rosemary. I’d love to visit again on my next trip🥰

ChIJQQ1lAsQvdTER4Ek8KG3kvsk.text: Lovely little speciality coffee place. It's down a little alleyway. A little hard to spot. That's why it's worth it. I got my usual, oat cappuccino hot. ChIJz38r99UvdTERoh8d6N7-qZM.author: Taro
ChIJz38r99UvdTERoh8d6N7-qZM.text:
This is the worst cafe I've ever visited. Instant regret. I don't know where to start. The drinks were way too sweet ( even for local Southern Vietnamese who drank with us ). The staff is very lazy and they made the egg coffee really really bad. Please look at the picture since the "egg foam" looks nothing like it should.

Another very strange thing ( this can only happen in Vietnam ), was the sign by the register. It's only in Vietnamese but it basically says that if you don't take a receipt, you'll get free water....like what????

The staff didn't even issue me a receipt and then when I asked for my free water ( they do not provide ANY water for any customer ), the staff said they printed it but forgot to give it to me. So in their logic I'm not entitled to water. I don't know about you guys but this is complete madness.

Please save yourself time and money and do not come here.

ChIJz38r99UvdTERoh8d6N7-qZM.text:
A good place to chill late night and spend time with friends and family.  It's cozy and friendly with nature. A lot of planting inside and outside building. If you want to feel nature, outside terrace is also a great choice that I recommend. Try their best seller and recommendation, you won't be disappointed 😉
I was surprised that they don't check temperature and ask to show Vax certificates. However it was crowded. All staffs were so nice. They let us know our order may take time due to the busy making order. We feel satisfied to wait for the order and enjoy our moment.

ChIJz38r99UvdTERoh8d6N7-qZM.text:
I stopped by this café for a coffee and had a pleasant experience. The staff were friendly and communicated in passable English, so I didn’t need to rely on translation apps, which was a nice bonus. The seating arrangement made it suitable for impromptu business meet ups as I saw several people discussing whilst typing on their laptops.

While the coffee was great, the décor and setup could benefit from some updates to create a more comfortable and soothing atmosphere. A few changes could enhance the overall ambiance and make it an even more inviting place to relax.

I also tried the tiramisu, which was delightful and worth a taste.

A handy note: there are restroom facilities available in the same building as the café. Overall, it's a cozy spot that has potential!

ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.text:
Lovely café with great potential! They have a wonderful selection of drinks, and the setting by the water is absolutely charming. It’s the perfect spot to work in peace calm atmosphere, not too much music. The staff are very attentive and friendly. I fell in love with their salted coffee and the salted caramel latte both are a must-try!

If I could make one small suggestion, the place could use a little refresh to make it truly perfect.

ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.name: places/ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kMkxVRm1OV2RNT0VFd2FXaHJWVVpqU1hwaFZGRRAB
ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.author: Silva Tran
ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.text: I arrived at around 7pm and had an espresso right at the bar. Sensational! Wouldn't expect it to be this delicious. Always have a tender spot for coffee shops that still serves good espresso after dusk. The barista Gia Han told me that what I had is their signature blend of Big Smoke and BSWB - both Vietnamese bean with distinctive characteristics thus perfectly combine for a complex, delicate cup. And she made real what she said, delivered such essence of what a true espresso should be. Were it not too late would I go on for the second, third, or maybe fourth espresso... Gonna come back again, surely.

ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.name: places/ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oMmRFaEVXVU5FVlRVeVR6bG9SRGRRTWt0UVRVRRAB

ChIJFbNbZhkpdTEREnQAU62EGgY.text:
Le coffee shop magnifique!
It's actually hard to find a good Americano these days. Coffee shops are growing more and more into the absurdity of colorful non-sense drinks they almost forget how to extract the substantial of precious beans given to us by Nature. How rare now is a café really pulling an espresso with love and respect! But how lucky am I to find one! The feminine barista, Han, gave me an Americano that I would never forget. Even diluted with ice and water it's still so flavorful and subtly sweet! I like the space and ambience here as well. Minimalized to the point that's perfect to take a mindful dive into the coffee. Parfaitement!

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.name: places/ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLZWF3N19EeFBIZEVnEAE
ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.author: Hà Trang Minh (Bryan Trang)
ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.text:
Ollin Cafe at 220 Tran Nao, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City, is a delightful spot that effortlessly blends modern simplicity with refined elegance.

The spacious venue offers both indoor and outdoor seating, catering to different preferences. The outdoor area is perfect for soaking in the ambiance, while the indoor space is cozy and equipped with power outlets, making it an ideal spot for working or relaxing.

The cafe’s decor strikes a balance between contemporary and sophisticated, creating a welcoming atmosphere. Their menu features a variety of light bites, including sweet and savory pastries, as well as freshly baked goods, all of which pair wonderfully with their delicious drinks. The beverages are a highlight, crafted with care and bursting with flavor.

What truly stood out during my visit was the exceptional service. It was raining when I arrived, and the security staff kindly lent me an umbrella to walk from the street to the cafe, ensuring I stayed dry. This thoughtful gesture left a lasting impression and showcased their commitment to customer care.

Overall, Ollin Cafe is a gem worth visiting. Whether you’re looking to work, unwind, or simply enjoy quality food and drinks in a beautiful setting, this place delivers.

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.name: places/ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xONlFWRjBOWEJyWkVkamJFbElSRFJtTUc4eVFuYxAB

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.text:
Ollin Trần Não = Bali vibes + caffeine magic! 🌴☕
Gorgeous garden, super chill seats, and drinks that taste like a tropical vacation in a glass. Came for coffee, stayed for hours… and seriously considered forwarding my mail here. 📬✨

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.name: places/ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sM00wMDJhbGRKUzFCT1dtcDZVMTlzUlVSbWJWRRAB

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.text: Ollin Cafe is a perfect spot with spacious indoor air conditioned seating and a breezy outdoor garden. Relaxing under the shade of trees feels refreshing and cozy, making it ideal for both casual talks and focused work.

ChIJVfCQow4ndTERlcGUN5HBPUQ.text: Ollin Cafe is a hidden gem that offers a cozy and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for a casual hangout or a quiet work session. The menu features a great selection of coffee, tea, and light snacks, all made with quality ingredients. Their signature drinks are creative and delicious, appealing to both coffee lovers and those looking for something different. The staff is friendly and provides excellent service, making you feel right at home. Prices are reasonable, considering the quality and ambiance. Overall, Ollin Cafe is a great spot to unwind and enjoy a good cup of coffee.

ChIJ3_io66MvdTERjrt36-K0phg.text:
This is one of the few hidden gems in Q3. If you're looking for a place to chill with a view, great drinks, and that can accommodate a big group, I would highly recommend this place. The drinks are affordable, and they taste good.

It's a hard location to find, and the way up is mildly confusing, but the view and atmosphere is worth the trip. You can either sit in their decorated space or choose one of the many rooftop locations to chill. It's a great spot to take pictures with your friends or by yourself.

P.S. I advise going earlier in the day to avoid the crowd as this is a popular location for folks to come take pictures. So if you don't like the crowds moving around, I would avoid the evening and night time.

ChIJ3_io66MvdTERjrt36-K0phg.name: places/ChIJ3_io66MvdTERjrt36-K0phg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3MGZxY1FREAE
ChIJ3_io66MvdTERjrt36-K0phg.author: 陳奕澄（Eason Chen）
ChIJ3_io66MvdTERjrt36-K0phg.text:
Trên Tầng Thượng is a hidden gem located in a small alley near the train station in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Although tucked away, once you climb the stairs, you’ll discover a spacious and beautifully designed restaurant with a romantic and relaxed atmosphere.
It’s a popular spot for young Vietnamese, especially in the evenings.

My visit was particularly special as I was there to help a Vietnamese friend propose to his girlfriend. The staff at Trên Tầng Thượng were incredibly kind and helpful, assisting us with decorations and preparations, which made the surprise proposal go smoothly. Their friendliness and willingness to accommodate our needs really stood out.

We also ordered several dishes for dinner, and I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food. While the café is known for its coffee, the food is equally impressive. The grilled meat skewers, in particular, were so delicious that they left us speechless.

In terms of pricing：
The drinks here are reasonably priced around VND 100,000.
The food is slightly more expensive, with most dishes ranging from VND 200,000 to 300,000.
And this time, we opted for a set menu, which included six courses for about VND 1,000,000. However, if you have a group of men with big appetites, the portion size might be a bit on the smaller side.

Apart from that, the most impressive part is that there is even a singer who was singing almost all the night. This made the whole atmosphere become more relaxed.😎

Overall, Trên Tầng Thượng is a fantastic place to enjoy a relaxed evening in Ho Chi Minh City. Whether you’re looking for a romantic spot, a place to celebrate a special occasion, or just a café with great food, this is definitely a place worth visiting.

Really good cafe sua da here

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Saveur, a charming café nestled in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. From the moment I stepped inside, I knew I was in for a treat. The warm and inviting ambiance, coupled with the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, instantly captured my attention and set the stage for a memorable experience.

The staff at Saveur deserves special mention for their exceptional hospitality. They greeted me with genuine smiles and were eager to assist with any inquiries I had.

Now, let's talk about the star of the show—the coffee itself. Saveur boasts an impressive selection of high-quality beans sourced from various regions, allowing coffee enthusiasts to embark on a journey of flavors. I opted for their signature blend, and I must say it exceeded all expectations. Each sip was a symphony of rich, robust flavors, with notes of chocolate and caramel dancing on my palate. The coffee was expertly brewed, achieving the perfect balance of strength and smoothness. It was evident that the baristas at Saveur take great pride in their craft.

Saveur provides a cozy and comfortable environment, making it an ideal spot for both relaxation and productivity. The tastefully decorated interior, combined with soft background music, creates a serene atmosphere perfect for savoring your coffee or engaging in meaningful conversations with friends.

ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.name: places/ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCWldUUlNWblpuYkhkdVdtbDBRak5RWTFRd2RGRRAB
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.author: Bem Xe Lem
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.text:
Stepping into Cà phê Cơm Tấm ĐỖ – Phủ felt like opening a door back to the 80s and 90s, when life moved slower, radios hummed in the background, and the scent of home-cooked meals drifted through wooden windows.

The space is a living postcard — weathered walls, classic checkered tiles, vintage guitars hanging by the window, and the warm patina of time on every piece of furniture. It’s not “decor” here; it’s a time capsule. For those of us who grew up in that era, every detail whispers, “Remember?”

And then there’s the food — the star of the show. The cơm tấm here is the kind you don’t just eat, you feel. Perfectly grilled pork chop with a gentle smokiness, fried egg with a creamy yolk, bouncy vermicelli, and fluffy rice — all tied together by a tangy-sweet fish sauce. Every bite is comfort; every bite is a memory. Pair it with a cold soda chanh, and you have a full ticket back to simpler days.

For anyone visiting Saigon, especially those chasing a taste of the past, ĐỖ – Phủ is not just a meal stop — it’s a chapter of your own story waiting to be re-read.

ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.name: places/ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VQcW50Y0RKdTR6RXRRRRAB
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.author: Maricar Custodio
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.text:
Awarded as one of the Exciting Things in Ho Chi Minh 2023, Cà Phê Đỗ Phủ is renowned for its culinary offerings. A standout dish is the “Cơm Tấm Đại Hàn” (Korean-style broken rice), which features tender grilled pork chops, shredded pork skin, pickled vegetables, and a fried egg, all complemented by a flavorful fish sauce.

They also offer a version of Vietnamese phin filter coffee that’s paired with youtiao (giò cháo quẩy), a uniquely nostalgic combination that reflects the blending of Vietnamese and Chinese culinary influences.

Beneath its unassuming facade lays a pivotal role in Vietnam's struggle for independence, the establishment became a clandestine base during the Vietnam War. It housed secret tunnels and bunkers used to store weapons and documents, playing a crucial part in Vietnamese operations.

This café stands as a testament to Vietnam's resilience and rich cultural tapestry, offering visitors a unique blend of history and gastronomy in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.

ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.name: places/ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2MWF6T3JnRRAB
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJoW9jUmYpdTERU6GsiY8NkWo.text:
Do Phu Cafe is an interesting destination if you love to learn a little about the history and explore the old house that used to be the secret base of the Saigon Special Forces.

The lady (perhaps the host) is very willing to introduce and show you where documents, letters, and money were hidden in aluminium cans hanging in the narrow wall. The secret basement, just enough for one person to crawl into, is camouflaged in a wooden wardrobe upstairs, with an exit to the house's back door.

It is great to be able to enjoy broken rice in a space where the objects associated with it seem to witness all the events that happened here, from the past during the war to today's peacetime.

Although it is introduced that the broken rice dish still retains the same flavour as before 1975, honestly I find it a little below average. The meat is too dry and the steamed egg meatloaf seems to have too little glass noodles and wood ear mushrooms in the ingredients. In return, the pickles are very delicious.

The drinks are also very typical, most of them are popular drinks from the old days. But the flavours are not too outstanding.

Reservations are recommended to secure a bed. My "Take a Break" combo (VND 160.000) included two hours in a dorm-style bed with two drinks or cakes of my choice. However, Chidori is not the best place for napping, especially for light sleepers. There is constant noise from footsteps, cleaning, staff greetings, and ringing phones. All of them make it challenging to truly relax. And keep in mind there is a camera in the space, which might be limiting your privacy.

On the bright side, the space is impeccably clean. They disinfect regularly, leaving a pleasant scent, and the restrooms are spotless. They even offer complimentary iced tea on the staircase landing. The cafe also boasts delicious and unique drinks, setting them apart from other cafes.

In short, Chidori is a great choice for drinks, relaxation (if only in the café space), and enjoying a clean environment. If you are thinking of catching some Zzz, best to look elsewhere or consider a hotel with better soundproofing.

ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.name: places/ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGQ1NITkhPRGx4VFZrelQya3dZbXhpZFdWMFltYxAB
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.author: hoa tran
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.text: The old house with some corner really nice. Cooling even in the room open air. I love the tree in the gate too

ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.name: places/ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OME9VMHdURTgxV0ZoTlpqTjJWVmhhTUc5MGQyYxAB
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.author: Nhat Huy
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.text: A green, quiet corner with vintage vibe. Highly recommended.

ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.name: places/ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNDeXJEME93EAE
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.author: Ak
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.text:
This cafe is pretty unique because it feels like a mixture of modern and traditional together.

I usually don’t walk into traditional looking cafe and this cafe looks like the one from the outside, but once you are inside the lighting and painting and nice air makes you feel like you came to a modern cafe. Chairs and tables are also good here unlike most of traditional cafes.

Only 29K VND for a vietnamese coffee and they offer a set with banh minh as well. The staff was really nice too, so this one is worth visiting👍

ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.name: places/ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRNHVydVNREAE
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.author: Sean Lam
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.text: Nice little cafe in a very quiet neighborhood in D1. Not noisy and jazz music gives a good vibe.

ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.name: places/ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ5cEpXd1pREAE
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.author: Olivier Vincent Marty
ChIJI5LRx1AvdTER4IUoLNRo35w.text: Charming and quiet old fashioned coffee shop. I love Saigon for places like this one. Café Da 29k in March 24.

ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.name: places/ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaMlVWZDBXWGhEZFhsVFQxbGlWVUZTUWpSb1dVRRAB
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.author: Fayt 117
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.text:
Cozy chairs, was playing my Steam Deck and the backrest, though short, did provide sufficient armrest. Pleasant vibe, not to loud. Power source everywhere, even on the long table (applause to the owner for this).
Edit : they just re-opened and this is my 1st time, I dont know what changed.

ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.name: places/ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuOV8tUjRRRRAB
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.author: David T
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.text: Very nice clean cafe with a great price, friendly english speaking staff and air conditioning. Tried the coffee with fresh milk 45k vnd and it was high high quality, tasty. Overall highly recommend.

ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.name: places/ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSMDhETEx3EAE
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.author: Rosa Nguyen
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.text: I passed by here but I was satisfied with this coffee shop due to the good drinks and nice view, the weather is hot but the view can  balance. The beverage price is 45-55k per drink.

ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.name: places/ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJeWExdmkzMWNYZ0hnEAE
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.author: Jest Rudo
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.text: Finally good salty coffee! You must try it here 🏅

ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.name: places/ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUROb1pYY3hRRRAB
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.author: Danny R
ChIJe9FYXfovdTER5GsgpK04BGo.text: Pretty cozy place especially upstairs. Went here a few times because their drinks are creative and delicious.

ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.name: places/ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKM2JrVllYMHRGTUZwV016bFhUaTA0VlZCNllWRRAB
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.author: домовенок кузя
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.text:
spacious, and the plus side is that it is open 24hrs. the drinks are average and thus pricey.

the clientele is great and respectful though. people are courteous, and speak to each other mindfully as to keep the studious environment going.

good space for work. the buzzers are a buzz kill, unfortunately. the staff should both be a. well-paid enough, and b. actually serve customers. for the price and quality of the drinks, self-service does not make much sense. it is laziness.

the security guard right outside is very sweet and smiley. I would say that is definitely the highlight. the guard right at the entrance of this area though, was extremely aggressive towards the dogs they own. it was sad to watch puppies get treated so badly…

ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.name: places/ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkeXJIeHNBRRAB
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.author: Ak
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.text: Pretty impressive renovated retro cafe that is very spacious and things are well spaced out. There are so many power outlets on the wall, so it’s a great place if you need to charge your devices, or the tables and chairs are decent so you can even work or study here for some good amount of hours. The prices of the drinks are good for the space and the quality of them are actually good as well. This is one of the cafes worth checking out in this area.

ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.name: places/ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUZ2Uzb2dRRRAB
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.author: David Zhang
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.text:
A great place to get some work done

The tables are nice and spacious, that AC is pretty cool, the Internet is blazing, fast and reliable, and there’s plenty of room for lots of people

The drink that I had was pretty good as well

You’ll find lots of young people working here or just chilling here

Really nice vibe too

ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.name: places/ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJM1BYZHlBRRAB
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.author: M
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.text:
I'm not sure if all Bamos locations are 24hr, this one being so is nice.

This franchise is clearly used as an individual study/work coffee shop opposed to relaxing and socializing. The tables and chairs are more library style and less comfort-first and chill style; usually, it's quiet.

The prices are midrange (50K/$1.95 for a large milk tea), I tried a Bamos Milk Tea (standard milk tea).

ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.name: places/ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KcFgydExXbVZ6YTJKbVRXZFljRnBRUVdNeFgzYxAB
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.author: Bao Lan Nguyen
ChIJfS0PNO0pdTER2U9eJatCYaA.text:
Terrible coffee, wooden chairs that feel cheap and unmotivated staff that look like they don’t want to work and be there

Plenty of uni students hanging out there with their laptops. Ok if you want cheap coffee and need a place to crash I suppose

ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.name: places/ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21KWWMyWlpVbFZMZDNoYVZIaDZkRVl6T1hSSk9VRRAB
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.author: Duy Ngo
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.text: Great location, comfortable atmosphere and friendly staff. They don't use the plastic straws. Black coffee tasted good.

ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.name: places/ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNXdHFpbWpRRRAB
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.author: Ak
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.text: This is a very nice vivid and fairy spacious cafe. The design is modern and this place gets a lot of sunlight. There are some workable tables here. Their Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk is 39k and it’s pretty good. It’s safe to say that this is one of the best cafes in this area.

ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.name: places/ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPajl2UUJ3EAE
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.author: Martin Le
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.text:
Sunday ! Hello sunshine,

We passed by this coffee shop and decided to drink in. Cool place, quiet, modern, clean look, white background decor

Smell: Did not smell coffee although I saw machines decorating the backside and in the cabinet area, (expecting strong coffee smell)

Music: okay song theme, a bit loudly

Drink: Good

Comfortable: air conditioners, chair without cushion, some nice working study table, open air window view.

Staff: friendly and great welcome
Suggestion:

Price: everything abt VND 55k average range

Location: easy find

Recommendation for you

NOT: family gathering, kid place, babysit, baby infant or friend chitchat sing, smokers, gambler

ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.name: places/ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twYVEyVmFXbGxzVTJSMGVIZFNVbXBPYm1ORk9HYxAB
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.author: Jim “Alexander” Serup
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.text:
Not much to eat or drink, coffee is bitter and they barely have anything to eat. Cup noodles and some dated waffles. Would not recoment this place to work from, it's more a student hub for locals.

Side note, I asked if the noodles had chili in them, because I got some teeth pulled out a few days ago, so I can't eat spicy food. They said no, but after tasting the noodles then my mouth was burning.

So all in all, low service, no food and poor coffee menue.

Price was cheap tho, and the cafe is pretty,  so there's a potential but imo then there's missing a lot before it's a great work spot

ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.name: places/ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmOUlmY3dnRRAB
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.author: Van Khanh Trinh Nguyen
ChIJJ3ToRuEpdTER75zW9rAvMu4.text:
Highly recommended!!

I was so happy to come back and enjoy original Croffle again. Couldn’t wait to share the photo of my beloved Croffle here.

Thanks a lot, Song Ca Phe team.

Wishing team countless success and happiness in 2025 🎉🎉

ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.name: places/ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfNDUzX2hBRRAB
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.author: Fabian Nguyen
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.text:
A nice place to study and/or work!
However:
They don't accept card payments. Also my 500k VND bill was not accepted as they didn't have chance. Hence I was not able to order anything. It was quite awkward.

ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.name: places/ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBeUt1YVNnEAE
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.author: Alex Mijares
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.text:
Ambience is great, there's no doubt in that but why does it have to be more than 30 mins to get the order of coffee?

Ordered sausage and coffee at 9:45 PM, received the order at 10:19 PM (more than 30 mins)

When I asked for the order at 10:00 PM, even just for the coffee they said  that " You would like to get your coffee now?" I responded yes but they still served it at the same time as the food.

Then when the buzzer was buzzing for (10 seconds), I left it a bit because I was finishing my work. Then the employee went up to me with the food and said "Your buzzer has been buzzing for a long time, you should pick up the food."

You know what has been waiting for a long time, the food that I waited for, for 30 MINS.

ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.name: places/ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ1b1p2MjZRRRAB
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.author: Ak
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.text: Newly opened cafe in 2023 that has pretty nice AC spaces and workable tables. Everything looks new and nice, plus the drinks are very good. Clean bathrooms and well organized environment. There are so many good workable cafes in this area and this is a nice new addition.

ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.name: places/ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM1anNhSGxnRRAB
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.author: Toan Bui
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.text:
Funky, relaxing chill out cafe - non smoking!!!!

Fantastic spot for photos with outside garden and balcony.   Plenty of aircond space for a little ofice work with study benches and and heaps of power outlets for everyone. :))

Coffee (egg) variety sensational!!!

ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.name: places/ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmOV9fa3RBRRAB
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.author: Henry Lu
ChIJiQ9XMBspdTERH7NXFOXVd14.text:
Nice place for youngsters to sit around and enjoy coffee. Can get abit noisy, wouldnt recommend if you look for quiet place to study

The cafe salted foam coffee is pretty good!!!

ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.name: places/ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGbVJqRkdUMVJ2VGxwclpEZHBTbkJrZFRKUlIyYxAB
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.author: Michael McElligott
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.text: Really nice spot for getting a coffee and relaxing, studying, browsing, etc. for a few hours! There are 3 floors and each one has a lot of seating. It seemed to be very popular with the local young population. Their milk coffee was delicious! The tiramisu was tasty as well but more like a cake-style tiramisu than the original Italian treat.

ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.name: places/ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ONlZHSlJPVmRKVG1rd0xURXROM0pGUzBsaU9VRRAB
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.author: Như Trương
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.text: This coffee has quickly become my go-to place. The vibe is chill, the Wi-Fi is fast, and the coffee never disappoints.

ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.name: places/ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR0b01IVjlBRRAB
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.author: andooAU
ChIJtR2E-PApdTERisXz_qR6vbQ.text: Went here at 6am for my missus makeup for photoshoot—Haven’t tried their foods yet, but can tell their coffee is insanely good. A true Vietnamese coffee.

ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.name: places/ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWcmMweG9kazFyZVRsblVFRTRORTAxT1dVelNrRRAB
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.author: James Smith
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.text: Ca Ke Café has a beautiful design, making it a great spot for those who want to enjoy their drinks while relaxing or getting some work done. The beverages are carefully prepared, with a wide variety ranging from coffee to other drinks that can satisfy different tastes. The service here is friendly, always making customers feel comfortable. I think that this is a great choice if you're looking for a quiet, clean cafe with a cozy atmosphere to meet friends or focus on work.

ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.name: places/ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfMy1qZ1FREAE
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.author: Rebecca Maschmedt
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.text: Really nice cozy vibes and beautifully decorated! A lot of people come here to study or sit for a longer period of time. We ordered a salted iced coffee and a normal iced coffee and they're to die for! The salted is so velvety and the normal has its own unique flavour. We've come here twice and will definitely be coming back again :)

ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.name: places/ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twRmJERnBiREJPYTFReWNrdGliVWhXU0hWbmNIYxAB
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.author: Mỹ Nhàn
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.text: Having coffee here is such a memorible experience during my visit to Vietnam. The atmosphere is really cozy. The waiters are really friendly. I’ll definitely be coming back again.

ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.name: places/ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3OE5MM2RREAE
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.author: Jessica Ren
ChIJRUdImaUpdTERO15bESUfMdY.text: The drinks are quite delicious, recommend dishes related to ice cream, very delicious. You can visit and experience it.

ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.name: places/ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQyc0oyLVR3EAE
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.author: Ak
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.text:
Nice vintage cafe with great staffs. Probably the most trained and polite staffs I have ever encountered at any cafes in HCMC. The staffs are super nice here and their attitude is like they are working at a nice hotel. It maybe a small thing, but it surely makes me feel better especially in the morning. This place is fairy new, so everything is clean and nice as well. They also have a 2nd floor and it’s pretty spacious and good for groups. Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk here is 35k and it is actually great. I hope they can keep this great service.

I came back after 2years and the space is not good anymore. It stinks and a bit run down already.

ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.name: places/ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURobWJHLWRREAE
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.author: Quyen Huynh
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.text: It's a cozy place and looks nostalgic. The decoration looks like a traditional house from the North of Vietnam. I ordered coffee with coconut, and my sis ordered coffee with rum. Oh my godddddd. They were so perfectly. I will go back here to hang out with friends because not only the good beverages but also the good space to spend time chatting, even work from coffee 😊.

ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.name: places/ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURXeWZfZEFnEAE
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.author: kang k
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.text: The coffee here is delicious.  The comfortable interior is nice too.  I heard that there are already many shops in Hai Phong.  Will come back here again.

ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.name: places/ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURud2RtOGJBEAE
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.author: Lea Eck
ChIJ0REscyUpdTER58SEPfVDKfg.text: It's a very cute cafe with a very chill athmosphere. The staff is nice and they have the best coconut coffee in ho chi minh!!:)

ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.name: places/ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sSk5UZ3hjSFE1VkdsaVJUaFhWekZOUlZZMWJWRRAB
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.author: Brewforone
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.text:
📍 ʙᴇᴀɴᴛʜᴇʀᴇ ᴄᴀꜰᴇ ɪɪ - ʜᴏÀɴɢ ꜱᴀ ʙʀᴀɴᴄʜ

- After a long search in the morning and a couple of “Closed” signs, I ended up going to Beanthere Café. The space has a vintage, slightly Victorian charm spread over three large floors both indoors and outdoors. It was humid as usual so indoors it was.

That said, it’s not exactly the place I’d choose to work from. Between the background chatter, music, and coffee machines, it’s more of a “soak in the atmosphere” type of spot than a focus zone.

I had both the usual Bac Xiu as a control which was pretty nice but I've been having Matcha lately (this time with coconut water) which was exactly what I was looking for. Not too sweet, which is perfect for me. Would visit again just for the aesthetics but not for working haha.

ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.name: places/ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaRmMwbHNWV3hNWVdnd1JrSTFhM1ZzYkV3MFJtYxAB
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.author: Luu Minh Triet
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.text:
The entrance is narrow, passing through an old apartment building. The inside of the restaurant is beautifully designed with a nostalgic atmosphere.

Go to alley 2A Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, it will be more convenient street

ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.name: places/ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201SlZsWnRNM2cwWkVkTlRrUkplRWcyUTJwZk9GRRAB
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.author: top 1 saigonese enthusiast
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.text:
(⌒0⌒)／~~ luisine but more victorian-esque

Went here to work with a client. The space seems reasonable, with royal aesthetics. A bistro wide wide variety of food items to choose from, I got the lotus milk tea and salmon carbonara. Typical milk tea, it was alright, pasta wasn't as refined to my taste. Perhaps the salmon felt too mushy? Nevertheless, it looks pretty.

ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.name: places/ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VMQ2d5NG1maUpYSnFRRRAB
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.author: Van Ngo
ChIJKeUS9PspdTERSMqwoAgpNCY.text: I love the ambiance, vintage vibe, and the service here. Even though they're busy, the staff is attentive and efficient. However, both beverages we tried (earl gray tea with matcha foam/watermelon and beet juice) aren't great. But other options are still worth a try.

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.name: places/ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twSE5sZHBRbEp4UkY4ekxXcGhNMmhxWlZWVFdHYxAB
ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.author: Tiffany Boogaloo
ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.text:
Came here on a rainy day, so the place was a little wet here and there - the outdoor area was completely wet, but luckily we reserved a spot for the five of us at the cafe and got the biggest table. :) There was a part of the roof that was dripping, so the staff were quick to put a bowl there to protect the water from splashing onto us.

We ordered their various handmade cookies which were served with egg cream - loved the bear cookies that had cream in the biscuits and the salty long biscuits that fit well with the egg cream.

Food was very nice, we tried banh mi with sizzling beef, fried noodles, and rice noodle soup - im not too sure of the names but they do have english translations under the vietnamese names for the menu.

We finished the meal with lemon cake, which tasted lovely with a bite of the sweet lemon slice on top of the cake. The slight bitterness of the lemon complements the sweetness of the cake, which was less sweet than the lemon slice so it didn't feel overwhelming.

Enjoyed the Egg coffee, Salted cream coffee and tea drinks tremendously - Cu Tren Cay is a cosy beautiful place you should visit at least once when in Ho Chi Minh. ;)

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.text:

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.name: places/ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfck5hZUhBEAE

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.text: I stumbled upon this cafe by accident. I was walking along the main road and needed a place to rest and charge my phone. Anyhow, this place is like a wooden cabin/tree house. The entrance is a plant shop and behind the shop you’ll find the coffee shop. It’s a hidden gem. I saw mostly Vietnamese. The coffee prices were fair and the vibe was spectacular.

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.name: places/ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2NGJhVEp3EAE

ChIJSUxqhQ0ndTERuimyNs-6qY0.text:
First of all, they could make me an egg coffee with no condensed milk or sugar, and the coffee still tasted good. That said a lot about the initiative taken by the barista.

This place is huge and has many 'book' sections for quiet reading, studying, or working. The decor is shabby-chic, but very sophisticated and charming.

ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.name: places/ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmMUpULTlRRRAB
ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.author: Navis Trần
ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.text:
If you ever find yourself in Vietnam and miss out on this coffee shop, oh no—you’re seriously missing a slice of heaven! 🌟

✨ Stunning nighttime views that will leave you speechless.
🍃 A refreshing, serene environment that feels like pure luxury.
🎨 Their art coffee? Absolutely priceless—not just in taste but in experience!
🎲 Bonus: They’ve got board games to keep the fun flowing.

The staff? Incredibly kind, attentive, and always ready to make your visit unforgettable. It’s the perfect spot for coffee lovers, game enthusiasts, and anyone craving good vibes.

I got a tiny bonus mug of eggo 🥹🫶 love it!! ❤️

Highly recommend this hidden gem—don’t miss it, y’all! 🫶💫✨💫

ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.name: places/ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRbGY2NkRnEAE
ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.author: M
ChIJGW99XJIpdTER8nGmjobQQY8.text:
I saw some amazing looking latte art coffee in the Maps photos, so I wanted to try it. I asked if I could get one (pointing to the Japanese style building one on the menu), but I didn't want egg coffee.

The guy had said I could get it on the bubble oolong milk tea macchiato, so I was excited. But it turned out, it must require an egg to draw one of those. There was a cute drawing of a face on mine, but it wasn't the elegant picture I was anticipating.

The size was ok; tasted standard. 49K/$1.90 is mid-range for price.

The space is kind of small inside. I only tried 2nd floor, though. It was nice and quiet until a large group of 10+ college students came in. I got annoyed and went to the outdoor seating section, which was hot and humid and had one smoker which I get too much secondhand smoke in Vietnam, and I had to sit on the board game table (which is slim) so I could be near an outlet.

I hope everyone else gets the latte art (only with egg lattes) they want, and it's quiet for you.

ChIJrWpZfwAhdTERFh0zrBh7LoI.author: Loan Cao
ChIJrWpZfwAhdTERFh0zrBh7LoI.text:
About the space:
- The shop is spacious, clean.
- The music is played in the style of Den Vau, sounds ok. The speakers are normal, loud enough but not good.
- The tables and chairs are old-fashioned wooden, look comfortable, but sitting is not really comfortable.
- At noon, the air conditioner is on inside. It's not completely cool, but with many fans, it's still very comfortable.

- (At noon) Customers mainly come alone and work with laptops, only about 25% come in couples so it's not noisy when talking.

- Many power outlets.

Staff:
- Very good, quick and tidy.

I saw a customer ask to add a table inside, the staff also did it very quickly.

Drinks:
- I ordered fresh milk and coffee, it was ok.

Overview:
- Comfortable space.
- Basic drinks.
- Extremely affordable prices (2x-3x)

Conclusion:
Definitely come back. Thank you shop.

ChIJv9DJIkgpdTER3XoDa__g53o.text:

ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.author: nishi
ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.text:
I visited this cafe again after a year, and unfortunately, the experience was deeply disappointing as the entire concept has changed.

Previously, this place was known for its creative drink menu and selection of pastries. That is all gone. Now, they only serve pre-bottled beverages and simple snacks. The menu has also become inconvenient for individuals, as the solo combos have been removed. I had to order a two-person set, and was charged an unexplained 20,000 VND fee on top of the listed price, which I was only informed of after my drink was prepared.

While they've added new features like TVs with Netflix, they don't provide headphones, which could lead to a very noisy environment. The booths now have fully private curtains, and most concerningly, I found condoms placed inside. This strongly suggests a shift in purpose from a relaxing cafe to something more akin to a love hotel, which is a stark contrast to their previous house rules.

I suspect the business has changed hands and pivoted to a more profitable model. However, as a fan of the original concept, I can no longer recommend this establishment.

ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.name: places/ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNQcEpiMThBRRAB
ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.author: Mary C
ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.text:
I googled a quiet place to relax in hectic Ho Chi Minh City and found this spot recommended by a member on Reddit. I was pleasantly surprised by how great it was! I haven’t been to other pod cafes before, so my references might be limited, but I absolutely loved it!

I paid 117,000 VND for 3 hours in a large pod, including a beverage. Normally, the limit is 2 hours, but I think they had a happy hour or promotion running. The staff were very friendly and accommodating, though they barely spoke English.

First, you order your beverage at the counter. I went with cà phê sữa đá (Vietnamese iced coffee with milk). Then, you take off your shoes and put on their slippers. My pod was on the first floor. It was clean, smelled nice, and had relaxing background music.

The pod had several sockets, and the bed was covered in PVC leather. They provided a blanket and comfy pillows, making it easy to relax, work, or simply spend quality time. I enjoyed it so much that I’m planning to move to a hotel nearby just to spend more time there. Amazing concept!

ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.name: places/ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSMnI3ZUpnEAE

ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.text:
Such a brilliant idea for those of us who travel and often have time to kill between flights that doesn’t solicit booking into a hotel. 5 stars for the overall concept of the place. Unfortunately we were only able to award it 3 though, as it wasn’t exactly the cleanest - see photos.

The drinks and service were good all round though and regardless of the issues with cleanliness we would probably still return. It’s around 5 USD for 2 hours in a pod & two drinks. The celery drink was delicious.

ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE.name: places/ChIJy_FKhdMpdTERxjnvqX314uE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR5MHEtN2xnRRAB

ChIJi9ioHAApdTERFihPASGEbMg.text: Nam Ky Coffee Shop - the name sounds strange but also very familiar. Formerly Nha Nam Book Coffee. The shop has the style of the previous decades. It gives us the feeling of living and reminiscing about the past. With an airy, quiet space, this place can be said to be an ideal place to concentrate on studying and working. You can choose quite a lot of food and drinks. In addition, the shop also has countless books for us to supplement our knowledge. Self-service form, after ordering, users will wait for the food and come to pick it up themselves, if you order food, the staff will bring it to you. The drinks are quite good, similar to the price. ChIJi9ioHAApdTERFihPASGEbMg.name: places/ChIJi9ioHAApdTERFihPASGEbMg/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWb2RrbFVSUzE1TTJGbVl6RnlURzVyU0V3NU1XYxAB
ChIJi9ioHAApdTERFihPASGEbMg.author: Nguyen Luong Hung
ChIJi9ioHAApdTERFihPASGEbMg.text:
XU NAM KY Coffee Shop – this is a “living museum” full of old Saigon!
The shop is covered with golden relics from before 1975: noodle carts, “unique” vintage motorbikes, movie posters, nostalgic old signs and an old Akai machine that still echoes the song of time. Every corner of the shop is like a book opening up a brilliant memory.

On the 2nd floor, the shop has 3 private rooms, soundproof, cool with a free bookshelf of all genres, an ideal “oasis” for students to review, read books or relax with a cup of coffee for only 👌29,000 VND!

Not just a coffee shop, **Xu Nam Ky** is also a cultural meeting place – where the past 🕰️ blends with the present 💡. Stop by to enjoy a cup of aromatic coffee, listen to the Akai machine whirring… and feel the soul of Saigon in the past! ☕✨
Today Hung visited the Coffee Shop - XuNamKy Coffee and met Collector Huynh Minh Hiep and had a very happy and emotional conversation about a beautiful past.
The shop is beautiful and contains many beautiful souvenirs. The shop has reasonable and cheap prices.
I love the Coffee Shop - Xu NamKy ☕☕😻😻😍😍🌺🌺❤❤🌹🌹👍👍

ChIJN8FC9TkrdTERXn2NVgFMids.author: Katy Ng
ChIJN8FC9TkrdTERXn2NVgFMids.text:
An interesting, stylish cafe, designed in the countryside style of the 90s.

The entrance to the cafe is quite wide, leading to a space completely separate from the outside world. The cafe space stands out with 2 small, old, single-wood houses and thatched-roof corridors interspersed with each other, bringing me back to memories of the old days.

In the middle of the cafe is a small lake. The lake and surrounding area are decorated with small, leafy trees and classic, quiet decorative corners. The space is arranged simply but has highlights, many beautiful shooting angles

The cafe space is really gentle and peaceful. I went on a rainy day, the rain drizzled on the tiled roof and then fell on the wooden surface, the space was very beautiful and comfortable. I felt nostalgic and comfortable when sitting at the cafe.

There are many seats and each seat is decorated just enough, rustic with vases, bonsai, old objects, the overall look is very pleasant.

However, the quality of the drink does not match the investment in space.

Mango ice cream salt tea made from green tea leaves, industrial mango jam, condensed milk cream, the blandness of the green tea does not blend with the sweetness of the mango jam, the salty cream layer on top is quite thick and has nothing to do with the glass of water.

Green rice coconut cream is arranged like shaved ice. The condensed milk mixed with hot water and a lot of ice makes it extremely thin, the green rice is hard, tasteless and not suitable to eat with ice that has a diluted milk flavor.

The staff is enthusiastic, only the cashier is quite sloppy, rushing to order, rushing to collect money as if afraid that after I order, I will run away.

Pros: a perfect place for studying. It’s quiet. The air conditioning is not too hot, not too cold. The ground floor is for those who want to talk a bit. Cons: no outside food are allowed. The choice of savory food is just noodles. Customers are mainly young students which makes an old person might feel a bit lost.
In general, im very satisfied with the environment here. I will be back here many times.

The drink was mediocre and definitely not worth the cost—an average cup costs around 70-80k. Spending 300k on a bill, yet they can't provide an extra disposable cup? They really need to reconsider their approach to providing a good customer experience.

Aside from that, the area is quite spacious.

This place is not worth visiting unless they retrain their staff and improve their serving procedures.

ChIJO4yItZIpdTERc3TQCfBMmBQ.author: Saigon Storage
ChIJO4yItZIpdTERc3TQCfBMmBQ.text:
Staff were really good, friendly & entertained my daughter.

The displays are incredible. The toys for kids to play are also great.

The spaghetti with meatballs was tasty & well priced.

The let down of the day was the burger. Firstly it was served on a black bun which is not stated on the menu. I do not eat this type of bread & after a considerable debate the bun was replaced with a white bun. The replacement bun was not fresh & stale. At 169k, its already over priced & was a real disappointment.

Due to the great staff & the huge effort that has been put into this place, its well worth a visit. My daughter enjoyed it & wants to return.

I love all the decorations, atmosphere and the food presentation. Plus they have a great collection of Jurassic park statues and figures you see for free in their gallery! If you got kids they also have an area for them to play and learn.

I’d probably give it a 3.5 if I could, but since that’s not an option, I’m giving it a 4 because the overall experience was solid.

ChIJwbjWqTMndTERnWjw15LlZm8.text:
Here is a review you can use to post on a map (Google Maps, Foody, etc.):

⸻

The hammock cafe is very airy and spacious, an ideal place to rest or relax in the middle of the day. The space is designed rustically with a thatched roof, simple plastic tables and chairs, and rows of colorful hammocks hanging close together, creating a feeling of closeness and comfort.

The big plus point of the cafe is that there are many green trees and fruit trees around, helping the air to always be cool and pleasant, especially in the morning or evening. The cafe has a convenient car parking area, suitable for both car and motorbike customers.

However, a small minus point is that the cafe does not have a fan, so on hot days it will be a bit stuffy if you sit for a long time. However, thanks to the open space and many trees, the feeling is still much more pleasant than closed cafes.

Drinks here are simple, popular such as iced tea, milk coffee, soft drinks, etc. and reasonably priced. Suitable for both locals and tourists who want to experience a relaxing, affordable and close-to-nature space.

ChIJQ-pC_fkudTERxeSQooFINb8.text:
My first time here; their menu is rather mind-boggling at first, given the number of menu items, but they have them grouped in categories which can make your choice easier. You can adjust the amount of sugar and ice in your order.

I got the fresh milk with dried longan and dried red apple. It was quite sweet - even with no sugar; the longan and dried apple had been minced quite tiny. I was disappointed with the very limited quantity of longan and apple. They also give a glass of tea; today they served it hot which was appropriate as it was a damp, rainy day.

The staff were prompt and friendly.

Spacious with two floors and a variety of seating options; especially suitable for working in groups. There are lots of well-placed electrical outlets to recharge your devices. Not suitable if you want a quiet space. 🙃🙃

Limited parking given the amount of seating; two security guards to watch the bikes.

The order area is rather cramped; the whole place could do with a good housekeeping: the light fixtures have a layer of dust and cobwebs.

ChIJ_5hUJyIvdTERWmZ2rskuyO0.text:
koi thé cao thắng is your go-to for that reliable bubble tea fix

THE SIGNATURE SIPS
their golden bubble tea is an absolute serve. that iconic milk tea base with perfectly chewy pearls that hit different every time. consistently solid and always satisfying.

THE MODERN VIBES
this location gives clean aesthetic energy with its sleek interior and efficient setup. the whole space feels fresh and organized, making it a chill spot to grab your drink.

THE CONVENIENCE FACTOR
quick service and prime location make this a no-brainer when that bubble tea craving hits. perfect for a pick-me-up that never disappoints.

THE FINAL CALL
if you're chasing quality boba that always delivers, koi thé is the move. your taste buds will thank you later.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJLTRoBisvdTERW2U14g7gc4s.author: Anh Tú
ChIJLTRoBisvdTERW2U14g7gc4s.text:
At 20:24 I bought a glass of Black Tea with Lime and Winter Melon like every day, I'm really addicted to this. But after buying it and drinking it at home, I only tasted the Black Tea and Lime, the usual Winter Melon flavor was absent, and the lime was sour and I felt that there was no sugar in it. Hiccc, I was craving it so much but when I bought it and drank it, I was really disappointed, I don't know if the shop messed up my order 😭😭😭😭😭
Actually, at 20:53 I called to report my problem, but the response was unprofessional. With the price of a glass of water, I really shouldn't expect much from the service, but I was really disappointed with the way the basic problem should be handled by staff working in the F&B industry.
Me: at 20:24 I bought a cup of Red Tea with Lime and Winter Melon from your place, but why did I only drink it today?
Employee: Sister, our Winter Melon flavor is only about 50-60% for size L
Me: but I have drunk it here many times, the flavor of this cup is not the same as the one I usually drink
I am talking to myself on the phone right now, she said she checked the camera (does that mean she checked the camera so quickly?)
Employee: we checked the camera again and found it was done correctly, that's why we didn't add sugar
Me: do you have a manager?
Employee: we don't have a manager, I'm an employee
If you say it's the first time you drink it and you don't know the flavor, that's not true, because I came to buy it yesterday and bought it again today and I still have the old receipt, so I get a 20% discount if I keep the receipt within 48 hours. I don't know about Hau Giang branch but the Nguyen Bieu branch I drank was really delicious, sour and sweet with a distinct winter melon flavor. A bit disappointed with Hau Giang branch

ChIJl3hyJQAvdTERYOT21TEnNxk.text:
A Hidden Gem for Tea Lovers!
I’m absolutely blown away by this tea shop! Every blend feels like a work of art — creative, aromatic, and full of personality. The staff clearly know their craft and are so passionate about helping you find your perfect flavor. I tried their Oolong and Shan Tuyết, and both were unlike anything I’ve ever tasted — perfectly balanced and beautifully presented.
The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and filled with the comforting scent of freshly brewed tea. It’s the kind of place where you can sit for hours, chat with friends, or just relax with a good book.
If you’re tired of the same old tea options and want something truly unique, this shop is a must-visit. Every sip feels like a new experience. Highly recommend! 🍵✨

We stay right behind this coffee shop and are here for 3 weeks. The reviews were bad but thought we would try it out. Our first visit we ordered a lemon iced tea and a coffee with milk. I didn’t specify nor did they confirm but I was given an ice coffee. I wanted hot. They made it right with no questions asked. Even though we stayed in for our order everything comes in to go plastic take away (although oddly my coffee was in a ceramic mug and was a proper size for a medium. The environment was pleasant so we stayed a few hours working.
On our 2nd attempt at this place, we ordered a cold coconut and again in ordered a milk coffee, hot. Even though we are sitting here everything comes in to go with lots of plastic and my coffee was barely a shot. How she added milk to my had shot is a mystery. I inquired and her English skills weren’t great and she looked confused. I simply let it go. This will be our last visit here even though we still have two more weeks in the city.

——-
But most of the time when I order via Grab, I call to say I'm out of black pearls. If they're out, I turn it off on the app so people can consider. Every time I order, the driver comes to pick it up and then calls to say I'm out of black pearls. At that time, there's no other choice but to choose another option because I don't want the driver to wait.

If the shop doesn't have that dish, let the customer know in advance, don't be so preemptive :)

The pearls here have a thermos pot so they are delicious, chewy, not mushy like other milk tea shops. 

My mother drank Gao tea and also praised it as delicious, not too sweet (I asked for 50% sugar), but the tea was really fragrant, when I ordered water the staff just started making tea - highly appreciated, the tea must be fresh for the flavor to be fragrant. 

The shop now has a new identification board so it is easier to find, highly appreciated for improvement, quality improvement. 

The staff are quite cute, when entering the shop, I saw many students and office workers so the space was not chaotic.... okay

ChIJP4A1RxIndTER-TWXjiobDwA.name: places/ChIJP4A1RxIndTER-TWXjiobDwA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOYVpqaG5SRkkxV2twbll6ZEVVbVE0Wm1aVk0yYxAB
ChIJP4A1RxIndTER-TWXjiobDwA.author: Double D
ChIJP4A1RxIndTER-TWXjiobDwA.text:
EVERYONE SHOULD NOT BUY

I buy here a few times a week. The staff's attitude is unprofessional but it doesn't affect me much so I don't care - until today!

Bought 2 glasses, 1 size L - 1 size XL
After paying, they DID NOT GIVE THE BILL, only gave the QR code for the transfer
While waiting for me to transfer the money, they joked with each other and were not focused - so they stuck the order sticker on the wrong size of the glass (bought XL size but stuck both on L size)

When I received the water, I asked to confirm "Why isn't my glass XL size?"
The female staff wearing glasses confirmed "You ordered and we charged for 2 L size glasses, if you want to upgrade, you have to pay 5k more". I think you guys mistakenly pressed L when ordering, so it's ok

When I got home, I looked at the cup and found out that the staff was careless, when the customer asked again, they answered firmly without checking

Unprofessional, from the person who pressed the bill and stuck it on the cup to the person holding the cup to make the order. The XL is so clear but they didn't pay attention.

Called the hotline but they didn't answer, called the store's phone many times and when they picked up and heard the word complaint, they immediately felt annoyed.

THE PEAK OF THE VERY UNEDUCATED ATTITUDE TOWARDS CUSTOMERS

"WE WERE TALKING BUT THE PHONE HANGED OFF" is what the two staff said to each other while the call was still going on.

I don't know what to say, not that I regretted spending 5k on a cup that was made wrong. But the experience was frustrating and very disappointing.

NEVER COME BACK!

**Review of Hi GoGo Milk Tea Shop, Bui Dinh Tuy, Binh Thanh**

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Hi GoGo Milk Tea Shop on Bui Dinh Tuy Street, Binh Thanh, is a great place for those who love milk tea and delicious, diverse drinks. After many visits, I always feel satisfied with the quality of drinks and service here.

Milk tea at Hi GoGo is very rich with many different flavors and toppings. From traditional milk teas such as brown sugar pearl milk tea, matcha milk tea, to fresh fruit teas such as peach tea, lychee tea, all are carefully prepared and delicious. In particular, the pearls at the shop are always fresh and have the right amount of chewiness, blending perfectly with the sweet and fatty taste of milk tea.

Hi GoGo's menu is also very diverse, not only milk tea but also many other drinks such as yogurt drinks, smoothies, and fresh fruit juices. This creates many options for customers, ensuring that each time they come, they can try new and attractive dishes. 

The space of the shop is designed to be modern and cozy, creating a comfortable feeling for customers when enjoying drinks on the spot. Tables and chairs are arranged neatly and cleanly, with small corners decorated beautifully, very suitable for young people to gather, study or work. 

The staff at Hi GoGo are very friendly and enthusiastic. They are always ready to advise and help customers choose drinks that suit their preferences. The service is fast and thoughtful, ensuring that customers do not have to wait long even when the shop is crowded. 

The prices at Hi GoGo are also very reasonable, suitable for the quality of drinks and services that the shop provides. This is a big plus, especially for students and those who love milk tea but do not want to spend too much. 

In short, Hi GoGo Milk Tea Shop on Bui Dinh Tuy Street, Binh Thanh District, is an ideal place for those who love delicious, diverse drinks and a comfortable space. With excellent drink quality, good service and reasonable prices, Hi GoGo will definitely satisfy you. Highly recommended!

No one arranged the tables and chairs outside, the previous customer left trash and no one cleaned it up, the next customer had to clean it up.
The restaurant took a long time to prepare the dishes, even though there was no one in the restaurant.
The staff were unpleasant, unprofessional, and answered the customers very grumpily. When I bought 2 cups, the staff didn't say anything other than the amount, didn't mention anything about accumulating points, the next customer came to buy and asked, then the staff checked. At this time, I asked the staff, the staff gave me a coupon and checked 1 mark, seemingly reluctantly, I asked again if I bought 2 cups and also checked 1 mark, then the staff took another check, still not saying anything.
A staff member (or manager???) standing to take orders seemed very unpleasant with the other staff members.
Overview of the drinks:
1. Egg cream coffee.
The coffee was weak, the egg cream didn't have much egg smell but seemed to smell industrial.
2. Milo with brown sugar pearls.
The taste was quite ok, the pearls were okay. A bit too little Milo, too much ice.

I went to buy it at home but in the end I still had to find the owner's number, because the shop was in a small alley, it was difficult for me to go in and back by motorbike, so if you want to buy it conveniently, please consider it.

ChIJHVvUeSAvdTERcyclNk5GLUw.text:
The name is “bakery” but all the snacks are delicious 😂 This shop makes food that is super suitable for my taste. The price is also cheap
In my opinion, you must try dishes like:
➕Stir-fried corn: If you like to eat a little sweet, this dish is perfect. The restaurant stir-fries corn super sticky, smells of butter, and is delicious with shredded pork. 1 plate is quite a lot, enough for 2 people
➕Lau ly: The Thai hot pot broth is very sour and spicy, not too sour or sweet, it is perfect for those who like Thai vermicelli. The 35k portion has a lot of toppings, and a lot of vermicelli too.
➕Mixed noodles: The noodles always come with seaweed soup, making it less stuffy. Remember to pay attention to the spiciness, the toppings are a bit greasy, I think you should drain the oil a bit to avoid getting bored. The noodles are mixed well with spices, and there are also Indo/Siukay/Miliket noodles
➕Btrang rolls with butter and scallion oil are super sticky, 1 portion of 5 rolls is very long and the price is cheap at only 30k, I see other shops selling this dish for 40k or more. The type I ordered is without Vietnamese coriander, the shop thoughtfully divided it into 2 types for those who don't like to eat vegetables like me hihi
➕The black tea with lime is delicious, worth a try

➖ The peach milk tea is delicious, a bit sweet and has too much peach syrup. I hope the shop improves this drink
➖ Fried squid spring rolls are quite thick, you can eat quickly because of the oil
➖ The space of the shop is quite hot and stuffy, most of the customers are take away, but I hope the shop improves the space so that more customers can come to eat

ChIJcwjeHgApdTERKYrqYJPdeBM.text:
“The ultimate dipping rice paper – divine sauce, eat it and you will be addicted!”
If you are a fan of snacks, especially rice paper, then you cannot miss Co Ganh Rice Paper Dipping at Lot D001, A4 Phan Xich Long apartment building, Phu Nhuan district. The restaurant is famous for its unique dipping rice paper, a combination of soft Tay Ninh rice paper, chicken eggs, quail eggs, Vietnamese coriander and especially the rich sweet, sour, salty, spicy sauce, making anyone who eats it once remember it forever.
The menu is diverse with many attractive combos such as dipping rice paper with eggs, mixed mango, peach tea, lime tea,... Reasonable prices, ranging from 10,000 VND to 40,000 VND for individual dishes and from 35,000 VND to 200,000 VND for combos.
The restaurant is open from 10:00 am to 9:00 pm, serving enthusiastically and quickly. The space is clean and airy, suitable for groups of friends to gather or buy takeaway. This is truly an ideal place for those who want to enjoy delicious rice paper dipping sauce in Saigon. I will definitely come back many times!

ChIJZ5WO0SMpdTERP556TV5DUo4.text:
Here you can choose to buy and mix the rice paper yourself, or let Co Nha mix it for you. During peak hours, the self-mixed option might be quicker. Luckily, on my visit, she had just set up and I opted to wait for her freshly mixed version.

A bag costs VND 20.000. The ingredients are very simple: rice paper, satay, annatto oil, shrimp salt, fried garlic, laksa leaves, and 5 quail eggs. It is worth noting that some might find it a touch on the salty side.

I see people often compare this place to Co Anh's rice paper, another nearby local vendor, but that is rather pointless. They both offer unique flavour profiles worth trying on.

The rice paper here is the kind that is dried in the dew, so when you eat it, you can clearly feel the elasticity, a little chewy, very delicious and mouth-watering. The owner mixes quite a lot of salt, so the taste will be a little saltier than usual. Those who do not eat salty food should tell her to put less salt from the beginning to suit their taste. A full bag of toppings, add eggs as in the picture for only 20k but it is very delicious, worth every penny. Just looking at the picture, you can eat it without getting bored, if you live far away, you can buy it and mix it yourself. 
This is really the number 1 shop in my heart. Although sometimes the owner looks a little annoyed, but in general, it does not affect the quality of the food and the overall experience. Nearby, there is also Ms. Anh's rice paper shop which is equally delicious, so if you have time, you should try both. 
Oh, the newly opened lemon lotus tea opposite is also very delicious, so you should try it. The owner is very cute

ChIJx1UkILcvdTERcTDW6olCEe0.text:
This time I’m going to introduce a street food in Ho Chi Minh to you.
🍕This is not Pizza, this is the soul snack of Vietnamese street!
Just this time I have the opportunity to record a video for you to watch😁,
The aunt on the roadside performed a piece of rice paper with a lot of ingredients.
Take a bite, the fragrance, crispness and saltiness are all in one bite~
If you come to Vietnam and don’t eat Bánh Tráng Nướng, you will regret it!
This is a very popular street food in Vietnam:
Bánh Tráng Nướng (roasted rice paper),
Also known as "Vietnamese Pizza".
This street food is usually made with rice paper as the base and topped with various ingredients.
(such as shallots, dried shrimps, green onions, eggs, cheese, hot sauce, etc.),
Then it is grilled over charcoal fire.
Fragrant, crispy and delicious, cheap (30,000 per serving)
It is a favorite for locals for afternoon tea or midnight snack.
🍳 Method: Auntie will first add green onions, dried shrimps and sauces on the rice paper.
Add cheese and eggs toppings,
Finally, slowly roast it on charcoal fire, the aroma is really charming~
💰 The price is very reasonable, about 30,000 VND per portion
🕐 Freshly made and baked, it is recommended to eat it on the spot for the crispiest taste!
Have you ever tried this Vietnamese street food? 👀
If you come to Vietnam, you must eat this kind of "roadside snack" 😁
If you want to see more Vietnamese food guides, remember to click on my homepage + bookmark this article!
Time: Afternoon
📍Location: 54 Ngô Đức Kế, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh
