3. I waited too long so I asked for the bill but the staff came out and told me to do it, not that the customers were leaving, making excuses like this made me feel annoyed.
4. I ordered grilled rice paper with soft-boiled eggs but they brought out only undercooked eggs, they were just hot. The quality of the food was not guaranteed.
5. After eating, I waited for more, then asked for the bill but they refused to pay, even though I tried to be very understanding. But then they came out and asked to make it for me again. I do not like this way of keeping customers. Very annoying and unpleasant.
Conclusion: If you go and see too many people, don't expect anything. More anger makes the food not delicious. Instead, you should go home and wait for a chance to come back. Personally, I will never come back. Thank you.

ChIJ5RbuQNEvdTER7C6Krt003VQ.name: places/ChIJ5RbuQNEvdTER7C6Krt003VQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsblVXeEdZVTgwWXpCNFV6VXlZMUJDU1dwMWJGRRAB
ChIJ5RbuQNEvdTER7C6Krt003VQ.author: Na Lê
ChIJ5RbuQNEvdTER7C6Krt003VQ.text: This afternoon, August 19, 2025, I was brought to this restaurant for the first time by my friend rcm. Honestly, I am a very easy-going person, but today's incident left me with a bad impression of the restaurant. I ordered rice paper with fried onion fat, when I entered, I saw a girl peeling the rice paper to mix it. A while later, a man walked in and took a box of rice paper (already mixed) from a male customer waiting outside. The owner of this restaurant poured the mixed rice paper into the mixing bowl, and what I didn't expect was that the portion was mine. While mixing, I felt that his attitude was not calm because the male customer ordered 2 boxes but only took 1 box. It turned out that the owner mixed the extra box for me. While mixing, he asked, “Can I have this?” Seeing me stuttering in embarrassment, he asked again, “Do you think I’m making leftovers for you?” and with an unsympathetic face. Both my friend and I were shocked and in order not to continue like that, I had to take this rice paper box home. I don’t think anyone would want to have food that was once given to someone else, but then take that food for themselves, right? These are all comments after I got home. Really disappointed!

ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.name: places/ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkcE9xTEtBEAE
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.author: LanHuong Pham
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.text: The restaurant is clean, plentiful and delicious. I only like to eat garlic rice paper, the rice paper is mixed with spices, with fried onions and many other toppings like mixed rice paper. Depending on each person's preference, you can choose your own topping. Here, I only use mango and quail eggs, add a lot of satay but not too spicy. The rice paper here has a mild salty and sweet taste that is very easy to eat, along with the slightly sour taste of mango, it's great.

ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.name: places/ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURNNDY2Um5nRRAB
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.author: Nga Tran
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.text:
This is because a friend invited me to go to District 6 for a snack, I'm not very familiar with this area 😂 My friend said that this place has been selling rice paper for a long time. The price is always cheap, from a few thousand to a few tens. She said the pan is big so she told me to choose many portions to fry them all :))
_Mixed garlic rice paper - 1 mixed plate brought out a lot, there's also grilled dried squid and I think this plate is the most delicious 😋.
_Rice paper rolls with fresh squid and eggs - it's okay, there's a lot of butter sauce so it's a bit fatty 😚
_Rice paper fried with minced meat - I thought I was eating a mini version of fried spring rolls 🤣 Crispy but fried so I get bored quickly 😅
3 plates of rice paper like above and mineral water cost 48k. A little later, I ordered another glass of peach tea for 15k. When ordering, she also asked if I wanted to eat peach pieces or not. The tea here is really delicious. It has a real tea flavor, not just peach flavor and sweet sugar, the cup is as big as a beer glass and it's very satisfying to drink 😆

ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.name: places/ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQxcnNXRDJnRRAB
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.author: Sung Âu Dương
ChIJSXq2HXQvdTERhNMlK9qR1GI.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for years, it's still delicious, Aunt 9 is old so it takes a while to work so you have to wait a bit. If you want to eat there, park your car on the side of the road and order drinks, that place is a place that sells drinks so Aunt 9 borrowed it to sell, if you eat there, order drinks to support the restaurant. The lime tea is delicious, only 10k. As for rice paper, I always recommend rice paper rolls, only 20k but a full box and very delicious, satay and avocado if you like to eat more, ask for more. Mixed rice paper is also 20k and a plate is very large, full of all kinds of dried beef, chicken, squid, eaten with black beef sauce + satay, it's delicious.

ChIJ09gNsz0vdTERwKVqnbfXy88.text: I am the driver to pick up the order, the staff here only play single player games and don't work.

They also always give me a discount when I purchase more things, which is cute. The owners are lovely people.

ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.author: Hoài Lê
ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.text:
Many types of rice paper, delicious, reasonable price. There is also crispy rice with pork floss, dumplings for snacks, and big cups of drinks. 
Personally, the butter rice paper here is not to my taste, it is a bit loose to roll. The mixed rice paper with scallion oil and pork fat is quite okay, strange taste. 
But it seems that recently the restaurant focuses on selling hot pot with Thai vermicelli more than selling rice paper, which used to be more delicious, but now it has lost its flavor and is very oily. The hot pot is also quite okay, delicious, reasonable price. 
Sometimes the staff does not pay attention to customers, customers call repeatedly to come. 
Sitting outside on the sidewalk is cool, overall I recommend this restaurant, should try.

ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.name: places/ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJbE9iMVFREAE

ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.text: At this food court, our family came to experience dinner on the sidewalk, sitting on chairs to eat snacks, mixed rice paper, and seafood hot pot. It was very fun, the breeze was cool, the price was cheap but delicious and the stomach was full. It is considered a night food street with lots of delicious food. From the main road, Do Xuan Hop is crowded with traffic jams. Turn onto Road 9, Phuoc Binh Ward, District 9 to reach the bustling food court.

ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.name: places/ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKc2ZPWUh3EAE

ChIJsfcQJJwndTER46AMkpkVu9I.text:

- I often order the following dishes: rice paper with scallion oil, soft rice paper with satay, fried rice paper with tamarind sauce (the tamarind sauce is served separately, so tell the lady to add a little satay to the sauce, it will be much more delicious).

- The pork fat here is delicious, the spongy type. Not the kind that is so hard that you can't chew it.

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.text: I stopped in for breakfast and got the banh beo. They come 20 to a platter and are simple but very tasty. The ones I was served came with shrimp powder, green onions, and crispy fried pork skin. I thought the fish sauce was pretty mild but it went well with the simple banh beo. Theres takeaway and a small dine in space in back. The owner was very fast and polite and Theres room for motorbike parking available on the sidewalk.

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.text: My choice was thập cẩm (combination of everything). It tastes nice and fresh. Reasonable price for me. Bánh bèo, bánh ít ram, and nem chua are my favorite ❤️

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.text: Banh Beo is a classic Hue snack that I enjoyed so much. Served in small dishes with shrimp, pork, and crispy toppings, it’s both fun to eat and flavorful. The taste was delicate yet rich. I loved it and will definitely suggest my friends to try Banh Beo when visiting Hue.

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.name: places/ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNabzd2T2pRRRAB
ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.author: Rafe
ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.text: Reminds me of Teochew rice cake - Chwee Kueh with prickled radish. But this has a much more complex texture and flavour profile. The soft chewy texture from the rice cake mixed with the crackling pork rinds. Also they mixed in other glutinous rice cake that i am not quite sure exactly what it is but it compliments and elevated the entire dish. The broth is savoury and yet a hint of tart it was the best match with rice cakes as the rice tend to be clump. Very unique dish and i think not very easily found in Saigon. If you happen to be in this area, its a must try at only 32,000VND.

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.name: places/ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR1M1phb09REAE

ChIJWQRBND0vdTERx6QbmOc_o78.text:
Yum yum!
Make it perfect for an aperitif or an afternoon snack. Order the full options plate then pick out what you like the most.
The rice flour textures were created perfectly for each cake. The fillings are addictive and well seasoned.
Came back second time and will keep coming back!

ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.author: REAMS
ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.text: Delicious local restaurant, with their signature chive banh canh and banh beo. Prices are reasonable, service is quick and friendly. Might be a bit difficult to spot the place if you never been to the area.

ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.name: places/ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzNzRTM3dRRRAB
ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.author: Duy Hoang Quoc Dang
ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.text:
Bánh Canh Hẹ (garlic chives vermicelli), including small chopped chives (amazingly delicious), fish cake, boneless fresh fish meat and quail eggs. The fish meat is tender and melts right in your throat.

All served in hot meaty broth, you can add on with chili and a wedge of lemon for more flavorful.

One of the best Banh Canh He I’ve ever had in Saigon, service is top too!

Side dish: bánh bèo, with chicken shred, bread crumbs and dipping with sauce. Worth a try!

ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.name: places/ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNja292M3FRRRAB

ChIJraz7ws8odTERw1SdFz-QJVI.text: This place is always busy with lots of guests. I rate 5 stars, we've been here all of time, alone, with friends, family. With a very good price and great food, I believe my review and my 5 stars is worth it!

ChIJX2wa9kYvdTER7cWd4rrzYj0.text:
- Delicious & affordable banh beo -
One of the dishes that is also very typical in the list of delicious dishes in the Central region is banh beo chen.
A bowl of banh beo fits in the palm of your hand, with minced shrimp and pork filling, red in color (or yellow in color from turmeric depending on the place), sprinkled with peanuts and fried onions.
The shop sells in the afternoon until sold out.
The price is reasonable, 3.5k/bowl. The average appetite is about 4-5 bowls, 14k - 17.5k is very reasonable for a delicious afternoon meal.
In addition, the menu also has banh bot loc 2k/piece, cha 3.5k/stick, homemade yogurt 3.5k/jar. I tried them all and found them all delicious.

ChIJ0cuMyzgvdTERJNp8NfIXyzo.text:
Bánh Bèo Chợ Bến Thành is a must-visit food stall in the heart of Ben Thanh Market, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. Specializing in bánh bèo (Vietnamese water fern cake), this stall offers a traditional dish that captures the essence of central Vietnamese cuisine. Bánh bèo consists of soft, steamed rice flour cakes topped with minced shrimp, crispy pork skin, and scallions, all enhanced with a light, flavorful fish sauce.

Located in the historic Ben Thanh Market, which has been a bustling trade hub since the early 1900s, the stall provides a chance to savor authentic Vietnamese flavors in a lively and iconic setting. While some staff may speak basic English, visiting with local friends can greatly enhance the experience and help you navigate the vibrant market environment.

For a true taste of Vietnamese street food culture, this bánh bèo stall is a culinary highlight you won’t want to miss!

ChIJNY9b8-QvdTER1TrjuHgCF8Y.text: The stall is open around 2 p.m. and usually starts to run out of items around 3-4 p.m so definitely come early if you want to try out everything. Yummy bite-sized bánh bèo topped with velvety mung bean, prawn floss, croutons, and some scallion oil create the perfect combination of flavor and texture. The bánh bột lọc is a real treat: savory shrimps encased in such a soft and chewy dumpling skin. A plate of any item also comes with a thick slice of peppery and delicious chả.

ChIJNY9b8-QvdTER1TrjuHgCF8Y.text: The banh beo shop is hidden in the heart of Nguyen Van Troi market, district 3 but it is very easy to find, the alley just entering the market is where you will see Hue Thuy Linh banh beo shop. Around 1:30 pm, the shop is always crowded with customers, so as soon as you park your car, you have to run in and sit down to get a seat. I ordered a full plate of banh beo and the ladies made it in less than 1 minute and 30 seconds and had this attractive plate of banh beo. The fish sauce is poured with 2 types of sweet fish sauce and salty fish sauce, combined together, it is extremely delicious. A whole plate of cha ba is only 47k, so if you go to the market, stop by her shop to eat. The price is the same, the quality is good for those who like to eat and explore the market.

Personally, I find the food normal, the tapioca cake has the right amount of chewiness, not too hard or too soft; the other types of cakes are kind of mushy, overcooked. A plate like that for a snack will quickly make you feel full and tired. The tangerine juice at a nearby shop is 15k/cup, quite fragrant, moderately sweet, not too much sugar.

The food is delicious, everyone.

I've been eating here for a long time, but only now have time to review it. I've been passing by for a while now but haven't seen it, it seems like the restaurant's address has changed.
That day, my friend and I tried a few dishes like the ones I posted. Unfortunately, the shrimp wet cake dish was delicious but we haven't tried it yet, so we're planning to come back.
The shrimp wet cake is a specialty here. It's delicious when it's served with shrimp.
The rice cake is hot and delicious.
The water here is also special. I rarely see any restaurant that has Danh Thach here. There are plenty in my hometown.
After eating, I know which cake is made from what. There's information about the cake.
The space of the restaurant is small and pretty.
If you pass by, stop by and try it.

ChIJ2bJsOiAvdTERjvr4Daqi7JE.text: Affordable yet delicious treats from the South (especially the Mekong Delta area). They have a balanced and distinctive combination of sweet and savoury flavours. The only downside is the seating and environment, which might be loud, tight, and uncomfortable for non-locals.

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.text:
Very nice staffs and helpful, food was good but not that great, the crab meat balls were ok, lotus seed chè was too sweet. Nice decor, but the restroom wasn't clean.

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.text:
Been here for many times but this’s the first time I make a review for this restaurant.

The Hue cuisine was really good with reasonable price. However, the portion was quite small which is suitable for person eating like a bird. Highly recommend “Banh Khoai” and “Banh Ram It”, these 2 were so good compared to what I had at Hue city.

I will definitely come back again soon.

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.name: places/ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwMVpqbmpRRRAB

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.text:
Price is quite reasonable, taste is normal, service and atmosphere is good

Bun bo Hue is just ok, portion is a bit small if compared to the price, would give it 6.5/10. Rice with steamed pork and shrimp is normal, 7/10. Stir fried salt leaf Hue (vegetarian option) is a bit oily although taste is quite interesting, 7/10.

Roasted pork chè and longan chè (dessert dishes) are 7/10.

Salt coffee and salt cacao are 7.5/10, although the latter tastes better for me.

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.text: Nice small restaurant for Huế food lover. Food was prepared very quick with some portions.

ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.author: Mr14014
ChIJq6WD3x0vdTER88bgyk6LJqY.text:
The price was cut-throat.
Even though the servive was rather good.
The scenery was warm and welcome.

The food...
tasted ok at most.
The price for such food?
I would choose other places.

80k/bún bò Huế for 1 piece of pork trotter, 2 slides of beef, 3 balls of crab balls and several tiny chunks of beef tendon. And they used frozen soup, it was overly salted because it was reheated.

No, I do not recommend this place, don't go here.

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.author: Lý Hồng Bảo
ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.text:
A very delicious mixed plate.
- Fragrant rice cake, fatty coconut milk, served with a little minced meat and fish sauce, very harmonious.
- Shrimp and pork rice cake is also delicious, not excellent.
- Steamed rice cake is very delicious, like meat + soft green beans, rich, fragrant with pepper. However, eating 1 in a mixed plate is delicious, if you order many pieces/plate separately, you will quickly get bored.
- Comes with a leaf sausage, also quite delicious.
- I find the fish cake less delicious than the other types.
- The most outstanding plus point is the fish sauce. It is very well-matched and wonderful.

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.name: places/ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJbmEzU2NREAE

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.text: I used to come here to buy takeaway, it was okay to eat. Today I had a chance to come back to the restaurant, I ordered 1 portion of banh bot loc and 1 portion of rice noodles, the taste is very different from the old days, the rice noodles are like soaked in water and mixed with boiled vegetables, the plate of noodles has fried eggs cut into strips and 1 spring roll, it's not delicious so I threw away the whole plate, the tapioca noodles are okay to eat, if you eat on the spot, the restaurant is narrow, hot and has few seats

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.name: places/ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VONkJtdk95dzRyQk53EAE

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.text: The hostess is very friendly, the box I bought for 25k is full and very delicious and filling. Everyone please support me.

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.name: places/ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR6LXBpdjRRRRAB
ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.author: Liên Trúc
ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.text: The restaurant specializes in Hue banh beo, but also has other dishes such as spring rolls, fried noodles, etc. The banh beo is delicious and you won't get bored of eating it. The restaurant is a bit dirty. Even though there were no customers when I arrived, the public restroom was still not cleaned, and there was trash everywhere. The old lady and man selling the food were a bit annoying. I asked but they didn't answer, which was very annoying.

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.name: places/ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQwenNxQjdRRRAB

ChIJn_Cv86wudTERuwvK4_haFso.text:
Delicious mixed banh beo.

I visited the shop around 3:30pm, the shop was quite crowded but the food came out quickly. If it's your first time, you can choose the mixed plate - banh beo, banh duc, it tran, cha, a little of each.
I found the banh duc very delicious, fatty with coconut milk, served with minced meat, very interesting.
Price is about 20k/plate. There is also fried noodles which are also attractive at 18k/portion.

ChIJ4fiTMgApdTERoKEG7Yq1pwk.name: places/ChIJ4fiTMgApdTERoKEG7Yq1pwk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURia3JiVFlnEAE

ChIJ4fiTMgApdTERoKEG7Yq1pwk.text: Just randomly got some rolls as it's down my street. And it was surprisingly good for the price. And the owner is so cute. I want to go on a date with her 🫣

ChIJ4fiTMgApdTERoKEG7Yq1pwk.text: Super delicious rice paper to eat during the day, it's chewy with minced meat and vegetables, very unique, dipped in sweet and sour sauce, it's great. I like the chicken feet cold and crispy like this, mixed with just the right flavor. I see this restaurant is crowded so the food is probably sold out all day, there's no leftovers, everyone should try it!!

ChIJ-S9XX_0udTER9AwkiGy2q6k.text:
The small shop mainly sells take-out, the bread I ate was delicious and suitable for my taste, the sausages that came with it were also delicious, I ordered banh bot loc for 35k with 2 sausages, pickles and fried bread or something, it was extremely worth the money, spicy fish sauce, whoever doesn't like spicy, remember to tell the lady, the waitress is very cute!!! 
I finished eating and then I'm writing a review, my mouth is watering!!!

ChIJ-S9XX_0udTER9AwkiGy2q6k.name: places/ChIJ-S9XX_0udTER9AwkiGy2q6k/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNGaGJmVTlRRRAB
ChIJ-S9XX_0udTER9AwkiGy2q6k.author: Tu Hoang
ChIJ-S9XX_0udTER9AwkiGy2q6k.text:
The restaurant is located on Huynh Man Dat Street, opposite the very prominent Da Lat Pho cafe, so it is quite easy to find. Banh beo, banh bot, banh bot loc come with their own toppings, along with homemade fish sauce that is delicious and sticky. Banh tam bi is no less, delicious skin, delicious sausage, coconut milk blends together, very tasty. The price is also very affordable, only from 25-30k. 

The restaurant space is quite narrow, with only 2 dining tables right in front and next to the counter, which is more suitable for quick meals to give the table to the next person. The service is quite fast and neat. The restaurant does not sell iced tea, only mineral water. 

*Note: The restaurant will default to spicy fish sauce when brought out. You should tell them in advance if you cannot eat spicy food, otherwise it will be spicy.

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.name: places/ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBNTYtTHlnRRAB

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.text: Great breakfast spot - the lady tries to communicate with me despite the language barrier and I really enjoyed my breakfast here. They only serve one item, the steamed rice cakes. You can add toppings like Vietnamese sausage. Ordered a coffee and it only costs me 36k. Will recommend for the local experience!

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.name: places/ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMeU91U2pnRRAB

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.text: Pretty sure the banh beo is spoiled because the banh beo was very sour.  the banh bot loc was on the harder side, rather than slightly softer and chewy. sauce very bland.

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.text: - The restaurant is located in an alley opposite Le Van Sy market, sitting on the sidewalk is quite narrow. - Banh beo and banh bot loc are okay, nothing special, the price is a bit high compared to the quality.

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.name: places/ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuOEplSGRBEAE

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.text:
The restaurant is located in a bustling culinary alley on Le Van Sy street. Inside, you can see a lot of food. I love long-standing restaurants like this because they're mostly delicious. But the shop here is not what I expected, the banh beo is thick (I prefer thinner) so it's a bit boring to eat, the topping with banh beo is OK, the banh beo is too hard, the rolls are also normal, the good thing is the fish sauce is delicious.
It's just a simple cake stand on an alley, so the space to sit at lunch is a bit sunny, and the prices are not affordable, so the food doesn't attract me to come back.

ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA.name: places/ChIJTXjoCysvdTER6d3WoDWp0pA/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuaU1feEJREAE

Many locals and tourists eat there since it is just next to Ben Thanh market and their price are reasonable. You can get your taste of local food in this cafe and motorbike parking is easily available.

Surrounded by nail salons, you do have to cross the "jungle" of salon touts before reaching the cafe.

ChIJafLlnCMvdTERf81CIuougxA.text:
Giang Cu Man, anyone from the Central region who misses hometown food should try this restaurant. The restaurant is quite small, located on a street corner, only open from afternoon to evening. There are only 2 tables, quite cramped, so most people buy a lot to eat. 

The restaurant sells 7749 dishes of banh bot loc, rice flour, and all kinds of flour in Hue. A mixed plate in the picture is 30k. For those who want to eat each type separately, they also sell by quantity. 

I live in Phu Yen and my taste is similar to my hometown. The fish sauce is delicious, the uncles and aunts are cheerful. Every week I have a new plate to satisfy my cravings. A plate of that size is enough for a girl like me to eat a lot. 

Banh it Tran here is very delicious, the filling inside is marinated with rich flavor. 

Compared to District 3, the price is too cheap for a dish worth experiencing.

ChIJafLlnCMvdTERf81CIuougxA.text: This Hue banh beo place is just a small corner at the intersection of NDC and NTH, but customers come in and out to buy to take away. I ate a portion of mixed spring rolls with a lot of them, delicious pork rinds, just enough sour spring rolls, lots of pickles, rich fish sauce poured in and importantly, I was full, it was only 40k :v you can park your car right on the sidewalk, there is also a place to sit but only for small groups or solo because there is no place for a group, like eating and going home, you can't sit and chat. I sat down to eat when it was drizzling and sunset, right at the corner of the intersection, it was also very chill ☺️

ChIJVVABgiDVdDER9PXo5ThxF_c.text:
[Shared by YouTube channel 5+ English]
I have passed by your Banh Beo shop many times but had no intention of stopping by to eat because this dish is not my taste.

One day, my wife and I gave ourselves a try and fell in love with this dish.

The portion of the cake is just the right amount for an adult's morning. The cake is very fragrant and soft, with simple toppings including pork floss, dried shrimp powder, crispy fried bread and scallion oil, but it blends well with Banh Beo and chili fish sauce, pickles.

Your uncle and aunt are very gentle and friendly although they don't talk much.

The space of the shop is suitable for those who like to have breakfast in peace, away from dust and noise.

ChIJV7j3RbAndTER4wSUBWbqo08.author: Nguyễn Khanh
ChIJV7j3RbAndTER4wSUBWbqo08.text: The first and last time. I think it should be negative. 1 star is too lenient. At 7:50, I stopped by to buy a box of grilled pork noodles for 30K and opened it and was shocked. I got a few spring rolls. Even the people around me spoke up. Because my house was close by, the ladies told me to run down and ask if I forgot to put in the meat. BUT NO, 30k here is probably 10-15k, I was also careless and didn't take a picture. When I went down to complain, she used her bare hands to pick up all the spring rolls and put in 2 skewers of meat :) I was speechless. I was so angry that I had to go home and write an article right away. It looks beautiful on the picture. I agree that the price is high but it has to be appropriate 😡😡😡 Anyone who is planning to eat here should avoid this restaurant.

ChIJV7j3RbAndTER4wSUBWbqo08.name: places/ChIJV7j3RbAndTER4wSUBWbqo08/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURMMXNQSkZ3EAE

ChIJV7j3RbAndTER4wSUBWbqo08.text:
I ordered 2 pancakes and a bowl of fish cake noodles. The pancakes were soft and soaked in oil, rolled with vegetables and dipped in fish sauce and tasted good. The fish cake noodles were old noodles because the noodles were hard and sticky, not as chewy as new noodles. I knew because they didn't even bother to blanch the noodles, just poured the broth in, so I knew right away. The fish cakes were normal.
Flies were flying on the table, even landing on the rice paper plate. The table was very dirty, I wiped several paper towels and it was still coffee-colored. It was disgusting so even though I was thirsty, I didn't dare drink.
I complained but still gave 5 stars because the seller was old. But if you ask me if I would come back, I wouldn't!

ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.text: You can see why it is busy, Banh beo is delicious and service is quick.

ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.author: Nancy Tran
ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.text:
Highly recommended!! The food is delicious  they have 3 kinds of this dish, you guys should try all of them.
Especially the price is very cheap!!!
Will comeback if I have a chance for sure

ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.name: places/ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VPeWh4NWFUM1k3QWdnRRAB
ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.author: Giang
ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.text: Really good banh beo. Definitely coming back.

ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.name: places/ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNvaDl6NW93RRAB
ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.author: Tuan TA
ChIJE2EnjTbRdDER0qP99s45t4A.text: Cheap but delicious, a bit dirty. Staff was helpful.

ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.name: places/ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kalNEUnhZbXcwZDFoblNVSkpNbEZ5YVc4d1JrRRAB
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.author: Thanh Thuỷ Lê Thị
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.text:
Delicious
Only 3k/1 bowl but 2 people each eat 10 bowls and will be so full that they can't eat dinner🤣💯

ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.name: places/ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUanMzM3VRRRAB
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.author: Mèo con dễ nuôi
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.text:
- The space of the restaurant is old-fashioned, but clean, high tables and chairs, with a roof to protect from the sun and rain
- The banh beo is delicious, the price is reasonable (3k/1 piece) eating in a bowl feels very nice, not boring, every time we go, we order 20 bowls to be satisfied
- The owner is kind, I forgot something and she kept it for me for 10 VND for service
- The restaurant opens from 1-2 pm and by 5 pm when I arrived, it was all gone. It seems like the restaurant is closed on Sundays

ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.name: places/ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR5cHFUUUNnEAE
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.author: Loc Truong
ChIJPzZTgWHZdDER7GlvDpYL34Q.text: Enthusiastic owner. Delicious dipping sauce. Very crowded. Cakes often run out early.

ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.name: places/ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KclpFUlNWV2hHWWtSWWNGRXdkMUpOY25sd1pFRRAB
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.text:
Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts!

Like every day, I continue to feed my hunger for banh cuon. This time, the rice roll is decadently smooth, just thin enough for you to see and to contain the generous filling within, with a whisper of fermentation that lends a delicate tang. The blend of minced pork, jicama and wood ear mushrooms is the usual; the sheer volume and the flavourful fish sauce separate it from your typical street vendor. Toppings include lightly sweet fried shallots, sweet pork floss and bouncy fried Vietnamese sausage. Double down on the carbs with the shrimp pancake.

ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.name: places/ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3MHNIdVJBEAE
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.author: Lydia Lim
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.text:
It can be quite difficult to get to this place because of the bad traffic. But it’s certainly worth it! The rice rolls were freshly made and taste good and hearty 💕

Love the service as well. The old uncle was also very nice to ask me to take a sit in the shop first while I wait for my ride.

ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.name: places/ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJeTRXSVhREAE
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.author: S Wun
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.text: Apr 2025: 100% local place as we were the only tourists having breakfast there. Locals come in pjs here to eat - testament to how local it is. Delicious and English menu available. We preferred the non egg version. Ordered extra side of prawn fritter. It’s like a chee Cheong fun but rounder and fatter. Tasty with fish sauce - available in a jug at the table!

ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.name: places/ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMzMzk2TVlREAE
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.author: Nor Asyraf
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.text: Best banh cuon - Vietnamese steamed rice rolls in town and they have arguably one of the best fish sauce as well. I term it the Vietnamese chee cheong fun. The banh cuon is served with fresh herbs, fried garlic. And of course with its most distinct flavour n style. A good option as a breakfast food.

ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.name: places/ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSbGRURmxjMEZHUjJSbVQyaEVPSFpxUldoaFpXYxAB
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.author: Chi Truong
ChIJb_2wFd4udTER7KbyhPMbiM8.text: I’ve been eating here since I was a kid - almost 30 years now. This is (personally) my absolute favourite bánh cuốn place. The fillings are delicious and the fish sauce is perfect to my taste. Yes, the portion is a bit small, but I usually just order extra 😂

ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.name: places/ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGWFZtdzRUMHBvY2toeFVVbGtUUzFIVVRReWFrRRAB
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.author: Felicia Y
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.text: My favourite local breakfast food! Very authentic and everything is freshly made after you order. Rice rolls are soft and filled with well seasoned sautéed mushrooms. Fish cake was firm and nicely seasoned and the fried prawn cracker was the best! A Must try!

ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.name: places/ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tORGJXcEJVRWxmVFc0MloweHhaM0ZUTkhJemJWRRAB
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.author: A Wijaya (A Wijaya)
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.text: Closed early. Fresh rice flour rolls. Good texture. Very yummy

ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.name: places/ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3bGFIU2dnRRAB
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.author: Viet Nguyen
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.text: I love it. In the heart of District 1 (based on location to Ben Thanh) down this short alley way is this food cart. Fresh made with the perfect amount of veggies along with the crispy shrimp. So good and worth the visit. Owner is so friendly. Had breakfast but seeing they closed at noon, had to….I did an order to go….

ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.name: places/ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLWHRqS3Z6NHV6ak9REAE
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.author: J. H.
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.text: Bánh cuốn is definitely a breakfast that flies under most people’s radar, unlike the more popular Bahn Mi. The rice rolls incredibly light & tasty, packed with minced pork, mushroom and parsnip. As with most Vietnamese dishes, it comes with generous pile of leafy herbs. For those who can take 🔥 heat, add the chilli padi into the dipping sauce for an extra pizzazz.

ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.name: places/ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJZ00tN3lnRRAB
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.author: Michelle
ChIJA6NUv8ovdTER-Celq2MET6s.text: Super nice local place. The food is very delicious, the staff also super nice. For my fellow gluten-free people: the main dish itself is made with rice flour, but the shrimp cake is mix of wheat and rice flour.

ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.name: places/ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCU1FpMUZRWEJJY2tSallVZHZTMVpyVjI5SlRsRRAB
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.author: Ben Herman
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.text: This shop does really, really excellent banh cuon nong and they offer a huge variety of different filling options. Including vegan versions, which I rarely see! They were excellent. We got a vegan combo filling and a pork filled order and both were awesome. I also insist you try the banh dau, this was incredible. The crust was crispy while the bead filling was soft and it was freshly made. Service was fine and Theres some room for motorbike parking out front.

ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.name: places/ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t3eE56VXRSRU5mYzB4SlJsb3dNMU40VDNSWVIwRRAB
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.author: KahSeng Teng
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.text: Great steamed rice! Very soft and and dishes were made fresh too. Mushroom one is good.

ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.name: places/ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3MGFYS0ZREAE
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.author: Mika Choudhary
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.text: It is so hard to find these in Vietnam! I’m so lucky my friend told me about this place. You need pretty special equipment to be able to make these. They also have vegan, vegetarian and meat based options.

ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.name: places/ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ack5sUkJiMjVoZUU5VllYTlZkekUwYlVsd2IzYxAB
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.author: Miyu Huynh
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.text: I had the mushroom and meat filling without the porksausage. They added a generous amount of delicious filling + they make their banh cuon freshly per order!! Absolutely worth a visit :)

ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.name: places/ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ5N2RIQjlRRRAB
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.author: Erica Vong
ChIJ9_gWtAQvdTERm2AjKpI6sH8.text: We ordered Grab Eats at 5:30AM as soon as store opened.  Took 20 minutes to deliver and we were 0.5km from the store.  We ordered the THIN rolled ones and they were excellent.

ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.name: places/ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Gd1IzQlhUMjlVVXpKa1JHeEZRbVppTlhoamRGRRAB
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.author: Luca Clavarino
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.text: This is the kind of place that makes me love this Country: great food, kind welcoming, quick service, simple family atmosphere, prices within everyone's reach.

ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.name: places/ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURaeWJ6M3pBRRAB
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.author: Thảo Nguyên
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.text:
I was craving banh cuon late at night, searched the map and saw this shop was still open so I ran there right away.
The banh cuon is very attractive. Both the rice cake and the fish sauce are delicious. The utensils are very clean.
The uncle and aunt are cute.
When I asked what time it closed, the uncle said it closed at exactly 12 midnight.

ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.name: places/ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3dEt1YkxnEAE
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.author: Kiyomi Hen
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.text: The rice rolls are quite ok, the plate is a bit small, clean, the restaurant space is a bit small but clean ok, will come back to support again

ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.name: places/ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfa3RMc01REAE
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.author: Nb Chi
ChIJsbwvqmcpdTER4dygJUJLt3E.text: The shop is small and dark, the rice rolls are normal, the rice rolls in the box are 1.5 boxes. Vegetables are more than 1/2 box

ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.name: places/ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNRZ295aDNBRRAB
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.author: Christina Bui
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.text: The bánh cuốn here is quite tasty and special - I've never come across any other sellers who make their bánh cuốn out of eggs. (They also sell the regular bánh cuốn made of rice as well.) Price is cheap (28k for "everything") and you can order it to go if you're in a hurry.

ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.name: places/ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmai16VXdnRRAB
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.author: Henry Lu
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.text: One of the steam rice paper roll in tge area with reasonable price

ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.name: places/ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBenZLdFFBEAE
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.author: Linda Vo
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.text: The banh cuon here is the best in the city! It's located in a small alley and run by a sweet family that provides excellent customer service. Very clean and organized, locals eat here and not touristy like other places. You can call the restaurant directly to get delivery services too. I recommend getting the mixed plate.

ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.name: places/ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBdU9QMC13RRAB
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.author: Jean Huynh
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.text: This is a small mom and pop shop in an alley.  But this is one of the best tasting banh cuon I ever have had.  They use egg wrap to roll the banh cuon instead of flour.  Very highly recommend to try!

ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.name: places/ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNvLWFldG9nRRAB
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.author: t trn
ChIJrcJd_sUodTERdVLLqFGZQSc.text: Hidden germ in alley. I have tried so many banh cuon places in USA, Canada, HCMC but this place is the best for us! Large Portion enough for breakfast n lunch :-)

ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.name: places/ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMaWstNEQwc3V2eFNBEAE
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.author: Taweekiat Trongwongsa
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.text:
Spring roll and egg spring roll are very foreigner friendly, thenother local menu may be a bit too complicated to explain.
Still recommend normal spring roll and crab soup

ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.name: places/ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VQYU5pYmJOMThHWnV3RRAB
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.author: Nguyen My
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.text:
Forever my favorite banh cuon in Ho Chi Minh City! 😍The filling is a mix of pork, shrimp, and mushrooms, but the real standout is the rice roll with perfectly textured, soft yet slightly chewy.
With fish sacrifice, honestly super tasty and reasonable price point

ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.name: places/ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR6eXJYWGpBRRAB
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.author: E D E N. S.
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.text:
Staff look tired in the morning !? But they served according to the instructions well.

Food looks less but it filled us up very pleasantly.
Bánh Bèo was the best I've tasted in VN with a mixture of coconut milk and rice flour. Somehow tastes like bánh đúc.
Everything was well presented and decent flavor.

Bánh cuốn was awesome too, well mixed with fish sauce and their fermented pork (nem) was clean, well prepared.

The fried 🍤 cake was average, 22k / pcs yet nothing special.

The total bill of 5 people was 600k with take away and coffee, it was worth everything. I'll definitely come back

ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.name: places/ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0SlZXRnFhRlpaWXpFeGR6ZEtPV3QyVUdKeFZIYxAB
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.author: Helen Tran-Tran
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.text: I highly recommend this local  bánh cuốn shop. You definitely have to come here early we came for dinner but  there wasn't many options left.

ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.name: places/ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNfOEk2cm9nRRAB
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.author: Sam
ChIJj1SuDSIvdTERPRh_zWyXoAs.text:
A small shop opened for a very long time and was quite famous for its signature dish.
Plus:
- The food is decent, well presented and offers great green to balance out the amount of rice flour and protein it offers.
- The rice flour layer is thin soft and just nice
Minus:
- Too much of meat filling and a bit dry. More of casanova, mushrooms or red onion would make the texture great.
- The place is not entirely clean. It looks clean but the surface is oily greesy

ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.name: places/ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCRVVESjRRWFpvYVZwaFpuWnRVVGczV0VScVZsRRAB
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.author: Pho Ga
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.text: Best bánh cuốn in Saigon, period. Silky smooth & pillowy rice roll, tastiest meat filling I’ve ever had, full king prawn & nước mắm not being too salty 😮‍💨👌 the store being super clean is a lovely plus too!

ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.name: places/ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sxMFNrTTVlVXRXZEY5bWVISXhXR2N3VEhGdVNVRRAB
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.author: Felix
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.text:
One of the best banh cuon I’ve eaten in many years! Even had 2 plates because it was soo good!

Try the special one with egg and shrimp! ☺️

ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.name: places/ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLUF91X2FXeWQyMGFnEAE
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.author: Tram Key
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.text: The best banh cuon in saigon!!! Everything is just simply perfect and delicious

ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.name: places/ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNKOXJ2bEFnEAE
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.author: SyMui Che
ChIJJy5P2eYudTERFcs0OldH7Lo.text: That unpleasant attitude of the staffs, I already asked her not to put fried onion to my dishes, she was not listening, she even yelled and got mad at me saying that I should say it earlier, I was like I’d already told her but she was not listening. She’s even cut the portion of my order. I don’t care about how good or bad the food is, this kind of attitude should not be existed if you’re doing f&b services. Not recommend

ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.name: places/ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNKbmZTNUpREAE
ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.author: Duy Tuan Le Ngo (DArK9)
ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.text: Nice egg rolls, 5 years 1 taste, stability quality

ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.name: places/ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNvemNUUUhBEAE
ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.author: Lê Na Trần
ChIJZenloawudTERWLIv8SuuLpo.text: This was delicious. Even my fussy friend thought so.

ChIJOSZ8FwApdTERS9vHXoMBPmM.name: places/ChIJOSZ8FwApdTERS9vHXoMBPmM/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWRVRFSldZbnBXYVVvNWRtbFhNbW95YVhkV1NWRRAB
ChIJOSZ8FwApdTERS9vHXoMBPmM.author: girdhar vaishnav
ChIJOSZ8FwApdTERS9vHXoMBPmM.text:
My goodness , I found this restaurant just by walking in a near by street. I tried vegetarian options mixed vegetables steamed rice paper roll and bean cake , the owner taught me how to combine and eat. This restaurant is established with love n pure traditional taste. I can feel the legacy of a mother's taste passing to her daughter and to her grand daughter. Must visit to taste the real Vietnamese food.

ChIJh0AiXgwvdTERo1AJMaxEhqo.text:
Corner of Saigon - fish watching people...
Wandering through small alleys and hamlets in District 10 and 11, here and there are still some corners of Saigon, the dreamy memories of my childhood. Near my grandmother's house, my grandmother and I migrated to the South to sell banh cuon. We ate it since we were little, always going to buy banh cuon - without shrimp and sausage. It was so full all afternoon... then gradually that taste, the thin, smooth, soft layer of cake, the filling kept following the lonely old man, wandering the journey... by chance, I knew the shop near Uncle Ho's company - Song Nhac audio Karaoke, like a combination of the present and memories, the house style like my grandparents' house, the tiled floor of the last century, 2 fish ponds like when my father lived together and made a fish pond... the Northern accent was out of sync with the Southern accent, like family members, neighbors...
Every morning around 9am, after parking the car, I went to have a plate of 34k cake, clean, delicious and quality... suggested the shop owner to serve free hot tea... but it was not possible. Ms. Thao's rice cake shop is located right at the intersection of 2 alleys 284 Ly Thuong Kiet - 666 3/2 street. Very memorable, delicious and clean...

A plate of rice cake...
A plate of hot rice cake, thin and bright.
Mushroom and meat filling, rolled tightly.
Sweet, sour, spicy and aromatic dipping sauce.
A small corner of Saigon in Me...

ChIJdeA7wl0vdTERFTBA9r5u3Cw.text:
The best steamed roll (Bánh cuốn) with Northern flavor!
We were walking around to find something to eat and saw this restaurant which mentioned Northern flavor steamed roll (Bánh cuốn vị Bắc). Since I am from Hanoi where Bánh Cuốn is a popular breakfast item, I decided to give it a try, without high expectation. To my surprise, the steamed roll is so good that I forgot I am in the South!
We had steamed roll with shrimp inside. They served with two pieces of Vietnamese pork ham. Out of the world!!!
The sauce was incredible delicious. At the casher, I met with the owner, who said that he comes from Hải Phòng. He uses all ingredients from Hải Phòng including rice and fish sauce. He made the special broth from the bones to mix in the dipping sauce. This home-made dipping sauce brings the steamed roll to next level. Definitely coming back and strongly recommended!!!

I've eaten Hanoi Banh Cuon in Saigon many times, but Thanh Tri Banh Cuon has a very unique and special taste.

The fried pork rolls that come with Banh Cuon are delicious. I also ordered a plate of cinnamon pork rolls (so delicious and deep).

The owner and her son are very cute. I think this restaurant is worth the experience. I will definitely come back. Great!

The restaurant has pickled crocodile water as delicious as Hanoi
The price is reasonable, opening hours are from early morning to 8-9 pm, but the bun is sold out by late afternoon, only banh cuon and xoi are sold until 9 pm
Recommend so that you don't have to look far

ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.name: places/ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR0dWQzbENnEAE
ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.author: Vy N.
ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.text: Delicious, fresh and affordable. We went for a late dinner at 7pm and paid 65k for two plates (they only sell bánh ướt and bánh cuốn). It’s facing a very busy street so there is a lot of noise, but there’s some indoor seating if you prefer to be further away from the traffic. The lady (owner?) was very kind and not pushy, service was quick and we were very happy with the meal.

ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.name: places/ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmbE5tdktnEAE
ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.author: Jacqueline Huynh
ChIJrxa8hCMvdTERtDwoM4hJrPQ.text: Lovely street and local experience. Tons of food on this street. One plate of banh Cuon is 35k

ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.name: places/ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwMk1uTTJjVXR3UmpaRldubHVVakZWTW0xWk5VRRAB
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.author: Daniel Tran
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.text:
Visit: October 2025

Really loved this place. I'm a huge fan of steamed rice rolls (Cheung fun) and this place did not disappoint. The staff was extremely professional, the restaurant was immaculate and clean, and the owner was super and extremely welcoming and kind.

The restaurant had been visited by a lot of celebrities and is also Michelin guided. All of the dishes are big portions and are all made with quality. We had most of the different rice rolls. Each piece of the cut rice roll had big piece of it's specified type (ex. shrimp, scallop, or mushroom). Even the crispy prawn wonton was fried perfectly and was filled to the brim with prawn. The crysanthemum tea and monk fruit teas were also both really good, lightly sweetened and with a natural sweetness. It was really refreshing

The chef has been cooking rice noodles for 18 years. I would definitely recommend this place. Everything is a hit, and the pricing is fair for the service, amount of food, and quality

ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.name: places/ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205R01uUm5VMUY1Y2sxNmFGTllOMTlOWmpaNmJWRRAB
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.author: tikiwake
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.text: Recently opened nice clean establishment across from the Ben Thanh Market. The rice rolls as good or better than you can get in Canada. Mushroom and BBQ pork and fries wonton. Given free dessert. Very reasonably priced for quality fresh ingredients. Friendly staff. Recommend a visit. Only issue please reduce plastic use, no need for single use items while eating in (cups, spoons, dessert cups, paper plates, etc)

ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.name: places/ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201aVJXaFlURXRWZFVSR1ltSnliWEp3Wm1OUWRYYxAB
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.author: Jeanny Tao
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.text:
This place deserves a 10000000000/10! Service, ambiance, the owner? Everything is exceptional here!! We wandered around HCMC and was looking for some dinner and wandered across this restaurant. The chef is so friendly and patient with us to explain the different dishes and his cooking technique. The cheong fun was amazing! Literally the best cheong fan I’ve ever had in my life. It was so smooth and juicy and flavorful. And the spicy sauce on the side just adds flavor.

The owner is a famous Singaporean and opened his first Vietnam flagship here. He also gave us some stuff on the house!

If you want amazing food and excellent service, come eat here!! You will not regret it :)

ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.name: places/ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSYVdWOW1WekYzWWxwMFNucFZjekpzVDNkWWJHYxAB
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.author: T Nguyen
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.text:
Had a lovely experience eating here with the family. The owner was at the store and he was so nice! He recommended the best sellers and asked us how everything tasted as we were enjoying the banh cuong. The sauce is flavored very well and the banh cuon was very soft and consistent.
We had the #2 + #3 + fried wonton. We had to get another order of each #2 and #3. I greatly appreciate how clean the kitchen is!
Definitely would come again.

ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.name: places/ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xVFRIVklUVXQyT0dSa1dtbFVRVFZQTlV4ZmJXYxAB
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.author: Kevin Le
ChIJhUD6B44vdTERnHhEVPKIsc0.text: I didn’t plan on reviewing; so I didn’t take any photos prior to eating the dish.  You can tell from the photo that I enjoyed what we ordered whole-heartedly.  The dishes were light and super fresh!  The soy sauce is flavorful and on point.  Stellar service from the staff… very kind and attentive.

ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.name: places/ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYa2ItQmJnEAE
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.author: Jane D
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.text: ⭐️✨ What a hidden gem! It comes out so hot and the taste is delicious! I ordered the Bánh Cuốn- Tiêu Chuẩn. It was loaded with toppings. While I’m usually a fan of basic dishes without any toppings at all, this was different. I loved the full impact of different flavours. The service was really fast and was really friendly as we got to the restaurant. I picked a different size dish at the start and I was advised that that would be too big in comparison to the one that I picked afterwards. I’d like to say that the idea of the fish sauce coming out of the teapot is a convenient and unique clean way so that it doesn’t spill everywhere.✨⭐️

ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.name: places/ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZcXN1OWhBRRAB
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.author: Trí Âu
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.text: The food is good, but the place is crowded during rush hour, there is not many tables, they also offer take-away

ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.name: places/ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURadE1QY2V3EAE
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.author: Ling
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.text:
Dined here for breakfast. One of my favorite banh cupn places in HCM. They make their banh cuon the way I like it: an even proportion of fillings to flour ratio, doesn’t feel oily, and each piece was thick/plump so each bite feels fulfilling in the mouth. The flavor of the fillings was perfect. I tried the regular banh cuon and the egg banh cuon (cooked to the way I like—no running yolk).

They have a combo dish that I would highly recommend! The combo has variations of meats (nem, sausage, egg rolls, etc) that goes well with the banh cuon. See attached picture.

There’s a huge menu on the wall for easy ordering in Vietnamese or you can show a picture from here of what you went. Staff were accommodating and can be helpful. Just be mindful it gets busy so it’s not really a place for you to sit down and chill with your friends. Turnover of tables/ seats are quick to accommodate the next guest. I came here a total of 3 times in my 7 days stay.

Please note, they have a separate sitting area across from their cooking stand.

And during morning traffic, it can be crazy busy both with diners and people stopping to pick up to-go.

But it’s worth it!

ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.name: places/ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKa055amNREAE
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.author: Christina Huynh
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.text: This place is packed for breakfast. Bánh cuốn trứng (rice rolls with eggs) is always my go-to order here. The rice sheet is quite thick because of the egg but the texture is not sickeningly doughy. Inside the rolls, the mouth-watering aroma of the filling consisting of minced pork, chopped onions, jicama, wood ear mushrooms, and black pepper will tantalize the your tastebuds. These pillowy rolls are served hot with fresh basil, bean sprouts, cilantro, and delicious fish sauce. Quick, filling, and affordable.

ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.name: places/ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURGd2J2VzVRRRAB
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.author: Chinh Nguyen
ChIJL0I1Ot8odTER6u6o-NA8I0E.text: Great hidden local gem. This is as good as bánh cuốn gets. It’s a little tricky to get here, the streets are narrow, and the moped traffic is high…but it’s a great place if you’re looking for cheap, authentic, and local.  Note - Sit down area is across from where they make it.

ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.name: places/ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21rMlJteDFkSFZDVEdOalp6RjRRazFtVlY5blVWRRAB
ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.author: Casa H.
ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.text:
Worth a try - old time place for Saigonese.

This place is one of an old time place.

Location: near the Binh Dan Hospital and very easy to find.
Accommodation: well-maintained and lots of space, easy to park your bike, no parking slot for auto.
Staff: appropriate friendly.
Pricing: for us, it is acceptable as the dish is good, served with fresh vegetables, plain fish sauce and 1/4 of Vietnamese sausage.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants to try one of an old time street shop of Saigon.

ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.name: places/ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3ck9mckhREAE

ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.text:
cant say no to freshly made Banh Cuon in the morning!

each plate only has three hand made Banh Cuon, so if ur hungry youll need to order two plates
well flavoured, served with a pretty decent cut of Cha (a viet ham) and so makes it still a decent eat.

local style seating on small stools n tables.
only open in the mornings until sold out!

I think ideally, if you go with one more person, you can definitely do 1 plate without and 1 plate with chả and that would still be enough chả for both.

ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.name: places/ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURRaThDamZ3EAE
ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.author: Trinh Pham
ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.text:
Not even my first time trying, but consistently, they amazed me how disappointing their ‘banh cuon’ is. Every damn time, the filling is dry as hell.

The only reason why I’ve had to visit the spot was because I was in the area and is almost lunch time so most breakfast stalls were closed.

On top of that, their topping as in ‘cha’ was mid. They give you a big chunk of it but the flavor and texture ain’t right. But, at least their fish sauce is decent and their fried shallots is homemade (not mixed with flour)

ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU.name: places/ChIJuQeRAiQvdTERw_Uk6FzkdnU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wQk5ETmlOSEpSTTNCelJVbDVjV3hzVm1wUlNtYxAB

Typical banh cuon restaurant that is now relocate from street to a house for better enjoyment of their specialities.
Must see

A strong competitor among many banh cuon shops in Hoang Dieu 2 area.

ChIJ-7uFiN0udTERr8hWdGUMNGQ.text: The bánh cuốn and shrimp cake here were very fresh and tasty. Their fish sauce was light and delicate, which I like more than the typical thick and sweet fish sauce in the other places. Despite being a small place in an alley, the food was surprisingly good here.

ChIJ-7uFiN0udTERr8hWdGUMNGQ.name: places/ChIJ-7uFiN0udTERr8hWdGUMNGQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aRVZHbFRiR3RZTFdka0xVZFJVMEozY1hFM1JYYxAB

ChIJ-7uFiN0udTERr8hWdGUMNGQ.text: Definitely a must if you are in Saigon. I have been coming here for years. Probably written quite a few reviews about this place on different platforms so there's no need to post anymore photos. If I am craving for bánh cuốn then it's here.

ChIJNz0ptsQvdTERX92XG7DqNi0.text: My favorite banh cuon stall since I was a child. The quality and quantiy never disappoints me.

ChIJNz0ptsQvdTERX92XG7DqNi0.name: places/ChIJNz0ptsQvdTERX92XG7DqNi0/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURhd0thdmtRRRAB
ChIJNz0ptsQvdTERX92XG7DqNi0.author: ngan ta
ChIJNz0ptsQvdTERX92XG7DqNi0.text: Delicious cake, good quality, lots of food, cheap too. Everyone should try it.

ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.author: Ben Herman
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.text: Really fantastic steamed Cantonese rice rolls. We got four options and they were all really tasty. Prices are super affordable and the service was very friendly and fast, even at lunchtime on a Saturday. I can’t choose a favorite because they were all so good. Lots of motorbike parking available on the sidewalk out front.

ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.name: places/ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNYl8wSWZBeTV5LU1BEAE
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.author: Rae Zyon
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.text: Delicious rice rolls. Absolutely worth the trip here. Plenty of filling to choose from, the prawns are fresh, the beef is tender and velvety, all wrapped in a soft and smooth rice roll. Flood it with their seasoned soy sauce, it is simple, flavourful and delicious. The siumai is also exceptional, plump, juicy and very well seasoned.

ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.name: places/ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMNmE1b1gxeEpTWlFREAE
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.author: Vi Hoang
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.text: Just a takeaway but still full of flavor. Their best dishes I think if egg rice roll, even after cool down still soft, moist and full of flavor. The dipping and sate also a big plus to their dishes. Xiaomai and hargow were not as expected

ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.name: places/ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNMM1l5ejZnRRAB
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.author: Carl Shi
ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.text:
Walk passed from this hidden gem food store, serving Cantonese style steamed savoury rice roll with meat or seafood. Great taste, fresh ingredients and well balanced sauces and the texture of the prawn s and pork mince.
We had one then purchase another one for takeaway.

Worth go and try which  is inexpensive, fresh and good taste.

ChIJ07H6CwcvdTERN10SE-39Jng.text: I ate here today and had to wait for a long time, but the restaurant still prioritized take-out orders first.

ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM.text: They have egg rolls as well and it is amazing. ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM.text: I bought a box of banh cuon early this morning and when I brought it home and opened it, there was no filling, only the outer shell.

ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM.name: places/ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSMmI2ek1nEAE
ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM.author: ha nguyen
ChIJs5_RR6sudTERPeyIpPc01HM.text:
Lễ nên rảnh chạy con đường Độc Lập buổi sáng để khám phá rồi tình cờ phát hiện quán bánh cuốn này khá thú vị.
@Về cấu trúc: Mình ấn tượng từ ngoài vào trong. Nhin ngoài thấy quán rộng rãi, dễ đậu xe, bảng hiệu, đồ ăn nhìn khá chuyên nghiệp. Bước vô thấy quán tráng bánh bằng cái máy, đóng nước mắm bằng máy, xe chiên bánh hoành tráng nữa là thêm 1 trầm trồ.
Tổng kết là quán có sự sắp xếp khoa học, gọn gàng và chuyên nghiệp
@Về chất lượng : Tổng thể dĩa bánh ăn cũng được. 7/10 điểm. Vỏ bánh xay từ gạo, pha bột vừa phải nên kết cấu ăn dẻo, không cứng. Số lượng bánh cuốn khá nhiều nên ăn no nha
Nhân bánh gồm củ sắn, nấm mèo, thịt băm. Tỷ lệ củ sắn nhiều và quán xào không bị khô nên ăn đỡ ngán. Dĩa bánh có 2 lát chả gồm chả chiên, chả lụa. Thêm 1 miếng bánh khoai, 1 nửa cái bánh cống size nhỏ. Cuối cùng là 1 lát nem nhỏ  Chả, và bánh chiên mình thấy không ấn tượng . Bánh chiên dầu nên ngấy. Nem chua ngon nhưng cho ít quá. Rau ăn kèm chủ yếu là dưa leo. Mình thích rau nên là giá, độn vài sợi dưa leo mỏng. Như vậy thì cảm giác nhai giòn tan hơn là giòn cứng như dưa leo.
Nước mắm cũng ổn nhưng thiên ngọt. Giảm độ đậm đà đi mình nghĩ ăn ok hơn
@ Về giá: Quán nằm ở mặt tiền mà giá bánh đầy đủ chỉ 30k. Các món nước uống mình chưa thử nhưng nhìn giá thì khá bình dân.
Tóm lại đây là quán bánh cuốn ok để ăn sáng cho một ngày mới hay dắt bạn bè khu vực khác tới để giới thiệu. Quán cũng có nét hay hay, đặc biệt để giới thiệu đó các bạn.

ChIJzyyRiJQvdTERa8XVUXxNqnE.text:
Follow @bredgyeats on instagram for more food posts!

Very few master texture the way banh cuon/steamed rice noodle rolls does. The rice wrapper is silky smooth and lightly glutinous, that houses a modest amount of minced pork, shrimp, wood ear mushrooms, and a layer of egg for extra richness. By itself, it might be missing something, and you'd be right. The dish is completed by the crispy fried shallots and nuoc cham, which is a sweet, lemony and savory fish sauce that the banh cuon should be swimming in. On the side, Vietnamese coriander adds an herby layer, the blanched bean sprouts bring a crisp freshness, and the pork sausages add another dimension of savoriness.

ChIJbf2j6ugudTER7FoPoW-Jo-I.author: Alex
ChIJbf2j6ugudTER7FoPoW-Jo-I.text:
If Michelin gave stars for family-run bánh cuốn joints, this place would already have three.

We’ve been loyal patrons since 2018, which officially makes us part of the extended family. The bánh cuốn here? Silky, soft, and filled with more love than your average rom-com. You know it's authentic when Grandma keeps a watchful eye from the back like a bánh cuốn godmother, ensuring everything runs smoother than the rice rolls themselves.

The team? Exceptionally friendly — suspiciously so. I’ve never felt more welcomed while holding chopsticks in one hand and existential joy in the other. And the nước mắm? It's got the perfect kick — like being lovingly slapped by a chilli.

Best part? You get to enjoy your meal while District 10’s traffic orchestra serenades you with a symphony of motorbikes and honking — the true Saigon brunch soundtrack. Where else can you eat while contemplating the chaos of urban planning?

Perfect for breakfast, post-breakfast, and pre-lunch snacks. Don’t walk — drift through the honking scooters and get yourself a seat. Just don’t take mine.

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.author: Am I XNhi?
ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.text:
The restaurant is crowded, but I have lived in Go Vap for more than 20 years and only now know about this restaurant. Both inside and outside, there are only about 4-5 tables; from pouring cakes, standing at the counter to serving and cleaning, they are all family members, middle-aged uncles and aunts.

I ordered Banh cuon trung nhien (35K).
- Side dishes include 2 pieces of sausage, 1/2 spring roll, 1 piece of shrimp cake and 1 nem chua ball.
- The rice rolls are thin and soft, I really had to wow when I tried the first chopsticks
- The best is the spring rolls: inside is full of taro, green beans, very flavorful; outside is crispy.
- The fried spring rolls are very crumbly, tasteless.
- My plate has 2 fried spring rolls, while my younger brother's plate has 1 spring roll - 1 pork roll. It is a family restaurant so it is not very professional.
- Diluted fish sauce, just right for my bland taste
- Crispy fried onions, the restaurant also gives a generous amount

The plate size here is small, the standard portion only has 1 rice cake - cut into 6-7 slices or so. So my younger brother had to order an extra plate of rice cake. Breakfast for the two of us was 90K, not cheap in this Go Vap area.

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.name: places/ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR4NGFmWl9RRRAB
ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.author: Dũng Phạm
ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.text:
Looking at the restaurant when I entered, I guessed it was hot. I admit that this is the most delicious banh cuon restaurant I've eaten in Go Vap.
The owner and her son kept ordering, placing orders... running around without stopping, customers kept coming in. But the service was still very fast because there was someone making the banh cuon separately so I didn't have to wait too long.
The only thing I wasn't satisfied with was the dipping fish sauce which was too bland. Saigonese people usually pour this fish sauce directly onto the banh cuon plate and slurp it while eating, making it bland. Okay fine 👌
1 portion of cake + sausage (I don't eat shrimp cake, tofu, nem chua...) because I eat Northern style so it feels weird so I don't eat, whoever likes to eat can eat 🤣
After that, I still felt hungry and not full enough so I ordered another portion of rice rolls, total 42k (my mom said 43k, but my son said 42k) 🤔 why are there 2 prices 🙄
After paying, my son is like a young man so he didn't forget to say thank you, but my mom must have been tired because of the crowd and didn't have the habit of saying thank you for buying so she didn't say anything.

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.name: places/ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURVNE0zMndBRRAB

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.text: Banh cuon 708 has been sold here for a long time, maybe 20 years. At first, it was a mother and daughter who sold it, then passed it on to the daughter in the family. The cake is delicious, with a Northern flavor,... in addition to side dishes such as pork roll, cinnamon, or spring rolls, there is also tofu to eat with it. The vegetable plate is always huge, very delicious. Average price 27k/portion.

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.text: The restaurant is quite crowded, customers order first, and the hot food is quite delicious. Affordable price. Only sold in the morning.

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.name: places/ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPME1PUHdnRRAB

ChIJO-ytL2wpdTERLYn_BwC0DwM.text:
It's been a long time since I've been in Go Vap and now I know there's a delicious banh cuon shop like this. The fish sauce is delicious, the shop is a bit small and has wet egg rolls.
The large plate of only 32 pieces includes cakes, fried shrimp cakes that are quite crispy, fried pork rolls and a portion of spring rolls served with lettuce and mixed bean sprouts that are quite clean, and fried onions are quite crispy and yummy!
It's always busy with customers and shippers, but rest assured that the food will still arrive as quickly as usual. The shop's premises are small so parking space is limited. Too delicious for a morning.

ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk.author: Hang Nguyen
ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk.text:
- The cake is extremely delicious, guys -
The content and appearance are both beautiful. I am a fan of banh gio, so when I heard about banh gio with 7 quail eggs, I tried it right away.
The first thing I did after unboxing was to 'count the quail eggs' :)... 7 eggs and a lot of meat filling... the cake crust is chewy, soft, and the filling is fragrant. The taste is very good for me. Unfortunately, after buying it, it is no longer the preferred heat level.
I also really like the 'environmental friendliness' of Bep Nha Tui. Paper bags and no plastic strings to wrap the cake. Completely eliminating plastic bags and plastic spoons is great.
The price at the counter is 25k for geo 7-egg meat banh gio, ordering from Go Viet is 5k more, not including shipping fee.
The price is reasonable compared to the quality of the cake
Must try for the banh gio team :)

ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk.text:
Bánh giò Bếp Nhà Tui
632 Trường Sa, P.17, Q.PN

I craved bánh giò so I ordered this place to try it. The cake is pictured as shredded chicken with shiitake mushrooms and 7 quail eggs. Lots of chicken, shiitake mushrooms, 7 quail eggs, plus a bag of chili sauce.
The packaging is beautiful, hygienic, and the taste is ok. But ordering on GRAB, NOW, LOSHIP, GO-VIET is more expensive than 5k 😭 Like this cake is 30k, normally buying on the spot is 25k

ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk.name: places/ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNjeDZPNEh3EAE

ChIJJfXk6R0pdTERoscHy3Fxmfk.text: Suddenly craving for banh gio, I searched NOW and found this shop. Seeing the beautiful pictures, the high price (25k for 1 banh gio is not cheap) I thought it must be delicious so I immediately ordered a Banh gio with minced pork and wood ear mushroom and 3 eggs. But when I received it, it was over. The cake is extremely bad. This is the worst banh gio I have ever eaten. The cake is soggy. I felt sorry for the money so I tried to eat it but couldn't eat it and had to throw away more than half of it. The cake was soggy like it was spoiled or something, I don't know but it was disgusting and made my throat feel sick. In general, the food quality is terrible, far worse than the 10k banh gio at Circle K (more than 15k but got 2 quail eggs, and the cake is incredibly bad).

ChIJoUUjOyAvdTERtxQQS1ObD2k.text: Try it now, the ultimate in mixed dry noodles. Many textures and flavors. ChIJ_TqvZYAudTERghcSMwsI4q8.text: It's been 20 years since I've been back, the taste is still delicious, the broth is just sweet enough - the meat is fragrant. The floor is dirty from the many people coming to eat at this shop. you sit on a stool, and use another stool as your table. It's a fun, bustling experience if you like experiencing local eateries. The people running the shop seemed nice.

ChIJKZycAJEndTERSywP846_pWs.author: Magdalena Szewczyk
ChIJKZycAJEndTERSywP846_pWs.text:
Unfortunately, I have to leave a negative review of this place. Although the food was really delicious, we were unpleasantly surprised when it came time to pay the bill.

Like most tourists, I don’t speak Vietnamese. I ordered a dish from the menu priced at 68,000 VND, pointing to it with my finger since the waiter didn’t speak English. However, when we received the bill, the price was 83,000 VND plus a tip, so the total turned out to be much higher.

The staff said it wasn’t their fault that I didn’t understand what I was ordering (apparently, the base price was only for the noodles and broth, and the meat cost extra). Apart from saying “sorry,” they didn’t make any effort to resolve the situation and insisted that we pay the full amount.

During the discussion, it turned out that the rest of the staff actually spoke English quite well. Why didn’t they send someone over to explain how ordering works in this restaurant? The menu is unclear, and as a European, I’m used to all additional charges being clearly stated — no surprises or hidden fees.

Unfortunately, this experience left a bad impression. :(

ChIJJ8M88jApdTERhyEBimfJ2RY.text: This was my first time trying these dishes! I really liked the bánh đúc nóng thịt but did not care for xôi xéo (my personal preference). I thought the bánh đúc nóng was a good mixture of textures and flavors, although I think I should have ordered more for a lunch. Service was good but I definitely got a weird look for ordering in vnese with my American accent. The dining area is very small but it’s got AC. No tra da but they have other bottled drinks. There’s a bit of room outside for motorbike parking.

ChIJJ8M88jApdTERhyEBimfJ2RY.text:
one of the best Banh Duc in town!

its a little hidden away.. but easy enough to find as its on the corner of an alleyway

their menu is simple with basically two main dishes to choose from. but these guys do it gooooood!

the place is tiny.. seats maybe 2-3 small groups inside.. and a couple seats outside

ChIJJ8M88jApdTERhyEBimfJ2RY.text: Difficult to find ban duc and xoi xeo in HCM so was happy to eat here as their dishes are excellent. I had the special topping for both and it was a lot of food. Each dish was around 50k dong I think. Worth visiting if you're after an unusual dish only usually found in Hanoi.

ChIJJ8M88jApdTERhyEBimfJ2RY.text: Hands down one of the best meals I’ve ever had in my life

ChIJjUjlHmApdTERxORW6tbTnZ0.text: Really lovely food with a ton of great toppings! The chicken with mushrooms and the minced pork were both excellent. The sauce is VERY sweet. If you’ve never had this dish, this is a perfect place to try it. Service was fast and friendly and the store is neat and clean. Theres room for motorbike parking available on the sidewalk.

ChIJjUjlHmApdTERxORW6tbTnZ0.text: Was taken here by a member of staff from my hotel, it was one of the nicest bowls of food I have ever eaten fully loaded it cost less than £1.30 with soft boiled quail eggs and one of the sweetest broths I have tasted laid on a bed of pillows of soft rice sheets.

ChIJjUjlHmApdTERxORW6tbTnZ0.text: Came here for the experience. I had the full topping, but it wasn't that much. It was not very hot, and I didn't find it very tasty. Rather disappointed.

ChIJjUjlHmApdTERxORW6tbTnZ0.text: Small and crowded. The food is very good. Worth my money.

ChIJRxLOTQkpdTERXYi0m-h2k4I.text: Local store tucked in an alley. It’s an unique Vietnamese food similar to Banh Cuon and it is good to try. It’s hard to get in here and the store is very local with only some low chairs and no tables.

ChIJRxLOTQkpdTERXYi0m-h2k4I.text:
A mix of sweet, salt fish sauce. Really soft and tender steam rice cake with meat topping.
Highly recommend: Bánh đúc, Cheese yoghurt, bánh ít trần

ChIJRxLOTQkpdTERXYi0m-h2k4I.text: Nothing can beat a hot bowl of banh duc on a rainy day
