ChIJRxLOTQkpdTERXYi0m-h2k4I.text: The best Banh Duc in Vietnam. It tastes the same since I had it as a kid. Owned and run by a family of sisters. Excellent service.

ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.name: places/ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VOVDMyT0hfd0llZlNBEAE
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.author: Gia Thanh Dang
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.text: The banh duc here is delicious and served quickly. The space is cozy and comfortable—not too big, but just right for a casual meal. Prices are reasonable, making it a great spot for a tasty and affordable bite.

ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.name: places/ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25rNVdIRmxXREJDTmtwMWNVSkVNVlJHWldZeVgyYxAB
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.author: Thy Nguyen
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.text: The Nong Nguyen Banh Duc Restaurant at 63D Pham Van Hai, Ward 3, Tan Binh District is an ideal place for those who love rustic Vietnamese food. The restaurant space is clean, cozy, with simple wooden tables and chairs creating a sense of closeness. The hot banh duc dish is fragrant and fatty, with rich filling, served with a mildly spicy garlic and chili fish sauce, very tasty. There are also stir-fried pork noodles, banh beo, che khuc bach and many other refreshing dishes. The prices are reasonable, only from 26,000 - 45,000 VND. The restaurant serves quickly and friendly, and has both GrabFood and ShopeeFood. A place worth trying for a delicious, warm meal in the heart of Saigon.

ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.name: places/ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21aT2RWWkZNQzFZV1RGcWVIVjZYelp4ZVdzdExWRRAB
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.author: Nhi Nguyen
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.text:
I have visited the restaurant many times and have always been satisfied. I find the banh duc with shredded chicken thighs and shiitake mushrooms and the banh duc with mixed eggs to be very reasonable, with plenty of toppings and moderate portions. The fish sauce mixed here is a big plus, rich but not too strong. In particular, the fried onions are crispy and fragrant, and extremely delicious to eat with. The banh duc is soft, smooth, easy to eat, and you can eat it forever without getting bored. 

The restaurant space is simple, clean, and airy. The staff is fast and friendly. The price is reasonable compared to the quality (26k - 40k). The restaurant has many branches so it is very convenient to visit. 

📌 Personal score: 

• Taste: 9/10 

• Price: 8.5/10 

• Space: 8/10 

• Service: 9/10 

Overall, this is one of the most delicious and stable banh duc restaurants I have ever eaten at. It is worth recommending to friends and will definitely come back many more times.

ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.name: places/ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnOWNQNHhnRRAB
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJgb4KwC8pdTERw9ofufbz3LE.text:
The branch of Banh Duc Nguyen is in Van Kiep, Binh Thanh.

The Pham Van Hai side is twice as big, more spacious, airy and bright.

The menu here has an additional dish of stir-fried pork vermicelli, because I ate full-topping banh duc at Van Kiep, so I came here to order stir-fried pork vermicelli to try.

1 bowl is 45k, looks very full and beautiful.

- There is still delicious fatty pork roll, fragrant and crispy fried onions, but the stir-fried pork is dry, feels like it has been stir-fried 2-3 times. The marinade is not very good.

2 spring rolls are as small as a thumb, the rice paper is very thick, I don't rate it highly.

- The fish sauce is sour, when you bring it out to touch the bowl, it feels quite hot, but has a strong garlic smell.

The plus point is that there is sour papaya which is quite strange and delicious.

In short, next time I won't eat stir-fried pork vermicelli when I come here, I will only order banh duc, because banh duc is more delicious.

ChIJcxbqOMMvdTERGE-XfeCm1SQ.name: places/ChIJcxbqOMMvdTERGE-XfeCm1SQ/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WeVIxOVRkRkJHY0VWeWNWVmZiRVl4ZVc1c2NVRRAB
ChIJcxbqOMMvdTERGE-XfeCm1SQ.author: Ben Herman
ChIJcxbqOMMvdTERGE-XfeCm1SQ.text: This spot is takeaway only, and service is very fast. I got two regular bowls and they were warm and very tasty, with a good amount of toppings. The sauce wasn’t too sweet and made the dish very good. They have a few different varieties but the standard bowl is 30k. A great snack for a cool day.

ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.name: places/ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxbW9HZkJREAE
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.author: Nguyen Ruud
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.text: The banh duc is super delicious. Although the shop is a bit small, it is one of the best banh duc shops in Saigon. Every time I come to buy, I see a lot of shippers waiting. In addition, they also sell bread and fried onions in the morning. If you have the chance, you should come and try it. It's great.

ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.name: places/ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwd1pmT3Z3RRAB
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.author: Ngà Nguyễn Thị Châu (Go Green)
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.text:
A small restaurant in an alley, with seating but I mostly see takeout.
A bowl of banh duc costs 26k but is very good quality, one bowl is enough to fill you up, hot and soft banh duc, full of toppings, fragrant and crispy homemade fried onions, sweet and salty fish sauce. There is free iced tea.
The owner is very kind and friendly.

ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.name: places/ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMtbk9EV093EAE
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.author: Uyên Ngô
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.text: The banh duc is delicious, but it's a family-style restaurant so there are few seats, mainly for take-out, fried onions and meat are too much, only 26 branches, the banh duc is hot and chewy, just my taste, the fish sauce is not too sweet, I was so worried that I forgot to take a picture 🥲 It's so delicious that I bought some for my mom and dad to eat too 😬 It's sold from 12 noon to 5-6 pm, I think

ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.name: places/ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURpb09yQ0lnEAE
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.author: Ngọc An Nguyễn Thị
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.text:
The shop opens at noon, everyone, it's sold out early but it's super delicious, eat a small bowl for 20k but you'll be full until evening akk everyone
Price 20 - 25k
Located in a small alley

ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.name: places/ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNLdktxd1pnEAE
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.author: Lan Anh Nguyen
ChIJx-XXrIUpdTERhepUJ9SSUIo.text: Delicious, should only order a small portion, a large portion is easy to get bored of. Lots of fried onions, meat and bread. Very appealing. Only remembered to take a photo halfway through eating.

ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.name: places/ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWQ1FVTTBlSGt5YlRCNE0wcFRkVlZxUTBoRk5HYxAB
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.author: Thao Huynh
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.text:
I read the review so I was curious to come down from Binh Duong to try it. The banh duc here is different than other places, it is not in pieces but a soft dough ball and has shredded chicken thighs, shiitake mushrooms, and shrimp. My friend and I came here to eat around 10am and there was only 1 portion of banh duc left so my friend ordered another portion of stir-fried pork vermicelli.
My first impression of the price is not cheap because it costs money to rent the premises so I sympathize.
Regarding the quality of the food, heavy eaters will definitely not be full, but it is okay to try it for the experience.
The stir-fried pork vermicelli has nothing special, I think my dad cooks better, probably because it doesn't suit my taste.
As for banh duc, the fish sauce is not as sweet as the reviewers said, the seller also has little chan so those who like salty food will probably have to ask for more.
As for the house number, it is 149 Le Duc Tho but the review says it is 148, we almost died looking for it. The parking lot is compact in front of the restaurant, maybe 5 motorbikes full, no car parking.
If you ask me if I would come back to eat, I would say yes, but it is one of the options when I am hungry or on the go, but not if I travel far to eat like an addict.

Thank you everyone for watching, everyone can come and try it out

ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.name: places/ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201d00waEtRVUZEYTJKRldGY3lRV1pRTmtocE1VRRAB
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.author: Winter
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.text: In my opinion, the restaurant selling Banh Duc is quite good. The stir-fried pork vermicelli dish has a slightly salty dipping sauce and the stir-fried pork is a bit salty. It may be because each person's taste is different, you can try it yourself and judge for yourself. The price is 40k - 45k for a full portion. Rating 7/10

ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.name: places/ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJdVBuS1hLbk96RGl3RRAB
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.author: VÕ CHÍ KIỆT
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.text: The food was delicious. The service was poor. I waited for a table, and I don't blame the restaurant because it was crowded. When I ordered, they said the banh beo wasn't ready yet, so they didn't order. After a while, I asked again and they said how long it would take, and they said it would take 5 minutes 😬. When the banh beo was brought out, omg my banh beo didn't have any pork fat. While watching the review, the pork fat was very full, so I had to order another bowl of pork fat. But the good thing was, I ate almost all of it before they brought out tissues and cinnamon sausage to put on the table. 🙂 Why am I leaving a review here? Because after eating, my stomach hurt, both my boyfriend and I. I confirm that it was because of the banh duc, because we hadn't eaten anything else that day except banh duc 😃. I don't blame much, but I hope the restaurant will review it.

ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.name: places/ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxalluTlZRbW80VkVWS09YRlpXbGRzTXprM1FsRRAB
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.author: Ngân Ainas
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.text: I bought take-out. I bought banh duc with full topping and banh beo. I like to eat cha. The restaurant said they ran out of cha. I bought 2 Hue cha sticks instead. The restaurant charged me but didn't put them in. My house is far away so I can't go back because I'll have to return the 2 cha sticks. I called the hotline to tell them. But the hotline didn't answer. Eating these dishes mainly with cha makes you feel the full flavor and really ruins the appetite.

ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.name: places/ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25kRFRXVlRYM0ZLYjNKV09FWnpXRUpXUzNvMFdFRRAB
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.author: Tu Quyen “Queenie” Nguyen Tran
ChIJcW0lLfYpdTERgabJ2YuqtRc.text: I arrived at the restaurant at 8:30 pm, there was no one there, I felt a bit nervous, but I went in because I was hungry. The hot rice cake was not hot, the fish sauce was salty, the staff smoking in front of the door blew smoke into the restaurant. I tried to finish eating, because the first time was like the last time.

ChIJTy3Yd9IudTEReFIs7HtZpds.name: places/ChIJTy3Yd9IudTEReFIs7HtZpds/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQzdE1DS21nRRAB
ChIJTy3Yd9IudTEReFIs7HtZpds.author: Lotus Smile
ChIJTy3Yd9IudTEReFIs7HtZpds.text: She sells across from the milk tea shop, so it's easy to find her banh duc, which is delicious with a rich dipping sauce and only 5k/piece. Everyone come and support her. She sells from 10am.

ChIJx16EOrgpdTERUoj4URS5YrA.name: places/ChIJx16EOrgpdTERUoj4URS5YrA/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kSFMydHNTRnBUTm1Gb2VVSXdjMEZyZG1Sb1oyYxAB
ChIJx16EOrgpdTERUoj4URS5YrA.author: Hoang Phu Nam
ChIJx16EOrgpdTERUoj4URS5YrA.text:
Traditional hot banh duc, Hanoi standard

The sticky banh duc blends with the fatty, sweet and soft taste of meat and crunchy wood ear mushrooms, the harmonious sweet and sour sauce, the spicy taste of chili, quite appetizing on a chilly Saigon day 😍

19 Nguyen Phi Khanh, Tan Dinh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

ChIJRxz-fakrdTERiUaScKv18P0.name: places/ChIJRxz-fakrdTERiUaScKv18P0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUR3bFlmQmF3EAE
ChIJRxz-fakrdTERiUaScKv18P0.author: Tina Doo
ChIJRxz-fakrdTERiUaScKv18P0.text: So annoyed that I had to come here to review. The first problem was the wrong dish (ordered special banh duc, delivered regular banh duc). The second problem was seeing a hair made me want to vomit. If the shop is aiming for wholesale, then do it properly, otherwise, just close it.

ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.name: places/ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNYc2RxR1lnEAE
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.author: Tú Oanh Nguyễn Thúy
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.text:
I heard that my aunt's shop sells out very quickly, so I went there but I was afraid that she would close early because it was raining, but luckily she was still selling. 

Her shop is small, neat, and delicious with chairs around the counter for everyone to sit and eat. 

That day, I ate mixed banh beo for 25k, I felt that it was quite filling, the banh duc was very fragrant and had fatty coconut milk, any girl can eat 1 portion and be full. I bought more chè for my mother for 10k/bag, my mother said it was delicious. 
The aunt did business openly and happily, the customers were polite, they ate and chatted very happily, I will come back many times to try the remaining dishes 🥰

ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.name: places/ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2cC1IR3VnRRAB
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.author: Khai Ho Thanh
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.text: Roadside restaurant so there is no place to sit or park. The food and desserts are delicious, the prices are very affordable, and the place is clean. The lady cooks the food quickly and enthusiastically.

ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.name: places/ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twSE5TMUxXRmhmYldoQ1Qxa3lkUzFKTlcxNlZrRRAB
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.author: KIERA DANG
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.text: I heard some fake reviews on FB so I drove from District 11 to here to find food (20km round trip). When I got there, I was surprised. The cart was tiny, with a small horizontal bench and a tiny vertical bench. The food was definitely not delicious and nothing special, just like any other Beo Loc restaurant that you just stop by the roadside, except that it was cheap. Because it was cheap, it was not delicious in the high-quality way for Beo Nam Loc fans. The banana cake was just flour, everything else was flour. So boring!!!

ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.name: places/ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURic003M1pBEAE
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.author: Hiếu Phúc Võ
ChIJTT2eVygpdTERodhI9T080qs.text:
Addicted to her banh beo and banh khot. Every day at 2pm (she is off on Mondays), she pushes the cart out, the menu is different every day for 6 days but every dish is delicious and especially every dish is cheap, mixed banh beo 25 branches, shrimp and meat banh khot 21 branches. She sells around 3:30pm or sometimes 3pm and it's sold out so if you want to eat, try to come early

ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.name: places/ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21GWk1pMXRiVW93YUVWRU5XeFBTMHBtVG1SVlkxRRAB
ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.author: dan
ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.text:
The entrance is marked by red banners, just brave the dark alley and you’ll be rewarded with awesome local cuisine!

BÁNH ĐÚC (NÓNG): Rice Cake (Hot)
Think porridge but in mochi form. Have only tasted sweet mochi all my life, so this is really interesting to me. When paired with a flavorful savory broth which is oily, the mochi isn’t sticky, just very soft. It works!

BÁNH ĐA (TRỘN THẬP CẨM): Rice Paper (Mixed)
“Mixed” refers to a bit of every single protein option - all kinds of pork, tofu, and even fried fish. We got the dry version and the sauce was a savory, sour concoction - reminds me of the Bar Chor Mee back home. Soup is served separately and tastes a bit like almond. Was a pretty hearty meal!

ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.name: places/ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pVd1Z6QTVZVlJVVVRoaldqUmFURnBJTnpWbE9XYxAB
ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.author: KeoneEwe Yummy
ChIJETY59PKrNTER5AJHmyMUhWc.text:
I feel I need to do community service on showing how to get there. (See my picture on map)

The entrance is on the east side of the block.  There is a small alley with the shop sign board, walk straight into until the end, the shop is on your right. (The red sign board)

The menu is clear yellow on the wall but seems no English translation.

Banh Duc Nong is the first one. It is sticky rice mochi kind of comfort food, with some toupok (fried tofu) and some minced meat, mushroom. 25k VND (2025)

It is a small bowl, don’t it is enough. More like a mid morning snack to me.

Savory. Not sweet.

Sticky rice mochi is such a good experience to taste, and playful too.

I like the texture, and the taste also okay.

The shop is small, handled by a lady, quiet, simple, honest and humble.

It would be a perfect morning breakfast if you don’t feel like hungry but wanted to eat.

Or just like me, a post-breakfast-walking-around-oh-this-is-nice-pre-lunch tasting.

A little bit of Hanoi heaven.

There you go. You are welcome.

ChIJ0d8i9VwndTER6XWO2Tq-5pI.author: Tuan Nguyen
ChIJ0d8i9VwndTER6XWO2Tq-5pI.text:
A rare hot banh duc shop in District 2 - District 9.

Passing by during rush hour, I didn't think it was crowded, so I decided not to go in, but in the end, I went in to try it.

Ordered a full topping banh duc portion, but the fat was gone right away, so the salesgirl only charged 35k.

- I think the banh duc portion is a little small for such a large amount of filling, the color of the cake is not completely opaque white but still transparent, and has a smell like lime powder, but it's okay.

- All the toppings are delicious from minced meat, quail eggs, and fish sausage, but I don't think the shrimp is very suitable.

- The fried onions are golden and crispy, just like homemade, making the banh duc more delicious.

The fish sauce is mixed perfectly, very tasty.

There is only 1 female employee, but I think the dish is made quite quickly, 3 portions are made in 5 minutes and all 3 are ready.

🙏🙏

ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0.author: Jamie H.
ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0.text: The desserts are mediocre. The Che Thai was okay, but the banh flan is not authentic. They added coconut milk or cream, making it too heavy on coconut flavor. Parking costs 2,000 VND per motorbike. Most of the staff look unhappy, and it’s clear the attitude comes from the owners. The daughter’s (owner) attitude was terrible when I was there. Too many staff for such poor service. I will not return or recommend this place. There are better dessert spots that are not on Google Maps yet.

ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0.name: places/ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VLdnR6YmFEdzVXSUFnEAE
ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0.author: REAMS
ChIJkwOVheYudTERBqpum3VVX_0.text: Good variety of sweet dishes and snacks. Nice street pavement seats. You can park your bikes or car nearby.

ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.name: places/ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNbW9sTkhqdnF5bi1RRRAB
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.author: Andrea W
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.text:
Nice little dessert stall. I would high recommend the yoghurt. Flan was not very smooth.

Desserts placed at the side of the table seem to be left there to have as extras and charged upon consumption.

ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.name: places/ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYcmVqZTl3RRAB
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.author: Gareth Keigan
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.text: a very authentic vietnamese dessert place! ordered the mix jelly (s/n 22) and the flan (s/n 3). the flan tasted like somewhat crème brûlée jelly? overall quite a decent experience here. and they also have a english menu!!! come give it a try

ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.name: places/ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNyeGFiMkFREAE
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.author: Minh Luat Le
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.text:
This Vietnamese dessert shop has a very long history (it’s even much older than me), and build their own big brand name which every single Saigon-ese can tell the shop is their childhood.

I took an order of Sâm bổ lượng (ching bo leung), Thạch thập cẩm (all mixed), yaourt (homemade yogurt), Nhãn lạnh (dried longan flesh), thạch dừa (coconut jelly). And surprisingly they’re all good. The general taste is fresh and acceptably sweet. So I think this shop is best for when you’ve had a big meal or a big hot noodle soup, and need a ‘cherry on top’ dessert to finish your whole appetite, think of this place!! Highly recommended for your food tour. I really love the yogurt, very delicious.

ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.name: places/ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURyeElma1lBEAE
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.author: Matsuda Emiko
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.text: I visited in the morning.  A staff treated me well.  There is an English menu so it's easy to order😊  Flan and Lychee jelly were so nice😋

ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.name: places/ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURubHFUVHRnRRAB
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.author: Tan Trinh Nguyen
ChIJYf9kcR8vdTEREC9zJKkmCrk.text: Good taste, not too sweet. But somtime it is too crowded and no place for parking.

ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.name: places/ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xOT1prdEdiakpVZURKUE1IcExNRVpFYUhKVGIxRRAB
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.author: Jerry Lai
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.text: Possibly the best Bộ Không I've had in Vietnam over 15 years.  A little over priced for the size, I've had bigger bowls for less but the meat was the best.  Tender and fall off the bone.

ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.name: places/ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2ejd1M0FnEAE
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.author: clink k
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.text:
We came slightly after 3pm and the place is already crowded and receiving a lot of take away orders. They had a good selection of hot dessert in small bowls. We had a banana in coconut milk, black bean, red beans, yam with sweet potato, black sesame and 2 flan.

Flan is topped with ca phe. Lovely! 7 items at 55k

Highly recommend if you want to experience local style dessert complete with seating on stools by the roadside.

ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.name: places/ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBdzY2cnp3RRAB
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.author: Michelle Salim
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.text:
Local style dessert!
Super recommended only around 7K per small portion. It makes you want to order more!

Great selling technique, you got to try everything and finally decided what you want and order more ❤️

Got this recommendation from Tiktok! Definitely a place to go to should you want to try vietnamese dessert 🫶🏻

They gave you also free tea that can help to neutralize your taste bud 😗

ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.name: places/ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURnNjhXMXB3RRAB
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.author: Vivian Chin
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.text:
We visited a dessert stall near our hotel and really liked it. You get to enjoy and experience it just like the locals do. A cool place to yam cha~
It was nice, affordable, with quick service and tasty food! Overall, it was a great experience!

ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.name: places/ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURWeDVtVjR3RRAB
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.author: Sky
ChIJIc-YAOMudTER6HiINHrGF84.text:
This sweet soup shop is very old.

The sweet soup is very delicious, and the price is very reasonable.

The service staff is very good, the shop is crowded but works very quickly, and there is no waiting.

However, there are situations where beggars often harass tourists, making the image less beautiful.

ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.name: places/ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xoMVdtdGZjVFExWmw5ZlJITnphRGN0VVhVNVJFRRAB
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.author: Lana
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.text:
Che troi was delicious. The glutinous bowls have different type of filling inside.

Che ba mau was decent but not the best i had. Egg custard was okayish

Strawbery tofu tasted like jello

ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.name: places/ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLR3Qtc191bFpQcnF3RRAB
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.author: MK
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.text: Stopped by after a long day in the heat. Hot inside too, but needed something with ice and chè was a perfect treat. Wife loved her chè troi nuoc. It was warm, but she loves that stuff. Kids and I needed something with ice and ours was good too!

ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.name: places/ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4eFpFVnhSVGswV0V0aU5FNVNjbnBRZW5aT1JrRRAB
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.author: Duong Nguyen
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.text: Good tradional Chinese dessert. All the desserts are not so sweet & come with natural taste. Highly recommend

ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.name: places/ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYZ0xTbnRnRRAB
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.author: Ai đó không phải tôi
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.text: Come here for the  雞 蛋 茶 (hột gà trà), still feel like im eating an egg, not my type, but the soup was nice. Other chè is nothing significant, i would recommend only try their signature here, fast service.

ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.name: places/ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkZzR5RC1nRRAB
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.author: Kal Pas
ChIJ67SU4vMudTERyb8_WbHBIiU.text:
I love all sweet desserts in here, they're not too sweet and were cooked until perfectly soft.
Price is a bit higher than average but the quality and quantity made me satisfied.
The store is tight and the waitresses are fast but they didn't smile much 😅😅😅
I always come here whenever I have a chance.
Highly recommend.

ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.name: places/ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOUmIzUk5kV013TTFKUFJsaGtWREF4ZEhJeWQzYxAB
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.author: Harry Dang
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.text: Great place to get authentic traditional Vietnamese sweet soups. This shop is only open in the evening between 5:00-10:30. Price range from 20k-50k depending on variety. There is no real restaurant just lots of little red table and stools on the sidewalk in front of shops that have closed for the night. Nostalgic of the old days.

ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.name: places/ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3amN5ZDRRRRAB
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.author: Phuc Phan
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.text:
Order: Chè nhãn nhục củ năng, Đậu hủ hạnh nhân, Sâm bổ lượng.

💛 Great variety of Chinese Chè for you to choose from. The nhãn nhục and sâm bổ lượng tasted great, not that sweet.
🤔 Đậu hủ hạnh nhân was too sweet. Some of the options have more sugar, so be cautious when you order.
🤔 Portion was small compared to the price, but service was quick and efficient.
😵‍💫 Plenty of street parking with an attendant, but you have to pay a small fee. There are tables on both sides of the streets, so you may have to cross that busy street to get to your table.

ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.name: places/ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYMjRUejNnRRAB
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.text:
This place is always packed with people waiting for their chè. I do not get what keeps the hype going, to be honest.

Their chè is not that great, it is overpriced, the hygiene is questionable, the seats are uncomfortable, and you have to eat in dim lighting. And, to make matters worse, they charge you VND 5.000 for parking!

Some dishes let you choose how sweet you want them. But the longan and water chestnut chè I had was way too sweet and mushy for my taste. The water chestnuts were not even crunchy.

I have seen loads of overseas Viets and tourists here. If you want a better overall experience, I would recommend Tuong Phong instead, it is only a few streets away.

ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.name: places/ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURkLWRERDRBRRAB
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.author: Linh Tran
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.text: I recently tried "Chè cột điện," a popular street-side dessert spot. The place was bustling, but unfortunately, it seemed like my order was forgotten, as it took a while to be served. The pricing felt a bit steep for the portion sizes offered. However, the dessert itself was pleasantly sweet and light, making it quite enjoyable. A nice touch was the complimentary iced tea provided. Despite the wait and the price, the dessert experience was decent.

ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.name: places/ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPME5HSWFBEAE
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.author: GNG
ChIJG799GPQudTERKvaAr857_0I.text: Old fashion dessert shop in Chinatown District 5. You can taste many hot and cold Chinese style Che while seating on the sidewalk in the calm evening. Price is about 25kd for each. You can try the boiled egg in sweet tea one or the classic Sam Bo Luong.

ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.name: places/ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214eE5EWlZVMjVuZGxjelJIQmZSMmx2T0d3eVVYYxAB
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.author: Gia Thanh Dang
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.text: I used to enjoy Chè Khúc Bạch Thanh back when it was at the old location, and although the shop has now moved a bit farther away, I’m glad I visited again. The new space feels much cleaner and more comfortable, with a cooler and fresher atmosphere than before, which makes the experience even more enjoyable.

ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.name: places/ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ObWRWUXhOQzFFWTE5VE1HUTBVMmgzYTBGT2RGRRAB
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.author: Wincent Lie
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.text: Highly recommended. Love their panacota & matcha jelly. Super refreshing..

ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.name: places/ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwa2VHV1pBEAE
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.author: Ony
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.text:
Tried the local dessert. It was fresh.

We tried the jackfruit and lychee. The bowl we ordered was small and the price was 25k. It was OK.

The dessert was just OK for us.
Maybe it is good dessert for many other people.

ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.name: places/ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN2N3JUTkZ3EAE
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.author: Jules Dang
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.text: Delicious dessert, especially on a hot day in Saigon. Light, yummy, fresh. Highly recommend.

ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.name: places/ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURwaEtDdEp3EAE
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.author: Emily Lek
ChIJWToKDcwodTERcPcy-cX7Qd4.text: This Vietnamese panna cotta place is great. The little cubes of panna cotta were firm and had great texture in each bite (the mango pudding ones were my favourite for their stand-out flavour). The not-too-sweet soup and longans as well as mixed fruits were also super refreshing on a hot sleepy afternoon.

ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.name: places/ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xveU9VZHRaM1JKY1RGWU5IVjVOamN0ZG1RMVdsRRAB
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.author: LouAnn BT
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.text: Nice Che, good presentable, almost bot enough sweet but that’s not the restaurant fault. It’s advertised no sweet che :) (found out after the fact). Tiny Bit Higher price than other places

ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.name: places/ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toU2IxQXhjSFJxVFhKRGJtdEtUMmRPTm1aeFMwRRAB
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.author: Alec
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.text: Came here with local friends, great place to relax, socialise and enjoy great tasting dessert. It's sweet yet refreshing, perfect after a big meal.

ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.name: places/ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmNV9PeUdBEAE
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.author: A N
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.text:
I absolutely love this place! The combo chè, especially with durian mixed in, is absolutely delicious. Chè holds a special place in my heart – it's a dessert my mom loves, and growing up, it was always around. Every time I eat it now, it brings back memories of her and feels like a comforting taste of home.

The shop itself is wonderful and cute, with a great location that makes it easy to stop by whenever I’m in the area. If you're a fan of chè or just looking to try something new and nostalgic, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommend!

ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.name: places/ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWc0xVaEpkRnB1TmtVd2RGRmlXa05CY2xoalQyYxAB
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.author: Petr Studený
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.text: Chè Miss Đác was my favorite chè during my travels across Vietnam. I'll miss it. Ngon!

ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.name: places/ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNibl9QYzdRRRAB
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.author: The MY World
ChIJx4af0SIpdTERUFWkG-QTKjo.text: It's Vietnamese sweets shop. The shop is nice looking and the good place for relax with friends. The sweets are ok, I don't say awsome but tastes good anyway.

ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.name: places/ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRNzhTSEVBEAE
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.text:
If you are after a place that does a bit of everything – snacks, proper meals, and drinks – without being too fussy, this shop might do the trick.

Personally, I am not a huge fan of their sweet soup, it is alright for quenching your thirst, but the flavour does not really stick around.

The "syrup cocktails"? Well, the fruit chunks are massive, some are far too sweet, and others are just a bit bland. Khuc Bach? Disappointing texture, really, far too soft and crumbly.

ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.name: places/ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPLUt6cEpREAE
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.author: Tri Vuong
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.text: One of the ideal place to hang out with friend after work. More snack foods and sweet soups. The specialty of this shop is Batata sweet soup for both using hot and cold. Quick service with nice staffs. The quality is so good and the price is reasonable!!!

ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.name: places/ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJanp6dF95czd1OTJnRRAB
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.author: Trinh Thien Phat
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.text:
Average, not a wow!
The space is quite small although the price is reasonable! Am I coming back? Yeah nah.

ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.name: places/ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNmcExIc0pnEAE
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.author: Fred Jaeger
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.text:
Banh flan was not jelly ish but hard
Black bean with pandan is not so good

ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.name: places/ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuNDgyTmJ3EAE
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.author: Kai Warner
ChIJlztbWykvdTERElvCg23pEoI.text: Such a nice atmosphere and the food was DELICIOUS! The staff didn’t speak English, but they have an English menu. We ordered off an image from a prior Google review which made it a lot easier. Overall definitely recommend!

ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.name: places/ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBd29UNTZ3RRAB
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.author: Han Le Duc
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.text:
Great sweet soup, cheap and just stop to eat then go or you can seat there eat.
Have been eaten here since i was a student. Still love the taste and the vibe here

ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.name: places/ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQwaVlLZ1hREAE
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.author: Eddie Wan
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.text: This street dessert stall has been selling over 40 years and the owner has 80 years old, still working , the desserts not so sweet and cheap just cost 5,000 vnd/ bowl, many of youngsters customers , must come to try ...

ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.name: places/ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNBNzk2cXpRRRAB
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.author: Le Duy
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.text: Sweet soup shop at night after 9 pm of 2 old people. The shop has existed for 41 years. This is an interesting place for you to discover the cuisine in Saigon.

ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.name: places/ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURoa1kyZE5nEAE
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.author: Kev Ngh
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.text: Very cheap and delicious Vietnamese desserts, 10K per small bowl

ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.name: places/ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNZbTkydTBBRRAB
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.author: See You In Viet Nam
ChIJ_wp7U9godTER8vdvgm0cXGU.text: Want to experience something really Saigon, have been selling sweet soup since 1976 by an elderly couple. The stall sell on the street with 5 different types of sweet soups, they sell from 9pm until sold out (probably midnight). 5,000VND a small bowl.

ChIJvZhsyNIodTERjjnrc-zmBO8.author: Lola Nguyen
ChIJvZhsyNIodTERjjnrc-zmBO8.text: If you fancy a delicious hot chè, this place is for you. It is really really good, a real highlight of Must go vietnamese dessert list. She has incredible list of "chè" which are all delicious. I love chè bà ba (taro, sweet potatos, tapioca bubble, and some other ingredients), chè bắp (sweet corn), chè đậu trắng (white bean). If you prefer less sweet, ask her to not put in coconut milk. The place has no sign so go slowand pay attention to your left side. Best option is to take away. Selling time starts around 7pm and it can be crowded sometimes. Price is 20,000/cup. Better to go with a vietnamese if you are not fluent in vietnamese as the seller's voice is a bit difficult to understand, I could barely understand what she said and always had to ask her to repeat lol. The other vietnamese cakes are worth to try too especially "bánh da lợn" (vietnamese steamed layered tapioca cake)

ChIJvZhsyNIodTERjjnrc-zmBO8.text: I ordered white bean sweet soup and nhon sweet soup. Overall, the sweet soup is not as sweet as the traditional sweet soup. The sweet soup portions here are a bit large, so those who want to eat many dishes will have a hard time. I rate the white bean sweet soup 8/10, the nhon sweet soup 8/10. I will come back. The owner is very friendly. She said this sweet soup shop has been in business for 40 years.

ChIJb75ZvvYvdTER72Du6K7d7lc.name: places/ChIJb75ZvvYvdTER72Du6K7d7lc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUM3OEpmUTV3RRAB
ChIJb75ZvvYvdTER72Du6K7d7lc.author: Xuân Trung Lê
ChIJb75ZvvYvdTER72Du6K7d7lc.text:
I found out about the restaurant after going out to eat in District 5, because the restaurant closed quite late and I liked sweets, I stopped by to try. The staff here were friendly and served the dishes quite quickly. I mean sweet soup, it seems they also sell snacks.

Snow armor sweet soup, snow armor is the mucous membrane in the ovary of the female snow frog. You can find more information on Google. At the restaurant, they cook snow armor with fresh milk. Snow armor does not have a distinctive smell, nor is it fishy, ​​besides the good effects it brings, it also has no taste. So personally, I think this restaurant cooks it well with milk. In 1 bowl, snow armor does not have too much.

Durian sweet soup, as in the picture you can see in the sweet soup there is fresh durian, cocoa jelly and tapioca starch, this dish is eaten cold, the sweet soup is not too sweet. They also choose delicious durian, so those who like durian might like this dish.

Taiwanese sweet soup has cao qui linh, you can taste it right away, but I don't remember much about the other two types of flour. The sweet soup is cooked to a moderate sweetness.

Red bean sweet soup is eaten with tapioca pearls. The beans are soft enough, not mushy, so when you eat it, it feels a bit powdery like the way sweet soup was cooked in the old days. Tapioca pearls have a smooth, soft texture, complementing the red beans, making it easier to eat without drying out your mouth. The sweet soup is lightly sweet and has a distinct flavor cooked from red beans.

Overall, I found an interesting, fun dessert shop with delicious sweet soup.

Thank you :)

ChIJieDCNJkvdTER0R2arROAJWk.text:
quán chè mỹ is the sweet spot for your dessert cravings

THE CHÈ EXPLAINED
chè is vietnam's iconic sweet dessert soup, served hot or cold with endless combinations of beans, fruits, coconut, and sticky rice. it's the ultimate comfort treat.

THE LOTUS SEED SITUATION
the chè hạt sen we tried was an absolute serve. warm, comforting, with soft lotus seeds in a subtly sweet broth that just hits different. seriously good for the soul.

THE VIBES
this no-frills spot keeps it 100 with simple plastic stools and focused dessert energy. the steady stream of locals says everything you need to know.

THE SWEET ESCAPE
when you need a break from the saigon heat or just want something authentically sweet, this place is the move. perfect for that afternoon pick-me-up.

THE FINAL CALL
if you're chasing proper vietnamese desserts that actually deliver on flavor, this spot is a total yes. that lotus seed chè is everything.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJDbDPq-UvdTERiPrL7LhJzMc.author: Bredgy L.
ChIJDbDPq-UvdTERiPrL7LhJzMc.text:
Follow @bredgyeats for more food pictures!

Vietnamese desserts are the sugar hit that reminds me of the signature glow of a Nintendo DS - nostalgic, joyful, and filled with all sorts of fun. Just as Che offers a spectrum of textures and flavours, the first trio comes bathed in warm coconut milk sago, coating the ingredients in a seductive creamy glaze to tie everything together. The steamed banana cake stood out for its satisfying bouncy-chewy texture, studded with sweet banana slices and mild sweetness that blended well with the coconut milk. The steamed banana slices leaned firmer and had a slight tannic edge, while the sweet potato had a hint of sugariness. Now, this one's a keeper, a journey of textures taking the stage. The Che Bot Bang has a glossy, bouncy tapioca shell that gives way to a smooth, nutty mung bean filling. Delicately sweet and earthy, it provides just enough contrast to the richness of the coconut milk. However, this one could be traded back to GameStop after trying it once. While the mesmerizing colours from the rainbow of components like water chestnut rubies, mung beans, and jelly bring a different texture here and there, the flavour depended heavily on the coconut milk, which might've fatigued my palate, like a game that didn't need another sequel.

ChIJ-Qw-5_kudTER97TSS3cAXxI.name: places/ChIJ-Qw-5_kudTER97TSS3cAXxI/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNYaDRYZlR3EAE
ChIJ-Qw-5_kudTER97TSS3cAXxI.author: Genevieve Vox
ChIJ-Qw-5_kudTER97TSS3cAXxI.text:
The shop has an indoor area with high stainless steel chairs and tables, while the outdoor area consists of stools set up on the narrow pavement.

Their menu boasts 48 dishes, but most of them are simply variations of a few ingredient combinations. Chinese sweet soup is not a treat but rather a light dish with traditional medicinal benefits. As such, the flavour has a pleasant sweetness from rock sugar alone.

I chose 杏仁蓮藕 (almond tofu with lotus root) and 六祥甜品 (six combination soup). The almond tofu is called tofu because it has a similar texture, but it does not actually contain soy, the main ingredient in tofu. Instead, it is made with milk and agar, so it is more like an almond-flavoured jelly. Some people might find the aroma slightly rubbery, but this is because dessert places often add a few drops of bitter almond extract to create a stronger and deeper almond flavour.

The six combination soup ingredients may vary from place to place. Here, it contains coconut pudding, ginkgo seed, seaweed, lotus root, water chestnut, and snow fungus.

The sweet soups at Tuong Phong are a delight to savour, making the perfect accompaniment to a full meal. The service is adequate, with everyone being gentle. Parking is across the street.

ChIJV0jc8UgvdTERvsuMVBlsyHM.author: SEO HITA 2
ChIJV0jc8UgvdTERvsuMVBlsyHM.text:
I learned about this sweet soup shop through a friend's recommendation, and was really satisfied after my first experience. The shop is located right on the street so it's easy to find, the outside looks simple but the inside is neat, clean and comfortable. Tables and chairs are arranged reasonably, there is space for groups of friends to gather as well as a small corner for those who go alone. The atmosphere is cozy, the music is soft, not noisy, creating a pleasant feeling. 

The sweet soup menu here is very rich, from traditional dishes such as pomelo sweet soup, green bean sweet soup, black bean sweet soup to modern dishes such as white jelly sweet soup, matcha sweet soup, durian sweet soup. I ordered three dishes: pomelo sweet soup, white jelly sweet soup and mixed sweet soup. The pomelo sweet soup is crispy, not bitter, the tea has the aroma of pandan leaves. The white jelly sweet soup is soft and fatty, eaten with crunchy almonds, very delicious. As for the mixed sweet soup, the toppings are full, every spoonful is interesting. 

The big plus is the fresh and quality ingredients. The fruit is naturally sweet, the beans are cooked to a soft, not mushy taste. The sweetness is light, not too strong, so you won't feel full after eating. In addition to sweet soup, the shop also has plan cakes, jelly, cheese yogurt, etc. The prices are very reasonable, ranging from 15k - 30k per dish, suitable for students, families and tourists. 

The staff is friendly, quick and enthusiastic. I came when the shop was quite crowded but didn't have to wait too long. When I asked more about the ingredients, the staff happily explained, making me feel comfortable and appreciated. 

In short, this is a delicious, clean, reasonably priced and good-service sweet soup shop. If you are looking for a place to enjoy traditional sweets with a touch of modernity, you should definitely stop by. Personally, I will definitely come back to try more dishes on the menu. The shop sells take-out so it is very quiet.

ChIJMbWKkTopdTERxcriUaUjLjo.name: places/ChIJMbWKkTopdTERxcriUaUjLjo/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xWSFZrdHVkbVJPVkRob2JHSXRkbEJVVEcxbGVHYxAB
ChIJMbWKkTopdTERxcriUaUjLjo.author: Thanh Hảo Lê
ChIJMbWKkTopdTERxcriUaUjLjo.text:
I recently visited Kai Kai, a Chinese-style chè (sweet soup) shop in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was a surprisingly emotional trip down memory lane. It’s not just a dessert shop; it's a little pocket of nostalgia that instantly transports you back to the simple, comforting flavors of childhood.

Walking in, the vibe is unassuming—it's clean, bright, and busy, exactly how a good local spot should be. But the moment I took my first spoonful of the Black Sesame Soup (Chè mè đen), I was hooked.

This is where the emotional part comes in: my grandmother used to make a similar sweet soup, and Kai Kai’s version tasted exactly like hers. It was warm, velvety smooth, and had that perfect, subtle roasted aroma that tells you it was made with care. It wasn't overly sweet—a huge plus for me—allowing the pure, nutty flavor of the sesame to shine. It was a moment of genuine, unexpected comfort, almost like a warm hug in a bowl.

My friend got the Snow Fungus and Papaya Soup (Chè tiềm đu đủ), which was refreshing and light, a wonderful contrast to my thick, hearty soup. The texture of the snow fungus was crunchy, and the soup itself was a gentle, hydrating sweetness.

If you are looking for an authentic taste of traditional Chinese sweet soups that prioritize subtle flavor and quality ingredients over flashy toppings and excessive sugar, Tiệm chè Kai Kai is a must-visit.

It's a beautiful way to connect with a simpler, sweeter time. Go for the Chè mè đen—it's pure, unadulterated comfort food.

Highly recommended for a dose of sweet nostalgia!

ChIJwb-3a-IndTER_uZS-YQ9IRc.text:
I visited the Bat Pho Co dessert shop a few times and found the desserts here delicious, traditional in taste and not too sweet, very easy to eat. The menu has many types such as pomelo dessert, white jelly dessert, mixed dessert, ginseng... all of which are made quite carefully. 

The prices are reasonable, mid-range compared to the general level, suitable for students and families. I especially like the way the coconut milk is cooked with moderate fat, not greasy. 

However, the shop is a bit small, so during peak hours (evenings or weekends) it will be a bit crowded and have to wait for a table. The space is not too luxurious, but clean and the service is fast. 

Overall: delicious desserts, reasonable prices, friendly service, worth a visit when looking for a cool sweet after a meal. If the shop had a larger space, it would be even better.

ChIJ8RFiViwvdTEReAqcx9I_py8.author: yumz
ChIJ8RFiViwvdTEReAqcx9I_py8.text:
sinh tố 142 is serving up vietnamese fruit perfection with proper seating

THE SINH TỐ SITUATION
this ain't your basic western smoothie. sinh tố is vietnam's ultimate fruit blend with fresh fruit, condensed milk, and sometimes yogurt for that rich, creamy texture that absolutely slays.

THE CAN'T-MISS FLAVORS
their classic avocado sinh tố is straight fire. when durian season hits, the avocado durian combo is next level. everything on their menu is lowkey genius and consistently good.

THE COMFORTABLE VIBES
unlike typical street spots, this place keeps it cozy with indoor patio seating facing the street. perfect for people-watching while you sip your drink in comfort.

THE FINAL VERDICT
if you're chasing authentic vietnamese fruit blends that always deliver, this spot is a total win. that avocado durian situation might just change your life.

don't forget to ❤️.

ChIJX4HoG7ModTERDSxLtOTqFsc.text:
fruit smoothies plate 567 on phạm viết chánh is the real deal for vietnamese drinks and desserts.

THE NUOC MIA THAT HITS DIFFERENT
their sugarcane juice is straight fire. fresh pressed and perfectly sweet without being overwhelming. it’s the ultimate thirst quencher for beating that hcmc heat.

THE DURIAN DARE
if you're feeling adventurous, their durian-blended sugarcane juice is a wild ride. the creamy, funky durian mixed with sweet sugarcane is a combo that actually slaps once you get past the fear.

THE AVOCADO SITUATION
their classic sinh to bo is pure comfort in a glass. creamy, rich, and perfectly sweetened. it’s the kind of drink that makes everything feel right.

THE BÌNH THẠNH VIBES
this no-frills spot keeps it 100 with authentic vietnamese drinks and desserts. the constant buzz of blenders and happy customers says everything. it’s that legit.

don’t forget to ❤️.

ChIJX4HoG7ModTERDSxLtOTqFsc.name: places/ChIJX4HoG7ModTERDSxLtOTqFsc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnLWJXeHlBRRAB
ChIJX4HoG7ModTERDSxLtOTqFsc.author: Thanh Hảo Lê
ChIJX4HoG7ModTERDSxLtOTqFsc.text:
Nestled in the bustling district of Bình Thạnh, Sinh Tố 567 is a haven for those seeking refreshing fruit smoothies and delectable desserts. This unassuming eatery has garnered a loyal following thanks to its vibrant atmosphere, generous portions, and affordable prices.

Sinh Tố 567 boasts an extensive menu featuring a plethora of fruit smoothies, fresh juices, and refreshing drinks. Some of the most popular choices include the avocado smoothie, mixed fruit smoothie, and passion fruit juice. Each drink is meticulously crafted with fresh fruits and natural ingredients, resulting in a burst of flavors that tantalize the taste buds.

In addition to its refreshing beverages, Sinh Tố 567 also offers a selection of delectable desserts, including chè (Vietnamese sweet soup), bánh flan (caramel custard), and various fruit salads. These sweet treats perfectly complement the refreshing smoothies, providing a satisfying and well-rounded dining experience.

The restaurant itself is small and cozy, with a vibrant atmosphere that is perfect for a casual gathering with friends or family. The staff is friendly and attentive, ensuring that guests feel welcome and well-cared for.

Sinh Tố 567 is a great value for money, offering delicious and filling meals at affordable prices. The portions are generous, and the quality of the ingredients is top-notch.

Sinh Tố 567 is a must-visit for anyone seeking a refreshing and satisfying dining experience in Ho Chi Minh. With its wide variety of delicious smoothies, desserts, and friendly atmosphere, it is easy to see why this eatery has become a popular choice among locals and tourists alike.

ChIJE7KjRP8odTERKszpCtYoQMk.text:
I have visited this shop twice and each time I left with an indescribable feeling of satisfaction. If I had to choose a "must-try" dish, I would not hesitate to recommend **banana ice cream** - the perfect combination of smooth, sweet ice cream, embellished with rich fresh coconut topping and crunchy peanuts. Each spoonful of ice cream melts on the tip of the tongue, bringing a refreshing feeling, especially suitable for hot days in Saigon. 

The space of the shop is a big plus: airy, cool night breezes and a unique view of **watching planes landing** create an unforgettable "chill" experience. Friendly staff from A-Z: from attentive car drivers, enthusiastic dish advice to fast service speed. 

With reasonable prices, the shop is truly an ideal "destination" for friends' gatherings or romantic dates. I will definitely be back to explore more of the menu – and of course, not without that addictive banana ice cream!

ChIJkWXLEAgndTERSQWCm8J0UM4.author: Cris Seeing
ChIJkWXLEAgndTERSQWCm8J0UM4.text:
Okay, folks, if you love fresh juice, you've GOT to try Reviet Juice. I'm usually skeptical of those juice places – half the time, it's mostly sugar and weird additives.  But Reviet is different.

First, the variety!  They've got your standard orange and apple, but also crazy combinations with kale, beetroot, you name it. I went with pure apple – I'm a classic guy – and let me tell you, it tasted like they squeezed the apples themselves right there!

You can see them making it, right behind the counter.  They pile in the fruit, press it all down...freshness you can actually witness.  And the taste?  Tart, a little sweet, and incredibly refreshing.  None of that over-processed, bottled flavor you get elsewhere.

Reviet, you've won me over.  If you want seriously good juice, ditch the supermarket stuff and head here.  Your tastebuds will thank you!

I find out that it was very rude, as my Vietnamese is not good otherwise I would ask him back. I ordered my Thai milk tea. The staff used his personal phone 3 times while making the thai milk tea. Do your personal stuff on break or afterwork.The staff didnt ask me Red or Green milk tea. I also forgot but i am disappointed with the level of customer service. Circle K Vietnam needs to train your staff better, kinda like in Thailand. Just my 2 cents.

ChIJ3x8rTgAvdTERuxvslVL5dqE.text: The shop is located at 72 Nguyen Xuan Khoat, Tan Thanh Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City. The shop is located in Dung Rice Warehouse. ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.name: places/ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSTE5TMWFjM3AwTTBkdVgxVjZWRzFEZHpBelZHYxAB
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.author: Tiênn Nguyễn Thị Thu
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.text:
Go Café Nguyen Hong Dao is an ideal space to relax and work.

With a modern, intimate but equally sophisticated design, the shop creates a pleasant feeling right from the moment you step in.

A rich drink menu, from strong coffees to cool fruit teas.

In particular, the quality of coffee here is very good, the flavor is rich, not bland. The staff is quick and friendly.

A big plus is the spacious and airy space, suitable for working, studying or dating with friends.

If you are looking for a quiet place to relax, Go Café Nguyen Hong Dao is a choice not to be missed.

ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.name: places/ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pabk5YSlJiRUpsUjIxbGRVMTNTbVpSWVZkWFNIYxAB
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.author: Sơn Kim
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.text: At the age of over 40 like me, I quite like the space of Go cafe on Nguyen Hong Dao street - quiet, clean and not too noisy. The drinks are tasty, simple but well-made, the price is also reasonable compared to the area. The staff is gentle, polite, creating a comfortable feeling when sitting for a long time. The cafe is suitable for reading, chatting or taking a break in the middle of the day. If someone in middle age like me is looking for a place to relax, this is a good choice.

ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.name: places/ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sMlVrUXlORnAwVnpacVJHNHdUMmx5TkVKYWMzYxAB
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.author: 06 M Đức 10a4
ChIJp0uP8cQpdTERiVcUzKJgTc4.text:
G's coffee is beyond words - fragrant, strong, addictive! Today I visited the Nguyen Hong Dao branch and was really satisfied, so I had to write a few lines to share 😍

The shop has 2 spacious floors, light decor, many cute virtual living corners. There is both a cool outdoor area and a quiet air-conditioned room for those who want to work. Especially, there is a separate WC for each floor, very clean 👍🏻

Strong wifi, full power outlets, sitting and studying or working all day is still very good. There are many eateries around, convenient to stop by and rest. Very suitable for those who want a change of pace but still have a quiet space.

I ordered Iced milk coffee and I must say it was super delicious! The coffee was strong but not harsh. A big plus is the diverse menu, there is also yogurt, fruit tea, and juice for those who can't drink coffee.

The staff are super cute. I spilled water on the table, they immediately came to help, cleaned it up and asked very thoughtfully. There was no unpleasant attitude at all, on the contrary, they smiled very friendly. 10 points for service attitude! 
Beautiful space - delicious drinks - good service, in general, a cafe worth visiting. Will come back often to chill on the weekend 😌☕️

ChIJ9x33L50rdTERlAqKW5utkt8.text:
Review of the grilled restaurant “Mot Khong Hai” – 102 Cau Xeo, Tan Phu

Last weekend, I had the opportunity to visit the grilled restaurant “Mot Khong Hai” at 102 Cau Xeo, Tan Quy ward, Tan Phu district. The first impression of the restaurant was the simple, rustic space, suitable for gatherings with friends or having a light meal after work. The restaurant was quite crowded but the service was very fast and enthusiastic.

A big plus point is that the dishes were served very quickly, no need to wait long even though the restaurant was crowded. I ordered some dishes such as: grilled blood cockles, tofu with onions, grilled intestines, and especially the razor clams – I must say they were very fresh, sweet meat, not fishy, ​​proving that the ingredients were very good. The grilled blood cockles were also very rich, the grilled flavor was just right to keep the succulent inside. The fragrant tofu, served with fried onions and a slightly spicy dipping sauce, was very tasty.

In addition, the restaurant's grilled offal is also prepared quite cleanly, without any odor and has a moderate crispiness. Accompanying the dish is cold draft beer, very suitable for the hot weather in Saigon. Cold towels are served quickly and cleanly. 

Regarding the price, the bill for my meal was only about 392,000 VND for 2 people, including beer and a variety of dishes. I find this price reasonable compared to the general level in Ho Chi Minh City, especially when compared to the quality of the food and the speed of service.

•	Dish 2: The fish? Let’s just say “fresh” wasn’t anywhere near the kitchen. It was tough, bland, and lifeless. Bland! We touched maybe 5% before giving up entirely.

Honestly, it was a waste of time and money. A truly unforgettable experience for all the wrong reasons.

ChIJUYRhG7AvdTERWqncgeqYnMU.text:
BIA HƠI HÀ NỘI QUẬN 7

This spot serves Hanoi’s famous bia hơi — a light, freshly brewed beer that’s practically a substitute for water in Vietnam’s hot climate.
It’s crisp and easy to drink, especially in the heat, making it incredibly refreshing.
The food is also great, offering an authentic taste of local Vietnamese cuisine.
A great place to enjoy both beer and bites. Highly recommended!

While drinking, two cockroaches crawled onto the table, onto the food, and one even flew over my head, which really ruined the feeling of deliciousness. 

- The Hanoi beer served is not properly chilled, not enjoyable to drink. 

If the restaurant improves the hygiene of the table area and common space, as well as ensures that the beer is properly chilled, it will be a reasonable drinking spot for friends to gather.

ChIJWVRfzT4vdTER0PSpi9NS33s.name: places/ChIJWVRfzT4vdTER0PSpi9NS33s/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLT1R0c1M4aDdMcDZRRRAB
ChIJWVRfzT4vdTER0PSpi9NS33s.author: S
ChIJWVRfzT4vdTER0PSpi9NS33s.text:
I love craft beer, but unfortunately I didn’t liked my visit at East West Brewing Company. While it’s nice that you can order a tasting, there’s hardly any explanation given about the beers or the brewery itself. The staff is friendly and available for questions, which I appreciated, but I’m used to a more engaged experience when visiting breweries.

The beers themselves were quite disappointing tbh. I carefully chose my tasting based on my experience and the descriptions on the menu, but the actual flavors didn’t match at all. Some beers were too light in color, others had sour or bitter notes where they didn’t belong—or weren’t described (e.g. Modern Belgium Dark tasted like IPA and was actually light brown). I even left one half-finished, which I rarely do, as I consider it a waste..

To their credit, a staff member asked for feedback after we paid, and I shared my honest thoughts. He acknowledged that some beers may have been brewed too warm or left too long, which at least shows some accountability. He encouraged me to leave a review to help them improve, which I respect.

The location is central, clean, and spacious. They also sell bottles, cans, and merchandise (though I didn’t buy any for obvious reasons).

In short: a decent place to sit, but not one I’d return to for the beer.

ChIJobwAtrsvdTERiJojal5JYGE.text: This Hanoi draft beer shop is truly an ideal destination for those who love rustic cuisine and cold beer. The beer here is very refreshing. ChIJobwAtrsvdTERiJojal5JYGE.name: places/ChIJobwAtrsvdTERiJojal5JYGE/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VOWDhnY2Vsd0k3Q19RRRAB
ChIJobwAtrsvdTERiJojal5JYGE.author: MINH Vo Tuan
ChIJobwAtrsvdTERiJojal5JYGE.text:
I accidentally discovered a draft beer shop right in the center of District 1 that not many people know about, so I'm here to share with anyone who loves draft beer in Hanoi. 

The shop is located right on the front of Ton Duc Thang Street, formerly an office lunch shop, now converted into a shop specializing in draft beer. The space is spacious, clean, with both the ground floor and the upper floor. If you go in the late afternoon, sit upstairs, which is cool and private, suitable for gathering friends or having a few bottles after work. 

The menu has standard Northern dishes: I ordered Phung spring rolls, onion-marinated tofu, mixed offal, all dishes are good, seasoned to taste, not modified in the sweet style of the South, so anyone from the North will probably feel familiar. 

For beer, you should order a 2L bottle, which will be poured directly from a large bottle, and will be more fragrant and cooler than the small 2L beer bottle. The beer is new, has a lot of foam, has a characteristic aroma, and is very refreshing to drink cold, very suitable for summer. 

The staff is numerous, mostly young people, agile, cheerful, proactive in serving customers. The price is very reasonable, about 300k/person for a drink right in the center of District 1, very reasonable for the location, space and quality of service. 

Vote 5 stars for a worthwhile experience, I will definitely come back.

ChIJ86c5KAAvdTERv6u-a3FZd_k.author: phrygiangates
ChIJ86c5KAAvdTERv6u-a3FZd_k.text:
A Disappointing Experience with Racist Treatment and Bad Food

I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. When the server came to pour water for me, I politely asked them to wait as I wanted to check if I had enough Vietnamese Dong to pay. After confirming that I had enough, I placed my order without needing to exchange currency.

However, before my food was even served, the server came over twice to ask if I had enough money, which was unnecessary and made me feel uncomfortable. Later, they insisted I pay before the food arrived, which I reluctantly did, though I now regret not simply walking out.

What made the situation worse was the clear difference in how I was treated compared to the table next to me, where white customers were seated. The server was attentive to them, pouring water and continuously refilling their ice bowls with beer. Meanwhile, after I paid, they didn’t even bother pouring water for me.

On top of that, the food was not good at all. The flavors were bland, and it did not meet my expectations.

This kind of discriminatory treatment is unacceptable. No customer should feel unwelcome or be treated differently based on their ethnicity. I strongly advise against dining here if you value respectful and equal service, or even just good food.

ChIJ5ZeYWhkpdTER9ydOwq5LfG0.author: T D
ChIJ5ZeYWhkpdTER9ydOwq5LfG0.text: Let’s “nhau”! Thé meaning of NHAU is to have a gathering of family, friends and colleagues gather and enjoy a variety of different items with ingredients that isn’t too heavy or full on your taste palette to enjoy these moments together. I’ve been to this location many times and it dawned on me that I’ve never put together a review on how much I love the food here. Hands-down, this is one of my top places in this city to have and share these moments with my friends. The food here is very flavorful and on point. Right next to the river with lots of traffic going by that is a perfect setting for lively atmosphere. This place is absolutely clean and I could definitely tell the preparation of the food is clean and well thought after as well. I’ve included a couple photos of what we’ve ordered so far and I will continue to update and upload more photos next time. come here and drink with friends and family for whichever occasions that may bring people together. From soccer tournaments on TV, to birthday  events I’ve been a part of. Every time I’m in the city I always make a stop here at least once before I leave. Thank you very much for the amazing service and great food. Until next time.

ChIJ2ya7AAAvdTERvMQcpjO_ZVc.text: I have been to Saigon many times, and for the first time my brother took me to drink Hanoi draft beer right in the heart of Saigon. ChIJ2ya7AAAvdTERvMQcpjO_ZVc.text:
Pho Bia - Big restaurant, small quality, watching football is also... lucky! ⚽️
I came to Pho Bia with the hope of enjoying a delicious meal and watching football on the big screen. But maybe I had high expectations.
The first plus point is that the restaurant has a spacious parking lot, cars can park comfortably. The staff is enthusiastic, but it seems that they are only "energetic" when serving beer customers, but for customers drinking soft drinks...
Regarding the food, I was quite disappointed. The price is high compared to the quality, the portion is small. The braised fish dish is okay, but the fried fish and frog are nothing special.
I came to the restaurant mainly to watch football, but the big screen was faulty, the colors were not clear. The restaurant space is airy, but quite noisy and crowded.
You should consider carefully before coming here

If I’m you’re from Hanoi and in the area, give it a try!

ChIJrTraVIAvdTERbn0BI0vuubY.text: Quán Bia Hơi Hoàn Lương gave me a lively and authentic experience. The atmosphere was cheerful, filled with laughter, conversations, and the sound of glasses clinking. The beer was fresh and light, perfect for long evenings with friends. What I enjoyed most was the variety of local snacks that paired wonderfully with the drinks—grilled dishes, fried specialties, and flavorful seafood. The staff were attentive despite the bustling crowd, keeping the service smooth. It felt like a true local gathering spot where people come not just to drink, but to share joy and community spirit.

ChIJU8omHTQpdTERzzCdinf2cjA.text: Located in a busy area, this restaurant offers above average food and an OK selection of beer. They provide detailed VAT invoice, but it is recommended to call ahead to double check. It is a great option for large parties over 50 persons. The price point is acceptable, but be aware that there is no car parking available. However, bike parking is available in the small long alley, with clear security instructions provided. The decoration is pretty and adds to the overall ambiance of the restaurant. The waiting service is fast and efficient, with no need to wait long for your food to arrive. Overall, this restaurant is a solid choice for those looking for good food and a pleasant small to medium party experience.

ChIJh31is4wndTERR_zM12oQdF8.text: Bia Hoi Ha Noi places are all very similar. Mostly family run, the menu is familiar to locals, and the beer is excellent. The young women on staff are pleasant but I'm pretty sure Daddy would step out from behind the stove if you treated them with disrespect.

ChIJh31is4wndTERR_zM12oQdF8.author: YJ
ChIJh31is4wndTERR_zM12oQdF8.text:
Thoroughly enjoyed the meal here. Menu was absolutely foreign as it is all written in Viet. Service staff spoke very little English too and seemed flustered with two foreigners who stumbled upon this local eating joint. Google Translate somewhat helped, but English translation of menu items like "fake prosthetic leg" was not helpful. However, eventually figured out a few things and all the dishes showed up rather promptly. Food was delicious, down to earth and wholesome 😋 service staff were enthusiastic, tried their best at figuring out what menu items we were pointing at. Prices were very reasonable - a big jug 🏺  of beer 🍺 sitting in an ice bucket was reasonably priced at 120000 dong. And despite eating on short stools and low tables in a back alley, the place was surprisingly clean 🫧
Vibes were great too. Friday evening and all locals were here unwinding having a good time with rounds of beer and beer food. Patrons were friendly and chill and definitely a great core memory for a memorable weekend trip in HCM.

ChIJK2iXB0gvdTER_Cz4jsQZqbo.author: Ashley T.
ChIJK2iXB0gvdTER_Cz4jsQZqbo.text:
Food: nice family portioned dishes with a huge range of vietnamese dishes to choose from. Their seasoning was good, well-balanced and southern vietnamese style of seasoning. Price was not too expensive, suitable for going in big groups. For me personally, the seafood was not as food as other options. My fave was the veggies fried noodles which for me was fried to perfection. Ordered other kinds of sea snails, sweet and sour crabs, deep fried squids, fried tofu with pork floss and other random stuffs. The only let-down was the spicy Thai hotpot which was bland and had very stingy topping.

Space: very big and open restaurant. Often crowded but still, enough seats to choose from. There would be staffs arranging tables for you though sometimes during busy hour they'd set up tables at conventionally inconvenient spots like next to the toilet's door or ish.

Service: very energetic staffs. Though sometimes could be a hassle because of their overly-catering attitude. The staffs that looked after my table were literally on edge waiting for us to finish our food just to frantically clean every single dishes every 15 minutes. One of them mistook the food I'm eating as trash and threw other trash in then took it away. Hope they'd let the staffs loosen up a bit though.

The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable, allowing everyone to enjoy their time without feeling rushed. With its affordable menu and friendly setting, this place is a solid choice for those looking to have a good time while sharing food and drinks with friends.

ChIJN8LfcUcvdTER8RhGiGmQBlo.text:
Visiting the OG Pasteur Street Craft Beer in Ho Chi Minh City was actually not on our list during the transit back from Vung Tau to HCMC. However, while checking out the vicinity after dropping off close to Takashimaya HCMC, Kate was sharp in noticing that there’s an actual Pasteur Street nearby on Google Maps and upon closer inspection, there it was – Pasteur Street Craft Beer! Having visited one of its outlet previously in Hanoi, it was a thrill for us to visit the Original (OG) Pasteur Street Craft Beer on Pasteur Street in Ho Chi Minh City!

As it was rather hot when we visited, we started the session with Jasmine IPA (115k VND) and Session IPA (99k VND). Both tasted as great and refreshing as we remembered it. Love the Jasmine IPA with its floral fragrance – the beer that kickstarted the journey for Pasteur Street Craft Beer.

Thereafter, Kate wanted to try out the Stouts and we wanted to order both the Irish Stout (99k VND) and Cyclo Stout (165k VND). However, our staff shared that it would be better if we had a sip of Cyclo Stout before we tried it as it was pretty strong at 13%…

ChIJvxBrszEvdTERj1HMQx-epNc.text: I came with a friend. Because it was the first time we came to the restaurant, we were both very curious. But the experience was really bad. Second, my friend and I ordered 2 dishes, fried tofu and chicken hotpot, but it took 10 minutes for the tofu dish to arrive and more than 30 minutes for the hotpot to arrive. When I reminded the staff, they kept saying that the kitchen was jammed and I could order another dish to get the dish faster. "I think they're trying to up the sale." Third, near the end of the meal, I saw a foreign object that looked like a chili sauce bottle cap. When I told the staff, they took the object into the kitchen but there was still no apology from the staff or manager. To put it simply, the total bill was more than 400k, but I feel that to experience FNB like this is too bad.

ChIJub6lAhkldTERllhcCgEbPPg.text:
Son Beo Quan – Rustic but “delicious”, draft beer is a great mood-setter.

Son Beo Quan is the right place for those who love rustic cuisine, not flashy but the quality is in every bite. The dishes are cooked in the style of “upgraded home-cooked meals”, rich in flavor, easy to eat, suitable for both adults and children.

Another plus point is that there is draft beer – not excellent in the style of a beer bar, but okay to have a cup of tea next to a hot dish. The wind blows gently, the beer is cool in your hand, and that’s it!

The space is not luxurious, but neat and clean. The price is “cute”, affordable, you can eat and drink comfortably without worrying about being “ripped off”.

ChIJIQYbRegpdTER6EvdvpWPcmo.text: Standard beer, delicious food, cheap price, spacious, cool, clean, airy space. There are VIP rooms, air-conditioned areas, bar lobby areas, outdoor areas to sit and drink beer and watch the bustling traffic. Another plus point is that the restaurant has a very large parking lot, cars and motorbikes can turn around freely. For example, if you get too drunk that day, you can leave your car at the restaurant and pick it up the next day, which is okay. In the morning, the restaurant sells coffee, juice, chicken pho, beef stew and bread, and at noon, you can order lunch in the air-conditioned room.

The owner is quite nice, also from Phu Yen so the taste is guaranteed to be "authentic", the special thing is that the trays will be made of wood, the decoration is also elaborate.

Let Phuc review some dishes from the land of Nau for you to refer to such as Chicken on the Tray, Mixed Rolled Mat, Tuna Eye & Chicken Hotpot with Perilla Leaves...

Chicken Rice Bun Cha Ca Restaurant 189
📍189 Nguyen Oanh, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC
(Next to Tran Dai Nghia University, opposite Sacombank)
#dicungphuc #comgabunchaca189

Plenty of beer collection, so it’s a plus!

Price is at the average level, but I fell some dishes are overcharged.

ChIJR5HuYbQvdTEROlXBTuCEQRU.author: Namski
ChIJR5HuYbQvdTEROlXBTuCEQRU.text:
I'm back.....after two surgeries to replace my ear drums after spending a few hours here having dinner with my family. Let's start with the positives: The food is delicious. The service is amazing and the price is expectedly higher. The music selection is upbeat and invigorating but the restaurant management wants the volume turned up loud enough to drown out the traffic noises.  They succeeded. It was so loud I became an expert lip reader, because I couldn't hear the person in front of me. And when I tried to respond, I can read their lips asking me not to scream. It was so loud, the beer in the beer tower formed a tsunami wave. It was so loud the frogs and the octopus were squirming.
Not coming back, of course. The idea of having a conversation during dinner is out the window with this restaurant. For ones who plan to come, I recommend ear protection rated up to 130 decibels.
I hope this review is LOUD ENOUGH FOR YOU!

ChIJmZRjJpgvdTERmX0K91ZzwXI.text:
We had our very first meal in Saigon at The Street 181C, and it set the bar high. Despite a slight language barrier, the staff were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to help us with our order. The food was outstanding—beautifully seasoned, generous in portion, and offered at a great value.

The ambiance was equally impressive. We chose an outdoor table, which turned out to be the perfect spot for a relaxed dinner. While the sounds of traffic added a bit of background noise, it only enhanced the authentic Saigon vibe. The energy, the flavors, and the warmth of the people made this a memorable dining experience.

ChIJycCmlzkvdTERTr6ArxJGKrQ.text:
Quán Nhậu Sạc Station near Ben Thanh Market is a hidden gem in Ho Chi Minh City! The beer here is incredibly affordable, and the food is absolutely delicious, making it a fantastic spot for both locals and tourists alike.

The atmosphere is vibrant and full of energy, with lively music setting the perfect backdrop for a fun night out. It’s a popular spot for young people to celebrate their birthdays with friends, and the whole place really comes alive with the celebrations.

One of the unique features of this place is a character dressed up who entertains with groovy dance moves, adding an extra layer of fun, especially during birthday celebrations. It’s a must-visit if you’re in the area—sit back, relax, enjoy the music, and soak in the youthful energy.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a lively and affordable night out in Ho Chi Minh City!
