ChIJYU5zct0vdTERS-173za1tqA.text:
I visited 7 Kho on Lý Thái Tổ for a casual date with my friend. We only tried a few dishes  Đậu hũ chà bông hột vịt bắc thảo and a sharing platter with Pate Hải Phòng, bánh mì, and some side dishes.

I didn’t try enough dishes to fully recommend the menu, but from what I had, the food was decent ,good for pairing with drinks. I had Hà Nội beer, which was refreshing and paired nicely with the vibe.

What I really liked was the atmosphere. You get that open-air, street-side vibe and if the weather’s a bit windy, it’s even better. A cool spot to chill and catch up with friends.

Their staff are friendly.

If you're into exploring Hà Nội style drinking food with beer, this place is worth a try!

ChIJYU5zct0vdTERS-173za1tqA.text: 7 Kho is a fantastic spot in Saigon if you're looking for an authentic Bia Hanoi experience! The flavor profiles of the dishes are satisfactory, though not exceptional, which raises questions about the justification for the premium pricing. Noteworthy dishes include "ốc móng tay xào me" and "răng mực xào bơ cay", both of which are recommended for their distinctive sauces.

I ordered the long beans with shrimp paste and it was as delicious as my mother's cooking, I really liked it. The restaurant has giant linh fish.
At first, I took pictures, but later it was so delicious that I was so busy picking it up that I forgot to take pictures to advertise the restaurant :))))
The tables are far apart so it's airy, not noisy, in general, a new place worth visiting.

ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik.author: tee dee
ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik.text:
This place brought back so many childhood memories for me. We ordered the Vietnamese traditional family dishes from both North and South Vietnam. They were all good and made with the exact typical taste that I had 30+ years ago (both at home and at the street food stalls). It's extremely hard to find a good restaurant in Vietnam that can deliver the typical taste of family dishes in the 80s/90s. Most places are fusion or somewhat Westernized.

The place is very nice and clean. Staff were friendly. They also have super cute high chairs for kids.

ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik.name: places/ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURaamY2ZmF3EAE
ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik.author: Zhuge Liang
ChIJW_yItVovdTER499XDFnfYik.text:
Friendly and prompt service, with English support 😄 🙇🏻‍♂️

Food were 🌟

Purple yam soup: porridge like, but with yam. Not as sour as a Tom Yum soup but sufficiently so to open up your appetite.

Stir fried jasmine flower: flavourful and cooked al dente for those who like their veggies crunchy.

Crispy pork: wowww, must try! Imagine HK style roast pork (with the crunchy skin) marinated with Maggi soy sauce 😋

Clay pot rice: visually impressive with 锅巴 (fried rice crackers) texture. Rather bland, which pairs it well with the main dishes.

Clay pot frog: well-seasoned and crunchy skin (if you like them) and full of _wok hei_.

Don't miss their drinks; recommend the Ha Do (house) milk tea.

Seoul Spicy Noodles – a new restaurant but left a good impression.

I tried the restaurant when passing by Phan Van Hum, saw that the restaurant had just opened, the space was clean, airy, and had air conditioning so it was very comfortable to sit and eat. The tables and chairs were simple but clean and tidy, creating a sense of security when eating.

Ordered a portion of level 2 spicy beef noodles – the broth was rich, just the right amount of spicy, and the taste was very good. There were also quite a few toppings: beef, fish cakes, sausages, and kimchi, the noodles were chewy and not broken. The price was reasonable, about 50-60k/portion, filling.

The biggest plus point was that the staff were very friendly. I arrived when the restaurant was not crowded, but they still took the initiative to greet me, were friendly, served me quickly, and were not afraid to suggest dishes. Although it was a new restaurant, the service attitude was quite professional.

👉 Overall, this is a spicy noodle shop worth trying if you are in District 12. Good food, cool space, friendly staff - a pleasant and satisfying dining experience.

And don’t get mad if the security guard tells you there’s no more tables. He’s just doing his job and letting you know. He’s not chasing you.  This place is for spicy ramen lovers. 🍜🍜🌶️🌶️🍲🍲Level 0 was still too spicy for a couple of us. You can always ask for extra hot sauce on the side but it’s pure chili pressed juice so beware. They also have on spicy dishes.
I absolutely agree with another reviewer:
“Mình ghé quán vào lúc quán đang chạy combo 39k gồm mì và nước. Mặc dù quán rất đông nhưng nhân viên nhiệt tình, sắp xếp chỗ ngồi cũng rất nhanh chóng.”

The lemon tea was okay for drinks, and the watermelon juice wasn't so good for me, but my friend thought it was okay. However, the ground floor was quite hot. I ate at noon, so I don't know if it was due to the outside air, but it was very hot. The food was served quite slowly. I ordered 2 portions of noodles and 2 appetizers. My friend's noodles came out first, and it took about 5 minutes after I finished eating my portion (???). I'm not sure if the black bean noodles take longer to make than the mixed noodles, but the slowness with which the food was served made me lose my appetite terribly. The black bean noodles were okay, but there were few vegetables, and it was boring to eat. I probably won't come back.

ChIJOcxNtCwvdTERvKcJ4kUMlp0.text: I have eaten here a few times because I live in the area. But recently, I found the service not good, to say very poor. In addition, I ordered an extra chicken thigh and asked the kitchen to cut it for me. When it was brought out, the staff said the restaurant was too crowded so they brought scissors and asked me to cut it myself. I was still very normal and had no problem. But looking at the time, the restaurant was not crowded (around 8-9 pm on a normal day). The restaurant was not crowded, but I had to wait a whole morning for someone to come to order. Until paying the bill, I don't know which staff member was very impolite (I think it was extremely impolite no matter what program this was of the restaurant) and noted that my chicken thigh in the bill was "cut for the customer". I just went to eat normally, I don't want to be a customer or anything, but the staff noted like that, the owner should review the staff's personality. Customers are customers, not gods. If the restaurant's motto is that the customer is king, then pay attention to every little detail for the customer, don't just note it on the bill like that. Even if you note it, you don't cut it for them, which is extremely impolite and rude. The restaurant should review its staff and review how they are trained to serve them better.

ChIJd5R1nzA7dTERM6S32aZ6YxY.text: I have eaten at this restaurant many times. I have eaten there and also taken it home. I also have a few comments, if possible, I can help the restaurant develop more. First, the spicy noodles of the restaurant are very delicious, with a rich flavor. But I want to advise the restaurant to add more onions and other things to each portion of spicy noodles. It will be more delicious if you eat less and less boring. As for the Yangzhou fried rice, you should also add a little bit of pepper, the flavor of the rice is still quite bland in my opinion, so adding a little onion will make the flavor more complete. The restaurant is very enthusiastic, as for the food, just add a little more flavor and it will be delicious. This is according to my taste, I just give suggestions to help the restaurant develop more about the dishes, but for me, it is already very delicious as it is. But if there is money, the restaurant can also buy an umbrella to put outside because in the afternoons or mornings when you come to the restaurant, sitting outside will be sunny. The rest is fine!

ChIJq4X5dAAtdTER3gqha0Tp19Y.text:
The food is delicious, tasty, and suitable for the diners' taste. The food is hot and delicious, just a little bit long to wait for them to cook. 😝
The cold drinks are 10 points, no complaints. 😝
The service is cheerful, lively, enthusiastic with customers, dedicated, if you don't know what to eat, the service will advise you enthusiastically. 😆
The service is a bit slow, you order and wait about 5 minutes or more, the service will bring the water first, then about 3 minutes later the food is brought up, but the service is quite okay! 😚
The atmosphere of the restaurant is a bit noisy because there are many students who come to eat to support the restaurant, and the air is too cold because the restaurant turns on the air conditioner at a small number 😵‍💫 If the restaurant sets it at around 30°C, it will probably be okay. 
My total score for the restaurant is 9 points🤩 because the food here is mainly spicy, so if you can't eat spicy food, remember to tell the server to reduce the spiciness to better suit your taste. Love you Seoul City Spicy Noodle Shop!!🥰🥰

ChIJq4X5dAAtdTER3gqha0Tp19Y.text: I swear, I went on the opening day on March 8 with my relatives. Even though the restaurant wasn't crowded, the wait was really long. I ignored it. On May 25, I went with my friend. The waitress had an unpleasant attitude towards us, so we tried to choose the dishes as quickly as possible. The restaurant was crowded so the dishes took a while to come out, I didn't have any comments, but there was a group of friends who came first but *Order Later* and they were joking and didn't choose the dishes. We chose first, but when it was brought out, it was the other group's. The other tables' sauces were brought up, but our table had to get it ourselves. The waitress had a grumpy, frowning attitude. Even though I know the restaurant is crowded, at least I know what the service attitude is like, what is right. I hope the restaurant will improve, I'm talking here because from my experience of trying 3 branches in Seoul, I found this one opposite the school but quite bad from my personal experience. I hope the restaurant will improve soon!

Like the Lê Văn Việt location, this was quite slow even though two customers already had their food or it was brought out closely after I sat down and I was the only other customer... it must be just the Chanwoo philosophy to take extra time? I believe it was 20-25 mins for ny single order.

I wanted to try a beef gimbap roll (as I've had the fried roll at the other location), however, they couldn't sell it to me because they didn't have beef. I chose the fried chicken set. I thought it was 99K, but it was only 69K/$2.80 - thank God.

The chicken was seemingly over-fried. It tasted like frozen chicken and not fresh chicken. The batter was hard. Parts of the chicken were dry. The fries were also slightly overcooked.

You're better off getting chicken at Lotteria, Jollibee, McDonald's, etc.

I was guided in by maybe the manager and sat down. I waited for service and then tried making knocking noises to get someone to come, but no one came. The manager came in and had to tell someone to attend to me. First floor was kind of disorganized and messy, which is why they want customers to use 2nd floor. The space is not large, but maybe 6 tables (perhaps 3 larger floor seating tables). I tried to find a bathroom to wash my hands, but it didn't seem like there was one, even on 3rd floor.

When it was brought out, each bowl had 2 pieces of beef and no kimchi anywhere 😅🥹 specifically 2 pieces of beef, 3 pieces of sausage, 4 pieces of fish balls, 1 piece of enoki mushroom and noodles, no cabbage or kimchi 🥲🥲
About the noodles, they were a bit small compared to other places I've eaten. I got a free bottle of iced tea like other places. I didn't use the wet towel so I don't know if it was a charge or not.

I saw a shopeefood guy sitting and waiting for a long time but still couldn't get the order, he said that the shop said to wait 15 minutes to come back and it was available after 15 minutes he came back but still had to wait for another 15 minutes, looking at him was pitiful. I don't know if you guys order through the app and wait like that, will there be a boom in orders 🥲🥲. I probably won't come back because I don't think it's good.

ChIJg4D4ADrXdDER2tE1LzDNN3o.text: This afternoon, my family was the first to come to the restaurant and waited a long time for 2 glasses of water. After a long time, the second customer came in and they brought the food to them. My family waited impatiently. Nearly an hour later, another customer came in and they brought the food to them. My family waited so long for the noodles that the customer who came later asked why our table came early and didn't bring it to them first. The restaurant didn't answer and went inside. We asked for the bill for 2 glasses of water but they were slow and had to wait. 2 glasses of water cost 60k, not a small amount. This restaurant took advantage of me and thought I was poor so they intentionally didn't serve me. When I left, the restaurant didn't apologize or explain. With this attitude, the restaurant must be hoping to close down soon. There are many places that sell spicy noodles. A 1-star rating is too high. Everyone in the Dong Thanh area should stay away from this restaurant.

The original price of the mixed bowl is 69k, not to mention the 20% surcharge, but in the bowl there was only 1 thin slice of beef, the noodles were only a small pinch of kimchi, and the noodles were bland. I tried to finish all the toppings because I couldn't bear to throw 69k + 20% surcharge out the window 😵‍💫😵‍💫
Oh, I also ordered a glass of fresh milk with black sugar pearls. But why didn't you say that there were no pearls, why did you put 3q jelly for me?? When I finished, the drink was almost completely melted, why???
This is the first time I've eaten at a spicy noodle shop and was quite annoyed like this!!
If you guys are looking for a spicy noodle shop, you should consider whether to visit this shop or not!! As for me, I say bye!! Xu because my shop is usually full, so I stopped by to try it - who would have thought it would be this bad

ChIJ950ZRAAvdTERJ6Wlwtzr5zU.text:
The tastiest banh mi we've had since living here!

All the ingredients tasted super fresh, and the banh mi itself was quite a bit bigger than what you usually get.

I went there to get a snack for my partner and I and it ended up being the whole meal!

We got the standard Saigon Banh Mi which includes pate, some sort of ham, pickled vegetables and pork floss, it was incredibly tasty, and large if you're not super hungry you can easily halve one with someone else.

No photos because we devoured them immediately! Will try to post some next time we go, because there will absolutely be a next time!

Atmosphere-wise, it's a standard stall looking out on the road, nothing special, nothing bad either. It is drive thru if you have a motorcycle, like I did.

The service was nice, I speak a little Vietnamese and they understood, but the staff were young and were able to speak English, albeit for the purposes of our transaction.

What truly made the visit memorable was the owner: super friendly, chatty, and full of humor — turned a quick meal into a feel-good moment.

Tip: Gently press the bread before eating to slightly deconstruct it — it brings out even more crisp and texture.

ChIJs_GU0wQvdTERaYnaeUaqS2Y.text: Can you even say you’ve been to Vietnam and not have had an iconic Banh Mi sandwich? Lots of filling options (though my default is pork), and the bread is amazing. They can make spicy or not. Wash it down with a Vietnamese ice coffee and you’ll have a great lunch and experience a prime example of this iconic sandwich.

ChIJIdqfGektdTERjBbqbdrsdJU.author: Tom Nguyen
ChIJIdqfGektdTERjBbqbdrsdJU.text: truly a hidden gem. i know there's 127 reviews already but it's nestled in a quiet, albiet rich neighborhood. i think only ppl who live nearby know about it. it's so incredibly hard to find good bo ne in hcmc. i would consider this place one of the best and it is the best ive found. there used to be an even better one, foodwise, in d10 but they change the recipe and it's just average now and expensive at 85k. this place however has decently seasoned and soft beef. excellent bread choice. excellent butter and pate. average everything else but it's so hard to find good places in hcmc that this gets elevated big time. another great thing about this place is the employees here are happy and appears to actually love their jobs. that's very rare in hcmc. the atmosphere is unparalleled on a cool winter morning. it sits on a corner of wide streets with very little traffic. the chairs are cloth lawn chair style, way more comfortable than shitty stools. it has plenty of seating so you're not hot and crowded with sizzling food next to you. the experience was magnificent. i ride around that area all the time because it's pleasant and ive probably seen it on google maps but assumed it sucked like 99% of em. it's such a shame because the day before left vn i discovered it. i ate there twice that day. i would've eaten every week if i knew. it's price low too at 45k-50k. these are the places ppl dream of when they think of advantages vn has to offer. in reality 99% of vn restaurants are absolute shit. this one is above them by a mile. friendly host left such a good dining impression that lingers.

ChIJp_JdAZEvdTERJfLyDQjBRLc.author: The Nhan Nguyen
ChIJp_JdAZEvdTERJfLyDQjBRLc.text:
The restaurant has 2 addresses: 1 in Hung Vuong 1 apartment, 2 in Pham Thai Buong.
The food is delicious.
As for the service attitude, I rate 1 star.
I had an extremely bad experience with the food ordering service via the app of this restaurant.
November 2, 2025:
1. I ordered 2 sandwiches, 3 cups of sweet soup, 1 coffee.
2. During the time, the shipper contacted me to inform the restaurant that they were out of sweet soup, asking how to handle it. I told the shipper to ask the restaurant to contact me to find a solution.
3. About 5 minutes later, the restaurant called, asking if I could change to another dish? I couldn't find another dish I liked, so I suggested that the restaurant send me cash through the shipper for the dishes that were out of stock because: 1/ I paid by card, now if I cancel, sometimes I get my money back immediately, sometimes it takes a whole week, and I don't remember to track it; 2/ If I reorder, I will have to spend more time for the app to find the shipper, and then the shipper will arrive at the restaurant.
4. The restaurant representative (I call her sister, maybe the owner) said she would ask the staff and promised to let me know.
5. The restaurant canceled the order without any prior notice. (Although I was annoyed that the restaurant did not control the dishes on the app before, I was okay, but up to now, I feel a bit upset that the restaurant is disrespectful to me)
6. I called the restaurant representative back (the phone number that called me before) and argued. The reasons she gave: 1/ She did not agree with sending cash to the shipper to refund the out-of-stock items: she was not at the restaurant so she did not know (I asked her if she did not know, then why did the restaurant representative call me?) and the issue of the costs the restaurant had to bear (I asked her: did she solve the problem in a way that prioritized the restaurant's interests or the customer's interests when it was clear that the problem occurred due to the restaurant's fault and she had never agreed with me on the refund amount); 2/ The reason she canceled the order: after canceling the order, you can reorder it yourself and add a bonus sentence: I have never met a customer like me.
I may be annoyed but I am not upset that the restaurant cannot control the out-of-stock items on the app, I just feel disrespected in the way the restaurant representative behaved when the problem occurred.
I wrote to record a really bad experience with the restaurant, also to add a perspective for the restaurant (whether or not it is accepted depends on the point of view).

ChIJXa6WK4cudTERbejM7JWLVQk.text: My family has eaten here for a long time and these days, the food here is too salty. Moreover, the servants here are not friendly. Then my sister was burned. We talked back that our family was burned and the woman serving us just said: "Oh yeah, your were burned" with her arrogant expression and she didn't even apologize. At last, when we talked to another waiter they only said that they would take that into consideration and that was all, without any apology.

The meatballs have a thick sauce so they are very delicious when dipped in bread, 15k/big ball but if one person is full, buy 2 balls.
My family often buys a lot to have for breakfast or eat with rice, it's also delicious.

I stopped by shortly before their morning hours closed which was sad, because I was very tempted to go back and get a second! The owner is so friendly and kind and speaks fluent English. If you’re in the neighborhood this is highly recommended.

ChIJtwR7rWUldTERuZp2LyNVE3c.text: Extremely unhappy. At noon, I was the first one to come and order first, then another customer came after me. Then instead of saying sorry to the customer, she showed an unpleasant attitude, and even grumbled something in her mouth. I thought that was it, but after eating, I found out it was a meat sandwich, not a meatball as I ordered, I wasted 20k to buy a meat sandwich, but received a meat sandwich 🙂. It's better to sell the wrong one, but if the owner or staff is cheerful and open to customers, I won't be upset if I buy the wrong one, maybe I'll continue to support them in the future. But if you come across a sales person who is absent-minded and doesn't pay attention to what the customer orders, makes a lot of mistakes, and when the customer reminds her of her mistake, she doesn't even admit it, but instead acts grumpy and complains, then honestly, spending 1k to buy from her is a waste 🙂. The person who sold to me was a short, skinny woman with long hair that reached below her waist, wearing a conical hat indoors, extremely unpleasant. I will never buy from her again!!!

ChIJdaUkKiAvdTERHZM4lIdqa4s.text: Our local tour guide recommended this store. It was our first time to try Banh Mi and it didn’t disappoint. It’s very yummy 😋 and now I’m looking for the same taste but in different stores ‘cause I miss it (I’m no longer in Saigon). 🥹🥲 It was only 30,000 dong for 1 Banh Mi, as far as I can remember. I regretted buying 1 only. 🥲

ChIJdaUkKiAvdTERHZM4lIdqa4s.text: The best Banh Mi I’ve had in Vietnam so far, including Hoi An. Light, fresh bread, not too much meat and perfect amount of veg (coriander etc). And great flavour. We only had to wait a few minutes to be served and service was very friendly. Would love to come back here again.

ChIJARSGQN4udTER7AADclE8pk4.text: Delicious. As for the full topping, it's delicious beyond reproach, and adding a cup of milk tea is the best. It's perfect for me. I buy it and eat it right away without any hesitation. Sit down and enjoy the flavor the restaurant brings. 😁

ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.author: Wandering Free bird
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.text:
The shop is excellent, the owner and the staff are very nice. The food is prepared very fresh and it's really nice banh mi and the coffee is very strong and good as well. The white coffee was a bit too sweet for me. But I will try some of the other coffees on the menu.

overall, it's a great place. I really enjoyed coming here and such a friendly vibe. And the food is nice as well ...highly recommended. Give it a shot.

ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.name: places/ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VOdWIwYWpnc0xUNlZBEAE
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.author: Yanina Ramseyer
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.text: We tried the Bánh Mì Hoi An, and it was hands down one of the best bánh mìs we've ever had. The bread was spot-on—crispy on the outside, soft inside, and incredibly fresh. Every bite was packed with flavor. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and the service was amazing.

ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.name: places/ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VNZks4STdjZ1lEVE9BEAE
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.author: Aku Alapelto
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.text: This is literally the best Banh Mi that me and my girlfriend had in Vietnam. All the flavours combined together makes up a combination of tastes that I havent had anywhere else. Also the shredded chicken here has been the best so far. Service is amazing and the prices are also cheap. So definitely would recommend!

ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.name: places/ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR2a1pmUElnEAE
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.author: Thành Đoàn
ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.text: Decent banh mi place, 9.5/10. It’s just banh mi, nothing can go wrong with it right, but banh mi here is great, from the bun to the meats, vegetables, and the sauces, all comes together great, very tasty. Highly recommended if you are new to town and wanna grab other banh mi than those widely advertised ones.

ChIJEUX2F8ovdTERll_PRyyKTqg.text: Very good food n drinks. Owner should should display more food items upfront at display rack as it looked empty. That will help pull in more customers.

ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.name: places/ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tKbVZGSXlhM1Y1U1Y4eU5FSktUMnBoZW5oYVpsRRAB
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.author: Tỉnh Lê
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.text: The Hoi An Banh Mi shop at 36/17 Le Thi Rieng offers an authentic taste of Central Vietnam right in the heart of Saigon. The baguette is crispy, the fillings are rich in flavor, the sauce is delicately balanced, and the prices are reasonable. While the place isn’t overly fancy or sophisticated, for true lovers of Hoi An-style banh mi, this is definitely a spot worth trying. Whether you’re a die-hard fan of Hoi An cuisine or simply looking to switch up your usual banh mi routine, this place is an ideal destination for a quick yet satisfying breakfast.

ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.name: places/ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4UlVrTlVYMVZIVEMxRFdrSmhabmhxWm5oWWQwRRAB
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.author: Tom
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.text: I stayed in district one for a week and tried a few Banh Mi places in the area. For me this was by far the best one, decent price and great food. Really good bread, packed full of meat and veg. It’s also down the alley so it’s nicer to sit outside compared to all the others on the main road. I ended up coming here twice during my stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.name: places/ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKWldrcFplak5xU1VKeGVIWnJMV05hYlMxUk1rRRAB
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.author: Diamond (A3)
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.text: The bread crust is crispy on the outside and wonderfully soft on the inside, providing the necessary textural contrast. What really sets it apart is the generous mix of quality ingredients. You’ll find a rich mix of cold cuts (cha lua, ham), grilled meats, and often a perfectly cooked sunny side up egg. However, the real stars are the creamy, rich pate and their signature butter/mayonnaise. These elements add an incredible depth of flavor and a delicious, luxurious taste that is simply addictive. Fresh herbs, sliced cucumber, daikon and carrot pickles, and a touch of chilli complete the symphony of flavors, providing a balance of salty, sour, and refreshing.

ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.name: places/ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sxWlVURXphSEJoYUZNM0xVbFRUREIzVFV4Q1JYYxAB
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.author: Robert Gates
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.text:
Just had the most delicious Hoi An banh mi and coconut/ mango smoothie (take away). Nice to have a variation from the usual banh mi in Saigon. Enjoyed my chat with the friendly owner too.
I will definitely return for more.

ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.name: places/ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WeVdFUnVSVmhSU0dGNFUxQlNYMVYxYlhselUzYxAB
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.author: Hannah Gardiner
ChIJD9nTUgAvdTERnOVhNO_wT9w.text: Yummy banh mi (althought I removed the round pate looking meat they put in) and my lemon ginger drink was so nice.

ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.name: places/ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21JdGVsVkZkMlY0VERoNWJqaDRkVEpLWlUxc1ExRRAB
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.author: Van Ngo
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.text: Grilled pork is tender and well seasoned. The combination of flavours remind me of Northern style banh mi which is more flavourful imo. Other ingredients are fresh. But banh mi texture might get a little bit soggy because they use liquid sauce. Portion is right.

ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.name: places/ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURIcVo3d0l3EAE
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.author: Cong Minh Doan
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.text: Bánh Mì Chim Chạy offers tasty sandwiches, but they can feel a bit heavy after a while. The grilled pork bánh mì wasn’t very impressive, lacking standout flavor. However, the shredded chicken bánh mì was much better. Overall, I’d give it a 4/5, but there’s definitely room for improvement to make the menu more exciting.

ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.name: places/ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ5cklDV25RRRAB
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.author: Trey Saunders
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.text:
There are many banh mi places in this area so I chose Chim Chay because it had many Grab drivers waiting to pick up orders. This is usually a good sign and despite the number of orders, they are very efficient and it did not take long for me to receive my order.
There are 2 options, chicken or pork - with the pork being a little more expensive than the chicken. You can also choose how much spice to add.
The banh mi had a good flavour and the fillings tasted fresh including the bread roll, how a banh mi should be made!
It was convenient that there was a toothpick and wet towelette included in the bag.

ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.name: places/ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc/reviews/Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKM1ozZENMWE5JYzI1S2RDMUJWa0pwTkRSRlFtYxAB
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.author: Maja Geroska
ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.text: Ridiculously delicious! Crunchy bread (not soggy or soft crusted) and the grilled pork is not fatty, which I appreciate.

ChIJY5mIGtwvdTER3akp6RBkjWc.text: I’m no expert but this was delicious! I got the pork one with a little bit of spice, came with a wipe and toothpick too which is appreciated. Only thing is, there are no seats
